<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "TennisRobot/ios/TennisCamera/Sources/CaptureStats.swift", "sha256": "58188fd75ad3b1246b0097bcb2d86db21bb74751ff97f8ab33d45aa555bf7a54", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````swift
import Foundation

/// Everything the UI and the status packet need, sampled atomically.
struct StatsSnapshot: Equatable {
    var captureFPS: Double = 0
    var detectorMedianMs: Double = 0
    var detectorP95Ms: Double = 0
    var packetRate: Double = 0
    var droppedFrames: Int = 0
    var frames: Int = 0
    var detections: Int = 0
    var packets: Int = 0
    var sequence: UInt32 = 0
    var lastDetectorMs: Double = 0
    /// u/v/radius/confidence of the most recent detection, for the UI.
    var lastUV: String = "—"
}

/// Lock-protected rolling counters written from the capture queue at 240 Hz and
/// read from the main thread at 5 Hz.
///
/// The windows are short on purpose: a 240-sample frame window is exactly one
/// second at the target rate, so "capture fps" is a one-second measurement
/// rather than a lifetime average that hides a stall.
final class CaptureStats: @unchecked Sendable {
    private static let windowFrames = 240
    private static let windowDetector = 240
    private static let windowPackets = 480

    private let lock = NSLock()

    private var frameTimes: [UInt64] = []
    private var detectorTimes: [Double] = []
    private var packetTimes: [UInt64] = []

    private var droppedFrames = 0
    private var frames = 0
    private var detections = 0
    private var packets = 0
    private var sequence: UInt32 = 0
    private var lastDetectorMs: Double = 0
    private var lastUV: String = "—"

    func recordFrame(tNs: UInt64) {
        lock.lock()
        frames &+= 1
        frameTimes.append(tNs)
        if frameTimes.count > Self.windowFrames {
            frameTimes.removeFirst(frameTimes.count - Self.windowFrames)
        }
        lock.unlock()
    }

    func recordDropped() {
        lock.lock()
        droppedFrames &+= 1
        lock.unlock()
    }

    func recordDetector(milliseconds: Double) {
        lock.lock()
        lastDetectorMs = milliseconds
        detectorTimes.append(milliseconds)
        if detectorTimes.count > Self.windowDetector {
            detectorTimes.removeFirst(detectorTimes.count - Self.windowDetector)
        }
        lock.unlock()
    }

    func recordDetection(_ detection: BallDetection) {
        lock.lock()
        detections &+= 1
        lastUV = String(format: "%.0f, %.0f  r %.1f", detection.u, detection.v, detection.radius)
        lock.unlock()
    }

    /// One counter for every packet on the wire, observations and statuses
    /// alike, so a receiver can detect a gap from any cause.
    func nextSequence() -> UInt32 {
        lock.lock()
        defer { lock.unlock() }
        let current = sequence
        sequence &+= 1
        return current
    }

    func recordPacket(tNs: UInt64) {
        lock.lock()
        packets &+= 1
        packetTimes.append(tNs)
        if packetTimes.count > Self.windowPackets {
            packetTimes.removeFirst(packetTimes.count - Self.windowPackets)
        }
        lock.unlock()
    }

    func reset() {
        lock.lock()
        frameTimes.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)
        detectorTimes.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)
        packetTimes.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)
        droppedFrames = 0
        frames = 0
        detections = 0
        packets = 0
        sequence = 0
        lastDetectorMs = 0
        lastUV = "—"
        lock.unlock()
    }

    func snapshot() -> StatsSnapshot {
        lock.lock()
        let framesCopy = frameTimes
        let detectorCopy = detectorTimes
        let packetsCopy = packetTimes
        var result = StatsSnapshot()
        result.droppedFrames = droppedFrames
        result.frames = frames
        result.detections = detections
        result.packets = packets
        result.sequence = sequence
        result.lastDetectorMs = lastDetectorMs
        result.lastUV = lastUV
        lock.unlock()

        result.captureFPS = Rate.measure(framesCopy)
        result.packetRate = Rate.measure(packetsCopy)

        if !detectorCopy.isEmpty {
            let sorted = detectorCopy.sorted()
            result.detectorMedianMs = Metrics.percentile(sorted, 0.5)
            result.detectorP95Ms = Metrics.percentile(sorted, 0.95)
        }
        return result
    }

    private enum Rate {
        /// Events per second over the span covered by the samples.
        static func measure(_ times: [UInt64]) -> Double {
            guard times.count >= 2, let first = times.first, let last = times.last, last > first else {
                return 0
            }
            let span = Double(last - first) / 1e9
            guard span > 0 else { return 0 }
            return Double(times.count - 1) / span
        }
    }

    private enum Metrics {
        /// Nearest-rank percentile on an ascending array.
        static func percentile(_ sorted: [Double], _ fraction: Double) -> Double {
            guard !sorted.isEmpty else { return 0 }
            let index = Int((fraction * Double(sorted.count - 1)).rounded())
            return sorted[max(0, min(sorted.count - 1, index))]
        }
    }
}
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "TennisRobot/ios/TennisCamera/Sources/FlightModel.swift", "sha256": "a67ca46630419d40c185dd91bfc741b3c4dfe72f071cdd1f762e49dc7ccce1bb", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````swift
import Foundation
import simd

/// Tennis ball constants, matching `[ball]` in `config/default.toml`.
struct BallProperties: Equatable {
    var radiusM = 0.0335
    var massKg = 0.0575
    var dragCoefficient = 0.507
    var airDensityKgM3 = 1.225

    var areaM2: Double { Double.pi * radiusM * radiusM }
}

/// Translational flight with gravity and quadratic drag, integrated with RK4.
///
/// This is `src/tennisrobot/physics.py::FlightModel` with spin and wind fixed at
/// zero, for the same reason the Python defaults are: one camera cannot observe
/// spin, so fitting it would make the prediction look more certain than it is.
///
/// Everything here is in the camera frame (`x` right, `y` down, `z` forward), so
/// `gravity` is whatever direction the phone measured down to be. Nothing in
/// this type knows about world coordinates.
struct FlightModel: Equatable {
    var ball = BallProperties()
    /// Gravity in camera axes, m/s^2. Supplied from `CMDeviceMotion`.
    var gravity: SIMD3<Double>

    /// 0.5 * rho * A / m * Cd — the coefficient of `-|v| * v`.
    var dragScale: Double {
        0.5 * ball.airDensityKgM3 * ball.areaM2 / ball.massKg * ball.dragCoefficient
    }

    func acceleration(_ velocity: SIMD3<Double>) -> SIMD3<Double> {
        let speed = simd_length(velocity)
        guard speed > 1e-6 else { return gravity }
        return gravity - dragScale * speed * velocity
    }

    /// One RK4 step. `dt` may be negative: the same integration runs backwards,
    /// which is how a state at the newest observation seeds the fit window.
    func step(
        position: SIMD3<Double>,
        velocity: SIMD3<Double>,
        dt: Double
    ) -> (position: SIMD3<Double>, velocity: SIMD3<Double>) {
        guard dt != 0, dt.isFinite else { return (position, velocity) }

        let k1v = acceleration(velocity)
        let k1p = velocity

        let v2 = velocity + 0.5 * dt * k1v
        let k2v = acceleration(v2)
        let k2p = v2

        let v3 = velocity + 0.5 * dt * k2v
        let k3v = acceleration(v3)
        let k3p = v3

        let v4 = velocity + dt * k3v
        let k4v = acceleration(v4)
        let k4p = v4

        let positionNext = position + (dt / 6.0) * (k1p + 2.0 * k2p + 2.0 * k3p + k4p)
        let velocityNext = velocity + (dt / 6.0) * (k1v + 2.0 * k2v + 2.0 * k3v + k4v)
        return (positionNext, velocityNext)
    }
}
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "TennisRobot/ios/TennisCamera/Sources/FlightTracker.swift", "sha256": "191ecd791a1c026bd4373f021c65599a3a068b5a37f7141327b89e879f0c1f4f", "trailing_newline": true} -->

````````swift
import Foundation
import simd

/// One accepted detection with its capture time, in the form the tracker wants.
struct FlightSample: Equatable {
    let tNs: UInt64
    let u: Double
    let v: Double
    let radius: Double
    let confidence: Double
}

struct FlightState: Equatable {
    var position: SIMD3<Double>
    var velocity: SIMD3<Double>

    var speed: Double { simd_length(velocity) }
}

/// A fitted flight, and the crossing of the configured plane when the ball is
/// still heading towards it.
struct FlightPrediction: Equatable {
    let tNs: UInt64
    let state: FlightState
    let rmsPx: Double
    let radiusBiasPx: Double
    let observations: Int
    let intercept: SIMD3<Double>?
    let interceptTimeS: Double?
    let planeDistanceM: Double
}

/// Fits a gravity-plus-drag trajectory to the last window of detections and
/// predicts where it crosses a plane in front of the camera.
///
/// The estimator here mirrors `src/tennisrobot/estimator.py`, with the frame
/// changed from world to camera: depth comes only from apparent radius, and the
/// residuals are pixel centre and radius so the fit cannot trade one for the
/// other. Spin and wind stay at zero, because one camera cannot observe them.
///
/// The plane is at `z = planeDistanceM` in camera coordinates — perpendicular to
/// the optical axis. That is all a phone can know on its own: a strike plane
/// expressed in court coordinates needs the camera pose, which lives on the PC.
final class FlightTracker {
    struct Config: Equatable {
        var minObservations = 10
        var maxObservations = 60
        /// 0.18 s, about 43 samples at 240 fps. A shorter baseline cannot pin
        /// down velocity: at 0.05 s with 0.5 px of centre noise this model
        /// predicted a crossing metres from the truth while still passing the
        /// speed gate, which is the failure mode worth refusing outright.
        var minSpanS = 0.18
        /// Real flights fit at 0.7-0.9 px. A ball that is not flying — held, or
        /// resting — cannot follow a ballistic path at all and lands near 6 px,
        /// so this gate is what separates "tracking" from "a yellow blob on a
        /// string" rather than a loose sanity bound.
        var maxCenterRmsPx = 3.0
        var minSpeedMps = 3.0
        var maxSpeedMps = 45.0
        var minDepthM = 0.3
        var maxDepthM = 10.0
        /// Plane perpendicular to the optical axis, in front of the camera.
        var planeDistanceM = 1.0
        /// Refit every N samples; at 240 fps that is 60 Hz.
        var refitEvery = 4
        var maxIterations = 6
        var centerSigmaPx = 0.7
        var radiusSigmaPx = 1.0
        /// Longer than any plausible flight from detection to the plane.
        var predictionHorizonS = 2.0
        /// A gap this long ends the current track and starts a new one.
        var maxGapS = 0.05
        /// How far a candidate may be from the previous accepted detection and
        /// still be the same ball. A 12 m/s ball at 1.5 m moves about 25 px per
        /// frame, so this is loose enough for a fast ball and tight enough to
        /// reject an unrelated yellow blob elsewhere in the frame.
        var maxAssociationPx = 80.0
        /// The same ball cannot double or halve in projected size in one frame.
        var minRadiusRatio = 0.5
        var maxRadiusRatio = 2.0
    }

    private(set) var config: Config
    private(set) var fitCount = 0

    private var samples: [FlightSample] = []
    /// Last detection this track accepted, for candidate association.
    private var lastSample: FlightSample?
    /// Every candidate of the previous frame, used to prefer a moving blob when a
    /// track starts. A bright static object otherwise wins on confidence and the
    /// real ball is never followed at all.
    private var previousCandidates: [FlightSample] = []
    /// Why the last fit was refused. Silence on a device is the hardest thing to
    /// debug, so the reason is kept and logged at a readable rate.
    private(set) var lastRejection: String?
    private var lastLogNs: UInt64 = 0
    private var sinceLastFit = 0
    private var lastState: FlightState?
    private var lastStateNs: UInt64 = 0
    private var rejectedFits = 0

    init(config: Config = Config()) {
        self.config = config
    }

    var sampleCount: Int { samples.count }
    var rejectedFitCount: Int { rejectedFits }

    func update(config: Config) {
        self.config = config
    }

    func reset() {
        samples.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)
        lastSample = nil
        previousCandidates = []
        lastRejection = nil
        sinceLastFit = 0
        lastState = nil
        lastStateNs = 0
        fitCount = 0
        rejectedFits = 0
    }

    /// Feed every candidate of one frame. The tracker picks the candidate that
    /// continues the current track, because "highest confidence" is not the same
    /// as "the ball": a bright decoy elsewhere in the frame can win that contest
    /// frame by frame and tear the track apart.
    func add(_ candidates: [FlightSample], camera: CameraModel, model: FlightModel) -> FlightPrediction? {
        defer { previousCandidates = candidates }
        guard let chosen = associate(candidates) else { return nil }
        return add(chosen, camera: camera, model: model)
    }

    /// Nearest candidate to the last accepted detection, within the gates. Nil
    /// when nothing matches, which lets the gap rule end the track instead of
    /// gluing it to a different blob.
    func associate(_ candidates: [FlightSample]) -> FlightSample? {
        guard !candidates.isEmpty else { return nil }
        guard let last = lastSample else {
            // No track yet. Start only on a candidate that moved between the last
            // two frames: a ball does, a bright static object does not. Waiting a
            // frame costs 4 ms and stops the brightest blob in the scene from
            // owning the track from the start.
            guard !previousCandidates.isEmpty else { return nil }
            return Self.mostRecentlyMoving(candidates, than: previousCandidates)
        }
        var best: FlightSample?
        var bestDistance = Double.infinity
        for candidate in candidates {
            let dx = candidate.u - last.u
            let dy = candidate.v - last.v
            let distance = (dx * dx + dy * dy).squareRoot()
            guard distance <= config.maxAssociationPx else { continue }
            let ratio = candidate.radius / max(last.radius, 0.25)
            guard ratio >= config.minRadiusRatio, ratio <= config.maxRadiusRatio else { continue }
            if distance < bestDistance {
                bestDistance = distance
                best = candidate
            }
        }
        return best
    }

    /// The candidate that moved a plausible amount since the previous frame,
    /// taking the smallest such movement. Static blobs sit within a pixel of
    /// themselves; a ball at 240 fps does not. Among movers, the closest
    /// continuation is the least likely to be a random flicker.
    static func mostRecentlyMoving(
        _ candidates: [FlightSample],
        than previous: [FlightSample],
        minimumPx: Double = 1.5,
        maximumPx: Double = 80
    ) -> FlightSample? {
        guard !previous.isEmpty else { return nil }
        var best: FlightSample?
        var bestMove = maximumPx
        for candidate in candidates {
            var nearest = Double.infinity
            for prior in previous {
                let dx = prior.u - candidate.u
                let dy = prior.v - candidate.v
                nearest = min(nearest, (dx * dx + dy * dy).squareRoot())
            }
            guard nearest >= minimumPx, nearest < bestMove else { continue }
            bestMove = nearest
            best = candidate
        }
        return best
    }

    /// Feed one detection that has already been chosen. Returns a prediction when
    /// a fit was due and passed the gates.
    func add(_ sample: FlightSample, camera: CameraModel, model: FlightModel) -> FlightPrediction? {
        if let previous = samples.last {
            let gap = Double(sample.tNs &- previous.tNs) / 1e9
            if sample.tNs >= previous.tNs && gap > config.maxGapS {
                reset()
            }
        }

        samples.append(sample)
        lastSample = sample
        if samples.count > config.maxObservations {
            samples.removeFirst(samples.count - config.maxObservations)
        }

        sinceLastFit += 1
        guard samples.count >= config.minObservations,
              sinceLastFit >= max(1, config.refitEvery)
        else { return nil }

        guard let span = spanSeconds(), span >= config.minSpanS else { return nil }
        sinceLastFit = 0
        guard let fitted = fit(camera: camera, model: model) else {
            rejectedFits += 1
            lastState = nil
            note("fit failed", at: sample.tNs)
            return nil
        }

        let speed = fitted.state.speed
        let depth = fitted.state.position.z
        if fitted.rmsPx > config.maxCenterRmsPx {
            rejectedFits += 1
            lastState = nil
            note(String(format: "rms %.1f px > %.1f (%d obs, span %.2f s)",
                        fitted.rmsPx, config.maxCenterRmsPx, samples.count, span), at: sample.tNs)
            return nil
        }
        if speed < config.minSpeedMps || speed > config.maxSpeedMps {
            rejectedFits += 1
            lastState = nil
            note(String(format: "speed %.1f m/s outside %.1f..%.1f",
                        speed, config.minSpeedMps, config.maxSpeedMps), at: sample.tNs)
            return nil
        }
        guard depth >= config.minDepthM, depth <= config.maxDepthM else {
            rejectedFits += 1
            lastState = nil
            note(String(format: "depth %.2f m outside %.1f..%.1f",
                        depth, config.minDepthM, config.maxDepthM), at: sample.tNs)
            return nil
        }

        fitCount += 1
        lastState = fitted.state
        lastStateNs = samples[samples.count - 1].tNs

        let crossing = intercept(from: fitted.state, model: model)
        lastRejection = nil
        note(String(format: "fit ok rms %.1f px speed %.1f m/s depth %.2f m%@",
                    fitted.rmsPx, speed, depth, crossing == nil ? " (no plane crossing)" : ""),
             at: sample.tNs)
        return FlightPrediction(
            tNs: lastStateNs,
            state: fitted.state,
            rmsPx: fitted.rmsPx,
            radiusBiasPx: fitted.radiusBiasPx,
            observations: samples.count,
            intercept: crossing?.point,
            interceptTimeS: crossing?.timeS,
            planeDistanceM: config.planeDistanceM
        )
    }

    /// At most two lines a second, so the console stays readable.
    private func note(_ message: String, at tNs: UInt64) {
        lastRejection = message
        guard tNs &- lastLogNs > 500_000_000 else { return }
        lastLogNs = tNs
        NSLog("TennisCamera tracker: %@", message)
    }

    // MARK: - Fit

    private struct Fitted {
        let state: FlightState
        let rmsPx: Double
        let radiusBiasPx: Double
    }

    private func spanSeconds() -> Double? {
        guard let first = samples.first, let last = samples.last, last.tNs > first.tNs else { return nil }
        return Double(last.tNs - first.tNs) / 1e9
    }

    private func fit(camera: CameraModel, model: FlightModel) -> Fitted? {
        guard let newest = samples.last else { return nil }
        let t0 = Double(newest.tNs) / 1e9

        var times = [Double](repeating: 0, count: samples.count)
        var us = [Double](repeating: 0, count: samples.count)
        var vs = [Double](repeating: 0, count: samples.count)
        var rs = [Double](repeating: 0, count: samples.count)
        for (index, sample) in samples.enumerated() {
            times[index] = Double(sample.tNs) / 1e9 - t0
            us[index] = sample.u
            vs[index] = sample.v
            rs[index] = sample.radius
        }

        // Warm start from the previous fit when it is close enough in time,
        // otherwise from the radius-derived linear fit.
        var initial: FlightState
        if let previous = lastState, lastStateNs > 0, lastStateNs <= newest.tNs,
           Double(newest.tNs - lastStateNs) / 1e9 <= config.maxGapS {
            let dt = t0 - Double(lastStateNs) / 1e9
            let moved = model.step(position: previous.position, velocity: previous.velocity, dt: dt)
            initial = FlightState(position: moved.position, velocity: moved.velocity)
        } else if let guess = linearGuess(camera: camera, model: model) {
            initial = guess
        } else {
            return nil
        }

        var params = [
            initial.position.x, initial.position.y, initial.position.z,
            initial.velocity.x, initial.velocity.y, initial.velocity.z,
        ]
        guard var base = residual(
            params: params, times: times, us: us, vs: vs, rs: rs, camera: camera, model: model
        ) else { return nil }

        var cost = Self.dot(base, base)
        let steps: [Double] = [1e-3, 1e-3, 1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-2, 1e-2]
        var damping = 1e-3

        for _ in 1...config.maxIterations {
            var jacobian = [[Double]](repeating: [Double](repeating: 0, count: 6), count: base.count)
            for column in 0..<6 {
                var trial = params
                trial[column] += steps[column]
                guard let trialResidual = residual(
                    params: trial, times: times, us: us, vs: vs, rs: rs, camera: camera, model: model
                ), trialResidual.count == base.count else { continue }
                for row in 0..<base.count {
                    jacobian[row][column] = (trialResidual[row] - base[row]) / steps[column]
                }
            }

            var normal = [[Double]](repeating: [Double](repeating: 0, count: 6), count: 6)
            var gradient = [Double](repeating: 0, count: 6)
            for row in 0..<base.count {
                for a in 0..<6 {
                    gradient[a] += jacobian[row][a] * base[row]
                    for b in a..<6 {
                        normal[a][b] += jacobian[row][a] * jacobian[row][b]
                    }
                }
            }
            for a in 0..<6 {
                for b in 0..<a {
                    normal[a][b] = normal[b][a]
                }
            }
            let diagonal = (0..<6).map { max(normal[$0][$0], 1e-12) }

            var accepted = false
            var deltaNorm = Double.infinity
            for _ in 0..<8 {
                var damped = normal
                for a in 0..<6 {
                    damped[a][a] += damping * diagonal[a]
                }
                guard var delta = Self.solve(damped, gradient.map { -$0 }) else {
                    damping *= 10.0
                    continue
                }
                for a in 0..<3 {
                    delta[a] = min(max(delta[a], -0.75), 0.75)
                }
                for a in 3..<6 {
                    delta[a] = min(max(delta[a], -10.0), 10.0)
                }
                var trial = params
                for a in 0..<6 {
                    trial[a] += delta[a]
                }
                guard let trialResidual = residual(
                    params: trial, times: times, us: us, vs: vs, rs: rs, camera: camera, model: model
                ), trialResidual.count == base.count else {
                    damping *= 10.0
                    continue
                }
                let trialCost = Self.dot(trialResidual, trialResidual)
                if trialCost < cost {
                    let improvement = cost - trialCost
                    params = trial
                    base = trialResidual
                    cost = trialCost
                    damping = max(1e-9, damping / 3.0)
                    deltaNorm = delta.reduce(0) { $0 + $1 * $1 }.squareRoot()
                    accepted = true
                    if improvement <= 1e-6 * max(cost, 1e-12) {
                        deltaNorm = 0
                    }
                    break
                }
                damping *= 10.0
            }

            if !accepted || deltaNorm < 1e-6 {
                break
            }
        }

        // Residuals are scaled; convert back to pixels for the gates and report.
        var sumSquared = 0.0
        var radiusSum = 0.0
        for row in 0..<times.count {
            let du = base[row * 3] * config.centerSigmaPx
            let dv = base[row * 3 + 1] * config.centerSigmaPx
            let dr = base[row * 3 + 2] * config.radiusSigmaPx
            sumSquared += du * du + dv * dv
            radiusSum += dr
        }
        let rms = (sumSquared / Double(times.count)).squareRoot()
        guard rms.isFinite else { return nil }

        let state = FlightState(
            position: SIMD3<Double>(params[0], params[1], params[2]),
            velocity: SIMD3<Double>(params[3], params[4], params[5])
        )
        return Fitted(state: state, rmsPx: rms, radiusBiasPx: radiusSum / Double(times.count))
    }

    /// Residuals at every sample: `(du, dv, dr)` scaled by their sigmas, newest
    /// sample first. The state is carried backwards from the newest sample, so
    /// the fitted parameters are the state at that sample's time.
    private func residual(
        params: [Double],
        times: [Double],
        us: [Double],
        vs: [Double],
        rs: [Double],
        camera: CameraModel,
        model: FlightModel
    ) -> [Double]? {
        guard params.count == 6, !times.isEmpty else { return nil }
        var position = SIMD3<Double>(params[0], params[1], params[2])
        var velocity = SIMD3<Double>(params[3], params[4], params[5])
        var out = [Double](repeating: 0, count: times.count * 3)

        func evaluate(_ index: Int) -> Bool {
            guard let projected = camera.project(position, ballRadiusM: model.ball.radiusM) else {
                return false
            }
            out[index * 3] = (projected.u - us[index]) / config.centerSigmaPx
            out[index * 3 + 1] = (projected.v - vs[index]) / config.centerSigmaPx
            out[index * 3 + 2] = (projected.r - rs[index]) / config.radiusSigmaPx
            return true
        }

        guard evaluate(times.count - 1) else { return nil }
        if times.count > 1 {
            for index in stride(from: times.count - 2, through: 0, by: -1) {
                let dt = times[index] - times[index + 1]
                let stepped = model.step(position: position, velocity: velocity, dt: dt)
                position = stepped.position
                velocity = stepped.velocity
                guard evaluate(index) else { return nil }
            }
        }
        return out
    }

    /// Linear least squares on the per-sample 3D points, used to start the solve.
    private func linearGuess(camera: CameraModel, model: FlightModel) -> FlightState? {
        guard let newest = samples.last else { return nil }
        let t0 = Double(newest.tNs) / 1e9
        var times: [Double] = []
        var points: [SIMD3<Double>] = []
        for sample in samples {
            guard let depth = camera.depth(radiusPx: sample.radius, ballRadiusM: model.ball.radiusM),
                  depth >= config.minDepthM, depth <= config.maxDepthM
            else { continue }
            times.append(Double(sample.tNs) / 1e9 - t0)
            points.append(camera.backProject(u: sample.u, v: sample.v, depthM: depth))
        }
        guard times.count >= 3 else { return nil }

        let count = Double(times.count)
        let sumT = times.reduce(0, +)
        let sumT2 = times.reduce(0) { $0 + $1 * $1 }
        let denominator = count * sumT2 - sumT * sumT
        guard abs(denominator) > 1e-12 else { return nil }

        var position = SIMD3<Double>.zero
        var velocity = SIMD3<Double>.zero
        for axis in 0..<3 {
            let sumP = points.reduce(0.0) { $0 + $1[axis] }
            let sumPT = zip(points, times).reduce(0.0) { $0 + $1.0[axis] * $1.1 }
            position[axis] = (sumT2 * sumP - sumT * sumPT) / denominator
            velocity[axis] = (count * sumPT - sumT * sumP) / denominator
        }
        return FlightState(position: position, velocity: velocity)
    }

    // MARK: - Prediction

    /// Integrate forward until the ball crosses the plane in front of the camera.
    private func intercept(
        from state: FlightState,
        model: FlightModel
    ) -> (point: SIMD3<Double>, timeS: Double)? {
        let plane = config.planeDistanceM
        // Only a ball coming towards the camera plane has a crossing ahead.
        guard state.position.z > plane, state.velocity.z < -0.5 else { return nil }

        var position = state.position
        var velocity = state.velocity
        var time = 0.0
        let dt = 0.001

        while time < config.predictionHorizonS {
            let next = model.step(position: position, velocity: velocity, dt: dt)
            if next.position.z <= plane {
                let travelled = position.z - next.position.z
                let fraction = travelled > 1e-9 ? (position.z - plane) / travelled : 1.0
                let point = position + fraction * (next.position - position)
                return (SIMD3<Double>(point.x, point.y, plane), time + fraction * dt)
            }
            position = next.position
            velocity = next.velocity
            time += dt
            if position.z > 50 {
                return nil
            }
        }
        return nil
    }

    // MARK: - Small linear algebra

    private static func dot(_ a: [Double], _ b: [Double]) -> Double {
        var total = 0.0
        for index in 0..<min(a.count, b.count) {
            total += a[index] * b[index]
        }
        return total
    }

    /// Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting.
    private static func solve(_ matrix: [[Double]], _ rhs: [Double]) -> [Double]? {
        let n = rhs.count
        guard n > 0, matrix.count == n, matrix.allSatisfy({ $0.count == n }) else { return nil }
        var a = matrix
        var b = rhs

        for column in 0..<n {
            var pivot = column
            for row in (column + 1)..<n where abs(a[row][column]) > abs(a[pivot][column]) {
                pivot = row
            }
            guard abs(a[pivot][column]) > 1e-14 else { return nil }
            if pivot != column {
                a.swapAt(pivot, column)
                b.swapAt(pivot, column)
            }
            if column + 1 < n {
                for row in (column + 1)..<n {
                    let factor = a[row][column] / a[column][column]
                    if factor == 0 { continue }
                    for c in column..<n {
                        a[row][c] -= factor * a[column][c]
                    }
                    b[row] -= factor * b[column]
                }
            }
        }

        var solution = [Double](repeating: 0, count: n)
        for row in stride(from: n - 1, through: 0, by: -1) {
            var sum = b[row]
            if row + 1 < n {
                for c in (row + 1)..<n {
                    sum -= a[row][c] * solution[c]
                }
            }
            solution[row] = sum / a[row][row]
        }
        return solution
    }
}
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "TennisRobot/ios/TennisCamera/Sources/ObservationPacket.swift", "sha256": "3a1027178c44ee0d8d784a5a00d8f49a4095b88f5c6f847d3e523a66746f5a4f", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````swift
import CoreMedia
import Foundation

/// Fixed 40-byte observation packet shared with `tools/iproxy_receiver.py` and,
/// later, the Windows PC's `RemoteObservationSource`.
///
/// Little-endian, no padding, no framing beyond the 40 bytes:
///
///     offset  size  field
///     0       4     magic          UInt32 = 0x424F5254 ("TROB" on the wire)
///     4       1     version        UInt8  = 1
///     5       1     kind           UInt8  = 0 observation, 1 status,
///                                    2 flight state, 3 intercept
///     6       2     header_size    UInt16 = 40
///     8       4     sequence       UInt32
///     12      8     t_capture_ns   UInt64
///     20      4     u              Float32
///     24      4     v              Float32
///     28      4     radius         Float32
///     32      4     confidence     Float32
///     36      2     width          UInt16
///     38      2     height         UInt16
///
/// Python equivalent: `struct.Struct("<I B B H I Q f f f f H H")`.
struct ObservationPacket {
    static let magic: UInt32 = 0x424F_5254
    static let version: UInt8 = 1
    static let headerSize: UInt16 = 40
    static let byteCount = 40

    enum Kind: UInt8 {
        case observation = 0
        case status = 1
        /// Fitted 3D state, camera frame, metres.
        case state = 2
        /// Predicted crossing of the plane in front of the camera.
        case intercept = 3
    }

    var kind: Kind
    var sequence: UInt32
    /// Presentation timestamp of the sample buffer, in nanoseconds. Never the
    /// wall clock at send time.
    var tCaptureNs: UInt64
    var u: Float
    var v: Float
    var radius: Float
    var confidence: Float
    var width: UInt16
    var height: UInt16

    static func observation(
        _ detection: BallDetection,
        sequence: UInt32,
        tCaptureNs: UInt64,
        width: Int,
        height: Int
    ) -> ObservationPacket {
        ObservationPacket(
            kind: .observation,
            sequence: sequence,
            tCaptureNs: tCaptureNs,
            u: detection.u,
            v: detection.v,
            radius: detection.radius,
            confidence: detection.confidence,
            width: UInt16(clamping: width),
            height: UInt16(clamping: height)
        )
    }

    /// Status packets reuse the same layout with a different meaning:
    /// `u` = measured fps, `v` = median detector ms, `radius` = dropped frames,
    /// `confidence` = thermal state (0 nominal ... 3 critical).
    static func status(
        sequence: UInt32,
        tCaptureNs: UInt64,
        measuredFPS: Double,
        detectorMedianMs: Double,
        droppedFrames: Int,
        thermalState: Int,
        width: Int,
        height: Int
    ) -> ObservationPacket {
        ObservationPacket(
            kind: .status,
            sequence: sequence,
            tCaptureNs: tCaptureNs,
            u: Float(measuredFPS),
            v: Float(detectorMedianMs),
            radius: Float(droppedFrames),
            confidence: Float(thermalState),
            width: UInt16(clamping: width),
            height: UInt16(clamping: height)
        )
    }

    /// `kind = 2`, sent when the tracker produces a fit. Payload in the shared
    /// layout: `u, v, radius` are the ball position **x, y, z in metres in the
    /// camera frame** (`x` right, `y` down, `z` forward), and `confidence` is
    /// the centre residual RMS in pixels. `t_capture_ns` is the capture time of
    /// the newest observation in the fit.
    static func flightState(
        sequence: UInt32,
        tCaptureNs: UInt64,
        x: Double,
        y: Double,
        z: Double,
        rmsPx: Double,
        width: Int,
        height: Int
    ) -> ObservationPacket {
        ObservationPacket(
            kind: .state,
            sequence: sequence,
            tCaptureNs: tCaptureNs,
            u: Float(x),
            v: Float(y),
            radius: Float(z),
            confidence: Float(rmsPx),
            width: UInt16(clamping: width),
            height: UInt16(clamping: height)
        )
    }

    /// `kind = 3`, the predicted crossing of the camera-frame plane `z = const`.
    /// `u, v, radius` are `x, y, z` at that crossing in metres and
    /// `confidence` is the time from `t_capture_ns` to the crossing in seconds.
    /// The PC still has to rotate this into court coordinates; the phone does
    /// not know where the court is.
    static func intercept(
        sequence: UInt32,
        tCaptureNs: UInt64,
        x: Double,
        y: Double,
        z: Double,
        timeToPlaneS: Double,
        width: Int,
        height: Int
    ) -> ObservationPacket {
        ObservationPacket(
            kind: .intercept,
            sequence: sequence,
            tCaptureNs: tCaptureNs,
            u: Float(x),
            v: Float(y),
            radius: Float(z),
            confidence: Float(timeToPlaneS),
            width: UInt16(clamping: width),
            height: UInt16(clamping: height)
        )
    }

    /// The wire encoding of `ProcessInfo.thermalState`: 0 nominal, 1 fair,
    /// 2 serious, 3 critical. Unknown future states report nominal rather than
    /// inventing a value the PC would misread.
    static func thermalLevel(_ state: ProcessInfo.ThermalState) -> Int {
        switch state {
        case .nominal: return 0
        case .fair: return 1
        case .serious: return 2
        case .critical: return 3
        @unknown default: return 0
        }
    }

    /// Encode byte by byte. A Swift struct's memory layout is not the wire
    /// format: padding and field order are both compiler details.
    func encode() -> Data {
        var data = Data(capacity: Self.byteCount)
        data.appendLittleEndian(Self.magic)
        data.appendLittleEndian(Self.version)
        data.appendLittleEndian(kind.rawValue)
        data.appendLittleEndian(Self.headerSize)
        data.appendLittleEndian(sequence)
        data.appendLittleEndian(tCaptureNs)
        data.appendLittleEndianFloat(u)
        data.appendLittleEndianFloat(v)
        data.appendLittleEndianFloat(radius)
        data.appendLittleEndianFloat(confidence)
        data.appendLittleEndian(width)
        data.appendLittleEndian(height)
        return data
    }

    /// Decoder used by the unit tests to prove round-tripping and offsets.
    init?(decoding data: Data) {
        guard data.count == Self.byteCount else { return nil }
        let bytes = [UInt8](data)
        func read<T: FixedWidthInteger>(_ offset: Int, _ type: T.Type) -> T {
            var value: T = 0
            Swift.withUnsafeMutableBytes(of: &value) { raw in
                for i in 0..<MemoryLayout<T>.size {
                    raw[i] = bytes[offset + i]
                }
            }
            return T(littleEndian: value)
        }
        func readFloat(_ offset: Int) -> Float {
            Float(bitPattern: read(offset, UInt32.self))
        }

        guard read(0, UInt32.self) == Self.magic else { return nil }
        guard read(4, UInt8.self) == Self.version else { return nil }
        guard let kind = Kind(rawValue: read(5, UInt8.self)) else { return nil }
        guard read(6, UInt16.self) == Self.headerSize else { return nil }

        self.kind = kind
        self.sequence = read(8, UInt32.self)
        self.tCaptureNs = read(12, UInt64.self)
        self.u = readFloat(20)
        self.v = readFloat(24)
        self.radius = readFloat(28)
        self.confidence = readFloat(32)
        self.width = read(36, UInt16.self)
        self.height = read(38, UInt16.self)
    }

    init(
        kind: Kind,
        sequence: UInt32,
        tCaptureNs: UInt64,
        u: Float,
        v: Float,
        radius: Float,
        confidence: Float,
        width: UInt16,
        height: UInt16
    ) {
        self.kind = kind
        self.sequence = sequence
        self.tCaptureNs = tCaptureNs
        self.u = u
        self.v = v
        self.radius = radius
        self.confidence = confidence
        self.width = width
        self.height = height
    }
}

private extension Data {
    mutating func appendLittleEndian<T: FixedWidthInteger>(_ value: T) {
        var little = value.littleEndian
        Swift.withUnsafeBytes(of: &little) { append(contentsOf: $0) }
    }

    mutating func appendLittleEndianFloat(_ value: Float) {
        appendLittleEndian(value.bitPattern)
    }
}

/// Presentation timestamps from `CMSampleBuffer` and wall-clock status stamps
/// both come from the host time clock, so a receiver can compare them.
enum CaptureClock {
    /// Nanoseconds for a `CMTime` without going through `Double` seconds.
    static func nanoseconds(from time: CMTime) -> UInt64 {
        guard time.isValid, !time.isIndefinite, time.timescale > 0 else { return 0 }
        let converted = CMTimeConvertScale(time, timescale: 1_000_000_000, method: .roundHalfAwayFromZero)
        return converted.value > 0 ? UInt64(converted.value) : 0
    }
}
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "TennisRobot/ios/TennisCamera/Sources/ObservationServer.swift", "sha256": "b802c297708708a88d1f2dfa85f507ca0d0dc6a3152b15dfa0dce2a4a8ca1ad2", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````swift
import Foundation
import Network

/// TCP listener for the observation packets.
///
/// The app listens and the host connects, because `iproxy` is what makes the
/// USB-C link look like a local TCP socket. Nothing here knows or cares whether
/// the peer arrived over USB, Ethernet or Wi-Fi: it accepts one client, streams
/// packets, and keeps capturing when that client goes away.
///
/// `TCP_NODELAY` is on so a 40-byte packet is not held back by Nagle waiting for
/// more payload; at 240 Hz the packets are already tiny and spaced.
final class ObservationServer: @unchecked Sendable {
    private let queue = DispatchQueue(label: "tennisrobot.observation.server", qos: .userInteractive)
    private let lock = NSLock()

    private var listener: NWListener?
    private var connection: NWConnection?

    private var _connected = false
    private var _port: UInt16 = 5000
    private var bindRetries = 0
    private var _lastError: String?
    private var _sentPackets: UInt64 = 0

    /// Called on the server queue whenever the connection or error state
    /// changes. Hop to the main thread before touching UI.
    var onStateChange: (@Sendable (Bool, String?) -> Void)?

    var isConnected: Bool {
        lock.lock()
        defer { lock.unlock() }
        return _connected
    }

    var port: UInt16 {
        lock.lock()
        defer { lock.unlock() }
        return _port
    }

    var lastError: String? {
        lock.lock()
        defer { lock.unlock() }
        return _lastError
    }

    var sentPackets: UInt64 {
        lock.lock()
        defer { lock.unlock() }
        return _sentPackets
    }

    func start(port: UInt16) {
        queue.async { [weak self] in
            self?.bindRetries = 0
            self?.startOnQueue(port: port)
        }
    }

    func stop() {
        queue.async { [weak self] in
            guard let self else { return }
            self.listener?.cancel()
            self.listener = nil
            self.connection?.cancel()
            self.connection = nil
            self.update { self._connected = false }
        }
    }

    func send(_ data: Data) {
        queue.async { [weak self] in
            guard let self, let connection = self.connection else { return }
            connection.send(content: data, completion: .contentProcessed { [weak self] error in
                guard let self else { return }
                if let error {
                    self.update {
                        self._lastError = "send: \(error.localizedDescription)"
                    }
                    self.notify()
                    self.drop(connection)
                } else {
                    self.update { self._sentPackets &+= 1 }
                }
            })
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Private

    private func startOnQueue(port: UInt16) {
        listener?.cancel()
        listener = nil
        connection?.cancel()
        connection = nil
        update {
            self._port = port
            self._connected = false
            self._lastError = nil
            self._sentPackets = 0
        }
        notify()

        guard let nwPort = NWEndpoint.Port(rawValue: port) else {
            fail("invalid port \(port)")
            return
        }

        let tcp = NWProtocolTCP.Options()
        tcp.noDelay = true
        tcp.enableKeepalive = true
        tcp.keepaliveIdle = 2

        let parameters = NWParameters(tls: nil, tcp: tcp)
        parameters.allowLocalEndpointReuse = true

        do {
            let listener = try NWListener(using: parameters, on: nwPort)
            listener.stateUpdateHandler = { [weak self] state in
                guard let self else { return }
                switch state {
                case .ready:
                    self.update { self._lastError = nil }
                    self.bindRetries = 0
                    self.notify()
                case .failed(let error):
                    // A listener left behind by a previous launch can hold the
                    // port for a moment after the process dies. Retrying is
                    // cheaper than making the operator relaunch the app.
                    if self.bindRetries < 2 {
                        self.bindRetries += 1
                        self.listener?.cancel()
                        self.listener = nil
                        NSLog("TennisCamera: listen on %d failed (%@), retrying",
                              Int(port), error.localizedDescription)
                        self.queue.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.75) { [weak self] in
                            self?.startOnQueue(port: port)
                        }
                    } else {
                        NSLog("TennisCamera: listen on %d failed again: %@",
                              Int(port), error.localizedDescription)
                        self.fail("listen: \(error.localizedDescription)")
                        self.update { self._connected = false }
                        self.notify()
                    }
                case .cancelled:
                    break
                default:
                    break
                }
            }
            listener.newConnectionHandler = { [weak self] connection in
                self?.accept(connection)
            }
            self.listener = listener
            listener.start(queue: self.queue)
        } catch {
            fail("listen: \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }
    }

    private func accept(_ newConnection: NWConnection) {
        // One client at a time. A reconnect replaces the old data path instead of
        // waiting for its state machine to notice, because a half-open socket
        // after `iproxy` restarts can sit in `.ready` indefinitely.
        connection?.cancel()
        connection = newConnection

        newConnection.stateUpdateHandler = { [weak self] state in
            guard let self else { return }
            switch state {
            case .ready:
                self.update {
                    self._connected = true
                    self._lastError = nil
                }
                self.notify()
            case .failed(let error), .waiting(let error):
                self.update { self._lastError = error.localizedDescription }
                self.markDisconnected(newConnection)
            case .cancelled:
                self.markDisconnected(newConnection)
            default:
                break
            }
        }
        newConnection.start(queue: queue)
        drain(newConnection)
    }

    /// Read and discard anything the peer sends, so a clean close is noticed.
    private func drain(_ connection: NWConnection) {
        connection.receive(minimumIncompleteLength: 1, maximumLength: 256) { [weak self] _, _, isComplete, error in
            guard let self else { return }
            if isComplete || error != nil {
                self.markDisconnected(connection)
                return
            }
            self.drain(connection)
        }
    }

    private func drop(_ connection: NWConnection) {
        guard self.connection === connection else { return }
        self.connection = nil
        connection.cancel()
        update { self._connected = false }
        notify()
    }

    private func markDisconnected(_ connection: NWConnection) {
        guard self.connection === connection else { return }
        self.connection = nil
        update { self._connected = false }
        notify()
    }

    private func fail(_ message: String) {
        update { self._lastError = message }
        notify()
    }

    private func update(_ body: () -> Void) {
        lock.lock()
        body()
        lock.unlock()
    }

    private func notify() {
        lock.lock()
        let connected = _connected
        let error = _lastError
        lock.unlock()
        onStateChange?(connected, error)
    }
}
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "TennisRobot/ios/TennisCamera/Sources/RacketLink.swift", "sha256": "3f44f7e885cc7e7d7521cab843173060aadddab7bdba52ea3a9cb90c8e2358d4", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````swift
import CoreBluetooth
import Foundation

/// Minimal BLE client for the Tennis Buddee racket (protocol: firmware/include/protocol.h). It forwards the
/// raw notifications, stamped on arrival with the camera's clock, and decodes nothing: conversion to physical
/// units happens offline, where the packet's flags and the status packet say which scales applied.
final class RacketLink: NSObject, @unchecked Sendable {
    struct Snapshot {
        var state = "off"
        var imuPackets = 0
        var lostPackets = 0
        var packetsPerSecond = 0.0
        var gyro4000 = false
        var batteryMV = 0
        /// Packets the racket itself dropped because its BLE queue was full (status packet, since boot).
        var racketDropped = 0
    }

    private static let serviceUUID = CBUUID(string: "7E5B0001-6B1D-4D8E-9C1A-7E5B7E5B0001")
    private static let imuUUID = CBUUID(string: "7E5B0002-6B1D-4D8E-9C1A-7E5B7E5B0001")
    private static let statusUUID = CBUUID(string: "7E5B0003-6B1D-4D8E-9C1A-7E5B7E5B0001")
    private static let controlUUID = CBUUID(string: "7E5B0004-6B1D-4D8E-9C1A-7E5B7E5B0001")
    private static let shotUUID = CBUUID(string: "7E5B0005-6B1D-4D8E-9C1A-7E5B7E5B0001")
    private static let tapUUID = CBUUID(string: "7E5B0006-6B1D-4D8E-9C1A-7E5B7E5B0001")

    /// Every notification, with its arrival time on the camera clock. Called on the BLE queue.
    var onRecord: ((UInt64, SessionLogger.RacketKind, Data) -> Void)?

    private let queue = DispatchQueue(label: "tennisrobot.racket.ble", qos: .userInitiated)
    private var central: CBCentralManager?
    private var peripheral: CBPeripheral?
    private var wantsConnection = false

    private let lock = NSLock()
    private var snap = Snapshot()
    private var lastSeq: UInt16?
    private var windowStartNs: UInt64 = 0
    private var windowCount = 0
    private var lastStatus: Data?

    func snapshot() -> Snapshot {
        lock.lock()
        defer { lock.unlock() }
        return snap
    }

    /// The most recent status packet, so a session can begin with the racket's range settings on record.
    var latestStatus: Data? {
        lock.lock()
        defer { lock.unlock() }
        return lastStatus
    }

    func start() {
        queue.async {
            self.wantsConnection = true
            if self.central == nil {
                // Created on first use so the Bluetooth permission prompt appears when capture starts.
                self.central = CBCentralManager(delegate: self, queue: self.queue)
            } else {
                self.scanIfReady()
            }
        }
    }

    func stop() {
        queue.async {
            self.wantsConnection = false
            self.central?.stopScan()
            if let p = self.peripheral { self.central?.cancelPeripheralConnection(p) }
            self.peripheral = nil
            self.setState("off")
        }
    }

    private func setState(_ s: String) {
        lock.lock()
        snap.state = s
        lock.unlock()
    }

    private func scanIfReady() {
        guard wantsConnection, let central, central.state == .poweredOn, peripheral == nil else { return }
        if let known = central.retrieveConnectedPeripherals(withServices: [Self.serviceUUID]).first {
            connect(known)
            return
        }
        setState("searching")
        central.scanForPeripherals(withServices: [Self.serviceUUID])
    }

    private func connect(_ p: CBPeripheral) {
        central?.stopScan()
        peripheral = p
        p.delegate = self
        setState("connecting")
        // A fresh link starts a fresh count; otherwise earlier runs' losses pile onto this one.
        lock.lock()
        snap.imuPackets = 0
        snap.lostPackets = 0
        snap.packetsPerSecond = 0
        lastSeq = nil
        windowStartNs = 0
        windowCount = 0
        lock.unlock()
        central?.connect(p)
    }

    private func handleIMU(_ data: Data, at t: UInt64) {
        guard data.count >= 8 else { return }
        let seq = UInt16(data[data.startIndex]) | UInt16(data[data.startIndex + 1]) << 8
        let flags = data[data.startIndex + 7]
        lock.lock()
        if let last = lastSeq {
            let gap = Int(seq &- last) - 1
            if gap > 0 && gap < 1000 { snap.lostPackets += gap }
        }
        lastSeq = seq
        snap.imuPackets += 1
        snap.gyro4000 = flags & (1 << 3) != 0
        if windowStartNs == 0 { windowStartNs = t }
        windowCount += 1
        if t - windowStartNs >= 1_000_000_000 {
            snap.packetsPerSecond = Double(windowCount) / (Double(t - windowStartNs) / 1e9)
            windowStartNs = t
            windowCount = 0
        }
        lock.unlock()
    }
}

extension RacketLink: CBCentralManagerDelegate, CBPeripheralDelegate {
    func centralManagerDidUpdateState(_ central: CBCentralManager) {
        switch central.state {
        case .poweredOn: setState("idle"); scanIfReady()
        case .unauthorized: setState("Bluetooth permission needed")
        default: setState("Bluetooth off")
        }
    }

    func centralManager(_ central: CBCentralManager, didDiscover peripheral: CBPeripheral,
                        advertisementData: [String: Any], rssi RSSI: NSNumber) {
        connect(peripheral)
    }

    func centralManager(_ central: CBCentralManager, didConnect peripheral: CBPeripheral) {
        lock.lock()
        lastSeq = nil
        windowStartNs = 0
        windowCount = 0
        lock.unlock()
        peripheral.discoverServices([Self.serviceUUID])
    }

    func centralManager(_ central: CBCentralManager, didFailToConnect peripheral: CBPeripheral, error: Error?) {
        self.peripheral = nil
        setState("idle")
        scanIfReady()
    }

    func centralManager(_ central: CBCentralManager, didDisconnectPeripheral peripheral: CBPeripheral, error: Error?) {
        self.peripheral = nil
        setState("idle")
        scanIfReady()
    }

    func peripheral(_ peripheral: CBPeripheral, didDiscoverServices error: Error?) {
        guard let service = peripheral.services?.first(where: { $0.uuid == Self.serviceUUID }) else { return }
        peripheral.discoverCharacteristics(
            [Self.imuUUID, Self.statusUUID, Self.controlUUID, Self.shotUUID, Self.tapUUID], for: service)
    }

    func peripheral(_ peripheral: CBPeripheral, didDiscoverCharacteristicsFor service: CBService, error: Error?) {
        for c in service.characteristics ?? [] {
            switch c.uuid {
            case Self.imuUUID, Self.shotUUID, Self.tapUUID:
                peripheral.setNotifyValue(true, for: c)
            case Self.statusUUID:
                peripheral.setNotifyValue(true, for: c)
                peripheral.readValue(for: c)
            case Self.controlUUID:
                // Start the 1 kHz stream and ask for the wide gyro range; the range is also flagged in every
                // IMU packet, so the offline converter does not have to trust this setting.
                peripheral.writeValue(Data([0x01]), for: c, type: .withResponse)
                peripheral.writeValue(Data([0x11, 1]), for: c, type: .withResponse)
            default: break
            }
        }
        setState("connected")
    }

    func peripheral(_ peripheral: CBPeripheral, didUpdateValueFor characteristic: CBCharacteristic, error: Error?) {
        // Stamp first: everything after this is bookkeeping and would add to the apparent latency.
        let t = CaptureClock.nowNs
        guard let data = characteristic.value else { return }
        let kind: SessionLogger.RacketKind
        switch characteristic.uuid {
        case Self.imuUUID: kind = .imu; handleIMU(data, at: t)
        case Self.statusUUID:
            kind = .status
            lock.lock()
            lastStatus = data
            if data.count >= 2 { snap.batteryMV = Int(data[data.startIndex]) | Int(data[data.startIndex + 1]) << 8 }
            if data.count >= 8 { snap.racketDropped = Int(data[data.startIndex + 6]) | Int(data[data.startIndex + 7]) << 8 }
            lock.unlock()
        case Self.shotUUID: kind = .shot
        case Self.tapUUID: kind = .tap
        default: return
        }
        onRecord?(t, kind, data)
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import AVFoundation
import CoreMedia
import Foundation

extension CaptureClock {
    /// Now, on the same clock as `CMSampleBuffer` presentation timestamps, so a racket packet's arrival time
    /// and a camera frame's capture time can be subtracted directly.
    static var nowNs: UInt64 {
        nanoseconds(from: CMClockGetTime(CMClockGetHostTimeClock()))
    }
}

/// Writes one recording session to `Documents/sessions/<stamp>/` for offline analysis
/// (`tools/phone_session.py` in the repo root reads it). Every file is little-endian and every time is a
/// nanosecond count on the phone's host clock, the same clock as `t_capture_ns` in the observation packets.
///
///     frames.bin      u64 t_ns                                  one per delivered camera frame
///     detections.bin  u64 t_ns, f32 u, v, radius, confidence    one per ball candidate (24 bytes)
///     racket.bin      u64 t_ns, u8 kind, u16 length, payload    raw BLE notifications, t_ns = arrival
///     events.csv      t_ns,label                                 sync marks pressed by the user
///     video.mov       the 240 fps frames (optional)
///     video_frames.bin  u64 t_ns of each frame that reached video.mov, in file order (skipped frames are absent)
///     meta.json       format, device, counters
///
/// All file work runs on a utility queue; the capture queue only appends small values to a buffer.
final class SessionLogger: @unchecked Sendable {
    enum RacketKind: UInt8 {
        case imu = 1, status = 2, shot = 3, tap = 4
    }

    private final class LogFile {
        let handle: FileHandle
        var buffer = Data()
        init?(url: URL) {
            guard FileManager.default.createFile(atPath: url.path, contents: nil),
                  let handle = try? FileHandle(forWritingTo: url) else { return nil }
            self.handle = handle
        }
        func flush() {
            guard !buffer.isEmpty else { return }
            try? handle.write(contentsOf: buffer)
            buffer.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)
        }
        func flushIfLarge() {
            if buffer.count >= 64 * 1024 { flush() }
        }
        func close() {
            flush()
            try? handle.close()
        }
    }

    let directory: URL
    private let queue = DispatchQueue(label: "tennisrobot.session.log", qos: .utility)
    private let frames: LogFile?
    private let detections: LogFile?
    private let racket: LogFile?
    private let events: LogFile?
    private let videoIndex: LogFile?
    private var meta: [String: Any]
    private var frameCount = 0
    private var detectionCount = 0
    private var racketCount = 0
    private var firstFrameNs: UInt64 = 0

    // Video writer state, touched from the capture queue and `finish`.
    private let videoLock = NSLock()
    private let wantsVideo: Bool
    private var writer: AVAssetWriter?
    private var videoInput: AVAssetWriterInput?
    private var videoFailed: String?
    private var videoClosed = false
    private var videoFrames = 0
    private var videoSkipped = 0

    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - info: written to meta.json as-is (format, device, thermal state, ...).
    init?(info: [String: Any], recordVideo: Bool) {
        let formatter = DateFormatter()
        formatter.dateFormat = "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss"
        let stamp = formatter.string(from: Date())
        guard let documents = FileManager.default.urls(for: .documentDirectory, in: .userDomainMask).first else {
            return nil
        }
        let dir = documents.appendingPathComponent("sessions", isDirectory: true)
            .appendingPathComponent(stamp, isDirectory: true)
        guard (try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: dir, withIntermediateDirectories: true)) != nil,
              let frames = LogFile(url: dir.appendingPathComponent("frames.bin")),
              let detections = LogFile(url: dir.appendingPathComponent("detections.bin")),
              let racket = LogFile(url: dir.appendingPathComponent("racket.bin")),
              let events = LogFile(url: dir.appendingPathComponent("events.csv")),
              let videoIndex = LogFile(url: dir.appendingPathComponent("video_frames.bin"))
        else { return nil }
        directory = dir
        self.frames = frames
        self.detections = detections
        self.racket = racket
        self.events = events
        self.videoIndex = videoIndex
        events.buffer.append(Data("t_ns,label\n".utf8))
        wantsVideo = recordVideo

        var meta = info
        meta["format_version"] = 1
        meta["started_wall"] = ISO8601DateFormatter().string(from: Date())
        meta["started_host_ns"] = CaptureClock.nowNs
        meta["clock"] = "CMClockGetHostTimeClock, nanoseconds"
        meta["video"] = recordVideo
        self.meta = meta
        writeMeta()
    }

    var name: String { directory.lastPathComponent }

    // MARK: Logging (any thread)

    func logFrame(_ tNs: UInt64) {
        queue.async {
            if self.frameCount == 0 { self.firstFrameNs = tNs }
            self.frameCount += 1
            self.frames?.buffer.appendLE(tNs)
            self.frames?.flushIfLarge()
        }
    }

    func logDetections(_ tNs: UInt64, _ list: [BallDetection]) {
        queue.async {
            for d in list {
                self.detectionCount += 1
                self.detections?.buffer.appendLE(tNs)
                self.detections?.buffer.appendLE(d.u.bitPattern)
                self.detections?.buffer.appendLE(d.v.bitPattern)
                self.detections?.buffer.appendLE(d.radius.bitPattern)
                self.detections?.buffer.appendLE(d.confidence.bitPattern)
            }
            self.detections?.flushIfLarge()
        }
    }

    func logRacket(tNs: UInt64, kind: RacketKind, payload: Data) {
        queue.async {
            self.racketCount += 1
            self.racket?.buffer.appendLE(tNs)
            self.racket?.buffer.append(kind.rawValue)
            self.racket?.buffer.appendLE(UInt16(truncatingIfNeeded: payload.count))
            self.racket?.buffer.append(payload)
            self.racket?.flushIfLarge()
        }
    }

    func mark(_ label: String) {
        let t = CaptureClock.nowNs
        let clean = label.replacingOccurrences(of: ",", with: ";")
        queue.async {
            self.events?.buffer.append(Data("\(t),\(clean)\n".utf8))
            self.events?.flush()
        }
    }

    // MARK: Video (capture queue)

    /// Appends the frame to video.mov. Does nothing when video is off. A frame the encoder cannot take right
    /// now is skipped and counted instead of blocking the capture queue.
    func appendVideo(_ sampleBuffer: CMSampleBuffer) {
        guard wantsVideo else { return }
        videoLock.lock()
        defer { videoLock.unlock() }
        if videoFailed != nil || videoClosed { return }
        if writer == nil {
            guard let format = CMSampleBufferGetFormatDescription(sampleBuffer) else { return }
            let dims = CMVideoFormatDescriptionGetDimensions(format)
            do {
                let w = try AVAssetWriter(url: directory.appendingPathComponent("video.mov"), fileType: .mov)
                let input = AVAssetWriterInput(mediaType: .video, outputSettings: [
                    AVVideoCodecKey: AVVideoCodecType.hevc,
                    AVVideoWidthKey: Int(dims.width),
                    AVVideoHeightKey: Int(dims.height),
                    AVVideoCompressionPropertiesKey: [
                        AVVideoAverageBitRateKey: 30_000_000,
                        AVVideoExpectedSourceFrameRateKey: 240,
                    ],
                ])
                input.expectsMediaDataInRealTime = true
                guard w.canAdd(input) else { videoFailed = "writer refused the video input"; return }
                w.add(input)
                guard w.startWriting() else {
                    videoFailed = w.error?.localizedDescription ?? "startWriting failed"
                    return
                }
                w.startSession(atSourceTime: CMSampleBufferGetPresentationTimeStamp(sampleBuffer))
                writer = w
                videoInput = input
            } catch {
                videoFailed = error.localizedDescription
                return
            }
        }
        guard let input = videoInput, let active = writer else { return }
        if active.status == .failed {
            videoFailed = active.error?.localizedDescription ?? "writer failed"
            return
        }
        if input.isReadyForMoreMediaData, input.append(sampleBuffer) {
            videoFrames += 1
            let t = CaptureClock.nanoseconds(from: CMSampleBufferGetPresentationTimeStamp(sampleBuffer))
            queue.async {
                self.videoIndex?.buffer.appendLE(t)
                self.videoIndex?.flushIfLarge()
            }
        } else {
            videoSkipped += 1
        }
    }

    // MARK: Finish

    /// Flushes everything, closes the video and rewrites meta.json with the counters.
    func finish(extra: [String: Any], completion: @escaping (String) -> Void) {
        // Closing under the lock means a frame already in flight on the capture queue cannot append afterwards.
        videoLock.lock()
        videoClosed = true
        let finishing = writer
        videoInput?.markAsFinished()
        videoLock.unlock()
        let closeFiles = { [self] (videoError: String?) in
            queue.async {
                self.frames?.close()
                self.detections?.close()
                self.racket?.close()
                self.events?.close()
                self.videoIndex?.close()
                var meta = self.meta
                extra.forEach { meta[$0.key] = $0.value }
                meta["stopped_host_ns"] = CaptureClock.nowNs
                meta["first_frame_ns"] = self.firstFrameNs
                meta["frames"] = self.frameCount
                meta["detections"] = self.detectionCount
                meta["racket_records"] = self.racketCount
                self.videoLock.lock()
                meta["video_frames"] = self.videoFrames
                meta["video_frames_skipped"] = self.videoSkipped
                let failure = videoError ?? self.videoFailed
                self.videoLock.unlock()
                if let failure { meta["video_error"] = failure }
                self.meta = meta
                self.writeMeta()
                var summary = "\(self.frameCount) frames, \(self.detectionCount) detections, \(self.racketCount) racket records"
                if self.wantsVideo { summary += ", video \(self.videoFrames) frames (\(self.videoSkipped) skipped)" }
                if let failure { summary += " — video error: \(failure)" }
                completion(summary)
            }
        }
        if let finishing, finishing.status == .writing {
            finishing.finishWriting { closeFiles(finishing.status == .failed ? finishing.error?.localizedDescription : nil) }
        } else {
            closeFiles(nil)
        }
    }

    private func writeMeta() {
        guard let data = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: meta, options: [.prettyPrinted, .sortedKeys]) else { return }
        try? data.write(to: directory.appendingPathComponent("meta.json"))
    }
}

extension Data {
    mutating func appendLE<T: FixedWidthInteger>(_ value: T) {
        Swift.withUnsafeBytes(of: value.littleEndian) { append(contentsOf: $0) }
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import XCTest
@testable import TennisCamera

/// Full-range 4:2:0 frame built from RGB rectangles and discs.
///
/// The chroma plane is averaged over each 2x2 block exactly as the camera ISP
/// does, so these tests also exercise the edge behaviour the real pipeline sees
/// rather than handing the detector a chroma plane that is too clean.
struct SyntheticFrame {
    struct Patch {
        var cx: Double
        var cy: Double
        var radius: Double
        var r: Double
        var g: Double
        var b: Double
    }

    let width: Int
    let height: Int
    var luma: [UInt8]
    var chroma: [UInt8]

    init(
        width: Int,
        height: Int,
        background: (Double, Double, Double),
        patches: [Patch] = [],
        stripe: (x: Int, y: Int, w: Int, h: Int, r: Double, g: Double, b: Double)? = nil
    ) {
        self.width = width
        self.height = height
        luma = [UInt8](repeating: 0, count: width * height)
        chroma = [UInt8](repeating: 0, count: (width / 2) * (height / 2) * 2)

        var rgb = [(Double, Double, Double)](repeating: background, count: width * height)

        if let s = stripe {
            for y in max(0, s.y)..<min(height, s.y + s.h) {
                for x in max(0, s.x)..<min(width, s.x + s.w) {
                    rgb[y * width + x] = (s.r, s.g, s.b)
                }
            }
        }

        for patch in patches {
            let x0 = max(0, Int(patch.cx - patch.radius) - 1)
            let x1 = min(width, Int(patch.cx + patch.radius) + 2)
            let y0 = max(0, Int(patch.cy - patch.radius) - 1)
            let y1 = min(height, Int(patch.cy + patch.radius) + 2)
            guard x0 < x1, y0 < y1 else { continue }
            for y in y0..<y1 {
                for x in x0..<x1 {
                    let dx = Double(x) - patch.cx
                    let dy = Double(y) - patch.cy
                    if dx * dx + dy * dy <= patch.radius * patch.radius {
                        rgb[y * width + x] = (patch.r, patch.g, patch.b)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for y in 0..<height {
            for x in 0..<width {
                let (r, g, b) = rgb[y * width + x]
                let yValue = 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b
                luma[y * width + x] = UInt8(clamping: Int(yValue.rounded()))
            }
        }

        let chromaWidth = width / 2
        for cy in 0..<(height / 2) {
            for cx in 0..<chromaWidth {
                var r = 0.0, g = 0.0, b = 0.0
                for dy in 0..<2 {
                    for dx in 0..<2 {
                        let (pr, pg, pb) = rgb[(cy * 2 + dy) * width + cx * 2 + dx]
                        r += pr; g += pg; b += pb
                    }
                }
                r /= 4; g /= 4; b /= 4
                let cb = -0.168_736 * r - 0.331_264 * g + 0.5 * b + 128
                let cr = 0.5 * r - 0.418_688 * g - 0.081_312 * b + 128
                let offset = (cy * chromaWidth + cx) * 2
                chroma[offset] = UInt8(clamping: Int(cb.rounded()))
                chroma[offset + 1] = UInt8(clamping: Int(cr.rounded()))
            }
        }
    }

    func detect(_ detector: BallDetector, roi: CGRect? = nil) -> [BallDetection] {
        luma.withUnsafeBufferPointer { lumaBuffer in
            chroma.withUnsafeBufferPointer { chromaBuffer in
                detector.detect(
                    luma: lumaBuffer.baseAddress!,
                    lumaStride: width,
                    chroma: chromaBuffer.baseAddress!,
                    chromaStride: width,
                    width: width,
                    height: height,
                    roi: roi
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

final class BallDetectorTests: XCTestCase {
    private let tennisBall = (r: 220.0, g: 235.0, b: 40.0)
    private let frameWidth = 1920
    private let frameHeight = 1080

    func testSyntheticYellowBallCentroidAndRadius() {
        let detector = BallDetector()
        let frame = SyntheticFrame(
            width: frameWidth,
            height: frameHeight,
            background: (40, 60, 90),
            patches: [.init(cx: 900, cy: 520, radius: 40, r: tennisBall.r, g: tennisBall.g, b: tennisBall.b)]
        )

        let detections = frame.detect(detector)
        XCTAssertEqual(detections.count, 1, "one synthetic ball in an empty scene")
        guard let detection = detections.first else { return }

        XCTAssertEqual(Double(detection.u), 900, accuracy: 1.0, "centroid u")
        XCTAssertEqual(Double(detection.v), 520, accuracy: 1.0, "centroid v")
        XCTAssertEqual(Double(detection.radius), 40, accuracy: 1.0, "radius sqrt(area/pi)")
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(detection.confidence, 0.9, "a disc should score as a disc")
    }

    func testGrayAndBlueFramesProduceNoDetection() {
        let detector = BallDetector()

        let gray = SyntheticFrame(width: frameWidth, height: frameHeight, background: (128, 128, 128))
        XCTAssertTrue(gray.detect(detector).isEmpty, "neutral gray is not a tennis ball")

        let blue = SyntheticFrame(width: frameWidth, height: frameHeight, background: (30, 70, 200))
        XCTAssertTrue(blue.detect(detector).isEmpty, "blue is not a tennis ball")

        // A bright, unsaturated warm wall must not pass either.
        let beige = SyntheticFrame(width: frameWidth, height: frameHeight, background: (200, 195, 170))
        XCTAssertTrue(beige.detect(detector).isEmpty, "unsaturated beige is not a tennis ball")
    }

    func testROIReportsFullFrameCoordinates() {
        let detector = BallDetector()
        let frame = SyntheticFrame(
            width: frameWidth,
            height: frameHeight,
            background: (40, 60, 90),
            patches: [.init(cx: 600, cy: 400, radius: 25, r: tennisBall.r, g: tennisBall.g, b: tennisBall.b)]
        )

        // ROI covers x 480...960, y 270...540: the ball is inside it.
        let roi = CGRect(x: 0.25, y: 0.25, width: 0.25, height: 0.25)
        let inside = frame.detect(detector, roi: roi)
        XCTAssertEqual(inside.count, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(Double(inside.first?.u ?? 0), 600, accuracy: 1.0, "ROI offset must be added back")
        XCTAssertEqual(Double(inside.first?.v ?? 0), 400, accuracy: 1.0)

        // ROI that excludes the ball must find nothing.
        let elsewhere = CGRect(x: 0.6, y: 0.6, width: 0.35, height: 0.35)
        XCTAssertTrue(frame.detect(detector, roi: elsewhere).isEmpty)
    }

    func testYellowStripeIsRejectedByShape() {
        let detector = BallDetector()
        let stripe = SyntheticFrame(
            width: frameWidth,
            height: frameHeight,
            background: (40, 60, 90),
            stripe: (x: 700, y: 500, w: 520, h: 26, r: tennisBall.r, g: tennisBall.g, b: tennisBall.b)
        )
        XCTAssertTrue(stripe.detect(detector).isEmpty, "a long yellow stripe is not a ball")
    }

    func testTwoBallsAreBothReported() {
        let detector = BallDetector()
        let frame = SyntheticFrame(
            width: frameWidth,
            height: frameHeight,
            background: (40, 60, 90),
            patches: [
                .init(cx: 500, cy: 400, radius: 18, r: tennisBall.r, g: tennisBall.g, b: tennisBall.b),
                .init(cx: 1400, cy: 700, radius: 30, r: tennisBall.r, g: tennisBall.g, b: tennisBall.b),
            ]
        )

        let detections = frame.detect(detector)
        XCTAssertEqual(detections.count, 2)
        let us = Set(detections.map { Int(($0.u / 100).rounded()) })
        XCTAssertEqual(us, [5, 14], "both centroids present")
    }

    /// Not a performance gate (the simulator is not the phone), but a regression
    /// guard: this detector is supposed to be a couple of milliseconds, not tens.
    func testFullFrameDetectorTiming() {
        let detector = BallDetector()
        let frame = SyntheticFrame(
            width: frameWidth,
            height: frameHeight,
            background: (150, 160, 120),
            patches: [.init(cx: 900, cy: 520, radius: 40, r: tennisBall.r, g: tennisBall.g, b: tennisBall.b)]
        )

        var samples: [Double] = []
        for _ in 0..<30 {
            let start = DispatchTime.now().uptimeNanoseconds
            _ = frame.detect(detector)
            samples.append(Double(DispatchTime.now().uptimeNanoseconds - start) / 1e6)
        }
        let sorted = samples.sorted()
        let median = sorted[sorted.count / 2]
        print(String(format: "detector 1920x1080 full frame: median %.2f ms, p95 %.2f ms (simulator)",
                     median, sorted[Int(Double(sorted.count) * 0.95)]))
        XCTAssertLessThan(median, 40, "detector should stay in single-digit ms")
    }
}
````````
