<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "apple/RacketKit/Sources/RacketKit/FirmwareImage.swift", "sha256": "21ab232c7926935ea636a279e10cc681dd82b804bf972ca3d13d07caf252a01c", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````swift
import Foundation
import CryptoKit

/// Racket firmware the apps can install over BLE. firmware/tools/bundle_for_app.sh puts the current build
/// in the app as RacketFirmware.bin plus RacketFirmware.json ({ "version": "1.2" }).
public struct FirmwareImage: Sendable {
    public let data: Data
    /// Major.minor as the racket reports it; nil for a file picked by hand.
    public let version: String?

    public init(data: Data, version: String?) {
        self.data = Data(data)   // zero-based indices for chunking
        self.version = version
    }

    /// The image bundled with the app, if any.
    public static func bundled(in bundle: Bundle = .main) -> FirmwareImage? {
        guard let bin = bundle.url(forResource: "RacketFirmware", withExtension: "bin"),
              let json = bundle.url(forResource: "RacketFirmware", withExtension: "json"),
              let data = try? Data(contentsOf: bin),
              let meta = try? JSONDecoder().decode([String: String].self, from: Data(contentsOf: json)),
              let version = meta["version"] else { return nil }
        if let expected = meta["sha256"], Self.sha256(data) != expected.lowercased() { return nil }
        let image = FirmwareImage(data: data, version: version)
        return image.looksValid ? image : nil
    }

    /// ESP32 app images start with magic byte 0xE9; catches picking the wrong file.
    public var looksValid: Bool { data.count > 1024 && data.first == 0xE9 }

    static func sha256(_ data: Data) -> String {
        SHA256.hash(data: data).map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
    }

    /// True if this image is newer than the racket's reported version ("1.10" is newer than "1.9").
    public func isNewer(than installed: String) -> Bool {
        guard let version else { return false }
        let a = version.split(separator: ".").map { Int($0) ?? 0 }
        let b = installed.split(separator: ".").map { Int($0) ?? 0 }
        for i in 0..<max(a.count, b.count) {
            let x = i < a.count ? a[i] : 0, y = i < b.count ? b[i] : 0
            if x != y { return x > y }
        }
        return false
    }

    /// Standard CRC-32 (as zlib); the racket checks the received image against it.
    public var crc32: UInt32 {
        var c: UInt32 = 0xFFFF_FFFF
        for byte in data {
            c ^= UInt32(byte)
            for _ in 0..<8 { c = (c >> 1) ^ (0xEDB8_8320 & (0 &- (c & 1))) }
        }
        return ~c
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import Foundation
import simd

/// The samples around one hit, as the racket sends them in impact mode (firmware 1.5+).
public struct ImpactWindow: Sendable {
    public var seq: UInt16
    /// Index of the impact sample in `samples`.
    public var impactIndex: Int
    /// Sensor axes → world (z up) at `samples[0]`, from the racket's orientation filter.
    public var startOrientation: simd_quatf
    /// 1 kHz samples in sensor axes, as `RacketProtocol.convert` produces them.
    public var samples: [IMUSample]
    /// The racket's boot number in acked mode (firmware 1.6+), else nil.
    public var boot: UInt16?
    /// Captured while the link was busy or down, and sent late.
    public var backlog = false

    public init(seq: UInt16, impactIndex: Int, startOrientation: simd_quatf, samples: [IMUSample], boot: UInt16? = nil) {
        self.seq = seq
        self.impactIndex = impactIndex
        self.startOrientation = startOrientation
        self.samples = samples
        self.boot = boot
    }

    /// Names one window across reconnects and reboots (acked mode); seq alone restarts at every boot.
    public var key: WindowKey { WindowKey(boot: boot, seq: seq) }
}

public struct WindowKey: Hashable, Sendable {
    public var boot: UInt16?
    public var seq: UInt16
}

/// A source that finds hits itself and sends only the samples around each one: the racket in impact mode.
/// Callbacks arrive on an arbitrary queue.
public protocol ImpactSource: AnyObject {
    var onImpactWindow: ((ImpactWindow) -> Void)? { get set }
    var onPose: ((RacketProtocol.Pose) -> Void)? { get set }
}

/// A racket that computes each shot itself (firmware 1.6+): it needs the app's calibration and profile, and sends a
/// `ShotSummary` before each window.
public protocol ShotSummarySource: AnyObject {
    var onShotSummary: ((RacketProtocol.ShotSummary) -> Void)? { get set }
    /// `RacketProtocol.shotConfigPayload`; the source sends it now and again after every reconnect.
    func setShotConfig(_ payload: Data)
}

/// Collects hits' window chunks into `ImpactWindow`s. In plain impact mode one window arrives at a time and a new
/// one abandons an unfinished one. In acked mode (chunks carry a boot number) several can be in flight, chunks the
/// racket resends fill the gaps, and `missing` says what to ask for.
public struct ImpactWindowAssembler {
    private struct Partial {
        var chunks: [RacketProtocol.WindowChunk?]
        var updated: Double
    }
    private var partials: [WindowKey: Partial] = [:]
    /// Windows abandoned because a chunk never arrived.
    public private(set) var incomplete = 0

    public init() {}

    /// Returns the window once its last chunk is in. `time` turns racket micros into seconds; `now` (any clock)
    /// timestamps partial windows for `missing`.
    public mutating func add(_ chunk: RacketProtocol.WindowChunk, h3lisRange: UInt8, now: Double = 0,
                             time: (UInt32) -> Double) -> ImpactWindow? {
        guard chunk.total > 0, chunk.index < chunk.total else { return nil }
        let key = WindowKey(boot: chunk.boot, seq: chunk.seq)
        if chunk.boot == nil {
            // Plain impact mode: windows arrive one after another and are never resent.
            for (k, p) in partials where k != key {
                if p.chunks.contains(where: { $0 != nil }) { incomplete += 1 }
                partials[k] = nil
            }
        } else if partials[key] == nil, partials.count >= 8,
                  let stale = partials.min(by: { $0.value.updated < $1.value.updated })?.key {
            partials[stale] = nil
            incomplete += 1
        }
        var p = partials[key] ?? Partial(chunks: Array(repeating: nil, count: chunk.total), updated: now)
        if p.chunks.count != chunk.total { p.chunks = Array(repeating: nil, count: chunk.total) }
        p.chunks[chunk.index] = chunk
        p.updated = now
        guard p.chunks.allSatisfy({ $0 != nil }) else {
            partials[key] = p
            return nil
        }
        partials[key] = nil
        let parts = p.chunks.compactMap { $0 }
        let scale = RacketProtocol.mpuGyroLSBPerDps / 2   // window gyro is always at 8.2 LSB/dps
        var samples: [IMUSample] = []
        samples.reserveCapacity(parts.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.samples.count })
        for part in parts {
            let t0 = time(part.t0Micros)
            for (k, raw) in part.samples.enumerated() {
                samples.append(RacketProtocol.convert(raw, time: t0 + Double(k) * 0.001, h3lisRange: h3lisRange,
                                                      gyroLSBPerDps: scale))
            }
        }
        guard parts[0].impact < samples.count else { return nil }
        var window = ImpactWindow(seq: chunk.seq, impactIndex: parts[0].impact,
                                  startOrientation: parts[0].startOrientation, samples: samples, boot: chunk.boot)
        window.backlog = parts.contains { $0.flags & RacketProtocol.flagBacklog != 0 }
        return window
    }

    /// Acked-mode windows with chunks missing and nothing new for `quietFor` seconds, with the missing chunk
    /// indexes. Marks them as just asked about, so each gap is requested once per `quietFor`.
    public mutating func missing(now: Double, quietFor: Double) -> [(key: WindowKey, chunks: [Int])] {
        var out: [(key: WindowKey, chunks: [Int])] = []
        for (key, p) in partials where key.boot != nil && now - p.updated >= quietFor {
            out.append((key, p.chunks.indices.filter { p.chunks[$0] == nil }))
            partials[key]?.updated = now
        }
        return out.sorted { $0.key.seq < $1.key.seq }
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import Foundation

/// Firmware versions whose rotation scale was checked against the physical robot.
public enum MotionFirmware {
    public static let minimumCorrectedVersion = "1.8"

    /// These builds flagged 4000 dps while the IMU remained at 2000 dps, doubling
    /// both the recorded angular rates and the firmware's orientation integration.
    /// Halving a displayed speed cannot repair the already-integrated orientation.
    public static func hasKnownGyroScaleBug(_ version: String) -> Bool {
        let parts = version.split(separator: ".", omittingEmptySubsequences: false)
        guard parts.count >= 2, let major = Int(parts[0]), let minor = Int(parts[1]) else { return false }
        return major == 1 && (5...7).contains(minor)
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import Foundation
import simd

/// Mahony complementary filter. Quaternion maps racket frame → world frame (world z = up).
/// The accelerometer only corrects tilt when the racket is near-still (|a| ≈ 1 g, slow rotation),
/// so fast swings rely on the gyro, which is accurate over the ~1 s a swing takes.
public struct MahonyFilter: Sendable {
    public var q = simd_quatf(ix: 0, iy: 0, iz: 0, r: 1)
    public var kp: Float = 2.0
    public var ki: Float = 0.05
    var integral = SIMD3<Float>(repeating: 0)
    var initialized = false
    /// Yaw offset applied when reporting, so "recenter" makes the current heading face forward.
    public var yawOffset = simd_quatf(ix: 0, iy: 0, iz: 0, r: 1)

    public init() {}

    public mutating func update(gyro: SIMD3<Float>, accel: SIMD3<Float>, dt: Float) {
        let aNorm = simd_length(accel)
        if !initialized, aNorm > 0.5 {
            q = Self.tiltOnly(accel: accel)
            initialized = true
        }
        var w = gyro
        if aNorm > 0.85, aNorm < 1.15, simd_length(gyro) < 3 {
            let a = accel / aNorm
            let upBody = q.inverse.act(SIMD3(0, 0, 1))
            let e = simd_cross(a, upBody)
            integral += ki * e * dt
            w += kp * e + integral
        }
        let angle = simd_length(w) * dt
        if angle > 1e-9 {
            q = simd_normalize(q * simd_quatf(angle: angle, axis: simd_normalize(w)))
        }
    }

    /// Orientation for display, with the recenter offset applied.
    public var displayOrientation: simd_quatf { yawOffset * q }

    /// Rotates the world about the vertical so the racket's current tip direction points along world +x (screen right).
    public mutating func recenter() {
        let tip = q.act(SIMD3(1, 0, 0))
        let yaw = atan2(tip.y, tip.x)
        yawOffset = simd_quatf(angle: -yaw, axis: SIMD3(0, 0, 1))
    }

    static func tiltOnly(accel: SIMD3<Float>) -> simd_quatf {
        // Rotation taking the measured "up" (body frame) to world up.
        simd_quatf(from: simd_normalize(accel), to: SIMD3(0, 0, 1))
    }
}
````````

````````swift
                                         model: ImpactModel) -> Data {
        func rows(_ m: simd_float3x3) -> [Float] {
            let t = m.transpose
            return [t.columns.0, t.columns.1, t.columns.2].flatMap { [$0.x, $0.y, $0.z] }
        }
        let calQ = simd_quatf(c.mpuToRacket.transpose)
        var f: [Float] = rows(c.mpuToRacket) + rows(c.h3lisToRacket)
        f += [c.gyroBias.x, c.gyroBias.y, c.gyroBias.z, c.h3lisBias.x, c.h3lisBias.y, c.h3lisBias.z, c.accelScale]
        f += [calQ.real, calQ.imag.x, calQ.imag.y, calQ.imag.z]
        f += [profile.effectiveRadiusM, profile.forehandBodySign]
        f += [model.lateralGain, model.longitudinalGain, model.joltDeadband, model.acorCenter, model.spinGain]
        var d = Data([gen])
        for v in f { withUnsafeBytes(of: v.bitPattern.littleEndian) { d.append(contentsOf: $0) } }
        d.append(profile.rightHanded ? 1 : 0)

    static func quaternion(_ b: [UInt8], at o: Int) -> simd_quatf {
        func c(_ k: Int) -> Float { Float(Int16(bitPattern: UInt16(b[o + 2 * k]) | UInt16(b[o + 2 * k + 1]) << 8)) / 16384 }
        return simd_normalize(simd_quatf(ix: c(1), iy: c(2), iz: c(3), r: c(0)))

        return RawSample(ax: i16(o), ay: i16(o + 2), az: i16(o + 4), gx: i16(o + 6), gy: i16(o + 8), gz: i16(o + 10),

    public static func decodeHit(_ data: Data) -> Hit? {

        let b = [UInt8](data)
        let t = UInt32(b[2]) | UInt32(b[3]) << 8 | UInt32(b[4]) << 16 | UInt32(b[5]) << 24
        return Hit(seq: UInt16(b[0]) | UInt16(b[1]) << 8, tMicros: t, source: HitSource(rawValue: b[6]) ?? .motion,

    }

        let acked = data.count == 22 + count * 18

        return WindowChunk(seq: UInt16(b[0]) | UInt16(b[1]) << 8, index: Int(b[2]), total: Int(b[3]),
                           impact: Int(UInt16(b[4]) | UInt16(b[5]) << 8), startOrientation: quaternion(b, at: 6),
                           t0Micros: t0, samples: (0..<count).map { rawSample(b, at: first + $0 * 18) },
                           boot: acked ? UInt16(b[20]) | UInt16(b[21]) << 8 : nil, flags: b[19])
    }

    /// The shot as the racket computed it (firmware/src/shot.cpp, TBShotSummary), firmware 1.6+.
    public struct ShotSummary: Sendable, Equatable {
        public var seq: UInt16
        public var boot: UInt16
        /// The `Command.shotConfig` generation it was computed with.
        public var gen: UInt8
        public var type: ShotType
        public var spin: SpinType
        public var gyroSaturated: Bool
        /// Captured while the link was busy or down.
        public var backlog: Bool
        /// ms between the hit and sending; nil if it was hit before the racket last rebooted.
        public var ageMs: UInt32?
        /// When it was hit, if the app had set the racket's clock; else nil.
        public var unixMs: UInt64?
        public var swingKmh, ballKmh, spinRPM, faceDeg, pathDeg, impactXcm, impactYcm, peakG: Float
        public var rollRatio, ringNorm, jolt, impulse, spinAxisY, verticalSpin, swingDeg: Float

        /// When the ball was hit, as well as the racket knows.
        public func hitDate(receivedAt now: Date) -> Date {
            if let unixMs { return Date(timeIntervalSince1970: Double(unixMs) / 1000) }
            if let ageMs { return now.addingTimeInterval(-Double(ageMs) / 1000) }
            return now
        }

        public func metrics(receivedAt now: Date) -> ShotMetrics {
            var features = ImpactFeatures(rollRatio: rollRatio, ringNorm: ringNorm, jolt: jolt, impulse: impulse,
                                          spinAxisY: spinAxisY)
            features.verticalSpin = verticalSpin
            features.swingDeg = swingDeg
            return ShotMetrics(date: hitDate(receivedAt: now), type: type, swingSpeedKmh: Double(swingKmh),
                               ballSpeedKmh: Double(ballKmh), spinRPM: Double(spinRPM), spin: spin,
                               faceAngleDeg: Double(faceDeg), swingPathDeg: Double(pathDeg),
                               impactXcm: Double(impactXcm), impactYcm: Double(impactYcm), peakG: Double(peakG),
                               gyroSaturated: gyroSaturated, features: features)
        }
    }

    public static func decodeShotSummary(_ data: Data) -> ShotSummary? {
        guard data.count >= 80 else { return nil }
        let b = [UInt8](data)
        func u16(_ i: Int) -> UInt16 { UInt16(b[i]) | UInt16(b[i + 1]) << 8 }
        func u32(_ i: Int) -> UInt32 { (0..<4).reduce(0) { $0 | UInt32(b[i + $1]) << (8 * UInt32($1)) } }
        func u64(_ i: Int) -> UInt64 { (0..<8).reduce(0) { $0 | UInt64(b[i + $1]) << (8 * UInt64($1)) } }
        func f(_ k: Int) -> Float { Float(bitPattern: u32(20 + 4 * k)) }
        let types: [ShotType] = [.forehand, .backhand, .serve, .volley]
        let spins: [SpinType] = [.topspin, .flat, .slice]
        guard Int(b[5]) < types.count, Int(b[6]) < spins.count else { return nil }
        let age = u32(8), unix = u64(12)
        return ShotSummary(seq: u16(0), boot: u16(2), gen: b[4], type: types[Int(b[5])], spin: spins[Int(b[6])],
                           gyroSaturated: b[7] & 1 != 0, backlog: b[7] & 2 != 0,
                           ageMs: age == .max ? nil : age, unixMs: unix == 0 ? nil : unix,
                           swingKmh: f(0), ballKmh: f(1), spinRPM: f(2), faceDeg: f(3), pathDeg: f(4),
                           impactXcm: f(5), impactYcm: f(6), peakG: f(7), rollRatio: f(8), ringNorm: f(9),
                           jolt: f(10), impulse: f(11), spinAxisY: f(12), verticalSpin: f(13), swingDeg: f(14))
    }

    /// The racket's own sweet-spot verdict from its on-device model (firmware/src/sweetspot.cpp, ml/README.md).
    public struct ShotVerdict: Sendable, Equatable {
        public var seq: UInt16
        public var isSweet: Bool
        /// 0 when sweet; otherwise roughly 33...100, how far toward the frame the ball hit (100 = at the frame).
        public var offCenterPercent: Int
        public var confidencePercent: Int
        /// Impact loudness 0...255 (near 255 means the mic clipped).
        public var level: Int
    }

    public static func decodeShotVerdict(_ data: Data) -> ShotVerdict? {
        guard data.count >= 6 else { return nil }
        let b = [UInt8](data)
        return ShotVerdict(seq: UInt16(b[0]) | UInt16(b[1]) << 8, isSweet: b[2] != 0,
                           offCenterPercent: Int(b[3]), confidencePercent: Int(b[4]), level: Int(b[5]))
    }

    /// Taps on the handle, grouped by the racket into one gesture (firmware/src/tap.cpp). Swings and ball
    /// impacts are filtered out on the racket.
    public struct TapGesture: Sendable, Equatable {
        public var seq: UInt16
        /// Taps in the gesture: 1 single, 2 double, 3+ triple.
        public var count: Int
        /// Strongest tap's jolt, 0...255 (255 = 2 g or more).
        public var strength: Int
        /// Strongest tap's push direction, unit vector in accel (sensor) axes. See TapCalibration.
        public var direction: SIMD3<Float>

        public init(seq: UInt16, count: Int, strength: Int, direction: SIMD3<Float>) {
            self.seq = seq
            self.count = count
            self.strength = strength
            self.direction = direction
        }
    }

    public static func decodeTap(_ data: Data) -> TapGesture? {
        guard data.count >= 9 else { return nil }
        let b = [UInt8](data)
        let dir = SIMD3(Float(Int8(bitPattern: b[6])), Float(Int8(bitPattern: b[7])), Float(Int8(bitPattern: b[8]))) / 127
        return TapGesture(seq: UInt16(b[0]) | UInt16(b[1]) << 8, count: Int(b[2]), strength: Int(b[3]), direction: dir)
    }

    public static func decodePacket(_ data: Data) -> Packet? {
        guard data.count >= 8 else { return nil }
        let bytes = [UInt8](data)
        func u16(_ i: Int) -> UInt16 { UInt16(bytes[i]) | UInt16(bytes[i + 1]) << 8 }
        let seq = u16(0)
        let t0 = UInt32(u16(2)) | UInt32(u16(4)) << 16
        let count = Int(bytes[6])
        let flags = bytes[7]
        guard data.count >= 8 + count * 18 else { return nil }
        let samples = (0..<count).map { rawSample(bytes, at: 8 + $0 * 18) }
        return Packet(seq: seq, t0Micros: t0, flags: flags, samples: samples)
    }

    public static func decodeStatus(_ data: Data) -> Status? {
        guard data.count >= 8 else { return nil }
        let b = [UInt8](data)
        return Status(
            batteryMillivolts: UInt16(b[0]) | UInt16(b[1]) << 8,
            firmwareVersion: "\(b[2]).\(b[3])",
            mpuOK: b[4] & 1 != 0,
            h3lisOK: b[4] & 2 != 0,
            streaming: b[4] & 4 != 0,
            h3lisRange: b[5],
            droppedPackets: UInt16(b[6]) | UInt16(b[7]) << 8,
            impactMode: b[4] & flagImpactMode != 0,
            gyro4000: b[4] & flagGyro4000 != 0)
    }

    /// Converts a raw sample to physical units in the sensor frames.
    public static func convert(_ r: RawSample, time: Double, h3lisRange: UInt8,
                               gyroLSBPerDps: Float = mpuGyroLSBPerDps) -> IMUSample {
        let gPerCount = h3lisGPerCount(range: h3lisRange)
        let dps2rad = Float.pi / 180
        return IMUSample(
            time: time,
            accel: SIMD3(Float(r.ax), Float(r.ay), Float(r.az)) / mpuAccelLSBPerG,
            gyro: SIMD3(Float(r.gx), Float(r.gy), Float(r.gz)) / gyroLSBPerDps * dps2rad,
            highG: SIMD3(Float(r.hx >> 4), Float(r.hy >> 4), Float(r.hz >> 4)) * gPerCount)
    }
}

/// One 1 kHz sample in physical units.
/// `accel` and `highG` are in g, `gyro` in rad/s. Before calibration these are sensor axes;
/// after `Calibration.apply` they are racket axes (x = toward the tip, y = across the face, z = face normal).
public struct IMUSample: Sendable, Codable, Equatable {
    public var time: Double
    public var accel: SIMD3<Float>
    public var gyro: SIMD3<Float>
    public var highG: SIMD3<Float>

    public init(time: Double, accel: SIMD3<Float>, gyro: SIMD3<Float>, highG: SIMD3<Float>) {
        self.time = time
        self.accel = accel
        self.gyro = gyro
        self.highG = highG
    }

    /// Best available acceleration: the precise MPU6050 below ~14 g, the H3LIS331 above (MPU saturates at 16 g).
    public var fusedAccel: SIMD3<Float> {
        simd_length(accel) < 14 ? accel : highG
    }

    /// Just under the gyro's full scale; RacketBLE raises it while the racket streams at ±4000 dps.
    public static var gyroSaturation: Float = 1990 * .pi / 180
    public var gyroSaturated: Bool {
        abs(gyro.x) > Self.gyroSaturation || abs(gyro.y) > Self.gyroSaturation || abs(gyro.z) > Self.gyroSaturation
    }
}
````````

````````swift
/// Connects to the real racket over BLE. Firmware 1.5+ detects hits itself and sends only the samples around each

            case .unauthorized: "Bluetooth permission needed"
            case .idle: "Not connected"

            case .connecting: "Connecting…"
            case .connected: "Connected"

    /// Link counters since the app started, for a recording's link log: subtract the value at the start.
    public struct LinkStats: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {

        public static func - (a: LinkStats, b: LinkStats) -> LinkStats {

    /// Set once the racket accepted the image; cleared when it reconnects.
    private var otaRestartingInto: FirmwareImage?
    /// The link dropped after DONE, so the next status comes from the rebooted racket.

    private var otaWatchdog: DispatchWorkItem?

    private let service = CBUUID(string: RacketProtocol.serviceUUID)
    private let imuUUID = CBUUID(string: RacketProtocol.imuUUID)
    private let statusUUID = CBUUID(string: RacketProtocol.statusUUID)
    private let controlUUID = CBUUID(string: RacketProtocol.controlUUID)
    private let tapUUID = CBUUID(string: RacketProtocol.tapUUID)

    public func start() {

            self.wantsConnection = true
            self.scanIfReady()
        }

    public func stop() {
        queue.async {
            self.wantsConnection = false
            self.central.stopScan()
            if let p = self.peripheral { self.central.cancelPeripheralConnection(p) }
            self.peripheral = nil
            if self.central.state == .poweredOn { self.state = .idle }
        }
    }

    /// Every sample instead of impact windows: for calibration (still poses, ball drops) and raw recordings.
    public func setRawStream(_ raw: Bool) {
        queue.async {
            guard self.wantsRaw != raw else { return }
            self.wantsRaw = raw
            self.sendStreamMode()
        }
    }

        queue.async {

    private func sendShotConfig() {

        p.writeValue(Data([RacketProtocol.Command.shotConfig.rawValue]) + payload, for: c, type: .withResponse)
    }

    private func write(_ data: Data) {
        guard let p = peripheral, let c = control else { return }
        p.writeValue(data, for: c, type: .withResponse)
    }

    private func sendStreamMode() {
        guard let p = peripheral, let c = control, supportsImpactMode else { return }
        let mode: RacketProtocol.StreamMode = wantsRaw ? .raw : (supportsAcks ? .impactsAcked : .impacts)
        p.writeValue(Data([RacketProtocol.Command.streamMode.rawValue, mode.rawValue]), for: c, type: .withResponse)

    /// Sends a new firmware image to the racket, which verifies it and reboots into it. Progress arrives
    /// through `onFirmwareUpdate`.
    public func updateFirmware(_ image: FirmwareImage) {
        queue.async {
            guard self.otaImage == nil, self.otaRestartingInto == nil else { return }
            guard let p = self.peripheral, let c = self.otaControl, self.otaData != nil else {
                return self.reportUpdate(.failed("The racket isn't connected, or its firmware predates wireless updates"))
            }
            // Subscribe again in case the first attempt at connect failed; harmless if already subscribed.
            p.setNotifyValue(true, for: c)
            self.otaImage = image
            self.otaSent = 0
            self.otaAcked = 0
            var begin = Data([RacketProtocol.OTACommand.begin.rawValue])
            withUnsafeBytes(of: UInt32(image.data.count).littleEndian) { begin.append(contentsOf: $0) }
            withUnsafeBytes(of: image.crc32.littleEndian) { begin.append(contentsOf: $0) }
            p.writeValue(begin, for: c, type: .withResponse)
            self.reportUpdate(.sending(0))
            self.armWatchdog("The racket stopped responding")
        }
    }

    public func cancelFirmwareUpdate() {
        queue.async {
            guard self.otaImage != nil else { return }
            if let p = self.peripheral, let c = self.otaControl {
                p.writeValue(Data([RacketProtocol.OTACommand.abort.rawValue]), for: c, type: .withResponse)
            }
            self.endUpdate(.idle)
        }
    }

    private func reportUpdate(_ s: FirmwareUpdateState) {
        DispatchQueue.main.async { self.onFirmwareUpdate?(s) }
    }

    private func endUpdate(_ s: FirmwareUpdateState) {
        otaImage = nil
        otaRestartingInto = nil
        otaRebooted = false
        otaWatchdog?.cancel()
        otaWatchdog = nil
        reportUpdate(s)
    }

    /// Fails the update if the racket goes quiet for too long; rearmed on every reply.
    private func armWatchdog(_ message: String, after seconds: Double = 10) {
        otaWatchdog?.cancel()
        let item = DispatchWorkItem { [weak self] in
            guard let self else { return }
            if self.otaImage != nil, let p = self.peripheral, let c = self.otaControl {
                p.writeValue(Data([RacketProtocol.OTACommand.abort.rawValue]), for: c, type: .withResponse)
            }
            self.endUpdate(.failed(message))
        }
        otaWatchdog = item
        queue.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + seconds, execute: item)
    }

    /// Sends image chunks up to the end of the current window; the racket's PROGRESS ack opens the next one.
    private func sendWindow() {
        guard let image = otaImage, let p = peripheral, let c = otaData else { return }
        let size = image.data.count
        let windowEnd = min(size, (otaAcked / RacketProtocol.otaWindow + 1) * RacketProtocol.otaWindow)
        let chunk = p.maximumWriteValueLength(for: .withoutResponse)
        while otaSent < windowEnd && p.canSendWriteWithoutResponse {
            let n = min(chunk, windowEnd - otaSent)
            p.writeValue(image.data.subdata(in: otaSent..<otaSent + n), for: c, type: .withoutResponse)
            otaSent += n
        }
    }

    private func handleOTAReply(_ data: Data) {
        guard let image = otaImage, let first = data.first, let reply = RacketProtocol.OTAReply(rawValue: first) else { return }
        let b = [UInt8](data)
        switch reply {
        case .ready:
            armWatchdog("The racket stopped responding")
            sendWindow()
        case .progress:
            guard b.count >= 5 else { return }
            otaAcked = Int(UInt32(b[1]) | UInt32(b[2]) << 8 | UInt32(b[3]) << 16 | UInt32(b[4]) << 24)
            reportUpdate(.sending(Double(otaAcked) / Double(image.data.count)))
            armWatchdog("The racket stopped responding")
            if otaAcked >= image.data.count, let p = peripheral, let c = otaControl {
                p.writeValue(Data([RacketProtocol.OTACommand.end.rawValue]), for: c, type: .withResponse)
                reportUpdate(.verifying)
            } else {
                sendWindow()
            }
        case .done:
            otaImage = nil
            otaRestartingInto = image
            reportUpdate(.restarting)
            armWatchdog("The racket didn't come back after restarting", after: 45)
        case .error:
            endUpdate(.failed(RacketProtocol.otaErrorMessage(b.count >= 2 ? b[1] : 0)))
        }
    }

    /// After the reboot, the first status says which firmware is actually running.
    private func checkRestartedFirmware(_ status: RacketProtocol.Status) {
        guard let image = otaRestartingInto, otaRebooted else { return }
        if let expected = image.version, expected != status.firmwareVersion {
            endUpdate(.failed("The new firmware didn't start, so the racket went back to \(status.firmwareVersion)"))
        } else {
            endUpdate(.finished)
        }
    }

    /// The racket this app is paired with. With several rackets in range, only this one is ever used.
    private static let pairedKey = "tennisbuddy.pairedRacket"
    private var pairedID: UUID? {
        get { UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: Self.pairedKey).flatMap(UUID.init(uuidString:)) }
        set { UserDefaults.standard.set(newValue?.uuidString, forKey: Self.pairedKey) }
    }
    /// Rackets heard while choosing the first one to pair with: the nearest (strongest signal) wins.

    private var pickWork: DispatchWorkItem?

    /// Forgets the paired racket so the next connection picks the nearest one (swap rackets, new owner).
    public func forgetRacket() {
        queue.async {
            self.pairedID = nil
            self.candidates = [:]
            self.pickWork?.cancel()
            self.pickWork = nil
            if let p = self.peripheral { self.central.cancelPeripheralConnection(p) }
        }
    }

    private func scanIfReady() {
        guard wantsConnection, central.state == .poweredOn, peripheral == nil else { return }
        let connected = central.retrieveConnectedPeripherals(withServices: [service])
        if let known = connected.first(where: { pairedID == nil || $0.identifier == pairedID }) {
            connect(known)
            return
        }
        state = .scanning
        candidates = [:]
        central.scanForPeripherals(withServices: [service], options: [CBCentralManagerScanOptionAllowDuplicatesKey: pairedID == nil])
    }

    private func connectNearest() {
        pickWork = nil
        guard peripheral == nil, let best = candidates.values.max(by: { $0.rssi < $1.rssi }) else { return }
        candidates = [:]
        connect(best.peripheral)
    }

    private func connect(_ p: CBPeripheral) {
        central.stopScan()
        peripheral = p
        p.delegate = self
        state = .connecting
        central.connect(p)
    }

    /// Racket micros → seconds, counting the 32-bit counter's wraps (every ~71 minutes).
    private func racketTime(_ micros: UInt32) -> Double {
        if micros < lastMicros, lastMicros - micros > 1_000_000_000 { wraps += 4294.967296 }
        if micros > lastMicros || lastMicros - micros > 1_000_000_000 { lastMicros = micros }
        return Double(micros) / 1e6 + wraps
    }

    private func handleIMU(_ data: Data) {
        guard let packet = RacketProtocol.decodePacket(data) else { return }
        if let last = lastSeq {
            let gap = Int(packet.seq &- last) - 1
            if gap > 0 && gap < 1000 { lostPackets += gap; link.lostPackets += gap }
        }
        lastSeq = packet.seq
        let t0 = racketTime(packet.t0Micros)
        let wide = packet.flags & RacketProtocol.flagGyro4000 != 0
        link.packets += 1
        if wide { link.packetsAt4000dps += 1 }
        IMUSample.gyroSaturation = (wide ? 3990 : 1990) * .pi / 180
        let gyroScale = wide ? RacketProtocol.mpuGyroLSBPerDps / 2 : RacketProtocol.mpuGyroLSBPerDps
        let samples = packet.samples.enumerated().map { k, raw in
            RacketProtocol.convert(raw, time: t0 + Double(k) * 0.001, h3lisRange: h3lisRange, gyroLSBPerDps: gyroScale)
        }
        onSamples?(samples)
    }

    private func handleHit(_ hit: RacketProtocol.Hit) {
        if awaitingWindow != nil { lostWindows += 1; link.lostWindows += 1 }
        awaitingWindow = hit.seq
    }

    private func handleWindowChunk(_ chunk: RacketProtocol.WindowChunk) {
        let key = WindowKey(boot: chunk.boot, seq: chunk.seq)
        if let boot = chunk.boot, deliveredWindows.contains(key) {
            // A resend after our ack was lost: ack again (once, on its last chunk) and drop it.
            if chunk.index == chunk.total - 1 {
                link.duplicateWindows += 1
                write(RacketProtocol.windowAckPayload(boot: boot, seq: chunk.seq))
            }
            return
        }
        // A backlog window may come from before the racket rebooted: convert its clock without touching the live
        // wrap tracking (only times within the window matter to the analysis).
        let late = chunk.flags & RacketProtocol.flagBacklog != 0
        let wraps = self.wraps
        let time: (UInt32) -> Double = late ? { Double($0) / 1e6 + wraps } : { self.racketTime($0) }
        let now = ProcessInfo.processInfo.systemUptime
        guard let window = assembler.add(chunk, h3lisRange: h3lisRange, now: now, time: time) else {
            // The last chunk of a window arrived with gaps: ask for them now rather than at the next timer tick.
            if chunk.boot != nil, chunk.index == chunk.total - 1 { requestResends(now: now, quietFor: 0.1) }
            return
        }
        if awaitingWindow == window.seq { awaitingWindow = nil }
        link.windows += 1
        if window.backlog { link.backlogWindows += 1 }
        if let boot = window.boot {
            write(RacketProtocol.windowAckPayload(boot: boot, seq: window.seq))
            deliveredWindows.append(window.key)
            if deliveredWindows.count > 256 { deliveredWindows.removeFirst(deliveredWindows.count - 256) }
        }
        IMUSample.gyroSaturation = (gyroWide ? 3990 : 1990) * .pi / 180
        onImpactWindow?(window)
    }

    private func handleSummary(_ summary: RacketProtocol.ShotSummary) {
        link.summaries += 1
        // Already have this window (a resend after a lost ack): the shot was taken then.
        guard !deliveredWindows.contains(WindowKey(boot: summary.boot, seq: summary.seq)) else { return }
        onShotSummary?(summary)
    }

    private func requestResends(now: Double, quietFor: Double) {
        for (key, chunks) in assembler.missing(now: now, quietFor: quietFor) {
            guard let boot = key.boot else { continue }
            link.resendRequests += 1
            write(RacketProtocol.windowResendPayload(boot: boot, seq: key.seq, chunks: chunks))
        }
    }

    /// Asks for chunks of windows that stalled (a notification lost on the air).
    private func startResendTimer() {
        resendTimer?.cancel()
        let t = DispatchSource.makeTimerSource(queue: queue)
        t.schedule(deadline: .now() + 1, repeating: 1)
        t.setEventHandler { [weak self] in
            guard let self, self.supportsAcks, self.control != nil else { return }
            self.requestResends(now: ProcessInfo.processInfo.systemUptime, quietFor: 1.5)
        }
        resendTimer = t
        t.resume()
    }
}

extension RacketBLE: CBCentralManagerDelegate, CBPeripheralDelegate {
    public func centralManagerDidUpdateState(_ central: CBCentralManager) {
        switch central.state {
        case .poweredOn: state = .idle; scanIfReady()
        case .unauthorized: state = .unauthorized
        default: state = .poweredOff
        }
    }

    public func centralManager(_ central: CBCentralManager, didDiscover peripheral: CBPeripheral,
                               advertisementData: [String: Any], rssi RSSI: NSNumber) {
        guard self.peripheral == nil else { return }
        if let paired = pairedID {
            if peripheral.identifier == paired { connect(peripheral) }
            return
        }
        // Unpaired: listen for a moment, then take the closest racket rather than the first one heard.
        let rssi = RSSI.intValue
        if rssi == 127 { return }   // CoreBluetooth's "unavailable"
        candidates[peripheral.identifier] = (peripheral, rssi)
        if pickWork == nil {
            let work = DispatchWorkItem { [weak self] in self?.connectNearest() }
            pickWork = work
            queue.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 1.5, execute: work)
        }
    }

    public func centralManager(_ central: CBCentralManager, didConnect peripheral: CBPeripheral) {
        pairedID = peripheral.identifier
        lastSeq = nil
        supportsImpactMode = false
        supportsAcks = false
        assembler = ImpactWindowAssembler()
        awaitingWindow = nil
        // The racket may have rebooted (its clock restarts at 0): start timestamps fresh.
        lastMicros = 0
        wraps = 0
        peripheral.discoverServices([service])
    }

    public func centralManager(_ central: CBCentralManager, didFailToConnect peripheral: CBPeripheral, error: Error?) {
        self.peripheral = nil
        state = .idle
        scanIfReady()
    }

    public func centralManager(_ central: CBCentralManager, didDisconnectPeripheral peripheral: CBPeripheral,
                               error: Error?) {
        self.peripheral = nil
        control = nil
        otaControl = nil
        otaData = nil
        DispatchQueue.main.async { self.onFirmwareUpdateSupport?(false) }
        // A reboot into new firmware is expected to drop the link; anything else ends the update.
        if otaImage != nil { endUpdate(.failed("Lost the connection to the racket; it kept its old firmware")) }
        if otaRestartingInto != nil { otaRebooted = true }
        state = .idle
        scanIfReady()   // auto-reconnect
    }

    public func peripheral(_ peripheral: CBPeripheral, didDiscoverServices error: Error?) {
        guard let s = peripheral.services?.first(where: { $0.uuid == service }) else { return }
        peripheral.discoverCharacteristics([imuUUID, statusUUID, controlUUID, shotUUID, otaControlUUID, otaDataUUID,
                                            hitUUID, windowUUID, poseUUID, summaryUUID], for: s)
    }

    public func peripheral(_ peripheral: CBPeripheral, didDiscoverCharacteristicsFor service: CBService, error: Error?) {
        for c in service.characteristics ?? [] {
            switch c.uuid {
            case imuUUID: peripheral.setNotifyValue(true, for: c)
            case statusUUID: peripheral.setNotifyValue(true, for: c); peripheral.readValue(for: c)
            case shotUUID: peripheral.setNotifyValue(true, for: c)
            case tapUUID:
                tapSubscribeRetries = 0
                peripheral.setNotifyValue(true, for: c)
                if c.properties.contains(.write) { otaControl = c }
            case controlUUID:
                control = c
                peripheral.writeValue(Data([RacketProtocol.Command.startStream.rawValue]), for: c, type: .withResponse)
                peripheral.writeValue(Data([RacketProtocol.Command.gyroRange.rawValue, 1]), for: c, type: .withResponse)
            case otaDataUUID: otaData = c
            case hitUUID, windowUUID, poseUUID:
                supportsImpactMode = true
                peripheral.setNotifyValue(true, for: c)
            case summaryUUID:
                supportsAcks = true
                peripheral.setNotifyValue(true, for: c)
            default: break
            }
        }
        if supportsAcks {
            // Before the stream mode, so the first shot is already computed with this phone's calibration.
            write(RacketProtocol.setTimePayload(Date()))
            sendShotConfig()
            startResendTimer()
        }
        sendStreamMode()
        let canUpdate = otaControl != nil && otaData != nil
        DispatchQueue.main.async { self.onFirmwareUpdateSupport?(canUpdate) }
        state = .connected
    }

    public func peripheral(_ peripheral: CBPeripheral, didUpdateValueFor characteristic: CBCharacteristic,
                           error: Error?) {
        guard let data = characteristic.value else { return }
        if characteristic.uuid == imuUUID {
            handleIMU(data)
        } else if characteristic.uuid == windowUUID, let chunk = RacketProtocol.decodeWindowChunk(data) {
            handleWindowChunk(chunk)
        } else if characteristic.uuid == hitUUID, let hit = RacketProtocol.decodeHit(data) {
            handleHit(hit)
        } else if characteristic.uuid == summaryUUID, let summary = RacketProtocol.decodeShotSummary(data) {
            handleSummary(summary)
        } else if characteristic.uuid == poseUUID, let pose = RacketProtocol.decodePose(data) {
            gyroWide = pose.flags & RacketProtocol.flagGyro4000 != 0
            onPose?(pose)
        } else if characteristic.uuid == shotUUID, let v = RacketProtocol.decodeShotVerdict(data) {
            DispatchQueue.main.async { self.onVerdict?(v) }
        } else if characteristic === otaControl {
            handleOTAReply(data)
        } else if characteristic.uuid == tapUUID, let tap = RacketProtocol.decodeTap(data) {
            DispatchQueue.main.async { self.onTap?(tap) }
        } else if characteristic.uuid == statusUUID, let status = RacketProtocol.decodeStatus(data) {
            h3lisRange = status.h3lisRange
            checkRestartedFirmware(status)
            DispatchQueue.main.async { self.onStatus?(status) }
        }
    }

    public func peripheral(_ peripheral: CBPeripheral, didWriteValueFor characteristic: CBCharacteristic,
                           error: Error?) {
        // Without this, a rejected update command would only show up as a timeout.
        guard characteristic.uuid == otaControlUUID, let error, otaImage != nil else { return }
        endUpdate(.failed("The racket rejected the update command: \(error.localizedDescription)"))
    }

    public func peripheral(_ peripheral: CBPeripheral, didUpdateNotificationStateFor characteristic: CBCharacteristic,
                           error: Error?) {
        guard characteristic.uuid == otaControlUUID, let error else { return }
        // On tap firmware 0006 is the notify-only tap characteristic, not an update channel. The racket can
        // answer a subscribe with "insufficient resources" while its BLE buffers are busy streaming, so retry.
        if characteristic !== otaControl {
            tapSubscribeRetries += 1
            guard tapSubscribeRetries <= 10 else { return }
            queue.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.5) { [weak self, weak peripheral] in
                guard let self, let peripheral, self.peripheral === peripheral else { return }
                peripheral.setNotifyValue(true, for: characteristic)
            }
            return
        }
        let failure = FirmwareUpdateState.failed("Couldn't subscribe to the racket's update replies: \(error.localizedDescription)")
        if otaImage != nil { endUpdate(failure) } else { reportUpdate(failure) }
    }

    public func peripheralIsReady(toSendWriteWithoutResponse peripheral: CBPeripheral) {
        sendWindow()
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import Foundation
import simd

/// Anything that produces 1 kHz samples: the real racket over BLE, the simulator, or a recording.
public protocol SampleSource: AnyObject {
    /// Called on an arbitrary queue with batches of samples in sensor coordinates.
    var onSamples: (([IMUSample]) -> Void)? { get set }
    /// Calibration that maps this source's sensor axes to racket axes (the simulator is already in racket axes).
    var nativeCalibration: Calibration? { get }
    func start()
    func stop()
}

/// Live state for the UI, published ~30 times a second.
public struct LiveState: Sendable {
    public var orientation: simd_quatf
    public var gyroDps: Float
    public var highG: Float
    public var samplesPerSecond: Double

    public init(orientation: simd_quatf, gyroDps: Float, highG: Float, samplesPerSecond: Double) {
        self.orientation = orientation
        self.gyroDps = gyroDps
        self.highG = highG
        self.samplesPerSecond = samplesPerSecond
    }
}

/// Processes the sample stream: calibration → orientation → shot detection → analysis. From an `ImpactSource`
/// (the racket in impact mode) it analyses the windows the racket sends instead, and shows the racket's own
/// orientation live. All processing runs on a private serial queue; callbacks arrive on the main queue.
public final class RacketEngine: @unchecked Sendable {
    public var calibration: Calibration = .default {
        didSet { queue.async { self._calibration = self.calibration; self.pushShotConfig() } }
    }
    public var profile = RacketProfile() { didSet { queue.async { self.analyzer.profile = self.profile; self.pushShotConfig() } } }
    public var impactModel = ImpactModel() {
        didSet { queue.async { self.analyzer.model = self.impactModel; self.pushShotConfig() } }
    }
    /// Calibration mode: detect gentle impacts (ball drops) with no swing.
    public var calibrationMode = false { didSet { queue.async { self._calibrationMode = self.calibrationMode } } }

    public var onLive: ((LiveState) -> Void)?
    public var onShot: ((ShotMetrics) -> Void)?
    /// Raw (sensor-frame) samples for the recorder, delivered on the engine queue.
    public var onRaw: (([IMUSample]) -> Void)?
    /// Raw data plus per-impact pose/configuration for exact offline replay.
    public var onRecordingEvent: ((RecordingEvent) -> Void)?

    private let queue = DispatchQueue(label: "tennisbuddy.engine", qos: .userInitiated)
    private var _calibration: Calibration = .default
    private var _calibrationMode = false
    private var sourceCalibration: Calibration?
    private var filter = MahonyFilter()
    private var analyzer = ShotAnalyzer(profile: RacketProfile(), model: ImpactModel())
    private var ring: [(IMUSample, simd_quatf)] = []
    private let ringCapacity = 1500
    private var lastTime: Double?
    private var lastShotTime: Double = -10
    private var pendingImpactTime: Double?
    private var lastLivePublish: Double = 0
    private var rateCounter = 0
    private var rateWindowStart: Double = 0
    private var rate: Double = 0
    private var stillSamples: [IMUSample] = []

    private weak var source: SampleSource?
    /// A racket that computes shots itself, and the config generation it was last sent (all on `queue`).
    private weak var summarySource: ShotSummarySource?
    private var configGen: UInt8 = 0
    /// Windows whose shot already came from the racket's summary.
    private var summarized: Set<WindowKey> = []

    public init() {}

    public func attach(_ source: SampleSource) {
        self.source?.stop()
        self.source?.onSamples = nil
        self.source = source
        let native = source.nativeCalibration
        queue.async {
            self.sourceCalibration = native
            self.reset()
        }
        source.onSamples = { [weak self] batch in self?.ingest(batch) }
        if let impacts = source as? ImpactSource {
            impacts.onImpactWindow = { [weak self] window in self?.queue.async { self?.process(window) } }
            impacts.onPose = { [weak self] pose in self?.queue.async { self?.process(pose) } }
        }
        let summaries = source as? ShotSummarySource
        summaries?.onShotSummary = { [weak self] s in self?.queue.async { self?.process(s) } }
        queue.async {
            self.summarySource = summaries
            self.summarized.removeAll()
            self.pushShotConfig()
        }
    }

    /// Sends the racket what it needs to compute shots exactly as `analyzer` would. Each change gets a new
    /// generation, and summaries from an older one are ignored (their windows are analysed here instead).
    private func pushShotConfig() {
        guard let s = summarySource else { return }
        configGen = configGen == 255 ? 1 : configGen + 1
        s.setShotConfig(RacketProtocol.shotConfigPayload(gen: configGen, calibration: sourceCalibration ?? _calibration,
                                                         profile: analyzer.profile, model: analyzer.model))
    }

    private func process(_ summary: RacketProtocol.ShotSummary) {
        guard !_calibrationMode, summary.gen == configGen else { return }
        let key = WindowKey(boot: summary.boot, seq: summary.seq)
        guard summarized.insert(key).inserted else { return }
        if summarized.count > 512 { summarized.removeAll() }
        let shot = summary.metrics(receivedAt: Date())
        DispatchQueue.main.async { self.onShot?(shot) }
    }

    public func detach() {
        source?.stop()
        source?.onSamples = nil
        if let impacts = source as? ImpactSource {
            impacts.onImpactWindow = nil
            impacts.onPose = nil
        }
        (source as? ShotSummarySource)?.onShotSummary = nil
        source = nil
        queue.async { self.summarySource = nil }
    }

    public func recenter() { queue.async { self.filter.recenter() } }

    /// Average of the most recent `seconds` of raw samples, for calibration poses.
    public func captureStill(seconds: Double, completion: @escaping (Calibration.PoseReading) -> Void) {
        queue.async { self.stillSamples = [] }
        queue.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + seconds) {
            let reading = Calibration.PoseReading(samples: self.stillSamples)
            DispatchQueue.main.async { completion(reading) }
        }
    }

    public func ingest(_ batch: [IMUSample]) {
        queue.async { self.process(batch) }
    }

    private func reset() {
        lastLivePublish = 0
        rateCounter = 0
        rateWindowStart = 0
        filter = MahonyFilter()
        ring.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)
        lastTime = nil
        pendingImpactTime = nil
        lastShotTime = -10
    }

    private func process(_ batch: [IMUSample]) {
        onRaw?(batch)
        onRecordingEvent?(.samples(batch))
        let cal = sourceCalibration ?? _calibration
        for raw in batch {
            stillSamples.append(raw)
            if stillSamples.count > 5000 { stillSamples.removeFirst(1000) }
            let s = cal.apply(raw)
            // Timestamps jumped backwards: the racket rebooted (e.g. replugged). Restart timing, or the
            // live view and shot detection would wait for the old clock to catch up.
            if let lt = lastTime, s.time < lt - 0.05 {
                let yaw = filter.yawOffset
                reset()
                filter.yawOffset = yaw
            }
            let dt = Float(lastTime.map { min(max(s.time - $0, 0.0002), 0.02) } ?? 0.001)
            lastTime = s.time
            filter.update(gyro: s.gyro, accel: s.accel, dt: dt)
            ring.append((s, filter.q))
            if ring.count > ringCapacity { ring.removeFirst(ring.count - ringCapacity) }
            detect(s)

            rateCounter += 1
            if s.time - rateWindowStart >= 1 {
                rate = Double(rateCounter) / (s.time - rateWindowStart)
                rateCounter = 0
                rateWindowStart = s.time
            }
        }
        if let last = ring.last, last.0.time - lastLivePublish > 1.0 / 30 {
            lastLivePublish = last.0.time
            let state = LiveState(orientation: filter.displayOrientation,
                                  gyroDps: simd_length(last.0.gyro) * 180 / .pi,
                                  highG: simd_length(last.0.highG),
                                  samplesPerSecond: rate)
            DispatchQueue.main.async { self.onLive?(state) }
        }
    }

    private func detect(_ s: IMUSample) {
        let n = ring.count
        if let t = pendingImpactTime {
            if s.time - t >= 0.15 { finishShot(at: t) }
            return
        }
        guard n > 400, s.time - lastShotTime > 0.4 else { return }
        let jump = simd_length(s.highG - ring[n - 4].0.highG)
        let threshold: Float = _calibrationMode ? 4 : 10
        guard jump > threshold else { return }
        if !_calibrationMode {
            // Must be in a real swing: fast rotation in the last 150 ms.
            let recent = ring[(n - 150)..<n].map { simd_length($0.0.gyro) }.max() ?? 0
            guard recent > 5 else { return }
        }
        pendingImpactTime = s.time
    }

    private func finishShot(at t: Double) {
        pendingImpactTime = nil

        guard let center = ring.lastIndex(where: { $0.0.time <= t }) else { return }
        analyzeImpact(ring, near: center)

    /// `frames` are racket-frame samples with the orientation after each; `center` is roughly the impact.
    private func analyzeImpact(_ frames: [(IMUSample, simd_quatf)], near center: Int) {
        guard let shot = Self.shot(frames: frames, near: center, analyzer: analyzer, calibrationMode: _calibrationMode,
                                   date: Date()) else { return }
        DispatchQueue.main.async { self.onShot?(shot) }
    }

    static func shot(frames: [(IMUSample, simd_quatf)], near center: Int, analyzer: ShotAnalyzer,
                     calibrationMode: Bool, date: Date) -> ShotMetrics? {
        guard frames.count > 3 else { return nil }
        // Refine: largest high-g jump within ±6 samples.
        var best = center, bestJump: Float = 0
        for k in max(3, center - 6)...max(3, min(frames.count - 1, center + 6)) {
            let j = simd_length(frames[k].0.highG - frames[k - 3].0.highG)
            if j > bestJump { bestJump = j; best = k }
        }
        // Impact = first sample of the jump.
        let i0 = max(best - 2, 0)
        let lo = max(0, i0 - 700), hi = min(frames.count, i0 + 150)
        let window = frames[lo..<hi].map(\.0)
        let q = frames[max(i0 - 3, 0)].1
        return analyzer.analyze(window: window, impact: i0 - lo, orientation: q, date: date,
                                calibrationMode: calibrationMode)
    }

    // MARK: - Impact mode

    /// The racket's orientation (sensor axes → world) turned into racket axes → world.
    static func racketOrientation(_ sensorToWorld: simd_quatf, _ cal: Calibration) -> simd_quatf {
        // mpuToRacket maps sensor vectors to racket vectors; its transpose takes racket vectors back to sensor ones.
        simd_normalize(sensorToWorld * simd_quatf(cal.mpuToRacket.transpose))
    }

    private func process(_ window: ImpactWindow) {
        onRaw?(window.samples)
        let cal = sourceCalibration ?? _calibration
        onRecordingEvent?(.impact(window: window, calibration: cal, profile: analyzer.profile, model: analyzer.model, calibrationMode: _calibrationMode))
        // The racket already sent this shot; the window is only for the recording.
        if summarized.remove(window.key) != nil { return }
        lastShotTime = window.samples[min(window.impactIndex, window.samples.count - 1)].time
        guard let shot = Self.shot(window: window, calibration: cal, analyzer: analyzer,
                                   calibrationMode: _calibrationMode, date: Date()) else { return }
        DispatchQueue.main.async { self.onShot?(shot) }
    }

    /// The shot in one impact window: the same path the racket's firmware/src/shot.cpp follows.
    static func shot(window: ImpactWindow, calibration cal: Calibration, analyzer: ShotAnalyzer,

        // would have from the full stream.
        var f = MahonyFilter()
        f.q = Self.racketOrientation(window.startOrientation, cal)

        var frames: [(IMUSample, simd_quatf)] = []
        frames.reserveCapacity(window.samples.count)

        for raw in window.samples {
            let s = cal.apply(raw)
            let dt = Float(last.map { min(max(s.time - $0, 0.0002), 0.02) } ?? 0.001)
            last = s.time
            f.update(gyro: s.gyro, accel: s.accel, dt: dt)
            frames.append((s, f.q))
        }
        return shot(frames: frames, near: window.impactIndex + 2, analyzer: analyzer, calibrationMode: calibrationMode,
                    date: date)
    }

    private func process(_ pose: RacketProtocol.Pose) {
        filter.q = Self.racketOrientation(pose.orientation, sourceCalibration ?? _calibration)
        filter.initialized = true
````````

````````swift
import Foundation
import simd

/// Recorder input preserves whether samples arrived as a continuous stream or
/// as a window whose pose was tracked by the racket during unrecorded motion.
public enum RecordingEvent: Sendable {
    case samples([IMUSample])
    case impact(window: ImpactWindow, calibration: Calibration, profile: RacketProfile, model: ImpactModel, calibrationMode: Bool = false)
}

/// One JSON line next to the binary recording. Samples stay in the existing
/// format; this supplies the state required to replay an impact window exactly.
public struct RecordedImpactContext: Codable, Sendable {
    public var formatVersion = 1
    public var sampleOffset: Int
    public var sampleCount: Int
    public var impactIndex: Int
    public var seq: UInt16
    public var boot: UInt16?
    public var backlog: Bool
    /// Quaternion in x,y,z,w order, sensor to world at the first recorded sample.
    public var startOrientationXYZW: [Float]
    public var calibration: Calibration
    public var profile: RacketProfile
    /// RacketProfile deliberately omits this player-owned field when saving
    /// settings, so a recording must snapshot it explicitly for exact replay.
    public var forehandBodySign: Float
    public var model: ImpactModel
    public var calibrationMode: Bool

    init(window: ImpactWindow, sampleOffset: Int, calibration: Calibration,
         profile: RacketProfile, model: ImpactModel, calibrationMode: Bool = false) {
        self.sampleOffset = sampleOffset
        sampleCount = window.samples.count
        impactIndex = window.impactIndex
        seq = window.seq
        boot = window.boot
        backlog = window.backlog
        let q = window.startOrientation.vector
        startOrientationXYZW = [q.x, q.y, q.z, q.w]
        self.calibration = calibration
        self.profile = profile
        forehandBodySign = profile.forehandBodySign
        self.model = model
        self.calibrationMode = calibrationMode
    }

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case formatVersion, sampleOffset, sampleCount, impactIndex, seq, boot, backlog
        case startOrientationXYZW, calibration, profile, forehandBodySign, model, calibrationMode
    }

    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let c = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        formatVersion = try c.decode(Int.self, forKey: .formatVersion)
        sampleOffset = try c.decode(Int.self, forKey: .sampleOffset)
        sampleCount = try c.decode(Int.self, forKey: .sampleCount)
        impactIndex = try c.decode(Int.self, forKey: .impactIndex)
        seq = try c.decode(UInt16.self, forKey: .seq)
        boot = try c.decodeIfPresent(UInt16.self, forKey: .boot)
        backlog = try c.decode(Bool.self, forKey: .backlog)
        startOrientationXYZW = try c.decode([Float].self, forKey: .startOrientationXYZW)
        calibration = try c.decode(Calibration.self, forKey: .calibration)
        profile = try c.decode(RacketProfile.self, forKey: .profile)
        forehandBodySign = try c.decode(Float.self, forKey: .forehandBodySign)
        profile.forehandBodySign = forehandBodySign
        model = try c.decode(ImpactModel.self, forKey: .model)
        calibrationMode = try c.decodeIfPresent(Bool.self, forKey: .calibrationMode) ?? false
    }

    public enum ReplayError: Error { case invalidContext }

    public func window(from recording: [IMUSample]) throws -> ImpactWindow {
        guard formatVersion == 1, sampleOffset >= 0, sampleOffset <= recording.count,
              sampleCount > 0, sampleCount <= recording.count - sampleOffset,
              impactIndex >= 0, impactIndex < sampleCount,
              startOrientationXYZW.count == 4, startOrientationXYZW.allSatisfy(\.isFinite) else {
            throw ReplayError.invalidContext
        }
        let q = SIMD4(startOrientationXYZW[0], startOrientationXYZW[1],
                      startOrientationXYZW[2], startOrientationXYZW[3])
        guard abs(simd_length(q) - 1) < 0.01 else { throw ReplayError.invalidContext }
        var window = ImpactWindow(seq: seq, impactIndex: impactIndex, startOrientation: simd_quatf(vector: q),
                                  samples: Array(recording[sampleOffset..<(sampleOffset + sampleCount)]), boot: boot)
        window.backlog = backlog
        return window
    }
}

/// Raw sensor recordings (`.tbrec`): little-endian records of `f64 time` + 9 × `f32`
/// (accel xyz g, gyro xyz rad/s, high-g xyz g), all in sensor axes.
public enum RecordingFormat {
    public static let fileExtension = "tbrec"
    static let recordSize = 8 + 9 * 4

    public static func encode(_ samples: [IMUSample]) -> Data {
        var data = Data(capacity: samples.count * recordSize)
        for s in samples {
            var t = s.time
            withUnsafeBytes(of: &t) { data.append(contentsOf: $0) }
            for v in [s.accel.x, s.accel.y, s.accel.z, s.gyro.x, s.gyro.y, s.gyro.z, s.highG.x, s.highG.y, s.highG.z] {
                var f = v
                withUnsafeBytes(of: &f) { data.append(contentsOf: $0) }
            }
        }
        return data
    }

    public static func decode(_ data: Data) -> [IMUSample] {
        let n = data.count / recordSize
        var out: [IMUSample] = []
        out.reserveCapacity(n)
        data.withUnsafeBytes { raw in
            for i in 0..<n {
                let o = i * recordSize
                let t = raw.loadUnaligned(fromByteOffset: o, as: Double.self)
                func f(_ k: Int) -> Float { raw.loadUnaligned(fromByteOffset: o + 8 + k * 4, as: Float.self) }
                out.append(IMUSample(time: t, accel: SIMD3(f(0), f(1), f(2)),
                                     gyro: SIMD3(f(3), f(4), f(5)), highG: SIMD3(f(6), f(7), f(8))))
            }
        }
        return out
    }

    public static func csv(_ samples: [IMUSample]) -> String {
        var s = "time_s,ax_g,ay_g,az_g,gx_rads,gy_rads,gz_rads,hx_g,hy_g,hz_g\n"
        for x in samples {
            s += String(format: "%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f\n", x.time,
                        x.accel.x, x.accel.y, x.accel.z, x.gyro.x, x.gyro.y, x.gyro.z, x.highG.x, x.highG.y, x.highG.z)
        }
        return s
    }
}

/// Appends raw samples to a `.tbrec` file while recording.
public final class Recorder: @unchecked Sendable {
    private let lock = NSLock()
    private var handle: FileHandle?
    private var contextHandle: FileHandle?
    public private(set) var url: URL?
    public private(set) var sampleCount = 0
    public private(set) var missingImpactContexts = 0

    public init() {}

    public var isRecording: Bool { lock.withLock { handle != nil } }

    public func start(in directory: URL, name: String) throws {
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: directory, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        let url = directory.appendingPathComponent(name).appendingPathExtension(RecordingFormat.fileExtension)
        FileManager.default.createFile(atPath: url.path, contents: nil)
        let h = try FileHandle(forWritingTo: url)
        let contextURL = url.deletingPathExtension().appendingPathExtension("windows.jsonl")
        FileManager.default.createFile(atPath: contextURL.path, contents: nil)
        let contexts: FileHandle
        do { contexts = try FileHandle(forWritingTo: contextURL) }
        catch { try? h.close(); throw error }
        lock.withLock {
            handle = h
            contextHandle = contexts
            self.url = url
            sampleCount = 0
            missingImpactContexts = 0
        }
    }

    public func append(_ samples: [IMUSample]) {
        lock.withLock {
            guard let handle else { return }
            handle.write(RecordingFormat.encode(samples))
            sampleCount += samples.count
        }
    }

    public func append(_ event: RecordingEvent) {
        switch event {
        case .samples(let samples): append(samples)
        case .impact(let window, let calibration, let profile, let model, let calibrationMode):
            lock.withLock {
                guard let handle else { return }
                let context = RecordedImpactContext(window: window, sampleOffset: sampleCount,
                                                    calibration: calibration, profile: profile, model: model, calibrationMode: calibrationMode)
                // Binary samples and their offset metadata share the same lock,
                // including against stopping the recorder on the main thread.
                handle.write(RecordingFormat.encode(window.samples))
                if let data = try? JSONEncoder().encode(context), let contextHandle {
                    contextHandle.write(data + Data([0x0A]))
                } else {
                    missingImpactContexts += 1
                }
                sampleCount += window.samples.count
            }
        }
    }

    @discardableResult
    public func stop() -> URL? {
        lock.withLock {
            try? handle?.close()
            try? contextHandle?.close()
            handle = nil
            contextHandle = nil
            return url
        }
    }
}

/// Plays a recording back in real time as if it were the live racket.
public final class ReplaySource: SampleSource, @unchecked Sendable {
    public var onSamples: (([IMUSample]) -> Void)?
    public var nativeCalibration: Calibration? { nil }
    public var loop = true

    private let samples: [IMUSample]
    private var cursor = 0
    private var timer: DispatchSourceTimer?
    private let queue = DispatchQueue(label: "tennisbuddy.replay", qos: .userInitiated)
    private var timeOffset: Double = 0

    public init(url: URL) throws {
        samples = RecordingFormat.decode(try Data(contentsOf: url))
    }

    public var duration: Double { (samples.last?.time ?? 0) - (samples.first?.time ?? 0) }

    public func start() {
        stop()
        guard !samples.isEmpty else { return }
        let t = DispatchSource.makeTimerSource(queue: queue)
        t.schedule(deadline: .now(), repeating: .milliseconds(10), leeway: .milliseconds(2))
        t.setEventHandler { [weak self] in self?.tick() }
        timer = t
        t.resume()
    }

    public func stop() {
        timer?.cancel()
        timer = nil
    }

    private func tick() {
        var batch: [IMUSample] = []
        for _ in 0..<10 {
            if cursor >= samples.count {
                guard loop else { stop(); break }
                timeOffset += duration + 0.001
                cursor = 0
            }
            var s = samples[cursor]
            s.time += timeOffset
            batch.append(s)
            cursor += 1
        }
        if !batch.isEmpty { onSamples?(batch) }
    }
}
````````
