````````swift
import Foundation
import simd

/// Turns a window of racket-frame samples around an impact into shot metrics.
/// Physics notes: docs/PLAN.md §3. All tunable constants live in `RacketProfile` / `ImpactModel`.
public struct ImpactModel: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    /// cm of side-to-side offset per unit of roll ratio (≈ 100·I_twist·b / I_swing).
    public var lateralGain: Float = 1.65
    /// cm of tip/throat offset per unit of normalized ring energy.
    public var longitudinalGain: Float = 10.0
    /// Jolt below this magnitude counts as "center" (no tip/throat sign).
    public var joltDeadband: Float = 0.02
    /// Apparent coefficient of restitution at the sweet spot.
    public var acorCenter: Float = 0.42
    /// Fraction of brushing speed that becomes ball surface speed.
    public var spinGain: Float = 0.7
    /// Ball speed from the racket's speed loss at contact (`ShotAnalyzer.impulseBallSpeed`) instead of the
    /// still-ball formula. Off until a wall-speed test (docs/WALL_SPEED_TEST.md) fits `impulseGain`.
    public var useImpulseBallSpeed: Bool = false
    /// k = e/(1+e) · m_eff/m_ball in v_out = V + k·ΔV (assumed m_eff 0.25 kg, e 0.43 → ≈1.3; fit with
    /// tools/wall_speed_fit.py). Clamped to 0...4 when used.
    public var impulseGain: Float = 1.3

    public init() {}

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case lateralGain, longitudinalGain, joltDeadband, acorCenter, spinGain, useImpulseBallSpeed, impulseGain
    }

    // Saved models predate some fields: missing keys keep their defaults.
    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let c = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        lateralGain = try c.decodeIfPresent(Float.self, forKey: .lateralGain) ?? lateralGain
        longitudinalGain = try c.decodeIfPresent(Float.self, forKey: .longitudinalGain) ?? longitudinalGain
        joltDeadband = try c.decodeIfPresent(Float.self, forKey: .joltDeadband) ?? joltDeadband
        acorCenter = try c.decodeIfPresent(Float.self, forKey: .acorCenter) ?? acorCenter
        spinGain = try c.decodeIfPresent(Float.self, forKey: .spinGain) ?? spinGain
        useImpulseBallSpeed = try c.decodeIfPresent(Bool.self, forKey: .useImpulseBallSpeed) ?? useImpulseBallSpeed
        impulseGain = try c.decodeIfPresent(Float.self, forKey: .impulseGain) ?? impulseGain
    }
}

public struct ShotAnalyzer: Sendable {
    public var profile: RacketProfile
    public var model: ImpactModel

    // Shot-type tuning from a labeled session (data/room-2026-10-29: 22 hits, light, indoors). With the gyro at its
    // true scale (the session was recorded on firmware 1.5, which read it 2x high, so halve its raw values) volleys
    // turned the racket 32–42° in the 350 ms before contact, backhands 47–60°, forehands 52–67° and serves 61–71°.
    // Fitted on that one session; SmartTennisRacket's harder groundstrokes turn 140–250°.
    static let swingSpan: Double = 0.35          // fits in the racket's 384 ms impact window
    static let volleyMaxSwingDeg: Float = 45
    static let serveMaxVertical: Float = -0.1
    static let serveMinTipUp: Float = 0.6
    /// Speed of the ball coming in, for the ball-speed estimate. Unknown without tracking it, so the estimate is
    /// the speed the racket gives a still ball; rally balls arrive with pace this leaves out.
    static let incomingBallMs: Float = 0
    public init(profile: RacketProfile, model: ImpactModel) {
        self.profile = profile
        self.model = model
    }

    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - window: racket-frame samples; `impact` indexes the impact sample.
    ///   - orientation: racket→world orientation at the impact sample.
    public func analyze(window: [IMUSample], impact i0: Int, orientation q: simd_quatf,
                        date: Date, calibrationMode: Bool) -> ShotMetrics {
        let n = window.count
        func mean(_ r: Range<Int>, _ f: (IMUSample) -> SIMD3<Float>) -> SIMD3<Float> {
            let lo = max(0, r.lowerBound), hi = min(n, r.upperBound)
            guard hi > lo else { return .zero }
            return window[lo..<hi].reduce(.zero) { $0 + f($1) } / Float(hi - lo)
        }

        // Rotation just before and just after contact (skip the ~5 ms of contact itself).
        let wPre = mean((i0 - 10)..<(i0 - 2)) { $0.gyro }
        let wPost = mean((i0 + 12)..<(i0 + 30)) { $0.gyro }
        let dW = wPost - wPre
        let swingDeg = Self.swingAngleDeg(window, before: i0)

        // Racket speed at the sweet spot. Rotation about the shaft (x) only spins the head in place, so only the
        // rotation across it moves the sweet spot; on some hits it is nearly half of |ω|.
        let omega = simd_length(wPre)
        let vRacket = simd_length(SIMD2(wPre.y, wPre.z)) * profile.effectiveRadiusM   // m/s

        // World-frame geometry at contact.
        let up = SIMD3<Float>(0, 0, 1)
        let tipW = q.act(SIMD3(1, 0, 0))
        let normalW = q.act(SIMD3(0, 0, 1))
        let omegaW = q.act(wPre)
        var vDir = simd_cross(omegaW, tipW * profile.effectiveRadiusM)
        vDir = simd_length(vDir) > 1e-3 ? simd_normalize(vDir) : normalW
        let hitSign: Float = simd_dot(normalW, vDir) >= 0 ? 1 : -1   // which face meets the ball
        let hitNormal = normalW * hitSign
        let faceAngle = asin(max(-1, min(1, simd_dot(hitNormal, up)))) * 180 / .pi
        let pathAngle = asin(max(-1, min(1, simd_dot(vDir, up)))) * 180 / .pi

        // Shot type. A volley is a short swing. Turning about the vertical the forehand way (counter-clockwise from
        // above for a right-hander) is a forehand; the backhand way is a backhand, unless the forehand face hit the
        // ball: then the racket came over the top, which is a serve. Telling the faces apart needs the player's
        // forehand sign (taught, or learned by AppModel); until then serves need the tip up at contact.
        let type: ShotType
        let forehandTurn = (omegaW.z > 0) == profile.rightHanded
        // Share of the rotation about the vertical, forehand way positive. Serves were -0.21 to -0.82; a forehand
        // can be near 0 (+0.06 in the labeled session), so only a clear reverse turn counts as a serve.
        let forehandVertical = (omega > 1e-3 ? omegaW.z / omega : 0) * (profile.rightHanded ? 1 : -1)
        if calibrationMode {
            type = .calibration
        } else if swingDeg < Self.volleyMaxSwingDeg {
            type = .volley
        } else if abs(simd_dot(tipW, up)) > Self.serveMinTipUp && omega > 4 {
            // Long axis near vertical at contact: a serve. The sign depends on how the unit is mounted (the room
            // session's serves read -0.82 to -0.97 under the default calibration), so only its size counts.
            type = .serve
        } else if profile.forehandBodySign != 0 {
            let forehandFace = wPre.y * profile.forehandBodySign > 0
            type = !forehandFace ? .backhand : (forehandVertical < Self.serveMaxVertical ? .serve : .forehand)
        } else {
            type = forehandTurn ? .forehand : .backhand
        }

        // ---- Impact location ----
        let impulse = max(abs(dW.y), 0.5)
        let rollRatio = dW.x / impulse
        let impactX = max(-12, min(12, -rollRatio * model.lateralGain))

        // Frame ringing: band-pass (difference of two moving averages ≈ 120–250 Hz) on the face-normal axis.
        let ringStart = min(n, i0 + 4), ringEnd = min(n, i0 + 60)
        var ringEnergy: Float = 0
        if ringEnd - ringStart > 8 {
            let z = window[(ringStart - 4)..<ringEnd].map { $0.highG.z }
            var count: Float = 0
            for k in 4..<z.count {
                let fast = (z[k] + z[k - 1]) / 2
                let slow = (z[k] + z[k - 1] + z[k - 2] + z[k - 3]) / 4
                let b = fast - slow
                ringEnergy += b * b
                count += 1
            }
            ringEnergy = (ringEnergy / max(count, 1)).squareRoot()
        }
        let ringNorm = ringEnergy / impulse

        // Handle kick: velocity change along the face normal during contact, relative to the pre-impact trend.
        let base = mean((i0 - 14)..<(i0 - 4)) { $0.highG }.z
        var dv: Float = 0
        for k in max(0, i0 - 1)..<min(n, i0 + 5) {
            let excess: Float = window[k].highG.z - base
            dv += excess * Float(0.00981)
        }
        let jolt = dv * hitSign / impulse       // > 0: handle pushed back with the ball (throat); < 0: tip
        var impactY = min(14, ringNorm * model.longitudinalGain)
        if abs(jolt) < model.joltDeadband { impactY *= 0.3 } else if jolt > 0 { impactY = -impactY }

        var features = ImpactFeatures(rollRatio: rollRatio, ringNorm: ringNorm, jolt: jolt, impulse: impulse, spinAxisY: wPre.y)
        features.verticalSpin = forehandVertical
        features.swingDeg = swingDeg
        let distance = (impactX * impactX + impactY * impactY).squareRoot()

        // ---- Ball speed ----
        let e = model.acorCenter * max(0.55, 1 - 0.035 * distance)
        let vBallStill = e * Self.incomingBallMs + (1 + e) * vRacket
        let postSamples = min(n, i0 + 30) - max(0, i0 + 12)
        let impulse2 = Self.impulseBallSpeed(wPre: wPre, wPost: wPost, postSamples: postSamples,
                                             radius: profile.effectiveRadiusM, gain: model.impulseGain)
        features.racketDropMs = impulse2.drop
        features.ballSpeedImpulseMs = impulse2.speed
        let vBall: Float = calibrationMode ? 0
            : (model.useImpulseBallSpeed ? (impulse2.speed ?? vBallStill) : vBallStill)

        // ---- Spin: brushing speed along the strings ----
        let along = vDir - simd_dot(vDir, hitNormal) * hitNormal
        let brush = vRacket * simd_length(along)
        let spinRPM = Double(model.spinGain * brush / 0.0335 * 60 / (2 * .pi))
        let spin: SpinType = spinRPM < 600 ? .flat : (simd_dot(along, up) > 0 ? .topspin : .slice)

        let peakG = window[max(0, i0 - 5)..<min(n, i0 + 10)].map { simd_length($0.highG) }.max() ?? 0
        let saturated = window[max(0, i0 - 300)..<min(n, i0 + 30)].contains { $0.gyroSaturated }

        return ShotMetrics(
            date: date, type: type,
            swingSpeedKmh: Double(vRacket * 3.6),
            ballSpeedKmh: Double(vBall * 3.6),
            spinRPM: calibrationMode ? 0 : spinRPM,
            spin: calibrationMode ? .flat : spin,
            faceAngleDeg: Double(faceAngle),
            swingPathDeg: Double(pathAngle),
            impactXcm: Double(impactX),
            impactYcm: Double(impactY),
            peakG: Double(peakG),
            gyroSaturated: saturated,
            features: features)
    }

    /// Ball speed from momentum: the sweet spot loses ΔV = r·(ω_pre − ω_post) at contact and m_eff·ΔV =
    /// m_ball·(v_out + u); eliminating the unknown incoming speed u with the ACOR relation gives v_out = V + k·ΔV.
    /// ω is the rotation across the shaft only, as for `vRacket`. Only the sweet spot's speed along the face normal
    /// matters for the bounce; this uses the full across-shaft speed (not projected yet).
    /// Returns `speed` nil (use the still-ball formula) when there is no post window, no drop, or a non-finite result.
    static func impulseBallSpeed(wPre: SIMD3<Float>, wPost: SIMD3<Float>, postSamples: Int,
                                 radius r: Float, gain: Float) -> (speed: Float?, drop: Float?) {
        guard postSamples > 0 else { return (nil, nil) }
        let pre = simd_length(SIMD2(wPre.y, wPre.z)), post = simd_length(SIMD2(wPost.y, wPost.z))
        let drop = r * (pre - post)
        let k = max(0, min(4, gain))
        guard drop.isFinite else { return (nil, nil) }
        guard drop > 0 else { return (nil, drop) }
        let v = r * pre + k * drop
        guard v.isFinite else { return (nil, drop) }
        return (min(90, v), drop)
    }

    /// Degrees the racket turned in the `swingSpan` before sample `i0`. Uses sample times, so gaps in a raw stream
    /// that lost packets count for their real length (up to 60 ms each).
    static func swingAngleDeg(_ w: [IMUSample], before i0: Int) -> Float {
        guard i0 > 0, i0 < w.count else { return 0 }
        let start = w[i0].time - swingSpan
        var angle: Float = 0
        var k = i0 - 1
        while k > 0, w[k - 1].time > start {
            let dt = Float(min(w[k].time - w[k - 1].time, 0.06))
            angle += (simd_length(w[k].gyro) + simd_length(w[k - 1].gyro)) / 2 * dt
            k -= 1
        }
        return angle * 180 / .pi
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import Foundation

public enum ShotType: String, Codable, Sendable, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
    case forehand, backhand, serve, volley, hit, calibration
    public var id: String { rawValue }
    public var label: String {
        switch self {
        case .forehand: "Forehand"
        case .backhand: "Backhand"
        case .serve: "Serve"
        case .volley: "Volley"
        case .hit: "Hit"
        case .calibration: "Calibration"
        }
    }
    public var symbol: String {
        switch self {
        case .forehand: "arrow.turn.up.left"
        case .backhand: "arrow.turn.up.right"
        case .serve: "arrow.up.circle"
        case .volley: "hand.raised"
        case .hit: "tennisball"
        case .calibration: "scope"
        }
    }
}

public enum SpinType: String, Codable, Sendable {
    case topspin, flat, slice
    public var label: String { rawValue.capitalized }
}

/// Raw impact features, kept so calibration can refit the location model later.
public struct ImpactFeatures: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    /// Roll-rate jump ÷ swing-axis jump (side-to-side hit position).
    public var rollRatio: Float
    /// Frame ringing (120–250 Hz) at the butt ÷ impact strength (distance from the vibration node).
    public var ringNorm: Float
    /// Handle velocity kick against the ball direction; negative = toward the tip.
    public var jolt: Float
    /// Size of the swing-axis rotation jump, rad/s (impact strength proxy).
    public var impulse: Float
    /// Racket-frame rotation about the across-face axis just before contact, rad/s. Its sign tells forehand from
    /// backhand without the orientation estimate. Optional so older saved shots still decode.
    public var spinAxisY: Float?
    /// Share of the pre-contact rotation that is about world vertical, -1...1, positive the player's forehand way
    /// (counter-clockwise from above for a right-hander); serves and backhands turn the other way. Optional like
    /// `spinAxisY`.
    public var verticalSpin: Float?
    /// Degrees the racket turned in the 350 ms before contact; volleys are short swings. Optional like `spinAxisY`.
    public var swingDeg: Float?
    /// Sweet-spot speed lost at contact, r·(|ω_pre| − |ω_post|) across the shaft, m/s. Optional like `spinAxisY`.
    public var racketDropMs: Float?
    /// Ball speed from that drop (`ShotAnalyzer.impulseBallSpeed`), m/s; nil when it falls back. Recorded whether
    /// or not `ImpactModel.useImpulseBallSpeed` is on, so recordings can compare both estimates.
    public var ballSpeedImpulseMs: Float?

    public init(rollRatio: Float, ringNorm: Float, jolt: Float, impulse: Float, spinAxisY: Float? = nil) {
        self.rollRatio = rollRatio
        self.ringNorm = ringNorm
        self.jolt = jolt
        self.impulse = impulse
        self.spinAxisY = spinAxisY
    }
}

/// Everything we know about one shot. Shared by the apps, the Watch and the coach.
public struct ShotMetrics: Codable, Sendable, Identifiable, Equatable {
    public var id = UUID()
    public var date: Date
    public var type: ShotType
    public var swingSpeedKmh: Double
    public var ballSpeedKmh: Double
    public var spinRPM: Double
    public var spin: SpinType
    /// Face tilt at contact; positive = open (face tilted up).
    public var faceAngleDeg: Double
    /// Racket path at contact; positive = low to high.
    public var swingPathDeg: Double
    /// Hit location relative to the sweet spot, cm. x = across the face, y = toward the tip.
    public var impactXcm: Double
    public var impactYcm: Double
    public var peakG: Double
    public var gyroSaturated: Bool
    public var features: ImpactFeatures
    /// True when only the racket's mic heard this hit (motion sensors offline): sweet spot and distance are
    /// known, but speeds, spin and angles are not. Optional so older saved shots still decode.
    public var micOnly: Bool?
    public var hasMotion: Bool { micOnly != true }

    /// A hit known only from the racket's on-device sound model.
    public static func fromMic(sweet: Bool, offCenterPercent: Int, date: Date = Date()) -> ShotMetrics {
        // 100% off = at the frame, ~12 cm from the sweet spot. Direction is unknown, so it's drawn toward the tip.
        let distance = sweet ? 1.0 : max(Double(offCenterPercent) / 100 * 12, sweetSpotRadiusCm + 0.5)
        var shot = ShotMetrics(date: date, type: .hit, swingSpeedKmh: 0, ballSpeedKmh: 0, spinRPM: 0, spin: .flat,
                               faceAngleDeg: 0, swingPathDeg: 0, impactXcm: 0, impactYcm: distance, peakG: 0,
                               gyroSaturated: false,
                               features: ImpactFeatures(rollRatio: 0, ringNorm: 0, jolt: 0, impulse: 0))
        shot.micOnly = true
        return shot
    }

    public var impactDistanceCm: Double { (impactXcm * impactXcm + impactYcm * impactYcm).squareRoot() }
    public var isSweetSpot: Bool { impactDistanceCm <= ShotMetrics.sweetSpotRadiusCm }
    public static let sweetSpotRadiusCm = 4.0

    public init(date: Date, type: ShotType, swingSpeedKmh: Double, ballSpeedKmh: Double, spinRPM: Double,
                spin: SpinType, faceAngleDeg: Double, swingPathDeg: Double, impactXcm: Double, impactYcm: Double,
                peakG: Double, gyroSaturated: Bool, features: ImpactFeatures) {
        self.date = date
        self.type = type
        self.swingSpeedKmh = swingSpeedKmh
        self.ballSpeedKmh = ballSpeedKmh
        self.spinRPM = spinRPM
        self.spin = spin
        self.faceAngleDeg = faceAngleDeg
        self.swingPathDeg = swingPathDeg
        self.impactXcm = impactXcm
        self.impactYcm = impactYcm
        self.peakG = peakG
        self.gyroSaturated = gyroSaturated
        self.features = features
    }
}

/// Aggregates for a set of shots (a session, or one stroke within it).
public struct ShotSummary: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    public var count: Int
    public var sweetSpotPercent: Double
    public var avgSwingKmh: Double
    public var maxSwingKmh: Double
    public var avgBallKmh: Double
    public var maxBallKmh: Double
    public var avgSpinRPM: Double
    public var avgFaceAngle: Double
    public var avgPathAngle: Double
    public var avgImpactX: Double
    public var avgImpactY: Double
    /// Spread of impact positions (cm); lower = more consistent.
    public var impactSpreadCm: Double

    public init(_ shots: [ShotMetrics]) {
        let n = Double(max(shots.count, 1))
        // Speeds, spin and angles only exist for shots the motion sensors saw.
        let moving = shots.filter(\.hasMotion)
        let nm = Double(max(moving.count, 1))
        func avg(_ f: (ShotMetrics) -> Double) -> Double { shots.reduce(0) { $0 + f($1) } / n }
        func avgMoving(_ f: (ShotMetrics) -> Double) -> Double { moving.reduce(0) { $0 + f($1) } / nm }
        count = shots.count
        sweetSpotPercent = shots.isEmpty ? 0 : Double(shots.filter(\.isSweetSpot).count) / n * 100
        avgSwingKmh = avgMoving(\.swingSpeedKmh)
        maxSwingKmh = shots.map(\.swingSpeedKmh).max() ?? 0
        avgBallKmh = avgMoving(\.ballSpeedKmh)
        maxBallKmh = shots.map(\.ballSpeedKmh).max() ?? 0
        avgSpinRPM = avgMoving(\.spinRPM)
        avgFaceAngle = avgMoving(\.faceAngleDeg)
        avgPathAngle = avgMoving(\.swingPathDeg)
        avgImpactX = avg(\.impactXcm)
        avgImpactY = avg(\.impactYcm)
        let mx = avgImpactX, my = avgImpactY
        impactSpreadCm = (shots.reduce(0) { $0 + pow($1.impactXcm - mx, 2) + pow($1.impactYcm - my, 2) } / n).squareRoot()
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import Foundation

/// A bounded sensitivity model, not a validated ball-flight predictor.
/// Speed and spin follow ShotAnalyzer's impact model; side spin and trajectory are not modeled.
public enum ShotSimulator {
    public struct Parameters: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
        public var swingSpeedKmh: Double
        public var pathAngleDeg: Double
        public var faceAngleDeg: Double
        public var contactXcm: Double
        public var contactYcm: Double
        public var incomingSpeedKmh: Double

        public init(swingSpeedKmh: Double, pathAngleDeg: Double, faceAngleDeg: Double,
                    contactXcm: Double, contactYcm: Double, incomingSpeedKmh: Double = 43.2) {
            self.swingSpeedKmh = swingSpeedKmh
            self.pathAngleDeg = pathAngleDeg
            self.faceAngleDeg = faceAngleDeg
            self.contactXcm = contactXcm
            self.contactYcm = contactYcm
            self.incomingSpeedKmh = incomingSpeedKmh
        }

        public var clamped: Self {
            Self(swingSpeedKmh: bounded(swingSpeedKmh, 0...200),
                 pathAngleDeg: bounded(pathAngleDeg, -80...80),
                 faceAngleDeg: bounded(faceAngleDeg, -60...60),
                 contactXcm: bounded(contactXcm, -12...12), contactYcm: bounded(contactYcm, -14...14),
                 incomingSpeedKmh: bounded(incomingSpeedKmh, 0...200))
        }
    }

    public struct Result: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
        public var parameters: Parameters
        public var ballSpeedKmh: Double
        public var spinRPM: Double
        public var spin: SpinType
        public var estimated: Bool { true }
    }

    /// Non-finite inputs become zero before clamping. No unmeasured launch/landing numbers are returned.
    public static func simulate(_ input: Parameters, model: ImpactModel = ImpactModel()) -> Result {
        let p = input.clamped
        let distance = hypot(p.contactXcm, p.contactYcm)
        let e = bounded(Double(model.acorCenter), 0...1) * max(0.55, 1 - 0.035 * distance)
        let speed = p.swingSpeedKmh / 3.6
        let brush = speed * sin((p.pathAngleDeg - p.faceAngleDeg) * .pi / 180)
        let rpm = bounded(Double(model.spinGain), 0...1) * abs(brush) / 0.0335 * 60 / (2 * .pi)
        return Result(parameters: p, ballSpeedKmh: e * p.incomingSpeedKmh + (1 + e) * p.swingSpeedKmh,
                      spinRPM: rpm, spin: rpm < 600 ? .flat : (brush > 0 ? .topspin : .slice))
    }

    private static func bounded(_ value: Double, _ range: ClosedRange<Double>) -> Double {
        min(range.upperBound, max(range.lowerBound, value.isFinite ? value : 0))
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import Foundation
import simd

/// Generates realistic racket-frame IMU data in real time: idle holding, then swings with impacts.
/// Lets the apps be built and demoed without hardware. The physics mirrors `ShotAnalyzer`, so the
/// analyzer recovers roughly the shot that was simulated.
public final class SimulatedRacket: SampleSource, @unchecked Sendable {
    public var onSamples: (([IMUSample]) -> Void)?
    public var nativeCalibration: Calibration? { .identity }
    /// Seconds between shots.
    public var shotInterval: Double = 3.0

    private var timer: DispatchSourceTimer?
    private let queue = DispatchQueue(label: "tennisbuddy.simulator", qos: .userInitiated)
    private var buffer: [IMUSample] = []
    private var cursor = 0
    private var time: Double = 0
    private var q = simd_quatf(angle: 0, axis: SIMD3(0, 0, 1))
    private var rng = SystemRandomNumberGenerator()

    public init() {}

    public func start() {
        stop()
        q = Self.idle
        time = 0
        buffer = makeIdle(seconds: 1.0)
        cursor = 0
        let t = DispatchSource.makeTimerSource(queue: queue)
        t.schedule(deadline: .now(), repeating: .milliseconds(10), leeway: .milliseconds(2))
        t.setEventHandler { [weak self] in self?.tick() }
        timer = t
        t.resume()
    }

    public func stop() {
        timer?.cancel()
        timer = nil
    }

    /// A whole session at once (no timer), for tests: idle, then `shots` swings each followed by a pause.
    func generate(shots: Int) -> [IMUSample] {
        q = Self.idle
        time = 0
        var out = makeIdle(seconds: 1.0)
        for _ in 0..<shots { out += makeShot() + makeIdle(seconds: 0.8) }
        return out
    }

    private func tick() {
        var out: [IMUSample] = []
        out.reserveCapacity(10)
        for _ in 0..<10 {
            if cursor >= buffer.count {
                buffer = makeShot() + makeIdle(seconds: max(0.5, shotInterval - 2.2))
                cursor = 0
            }
            out.append(buffer[cursor])
            cursor += 1
        }
        onSamples?(out)
    }

    // MARK: - Scenario generation

    static let up = SIMD3<Float>(0, 0, 1)
    /// Ready position: racket horizontal in front, face vertical.
    static let idle = orientation(x: SIMD3(0, 1, 0), y: SIMD3(0, 0, -1))

    static func orientation(x: SIMD3<Float>, y: SIMD3<Float>) -> simd_quatf {
        let xn = simd_normalize(x), yn = simd_normalize(y)
        let z = simd_cross(xn, yn)
        return simd_quatf(simd_float3x3(columns: (xn, yn, z)))
    }

    private func gauss(_ sigma: Float) -> Float {
        let u1 = Float.random(in: 1e-6..<1, using: &rng), u2 = Float.random(in: 0..<1, using: &rng)
        return sigma * (-2 * log(u1)).squareRoot() * cos(2 * .pi * u2)
    }

    private func noisy(_ v: SIMD3<Float>, _ s: Float) -> SIMD3<Float> { v + SIMD3(gauss(s), gauss(s), gauss(s)) }

    /// Emits one sample for the current orientation and body angular velocity.
    private func sample(omega: SIMD3<Float>, extraHighG: SIMD3<Float> = .zero) -> IMUSample {
        let gravity = q.inverse.act(Self.up)                       // +1 g pointing up, body frame
        let perp = SIMD3<Float>(0, omega.y, omega.z)
        let centripetal = SIMD3<Float>(-simd_length_squared(perp) * 0.6 / 9.81, 0, 0)
        let a = gravity + centripetal
        let mpuAccel = simd_clamp(a, SIMD3(repeating: -16), SIMD3(repeating: 16))
        let gyroClamped = simd_clamp(omega, SIMD3(repeating: -34.9), SIMD3(repeating: 34.9))
        time += 0.001
        return IMUSample(time: time,
                         accel: noisy(mpuAccel, 0.01),
                         gyro: noisy(gyroClamped, 0.01),
                         highG: noisy(a + extraHighG, 0.15))
    }

    private func advance(_ omega: SIMD3<Float>) {
        let angle = simd_length(omega) * 0.001
        if angle > 1e-9 { q = simd_normalize(q * simd_quatf(angle: angle, axis: simd_normalize(omega))) }
    }

    /// Smooth move to `target` over `seconds`, emitting gyro that matches the motion.
    private func moveTo(_ target: simd_quatf, seconds: Double) -> [IMUSample] {
        let n = Int(seconds * 1000)
        let start = q
        var out: [IMUSample] = []
        for k in 1...max(n, 1) {
            let t = Float(k) / Float(n)
            let eased = t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
            let next = simd_slerp(start, target, eased)
            let rel = q.inverse * next
            var w = rel.axis * rel.angle / 0.001
            if rel.angle > .pi { w = -rel.axis * (2 * .pi - rel.angle) / 0.001 }
            if !w.x.isFinite { w = .zero }
            out.append(sample(omega: w))
            q = next
        }
        return out
    }

    private func makeIdle(seconds: Double) -> [IMUSample] {
        var out = moveTo(Self.idle, seconds: 0.4)
        for k in 0..<Int(seconds * 1000) {
            let sway = SIMD3<Float>(0.05 * sin(Float(k) * 0.004), 0.08 * sin(Float(k) * 0.003), 0)
            advance(sway)
            out.append(sample(omega: sway))
        }
        return out
    }

    private func makeShot() -> [IMUSample] {
        enum Kind { case forehand, backhand, serve, volley }
        let roll = Float.random(in: 0..<1, using: &rng)
        let kind: Kind = roll < 0.45 ? .forehand : roll < 0.75 ? .backhand : roll < 0.9 ? .serve : .volley
        let slice = kind != .serve && Float.random(in: 0..<1, using: &rng) < 0.15

        // Contact orientation (racket → world) and rotation axis (body frame).
        var contact: simd_quatf
        var pathDeg = Float.random(in: 12...30, using: &rng)
        if slice { pathDeg = -Float.random(in: 8...18, using: &rng) }
        let tanPath = tan(pathDeg * .pi / 180)
        var axis: SIMD3<Float>
        var peak: Float
        switch kind {
        case .forehand:
            contact = Self.orientation(x: SIMD3(1, 0, 0), y: SIMD3(0, 0, -1))
            axis = SIMD3(0, -1, -tanPath)
            peak = Float.random(in: 17...26, using: &rng)
        case .backhand:
            contact = Self.orientation(x: SIMD3(-1, 0, 0), y: SIMD3(0, 0, 1))
            axis = SIMD3(0, -1, tanPath)
            peak = Float.random(in: 15...23, using: &rng)
        case .serve:
            contact = Self.orientation(x: SIMD3(0, 0.15, 1), y: SIMD3(1, 0, 0))
            axis = SIMD3(0, -1, Float.random(in: -0.2...0.1, using: &rng))
            peak = Float.random(in: 24...32, using: &rng)
        case .volley:
            contact = Self.orientation(x: SIMD3(1, 0.3, 0), y: SIMD3(0, 0, -1))
            axis = SIMD3(0, -1, -0.1)
            peak = Float.random(in: 4...7, using: &rng)
        }
        // Open the face a little for slices, close it a little for topspin.
        let faceTilt: Float = (slice ? 0.35 : -0.05) * (kind == .backhand ? -1 : 1)
        contact = contact * simd_quatf(angle: faceTilt, axis: SIMD3(1, 0, 0))
        axis = simd_normalize(axis)

        // Angular speed profile: Gaussian bump peaking just after contact.
        let sigma: Float = kind == .volley ? 0.06 : 0.13
        let tPre: Float = kind == .volley ? 0.15 : 0.45
        let profile = { (t: Float) -> Float in peak * exp(-pow((t - 0.02) / sigma, 2)) }
        // Integrated angle from t to contact, to find the start orientation.
        var phi: Float = 0
        var t = -tPre
        while t < 0 { phi += profile(t) * 0.001; t += 0.001 }
        let start = contact * simd_quatf(angle: -phi, axis: axis)

        var out = moveTo(start, seconds: 0.7)
        // Forward swing up to contact.
        t = -tPre
        while t < 0 {
            let w = axis * profile(t)
            out.append(sample(omega: w))
            advance(w)
            t += 0.001
        }

        // Impact: true hit position (cm), mostly near the sweet spot.
        let hitX = gauss(2.2), hitY = gauss(3.2)
        let impulse = 0.35 * peak                                  // rad/s drop about the swing axis
        let dOmega = SIMD3<Float>(-(hitX / 1.65) * impulse, impulse, 0) // slows the -y rotation, adds roll
        let ringAmp = abs(hitY) * impulse * 0.55                   // g; frame rings more away from the node
        let joltSign: Float = hitY > 0 ? 1 : -1                    // tip hits kick the handle forward (+z)
        let joltAmp = min(abs(hitY), 8) * impulse * 1.5           // g during the 4 ms of contact

        for k in 0..<450 {
            let tt = Float(k) * 0.001
            var w = axis * profile(tt) + dOmega * exp(-tt / 0.15)
            if kind != .volley && tt > 0.2 { w *= exp(-(tt - 0.2) / 0.1) }   // follow-through slows down
            var extra = SIMD3<Float>(repeating: 0)
            if k < 4 {
                extra.z += joltSign * joltAmp
                extra += SIMD3(0, 0, 30 * (k % 2 == 0 ? 1 : -1)) * (peak / 20)   // contact spike
            }
            // Phase chosen so the ring integrates to ~0 over contact and doesn't fake a handle kick.
            extra.z += ringAmp * sin(2 * .pi * 160 * tt - 0.4 * .pi) * exp(-tt / 0.03)
            out.append(sample(omega: w, extraHighG: extra))
            advance(w)
        }
        return out
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import Foundation

/// Ground-truth check of the racket's on-device sweet-spot model: balls dropped on known squares of a taped 3×3
/// grid, each paired with the verdict the racket sent and the app's motion-sensor estimate for the same hit.
/// The center square is the sweet spot; every other square is 5 to 8 cm off it, outside `sweetSpotRadiusCm`.
public struct SweetSpotCheck: Sendable {
    public struct Cell: Hashable, Codable, Sendable {
        public var col: Int   // -1 left, 0 center, 1 right
        public var row: Int   // 1 tip, 0 center, -1 throat
        public init(col: Int, row: Int) { self.col = col; self.row = row }

        /// Taped square spacing: 5 cm across the face, 6 cm along it.
        public var xCm: Double { Double(col) * 5 }
        public var yCm: Double { Double(row) * 6 }
        public var distanceCm: Double { (xCm * xCm + yCm * yCm).squareRoot() }
        public var isSweet: Bool { distanceCm <= ShotMetrics.sweetSpotRadiusCm }
        public var name: String {
            if col == 0 && row == 0 { return "center" }
            let r = row > 0 ? "tip" : (row < 0 ? "throat" : "")
            let c = col < 0 ? "left" : (col > 0 ? "right" : "")
            return [r, c].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: "-")
        }
    }

    public struct Drop: Codable, Sendable, Identifiable {
        public var id = UUID()
        public var date: Date
        public var cell: Cell
        /// The racket's verdict; nil if none arrived (simulator, or a mic that missed the hit).
        public var racketSweet: Bool?
        public var offCenterPercent: Int?
        public var confidencePercent: Int?
        public var level: Int?
        /// The app's motion-sensor estimate; nil if the IMU didn't register the hit.
        public var imuXcm: Double?
        public var imuYcm: Double?
        public var peakG: Double?
        public var features: ImpactFeatures?

        /// Whether the racket's verdict matched the square; nil without a verdict.
        public var racketCorrect: Bool? { racketSweet.map { $0 == cell.isSweet } }
    }

    /// A verdict and an IMU impact this close together, on the same square, are one drop.
    public static let pairWindow: TimeInterval = 0.6

    public private(set) var drops: [Drop] = []

    public init() {}

    public mutating func add(verdict v: RacketProtocol.ShotVerdict, cell: Cell, at date: Date = Date()) {
        let i = pairIndex(cell: cell, date: date) { $0.racketSweet == nil } ?? newDrop(cell: cell, date: date)
        drops[i].racketSweet = v.isSweet
        drops[i].offCenterPercent = v.offCenterPercent
        drops[i].confidencePercent = v.confidencePercent
        drops[i].level = v.level
    }

    public mutating func add(shot: ShotMetrics, cell: Cell, at date: Date = Date()) {
        guard shot.micOnly != true else { return }
        let i = pairIndex(cell: cell, date: date) { $0.features == nil } ?? newDrop(cell: cell, date: date)
        drops[i].imuXcm = shot.impactXcm
        drops[i].imuYcm = shot.impactYcm
        drops[i].peakG = shot.peakG
        drops[i].features = shot.features
    }

    public mutating func undo() { if !drops.isEmpty { drops.removeLast() } }

    public func drops(in cell: Cell) -> [Drop] { drops.filter { $0.cell == cell } }

    /// Drops the racket gave a verdict on, and how many of those it got right.
    public var scored: Int { drops.filter { $0.racketSweet != nil }.count }
    public var correct: Int { drops.filter { $0.racketCorrect == true }.count }
    public var accuracy: Double? { scored > 0 ? Double(correct) / Double(scored) : nil }
    /// Sweet-spot drops the racket called sweet, and off-center drops it called off-center.
    public var sweetHits: (correct: Int, of: Int) { tally { $0.cell.isSweet } }
    public var offHits: (correct: Int, of: Int) { tally { !$0.cell.isSweet } }

    /// One row per drop, `dist_cm` as in the training `labels.csv`, for data/ and ml/.
    public func csv() -> String {
        let iso = ISO8601DateFormatter()
        iso.formatOptions = [.withInternetDateTime, .withFractionalSeconds]
        func f(_ v: Double?) -> String { v.map { String(format: "%.3f", $0) } ?? "" }
        func i(_ v: Int?) -> String { v.map(String.init) ?? "" }
        var out = "date,cell,col,row,x_cm,y_cm,dist_cm,expected_sweet,racket_sweet,racket_correct,off_center_pct,"
            + "confidence_pct,level,imu_x_cm,imu_y_cm,peak_g,roll_ratio,ring_norm,jolt,impulse\n"
        for d in drops {
            let ft = d.features
            let cols: [String] = [
                iso.string(from: d.date), d.cell.name, "\(d.cell.col)", "\(d.cell.row)",
                f(d.cell.xCm), f(d.cell.yCm), f(d.cell.distanceCm), d.cell.isSweet ? "1" : "0",
                d.racketSweet.map { $0 ? "1" : "0" } ?? "", d.racketCorrect.map { $0 ? "1" : "0" } ?? "",
                i(d.offCenterPercent), i(d.confidencePercent), i(d.level),
                f(d.imuXcm), f(d.imuYcm), f(d.peakG),
                f(ft.map { Double($0.rollRatio) }), f(ft.map { Double($0.ringNorm) }),
                f(ft.map { Double($0.jolt) }), f(ft.map { Double($0.impulse) }),
            ]
            out += cols.joined(separator: ",") + "\n"
        }
        return out
    }

    private func pairIndex(cell: Cell, date: Date, missing: (Drop) -> Bool) -> Int? {
        guard let i = drops.indices.last, drops[i].cell == cell, missing(drops[i]),
              abs(date.timeIntervalSince(drops[i].date)) <= Self.pairWindow else { return nil }
        return i
    }

    private mutating func newDrop(cell: Cell, date: Date) -> Int {
        drops.append(Drop(date: date, cell: cell))
        return drops.count - 1
    }

    private func tally(_ include: (Drop) -> Bool) -> (correct: Int, of: Int) {
        let d = drops.filter { include($0) && $0.racketSweet != nil }
        return (d.filter { $0.racketCorrect == true }.count, d.count)
    }
}
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "apple/RacketKit/Sources/RacketKit/TapSides.swift", "sha256": "8bd7b2b5417a221929f024cc08dad4eb7872b128cd9a862a0850e006eea2fe0a", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````swift
import Foundation
import simd

/// The handle is an elongated octagon: two wide sides parallel to the string bed and two narrower sides on
/// the edges. A tap pushes the handle along the normal of the side it lands on, so the racket's push
/// direction (RacketProtocol.TapGesture.direction) says which kind of side was hit.
public enum TapSide: String, Codable, Sendable {
    case wide, narrow
    public var label: String { self == .wide ? "Wide side" : "Narrow side" }
}

/// Score keeping by handle taps.
public enum ScoreCommand: Equatable, Sendable {
    /// Double tap on a wide side: you won the point.
    case won
    /// Double tap on a narrow side: your opponent won the point.
    case lost
    /// Triple tap anywhere: take back the last point.
    case undo

    /// Both points are double taps, so the side decides who won and an unclear side scores nothing. Single taps
    /// never score: a lone knock is what a ball, a bounce or a grip change looks like.
    public static func from(count: Int, side: TapSide?) -> ScoreCommand? {
        if count >= 3 { return .undo }
        guard count == 2, let side else { return nil }
        return side == .wide ? .won : .lost
    }
}

/// Which push direction belongs to which side, in the racket's accel (sensor) axes. Directions are compared
/// without their sign, because opposite sides of the handle push the same axis in opposite directions.
public struct TapCalibration: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    public var wideAxis: SIMD3<Float>
    public var narrowAxis: SIMD3<Float>
    /// False while the axes come from the racket calibration rather than recorded taps.
    public var isCalibrated: Bool

    /// Below this difference in |cos| between the two axes the side is reported as unknown.
    public static let minimumMargin: Float = 0.15

    public init(wideAxis: SIMD3<Float>, narrowAxis: SIMD3<Float>, isCalibrated: Bool) {
        self.wideAxis = simd_normalize(wideAxis)
        self.narrowAxis = simd_normalize(narrowAxis)
        self.isCalibrated = isCalibrated
    }

    /// Best guess before any taps are recorded: the wide sides face along the string-bed normal (racket z),
    /// the narrow sides across the face (racket y).
    public static func fromRacket(_ c: Calibration) -> TapCalibration {
        let rows = c.mpuToRacket.transpose
        return TapCalibration(wideAxis: rows[2], narrowAxis: rows[1], isCalibrated: false)
    }

    /// Fits each side's axis from recorded tap directions. Needs at least two taps per side.
    public static func fit(wide: [SIMD3<Float>], narrow: [SIMD3<Float>]) -> TapCalibration? {
        guard let w = principalAxis(wide), let n = principalAxis(narrow) else { return nil }
        return TapCalibration(wideAxis: w, narrowAxis: n, isCalibrated: true)
    }

    /// The side a push direction points at, and the |cos| margin over the other side (0...1).
    public func classify(_ direction: SIMD3<Float>) -> (side: TapSide, margin: Float)? {
        guard simd_length(direction) > 1e-3 else { return nil }
        let d = simd_normalize(direction)
        let w = abs(simd_dot(d, wideAxis)), n = abs(simd_dot(d, narrowAxis))
        guard abs(w - n) >= Self.minimumMargin else { return nil }
        return w > n ? (.wide, w - n) : (.narrow, n - w)
    }

    /// Angle between the two axes, 0...90°. Near 90° the sides are easy to tell apart; under ~40° they are not.
    public var separationDegrees: Float {
        acos(min(1, abs(simd_dot(wideAxis, narrowAxis)))) * 180 / .pi
    }

    /// Sign-free mean direction: the dominant eigenvector of the sum of outer products d·dᵀ.
    static func principalAxis(_ dirs: [SIMD3<Float>]) -> SIMD3<Float>? {
        let units = dirs.filter { simd_length($0) > 1e-3 }.map { simd_normalize($0) }
        guard units.count >= 2 else { return nil }
        var m = simd_float3x3()
        for d in units { m = m + simd_float3x3(columns: (d * d.x, d * d.y, d * d.z)) }
        // Power iteration from the direction that agrees best with the others.
        var v = units.max { a, b in
            units.reduce(0) { $0 + abs(simd_dot(a, $1)) } < units.reduce(0) { $0 + abs(simd_dot(b, $1)) }
        }!
        for _ in 0..<32 {
            let next = m * v
            guard simd_length(next) > 1e-6 else { break }
            v = simd_normalize(next)
        }
        return v
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import Foundation

/// The two sides of a match, from the wearer's point of view.
public enum Player: String, Codable, Sendable, CaseIterable {
    case me, opponent
    public var other: Player { self == .me ? .opponent : .me }
}

/// A score for both players (points, games or sets).
public struct ScorePair: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    public var me = 0
    public var opponent = 0
    public init(me: Int = 0, opponent: Int = 0) {
        self.me = me
        self.opponent = opponent
    }
    public subscript(_ p: Player) -> Int {
        get { p == .me ? me : opponent }
        set { if p == .me { me = newValue } else { opponent = newValue } }
    }
}

public struct MatchRules: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    /// 2 = best of three sets, 1 = a single set.
    public var setsToWin = 2
    public var gamesPerSet = 6
    /// No-ad scoring: at deuce the next point wins the game.
    public var noAd = false
    /// The deciding set is a 10-point match tiebreak (common in club doubles).
    public var matchTiebreak = false
    /// Just count points up, one for you and one for your opponent: no games, sets or tiebreaks.
    public var simpleCount = false
    public init() {}

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case setsToWin, gamesPerSet, noAd, matchTiebreak, simpleCount
    }

    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
        let c = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        setsToWin = try c.decodeIfPresent(Int.self, forKey: .setsToWin) ?? 2
        gamesPerSet = try c.decodeIfPresent(Int.self, forKey: .gamesPerSet) ?? 6
        noAd = try c.decodeIfPresent(Bool.self, forKey: .noAd) ?? false
        matchTiebreak = try c.decodeIfPresent(Bool.self, forKey: .matchTiebreak) ?? false
        simpleCount = try c.decodeIfPresent(Bool.self, forKey: .simpleCount) ?? false
    }
}

/// What a point decided, for the announcement.
public enum ScoreEvent: Equatable, Sendable {
    case point, game(Player), set(Player), match(Player)
}

/// Standard tennis scoring: points, games (deuce/advantage or no-ad), sets with a 7-point tiebreak at 6–6,
/// optionally a 10-point match tiebreak instead of the deciding set.
public struct MatchScore: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    public var rules: MatchRules
    /// Finished sets, in games (a match tiebreak is stored as its points).
    public var sets: [ScorePair] = []
    public var games = ScorePair()
    /// Points in the current game, or in the tiebreak.
    public var points = ScorePair()
    public var winner: Player?

    public init(rules: MatchRules = MatchRules()) { self.rules = rules }

    public func setsWon(_ p: Player) -> Int {
        sets.filter { $0[p] > $0[p.other] }.count
    }

    /// The deciding set is being played as a match tiebreak.
    public var isMatchTiebreak: Bool {
        rules.matchTiebreak && rules.setsToWin > 1
            && setsWon(.me) == rules.setsToWin - 1 && setsWon(.opponent) == rules.setsToWin - 1
    }

    public var isTiebreak: Bool {
        isMatchTiebreak || (games.me == rules.gamesPerSet && games.opponent == rules.gamesPerSet)
    }

    @discardableResult
    public mutating func award(_ p: Player) -> ScoreEvent {
        guard winner == nil else { return .match(winner!) }
        points[p] += 1
        if rules.simpleCount { return .point }
        let a = points[p], b = points[p.other]
        if isTiebreak {
            let target = isMatchTiebreak ? 10 : 7
            guard a >= target, a - b >= 2 else { return .point }
            if isMatchTiebreak {
                sets.append(points)
            } else {
                games[p] += 1
                sets.append(games)
            }
            return finishSet(p)
        }
        let gameOver = rules.noAd ? a >= 4 : (a >= 4 && a - b >= 2)
        guard gameOver else { return .point }
        points = ScorePair()
        games[p] += 1
        let g = games[p], o = games[p.other]
        guard g >= rules.gamesPerSet, g - o >= 2 else { return .game(p) }
        sets.append(games)
        return finishSet(p)
    }

    private mutating func finishSet(_ p: Player) -> ScoreEvent {
        games = ScorePair()
        points = ScorePair()
        if setsWon(p) >= rules.setsToWin {
            winner = p
            return .match(p)
        }
        return .set(p)
    }

    // MARK: - Text

    private static let calls = ["0", "15", "30", "40"]
    private static let spokenCalls = ["love", "fifteen", "thirty", "forty"]

    /// The current game score for display, wearer first: "30–15", "Deuce", "Ad you", or "5–3" in a tiebreak.
    public var pointText: String {
        if isTiebreak || rules.simpleCount { return "\(points.me)–\(points.opponent)" }
        let a = points.me, b = points.opponent
        if a >= 3 && b >= 3 {
            if a == b { return rules.noAd ? "Deciding point" : "Deuce" }
            return a > b ? "Ad you" : "Ad opponent"
        }
        return "\(Self.calls[min(a, 3)])–\(Self.calls[min(b, 3)])"
    }

    /// One player's column on a scoreboard: "0", "15", "30", "40", "AD", or tiebreak points.
    public func pointCall(_ p: Player) -> String {
        if isTiebreak || rules.simpleCount { return "\(points[p])" }
        let a = points[p], b = points[p.other]
        if a >= 3 && b >= 3 { return a > b ? "AD" : "40" }
        return Self.calls[min(a, 3)]
    }

    /// What to say after a point, wearer first.
    public func announcement(for event: ScoreEvent) -> String {
        func name(_ p: Player) -> String { p == .me ? "you" : "opponent" }
        func lead(_ s: ScorePair) -> String {
            if s.me == s.opponent { return "\(s.me) all" }
            let (hi, lo) = (max(s.me, s.opponent), min(s.me, s.opponent))
            return s.me > s.opponent ? "you lead \(hi) \(lo)" : "opponent leads \(hi) \(lo)"
        }
        switch event {
        case .match(let p):
            return p == .me ? "Game, set and match. You win." : "Game, set and match to your opponent."
        case .set(let p):
            let last = sets.last ?? ScorePair()
            return "Set, \(name(p)), \(last.me) \(last.opponent). Sets: \(lead(ScorePair(me: setsWon(.me), opponent: setsWon(.opponent))))."
        case .game(let p):
            return "Game, \(name(p)). \(lead(games))."
        case .point:
            if rules.simpleCount {
                return points.me == points.opponent ? "\(points.me) all." : "\(points.me) \(points.opponent)."
            }
            if isTiebreak { return "\(isMatchTiebreak ? "Match tiebreak" : "Tiebreak"), \(lead(points))." }
            let a = points.me, b = points.opponent
            if a >= 3 && b >= 3 {
                if a == b { return rules.noAd ? "Deuce, deciding point." : "Deuce." }
                return a > b ? "Advantage you." : "Advantage opponent."
            }
            if a == b { return "\(Self.spokenCalls[a]) all." }
            return "\(Self.spokenCalls[min(a, 3)]) \(Self.spokenCalls[min(b, 3)])."
        }
    }
}

/// A match in progress with an undo history: every point can be taken back.
public struct ScoreTracker: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    public private(set) var score: MatchScore
    /// Who won each point, oldest first.
    public private(set) var log: [Player] = []
    private var history: [MatchScore] = []
    public var startDate = Date()

    public init(rules: MatchRules = MatchRules()) { score = MatchScore(rules: rules) }

    public var canUndo: Bool { !history.isEmpty }
    public var pointsWon: Int { log.filter { $0 == .me }.count }
    public var pointsLost: Int { log.filter { $0 == .opponent }.count }

    @discardableResult
    public mutating func award(_ p: Player) -> ScoreEvent {
        if let w = score.winner { return .match(w) }
        history.append(score)
        log.append(p)
        return score.award(p)
    }

    /// Takes back the last point. Returns who had won it, or nil when there is nothing to undo.
    @discardableResult
    public mutating func undo() -> Player? {
        guard let previous = history.popLast() else { return nil }
        score = previous
        return log.popLast()
    }

    /// Finished sets plus the set in progress, e.g. "6–4 3–2". Empty for a simple point count, which has no sets.
    public var setsText: String {
        if score.rules.simpleCount { return "" }
        var parts = score.sets.map { "\($0.me)–\($0.opponent)" }
        if score.winner == nil { parts.append("\(score.games.me)–\(score.games.opponent)") }
        return parts.joined(separator: "  ")
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import Foundation

/// Display units. Stored metrics stay metric (km/h, cm); views convert at the edge.
/// Imperial is the default; the "useMetric" setting switches everything to metric.
public struct UnitSystem: Sendable, Equatable {
    public static let storageKey = "useMetric"
    public var metric: Bool

    public init(metric: Bool) { self.metric = metric }

    /// Current setting from UserDefaults (default imperial).
    public static var current: UnitSystem { UnitSystem(metric: UserDefaults.standard.bool(forKey: storageKey)) }

    public var speedUnit: String { metric ? "km/h" : "mph" }
    public var lengthUnit: String { metric ? "cm" : "in" }

    public func speed(_ kmh: Double) -> Double { metric ? kmh : kmh / 1.609344 }
    public func length(_ cm: Double) -> Double { metric ? cm : cm / 2.54 }

    /// Whole-number speed, e.g. "87".
    public func speedValue(_ kmh: Double) -> String { "\(Int(speed(kmh).rounded()))" }
    /// Speed with unit, e.g. "87 mph".
    public func speedText(_ kmh: Double) -> String { "\(speedValue(kmh)) \(speedUnit)" }
    /// Length with one decimal and unit, e.g. "1.6 in".
    public func lengthText(_ cm: Double) -> String { String(format: "%.1f %@", length(cm), lengthUnit) }
}
````````

````````swift
import XCTest
import simd
@testable import RacketKit

/// Acked impact mode (firmware 1.6+): the racket's shot summaries, windows with boot numbers that are acked and
/// resent, and the engine taking each shot once, from the summary when it can.
final class AckedImpactTests: XCTestCase {
    private func le16(_ v: Int) -> [UInt8] {
        let u = UInt16(truncatingIfNeeded: v)
        return [UInt8(u & 0xFF), UInt8(u >> 8)]
    }

    private func le32(_ v: UInt32) -> [UInt8] { (0..<4).map { UInt8((v >> (8 * UInt32($0))) & 0xFF) } }
    private func f32(_ v: Float) -> [UInt8] { le32(v.bitPattern) }

    /// A TBWindowChunkAcked as firmware/src/main.cpp sends it.
    private func chunk(boot: UInt16, seq: UInt16, index: Int, backlog: Bool = false) -> RacketProtocol.WindowChunk {
        var b = le16(Int(seq)) + [UInt8(index), 56] + le16(384) + le16(16384) + le16(0) + le16(0) + le16(0)
        b += le32(UInt32(1_000_000 + index * 8000))
        b += [8, RacketProtocol.flagGyro4000 | (backlog ? RacketProtocol.flagBacklog : 0)] + le16(Int(boot))
        for k in 0..<8 { b += le16(index * 8 + k) + le16(0) + le16(2048) + [UInt8](repeating: 0, count: 12) }
        XCTAssertEqual(b.count, 166)
        return RacketProtocol.decodeWindowChunk(Data(b))!
    }

    private func summaryBytes(boot: UInt16, seq: UInt16, gen: UInt8, type: UInt8 = 1, age: UInt32 = 250,
                              unixMs: UInt64 = 0) -> Data {
        var b = le16(Int(seq)) + le16(Int(boot)) + [gen, type, 2, 1 | 2] + le32(age)
        b += (0..<8).map { UInt8((unixMs >> (8 * UInt64($0))) & 0xFF) }
        b += (0..<15).flatMap { f32(Float($0) + 0.5) }
        XCTAssertEqual(b.count, 80)
        return Data(b)
    }

    func testDecodesSummary() throws {
        let s = try XCTUnwrap(RacketProtocol.decodeShotSummary(summaryBytes(boot: 9, seq: 4, gen: 3)))
        XCTAssertEqual(s.boot, 9)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.seq, 4)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.gen, 3)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.type, .backhand)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.spin, .slice)
        XCTAssertTrue(s.gyroSaturated)
        XCTAssertTrue(s.backlog)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.swingKmh, 0.5)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.swingDeg, 14.5)
        XCTAssertNil(s.unixMs)
        let now = Date()
        XCTAssertEqual(s.hitDate(receivedAt: now).timeIntervalSince(now), -0.25, accuracy: 1e-6)
        let m = s.metrics(receivedAt: now)
        XCTAssertEqual(m.type, .backhand)
        XCTAssertEqual(m.features.verticalSpin, 13.5)
        // Hit before a reboot, but the racket knew the time.
        let earlier = try XCTUnwrap(RacketProtocol.decodeShotSummary(summaryBytes(boot: 9, seq: 4, gen: 3,
                                                                                 age: .max, unixMs: 1_700_000_000_000)))
        XCTAssertNil(earlier.ageMs)
        XCTAssertEqual(earlier.hitDate(receivedAt: now).timeIntervalSince1970, 1_700_000_000, accuracy: 1e-3)
        XCTAssertNil(RacketProtocol.decodeShotSummary(summaryBytes(boot: 1, seq: 1, gen: 1, type: 9)))
    }

    func testAckedChunkCarriesBoot() {
        let c = chunk(boot: 0x1234, seq: 7, index: 3, backlog: true)
        XCTAssertEqual(c.boot, 0x1234)
        XCTAssertEqual(c.samples.count, 8)
        XCTAssertEqual(c.samples[1].ax, 25)   // samples start after the boot number
        XCTAssertNotEqual(c.flags & RacketProtocol.flagBacklog, 0)
    }

    func testCommandPayloads() {
        XCTAssertEqual([UInt8](RacketProtocol.windowAckPayload(boot: 0x0102, seq: 0x0304)), [0x14, 2, 1, 4, 3])
        XCTAssertEqual([UInt8](RacketProtocol.windowResendPayload(boot: 1, seq: 2, chunks: [5, 9])),
                       [0x15, 1, 0, 2, 0, 2, 5, 9])
        XCTAssertEqual(RacketProtocol.windowResendPayload(boot: 1, seq: 2, chunks: Array(0..<30)).last, 0)   // all
        XCTAssertEqual(RacketProtocol.setTimePayload(Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1)).count, 9)
    }

    func testAssemblerInterleavesWindowsAndFillsGapsFromResends() {
        var a = ImpactWindowAssembler()
        let time: (UInt32) -> Double = { Double($0) / 1e6 }
        // Window 1 loses chunk 10; window 2 arrives whole meanwhile.
        for i in 0..<56 where i != 10 { XCTAssertNil(a.add(chunk(boot: 5, seq: 1, index: i), h3lisRange: 3, now: 0, time: time)) }
        var done: ImpactWindow?
        for i in 0..<56 { done = a.add(chunk(boot: 5, seq: 2, index: i), h3lisRange: 3, now: 0.5, time: time) }
        XCTAssertEqual(done?.seq, 2)
        XCTAssertEqual(done?.boot, 5)
        XCTAssertEqual(a.incomplete, 0)   // window 1 is still waiting, not abandoned
        XCTAssertTrue(a.missing(now: 1.0, quietFor: 1.5).isEmpty)
        let gaps = a.missing(now: 2.0, quietFor: 1.5)
        XCTAssertEqual(gaps.count, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(gaps.first?.key, WindowKey(boot: 5, seq: 1))
        XCTAssertEqual(gaps.first?.chunks, [10])
        XCTAssertTrue(a.missing(now: 2.5, quietFor: 1.5).isEmpty)   // just asked
        let filled = a.add(chunk(boot: 5, seq: 1, index: 10, backlog: true), h3lisRange: 3, now: 3, time: time)
        XCTAssertEqual(filled?.seq, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(filled?.samples.count, 448)
        XCTAssertEqual(filled?.backlog, true)
        // Same seq after a reboot is a different window.
        XCTAssertNil(a.add(chunk(boot: 6, seq: 1, index: 0), h3lisRange: 3, now: 4, time: time))
        XCTAssertEqual(a.missing(now: 9, quietFor: 1.5).first?.key, WindowKey(boot: 6, seq: 1))
    }

    // MARK: Engine

    private final class FakeRacket: SampleSource, ImpactSource, ShotSummarySource {
        var onSamples: (([IMUSample]) -> Void)?
        var nativeCalibration: Calibration? { nil }
        var onImpactWindow: ((ImpactWindow) -> Void)?
        var onPose: ((RacketProtocol.Pose) -> Void)?
        var onShotSummary: ((RacketProtocol.ShotSummary) -> Void)?
        let lock = NSLock()
        var configs: [Data] = []
        func setShotConfig(_ payload: Data) { lock.withLock { configs.append(payload) } }
        func start() {}
        func stop() {}
    }

    private func window(boot: UInt16, seq: UInt16) -> ImpactWindow {
        let samples = (0..<448).map { k in
            IMUSample(time: Double(k) * 0.001, accel: SIMD3(0, 0, 1), gyro: SIMD3(0, k < 384 ? 15 : 3, 0),
                      highG: SIMD3(0, 0, k >= 384 && k < 390 ? 40 : 1))
        }
        return ImpactWindow(seq: seq, impactIndex: 384, startOrientation: simd_quatf(ix: 0, iy: 0, iz: 0, r: 1),
                            samples: samples, boot: boot)
    }

    private func settle(_ engine: RacketEngine) {
        // The engine works on its own queue and reports on the main queue.
        let e = expectation(description: "settle")
        DispatchQueue.global().asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.3) { DispatchQueue.main.async { e.fulfill() } }
        wait(for: [e], timeout: 2)
    }

    func testEngineTakesEachShotOnceFromTheSummary() throws {
        let racket = FakeRacket()
        let engine = RacketEngine()
        var shots: [ShotMetrics] = []
        engine.onShot = { shots.append($0) }
        engine.attach(racket)
        settle(engine)
        let gen = try XCTUnwrap(racket.lock.withLock { racket.configs.last?.first })
        XCTAssertEqual(racket.lock.withLock { racket.configs.last?.count }, 1 + 36 * 4 + 1)

        // Current config: the summary is the shot; its window only feeds the recorder.
        var raw = 0
        engine.onRaw = { _ in raw += 1 }
        racket.onShotSummary?(RacketProtocol.decodeShotSummary(summaryBytes(boot: 3, seq: 1, gen: gen))!)
        racket.onImpactWindow?(window(boot: 3, seq: 1))
        settle(engine)
        XCTAssertEqual(shots.count, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(shots.first?.swingSpeedKmh, 0.5)
        XCTAssertEqual(raw, 1)

        // A summary from an older config (the profile changed since) is ignored and the window is analysed here.
        engine.profile.rightHanded.toggle()
        settle(engine)
        racket.onShotSummary?(RacketProtocol.decodeShotSummary(summaryBytes(boot: 3, seq: 2, gen: gen))!)
        racket.onImpactWindow?(window(boot: 3, seq: 2))
        settle(engine)
        XCTAssertEqual(shots.count, 2)
        XCTAssertNotEqual(shots.last?.swingSpeedKmh, 0.5)
        XCTAssertNotEqual(racket.lock.withLock { racket.configs.last?.first }, gen)
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import XCTest
@testable import RacketKit

/// The racket checks the same CRC-32 (firmware/src/ota.cpp), and the app only offers newer firmware.
final class FirmwareImageTests: XCTestCase {
    func testCRC32MatchesStandardCheckValue() {
        XCTAssertEqual(FirmwareImage(data: Data("123456789".utf8), version: nil).crc32, 0xCBF4_3926)
    }

    func testVersionComparison() {
        let image = FirmwareImage(data: Data(), version: "1.10")
        XCTAssertTrue(image.isNewer(than: "1.9"))
        XCTAssertTrue(image.isNewer(than: "1.2"))
        XCTAssertFalse(image.isNewer(than: "1.10"))
        XCTAssertFalse(image.isNewer(than: "2.0"))
        XCTAssertFalse(FirmwareImage(data: Data(), version: nil).isNewer(than: "1.0"))
    }

    func testBundledFirmwareMatchesSourceVersionAndImageHash() throws {
        let repo = URL(fileURLWithPath: #filePath).deletingLastPathComponent().deletingLastPathComponent()
            .deletingLastPathComponent().deletingLastPathComponent().deletingLastPathComponent()
        let resources = repo.appendingPathComponent("apple/Shared/Resources")
        let image = try Data(contentsOf: resources.appendingPathComponent("RacketFirmware.bin"))
        let metadata = try JSONDecoder().decode([String: String].self,
                       from: Data(contentsOf: resources.appendingPathComponent("RacketFirmware.json")))
        let header = try String(contentsOf: repo.appendingPathComponent("firmware/include/protocol.h"), encoding: .utf8)
        func value(_ name: String) throws -> String {
            let line = try XCTUnwrap(header.split(separator: "\n").first { $0.hasPrefix("#define \(name) ") })
            return try XCTUnwrap(line.split(whereSeparator: \.isWhitespace).last).description
        }
        let version = try "\(value("TB_FW_MAJOR")).\(value("TB_FW_MINOR"))"
        XCTAssertEqual(metadata["version"], version, "Rebuild the app's firmware bundle after changing firmware")
        XCTAssertEqual(metadata["sha256"], FirmwareImage.sha256(image))
        XCTAssertTrue(FirmwareImage(data: image, version: version).looksValid)
        XCTAssertFalse(MotionFirmware.hasKnownGyroScaleBug(try XCTUnwrap(metadata["version"])))
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import XCTest
import simd
@testable import RacketKit

/// Impact mode (firmware 1.5+): decoding the racket's hit, window and pose messages, assembling windows, and checking
/// a window gives the same shot as the full stream it was cut from.
final class ImpactWindowTests: XCTestCase {
    private func le16(_ v: Int) -> [UInt8] {
        let u = UInt16(truncatingIfNeeded: v)
        return [UInt8(u & 0xFF), UInt8(u >> 8)]
    }

    private func le32(_ v: UInt32) -> [UInt8] { (0..<4).map { UInt8((v >> (8 * UInt32($0))) & 0xFF) } }

    private func quatBytes(_ q: simd_quatf) -> [UInt8] {
        [q.real, q.imag.x, q.imag.y, q.imag.z].flatMap { le16(Int(($0 * 16384).rounded())) }
    }

    private func sampleBytes(_ s: RacketProtocol.RawSample) -> [UInt8] {
        [s.ax, s.ay, s.az, s.gx, s.gy, s.gz, s.hx, s.hy, s.hz].flatMap { le16(Int($0)) }
    }

    private func chunk(seq: UInt16, index: Int, total: Int = 56, q0: simd_quatf = simd_quatf(ix: 0, iy: 0, iz: 0, r: 1),
                       t0: UInt32, samples: [RacketProtocol.RawSample]) -> RacketProtocol.WindowChunk {
        var b = le16(Int(seq)) + [UInt8(index), UInt8(total)] + le16(384) + quatBytes(q0) + le32(t0)
        b += [UInt8(samples.count), RacketProtocol.flagGyro4000]
        b += samples.flatMap(sampleBytes)
        XCTAssertEqual(b.count, 20 + samples.count * 18)
        return RacketProtocol.decodeWindowChunk(Data(b))!
    }

    private func raw(_ k: Int) -> RacketProtocol.RawSample {
        RacketProtocol.RawSample(ax: Int16(k), ay: 0, az: 2048, gx: 82, gy: 0, gz: 0, hx: 0, hy: 0, hz: 160)
    }

    func testDecodesHit() throws {
        let q = simd_quatf(angle: 0.5, axis: simd_normalize(SIMD3(1, 2, 3)))
        let bytes = le16(7) + le32(123_456_789) + [2, 25] + le16(1800) + quatBytes(q)
        let hit = try XCTUnwrap(RacketProtocol.decodeHit(Data(bytes)))
        XCTAssertEqual(hit.seq, 7)
        XCTAssertEqual(hit.tMicros, 123_456_789)
        XCTAssertEqual(hit.source, .mic)
        XCTAssertEqual(hit.jumpG, 25)
        XCTAssertEqual(hit.swingDps, 1800)
        XCTAssertEqual(simd_dot(hit.orientation.vector, q.vector), 1, accuracy: 1e-3)
    }

    func testDecodesPose() throws {
        let q = simd_quatf(angle: -1.2, axis: SIMD3(0, 1, 0))
        let bytes = quatBytes(q) + le16(950) + [42, RacketProtocol.flagMotionOK | RacketProtocol.flagGyro4000]
        let pose = try XCTUnwrap(RacketProtocol.decodePose(Data(bytes)))
        XCTAssertEqual(simd_dot(pose.orientation.vector, q.vector), 1, accuracy: 1e-3)
        XCTAssertEqual(pose.gyroDps, 950)
        XCTAssertEqual(pose.highG, 42)
        XCTAssertNotEqual(pose.flags & RacketProtocol.flagGyro4000, 0)
    }

    func testStatusReportsImpactMode() throws {
        let status = try XCTUnwrap(RacketProtocol.decodeStatus(Data([0, 0, 1, 5, 0x17, 1, 0, 0])))
        XCTAssertTrue(status.impactMode)
        XCTAssertEqual(status.firmwareVersion, "1.5")
        XCTAssertFalse(status.gyro4000)
    }

    func testStatusReportsGyroRange() throws {
        let status = try XCTUnwrap(RacketProtocol.decodeStatus(Data([0, 0, 1, 6, 0x0F, 1, 0, 0])))
        XCTAssertTrue(status.gyro4000)
        XCTAssertFalse(status.impactMode)
    }

    func testLinkStatsDifference() {
        var start = RacketBLE.LinkStats()
        start.packets = 10; start.packetsAt4000dps = 4; start.lostPackets = 30; start.windows = 2; start.lostWindows = 1
        var end = start
        end.packets = 110; end.packetsAt4000dps = 104; end.lostPackets = 330; end.windows = 7; end.lostWindows = 2
        let d = end - start
        XCTAssertEqual([d.packets, d.packetsAt4000dps, d.lostPackets, d.windows, d.lostWindows], [100, 100, 300, 5, 1])
    }

    func testAssemblesChunksIntoOneWindow() throws {
        var assembler = ImpactWindowAssembler()
        var window: ImpactWindow?
        for i in 0..<56 {
            let c = chunk(seq: 3, index: i, t0: 1_000_000 + UInt32(i) * 8000, samples: (0..<8).map { raw(i * 8 + $0) })
            let w = assembler.add(c, h3lisRange: 1) { Double($0) / 1e6 }
            if i < 55 { XCTAssertNil(w) } else { window = w }
        }
        let w = try XCTUnwrap(window)
        XCTAssertEqual(w.seq, 3)
        XCTAssertEqual(w.impactIndex, RacketProtocol.windowPre)
        XCTAssertEqual(w.samples.count, RacketProtocol.windowSamples)
        XCTAssertEqual(w.samples[447].accel.x * 2048, 447, accuracy: 1e-3)
        XCTAssertEqual(w.samples[447].time - w.samples[0].time, 0.447, accuracy: 1e-9)
        // Window gyro is at 8.2 LSB/dps: 82 counts = 10 dps.
        XCTAssertEqual(w.samples[0].gyro.x, 10 * .pi / 180, accuracy: 1e-5)
        XCTAssertEqual(assembler.incomplete, 0)
    }

    func testWindowWithAMissingChunkIsDropped() {
        var assembler = ImpactWindowAssembler()
        for i in 0..<56 where i != 10 {
            XCTAssertNil(assembler.add(chunk(seq: 1, index: i, t0: UInt32(i) * 8000, samples: (0..<8).map(raw)),
                                       h3lisRange: 1) { Double($0) / 1e6 })
        }
        var completed: ImpactWindow?
        for i in 0..<56 {
            completed = assembler.add(chunk(seq: 2, index: i, t0: UInt32(i) * 8000, samples: (0..<8).map(raw)),
                                      h3lisRange: 1) { Double($0) / 1e6 }
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(assembler.incomplete, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(completed?.seq, 2)
    }

    /// Cuts a window out of a simulated stream the way the racket does, and checks the engine's shot from that window
    /// matches its shot from the full stream.
    func testWindowGivesTheSameShotAsTheFullStream() throws {
        let sim = SimulatedRacket()
        sim.shotInterval = 2.5
        let streamEngine = RacketEngine()
        let lock = NSLock()
        var recorded: [IMUSample] = []
        streamEngine.onRaw = { batch in lock.withLock { recorded += batch } }
        var streamShot: ShotMetrics?
        let gotStream = expectation(description: "stream shot")
        streamEngine.onShot = { shot in
            guard streamShot == nil else { return }
            streamShot = shot
            gotStream.fulfill()
        }
        streamEngine.attach(sim)
        sim.start()
        wait(for: [gotStream], timeout: 15)
        sim.stop()
        let samples = lock.withLock { recorded }

        // The racket's cut: impact on the first sample of the largest 3 ms high-g jump.
        func jump(_ k: Int) -> Float { simd_length(samples[k].highG - samples[k - 3].highG) }
        let best = (3..<samples.count).max { jump($0) < jump($1) }!
        let impact = best - 2
        let start = impact - RacketProtocol.windowPre
        XCTAssertGreaterThanOrEqual(start, 0)
        XCTAssertLessThanOrEqual(impact + RacketProtocol.windowPost, samples.count)
        // The racket's orientation filter at the window start (the simulator is already in racket axes).
        var filter = MahonyFilter()
        for k in 0..<start {
            let dt = Float(k == 0 ? 0.001 : min(max(samples[k].time - samples[k - 1].time, 0.0002), 0.02))
            filter.update(gyro: samples[k].gyro, accel: samples[k].accel, dt: dt)
        }
        let window = ImpactWindow(seq: 0, impactIndex: RacketProtocol.windowPre, startOrientation: filter.q,
                                  samples: Array(samples[start..<(start + RacketProtocol.windowSamples)]))

        let source = FakeImpactSource()
        let windowEngine = RacketEngine()
        var windowShot: ShotMetrics?
        let gotWindow = expectation(description: "window shot")
        windowEngine.onShot = { shot in
            windowShot = shot
            gotWindow.fulfill()
        }
        windowEngine.attach(source)
        source.onImpactWindow?(window)
        wait(for: [gotWindow], timeout: 5)

        let a = try XCTUnwrap(streamShot), b = try XCTUnwrap(windowShot)
        XCTAssertEqual(b.type, a.type)
        XCTAssertEqual(b.swingSpeedKmh, a.swingSpeedKmh, accuracy: max(1, a.swingSpeedKmh * 0.02))
        XCTAssertEqual(b.ballSpeedKmh, a.ballSpeedKmh, accuracy: max(1, a.ballSpeedKmh * 0.03))
        XCTAssertEqual(b.impactXcm, a.impactXcm, accuracy: 0.5)
        XCTAssertEqual(b.impactYcm, a.impactYcm, accuracy: 0.5)
        XCTAssertEqual(b.faceAngleDeg, a.faceAngleDeg, accuracy: 3)
        XCTAssertEqual(b.swingPathDeg, a.swingPathDeg, accuracy: 3)
    }
}

private final class FakeImpactSource: SampleSource, ImpactSource {
    var onSamples: (([IMUSample]) -> Void)?
    var onImpactWindow: ((ImpactWindow) -> Void)?
    var onPose: ((RacketProtocol.Pose) -> Void)?
    var nativeCalibration: Calibration? { .identity }
    func start() {}
    func stop() {}
}
````````

````````swift
import XCTest
import simd
@testable import RacketKit

final class ImpulseBallSpeedTests: XCTestCase {
    /// 100 samples, impact at 50: |ω| across the shaft 10 rad/s before, 5 rad/s after.
    private func window(post: SIMD3<Float> = SIMD3(0, 3, 4), count: Int = 100) -> [IMUSample] {
        (0..<count).map { k in
            IMUSample(time: Double(k) * 0.001, accel: SIMD3(0, 0, 1),
                      gyro: k < 50 ? SIMD3(0, 6, 8) : post, highG: k == 50 ? SIMD3(0, 0, 20) : .zero)
        }
    }

    private func run(_ w: [IMUSample], on: Bool) -> ShotMetrics {
        var model = ImpactModel()
        model.useImpulseBallSpeed = on
        return ShotAnalyzer(profile: RacketProfile(), model: model)
            .analyze(window: w, impact: 50, orientation: simd_quatf(angle: 0, axis: SIMD3(0, 0, 1)),
                     date: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 0), calibrationMode: false)
    }

    private func oldBallMs(_ m: ShotMetrics) -> Float {
        let x = Float(m.impactXcm), y = Float(m.impactYcm)
        let e = ImpactModel().acorCenter * max(0.55, 1 - 0.035 * (x * x + y * y).squareRoot())
        return (1 + e) * 10 * RacketProfile().effectiveRadiusM
    }

    func testFlagOffKeepsOldFormulaAndRecordsBoth() {
        let m = run(window(), on: false)
        XCTAssertEqual(Float(m.ballSpeedKmh / 3.6), oldBallMs(m), accuracy: 1e-3)
        let r = RacketProfile().effectiveRadiusM
        XCTAssertEqual(m.features.racketDropMs!, r * 5, accuracy: 1e-4)
        XCTAssertEqual(m.features.ballSpeedImpulseMs!, r * (10 + 1.3 * 5), accuracy: 1e-3)
    }

    func testFlagOnUsesImpulse() {
        let m = run(window(), on: true)
        let r = RacketProfile().effectiveRadiusM
        XCTAssertEqual(Float(m.ballSpeedKmh / 3.6), r * (10 + 1.3 * 5), accuracy: 1e-3)
    }

    func testNoDropFallsBack() {
        let m = run(window(post: SIMD3(0, 6, 8)), on: true)
        XCTAssertNil(m.features.ballSpeedImpulseMs)
        XCTAssertEqual(Float(m.ballSpeedKmh / 3.6), oldBallMs(m), accuracy: 1e-3)
    }

    func testEmptyPostWindowFallsBack() {
        let m = run(window(count: 60), on: true)   // post window 62..<80 is past the end
        XCTAssertNil(m.features.ballSpeedImpulseMs)
        XCTAssertNil(m.features.racketDropMs)
        XCTAssertEqual(Float(m.ballSpeedKmh / 3.6), oldBallMs(m), accuracy: 1e-3)
    }

    func testClampsGainAndSpeed() {
        let s = ShotAnalyzer.impulseBallSpeed(wPre: SIMD3(0, 100, 0), wPost: .zero, postSamples: 18, radius: 1, gain: 9)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.speed, 90)
    }

    func testOldSavedModelDecodes() throws {
        let json = #"{"lateralGain":2,"longitudinalGain":10,"joltDeadband":0.02,"acorCenter":0.4,"spinGain":0.7}"#
        let m = try JSONDecoder().decode(ImpactModel.self, from: Data(json.utf8))
        XCTAssertEqual(m.lateralGain, 2)
        XCTAssertFalse(m.useImpulseBallSpeed)
        XCTAssertEqual(m.impulseGain, 1.3)
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import XCTest
import simd
@testable import RacketKit

/// Runs ShotAnalyzer on a labeled recording: a folder with the app's session-...-racket.csv and labels.txt (one
/// stroke per visible impact: FH, BH, SV, VO). tools/shot_type_check.py is the same check in Python.
/// Runs only with LABELED_SESSION=<folder> (e.g. data/room-2026-10-29); LABELED_FOREHAND_SIGN=-1 or 1 sets a
/// taught forehand; LABELED_GYRO_SCALE=0.5 corrects a firmware 1.5 recording (the room session's gyro reads 2x high).
final class LabeledSessionTests: XCTestCase {
    func testShotTypesMatchLabels() throws {
        guard let dir = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["LABELED_SESSION"] else {
            throw XCTSkip("LABELED_SESSION not set")
        }
        let folder = URL(fileURLWithPath: dir)
        let files = try FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(at: folder, includingPropertiesForKeys: nil)
        let csv = try XCTUnwrap(files.first { $0.pathExtension == "csv" })
        let labels = try String(contentsOf: folder.appendingPathComponent("labels.txt"), encoding: .utf8)
            .split { $0.isWhitespace || $0 == "," }.map(String.init)
        let cal = Calibration.default
        let gyroScale = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["LABELED_GYRO_SCALE"].flatMap(Float.init) ?? 1
        let samples: [IMUSample] = try String(contentsOf: csv, encoding: .utf8).split(separator: "\n").dropFirst()
            .compactMap { line in
                let v = line.split(separator: ",").compactMap { Float($0) }
                guard v.count == 10, let time = Double(line.split(separator: ",")[0]) else { return nil }
                return cal.apply(IMUSample(time: time, accel: SIMD3(v[1], v[2], v[3]), gyro: SIMD3(v[4], v[5], v[6]) * gyroScale,
                                           highG: SIMD3(v[7], v[8], v[9])))
            }

        // Orientation the way RacketEngine tracks it.
        var filter = MahonyFilter()
        var orientations: [simd_quatf] = []
        orientations.reserveCapacity(samples.count)
        for (k, s) in samples.enumerated() {
            let dt = Float(k == 0 ? 0.001 : min(max(s.time - samples[k - 1].time, 0.0002), 0.02))
            filter.update(gyro: s.gyro, accel: s.accel, dt: dt)
            orientations.append(filter.q)
        }

        // Impacts from high-g peaks, so hits the phone's detector missed still line up with their labels.
        var peaks: [Int] = []
        for (k, s) in samples.enumerated() where simd_length(s.highG) > 4 {
            if let last = peaks.last, s.time - samples[last].time < 0.6 {
                if simd_length(s.highG) > simd_length(samples[last].highG) { peaks[peaks.count - 1] = k }
            } else {
                peaks.append(k)
            }
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(peaks.count, labels.count, "impacts vs labels")

        var profile = RacketProfile()
        profile.forehandBodySign = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["LABELED_FOREHAND_SIGN"].flatMap(Float.init) ?? 0
        let analyzer = ShotAnalyzer(profile: profile, model: ImpactModel())
        let names: [String: ShotType] = ["FH": .forehand, "BH": .backhand, "SV": .serve, "VO": .volley]
        var right = 0
        for (label, p) in zip(labels, peaks) {
            // RacketEngine.analyzeImpact: largest 3-sample jump within ±6, impact on its first sample.
            let best = (max(3, p - 6)...min(samples.count - 1, p + 6))
                .max { simd_length(samples[$0].highG - samples[$0 - 3].highG) < simd_length(samples[$1].highG - samples[$1 - 3].highG) }!
            let i0 = best - 2, lo = max(0, i0 - 700), hi = min(samples.count, i0 + 150)
            let shot = analyzer.analyze(window: Array(samples[lo..<hi]), impact: i0 - lo,
                                        orientation: orientations[max(i0 - 3, 0)], date: Date(), calibrationMode: false)
            let ok = shot.type == names[label]
            right += ok ? 1 : 0
            print(String(format: "%@ -> %@%@ swing %.0f° vertical %+.2f ball %.0f km/h", label, shot.type.label,
                         ok ? "" : " ✗", shot.features.swingDeg ?? 0, shot.features.verticalSpin ?? 0, shot.ballSpeedKmh))
        }
        print("\(right)/\(labels.count) correct")
        // Serves need the forehand face, which a session without a taught forehand learns only partway through.
        let needed = profile.forehandBodySign != 0 ? labels.count : labels.filter { $0 != "SV" }.count
        XCTAssertGreaterThanOrEqual(right, needed)
    }
}
````````
