````````swift
import XCTest
import simd
@testable import RacketKit

final class RecordedImpactContextTests: XCTestCase {
    private func fixture() -> ImpactWindow {
        let samples = (0..<448).map { k in
            IMUSample(time: 10 + Double(k) * 0.001, accel: SIMD3(0.3, 0.4, 0.8),
                      gyro: SIMD3(4, 11, -3), highG: SIMD3(0, 0, k == 384 ? 25 : 1))
        }
        return ImpactWindow(seq: 19, impactIndex: 384,
                            startOrientation: simd_quatf(angle: 1.1, axis: simd_normalize(SIMD3(1, 2, 3))),
                            samples: samples, boot: 7)
    }

    func testSavedPoseAndConfigurationReproduceWindowAnalysis() throws {
        let folder = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: folder) }
        let recorder = Recorder()
        try recorder.start(in: folder, name: "fixture")
        let prefix = [IMUSample(time: 1, accel: .zero, gyro: .zero, highG: .zero)]
        recorder.append(RecordingEvent.samples(prefix))
        let window = fixture()
        var cal = Calibration.default
        cal.gyroBias = SIMD3(0.01, 0.02, -0.01)
        var profile = RacketProfile()
        profile.rightHanded = false
        profile.forehandBodySign = -1
        let model = ImpactModel()
        recorder.append(RecordingEvent.impact(window: window, calibration: cal, profile: profile, model: model))
        let url = try XCTUnwrap(recorder.stop())
        let samples = RecordingFormat.decode(try Data(contentsOf: url))
        XCTAssertEqual(samples.count, 449)
        XCTAssertEqual(recorder.missingImpactContexts, 0)
        let lines = try String(contentsOf: url.deletingPathExtension().appendingPathExtension("windows.jsonl"),
                               encoding: .utf8).split(separator: "\n")
        XCTAssertEqual(lines.count, 1)
        let context = try JSONDecoder().decode(RecordedImpactContext.self, from: Data(lines[0].utf8))
        XCTAssertEqual(context.sampleOffset, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(context.calibration, cal)
        XCTAssertEqual(context.profile, profile)
        XCTAssertFalse(context.calibrationMode)
        let restored = try context.window(from: samples)
        XCTAssertEqual(restored.samples, window.samples)
        XCTAssertEqual(restored.seq, window.seq)
        XCTAssertEqual(restored.boot, window.boot)
        let date = Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1)
        let expected = try XCTUnwrap(RacketEngine.shot(window: window, calibration: cal,
                    analyzer: ShotAnalyzer(profile: profile, model: model), calibrationMode: false, date: date))
        var actual = try XCTUnwrap(RacketEngine.shot(window: restored, calibration: context.calibration,
                    analyzer: ShotAnalyzer(profile: context.profile, model: context.model), calibrationMode: context.calibrationMode, date: date))
        actual.id = expected.id
        XCTAssertEqual(actual, expected)
    }

    func testCorruptOffsetsAndQuaternionsAreRejected() throws {
        let w = fixture()
        let valid = RecordedImpactContext(window: w, sampleOffset: 0, calibration: .default,
                                          profile: RacketProfile(), model: ImpactModel())
        var invalid = valid
        invalid.sampleOffset = Int.max
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try invalid.window(from: w.samples))
        invalid = valid; invalid.startOrientationXYZW = [0, 0, 0, 0]
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try invalid.window(from: w.samples))
        invalid = valid; invalid.sampleCount += 1
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try invalid.window(from: w.samples))
        invalid = valid; invalid.impactIndex = -1
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try invalid.window(from: w.samples))
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import XCTest
import simd
@testable import RacketKit

/// Replays a TennisCamera session's racket.bin (u64 arrival ns, u8 kind, u16 length, payload) through the real
/// engine, the way RacketBLE feeds it. Runs only with REPLAY_DIRS=<session folder>[,<folder>...].
final class ReplayTests: XCTestCase {
    func testReplayRecordedSessions() throws {
        guard let dirs = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["REPLAY_DIRS"] else { throw XCTSkip("REPLAY_DIRS not set") }
        for dir in dirs.split(separator: ",").map(String.init) {
            let data = try Data(contentsOf: URL(fileURLWithPath: dir).appendingPathComponent("racket.bin"))
            let engine = RacketEngine()
            if let sign = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["REPLAY_SIGN"].flatMap(Float.init) {
                var profile = RacketProfile(); profile.forehandBodySign = sign; engine.profile = profile
            }
            var shots: [(ShotMetrics, Double, Int)] = []   // shot, approximate impact time, packets lost in the 1 s before
            var lossTimes: [Double] = []
            var curT = 0.0
            let fill = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["REPLAY_FILL"] == "1"
            var prev: IMUSample?
            engine.onShot = { m in
                let t = curT - 0.15
                shots.append((m, t, lossTimes.filter { $0 > t - 1.0 && $0 <= t }.count))
            }
            var h3Range: UInt8 = 1
            var wraps = 0.0, lastMicros: UInt32 = 0
            var lastSeq: UInt16?, lost = 0, packets = 0
            var allSamples: [IMUSample] = []
            var pos = 0
            while pos + 11 <= data.count {
                let n = Int(data[pos + 9]) | Int(data[pos + 10]) << 8
                let kind = data[pos + 8]
                pos += 11
                guard pos + n <= data.count else { break }
                let payload = data.subdata(in: pos..<(pos + n))
                pos += n
                if kind == 2, payload.count >= 6 { h3Range = payload[5] }
                guard kind == 1, let packet = RacketProtocol.decodePacket(payload) else { continue }
                packets += 1
                if let last = lastSeq {
                    let gap = Int(packet.seq &- last) - 1
                    if gap > 0 && gap < 1000 { lost += gap }
                }
                var missing = 0
                if let last = lastSeq { let gap = Int(packet.seq &- last) - 1; if gap > 0 && gap < 1000 { missing = gap } }
                lastSeq = packet.seq
                if packet.t0Micros < lastMicros, lastMicros - packet.t0Micros > 1_000_000_000 { wraps += 4294.967296 }
                lastMicros = packet.t0Micros
                let t0 = Double(packet.t0Micros) / 1e6 + wraps
                let wide = packet.flags & RacketProtocol.flagGyro4000 != 0
                IMUSample.gyroSaturation = (wide ? 3990 : 1990) * .pi / 180
                let scale = wide ? RacketProtocol.mpuGyroLSBPerDps / 2 : RacketProtocol.mpuGyroLSBPerDps
                let samples = packet.samples.enumerated().map { k, raw in
                    RacketProtocol.convert(raw, time: t0 + Double(k) * 0.001, h3lisRange: h3Range, gyroLSBPerDps: scale)
                }
                if missing > 0 { lossTimes.append(t0) }
                if fill, missing > 0, let p = prev, let first = samples.first {
                    // Linear interpolation across the gap so the engine sees a continuous 1 kHz stream.
                    let n = Int((first.time - p.time) * 1000.0) - 1
                    if n > 0 && n < 400 {
                        var gapFill: [IMUSample] = []
                        for k in 1...n {
                            let f = Float(k) / Float(n + 1)
                            gapFill.append(IMUSample(time: p.time + Double(k) * 0.001,
                                                     accel: p.accel + (first.accel - p.accel) * f,
                                                     gyro: p.gyro + (first.gyro - p.gyro) * f,
                                                     highG: p.highG + (first.highG - p.highG) * f))
                        }
                        engine.ingest(gapFill)
                        allSamples += gapFill
                    }
                }
                allSamples += samples
                engine.ingest(samples)
                prev = samples.last
                curT = samples.last?.time ?? curT
                RunLoop.main.run(until: Date().addingTimeInterval(0.0005))
            }
            engine.ingest([])
            Thread.sleep(forTimeInterval: 2)
            RunLoop.main.run(until: Date().addingTimeInterval(1))

            // Independent swing count: gyro-magnitude peaks above 15 rad/s at least 0.6 s apart.
            var swings: [Double] = []
            for s in allSamples where simd_length(s.gyro) > 15 {
                if let l = swings.last, s.time - l < 0.6 { continue }
                swings.append(s.time)
            }
            let t0 = allSamples.first?.time ?? 0
            var report = "\n=== \(dir)\npackets \(packets), lost \(lost), samples \(allSamples.count)\n"
            report += "gyro swings (>15 rad/s): \(swings.count); engine shots: \(shots.count)\n"
            let clean = shots.filter { $0.2 == 0 }, dirty = shots.filter { $0.2 > 0 }
            func fh(_ a: [(ShotMetrics, Double, Int)]) -> String { "\(a.filter { $0.0.type == .forehand }.count)/\(a.count) forehand" }
            report += "fill=\(fill): shots with no packet loss in the prior 1 s: \(fh(clean)); with loss: \(fh(dirty))\n"
            for (s, _, lossN) in shots {
                report += String(format: "  [lost %d] %@ swing %.0f km/h ball %.0f km/h peakG %.0f impact (%.1f, %.1f) cm sat %@ spin %@\n",
                                 lossN, s.type.rawValue, s.swingSpeedKmh, s.ballSpeedKmh, s.peakG, s.impactXcm, s.impactYcm,
                                 s.gyroSaturated ? "Y" : "n", s.spin.rawValue)
            }
            report += "swing times (s from start): " + swings.map { String(format: "%.1f", $0 - t0) }.joined(separator: " ") + "\n"
            print(report)
        }
    }
}

/// Tries all 24 proper axis mappings as the sensor-to-racket calibration and counts the shot types each produces.
/// Every shot in the club sessions was a right-handed forehand, so the right mapping should call them all forehands.
final class CalibrationSweepTests: XCTestCase {
    private func shots(in dir: String, calibration: Calibration) throws -> [ShotMetrics] {
        let data = try Data(contentsOf: URL(fileURLWithPath: dir).appendingPathComponent("racket.bin"))
        let engine = RacketEngine()
        engine.calibration = calibration
        var out: [ShotMetrics] = []
        engine.onShot = { out.append($0) }
        var h3Range: UInt8 = 1, wraps = 0.0, lastMicros: UInt32 = 0, pos = 0
        var batches: [[IMUSample]] = []
        while pos + 11 <= data.count {
            let n = Int(data[pos + 9]) | Int(data[pos + 10]) << 8
            let kind = data[pos + 8]
            pos += 11
            guard pos + n <= data.count else { break }
            let payload = data.subdata(in: pos..<(pos + n))
            pos += n
            if kind == 2, payload.count >= 6 { h3Range = payload[5] }
            guard kind == 1, let packet = RacketProtocol.decodePacket(payload) else { continue }
            if packet.t0Micros < lastMicros, lastMicros - packet.t0Micros > 1_000_000_000 { wraps += 4294.967296 }
            lastMicros = packet.t0Micros
            let t0 = Double(packet.t0Micros) / 1e6 + wraps
            let wide = packet.flags & RacketProtocol.flagGyro4000 != 0
            IMUSample.gyroSaturation = (wide ? 3990 : 1990) * .pi / 180
            let scale = wide ? RacketProtocol.mpuGyroLSBPerDps / 2 : RacketProtocol.mpuGyroLSBPerDps
            batches.append(packet.samples.enumerated().map { k, raw in
                RacketProtocol.convert(raw, time: t0 + Double(k) * 0.001, h3lisRange: h3Range, gyroLSBPerDps: scale)
            })
        }
        for b in batches { engine.ingest(b) }
        engine.ingest([])
        Thread.sleep(forTimeInterval: 1.5)
        RunLoop.main.run(until: Date().addingTimeInterval(0.5))
        return out
    }

    func testSweep() throws {
        guard let dirs = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["REPLAY_DIRS"] else { throw XCTSkip("REPLAY_DIRS not set") }
        let dirList = dirs.split(separator: ",").map(String.init)
        var mappings: [simd_float3x3] = []
        let perms = [[0, 1, 2], [0, 2, 1], [1, 0, 2], [1, 2, 0], [2, 0, 1], [2, 1, 0]]
        for p in perms {
            for signs in 0..<8 {
                var rows: [SIMD3<Float>] = []
                for r in 0..<3 {
                    var v = SIMD3<Float>(0, 0, 0)
                    v[p[r]] = (signs >> r) & 1 == 1 ? -1 : 1
                    rows.append(v)
                }
                let m = simd_float3x3(rows: rows)
                if m.determinant > 0 { mappings.append(m) }
            }
        }
        var report = "\nmapping rows (racket x,y,z in sensor axes) -> forehand/backhand/serve/volley (pooled, \(dirList.count) sessions)\n"
        for m in mappings {
            var cal = Calibration.default
            cal.mpuToRacket = m
            cal.h3lisToRacket = m
            var counts: [ShotType: Int] = [:]
            for d in dirList { for s in try shots(in: d, calibration: cal) { counts[s.type, default: 0] += 1 } }
            let r = (0..<3).map { i in "(" + (0..<3).map { j in String(Int(m.transpose[i][j])) }.joined(separator: ",") + ")" }.joined()
            report += "\(r): F \(counts[.forehand] ?? 0) B \(counts[.backhand] ?? 0) S \(counts[.serve] ?? 0) V \(counts[.volley] ?? 0)\n"
        }
        print(report)
    }
}

/// Re-runs the engine's detection on the recorded sessions and prints per-shot features, to see which quantity
/// separates forehands from backhands. Mirrors RacketEngine.process/detect/finishShot (default calibration).
final class FeatureDumpTests: XCTestCase {
    func testDump() throws {
        guard let dirs = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["REPLAY_DIRS"] else { throw XCTSkip("REPLAY_DIRS not set") }
        for dir in dirs.split(separator: ",").map(String.init) {
            let data = try Data(contentsOf: URL(fileURLWithPath: dir).appendingPathComponent("racket.bin"))
            var samples: [IMUSample] = []
            var h3Range: UInt8 = 1, wraps = 0.0, lastMicros: UInt32 = 0, pos = 0
            while pos + 11 <= data.count {
                let n = Int(data[pos + 9]) | Int(data[pos + 10]) << 8
                let kind = data[pos + 8]
                pos += 11
                guard pos + n <= data.count else { break }
                let payload = data.subdata(in: pos..<(pos + n))
                pos += n
                if kind == 2, payload.count >= 6 { h3Range = payload[5] }
                guard kind == 1, let packet = RacketProtocol.decodePacket(payload) else { continue }
                if packet.t0Micros < lastMicros, lastMicros - packet.t0Micros > 1_000_000_000 { wraps += 4294.967296 }
                lastMicros = packet.t0Micros
                let t0 = Double(packet.t0Micros) / 1e6 + wraps
                let wide = packet.flags & RacketProtocol.flagGyro4000 != 0
                let scale = wide ? RacketProtocol.mpuGyroLSBPerDps / 2 : RacketProtocol.mpuGyroLSBPerDps
                for (k, raw) in packet.samples.enumerated() {
                    samples.append(RacketProtocol.convert(raw, time: t0 + Double(k) * 0.001, h3lisRange: h3Range, gyroLSBPerDps: scale))
                }
            }
            let cal = Calibration.default
            var filter = MahonyFilter()
            var ring: [(IMUSample, simd_quatf)] = []
            var lastTime: Double?, lastShot = -10.0
            var report = "\n=== \(dir)\n  t   | wPre body (x,y,z)   | faceLead(-wy) | wz_world 8ms  | wz mean 120ms | wz mean 300ms | tip.up | type(now)\n"
            for raw in samples {
                let s = cal.apply(raw)
                let dt = Float(lastTime.map { min(max(s.time - $0, 0.0002), 0.02) } ?? 0.001)
                lastTime = s.time
                filter.update(gyro: s.gyro, accel: s.accel, dt: dt)
                ring.append((s, filter.q))
                if ring.count > 1500 { ring.removeFirst(ring.count - 1500) }
                let n = ring.count
                guard n > 400, s.time - lastShot > 0.4 else { continue }
                let jump = simd_length(s.highG - ring[n - 4].0.highG)
                guard jump > 10 else { continue }
                guard (ring[(n - 150)..<n].map { simd_length($0.0.gyro) }.max() ?? 0) > 5 else { continue }
                // Impact at this sample (the engine waits 150 ms and refines; ±few ms does not matter here).
                lastShot = s.time
                let i0 = n - 3
                func meanW(_ a: Int, _ b: Int) -> SIMD3<Float> {
                    ring[(i0 - a)..<(i0 - b)].reduce(SIMD3<Float>.zero) { $0 + $1.1.act($1.0.gyro) } / Float(a - b)
                }
                let wPre = ring[(i0 - 10)..<(i0 - 2)].reduce(SIMD3<Float>.zero) { $0 + $1.0.gyro } / 8
                let q = ring[i0 - 3].1
                let tip = q.act(SIMD3(1, 0, 0))
                let omegaW = q.act(wPre)
                let ccw = omegaW.z > 0
                report += String(format: " %5.1f | %6.1f %6.1f %6.1f | %7.1f | %7.1f | %7.1f | %7.1f | %5.2f | %@\n",
                                 s.time - samples[0].time, wPre.x, wPre.y, wPre.z, -wPre.y, omegaW.z,
                                 meanW(120, 5).z, meanW(300, 5).z, tip.z, ccw ? "forehand" : "backhand")
            }
            print(report)
        }
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import XCTest
import simd
@testable import RacketKit

/// Optional replay against actual visually reviewed video contacts. The file paths
/// are supplied explicitly; local recordings are not bundled into the package.
/// This session contains only forehands and cannot validate the other shot types.
final class ReviewedVideoSessionTests: XCTestCase {
    func testReviewedForehandBaseline() throws {
        let env = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment
        guard let rawPath = env["REVIEWED_SENSOR_CSV"], let eventPath = env["REVIEWED_SENSOR_EVENTS"] else {
            throw XCTSkip("Reviewed real-racket recording paths not set")
        }
        let scale = try XCTUnwrap(env["REVIEWED_GYRO_SCALE"].flatMap(Float.init))
        let cal = Calibration.default
        let samples = try String(contentsOfFile: rawPath, encoding: .utf8).split(separator: "\n").dropFirst().map { line -> IMUSample in
            let values = line.split(separator: ",")
            let time = try XCTUnwrap(Double(values[0]))
            let v = try values.dropFirst().map { try XCTUnwrap(Float($0)) }
            return cal.apply(IMUSample(time: time, accel: SIMD3(v[0], v[1], v[2]),
                                       gyro: SIMD3(v[3], v[4], v[5]) * scale,
                                       highG: SIMD3(v[6], v[7], v[8])))
        }
        var filter = MahonyFilter()
        var orientations: [simd_quatf] = []
        for (k, s) in samples.enumerated() {
            let dt = Float(k == 0 ? 0.001 : min(max(s.time - samples[k - 1].time, 0.0002), 0.02))
            filter.update(gyro: s.gyro, accel: s.accel, dt: dt)
            orientations.append(filter.q)
        }
        var profile = RacketProfile()
        profile.forehandBodySign = 1  // Taught on the separate room recording.
        let analyzer = ShotAnalyzer(profile: profile, model: ImpactModel())
        let events = try String(contentsOfFile: eventPath, encoding: .utf8).split(separator: "\n").dropFirst()
        XCTAssertEqual(events.count, 29)
        var correct = 0
        for event in events {
            let fields = event.split(separator: ",")
            let index = try XCTUnwrap(Int(fields[0]))
            XCTAssertEqual(fields[1], "forehand")
            let lo = max(0, index - 700), hi = min(samples.count, index + 150)
            let shot = analyzer.analyze(window: Array(samples[lo..<hi]), impact: index-lo,
                                        orientation: orientations[max(index-3, 0)], date: Date(), calibrationMode: false)
            if shot.type == .forehand { correct += 1 }
            print("Reviewed sample \(index): \(shot.type.rawValue)")
        }
        print("Reviewed forehand baseline: \(correct)/\(events.count); other classes untested")
        // Frozen measured baseline, not a general four-class performance claim.
        XCTAssertEqual(correct, 28)
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import XCTest
import simd
@testable import RacketKit

final class TennisScoreTests: XCTestCase {
    private func play(_ s: inout MatchScore, _ p: Player, _ n: Int) {
        for _ in 0..<n { s.award(p) }
    }

    func testGameWithDeuceAndAdvantage() {
        var s = MatchScore()
        play(&s, .me, 2)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.pointText, "30–0")
        play(&s, .opponent, 3)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.pointText, "30–40")
        s.award(.me)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.pointText, "Deuce")
        s.award(.me)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.pointText, "Ad you")
        XCTAssertEqual(s.announcement(for: .point), "Advantage you.")
        s.award(.opponent)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.pointText, "Deuce")
        s.award(.opponent)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.award(.opponent), .game(.opponent))
        XCTAssertEqual(s.games, ScorePair(me: 0, opponent: 1))
        XCTAssertEqual(s.pointText, "0–0")
    }

    func testNoAdDecidesAtDeuce() {
        var rules = MatchRules()
        rules.noAd = true
        var s = MatchScore(rules: rules)
        play(&s, .me, 3)
        play(&s, .opponent, 3)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.pointText, "Deciding point")
        XCTAssertEqual(s.award(.opponent), .game(.opponent))
    }

    func testSetNeedsTwoGameLeadThenTiebreak() {
        var s = MatchScore()
        for _ in 0..<5 { play(&s, .me, 4); play(&s, .opponent, 4) }   // 5–5
        play(&s, .me, 4)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.games, ScorePair(me: 6, opponent: 5))
        play(&s, .opponent, 4)
        XCTAssertTrue(s.isTiebreak)
        play(&s, .me, 6)
        play(&s, .opponent, 6)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.pointText, "6–6")
        s.award(.me)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.award(.me), .set(.me))
        XCTAssertEqual(s.sets, [ScorePair(me: 7, opponent: 6)])
        XCTAssertFalse(s.isTiebreak)
    }

    func testStraightSetsWinsMatch() {
        var s = MatchScore()
        play(&s, .me, 4 * 6)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.sets, [ScorePair(me: 6, opponent: 0)])
        play(&s, .me, 4 * 5)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.award(.me), .point)
        play(&s, .me, 2)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.award(.me), .match(.me))
        XCTAssertEqual(s.winner, .me)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.award(.opponent), .match(.me), "points after the match are ignored")
    }

    func testMatchTiebreakReplacesDecidingSet() {
        var rules = MatchRules()
        rules.matchTiebreak = true
        var s = MatchScore(rules: rules)
        play(&s, .me, 24)
        play(&s, .opponent, 24)
        XCTAssertTrue(s.isMatchTiebreak)
        play(&s, .me, 9)
        play(&s, .opponent, 9)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.announcement(for: .point), "Match tiebreak, 9 all.")
        s.award(.me)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.award(.me), .match(.me))
        XCTAssertEqual(s.sets.last, ScorePair(me: 11, opponent: 9))
    }

    func testTrackerUndoRestoresEverything() {
        var t = ScoreTracker()
        for _ in 0..<4 { t.award(.me) }   // 1–0 in games
        t.award(.opponent)
        XCTAssertEqual(t.score.games, ScorePair(me: 1, opponent: 0))
        XCTAssertEqual(t.undo(), .opponent)
        XCTAssertEqual(t.undo(), .me)
        XCTAssertEqual(t.score.games, ScorePair(me: 0, opponent: 0))
        XCTAssertEqual(t.score.pointText, "40–0")
        XCTAssertEqual(t.pointsWon, 3)
        XCTAssertEqual(t.pointsLost, 0)
        while t.canUndo { t.undo() }
        XCTAssertNil(t.undo())
        XCTAssertEqual(t.score, MatchScore())
    }

    func testSpokenScores() {
        var s = MatchScore()
        var e = s.award(.me)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.announcement(for: e), "fifteen love.")
        e = s.award(.opponent)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.announcement(for: e), "fifteen all.")
        play(&s, .me, 2)
        e = s.award(.me)
        XCTAssertEqual(e, .game(.me))
        XCTAssertEqual(s.announcement(for: e), "Game, you. you lead 1 0.")
        play(&s, .opponent, 4)
        XCTAssertEqual(s.announcement(for: .game(.opponent)), "Game, opponent. 1 all.")
    }

    func testSimpleCountJustCountsPoints() {
        var rules = MatchRules()
        rules.simpleCount = true
        var t = ScoreTracker(rules: rules)
        for _ in 0..<7 { XCTAssertEqual(t.award(.me), .point) }   // no game at 4, no set at 24
        XCTAssertEqual(t.award(.opponent), .point)
        XCTAssertEqual(t.score.points, ScorePair(me: 7, opponent: 1))
        XCTAssertEqual(t.score.games, ScorePair())
        XCTAssertNil(t.score.winner)
        XCTAssertEqual(t.score.pointText, "7–1")
        XCTAssertEqual(t.score.pointCall(.me), "7")
        XCTAssertEqual(t.score.announcement(for: .point), "7 1.")
        XCTAssertEqual(t.setsText, "")
        t.undo()
        XCTAssertEqual(t.score.pointText, "7–0")
        for _ in 0..<7 { t.award(.opponent) }
        XCTAssertEqual(t.score.announcement(for: .point), "7 all.")
    }

    func testOldSavedRulesDecodeWithDefaults() throws {
        let old = Data(#"{"setsToWin":3,"gamesPerSet":4}"#.utf8)
        let rules = try JSONDecoder().decode(MatchRules.self, from: old)
        XCTAssertEqual(rules.setsToWin, 3)
        XCTAssertEqual(rules.gamesPerSet, 4)
        XCTAssertFalse(rules.noAd)
        XCTAssertFalse(rules.matchTiebreak)
        XCTAssertFalse(rules.simpleCount)
        XCTAssertEqual(try JSONDecoder().decode(MatchRules.self, from: Data("{}".utf8)), MatchRules())
        var simple = MatchRules()
        simple.simpleCount = true
        XCTAssertEqual(try JSONDecoder().decode(MatchRules.self, from: JSONEncoder().encode(simple)), simple)
    }
}

final class TapSideTests: XCTestCase {
    func testGestureMapping() {
        XCTAssertEqual(ScoreCommand.from(count: 2, side: .wide), .won)
        XCTAssertEqual(ScoreCommand.from(count: 2, side: .narrow), .lost)
        XCTAssertEqual(ScoreCommand.from(count: 3, side: nil), .undo)
        XCTAssertEqual(ScoreCommand.from(count: 4, side: .wide), .undo)
        XCTAssertNil(ScoreCommand.from(count: 1, side: .wide))
        XCTAssertNil(ScoreCommand.from(count: 1, side: .narrow))
        XCTAssertNil(ScoreCommand.from(count: 1, side: nil))
        XCTAssertNil(ScoreCommand.from(count: 2, side: nil), "an unclear side scores nothing")
    }

    func testFitIgnoresSignAndNoise() throws {
        let wide: [SIMD3<Float>] = [SIMD3(0.1, 0.05, 0.99), SIMD3(-0.05, 0.1, -0.98), SIMD3(0.15, -0.1, 0.97)]
        let narrow: [SIMD3<Float>] = [SIMD3(0.1, 0.99, 0.05), SIMD3(0.05, -0.97, -0.1), SIMD3(-0.2, 0.95, 0.1)]
        let cal = try XCTUnwrap(TapCalibration.fit(wide: wide, narrow: narrow))
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(abs(cal.wideAxis.z), 0.95)
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(abs(cal.narrowAxis.y), 0.95)
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(cal.separationDegrees, 75)
        XCTAssertEqual(cal.classify(SIMD3(0, 0, -1))?.side, .wide)
        XCTAssertEqual(cal.classify(SIMD3(0, 0.9, 0.2))?.side, .narrow)
        XCTAssertNil(cal.classify(simd_normalize(SIMD3(0, 1, 1))), "halfway between the sides is unknown")
        XCTAssertNil(TapCalibration.fit(wide: [SIMD3(0, 0, 1)], narrow: narrow), "one tap is not enough")
    }

    func testDefaultUsesRacketAxes() {
        let cal = TapCalibration.fromRacket(.default)
        // Default racket calibration: racket z = -sensor z, racket y = sensor x.
        XCTAssertEqual(cal.classify(SIMD3(0, 0, 1))?.side, .wide)
        XCTAssertEqual(cal.classify(SIMD3(1, 0, 0))?.side, .narrow)
        XCTAssertFalse(cal.isCalibrated)
    }

    func testDecodeTap() {
        let data = Data([0x05, 0x00, 2, 200, 0, 0, 0x81, 0, 127])   // dir (-1, 0, 1) before normalising
        let t = RacketProtocol.decodeTap(data)
        XCTAssertEqual(t?.seq, 5)
        XCTAssertEqual(t?.count, 2)
        XCTAssertEqual(t?.strength, 200)
        XCTAssertEqual(t?.direction.x ?? 0, -1, accuracy: 0.01)
        XCTAssertEqual(t?.direction.z ?? 0, 1, accuracy: 0.01)
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import XCTest
import simd
@testable import RacketKit

/// The racket computes each shot itself (firmware/src/shot.cpp, firmware 1.6+). This builds that C++ on the Mac and
/// checks it against RacketEngine's window path on the same wire bytes: simulated swings, cut into windows the way
/// the racket cuts them, seen through a non-trivial calibration.
final class ShotParityTests: XCTestCase {
    private static let repo = URL(fileURLWithPath: #filePath)
        .deletingLastPathComponent().deletingLastPathComponent().deletingLastPathComponent()
        .deletingLastPathComponent().deletingLastPathComponent()

    private func le16(_ v: Int) -> [UInt8] {
        let u = UInt16(truncatingIfNeeded: v)
        return [UInt8(u & 0xFF), UInt8(u >> 8)]
    }

    private func le32(_ v: UInt32) -> [UInt8] { (0..<4).map { UInt8((v >> (8 * UInt32($0))) & 0xFF) } }

    private func i16(_ v: Float) -> Int { Int(max(-32768, min(32767, v.rounded()))) }

    /// A racket-frame sample as the sensor would report it, in wire units (gyro at 8.2 LSB/dps, high-g at ±400 g).
    private func wire(_ s: IMUSample, _ cal: Calibration) -> [UInt8] {
        let toSensor = cal.mpuToRacket.transpose
        let a = toSensor * s.accel / cal.accelScale
        let g = toSensor * s.gyro + cal.gyroBias
        let h = toSensor * s.highG + cal.h3lisBias
        let dps: Float = 180 / .pi
        let hg = [h.x, h.y, h.z].map { Int(max(-2048, min(2047, ($0 / 0.195).rounded()))) * 16 }
        return [a.x, a.y, a.z].flatMap { le16(i16($0 * 2048)) }
            + [g.x, g.y, g.z].flatMap { le16(i16($0 * dps * 8.2)) } + hg.flatMap { le16($0) }
    }

    private func calibration() -> Calibration {
        var cal = Calibration.default
        // Default axes plus a few degrees of mounting tilt, so no axis maps straight onto another.
        let tilt = simd_float3x3(simd_quatf(angle: 0.12, axis: simd_normalize(SIMD3<Float>(1, 2, 0.5))))
        cal.mpuToRacket = cal.mpuToRacket * tilt
        cal.h3lisToRacket = cal.mpuToRacket
        cal.gyroBias = SIMD3(0.01, -0.02, 0.005)
        cal.h3lisBias = SIMD3(0.3, -0.2, 0.1)
        cal.accelScale = 1.02
        cal.isCalibrated = true
        return cal
    }

    /// Windows cut like impact.cpp: the largest 3 ms high-g jump, 384 samples before, 64 after. Each is its 56 chunks.
    private func windows(_ samples: [IMUSample], _ cal: Calibration) -> [[Data]] {
        func jump(_ k: Int) -> Float { simd_length(samples[k].highG - samples[k - 3].highG) }
        var out: [[Data]] = []
        var k = 3, seq = 0
        while k < samples.count - 20 {
            guard jump(k) > 10 else { k += 1; continue }
            let best = (k..<(k + 12)).max { jump($0) < jump($1) }!
            let impact = best - 2, start = impact - RacketProtocol.windowPre
            k = best + 600
            guard start > 0, impact + RacketProtocol.windowPost <= samples.count else { continue }
            // The racket's own orientation filter at the window start, in sensor axes.
            var f = MahonyFilter()
            let sensor = cal.mpuToRacket.transpose
            for j in 0..<start {
                let dt = Float(j == 0 ? 0.001 : samples[j].time - samples[j - 1].time)
                f.update(gyro: sensor * samples[j].gyro, accel: sensor * samples[j].accel, dt: dt)
            }
            let q0 = [f.q.real, f.q.imag.x, f.q.imag.y, f.q.imag.z].flatMap { le16(i16($0 * 16384)) }
            var chunks: [Data] = []
            for c in 0..<RacketProtocol.windowSamples / 8 {
                let first = start + c * 8
                // Racket micros: 1 ms per sample plus a little jitter at each chunk.
                let t0 = UInt32(5_000_000 + first * 1000 + (c % 3) * 7)
                var b = le16(seq) + [UInt8(c), 56] + le16(RacketProtocol.windowPre) + q0 + le32(t0)
                b += [8, RacketProtocol.flagGyro4000]
                for j in first..<(first + 8) { b += wire(samples[j], cal) }
                chunks.append(Data(b))
            }
            out.append(chunks)
            seq += 1
        }
        return out
    }

    private func runCPP(_ input: Data) throws -> [String] {
        let tmp = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent("shot_parity-\(UUID().uuidString)")
        let fw = Self.repo.appendingPathComponent("firmware")
        let build = Process()
        build.executableURL = URL(fileURLWithPath: "/usr/bin/xcrun")
        build.arguments = ["clang++", "-O2", "-std=c++17", "-I", fw.appendingPathComponent("include").path,
                           "-I", fw.appendingPathComponent("src").path, "-o", tmp.path,
                           fw.appendingPathComponent("tools/shot_parity/shot_parity.cpp").path,
                           fw.appendingPathComponent("src/shot.cpp").path]
        try build.run()
        build.waitUntilExit()
        guard build.terminationStatus == 0 else { throw XCTSkip("no host C++ compiler") }
        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: tmp) }
        let run = Process()
        run.executableURL = tmp
        let stdin = Pipe(), stdout = Pipe()
        run.standardInput = stdin
        run.standardOutput = stdout
        try run.run()
        stdin.fileHandleForWriting.write(input)
        try stdin.fileHandleForWriting.close()
        let out = stdout.fileHandleForReading.readDataToEndOfFile()
        run.waitUntilExit()
        XCTAssertEqual(run.terminationStatus, 0)
        return String(decoding: out, as: UTF8.self).split(separator: "\n").map(String.init)
    }

    private func check(profile: RacketProfile) throws {
        let saved = IMUSample.gyroSaturation
        IMUSample.gyroSaturation = 3990 * .pi / 180
        defer { IMUSample.gyroSaturation = saved }
        let cal = calibration()
        let model = ImpactModel()
        let wins = windows(SimulatedRacket().generate(shots: 40), cal)
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(wins.count, 30)

        var input = RacketProtocol.shotConfigPayload(gen: 7, calibration: cal, profile: profile, model: model)
        input.append(1)   // gyro4000
        input.append(contentsOf: le32(UInt32(wins.count)))
        for w in wins { for c in w { input.append(c) } }
        let lines = try runCPP(input)
        XCTAssertEqual(lines.count, wins.count)

        let analyzer = ShotAnalyzer(profile: profile, model: model)
        let types: [ShotType: Int] = [.forehand: 0, .backhand: 1, .serve: 2, .volley: 3]
        let spins: [SpinType: Int] = [.topspin: 0, .flat: 1, .slice: 2]
        var seen = Set<ShotType>()
        for (w, line) in zip(wins, lines) {
            var assembler = ImpactWindowAssembler()
            var window: ImpactWindow?
            for c in w {
                window = assembler.add(RacketProtocol.decodeWindowChunk(c)!, h3lisRange: 3) { Double($0) / 1e6 }
            }
            let shot = try XCTUnwrap(RacketEngine.shot(window: try XCTUnwrap(window), calibration: cal,
                                                       analyzer: analyzer, calibrationMode: false, date: Date()))
            seen.insert(shot.type)
            let f = line.split(separator: " ").map { Double($0)! }
            XCTAssertEqual(f.count, 18, line)
            XCTAssertEqual(Int(f[0]), types[shot.type], "type")
            XCTAssertEqual(Int(f[1]), spins[shot.spin], "spin")
            XCTAssertEqual(Int(f[2]) & 1 != 0, shot.gyroSaturated, "saturated")
            let swift: [Double] = [shot.swingSpeedKmh, shot.ballSpeedKmh, shot.spinRPM, shot.faceAngleDeg,
                                   shot.swingPathDeg, shot.impactXcm, shot.impactYcm, shot.peakG,
                                   Double(shot.features.rollRatio), Double(shot.features.ringNorm),
                                   Double(shot.features.jolt), Double(shot.features.impulse),
                                   Double(shot.features.spinAxisY ?? 0), Double(shot.features.verticalSpin ?? 0),
                                   Double(shot.features.swingDeg ?? 0)]
            let names = ["swing", "ball", "spin", "face", "path", "x", "y", "peakG", "roll", "ring", "jolt", "impulse",
                         "spinAxisY", "verticalSpin", "swingDeg"]
            for (k, v) in swift.enumerated() {
                // Float rounding only: the two run the same steps (simd may fuse multiply-adds).
                XCTAssertEqual(f[3 + k], v, accuracy: 1e-3 * max(1, abs(v)), "\(names[k]) in \(line)")
            }
        }
        XCTAssertGreaterThanOrEqual(seen.count, 3, "the simulator should produce several shot types")
    }

    func testRacketShotMatchesTheAppWithHandedness() throws {
        try check(profile: RacketProfile())
    }

    func testRacketShotMatchesTheAppWithTaughtForehand() throws {
        var profile = RacketProfile()
        profile.forehandBodySign = -1
        profile.rightHanded = false
        try check(profile: profile)
    }

    func testConfigPayloadSize() {
        let d = RacketProtocol.shotConfigPayload(gen: 1, calibration: .default, profile: RacketProfile(),
                                                 model: ImpactModel())
        XCTAssertEqual(d.count, 1 + 36 * 4 + 1)   // TB_SHOT_CONFIG_PAYLOAD
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import XCTest
@testable import RacketKit

final class ShotSimulatorTests: XCTestCase {
    private var baseline: ShotSimulator.Parameters {
        .init(swingSpeedKmh: 90, pathAngleDeg: 20, faceAngleDeg: 0, contactXcm: 0, contactYcm: 0)
    }

    func testMatchesAnalyzerSpeedAndSpinEquations() {
        let result = ShotSimulator.simulate(baseline)
        XCTAssertEqual(result.ballSpeedKmh, 0.42 * 43.2 + 1.42 * 90, accuracy: 0.001)
        let expectedSpin = 0.7 * 25 * sin(20 * Double.pi / 180) / 0.0335 * 60 / (2 * Double.pi)
        XCTAssertEqual(result.spinRPM, expectedSpin, accuracy: 0.001)
        XCTAssertEqual(result.spin, .topspin)
    }

    func testSlowerSwingAndOffCenterContactReduceBallSpeed() {
        let before = ShotSimulator.simulate(baseline)
        var slower = baseline; slower.swingSpeedKmh *= 0.95
        let after = ShotSimulator.simulate(slower)
        XCTAssertLessThan(after.ballSpeedKmh, before.ballSpeedKmh)
        XCTAssertEqual(after.spinRPM / before.spinRPM, 0.95, accuracy: 0.0001)
        var offset = baseline; offset.contactXcm = 10
        XCTAssertLessThan(ShotSimulator.simulate(offset).ballSpeedKmh, before.ballSpeedKmh)
    }

    func testFacePathAlignmentProducesNoBrushAndDirectionSetsSpin() {
        var p = baseline; p.faceAngleDeg = p.pathAngleDeg
        XCTAssertEqual(ShotSimulator.simulate(p).spinRPM, 0, accuracy: 0.0001)
        p.faceAngleDeg = 0; p.pathAngleDeg = -20
        XCTAssertEqual(ShotSimulator.simulate(p).spin, .slice)
    }

    func testClampsExtremeAndNonFiniteInputs() throws {
        let p = ShotSimulator.Parameters(swingSpeedKmh: 300, pathAngleDeg: .infinity,
            faceAngleDeg: -999, contactXcm: .nan, contactYcm: 999, incomingSpeedKmh: -10)
        let r = ShotSimulator.simulate(p)
        XCTAssertEqual(r.parameters.swingSpeedKmh, 200)
        XCTAssertEqual(r.parameters.pathAngleDeg, 0)
        XCTAssertEqual(r.parameters.faceAngleDeg, -60)
        XCTAssertEqual(r.parameters.contactXcm, 0)
        XCTAssertEqual(r.parameters.contactYcm, 14)
        XCTAssertEqual(r.parameters.incomingSpeedKmh, 0)
        XCTAssertTrue(r.ballSpeedKmh.isFinite && r.spinRPM.isFinite)
        XCTAssertNoThrow(try JSONEncoder().encode(r))
    }

    func testServeWithoutIncomingBallAndZeroSwing() {
        var p = baseline; p.incomingSpeedKmh = 0
        XCTAssertEqual(ShotSimulator.simulate(p).ballSpeedKmh, 1.42 * 90, accuracy: 0.001)
        p.swingSpeedKmh = 0
        XCTAssertEqual(ShotSimulator.simulate(p).ballSpeedKmh, 0)
        XCTAssertEqual(ShotSimulator.simulate(p).spinRPM, 0)
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import XCTest
import simd
@testable import RacketKit

final class ShotTypeTests: XCTestCase {
    /// A flat window with constant racket-frame rotation, so only the gyro sign can decide the type.
    private func shotType(wy: Float, sign: Float) -> ShotType {
        let window = (0..<1000).map { k in
            IMUSample(time: Double(k) * 0.001, accel: SIMD3(0, 0, 1), gyro: SIMD3(0, wy, 0), highG: .zero)
        }
        var profile = RacketProfile()
        profile.forehandBodySign = sign
        return ShotAnalyzer(profile: profile, model: ImpactModel())
            .analyze(window: window, impact: 700, orientation: simd_quatf(ix: 0, iy: 0, iz: 0, r: 1),
                     date: Date(), calibrationMode: false).type
    }

    func testBodySignDecidesForehandVersusBackhand() {
        XCTAssertEqual(shotType(wy: 28, sign: 1), .forehand)
        XCTAssertEqual(shotType(wy: -28, sign: 1), .backhand)
        XCTAssertEqual(shotType(wy: 28, sign: -1), .backhand)
        XCTAssertEqual(shotType(wy: -28, sign: -1), .forehand)
    }

    func testBodySignIsOffByDefault() {
        XCTAssertEqual(RacketProfile().forehandBodySign, 0)
    }

    /// Saves made before the forehand sign existed must still load, or the app silently resets to defaults.
    func testOldSavesStillDecode() throws {
        let oldProfile = Data(#"{"name":"Yonex","massKg":0.3,"lengthM":0.68,"balancePointM":0.3,"stringCenterM":0.5,"imuFromButtM":0.04,"effectiveRadiusM":1.1,"rightHanded":false}"#.utf8)
        let profile = try JSONDecoder().decode(RacketProfile.self, from: oldProfile)
        XCTAssertEqual(profile.name, "Yonex")
        XCTAssertFalse(profile.rightHanded)
        XCTAssertEqual(profile.forehandBodySign, 0)
        let encoded = try JSONEncoder().encode(profile)
        XCTAssertFalse(String(decoding: encoded, as: UTF8.self).contains("forehandBodySign"))

        let oldPlayer = Data(#"{"id":"3F2504E0-4F89-11D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301","name":"Quentin","rightHanded":true}"#.utf8)
        XCTAssertNil(try JSONDecoder().decode(PlayerProfile.self, from: oldPlayer).forehandBodySign)

        let oldFeatures = Data(#"{"rollRatio":0.1,"ringNorm":0.2,"jolt":0.3,"impulse":4}"#.utf8)
        XCTAssertNil(try JSONDecoder().decode(ImpactFeatures.self, from: oldFeatures).spinAxisY)
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import XCTest
import simd
@testable import RacketKit

/// Runs simulated swings through the engine and checks the analyzer recovers sensible shots.
final class SimulatorRoundTripTests: XCTestCase {
    func testSimulatedShotsAreDetectedAndPlausible() throws {
        let sim = SimulatedRacket()
        sim.shotInterval = 2.5
        let engine = RacketEngine()
        var shots: [ShotMetrics] = []
        let done = expectation(description: "shots")
        engine.onShot = { shot in
            shots.append(shot)
            if shots.count == 12 { done.fulfill() }
        }
        engine.attach(sim)
        sim.start()
        wait(for: [done], timeout: 60)
        sim.stop()
        for s in shots {
            print(String(format: "%@ swing %.0f ball %.0f km/h spin %.0f %@ face %.0f path %.0f hit (%.1f, %.1f) ring %.3f jolt %.3f imp %.1f",
                         s.type.label, s.swingSpeedKmh, s.ballSpeedKmh, s.spinRPM, s.spin.label, s.faceAngleDeg,
                         s.swingPathDeg, s.impactXcm, s.impactYcm, s.features.ringNorm, s.features.jolt, s.features.impulse))
        }
        XCTAssertGreaterThanOrEqual(shots.count, 12)
        XCTAssertTrue(shots.allSatisfy { $0.swingSpeedKmh > 5 && $0.swingSpeedKmh < 200 })
    }
}

final class DrillParsingTests: XCTestCase {
    func testParsesCoachDrill() {
        let d = Drill.parse("TITLE: Center the backhand\nGOAL: 10 backhands in the sweet spot\nWHY: Only 40% hit it.")
        XCTAssertEqual(d.title, "Center the backhand")
        XCTAssertEqual(d.target, 10)
        XCTAssertEqual(d.stroke, .backhand)
        XCTAssertEqual(d.criterion, .sweetSpot)
    }

    func testParsesSpinAndSpeedThresholds() {
        XCTAssertEqual(Drill.parse("GOAL: 8 forehands over 1800 rpm").criterion, .minSpinRPM(1800))
        let mph = Drill.parse("**GOAL:** 5 serves above 90 mph")
        XCTAssertEqual(mph.target, 5)
        XCTAssertEqual(mph.stroke, .serve)
        if case .minBallKmh(let k) = mph.criterion { XCTAssertEqual(k, 144.84, accuracy: 0.1) } else { XCTFail() }
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import XCTest
import simd
@testable import RacketKit

final class SweetSpotCheckTests: XCTestCase {
    private let center = SweetSpotCheck.Cell(col: 0, row: 0)
    private let tipLeft = SweetSpotCheck.Cell(col: -1, row: 1)

    private func verdict(sweet: Bool, off: Int = 0) -> RacketProtocol.ShotVerdict {
        RacketProtocol.ShotVerdict(seq: 0, isSweet: sweet, offCenterPercent: off, confidencePercent: 80, level: 200)
    }

    private func shot() -> ShotMetrics {
        ShotMetrics(date: Date(), type: .calibration, swingSpeedKmh: 0, ballSpeedKmh: 0, spinRPM: 0, spin: .flat,
                    faceAngleDeg: 0, swingPathDeg: 0, impactXcm: 1, impactYcm: 2, peakG: 12, gyroSaturated: false,
                    features: ImpactFeatures(rollRatio: 0.1, ringNorm: 0.2, jolt: 0.03, impulse: 0.5))
    }

    func testOnlyCenterSquareIsSweet() {
        XCTAssertTrue(center.isSweet)
        for col in -1...1 { for row in -1...1 where col != 0 || row != 0 {
            XCTAssertFalse(SweetSpotCheck.Cell(col: col, row: row).isSweet, "\(col),\(row)")
        } }
        XCTAssertEqual(tipLeft.name, "tip-left")
        XCTAssertEqual(tipLeft.distanceCm, (25.0 + 36).squareRoot(), accuracy: 1e-9)
    }

    func testVerdictAndImpactOfOneDropArePaired() {
        var check = SweetSpotCheck()
        let t = Date()
        check.add(shot: shot(), cell: center, at: t)
        check.add(verdict: verdict(sweet: true), cell: center, at: t.addingTimeInterval(0.2))
        XCTAssertEqual(check.drops.count, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(check.drops[0].racketCorrect, true)
        XCTAssertEqual(check.drops[0].peakG, 12)

        // Too late to be the same drop: a new one.
        check.add(verdict: verdict(sweet: true), cell: center, at: t.addingTimeInterval(2))
        XCTAssertEqual(check.drops.count, 2)
        XCTAssertNil(check.drops[1].features)
    }

    func testScoring() {
        var check = SweetSpotCheck()
        var t = Date()
        func next() -> Date { t = t.addingTimeInterval(3); return t }
        check.add(verdict: verdict(sweet: true), cell: center, at: next())
        check.add(verdict: verdict(sweet: false, off: 40), cell: center, at: next())
        check.add(verdict: verdict(sweet: false, off: 70), cell: tipLeft, at: next())
        check.add(shot: shot(), cell: tipLeft, at: next())   // no verdict: not scored
        XCTAssertEqual(check.scored, 3)
        XCTAssertEqual(check.correct, 2)
        XCTAssertEqual(check.sweetHits.correct, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(check.sweetHits.of, 2)
        XCTAssertEqual(check.offHits.correct, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(check.offHits.of, 1)
        check.undo()
        XCTAssertEqual(check.drops.count, 3)
    }

    func testCSVHasOneRowPerDrop() {
        var check = SweetSpotCheck()
        check.add(verdict: verdict(sweet: false, off: 55), cell: tipLeft)
        let lines = check.csv().split(separator: "\n")
        XCTAssertEqual(lines.count, 2)
        let header = lines[0].split(separator: ",", omittingEmptySubsequences: false)
        let row = lines[1].split(separator: ",", omittingEmptySubsequences: false)
        XCTAssertEqual(header.count, row.count)
        XCTAssertEqual(row[header.firstIndex(of: "cell")!], "tip-left")
        XCTAssertEqual(row[header.firstIndex(of: "racket_correct")!], "1")
        XCTAssertEqual(row[header.firstIndex(of: "off_center_pct")!], "55")
    }

    /// The high-g channel shares the low-g axes, so it gets the same rotation even when its gravity reading is noisy.
    func testPoseCalibrationUsesLowGAxesForHighG() {
        // Tip up reads -1 g on the sensor's Y axis (it points toward the butt), as on the clamped racket on 2026-10-29.
        let tip = Calibration.PoseReading(samples: [IMUSample(time: 0, accel: SIMD3(0, -1, 0), gyro: .zero,
                                                              highG: SIMD3(0.4, 0.6, -0.5))])
        let face = Calibration.PoseReading(samples: [IMUSample(time: 0, accel: SIMD3(0, 0, -1), gyro: .zero,
                                                               highG: SIMD3(0.5, 0.3, -0.4))])
        let cal = Calibration.from(tipUp: tip, faceUp: face)
        XCTAssertEqual(cal.h3lisToRacket, cal.mpuToRacket)
        XCTAssertEqual(cal.mpuToRacket, Calibration.default.mpuToRacket)
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import RacketKit
import SwiftData
import SwiftUI

@main
struct TennisBuddyApp: App {
    @State private var model = AppModel()
    @State private var coach = CoachModel()
    @State private var account = AccountModel()
    @Environment(\.scenePhase) private var scenePhase
    let container: ModelContainer = SyncedStore.makeContainer()
    #if os(iOS)
    @State private var watchBridge = WatchBridge()
    @State private var glasses = GlassesController()
    #endif

    var body: some Scene {
        WindowGroup {
            RootView()
                .environment(model)
                .environment(coach)
                .environment(account)
                #if os(iOS)
                .environment(glasses)
                .onOpenURL { glasses.handle(url: $0) }
                #endif
                .task { await account.observeAuthentication() }
                .onChange(of: account.displayName) { _, value in model.signedInPlayerName = value }
                .onChange(of: account.isSignedIn) { _, value in coach.setSignedIn(value) }
                .task(id: scenePhase) {
                    guard scenePhase == .active else { return }
                    while !Task.isCancelled {
                        await account.syncPendingStats(in: container.mainContext)
                        do { try await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(5)) } catch { return }
                    }
                }
                .tint(.accentColor)
                .onAppear {
                    model.modelContext = container.mainContext
                    model.signedInPlayerName = account.displayName
                    coach.connect(to: model)
                    coach.useTransport { await account.museTransport() }
                    coach.setSignedIn(account.isSignedIn)
                    #if os(iOS)
                    watchBridge.connect(to: model, account: account)
                    glasses.connect(to: model, account: account)
                    #endif
                }
        }
        .modelContainer(container)
        #if os(macOS)
        .defaultSize(width: 1200, height: 800)
        #endif

        #if os(macOS)
        Settings { AppSettingsView().frame(width: 420) }
        #endif
    }
}

struct RootView: View {
    @Environment(AppModel.self) private var model
    @AppStorage("selectedTab") private var tab = "live"

    var body: some View {
        TabView(selection: $tab) {
            Tab("Live", systemImage: "figure.tennis", value: "live") { NavigationStack { LiveView() } }
            Tab("Score", systemImage: "trophy", value: "score") { NavigationStack { ScoreView() } }
            Tab("Muse", systemImage: "sparkles", value: "muse") { NavigationStack { CoachScreen() } }
            Tab("Insights", systemImage: "chart.line.uptrend.xyaxis", value: "insights") { NavigationStack { InsightsView() } }
            Tab("Settings", systemImage: "gearshape", value: "settings") { NavigationStack { RacketView() } }
        }
        .tabViewStyle(.sidebarAdaptable)
        // Old tab values: History moved under Insights; Together became Muse; Racket became Settings.
        .onAppear {
            switch tab {
            case "history": tab = "insights"
            case "together": tab = "muse"
            case "racket": tab = "settings"
            default: break
            }
        }
    }
}

            LabeledContent("iCloud sync", value: SyncedStore.statusText)
````````

````````swift
import Foundation
import SwiftData

/// Long-term notes about one player, as the coach tools see them. Reads and writes stay on the main actor.
@MainActor
struct CoachMemory {
    static let maxNoteLength = 240
    static let maxNotesPerPlayer = 200
    /// Muse may add at most this many notes per answer, so a confused model can't flood the list.
    static let maxSavesPerAnswer = 2

    let notes: () throws -> [CoachNote]
    let save: (_ text: String, _ category: CoachNote.Category) throws -> CoachNote

    /// Notes for `playerID` in the app's store. New notes are linked to `sessionID`.
    static func store(_ context: ModelContext, playerID: UUID, sessionID: UUID?) -> CoachMemory {
        CoachMemory(
            notes: {
                try context.fetch(FetchDescriptor<CoachNote>(sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\.updatedAt, order: .reverse)]))
                    .filter { $0.playerID == playerID }
            },
            save: { text, category in
                let note = CoachNote(playerID: playerID, text: text, category: category, source: "coach", sessionID: sessionID)
                context.insert(note)
                try context.save()
                return note
            })
    }

    /// In-memory notes, for tests and previews.
    static func inMemory(_ initial: [CoachNote] = [], playerID: UUID = UUID()) -> CoachMemory {
        var list = initial
        return CoachMemory(notes: { list.sorted { $0.updatedAt > $1.updatedAt } }, save: { text, category in
            let note = CoachNote(playerID: playerID, text: text, category: category, source: "coach")
            list.append(note)
            return note
        })
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import Foundation
import Observation
import RacketKit
import SwiftData

/// Builds the facts the coach talks about. Shared by the template coach and Muse.
struct SessionDigest: Codable {
    struct Stroke: Codable {
        var type: String
        var count: Int
        var sweetSpotPercent: Int
        var avgBallSpeed: Int
        var maxBallSpeed: Int
        var avgSwingSpeed: Int
        var avgSpinRPM: Int
        var avgPathDeg: Int
        var avgFaceDeg: Int
        var avgContactTowardTip: Double
        var avgContactRight: Double
        var contactSpread: Double
    }

    var speedUnit: String
    var lengthUnit: String
    var durationMinutes: Int
    var totalShots: Int
    var sweetSpotPercent: Int
    var pointsWon: Int
    var pointsLost: Int
    var averageHeartRate: Int
    var strokes: [Stroke]
    /// Ball speed in the first vs last third of the session (fatigue).
    var firstThirdAvgSpeed: Int
    var lastThirdAvgSpeed: Int

    init(session: SessionRecord, units: UnitSystem = .current) {
        speedUnit = units.speedUnit
        lengthUnit = units.lengthUnit
        func spd(_ kmh: Double) -> Int { Int(units.speed(kmh).rounded()) }
        func len(_ cm: Double) -> Double { (units.length(cm) * 10).rounded() / 10 }
        let shots = session.shots.filter { $0.type != .calibration }
        let all = ShotSummary(shots)
        durationMinutes = Int(session.duration / 60)
        totalShots = shots.count
        sweetSpotPercent = Int(all.sweetSpotPercent)
        pointsWon = session.pointsWon
        pointsLost = session.pointsLost
        averageHeartRate = Int(session.averageHeartRate)
        strokes = ShotType.allCases.compactMap { t in
            let s = shots.filter { $0.type == t }
            guard !s.isEmpty else { return nil }
            let m = ShotSummary(s)
            return Stroke(type: t.label, count: m.count, sweetSpotPercent: Int(m.sweetSpotPercent),
                          avgBallSpeed: spd(m.avgBallKmh), maxBallSpeed: spd(m.maxBallKmh), avgSwingSpeed: spd(m.avgSwingKmh),
                          avgSpinRPM: Int(m.avgSpinRPM), avgPathDeg: Int(m.avgPathAngle), avgFaceDeg: Int(m.avgFaceAngle),
                          avgContactTowardTip: len(m.avgImpactY),
                          avgContactRight: len(m.avgImpactX),
                          contactSpread: len(m.impactSpreadCm))
        }
        let third = max(shots.count / 3, 1)
        firstThirdAvgSpeed = spd(ShotSummary(Array(shots.prefix(third))).avgBallKmh)
        lastThirdAvgSpeed = spd(ShotSummary(Array(shots.suffix(third))).avgBallKmh)
    }

    var json: String {
        let enc = JSONEncoder()
        enc.outputFormatting = [.prettyPrinted, .sortedKeys]
        return String(data: (try? enc.encode(self)) ?? Data(), encoding: .utf8) ?? "{}"
    }
}

/// Something that can turn stats into words: Muse or the built-in template fallback.
@MainActor
protocol CoachEngine {
    var name: String { get }
    func summarize(_ digest: SessionDigest) async throws -> String
    func answer(_ question: String, digest: SessionDigest) async throws -> String
    func drill(_ digest: SessionDigest) async throws -> String
    func scout(_ digest: SessionDigest, opponent: ScoutOpponent?) async throws -> String
    func plan(_ digest: SessionDigest) async throws -> String
    func review(_ digest: SessionDigest) async throws -> String
}

/// An opponent's shared totals, rendered in the digest's display units.
/// Shared aggregates, never your racket's measurements.
struct ScoutOpponent: Codable, Sendable {
    var name: String
    var shots: Int
    var sweetPercent: Int
    var avgBall: Int?
    var topBall: Int?
    var speedUnit: String

    var block: String {
        "\(name): \(shots) shots, \(sweetPercent)% sweet spot" +
        (avgBall.map { ", avg \($0) \(speedUnit)" } ?? "") +
        (topBall.map { " (top \($0))" } ?? "")
    }
}

enum CoachPrompts {
    static let system = """
    You are Muse, the AI in Tennis Buddee, a smart tennis racket. You are upbeat and know tennis well. You are given measurements from a sensor in the \
    player's racket. Only use numbers that appear in the data; never invent stats. Speeds use the data's speedUnit, \
    spin is rpm, contact positions use lengthUnit from the sweet spot (positive toward the tip / to the right). \
    Always write the units next to numbers and never mention JSON field names. Keep answers short, \
    concrete and encouraging.
    """

    static func summary(_ d: SessionDigest) -> String {
        """
        Session data:
        \(d.json)

        Write a session report in under 120 words, no greeting. Start with one sentence on the overall session. \
        Then name the strongest stroke with two of its numbers and the weakest area with two of its numbers. \
        End with exactly 2 bullet-point tips. Each tip must cite a number from the data and give one concrete \
        technique cue (for example contact point, footwork, swing path or racket face). No generic advice.
        """
    }

    static func question(_ q: String, _ d: SessionDigest) -> String {
        "Session data:\n\(d.json)\n\nPlayer's question: \(q)\nAnswer in under 80 words using the data."
    }

    /// For the tool-using coach: no data in the prompt, it looks up what it needs.
    static func agentQuestion(_ q: String) -> String {
        "Player's question: \(q)\nLook up what you need with the tools: the session digest, individual shots, the racket's live sensors and status, " +
        "the player's notes and the what-if simulator. Answer in under 80 words."
    }

    static func drill(_ d: SessionDigest) -> String {
        """
        Session data:
        \(d.json)

        Design ONE short drill for the player's weakest stroke. Reply with exactly these three lines and nothing else:
        TITLE: <2 to 5 words>
        GOAL: <a number from 5 to 15> <stroke name in plural> <condition>
        WHY: <one sentence that cites one number from the data, with its unit>
        The condition must be exactly one of: "in the sweet spot", "over <number> rpm", "over <number> \(d.speedUnit)".
        Never mention data field names. Example:
        TITLE: Center the backhand
        GOAL: 10 backhands in the sweet spot
        WHY: Only 35% of your backhands hit the sweet spot.
        """
    }

    static func scout(_ d: SessionDigest, opponent: ScoutOpponent?) -> String {
        let opp = opponent.map {
            "Opponent's shared totals (given by the Together share, not measured by your racket):\n\($0.block)"
        } ?? "No shared opponent data: scout the player as an opponent would, using compare_sessions across their recent sessions."
        return """
        Your session data:
        \(d.json)

        \(opp)

        Write a match plan in under 120 words, no greeting. Start with one sentence on how you match up. \
        Then: the opponent's likely strength and weakness from their totals against your digest; one pattern to lean on; \
        one thing to avoid. End with a prep drill in exactly TITLE/GOAL/WHY lines \
        (GOAL: <5-15> <strokes> <condition>; condition one of "in the sweet spot", "over <number> rpm", "over <number> \(d.speedUnit)"). \
        Cite numbers with units. Say once that opponent numbers are shared totals, not your measurements.
        """
    }

    static func plan(_ d: SessionDigest) -> String {
        """
        Session data:
        \(d.json)

        Design a 3-step practice plan for the next session: weakest link first, a progression, then a rally count. \
        Reply in exactly this format and nothing else:
        PLAN: <title, 2 to 6 words>
        STEP 1:
        TITLE: <2 to 5 words>
        GOAL: <a number from 5 to 15> <stroke name in plural> <condition>
        WHY: <one sentence that cites one number from the data, with its unit>
        NOTE: <one sentence: what success feels like>
        STEP 2: (same four lines, a different weakness or a harder progression)
        STEP 3: (same four lines; a rally count, so the condition may instead be "any <number> <strokes>")
        Each condition must be exactly one of: "in the sweet spot", "over <number> rpm", "over <number> \(d.speedUnit)". \
        Never mention data field names.
        """
    }

    static func review(_ d: SessionDigest) -> String {
        """
        Session data:
        \(d.json)

        Review this session like an assistant coach. Reply with 1 to 4 flags in exactly this format per flag and nothing else:
        FLAG: <short label>
        DETAIL: <one sentence citing numbers with units>
        EVIDENCE: <which numbers, e.g. "thirds \(d.firstThirdAvgSpeed)->\(d.lastThirdAvgSpeed) \(d.speedUnit)" or "backhand 30% sweet">
        Skip praise; only flag what needs a human's eyes. If nothing needs review, reply with exactly one line: CLEAR: <one sentence>.
        """
    }
}

/// Deterministic offline coach, available without an API key or network connection.
struct TemplateCoach: CoachEngine {
    let name = "Built-in engine"

    func summarize(_ d: SessionDigest) async throws -> String {
        guard d.totalShots > 0 else { return "No shots recorded yet. Start a session and hit a few balls." }
        let best = d.strokes.max { $0.sweetSpotPercent < $1.sweetSpotPercent }
        let worst = d.strokes.min { $0.sweetSpotPercent < $1.sweetSpotPercent }
        var out = "\(d.totalShots) shots in \(max(d.durationMinutes, 1)) min with \(d.sweetSpotPercent)% in the sweet spot. "
        if let b = best {
            out += "Your \(b.type.lowercased()) led the way: \(b.sweetSpotPercent)% sweet spot, averaging \(b.avgBallSpeed) \(d.speedUnit) (top \(b.maxBallSpeed)). "
        }
        if let w = worst, w.type != best?.type {
            let dir = w.avgContactTowardTip >= 0 ? "toward the tip" : "toward the throat"
            out += "Your \(w.type.lowercased()) needs work: \(w.sweetSpotPercent)% sweet spot, contact drifting \(String(format: "%.1f", abs(w.avgContactTowardTip))) \(d.lengthUnit) \(dir). "
        }
        out += "\n\n• "
        if d.lastThirdAvgSpeed < d.firstThirdAvgSpeed - 3 {
            out += "Ball speed dropped from \(d.firstThirdAvgSpeed) to \(d.lastThirdAvgSpeed) \(d.speedUnit) late in the session; take short breaks to keep your legs fresh."
        } else {
            out += "You kept your pace all session (\(d.firstThirdAvgSpeed) → \(d.lastThirdAvgSpeed) \(d.speedUnit)). Nice consistency."
        }
        if let w = worst {
            out += "\n• On your \(w.type.lowercased()), "
            let near = d.lengthUnit == "cm" ? 1.0 : 0.4
            out += w.avgContactTowardTip > near ? "let the ball come a little deeper so you meet it in the center of the strings."
                : w.avgContactTowardTip < -near ? "step in and reach a little further so contact moves up toward the center."
                : "keep your eyes on contact a beat longer to tighten your \(w.contactSpread) \(d.lengthUnit) spread."
        }
        return out
    }

    func answer(_ question: String, digest d: SessionDigest) async throws -> String {
        let q = question.lowercased()
        if let s = d.strokes.first(where: { q.contains($0.type.lowercased()) }) {
            return "\(s.type): \(s.count) shots, \(s.sweetSpotPercent)% sweet spot, \(s.avgBallSpeed) \(d.speedUnit) average (top \(s.maxBallSpeed)), \(s.avgSpinRPM) rpm, swing path \(s.avgPathDeg)°."
        }
        return try await summarize(d)
    }

    func drill(_ d: SessionDigest) async throws -> String {
        let w = d.strokes.min { $0.sweetSpotPercent < $1.sweetSpotPercent }
        let stroke = w?.type ?? "Forehand"
        return "TITLE: Center the \(stroke)\nGOAL: 10 \(stroke.lowercased())s in the sweet spot\nWHY: Only \(w?.sweetSpotPercent ?? 0)% of your \(stroke.lowercased())s hit the sweet spot."
    }

    func scout(_ d: SessionDigest, opponent: ScoutOpponent?) async throws -> String {
        guard d.totalShots > 0 else { return "No shots recorded yet. Play first, then scout." }
        let w = d.strokes.min { $0.sweetSpotPercent < $1.sweetSpotPercent }
        guard let opp = opponent else {
            return "No shared opponent data, so here is how an opponent would scout you: attack your " +
                "\(w?.type.lowercased() ?? "second serve") (\(w?.sweetSpotPercent ?? 0)% sweet spot). " +
                "Lean on your strongest patterns early and protect the weaker side late."
        }
        let gap = opp.sweetPercent - d.sweetSpotPercent
        var out = "You hit \(d.sweetSpotPercent)% sweet spot against \(opp.name)'s shared \(opp.sweetPercent)%. "
        out += gap > 5 ? "They are cleaner off the ground: keep rallies short and take time away. "
            : gap < -5 ? "You are the cleaner ball-striker: extend rallies and make them hit one more ball. "
            : "You match up evenly on clean contact: the match turns on first strikes and depth. "
        if let avg = opp.avgBall {
            out += "Their shared average is \(avg) \(d.speedUnit) against your \(d.strokes.map(\.avgBallSpeed).max() ?? 0). "
        }
        out += "Opponent numbers are shared totals, not your measurements."
        return out
    }

    func plan(_ d: SessionDigest) async throws -> String {
        guard d.totalShots > 0 else {
            return "PLAN: First session\nSTEP 1:\nTITLE: Meet the ball\nGOAL: 10 forehands in the sweet spot\nWHY: No shots recorded yet.\nNOTE: Easy swings; listen for clean contact."
        }
        let w = d.strokes.min { $0.sweetSpotPercent < $1.sweetSpotPercent }
        let stroke = w?.type ?? "Forehand"
        let low = stroke.lowercased() + "s"
        let best = d.strokes.max { $0.sweetSpotPercent < $1.sweetSpotPercent }
        let bloc = best.map { "TITLE: Trust the \($0.type)\nGOAL: 8 \($0.type.lowercased())s over \($0.avgSpinRPM) rpm\nWHY: Your \($0.type.lowercased()) averages \($0.avgSpinRPM) rpm; hold that shape.\nNOTE: Heavy ball, same swing." }
            ?? "TITLE: Hold your shape\nGOAL: 8 \(low) over 1000 rpm\nWHY: Spin keeps the ball in play.\nNOTE: Brush up the back of the ball."
        return """
        PLAN: Fix the \(stroke)
        STEP 1:
        TITLE: Center the \(stroke)
        GOAL: 10 \(low) in the sweet spot
        WHY: Only \(w?.sweetSpotPercent ?? 0)% of your \(low) hit the sweet spot.
        NOTE: Quiet head at contact; the middle of the strings does the work.
        STEP 2:
        \(bloc)
        STEP 3:
        TITLE: Twenty-ball rally
        GOAL: any 20 \(low)
        WHY: You hit \(d.totalShots) shots this session; string them together.
        NOTE: Crosscourt and patient; depth over winners.
        """
    }

    func review(_ d: SessionDigest) async throws -> String {
        guard d.totalShots > 0 else { return "CLEAR: No shots recorded, nothing to review." }
        var flags: [String] = []
        if d.lastThirdAvgSpeed < d.firstThirdAvgSpeed - 3 {
            flags.append("FLAG: Late fade\nDETAIL: Ball speed dropped from \(d.firstThirdAvgSpeed) to \(d.lastThirdAvgSpeed) \(d.speedUnit) in the last third.\nEVIDENCE: thirds \(d.firstThirdAvgSpeed)->\(d.lastThirdAvgSpeed) \(d.speedUnit)")
        }
        if let w = d.strokes.min(by: { $0.sweetSpotPercent < $1.sweetSpotPercent }), w.sweetSpotPercent < 60 {
            flags.append("FLAG: \(w.type) contact\nDETAIL: Only \(w.sweetSpotPercent)% of \(w.type.lowercased())s found the sweet spot across \(w.count) shots.\nEVIDENCE: \(w.type.lowercased()) \(w.sweetSpotPercent)% sweet")
        }
        if d.pointsLost > d.pointsWon, d.pointsLost + d.pointsWon > 0 {
            flags.append("FLAG: Scoreboard leak\nDETAIL: Lost \(d.pointsLost) points against \(d.pointsWon) won.\nEVIDENCE: points \(d.pointsWon)-\(d.pointsLost)")
        }
        return flags.isEmpty ? "CLEAR: Steady session, nothing needs a review." : flags.joined(separator: "\n")
    }
}

@MainActor
@Observable
final class CoachModel {
    var isWorking = false
    private(set) var lastEngineName: String?
    private(set) var lastFallbackReason: String?
    /// Muse's last validated swing film, shown on the Muse home and set on the What-if sliders.
    var lastFilm: SwingFilm?
    /// Notes Muse saved while producing the last answer, shown under it so nothing is remembered silently.
    private(set) var lastRemembered: [String] = []
    /// Online coaching is available while signed in (the server holds the Muse key).
    private(set) var museAvailable = false
    var engineName: String { lastEngineName ?? (museEnabled && museAvailable ? "Muse Spark · online" : fallback.name) }
    var museEnabled: Bool {
        didSet { UserDefaults.standard.set(museEnabled, forKey: "coach.museEnabled"); lastEngineName = nil }
    }
    /// Lets Muse read the player's notes and add new ones. Off: notes stay on the device.
    var memoryEnabled: Bool {
        didSet { UserDefaults.standard.set(memoryEnabled, forKey: "coach.memoryEnabled") }
    }
    @ObservationIgnored private weak var app: AppModel?
    private let fallback = TemplateCoach()
    @ObservationIgnored private var transportProvider: @MainActor () async -> MuseTransport?

    init(transportProvider: @escaping @MainActor () async -> MuseTransport? = { nil }) {
        self.transportProvider = transportProvider
        museEnabled = UserDefaults.standard.object(forKey: "coach.museEnabled") as? Bool ?? true
        memoryEnabled = UserDefaults.standard.object(forKey: "coach.memoryEnabled") as? Bool ?? true
        if let data = UserDefaults.standard.data(forKey: "coach.activePlan") {
            activePlan = try? JSONDecoder().decode(PracticePlan.self, from: data)
        }
    }

    func connect(to app: AppModel) { self.app = app }
    func useTransport(_ provider: @escaping @MainActor () async -> MuseTransport?) { transportProvider = provider }
    func setSignedIn(_ signedIn: Bool) { museAvailable = signedIn }

    func summarize(_ session: SessionRecord) async -> String {
        let digest = SessionDigest(session: session)
        return await run(session: session) { try await $0.summarize(digest) }
    }

    func answer(_ q: String, session: SessionRecord) async -> String {
        let digest = SessionDigest(session: session)
        return await run(session: session) { try await $0.answer(q, digest: digest) }
    }

    func drill(_ session: SessionRecord) async -> String {
        let digest = SessionDigest(session: session)
        return await run(session: session) { try await $0.drill(digest) }
    }

    /// Match plan against a friend's shared totals (or a self-scout when nil).
    func scout(_ session: SessionRecord, opponent: SharedPlayerStats?, opponentName: String) async -> String {
        let digest = SessionDigest(session: session)
        let units = UnitSystem.current
        let opp = opponent.map {
            ScoutOpponent(name: opponentName, shots: $0.shots, sweetPercent: Int($0.sweetPercent),
                          avgBall: $0.averageBallKmh.map { Int(units.speed($0).rounded()) },
                          topBall: $0.topBallKmh.map { Int(units.speed($0).rounded()) },
                          speedUnit: units.speedUnit)
        }
        return await run(session: session) { try await $0.scout(digest, opponent: opp) }
    }

    /// The plan the UI shows; starting a step runs it as a drill (mirrored on Watch).
    var activePlan: PracticePlan? {
        didSet {
            if let plan = activePlan, let data = try? JSONEncoder().encode(plan) {
                UserDefaults.standard.set(data, forKey: "coach.activePlan")
            } else {
                UserDefaults.standard.removeObject(forKey: "coach.activePlan")
            }
        }
    }

    func plan(_ session: SessionRecord) async -> PracticePlan {
        let digest = SessionDigest(session: session)
        let text = await run(session: session) { try await $0.plan(digest) }
        let parsed = PracticePlan.parse(text, sessionID: session.id, engineName: lastEngineName ?? fallback.name)
        activePlan = parsed
        return parsed
    }

    func startPlanStep(_ step: PracticeStep) {
        app?.startDrill(step.drill)
    }

    /// Review a session for a human coach: flags are saved for the review queue.
    func review(_ session: SessionRecord) async -> CoachReview {
        let digest = SessionDigest(session: session)
        let text = await run(session: session) { try await $0.review(digest) }
        let parsed = ReviewFlag.parseAll(text)
        let record = CoachReview(sessionID: session.id, flags: parsed.flags, clearNote: parsed.clear ?? "",
                                 engineName: lastEngineName ?? fallback.name)
        if let context = app?.modelContext {
            context.insert(record)
            try? context.save()
        }
        return record
    }

    /// Muse picks and tests the change for a swing film. Needs Muse online; there is no offline director.
    func swingFilm(_ session: SessionRecord, stroke: ShotType) async -> Result<SwingFilm, Error> {
        guard !isWorking else { return .failure(MuseError.invalidResponse) }
        guard museEnabled, museAvailable, let transport = await transportProvider() else { return .failure(MuseError.signInRequired) }
        isWorking = true
        defer { isWorking = false }
        let app = self.app
        // Read-only here: the director doesn't offer remember_note.
        let memory = memoryEnabled ? app.flatMap { app in
            app.modelContext.map { CoachMemory.store($0, playerID: app.activePlayerID, sessionID: session.id) }
        } : nil
        let tools = CoachTools(current: session, app: app, memory: memory) {
            guard let context = app?.modelContext else { return [session] }
            return try context.fetch(FetchDescriptor<SessionRecord>(sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\.startDate)]))
        }
        do {
            let film = try await SwingFilmDirector(client: transport, tools: tools).direct(stroke)
            lastEngineName = "Muse Spark · online"
            lastFilm = film
            return .success(film)
        } catch {
            return .failure(error)
        }
    }

    private func run(session: SessionRecord, _ body: (CoachEngine) async throws -> String) async -> String {
        guard !isWorking else { return "Muse is already answering. Please try again shortly." }
        isWorking = true
        lastFallbackReason = nil
        lastRemembered = []
        defer { isWorking = false }
        if museEnabled, museAvailable, let transport = await transportProvider() {
            let app = self.app
            let memory = memoryEnabled ? app.flatMap { app in
                app.modelContext.map { context in
                    let store = CoachMemory.store(context, playerID: app.activePlayerID, sessionID: session.id)
                    return CoachMemory(notes: store.notes) { [weak self] text, category in
                        let note = try store.save(text, category)
                        self?.lastRemembered.append(text)
                        return note
                    }
                }
            } : nil
            let tools = CoachTools(current: session, app: app, memory: memory) {
                guard let context = app?.modelContext else { return [session] }
                return try context.fetch(FetchDescriptor<SessionRecord>(sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\.startDate)]))
            }
            let muse = MuseCoach(client: transport, tools: tools)
            do {
                let text = try await body(muse)
                lastEngineName = muse.name
                return text
            } catch {
                if Task.isCancelled { return "Cancelled." }
                lastFallbackReason = error.localizedDescription
            }
        }
        lastEngineName = fallback.name
        return (try? await body(fallback)) ?? "No answer is available right now."
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import Foundation
import RacketKit
import SwiftData

/// What the racket can tell the coach right now: connection, hardware status and the last few seconds of live
/// readings. A snapshot, so tests can supply one without a racket.
struct RacketReadout {
    var source: String
    var connected: Bool
    var connection: String
    var sessionActive: Bool
    var lastShot: ShotMetrics?
    var status: RacketProtocol.Status?
    var live: [(date: Date, state: LiveState)]
    var impactModel = ImpactModel()

    @MainActor init(_ app: AppModel) {
        source = app.sourceKind.rawValue; connected = app.isConnected; connection = app.connectionLabel
        sessionActive = app.isSessionActive; lastShot = app.lastShot; status = app.racketStatus
        live = app.liveHistory; impactModel = app.impactModel
    }

    init(source: String, connected: Bool, connection: String, sessionActive: Bool = false, lastShot: ShotMetrics? = nil,
         status: RacketProtocol.Status? = nil, live: [(date: Date, state: LiveState)] = []) {
        self.source = source; self.connected = connected; self.connection = connection
        self.sessionActive = sessionActive; self.lastShot = lastShot; self.status = status; self.live = live
    }
}

/// The racket, its shot history and the player's notes, as tools Muse can call. All data access stays on the
/// main actor. Every tool reads, except `remember_note`, which adds at most a couple of notes per answer.
@MainActor
final class CoachTools {
    private let sessions: () throws -> [SessionRecord]
    private let readout: () -> RacketReadout?
    private let memory: CoachMemory?
    private let current: SessionRecord
    private var notesSaved = 0

    init(current: SessionRecord, app: AppModel?, units: UnitSystem = .current, memory: CoachMemory? = nil,
````````
