````````swift
        contactXcm = deltas.contactXcm
        contactYcm = deltas.contactYcm
        predictedBallBefore = predicted.ballBefore
        predictedBallAfter = predicted.ballAfter
        predictedSpinBefore = predicted.spinBefore
        predictedSpinAfter = predicted.spinAfter
        measuredBallBefore = measuredBefore.ball
        measuredSpinBefore = measuredBefore.spin
    }

    var deltas: WhatIf.Deltas {
        WhatIf.Deltas(swingPercent: swingPercent, faceDeg: faceDeg, pathDeg: pathDeg,
                      contactXcm: contactXcm, contactYcm: contactYcm)
    }

    var isComplete: Bool { completedAt != nil }

    /// Record the follow-up once the player has played again.
    func complete(followUpSessionID: UUID, measuredBall: Double, measuredSpin: Double, at date: Date = Date()) {
        self.followUpSessionID = followUpSessionID
        measuredBallAfter = measuredBall
        measuredSpinAfter = measuredSpin
        completedAt = date
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import AVFoundation
import Foundation

/// Reads the score out after each point, so it can be kept by tapping the handle with the phone in a bag.
/// Other audio is ducked while it speaks. iOS keeps speaking in the background via the `audio` background mode.
final class ScoreAnnouncer: NSObject, AVSpeechSynthesizerDelegate {
    static let enabledKey = "announceScore"
    private let synth = AVSpeechSynthesizer()

    var isEnabled: Bool { UserDefaults.standard.object(forKey: Self.enabledKey) as? Bool ?? true }

    override init() {
        super.init()
        synth.delegate = self
    }

    func say(_ text: String) {
        guard isEnabled else { return }
        #if os(iOS)
        let audio = AVAudioSession.sharedInstance()
        try? audio.setCategory(.playback, mode: .spokenAudio, options: [.duckOthers])
        try? audio.setActive(true)
        #endif
        synth.stopSpeaking(at: .immediate)   // a quick correction replaces the stale call
        synth.speak(AVSpeechUtterance(string: text))
    }

    func speechSynthesizer(_ synthesizer: AVSpeechSynthesizer, didFinish utterance: AVSpeechUtterance) {
        #if os(iOS)
        guard !synthesizer.isSpeaking else { return }
        try? AVAudioSession.sharedInstance().setActive(false, options: .notifyOthersOnDeactivation)
        #endif
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import Foundation
import SwiftData
#if os(macOS)
import Security
#endif

/// SwiftData store synced through the user's private iCloud database, so sessions recorded on the
/// iPhone show up on the Mac (and the other way round). Falls back to a local-only store when iCloud
/// isn't available (signed out, unsigned dev build), so the app always launches.
enum SyncedStore {
    static let containerID = "iCloud.com.quentinlynch.tennisbuddy"
    private(set) static var isSyncing = false

    static func makeContainer() -> ModelContainer {
        let schema = Schema([SessionRecord.self, ShotRecord.self, CoachNote.self, WhatIfTrial.self, CoachReview.self])
        if canUseCloudKit, FileManager.default.ubiquityIdentityToken != nil,
           let container = try? ModelContainer(
               for: schema,
               configurations: ModelConfiguration(schema: schema, cloudKitDatabase: .private(containerID))) {
            isSyncing = true
            return container
        }
        isSyncing = false
        return try! ModelContainer(for: schema, configurations: ModelConfiguration(schema: schema, cloudKitDatabase: .none))
    }

    /// CloudKit can trap asynchronously in an unsigned Mac build, beyond Swift's error handling.
    private static var canUseCloudKit: Bool {
        #if os(macOS)
        guard let task = SecTaskCreateFromSelf(nil),
              let containers = SecTaskCopyValueForEntitlement(task,
                  "com.apple.developer.icloud-container-identifiers" as CFString, nil) as? [String],
              let services = SecTaskCopyValueForEntitlement(task,
                  "com.apple.developer.icloud-services" as CFString, nil) as? [String] else { return false }
        return containers.contains(containerID) && services.contains("CloudKit")
        #else
        return true
        #endif
    }

    static var statusText: String {
        if isSyncing { return "On: sessions sync between your iPhone and Mac" }
        if FileManager.default.ubiquityIdentityToken == nil { return "Off: sign in to iCloud to sync" }
        return "Off: iCloud isn't available for this build"
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import AuthenticationServices
import Foundation
import Observation
import Supabase
import SwiftData
import RacketKit

@MainActor
@Observable
final class AccountModel {
    private(set) var userID: UUID?
    private(set) var dashboard: SocialDashboard?
    private(set) var sharedMatch: SharedMatchState? {
        didSet { onSharedMatchChange?(sharedMatch, userID) }
    }
    @ObservationIgnored var onSharedMatchChange: ((SharedMatchState?, UUID?) -> Void)?
    var isBusy = false
    var errorMessage: String?
    private(set) var lastSync: Date?
    @ObservationIgnored let client: SupabaseClient?
    @ObservationIgnored private var museConfig: (url: URL, key: String)?
    private var refreshInProgress = false
    private var statsSyncInProgress = false
    private var generation = 0
    @ObservationIgnored private var appleChallenge: AppleSignInChallenge?

    init() {
        if let url = Bundle.main.url(forResource: "BackendConfig", withExtension: "plist"),
           let data = try? Data(contentsOf: url),
           let config = try? PropertyListDecoder().decode(Configuration.self, from: data),
           let endpoint = URL(string: config.url), endpoint.scheme == "https", endpoint.host != nil,
           !config.publishableKey.isEmpty, !config.publishableKey.hasPrefix("sb_secret_") {
            client = SupabaseClient(supabaseURL: endpoint, supabaseKey: config.publishableKey)
            museConfig = (endpoint.appendingPathComponent("functions/v1/muse"), config.publishableKey)
        } else { client = nil }
    }

    private struct Configuration: Decodable { let url: String; let publishableKey: String }
    var isConfigured: Bool { client != nil }
    var isSignedIn: Bool { userID != nil }

    /// Transport for the online coach, authenticated as the signed-in user. nil when signed out.
    func museTransport() async -> MuseTransport? {
        guard let client, let museConfig, isSignedIn,
              let token = try? await client.auth.session.accessToken else { return nil }
        return MuseClient(endpoint: museConfig.url, publishableKey: museConfig.key, accessToken: token)
    }
    var displayName: String? { dashboard?.profile.name }

    func observeAuthentication() async {
        guard let client else { return }
        for await (_, session) in client.auth.authStateChanges {
            if Task.isCancelled { return }
            let id = session?.user.id
            if id != userID {
                generation += 1
                dashboard = nil; sharedMatch = nil; lastSync = nil
                userID = id
            }
            if id != nil { await refresh() }
        }
    }

    func signInWithGoogle() async {
        await perform {
            guard let client = self.client else { return }
            _ = try await client.auth.signInWithOAuth(provider: .google,
                redirectTo: URL(string: "tennisbuddee://auth/callback")!)
        }
    }

    func prepareAppleSignIn(_ request: ASAuthorizationAppleIDRequest) {
        appleChallenge = nil
        errorMessage = nil
        do {
            let challenge = try AppleSignInChallenge()
            appleChallenge = challenge
            request.requestedScopes = [.email, .fullName]
            request.nonce = challenge.hashedNonce
            request.state = challenge.state
        } catch { errorMessage = error.localizedDescription }
    }

    func completeAppleSignIn(_ result: Result<ASAuthorization, Error>) async {
        let challenge = appleChallenge
        appleChallenge = nil // Never reuse a completed or cancelled challenge.
        if case .failure(let error) = result,
           (error as? ASAuthorizationError)?.code == .canceled {
            errorMessage = nil
            return
        }
        await perform {
            guard let client = self.client else { throw SocialError.signInRequired }
            let authorization = try result.get()
            guard let challenge else { throw AppleSignInError.invalidState }
            guard let credential = authorization.credential as? ASAuthorizationAppleIDCredential,
                  let data = credential.identityToken,
                  let token = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8), !token.isEmpty else {
                throw AppleSignInError.missingToken
            }
            try challenge.validate(returnedState: credential.state)
            _ = try await client.auth.signInWithIdToken(credentials: .init(
                provider: .apple, idToken: token, nonce: challenge.nonce))
            // Apple gives the name only on the first consent. Preserve a later custom name.
            if let name = credential.fullName?.formatted().trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines),
               !name.isEmpty {
                do {
                    _ = try await client.auth.update(user: UserAttributes(data: ["full_name": .string(name)]))
                    let dashboard: SocialDashboard = try await client.rpc("social_dashboard").execute().value
                    if dashboard.profile.name == "Tennis player" {
                        let _: Bool = try await client.rpc("set_player_name",
                            params: ["p_name": String(name.prefix(60))]).execute().value
                    }
                } catch {
                    self.errorMessage = "Signed in with Apple. You can set your player name in Account."
                }
            }
            await self.refresh()
        }
    }

    func signOut() async {
        await perform {
            try await self.client?.auth.signOut(scope: .local)
            self.generation += 1
            self.userID = nil; self.dashboard = nil; self.sharedMatch = nil; self.lastSync = nil
        }
    }

    func refresh() async {
        guard isSignedIn, !refreshInProgress else { return }
        refreshInProgress = true
        let expected = generation
        defer { refreshInProgress = false }
        do {
            let result: SocialDashboard = try await rpc("social_dashboard")
            guard expected == generation else { return }
            dashboard = result
            if let id = sharedMatch?.id {
                let state: SharedMatchState = try await rpc("shared_match_state", ["p_match": .string(id.uuidString)])
                guard expected == generation, sharedMatch?.id == id else { return }
                sharedMatch = state
            }
            lastSync = Date()
        } catch { if expected == generation { errorMessage = error.localizedDescription } }
    }

    func saveName(_ raw: String) async {
        let name = String(raw.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).prefix(60))
        guard !name.isEmpty else { return }
        await action("set_player_name", ["p_name": .string(name)])
    }

    func requestFriend(code: String) async {
        await action("request_friend", ["p_code": .string(code.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).uppercased())])
    }
    func respond(to id: UUID, accept: Bool) async {
        await action("respond_friend", ["p_player": .string(id.uuidString), "p_accept": .bool(accept)])
    }
    func removeFriend(_ id: UUID) async {
        await action("remove_friend", ["p_player": .string(id.uuidString)])
    }

    func createMatch(title: String, friend: UUID? = nil) async {
        await perform {
            let state: SharedMatchState = try await self.rpc("create_shared_match", [
                "p_title": .string(title.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)),
                "p_friend": friend.map { .string($0.uuidString) } ?? .null])
            self.sharedMatch = state
            await self.refresh()
        }
    }
    func join(code: String) async {
        await perform {
            self.sharedMatch = try await self.rpc("join_shared_match", [
                "p_code": .string(code.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).uppercased())])
            await self.refresh()
        }
    }
    func acceptInvitation(_ id: UUID) async {
        await perform {
            self.sharedMatch = try await self.rpc("accept_match_invitation", ["p_match": .string(id.uuidString)])
            await self.refresh()
        }
    }
    func declineInvitation(_ id: UUID) async {
        await action("decline_match_invitation", ["p_match": .string(id.uuidString)])
    }
    func openMatch(_ id: UUID) async {
        await perform { self.sharedMatch = try await self.rpc("shared_match_state", ["p_match": .string(id.uuidString)]) }
    }
    func closeMatch() { sharedMatch = nil }

    func award(won: Bool, operation: UUID = UUID()) async {
        guard let state = sharedMatch, let me = userID, let guest = state.guest,
              !state.ended, state.tracker(for: me).score.winner == nil else { return }
        let other = state.host.id == me ? guest.id : state.host.id
        await action("add_shared_point", ["p_match": .string(state.id.uuidString),
            "p_winner": .string((won ? me : other).uuidString), "p_operation": .string(operation.uuidString),
            "p_expected_revision": .integer(state.revision)])
    }
    func undo() async {
        guard let state = sharedMatch, let last = state.points.last else { return }
        await action("undo_shared_point", ["p_match": .string(state.id.uuidString), "p_point": .string(last.id.uuidString)])
    }
    func endMatch() async {
        guard let state = sharedMatch else { return }
        await action("end_shared_match", ["p_match": .string(state.id.uuidString)])
    }

    /// Upload only the local player's racket summary, never Health data or private session notes.
    func shareStats(_ stats: SharedPlayerStats, matchID: UUID) async throws {
        let _: Bool = try await rpc("share_racket_stats", ["p_match": .string(matchID.uuidString),
            "p_shots": .integer(stats.shots), "p_sweet": .double(stats.sweetPercent),
            "p_average": stats.averageBallKmh.map(AnyJSON.double) ?? .null,
            "p_top": stats.topBallKmh.map(AnyJSON.double) ?? .null])
    }

    func syncPendingStats(in context: ModelContext) async {
        guard let me = userID else { return }
        guard !statsSyncInProgress else { return }
        statsSyncInProgress = true
        defer { statsSyncInProgress = false }
        let records = (try? context.fetch(FetchDescriptor<SessionRecord>())) ?? []
        let mine = records.filter { $0.sharedPlayerID == me.uuidString }
        let pendingIDs = Set(mine.filter(\.sharedStatsPending).map(\.sharedMatchID))
        for id in pendingIDs {
            guard let matchID = UUID(uuidString: id), userID == me else { continue }
            let sessions = mine.filter { $0.sharedMatchID == id }
            let counts = sessions.map { $0.shotRecords?.count ?? 0 }
            let shots = sessions.flatMap { $0.shotRecords ?? [] }.filter { $0.dataSourceRaw == "racket" }
                .compactMap(\.metrics).filter { $0.type != .calibration }
            let all = ShotSummary(shots)
            let motion = ShotSummary(shots.filter { $0.type != .hit && !$0.gyroSaturated })
            do {
                try await shareStats(SharedPlayerStats(id: me, shots: all.count, sweetPercent: all.sweetSpotPercent,
                    averageBallKmh: motion.count > 0 ? motion.avgBallKmh : nil,
                    topBallKmh: motion.count > 0 ? motion.maxBallKmh : nil), matchID: matchID)
                for (index, session) in sessions.enumerated() where userID == me && counts[index] == session.shotRecords?.count {
                    session.sharedStatsPending = false
                }
                try context.save()
            } catch {
                // Keep the durable pending flag so a later foreground sync retries this summary.
                errorMessage = "Racket stats are waiting to sync. " + error.localizedDescription
                return
            }
        }
    }

    private func rpc<T: Decodable>(_ function: String, _ params: [String: AnyJSON] = [:]) async throws -> T {
        guard let client, isSignedIn else { throw SocialError.signInRequired }
        return try await client.rpc(function, params: params).execute().value
    }
    private func action(_ function: String, _ params: [String: AnyJSON]) async {
        await perform {
            let _: Bool = try await self.rpc(function, params)
            await self.refresh()
        }
    }
    private func perform(_ body: () async throws -> Void) async {
        guard !isBusy else { errorMessage = "A change is already syncing. Please try again."; return }
        isBusy = true; errorMessage = nil
        defer { isBusy = false }
        do { try await body() } catch { errorMessage = error.localizedDescription }
    }
}

private enum SocialError: LocalizedError {
    case signInRequired
    var errorDescription: String? { "Sign in to use friends and shared sessions." }
}
````````

````````swift
import AuthenticationServices

struct AccountView: View {

                    Button("Sign out", role: .destructive) { signingOut = true }
                } footer: {

                }
            } else {
                Section {
                    Text("Play together").font(.title2.bold())
                    Text("Sign in to save your player profile, add friends, and share match scores.")
                    SignInWithAppleButton(.signIn) { request in
                        account.prepareAppleSignIn(request)
                    } onCompletion: { result in
                        Task { await account.completeAppleSignIn(result) }
                    }
                    .signInWithAppleButtonStyle(colorScheme == .dark ? .white : .black)
                    .frame(height: 44)
                    .frame(maxWidth: 360)
                    Button("Sign in with Google") { Task { await account.signInWithGoogle() } }
                        .buttonStyle(.bordered)
                }
                .disabled(!account.isConfigured)
                if !account.isConfigured {
                    Section { Text("Online accounts are not available in this build yet. You can still record sessions and customise your racket.") }
                }
            }
            if account.isBusy { ProgressView() }
            if let error = account.errorMessage { Text(error).foregroundStyle(.red).font(.callout) }
        }
        .formStyle(.grouped)
        .navigationTitle("Account")
        .disabled(account.isBusy)
        .task { await account.refresh(); name = account.displayName ?? "" }
        .task(id: name) {
            // Debounced autosave: wait for a pause in typing, skip unchanged or empty names.
            let trimmed = name.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
            guard !trimmed.isEmpty, trimmed != account.displayName else { return }
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1))
            guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
            saveName()
        }
        .onChange(of: account.displayName) { _, value in name = value ?? "" }
        .confirmationDialog("Sign out of Tennis Buddee?", isPresented: $signingOut) {
            Button("Sign out", role: .destructive) { Task { await account.signOut() } }
        }
    }

    private func saveName() {

    }
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "apple/Shared/Social/AppleSignInChallenge.swift", "sha256": "afc4268fe21310b853577f6f8a19188e870574e373f1369d900297ad147e4763", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````swift
import CryptoKit
import Foundation
import Security

/// Bind the returned Apple credential to one request. Only the hash goes to Apple;
/// Supabase receives the original nonce and verifies it against the signed identity token.
struct AppleSignInChallenge {
    let nonce: String
    let state: String

    init() throws {
        nonce = try Self.randomHex()
        state = try Self.randomHex()
    }

    var hashedNonce: String { Self.hash(nonce) }

    func validate(returnedState: String?) throws {
        guard returnedState == state else { throw AppleSignInError.invalidState }
    }

    static func hash(_ value: String) -> String {
        SHA256.hash(data: Data(value.utf8)).map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
    }

    private static func randomHex() throws -> String {
        var bytes = [UInt8](repeating: 0, count: 32)
        guard SecRandomCopyBytes(kSecRandomDefault, bytes.count, &bytes) == errSecSuccess else {
            throw AppleSignInError.randomUnavailable
        }
        return bytes.map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
    }
}

enum AppleSignInError: LocalizedError {
    case invalidState, missingToken, randomUnavailable
    var errorDescription: String? {
        switch self {
        case .invalidState: "The Apple sign-in request expired. Please try again."
        case .missingToken: "Apple did not return a usable sign-in token. Please try again."
        case .randomUnavailable: "A secure sign-in request could not be created. Please try again."
        }
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import RacketKit
import SwiftUI

struct SharedSessionView: View {
    @Environment(AccountModel.self) private var account
    @Environment(AppModel.self) private var app
    @Environment(\.scenePhase) private var scenePhase
    @State private var friendCode = ""
    @State private var matchCode = ""
    @State private var title = ""
    @State private var confirmEnd = false

    var body: some View {
        Form {
            if !account.isSignedIn {
                Section {
                    Text("Sign in to invite friends and share a session.")
                    NavigationLink("Sign in") { AccountView() }
                }
            } else if let state = account.sharedMatch, let me = account.userID {
                matchSection(state, me: me)
            } else {
                lobby
            }
            if account.isBusy { ProgressView() }
            if let error = account.errorMessage {
                Section {
                    Text(error).font(.callout).foregroundStyle(.red)
                    Button("Refresh") { Task { await account.refresh() } }
                }
            }
        }
        .formStyle(.grouped)
        .navigationTitle("Play together")
        .task(id: scenePhase) {
            guard scenePhase == .active else { return }
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                await account.refresh()
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                do { try await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(2)) } catch { return }
            }
        }
        .confirmationDialog("End this shared match for both players?", isPresented: $confirmEnd) {
            Button("End shared match", role: .destructive) { Task { await account.endMatch() } }
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var lobby: some View {
        if let dashboard = account.dashboard {
            if !dashboard.invitations.isEmpty {
                Section("Session invitations") {
                    ForEach(dashboard.invitations) { invite in
                        VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                            Text(invite.title).font(.headline)
                            Text("From \(invite.hostName)").foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                            HStack {
                                Button("Join") { Task { await account.acceptInvitation(invite.id) } }
                                Button("Decline", role: .destructive) { Task { await account.declineInvitation(invite.id) } }
                            }
                            .buttonStyle(.bordered)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if !dashboard.matches.isEmpty {
                Section("Your shared matches") {
                    ForEach(dashboard.matches) { match in
                        Button(match.title) { Task { await account.openMatch(match.id) } }
                    }
                }
            }
            Section {
                TextField("Session name (optional)", text: $title)
                if dashboard.friends.isEmpty {
                    Text("Add a friend below to invite them directly.").foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
                ForEach(dashboard.friends) { friend in
                    HStack {
                        Text(friend.name)
                        Spacer()
                        Button("Invite") { Task { await account.createMatch(title: title, friend: friend.id) } }
                            .buttonStyle(.bordered)
                        Menu {
                            Button("Remove friend", role: .destructive) { Task { await account.removeFriend(friend.id) } }
                        } label: { Image(systemName: "ellipsis") }
                    }
                }
                Button("Create session with a code") { Task { await account.createMatch(title: title) } }

                            Spacer()
                            if request.incoming {
                                Button("Accept") { Task { await account.respond(to: request.id, accept: true) } }
                                    .buttonStyle(.bordered)
                                Button("Decline", role: .destructive) { Task { await account.respond(to: request.id, accept: false) } }
                                    .buttonStyle(.bordered)
                            } else { Text("Pending").foregroundStyle(.secondary) }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Section {
                LabeledContent("Your friend code", value: dashboard.profile.friendCode).textSelection(.enabled)
                ShareLink("Share friend code", item: "Add me on Tennis Buddee: \(dashboard.profile.friendCode)")
                TextField("Their friend code", text: $friendCode).autocorrectionDisabled()
                Button("Send friend request") { Task { await account.requestFriend(code: friendCode) } }
                    .disabled(friendCode.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty)
            } header: { Text("Add a friend once") } footer: {
                Text("Once they accept, you can invite each other without entering a code again.")
            }
        }
        Section("Join with a session code") {
            TextField("Session code", text: $matchCode).autocorrectionDisabled()
            Button("Join session") { Task { await account.join(code: matchCode) } }
                .disabled(matchCode.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty)
        }
        .disabled(account.isBusy)
    }

    @ViewBuilder private func matchSection(_ state: SharedMatchState, me: UUID) -> some View {
        let tracker = state.tracker(for: me)
        let opponent = state.host.id == me ? state.guest?.name : state.host.name
        Section(state.title) {
            LabeledContent("You", value: account.displayName ?? "You")
            LabeledContent("Opponent", value: opponent ?? "Waiting for a player")
            HStack {
                Text(tracker.score.pointText).font(.largeTitle.bold().monospacedDigit())
                Spacer()
                Text(tracker.setsText).font(.title3.monospacedDigit())
            }
            Text("Best of 3 sets · advantage scoring").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            if state.ended {
                Text("Match ended").font(.headline)
            } else if state.guest == nil {
                LabeledContent("Session code", value: state.inviteCode).textSelection(.enabled)
                ShareLink("Share session code", item: "Join my Tennis Buddee session: \(state.inviteCode)")
                Text("Friend invitations also appear in your friend's Play together screen.").font(.caption)
            } else {
                HStack {
                    Button("I won") { Task { await account.award(won: true) } }
                    Button("They won") { Task { await account.award(won: false) } }
                }
                .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
                .disabled(account.isBusy || tracker.score.winner != nil)
                Button("Undo last point", systemImage: "arrow.uturn.backward") { Task { await account.undo() } }
                    .disabled(account.isBusy || state.points.isEmpty)
                if let winner = tracker.score.winner {
                    Text(winner == .me ? "You won the match" : "Your opponent won the match").font(.headline)
                }
            }
            if let sync = account.lastSync {
                Text("Updated \(sync.formatted(date: .omitted, time: .standard))").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
        }
        Section {
            if app.activeSession?.sharedMatchID == state.id.uuidString {
                Text("Your racket stats are being shared from this session.")
            } else if !state.ended {
                Button("Record my racket stats") { app.startSharedRecording(matchID: state.id, playerID: me) }
                    .disabled(app.isSessionActive || app.sourceKind != .racket)
                Text(app.isSessionActive ? "End your current recording first." : app.sourceKind != .racket
                     ? "Select and connect your smart racket in the Racket tab to share shots."
                     : "Start a recording to share your shots. Scoring works without a racket.")
                    .font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            ForEach([state.host] + (state.guest.map { [$0] } ?? [])) { player in
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                    Text(player.id == me ? "Your racket" : "\(player.name)'s racket").font(.headline)
                    if let stats = state.stats.first(where: { $0.id == player.id }) {
                        Text("\(stats.shots) shots · \(Int(stats.sweetPercent))% sweet spot")
                        if let average = stats.averageBallKmh {
                            Text("Average ball \(UnitSystem.current.speedText(average))")
                        }
                    } else { Text("No racket stats shared").foregroundStyle(.secondary) }
                }
            }
            if let rival = state.host.id == me ? state.guest : state.host {
                let stats = state.stats.first { $0.id == rival.id }
                NavigationLink {
                    ScoutView(opponent: stats, opponentName: rival.name)
                } label: {
                    Label(stats == nil ? "Scout yourself before playing \(rival.name)" : "Scout \(rival.name) with Muse",
                          systemImage: "binoculars")
                }
            }
        } header: { Text("Shared stats") } footer: {
            Text("Only real racket shots are shared. Heart rate, calories, and private session notes stay private.")
        }
        Section {
            Button("Back to friends") { account.closeMatch() }
            if !state.ended { Button("End shared match", role: .destructive) { confirmEnd = true } }
        }
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import Foundation
import RacketKit

struct SocialProfile: Codable, Identifiable {
    var id: UUID
    var name: String
    var friendCode: String
}

struct FriendRequest: Codable, Identifiable {
    var id: UUID { player.id }
    var player: SocialProfile
    var incoming: Bool
}

struct MatchInvitation: Codable, Identifiable {
    var id: UUID
    var title: String
    var hostName: String
}

struct SocialDashboard: Codable {
    var profile: SocialProfile
    var friends: [SocialProfile]
    var requests: [FriendRequest]
    var invitations: [MatchInvitation]
    var matches: [MatchInvitation]
}

struct SharedPoint: Codable, Identifiable {
    var id: UUID
    var winner: UUID
}

struct SharedPlayerStats: Codable, Identifiable {
    var id: UUID
    var shots: Int
    var sweetPercent: Double
    var averageBallKmh: Double?
    var topBallKmh: Double?
}

struct SharedMatchState: Codable, Identifiable {
    var id: UUID
    var title: String
    var host: SocialProfile
    var guest: SocialProfile?
    var inviteCode: String
    var ended: Bool
    var revision: Int
    var points: [SharedPoint]
    var stats: [SharedPlayerStats]

    /// The same ordered log is replayed from either player's perspective.
    func tracker(for player: UUID) -> ScoreTracker {
        var tracker = ScoreTracker()
        for point in points { tracker.award(point.winner == player ? .me : .opponent) }
        return tracker
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import RacketKit
import SwiftUI

/// Guided calibration: two still poses to align axes, then an optional sweet-spot check: ball drops on known
/// squares of a taped 3×3 grid, scored against the racket's on-device verdict and saved as a CSV for data/ and ml/.
struct CalibrationView: View {
    @Environment(AppModel.self) private var model
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss
    @AppStorage(UnitSystem.storageKey) private var useMetric = false
    private var units: UnitSystem { UnitSystem(metric: useMetric) }

    enum Step: Int { case intro, tipUp, faceUp, check, done }
    @State private var step: Step = .intro
    @State private var capturing = false
    @State private var tipUp: Calibration.PoseReading?
    @State private var selectedCell: SweetSpotCheck.Cell?
    @State private var check = SweetSpotCheck()
    @State private var savedCSV: URL?

    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            VStack(spacing: 24) {
                switch step {
                case .intro: intro
                case .tipUp: pose(title: "Tip up", symbol: "arrow.up",
                                  text: "Hold the racket with the tip pointing straight up and keep it still.")
                case .faceUp: pose(title: "Lay it flat", symbol: "rectangle.portrait.on.rectangle.portrait",
                                   text: "Lay the racket flat on a table, strings facing up. Pick the face you'd call \"front\".")
                case .check: checkStep
                case .done: done
                }
            }
            .padding(24)
            .frame(maxWidth: 560)
            .navigationTitle("Calibrate")
            .toolbar {
                ToolbarItem(placement: .cancellationAction) { Button("Close") { finish() } }
            }
        }
        .onAppear { model.calibrating = true }
        .onDisappear { stopListening(); model.calibrating = false }
    }

    private var intro: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 16) {
            Image(systemName: "scope").font(.system(size: 56)).foregroundStyle(Color.accentColor)
            Text("Calibrate your racket").font(.title2.bold())
            Text("Two quick poses teach the app how the sensors sit in the handle. Then, optionally, drop balls on a taped grid to check how often the racket's sweet-spot AI gets it right.")
                .multilineTextAlignment(.center).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            Button("Start") { step = .tipUp }.buttonStyle(.borderedProminent).foregroundStyle(.black)
        }
    }

    private func pose(title: String, symbol: String, text: String) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: 16) {
            Image(systemName: symbol).font(.system(size: 56)).foregroundStyle(Color.accentColor)
            Text(title).font(.title2.bold())
            Text(text).multilineTextAlignment(.center).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            Button {
                capture()
            } label: {
                if capturing { ProgressView() } else { Text("Hold still — capture") }
            }
            .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent).foregroundStyle(.black)
            .disabled(capturing)
        }
    }

    private func capture() {
        capturing = true
        model.engine.captureStill(seconds: 2) { reading in
            capturing = false
            if step == .tipUp {
                tipUp = reading
                step = .faceUp
            } else if let tip = tipUp {
                model.calibration = Calibration.from(tipUp: tip, faceUp: reading)
                model.recenter()
                step = .check
                model.calibrationMode = true
                model.onCalibrationImpact = { shot in
                    guard let cell = selectedCell else { return }
                    check.add(shot: shot, cell: cell)
                }
                model.onCalibrationVerdict = { verdict in
                    guard let cell = selectedCell else { return }
                    check.add(verdict: verdict, cell: cell)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private var checkStep: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 14) {
            Text("Sweet-spot check (optional)").font(.title2.bold())
            Text("Tape a 3×3 grid on the strings (squares about \(units.lengthText(5)) apart across, \(units.lengthText(6)) along). Hold the racket face-up with a relaxed grip, tap a square, then drop a ball on it from about \(useMetric ? "1.5 m" : "5 ft"). The center square is the sweet spot. Five drops per square is plenty.")
                .font(.callout).multilineTextAlignment(.center).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            if model.sourceKind != .racket {
                Label("Connect the racket: verdicts come from its on-device model.", systemImage: "exclamationmark.triangle")
                    .font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.orange)
            }
            VStack(spacing: 8) {
                Text("Tip ↑").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                ForEach([1, 0, -1], id: \.self) { row in
                    HStack(spacing: 8) {
                        ForEach([-1, 0, 1], id: \.self) { col in
                            cellButton(SweetSpotCheck.Cell(col: col, row: row))
                        }
                    }
                }
                Text("Throat ↓").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            Text(scoreText).font(.callout.monospacedDigit()).multilineTextAlignment(.center)
            if let last = check.drops.last { Text(lastDropText(last)).font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary) }
            HStack {
                Button("Undo") { check.undo() }.disabled(check.drops.isEmpty)
                Button("Skip") { stopListening(); step = .done }
                Button("Finish & save") { save() }
                    .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent).foregroundStyle(.black)
                    .disabled(check.drops.isEmpty)
            }
        }
    }

    private func cellButton(_ cell: SweetSpotCheck.Cell) -> some View {
        let drops = check.drops(in: cell)
        let scored = drops.filter { $0.racketSweet != nil }
        let right = scored.filter { $0.racketCorrect == true }.count
        let selected = selectedCell == cell
        return Button {
            selectedCell = cell
        } label: {
            VStack(spacing: 2) {
                Text("\(drops.count)").font(.title3.monospacedDigit().bold())
                Text(scored.isEmpty ? (cell.isSweet ? "sweet" : " ") : "\(right)/\(scored.count) ✓")
                    .font(.caption2.monospacedDigit())
            }
            .frame(width: 70, height: 70)
            .background(selected ? Color.accentColor : Color.secondary.opacity(0.15), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 12))
            .overlay {
                if cell.isSweet { RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12).strokeBorder(.green, lineWidth: 2) }
            }
            .foregroundStyle(selected ? .black : .primary)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }

    private var scoreText: String {
        guard let accuracy = check.accuracy else {
            return check.drops.isEmpty ? "Pick a square, then drop." : "No verdicts from the racket yet."
        }
        let s = check.sweetHits, o = check.offHits
        return "Racket AI right on \(check.correct) of \(check.scored) (\(Int((accuracy * 100).rounded()))%)\n"
            + "Sweet spot \(s.correct)/\(s.of) · off-center \(o.correct)/\(o.of)"
    }

    private func lastDropText(_ d: SweetSpotCheck.Drop) -> String {
        guard let sweet = d.racketSweet else { return "Last: \(d.cell.name) → no verdict from the racket" }
        let said = sweet ? "Sweet spot" : "\(d.offCenterPercent ?? 0)% off"
        return "Last: \(d.cell.name) → racket said \(said) (\(d.confidencePercent ?? 0)% sure)"
    }

    private var done: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 16) {
            Image(systemName: "checkmark.seal.fill").font(.system(size: 56)).foregroundStyle(.green)
            Text("Calibrated").font(.title2.bold())
            Text(check.drops.isEmpty ? "Sensor axes are aligned to the racket." : "Sensor axes are aligned.\n\(scoreText)")
                .multilineTextAlignment(.center).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            if let savedCSV {
                ShareLink(item: savedCSV) { Label("Share drop data (CSV)", systemImage: "square.and.arrow.up") }
                #if os(iOS)
                Text("Also in Files → Tennis Buddee → Calibration. Copy it to data/ to track the model's accuracy.")
                    .font(.caption).multilineTextAlignment(.center).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                #endif
            }
            Button("Done") { finish() }.buttonStyle(.borderedProminent).foregroundStyle(.black)
        }
    }

    /// Saves the drops, one CSV row each, next to the recordings.
    private func save() {
        stopListening()
        let dir = AppModel.recordingsDirectory.deletingLastPathComponent().appendingPathComponent("Calibration")
        try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: dir, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        let file = dir.appendingPathComponent("sweetspot-check-\(Int(Date().timeIntervalSince1970)).csv")
        if (try? check.csv().write(to: file, atomically: true, encoding: .utf8)) != nil { savedCSV = file }
        step = .done
    }

    private func stopListening() {
        model.calibrationMode = false
        model.onCalibrationImpact = nil
        model.onCalibrationVerdict = nil
    }

    private func finish() {
        stopListening()
        dismiss()
    }
}
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "apple/Shared/Views/Components.swift", "sha256": "eb72aa08da7b010a88da49ebcdbea0978612fd933b3414c706864de89e819add", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````swift
import RacketKit
import SwiftUI

/// Top-down drawing of the string bed with impact dots or a heat map.
/// Coordinates: impact x (across, cm) → horizontal, impact y (toward tip, cm) → up.
struct StringBedView: View {
    var shots: [ShotMetrics]
    var heatMap = false
    var highlight: ShotMetrics?

    private let halfWidthCm = 12.4, halfLengthCm = 16.2

    var body: some View {
        Canvas { ctx, size in
            let scale = min(size.width / (2 * halfWidthCm + 3), size.height / (2 * halfLengthCm + 3))
            let center = CGPoint(x: size.width / 2, y: size.height / 2)
            func point(_ x: Double, _ y: Double) -> CGPoint {
                CGPoint(x: center.x + x * scale, y: center.y - y * scale)
            }
            let head = CGRect(x: center.x - halfWidthCm * scale, y: center.y - halfLengthCm * scale,
                              width: 2 * halfWidthCm * scale, height: 2 * halfLengthCm * scale)
            let headPath = Path(ellipseIn: head)
            ctx.fill(headPath, with: .color(.primary.opacity(0.04)))

            // Strings (16 mains × 19 crosses).
            var strings = Path()
            for i in -7...8 {
                let x = center.x + (Double(i) - 0.5) * 1.5 * scale
                strings.move(to: CGPoint(x: x, y: head.minY)); strings.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: x, y: head.maxY))
            }
            for i in -9...9 {
                let y = center.y + Double(i) * 1.6 * scale
                strings.move(to: CGPoint(x: head.minX, y: y)); strings.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: head.maxX, y: y))
            }
            ctx.drawLayer { layer in
                layer.clip(to: headPath)
                layer.stroke(strings, with: .color(.primary.opacity(0.12)), lineWidth: 0.6)
            }
            ctx.stroke(headPath, with: .color(.primary.opacity(0.7)), lineWidth: max(3, scale * 0.9))

            // Sweet spot.
            let r = ShotMetrics.sweetSpotRadiusCm * scale
            let sweet = Path(ellipseIn: CGRect(x: center.x - r, y: center.y - r, width: 2 * r, height: 2 * r))
            ctx.fill(sweet, with: .color(.green.opacity(0.10)))
            ctx.stroke(sweet, with: .color(.green.opacity(0.6)), style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 1.2, dash: [4, 3]))

            if heatMap {
                ctx.drawLayer { layer in
                    layer.clip(to: headPath)
                    layer.addFilter(.blur(radius: scale * 1.6))
                    for s in shots {
                        let p = point(s.impactXcm, s.impactYcm)
                        let rr = 2.2 * scale
                        layer.fill(Path(ellipseIn: CGRect(x: p.x - rr, y: p.y - rr, width: 2 * rr, height: 2 * rr)),
                                   with: .color(.orange.opacity(0.35)))
                    }
                }
            } else {
                for s in shots {
                    let p = point(s.impactXcm, s.impactYcm)
                    let rr = max(3, 0.75 * scale)
                    let isHighlight = s.id == highlight?.id
                    let dot = Path(ellipseIn: CGRect(x: p.x - rr, y: p.y - rr, width: 2 * rr, height: 2 * rr))
                    ctx.fill(dot, with: .color((s.isSweetSpot ? Color.green : Color.red).opacity(isHighlight ? 1 : 0.55)))
                    if isHighlight { ctx.stroke(dot, with: .color(.primary), lineWidth: 2) }
                }
            }
        }
        .aspectRatio(2 * halfWidthCm / (2 * halfLengthCm + 6), contentMode: .fit)
        .accessibilityLabel("String bed with \(shots.count) impacts")
    }
}

/// A labeled number tile.
struct StatTile: View {

    var value: String
    var unit: String = ""

            }
            .font(.caption)
            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)

                if !unit.isEmpty { Text(unit).font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary) }
            }

    }

/// The card shown after every shot. The edge flashes green (sweet spot) or red (mishit),
/// a nod to the original project's green/red shot LEDs.
struct ShotCardView: View {
    var shot: ShotMetrics
    var flashID: UUID
    @State private var glow = 0.0
    @AppStorage(UnitSystem.storageKey) private var useMetric = false
    private var units: UnitSystem { UnitSystem(metric: useMetric) }

    var body: some View {
        let tint: Color = shot.isSweetSpot ? .green : .red
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
            HStack {
                Label(shot.type.label, systemImage: shot.type.symbol).font(.headline)
                Spacer()
                Text(shot.isSweetSpot ? "Sweet spot" : "Off center")
                    .font(.caption.weight(.semibold))
                    .padding(.horizontal, 8).padding(.vertical, 4)
                    .background(tint.opacity(0.18), in: .capsule)
                    .foregroundStyle(tint)
            }
            if !shot.hasMotion {
                HStack(alignment: .center, spacing: 16) {
                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                        Text(shot.isSweetSpot ? "Sweet spot" : "Off center")
                            .font(.system(size: 34, weight: .bold, design: .rounded))
                        Text(shot.isSweetSpot ? "Clean contact" : "About \(units.lengthText(shot.impactDistanceCm)) from the sweet spot")
                            .font(.subheadline)
                        Label("Heard by the racket's mic · motion sensors offline", systemImage: "waveform.badge.mic")
                            .font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    }
                    Spacer(minLength: 0)
                    StringBedView(shots: [shot], highlight: shot).frame(width: 90)
                }
            } else {
            HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 16) {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
                        Text(units.speedValue(shot.ballSpeedKmh))
                            .font(.system(size: 48, weight: .bold, design: .rounded)).monospacedDigit()
                        Text("\(units.speedUnit) ball speed (est.)").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    }
                    Grid(alignment: .leading, horizontalSpacing: 14, verticalSpacing: 6) {
                        GridRow {
                            metric("Swing", units.speedText(shot.swingSpeedKmh))
                            metric("Spin", "\(Int(shot.spinRPM.rounded())) rpm \(shot.spin.label.lowercased())")
                        }
                        GridRow {
                            metric("Face", angle(shot.faceAngleDeg, pos: "open", neg: "closed"))
                            metric("Path", angle(shot.swingPathDeg, pos: "up", neg: "down"))
                        }
                    }
                }
                Spacer(minLength: 0)
                StringBedView(shots: [shot], highlight: shot).frame(width: 90)
            }
            }
            if shot.gyroSaturated {
                Label("Gyro maxed out: speed is a lower bound", systemImage: "exclamationmark.triangle")
                    .font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.orange)
            }
        }
        .padding(16)
        .background(.background.secondary, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 18))
        .overlay {
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 18).strokeBorder(tint.opacity(0.25 + glow * 0.75), lineWidth: 2 + glow * 4)
        }
        .shadow(color: tint.opacity(glow * 0.6), radius: 18 * glow)
        .onChange(of: flashID, initial: true) { _, _ in
            glow = 1
            withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 1.2)) { glow = 0 }
        }
    }

    private func metric(_ label: String, _ value: String) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 1) {
            Text(label).font(.caption2).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            Text(value).font(.subheadline.weight(.medium)).monospacedDigit()
        }
    }

    private func angle(_ deg: Double, pos: String, neg: String) -> String {
        let d = Int(deg.rounded())
        return d == 0 ? "0°" : "\(abs(d))° \(d > 0 ? pos : neg)"
    }
}

extension TimeInterval {
    var clock: String {
        let s = Int(self)
        return s >= 3600 ? String(format: "%d:%02d:%02d", s / 3600, s / 60 % 60, s % 60)
            : String(format: "%d:%02d", s / 60, s % 60)
    }
}


/// The racket's own verdict from its on-device sweet-spot model (heard from the impact sound).
struct VerdictBadge: View {
    var verdict: RacketProtocol.ShotVerdict

    var body: some View {
        let tint: Color = verdict.isSweet ? .green : .red
        HStack(spacing: 10) {
            Image(systemName: "waveform.badge.mic").foregroundStyle(tint)
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                Text(verdict.isSweet ? "Sweet spot" : "About \(verdict.offCenterPercent)% off the sweet spot")
                    .font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
                Text("On-racket AI · \(verdict.confidencePercent)% sure")
                    .font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            Spacer()
        }
        .padding(12)
        .background(tint.opacity(0.12), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 14))
        .id(date)
        .transition(.opacity)
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import RacketKit
import SwiftUI
import UniformTypeIdentifiers

/// Installs racket firmware over Bluetooth: the build bundled with the app, or a .bin picked from Files.
struct FirmwareUpdateSection: View {
    @Environment(AppModel.self) private var model
    let installed: String
    @State private var pickingFile = false
    @State private var pending: FirmwareImage?
    @State private var fileError: String?

    var body: some View {
        Section {
            status
            if !model.firmwareUpdate.isInProgress {
                if !model.racketSupportsFirmwareUpdate {
                    Text("This racket's firmware predates wireless updates. Flash it once over USB (firmware/README.md); after that, updates install from here.")
                        .font(.footnote).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                } else {
                    if let image = model.bundledFirmware, image.isNewer(than: installed), let version = image.version {
                        Button("Update to \(version)", systemImage: "arrow.down.circle") { pending = image }
                    } else if model.firmwareUpdate == .idle {
                        if MotionFirmware.hasKnownGyroScaleBug(installed) {
                            Text("This version has a sensor-scaling fault. Install an app build with corrected racket firmware, or select a corrected firmware file.")
                                .font(.footnote).foregroundStyle(.orange)
                        } else {
                            Text("Firmware \(installed) matches the version bundled with this app").foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                        }
                    }
                    Button("Install from file…", systemImage: "doc") { pickingFile = true }
                }
            }
        } header: {
            Text("Firmware update")
        } footer: {
            Text("Keep the racket close and charged, and this screen open; it takes about a minute. If the new firmware doesn't start, the racket goes back to the old one.")
        }
        .fileImporter(isPresented: $pickingFile, allowedContentTypes: [.data]) { result in
            fileError = nil
            guard case .success(let url) = result else { return }
            let scoped = url.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource()
            defer { if scoped { url.stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource() } }
            guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: url) else { fileError = "Couldn't read that file"; return }
            let image = FirmwareImage(data: data, version: nil)
            if image.looksValid { pending = image } else { fileError = "That isn't an ESP32 firmware image (.bin)" }
        }
        .confirmationDialog("Install firmware?", isPresented: Binding(get: { pending != nil }, set: { if !$0 { pending = nil } }),
                            titleVisibility: .visible, presenting: pending) { image in
            Button("Install") { model.ble.updateFirmware(image) }
        } message: { image in
            Text("Installs \(image.version.map { "firmware \($0)" } ?? "the selected file") (\(image.data.count / 1024) KB). The racket restarts when it's done.")
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var status: some View {
        if let fileError {
            Label(fileError, systemImage: "exclamationmark.triangle.fill").foregroundStyle(.red)
        }
        switch model.firmwareUpdate {
        case .idle:
            EmptyView()
        case .sending(let fraction):
            ProgressView(value: fraction) {
                Text("Sending firmware…")
            } currentValueLabel: {
                Text("\(Int(fraction * 100))%")
            }
            Button("Cancel", role: .destructive) { model.ble.cancelFirmwareUpdate() }
        case .verifying:
            ProgressView("Racket is checking the new firmware…")
        case .restarting:
            ProgressView("Racket is restarting…")
        case .finished:
            Label("Updated to \(installed)", systemImage: "checkmark.circle.fill").foregroundStyle(.green)
        case .failed(let message):
            Label(message, systemImage: "exclamationmark.triangle.fill").foregroundStyle(.red)
        }
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import Foundation
import SceneKit

/// Minimal glTF 2.0 binary (.glb) loader for SceneKit: triangle meshes with positions, normals, UVs and
/// PBR materials (base color, normal and metallic-roughness textures). Enough for the racket model;
/// not a general-purpose importer (no skins, animations or node hierarchies beyond one level).
enum GLBLoader {
    struct LoadError: Error {}

    static func load(url: URL) throws -> SCNNode {
        let data = try Data(contentsOf: url)
        guard data.count > 20,
              data.prefix(4) == Data("glTF".utf8) else { throw LoadError() }
        let jsonLength = Int(data.u32(at: 12))
        let json = try JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data.subdata(in: 20..<(20 + jsonLength))) as? [String: Any] ?? [:]
        let binStart = 20 + jsonLength + 8
        let bin = data.subdata(in: binStart..<data.count)

        let accessors = json["accessors"] as? [[String: Any]] ?? []
        let bufferViews = json["bufferViews"] as? [[String: Any]] ?? []
        let images = json["images"] as? [[String: Any]] ?? []
        let textures = json["textures"] as? [[String: Any]] ?? []
        let materials = json["materials"] as? [[String: Any]] ?? []

        func viewData(_ index: Int) -> Data {
            let v = bufferViews[index]
            let offset = v["byteOffset"] as? Int ?? 0
            return bin.subdata(in: offset..<(offset + (v["byteLength"] as? Int ?? 0)))
        }

        func floats(_ accessorIndex: Int, components: Int) -> [Float] {
            let a = accessors[accessorIndex]
            let view = bufferViews[a["bufferView"] as? Int ?? 0]
            let base = (view["byteOffset"] as? Int ?? 0) + (a["byteOffset"] as? Int ?? 0)
            let stride = view["byteStride"] as? Int ?? components * 4
            let count = a["count"] as? Int ?? 0
            var out = [Float](repeating: 0, count: count * components)
            bin.withUnsafeBytes { raw in
                for i in 0..<count {
                    for c in 0..<components {
                        out[i * components + c] = raw.loadUnaligned(fromByteOffset: base + i * stride + c * 4, as: Float.self)
                    }
                }
            }
            return out
        }

        func indices(_ accessorIndex: Int) -> [UInt32] {
            let a = accessors[accessorIndex]
            let view = bufferViews[a["bufferView"] as? Int ?? 0]
            let base = (view["byteOffset"] as? Int ?? 0) + (a["byteOffset"] as? Int ?? 0)
            let count = a["count"] as? Int ?? 0
            let type = a["componentType"] as? Int ?? 5123
            return bin.withUnsafeBytes { raw in
                (0..<count).map { i in
                    switch type {
                    case 5121: return UInt32(raw.load(fromByteOffset: base + i, as: UInt8.self))
                    case 5125: return raw.loadUnaligned(fromByteOffset: base + i * 4, as: UInt32.self)
                    default: return UInt32(raw.loadUnaligned(fromByteOffset: base + i * 2, as: UInt16.self))
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        var imageCache: [Int: Any] = [:]
        func image(forTexture textureIndex: Int) -> Any? {
            guard textureIndex < textures.count, let source = textures[textureIndex]["source"] as? Int else { return nil }
            if let cached = imageCache[source] { return cached }
            guard source < images.count, let view = images[source]["bufferView"] as? Int else { return nil }
            let bytes = viewData(view)
            #if os(macOS)
            let img: Any? = NSImage(data: bytes)
            #else
            let img: Any? = UIImage(data: bytes)
            #endif
            imageCache[source] = img
            return img
        }

        func material(_ index: Int?) -> SCNMaterial {
            let m = SCNMaterial()
            m.lightingModel = .physicallyBased
            guard let index, index < materials.count else { return m }
            let spec = materials[index]
            m.name = spec["name"] as? String
            m.isDoubleSided = spec["doubleSided"] as? Bool ?? false
            let pbr = spec["pbrMetallicRoughness"] as? [String: Any] ?? [:]
            if let tex = (pbr["baseColorTexture"] as? [String: Any])?["index"] as? Int, let img = image(forTexture: tex) {
                m.diffuse.contents = img
            } else if let c = pbr["baseColorFactor"] as? [Double], c.count >= 3 {
                m.diffuse.contents = CGColor(srgbRed: c[0], green: c[1], blue: c[2], alpha: c.count > 3 ? c[3] : 1)
            }
            m.metalness.contents = (pbr["metallicFactor"] as? Double) ?? 1.0
            m.roughness.contents = (pbr["roughnessFactor"] as? Double) ?? 1.0
            if let tex = (pbr["metallicRoughnessTexture"] as? [String: Any])?["index"] as? Int, let img = image(forTexture: tex) {
                m.roughness.contents = img
                m.roughness.textureComponents = .green   // glTF packs roughness in G, metalness in B
            }
            if let tex = (spec["normalTexture"] as? [String: Any])?["index"] as? Int, let img = image(forTexture: tex) {
                m.normal.contents = img
            }
            return m
        }

        let root = SCNNode()
        for meshSpec in json["meshes"] as? [[String: Any]] ?? [] {
            for prim in meshSpec["primitives"] as? [[String: Any]] ?? [] {
                guard let attrs = prim["attributes"] as? [String: Int], let pos = attrs["POSITION"] else { continue }
                var sources: [SCNGeometrySource] = []
                let p = floats(pos, components: 3)
                sources.append(SCNGeometrySource(vertices: stride(from: 0, to: p.count, by: 3).map {
                    SCNVector3(p[$0], p[$0 + 1], p[$0 + 2])
                }))
                if let n = attrs["NORMAL"] {
                    let f = floats(n, components: 3)
                    sources.append(SCNGeometrySource(normals: stride(from: 0, to: f.count, by: 3).map {
                        SCNVector3(f[$0], f[$0 + 1], f[$0 + 2])
                    }))
                }
                if let t = attrs["TEXCOORD_0"] {
                    let f = floats(t, components: 2)
                    sources.append(SCNGeometrySource(textureCoordinates: stride(from: 0, to: f.count, by: 2).map {
                        CGPoint(x: CGFloat(f[$0]), y: CGFloat(f[$0 + 1]))
                    }))
                }
                guard let idx = prim["indices"] as? Int else { continue }
                let all = indices(idx)
                let base = material(prim["material"] as? Int)
                let geometry: SCNGeometry
                if base.name == "tennis racquet" {
                    // Split the handle off (butt is at z ≈ 4.4, grip ends near z ≈ 2) so it can take the secondary skin colour.
                    var frame: [UInt32] = [], grip: [UInt32] = []
                    for t in stride(from: 0, to: all.count - 2, by: 3) {
                        let z = (p[Int(all[t]) * 3 + 2] + p[Int(all[t + 1]) * 3 + 2] + p[Int(all[t + 2]) * 3 + 2]) / 3
                        if z > 2.0 { grip += all[t...t + 2] } else { frame += all[t...t + 2] }
                    }
                    geometry = SCNGeometry(sources: sources, elements: [
                        SCNGeometryElement(indices: frame, primitiveType: .triangles),
                        SCNGeometryElement(indices: grip, primitiveType: .triangles)])
                    let gripMaterial = base.copy() as! SCNMaterial
                    gripMaterial.name = "grip"
                    geometry.materials = [base, gripMaterial]
                } else {
                    geometry = SCNGeometry(sources: sources, elements: [SCNGeometryElement(indices: all, primitiveType: .triangles)])
                    geometry.materials = [base]
                }
                root.addChildNode(SCNNode(geometry: geometry))
            }
        }
        return root
    }
}

private extension Data {
    func u32(at offset: Int) -> UInt32 {
        withUnsafeBytes { $0.loadUnaligned(fromByteOffset: offset, as: UInt32.self) }
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import Charts
import RacketKit
import SwiftData
import SwiftUI

struct HistoryView: View {
    @Query(sort: \SessionRecord.startDate, order: .reverse) private var sessions: [SessionRecord]
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context

    /// Pushed from Insights (All sessions), so it uses that navigation stack.
    var body: some View {
        List {
            ForEach(sessions) { s in
                NavigationLink { SessionDetailView(session: s) } label: { SessionRow(session: s) }
            }
            .onDelete { idx in idx.map { sessions[$0] }.forEach(context.delete) }
        }
        .navigationTitle("All sessions")
        .overlay {
            if sessions.isEmpty {
                ContentUnavailableView("No sessions yet", systemImage: "clock",
                                       description: Text("Start a session on the Live tab."))
            }
        }
    }
}

struct SessionRow: View {
    var session: SessionRecord

    var body: some View {
        let summary = session.summary
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
            Text(session.title).font(.headline)
            HStack(spacing: 12) {
                if !session.playerName.isEmpty { Label(session.playerName, systemImage: "person") }
                Label("\(summary.count)", systemImage: "tennisball")
                Label("\(Int(summary.sweetSpotPercent))%", systemImage: "scope")
                Label(session.duration.clock, systemImage: "timer")
            }
            .font(.caption)
            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
        .padding(.vertical, 2)
    }
}

struct ShotDetailView: View {

                        row("Spin", shot.spinRPM, average.avgSpinRPM, "rpm")

                }
````````

````````swift
import Charts
import RacketKit
import SwiftData
import SwiftUI

/// The coach report for one session.
struct CoachCard: View {
    @Bindable var session: SessionRecord
    @Environment(CoachModel.self) private var coach

    var body: some View {
        GroupBox {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
                if session.coachSummary.isEmpty {
                    Text("Get a plain-language report on this session.")
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                } else {
                    Text(session.coachSummary).textSelection(.enabled)
                }
                HStack {
                    Button {
                        Task { session.coachSummary = await coach.summarize(session) }
                    } label: {
                        Label(session.coachSummary.isEmpty ? "Ask Muse" : "Regenerate", systemImage: "sparkles")
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
                    .foregroundStyle(.black)
                    .disabled(coach.isWorking)
                    if coach.isWorking { ProgressView().controlSize(.small) }
                    Spacer()
                    Text(coach.engineName).font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
            }
        } label: {
            Label("Muse", systemImage: "sparkles")
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Views

struct InsightsView: View {
    @Query(sort: \SessionRecord.startDate) private var records: [SessionRecord]
    @AppStorage(UnitSystem.storageKey) private var useMetric = false
    @State private var period = InsightPeriod.month
    @State private var stroke: ShotType?
    @State private var metric = InsightMetric.ballSpeed
    private var units: UnitSystem { UnitSystem(metric: useMetric) }

    private var sessions: [InsightSession] {
        records.filter { $0.summary.count > 0 }.map {
            InsightSession(id: $0.id, date: $0.startDate, duration: $0.duration,
                           averageHeartRate: $0.averageHeartRate, shots: $0.shots)
        }
    }

    private var model: InsightsModel {
        InsightsModel(sessions: sessions, period: period, stroke: stroke, metric: metric, units: units)
    }

    private let strokes: [ShotType?] = [nil, .forehand, .backhand, .serve, .volley]

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            if sessions.isEmpty {
                ContentUnavailableView("No data yet", systemImage: "chart.xyaxis.line",
                                       description: Text("Play a session and your trends show up here."))
            } else {
                let m = model
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 20) {
                    strokeChips
                    metricTabs(m)
                    summary(m)
                    chart(m)
                    byStroke(m)
                    recent(m)
                }
                .padding()
            }
        }
        .navigationTitle("Insights")
        .toolbar {
            ToolbarItem(placement: .primaryAction) {
                Menu {
                    Picker("Period", selection: $period) {
                        ForEach(InsightPeriod.allCases) { Text($0.label).tag($0) }
                    }
                } label: { Label(period.label, systemImage: "chevron.down").labelStyle(.titleAndIcon) }
            }
        }
        .onChange(of: records.count) { _, _ in if !model.hasHeartRate && metric == .heartRate { metric = .ballSpeed } }
    }

    private var strokeChips: some View {
        ScrollView(.horizontal, showsIndicators: false) {
            HStack {
                ForEach(strokes, id: \.self) { s in
                    let on = stroke == s
                    Button { stroke = s } label: {
                        Text(s?.label ?? "All")
                            .font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
                            .padding(.horizontal, 16).frame(minHeight: 44)
                            .foregroundStyle(on ? Color.black : Color.primary)
                            .background(on ? Color.accentColor : .clear, in: .capsule)
                            .overlay(Capsule().stroke(on ? .clear : Color.secondary.opacity(0.5)))
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(.plain)
                    .accessibilityAddTraits(on ? .isSelected : [])
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func metricTabs(_ m: InsightsModel) -> some View {
        ScrollView(.horizontal, showsIndicators: false) {
            HStack(spacing: 20) {
                ForEach(InsightMetric.allCases.filter { $0 != .heartRate || m.hasHeartRate }) { t in
                    Button { metric = t } label: {
                        VStack(spacing: 6) {
                            Text(t.label).font(.headline)
                                .foregroundStyle(metric == t ? Color.primary : Color.secondary)
                            Rectangle().fill(metric == t ? Color.accentColor : .clear).frame(height: 3)
                        }
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(.plain)
                    .accessibilityAddTraits(metric == t ? .isSelected : [])
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func format(_ v: Double) -> String {
        switch metric {
        case .ballSpeed, .swingSpeed, .spin, .shots, .heartRate, .sweetSpot: String(format: "%.0f", v)
        case .face, .path, .contact: String(format: "%.1f", v)
        }
    }

    private func summary(_ m: InsightsModel) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
            if let avg = m.periodAverage {
                HStack(alignment: .firstTextBaseline, spacing: 6) {
                    Text(format(avg)).font(.system(size: 56, weight: .bold, design: .rounded)).monospacedDigit()
                    Text(metric.unit(units)).font(.title3).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
                if m.points.count > 1, let d = m.delta { deltaPill(d) }
                if let top = m.top, let low = m.low {
                    Text("Top \(format(top)) · Low \(format(low)) · vs previous period")
                        .font(.subheadline).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
            } else {
                Text("No data").font(.title2.bold()).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
        }
    }

    private func deltaPill(_ d: Double) -> some View {
        let better: Bool? = {
            guard abs(d) >= 0.05, let dir = metric.betterDirection else { return nil }
            if dir == 0 { return nil }
            return (d > 0) == (dir > 0)
        }()
        let arrow = d > 0 ? "▲" : (d < 0 ? "▼" : "–")
        let word = better == true ? "better" : (better == false ? "worse" : "change")
        let color: Color = better == true ? Color(red: 0.37, green: 0.86, blue: 0.54)
            : (better == false ? Color(red: 1, green: 0.6, blue: 0.55) : .secondary)
        return Text("\(arrow) \(format(abs(d))) \(word)")
            .font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold)).foregroundStyle(color)
            .padding(.horizontal, 12).padding(.vertical, 6)
            .background(color.opacity(0.18), in: .capsule)
    }

    @ViewBuilder private func chart(_ m: InsightsModel) -> some View {
        let pts = m.points
        card {
            if pts.isEmpty {
                Text(stroke.map { "No \($0.label.lowercased()) shots in this period" } ?? "No shots in this period")
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary).frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 120)
            } else if metric == .shots {
                Chart(pts) { p in
                    BarMark(x: .value("Session", p.date, unit: .day), y: .value("Shots", p.avg))
                        .foregroundStyle(Color.accentColor)
                }
                .frame(height: 210)
            } else {
                Chart(pts) { p in
                    if metric.isPerShot {
                        RuleMark(x: .value("Session", p.date, unit: .day),
                                 yStart: .value("Low", p.low), yEnd: .value("High", p.high))
                            .lineStyle(StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 16, lineCap: .round))
                            .foregroundStyle(Color.accentColor.opacity(0.28))
                    }
                    PointMark(x: .value("Session", p.date, unit: .day), y: .value("Average", p.avg))
                        .symbolSize(90).foregroundStyle(Color.accentColor)
                }
                .chartYAxisLabel(metric.unit(units))
                .frame(height: 210)
            }
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder private func byStroke(_ m: InsightsModel) -> some View {
        let rows = m.byStroke
        if stroke == nil, !rows.isEmpty {
            card {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
                    Text("By stroke").font(.headline)
                    Chart(rows, id: \.type) { r in
                        BarMark(x: .value("Average", r.avg), y: .value("Stroke", r.type.label))
                            .foregroundStyle(Color.accentColor)
                            .annotation(position: .trailing) { Text(format(r.avg)).font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary) }
                    }
                    .frame(height: CGFloat(rows.count) * 40 + 20)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func recent(_ m: InsightsModel) -> some View {
        let last = Array(records.filter { $0.summary.count > 0 }.suffix(3).reversed())
        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
            HStack {
                Text("Sessions").font(.headline)
                Spacer()
                NavigationLink("All sessions") { HistoryView() }.font(.subheadline)
            }
            ForEach(last) { s in
                NavigationLink { SessionDetailView(session: s) } label: {
                    HStack {
                        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                            Text(s.startDate.formatted(.dateTime.weekday().day().month())).font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
                            Text("\(s.summary.count) shots · \(Duration.seconds(s.duration).formatted(.units(allowed: [.hours, .minutes], width: .abbreviated)))")
                                .font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                        }
                        Spacer()
                        VStack(alignment: .trailing, spacing: 2) {
                            Text("Avg \(units.speedText(s.summary.avgBallKmh))").font(.subheadline)
                            Text("Top \(units.speedText(s.summary.maxBallKmh))").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                        }
                        Image(systemName: "chevron.right").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.tertiary)
                    }
                    .padding(14)
                    .background(.background.secondary, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 18))
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
            }
        }
    }


    private func card<C: View>(@ViewBuilder _ content: () -> C) -> some View {
        content().padding(16).background(.background.secondary, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 22))
    }
}
````````

````````swift
                Circle().fill(model.isConnected ? .green : .orange).frame(width: 8, height: 8)
                Text(model.connectionLabel).lineLimit(1)
                if let mv = model.racketStatus?.batteryMillivolts, mv > 2500 {
                    Image(systemName: batterySymbol(mv))
                }
            }
            .font(.caption.weight(.medium))
        }
    }

    private func batterySymbol(_ mv: UInt16) -> String {
        switch mv {
        case 4000...: "battery.100"
        case 3800..<4000: "battery.75"
        case 3650..<3800: "battery.50"
        case 3500..<3650: "battery.25"
        default: "battery.0"
        }
    }
}
````````
