````````swift
import SwiftData
import SwiftUI

/// What the coach remembers about the active player across sessions. The player can add, edit and delete notes,
/// and turn off Muse's access to them.
struct MemoryView: View {
    @Query(sort: \CoachNote.updatedAt, order: .reverse) private var allNotes: [CoachNote]
    @Environment(AppModel.self) private var model
    @Environment(CoachModel.self) private var coach
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @State private var draft = ""
    @State private var category = CoachNote.Category.technique
    @State private var editing: CoachNote?

    private var notes: [CoachNote] { allNotes.filter { $0.playerID == model.activePlayerID } }
    private var trimmed: String { draft.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines) }

    var body: some View {
        @Bindable var coach = coach
        List {
            Section {
                Toggle("Let Muse use these notes", isOn: $coach.memoryEnabled)
            } footer: {
                Text(coach.memoryEnabled
                     ? "When Muse answers, it can read these notes and add new ones. They're sent to Meta with your question, including any injury notes. Notes sync through your iCloud."
                     : "Notes stay on your devices. Muse can't read or add them.")
            }
            Section("Add a note about \(model.activePlayer?.name ?? "you")") {
                TextField("e.g. Rushes the backhand when tired", text: $draft, axis: .vertical)
                    .lineLimit(1...4)
                Picker("Category", selection: $category) {
                    ForEach(CoachNote.Category.allCases) { Label($0.label, systemImage: $0.symbol).tag($0) }
                }
                Button("Remember", systemImage: "plus.circle.fill", action: add)
                    .disabled(trimmed.count < 3 || trimmed.count > CoachMemory.maxNoteLength)
            }
            if notes.isEmpty {
                Section {
                    ContentUnavailableView("Nothing remembered yet", systemImage: "brain",
                        description: Text("Add habits, goals or past injuries, and Muse will take them into account."))
                }
            }
            ForEach(CoachNote.Category.allCases) { cat in
                let group = notes.filter { $0.category == cat }
                if !group.isEmpty {
                    Section {
                        ForEach(group) { note in
                            Button { editing = note } label: { row(note) }
                                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                        }
                        .onDelete { offsets in offsets.map { group[$0] }.forEach(context.delete) }
                    } header: { Label(cat.label, systemImage: cat.symbol) }
                }
            }
        }
        .navigationTitle("Memory")
        .sheet(item: $editing) { NoteEditor(note: $0) }
    }

    private func row(_ note: CoachNote) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
            Text(note.text)
            HStack(spacing: 6) {
                Text(note.updatedAt.formatted(date: .abbreviated, time: .omitted))
                if note.addedByCoach { Label("Added by Muse", systemImage: "sparkles") }
            }
            .font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .contentShape(.rect)
    }

    private func add() {
        context.insert(CoachNote(playerID: model.activePlayerID, text: trimmed, category: category))
        draft = ""
    }
}

private struct NoteEditor: View {
    @Bindable var note: CoachNote
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @State private var text = ""
    @State private var category = CoachNote.Category.technique

    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            Form {
                TextField("Note", text: $text, axis: .vertical).lineLimit(2...6)
                Picker("Category", selection: $category) {
                    ForEach(CoachNote.Category.allCases) { Label($0.label, systemImage: $0.symbol).tag($0) }
                }
                if note.addedByCoach {
                    Text("Added by Muse on \(note.createdAt.formatted(date: .abbreviated, time: .omitted)).")
                        .font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
                Button("Delete note", role: .destructive) { context.delete(note); dismiss() }
            }
            .navigationTitle("Edit note")
            .toolbar {
                ToolbarItem(placement: .cancellationAction) { Button("Cancel") { dismiss() } }
                ToolbarItem(placement: .confirmationAction) {
                    let t = text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
                    Button("Save") {
                        note.text = t
                        note.category = category
                        note.updatedAt = Date()
                        dismiss()
                    }
                    .disabled(t.count < 3 || t.count > CoachMemory.maxNoteLength)
                }
            }
            .onAppear { text = note.text; category = note.category }
        }
        #if os(macOS)
        .frame(minWidth: 380, minHeight: 260)
        #endif
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import RacketKit
import SwiftData
import SwiftUI

/// The Muse section's look ("Lab"): always dark, felt lime on near-black, rounded display type.
enum MuseStyle {
    static let background = Color(red: 0.063, green: 0.071, blue: 0.051)   // #10120D
    static let card = Color(red: 0.102, green: 0.114, blue: 0.082)         // #1A1D15
    static let line = Color(red: 0.149, green: 0.165, blue: 0.118)         // #262A1E
    static let stage = Color(red: 0.020, green: 0.024, blue: 0.016)        // #050604
    static let lime = Color(red: 0.867, green: 0.910, blue: 0.357)         // #DDE85B
    static let ink = Color(red: 0.067, green: 0.075, blue: 0.047)          // #11130C
    static let text = Color(red: 0.953, green: 0.961, blue: 0.925)         // #F3F5EC
    static let muted = Color(red: 0.663, green: 0.682, blue: 0.604)        // #A9AE9A
    static let ghost = Color(red: 0.486, green: 0.510, blue: 0.416)        // #7C826A
    static let good = Color(red: 0.369, green: 0.863, blue: 0.541)         // #5EDC8A

    static func display(_ size: CGFloat) -> Font { .system(size: size, weight: .heavy, design: .rounded) }
    static let eyebrow = Font.system(size: 11, weight: .semibold, design: .monospaced)
}

extension View {
    /// Dark Muse background, also under the navigation bar on iPhone.
    func museScreen() -> some View {
        background(MuseStyle.background.ignoresSafeArea())
            .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
            #if os(iOS)
            .toolbarBackground(MuseStyle.background, for: .navigationBar)
            .toolbarColorScheme(.dark, for: .navigationBar)
            #endif
    }
}

/// Two swing trails, yours dashed and the change solid, through the ball: the hero card's picture.
struct SwingSketch: View {
    var color: Color

    var body: some View {
        Canvas { ctx, size in
            let w = size.width, h = size.height
            func curve(_ lift: CGFloat) -> Path {
                var p = Path()
                p.move(to: CGPoint(x: w * 0.06, y: h * (0.38 + lift)))
                p.addCurve(to: CGPoint(x: w * 0.82, y: h * (0.25 - lift * 1.6)),
                           control1: CGPoint(x: w * 0.25, y: h * (1.1 + lift)), control2: CGPoint(x: w * 0.62, y: h * (1.0 + lift)))
                return p
            }
            ctx.stroke(curve(0), with: .color(color.opacity(0.35)), style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 3, dash: [6, 7]))
            ctx.stroke(curve(0.1), with: .color(color), style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 6, lineCap: .round))
            let ball = CGRect(x: w * 0.71, y: h * 0.52, width: 20, height: 20)
            ctx.fill(Path(ellipseIn: ball), with: .color(Color(red: 0.984, green: 0.984, blue: 0.957)))
            ctx.stroke(Path(ellipseIn: ball), with: .color(color), lineWidth: 3)
        }
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}

/// Muse: the best change for your game, the next drill, memory, and questions, pushed from Insights.
struct CoachScreen: View {
    @Query(sort: \SessionRecord.startDate) private var sessions: [SessionRecord]
    @Query(sort: \CoachNote.updatedAt, order: .reverse) private var allNotes: [CoachNote]
    @Query(filter: #Predicate<CoachReview> { $0.statusRaw == "pending" }) private var pending: [CoachReview]
    @Environment(CoachModel.self) private var coach
    @Environment(AppModel.self) private var model
    @AppStorage(UnitSystem.storageKey) private var useMetric = false
    @State private var question = ""

    @State private var drill = ""
    @State private var filmError = ""
    @State private var openWhatIf = false
    private var units: UnitSystem { UnitSystem(metric: useMetric) }

    private var latest: SessionRecord? { sessions.last { $0.summary.count > 0 } }
    /// The newest session with motion shots, and its first stroke the swing film can draw.
    private var filmSource: (SessionRecord, ShotType)? {
        guard let s = sessions.last(where: { WhatIf.baseline($0.shots) != nil }),
              let t = SwingFilm.strokes.first(where: { WhatIf.baseline(s.shots, type: $0) != nil }) else { return nil }
        return (s, t)
    }
    /// The player's average for a stroke from the newest session that has it, as the What-if screen uses.
    private func baseline(_ stroke: ShotType) -> WhatIf.Baseline? {
        sessions.last { WhatIf.baseline($0.shots, type: stroke) != nil }.flatMap { WhatIf.baseline($0.shots, type: stroke) }
    }
    private var noteCount: Int { allNotes.filter { $0.playerID == model.activePlayerID }.count }
    private var pendingReviews: Int { pending.count }
    private var online: Bool { coach.museEnabled && coach.museAvailable }

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
                header
                hero
                HStack(spacing: 12) {
                    drillTile
                    memoryTile
                }
                if !drill.isEmpty { drillCard }
                whatIfRow
                featureRow(symbol: "list.number", title: "Practice plan",
                           detail: coach.activePlan.map { "\($0.title) · \($0.steps.count) steps" } ?? "Three steps from your last session") {
                    PracticePlanView()
                }
                featureRow(symbol: "binoculars", title: "Scout yourself",
                           detail: "Muse predicts where an opponent would attack") { ScoutView() }
                featureRow(symbol: "flag", title: "Review queue",
                           detail: pendingReviews == 0 ? "Flag a session for a human look" : "\(pendingReviews) waiting for you") {
                    ReviewQueueView()
                }
                askList
                ForEach(Array(chat.enumerated()), id: \.offset) { index, item in answerCard(item, last: index == chat.count - 1) }
                engineCard
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 16)
            .padding(.bottom, 16)
        }
        .safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom) { askBar }
        .navigationTitle("")
        .navigationDestination(isPresented: $openWhatIf) { WhatIfView() }
        .museScreen()
    }

    // MARK: Header and hero

    private var header: some View {
        HStack(alignment: .lastTextBaseline) {
            Text("Muse").font(MuseStyle.display(34)).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
            Spacer()
            HStack(spacing: 6) {
                Circle().fill(online ? MuseStyle.good : MuseStyle.muted).frame(width: 8, height: 8)
                Text(online ? "Muse Spark · online" : "Built-in engine").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
            }
        }
        .padding(.top, 4)
    }

    /// Muse's best change for the player's own swing, or the button that asks for one.
    @ViewBuilder private var hero: some View {
        let film = coach.lastFilm
        let stroke = film?.stroke ?? filmSource?.1 ?? .forehand
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
                Text("BEST CHANGE · \(stroke.label.uppercased())").font(MuseStyle.eyebrow).tracking(2)
                    .foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.ink.opacity(0.7))
                Text(film?.title ?? "Find your best change").font(MuseStyle.display(30)).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.ink)
                    .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                Text(film?.cue ?? "Muse tests changes on your average \(stroke.label.lowercased()) and shows you the one that helps most.")
                    .font(.subheadline).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.ink.opacity(0.8))
            }
            .padding([.horizontal, .top], 18)
            SwingSketch(color: MuseStyle.ink).frame(height: 110)
            heroFooter(film)
        }
        .background(MuseStyle.lime, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 28))
        .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 28))
        .contentShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 28))
        .onTapGesture { if film != nil { openWhatIf = true } }
        .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(film != nil ? .isButton : [])
    }

    @ViewBuilder private func heroFooter(_ film: SwingFilm?) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 16) {
            if let film, let base = baseline(film.stroke) {
                let b = ShotSimulator.simulate(base.parameters, model: model.impactModel)
                let a = ShotSimulator.simulate(WhatIf.apply(film.deltas, to: base.parameters), model: model.impactModel)
                footerStat(String(format: "%+.0f%%", (a.ballSpeedKmh / max(b.ballSpeedKmh, 1) - 1) * 100), "ball speed")
                footerStat("\(Int(a.spinRPM.rounded()))", "rpm, was \(Int(b.spinRPM.rounded()))")
                Spacer()
                Text("Watch ›").font(.subheadline.weight(.bold)).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.lime)
            } else if coach.isWorking {
                ProgressView().controlSize(.small).tint(MuseStyle.lime)
                Text("Muse is testing changes…").font(.subheadline).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
                Spacer()
            } else {
                Text(filmError.isEmpty ? (coach.museAvailable ? "Uses Muse Spark online" : "Sign in under Account to use Muse")
                     : filmError)
                    .font(.caption).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted).lineLimit(2)
                Spacer()
                Button("Find it ›") { findBestChange() }
                    .font(.subheadline.weight(.bold)).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.lime)
                    .disabled(!coach.museAvailable || filmSource == nil)
                    .frame(minHeight: 44)
            }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 18).padding(.vertical, 12)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 60, alignment: .leading)
        .background(MuseStyle.ink)
    }

    private func footerStat(_ value: String, _ label: String) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
            Text(value).font(MuseStyle.display(20)).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text).monospacedDigit()
            Text(label).font(.caption2).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
        }
    }

    private func findBestChange() {
        guard let source = filmSource else { return }
        let (session, stroke) = source
        filmError = ""
        Task {
            if case .failure(let error) = await coach.swingFilm(session, stroke: stroke) { filmError = error.localizedDescription }
        }
    }

    // MARK: Tiles

    private var drillTile: some View {
        Button {
            guard let latest, model.activeDrill == nil else { return }
            Task { drill = await coach.drill(latest) }
        } label: {
            tile(symbol: "scope", title: model.activeDrill == nil ? "Next drill" : "Drill running",
                 detail: model.activeDrill?.goal ?? (latest == nil ? "Play a session first" : "Muse plans one for you"))
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .disabled(coach.isWorking || latest == nil)
    }

    private var memoryTile: some View {
        NavigationLink { MemoryView() } label: {
            tile(symbol: "brain", title: "Memory", detail: noteCount == 1 ? "1 note Muse keeps" : "\(noteCount) notes Muse keeps")
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }

    private var whatIfRow: some View {
        Button { openWhatIf = true } label: {
            HStack(spacing: 12) {
                Image(systemName: "slider.horizontal.3").font(.title3).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.lime)
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                    Text("What if").font(.headline).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
                    Text("Try a change on your swing in 3D").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
                }
                Spacer()
                Image(systemName: "chevron.right").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.ghost)
            }
            .padding(14)
            .frame(minHeight: 60)
            .background(MuseStyle.card, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 22))
            .contentShape(.rect)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }

    private func featureRow<D: View>(symbol: String, title: String, detail: String,
                                     @ViewBuilder destination: @escaping () -> D) -> some View {
        NavigationLink(destination: destination) {
            HStack(spacing: 12) {
                Image(systemName: symbol).font(.title3).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.lime).frame(width: 28)
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                    Text(title).font(.headline).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
                    Text(detail).font(.caption).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted).lineLimit(1)
                }
                Spacer()
                Image(systemName: "chevron.right").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.ghost)
            }
            .padding(14)
            .frame(minHeight: 60)
            .background(MuseStyle.card, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 22))
            .contentShape(.rect)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }

    private func tile(symbol: String, title: String, detail: String) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
            Image(systemName: symbol).font(.title3).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.lime)
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
            Text(title).font(.headline).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
            Text(detail).font(.caption).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted).lineLimit(2).multilineTextAlignment(.leading)
        }
        .padding(14)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 116, alignment: .leading)
        .background(MuseStyle.card, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 22))
    }

    private var drillCard: some View {
        let parsed = Drill.parse(drill)
        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
            Text("NEXT DRILL").font(MuseStyle.eyebrow).tracking(2).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
            Text(parsed.title).font(MuseStyle.display(22)).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
            Text(parsed.goal).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
            if !parsed.why.isEmpty { Text(parsed.why).font(.caption).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted) }
            Button {
                model.startDrill(parsed)
            } label: {
                Label(model.activeDrill?.title == parsed.title ? "Drill running" : "Start on Watch", systemImage: "applewatch")
                    .font(.subheadline.weight(.bold)).frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 44)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.ink)
            .background(MuseStyle.lime, in: .capsule)
            .disabled(model.activeDrill?.title == parsed.title)
        }
        .padding(16)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .background(MuseStyle.card, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 22))
    }

    // MARK: Ask

    private static let suggestions = ["What's my weakest stroke?", "Am I getting tired?", "Show my last 5 off-center hits",
                                      "Is the racket working right?"]

    private var askList: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
            Text("ASK").font(MuseStyle.eyebrow).tracking(2).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted).padding(.top, 4)
            VStack(spacing: 0) {
                ForEach(Array(Self.suggestions.enumerated()), id: \.offset) { index, s in
                    Button { ask(s) } label: {
                        HStack {
                            Text(s).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
                            Spacer()
                            Image(systemName: "chevron.right").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.ghost)
                        }
                        .frame(minHeight: 48)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                        .contentShape(.rect)
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(.plain)
                    .disabled(coach.isWorking || latest == nil)
                    if index < Self.suggestions.count - 1 { MuseStyle.line.frame(height: 1) }
                }
            }
            .background(MuseStyle.card, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 22))
        }
    }

    private func answerCard(_ item: (q: String, a: String), last: Bool) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
            Text(item.q).font(.subheadline.weight(.bold)).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.lime)
            Text(item.a).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text).textSelection(.enabled)
            if last {
                RememberedNotes()
                Text(coach.engineName).font(.caption2).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
            }
        }
        .padding(16)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .background(MuseStyle.card, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 22))
    }

    private var askBar: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 10) {
            TextField("Ask Muse anything about your game", text: $question)
                .textFieldStyle(.plain)
                .foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
                .onSubmit { ask(question) }
            if coach.isWorking { ProgressView().controlSize(.small).tint(MuseStyle.lime) }
            Button { ask(question) } label: {
                Image(systemName: "arrow.up").font(.headline).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.ink)
                    .frame(width: 44, height: 44).background(MuseStyle.lime, in: .circle)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .accessibilityLabel("Send")
            .disabled(question.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).isEmpty || coach.isWorking || latest == nil)
        }
        .padding(.leading, 18).padding(.trailing, 6).padding(.vertical, 6)
        .background(MuseStyle.card, in: .capsule)
        .padding(.horizontal, 16).padding(.vertical, 8)
        .background(MuseStyle.background)
    }

    private func ask(_ text: String) {
        let q = text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
        guard !q.isEmpty, !coach.isWorking, let latest else { return }
        question = ""
        Task { chat.append((q, await coach.answer(q, session: latest))) }
    }

    // MARK: Engine

    private var engineCard: some View {
        @Bindable var coach = coach
        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
            Toggle("Use Muse online", isOn: $coach.museEnabled)
                .disabled(!coach.museAvailable || coach.isWorking)
                .tint(MuseStyle.lime)
                .foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
            Text(coach.museAvailable
                 ? "Muse sends your question and the shot data, racket readings and player notes it asks for to Meta. Health data and session notes are excluded; turn off player notes under Memory."
                 : "Sign in under Account to use Muse online. Until then the built-in engine answers offline.")
                .font(.caption).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
            if let reason = coach.lastFallbackReason {
                Text("Using the built-in engine: \(reason)").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
            }
        }
        .padding(16)
        .background(MuseStyle.card, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 22))
        .padding(.top, 8)
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import RacketKit
import SwiftData
import SwiftUI

/// A 3-step practice plan written from the newest session. Each step is a drill the Watch counts down.
struct PracticePlanView: View {
    @Query(sort: \SessionRecord.startDate) private var sessions: [SessionRecord]
    @Environment(CoachModel.self) private var coach
    @Environment(AppModel.self) private var model

    private var latest: SessionRecord? { sessions.last { $0.hasPlayableShots } }

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
                Text("Practice plan").font(MuseStyle.display(30)).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
                Text("Three steps from your last session: the weakest link first, a progression, then a rally count.")
                    .font(.subheadline).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
                if let plan = coach.activePlan {
                    planHeader(plan)
                    ForEach(Array(plan.steps.enumerated()), id: \.element.id) { index, step in
                        stepCard(step, number: index + 1)
                    }
                } else {
                    Text(latest == nil ? "Play a session first, then Muse writes a plan from it."
                         : "No plan yet. Muse writes one from your last session.")
                        .foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
                        .museCard()
                }
                writeButton
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 16)
            .padding(.bottom, 16)
        }
        .navigationTitle("")
        .museScreen()
    }

    private func planHeader(_ plan: PracticePlan) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
            Text("PLAN · \(plan.createdAt.formatted(.dateTime.weekday().day().month()).uppercased())")
                .font(MuseStyle.eyebrow).tracking(2).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.ink.opacity(0.7))
            Text(plan.title).font(MuseStyle.display(24)).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.ink)
            Text(plan.engineName.isEmpty ? coach.engineName : plan.engineName)
                .font(.caption2).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.ink.opacity(0.7))
        }
        .padding(16)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .background(MuseStyle.lime, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 22))
    }

    private func stepCard(_ step: PracticeStep, number: Int) -> some View {
        let running = model.activeDrill?.id == step.drill.id
        let progress = running ? model.activeDrill : nil
        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
            Text("STEP \(number)").font(MuseStyle.eyebrow).tracking(2).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
            Text(step.drill.title).font(MuseStyle.display(20)).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
            Label(step.drill.goal, systemImage: "target").foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
            if !step.drill.why.isEmpty { Text(step.drill.why).font(.caption).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted) }
            if !step.note.isEmpty {
                Text(step.note).font(.callout.italic()).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text.opacity(0.85))
            }
            if let progress {
                ProgressView(value: Double(min(progress.completed, progress.target)), total: Double(max(progress.target, 1)))
                    .tint(MuseStyle.lime)
                Text("\(progress.completed) of \(progress.target)").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted).monospacedDigit()
            }
            Button { coach.startPlanStep(step) } label: {
                Label(running ? (progress?.isDone == true ? "Step done" : "Running on Watch") : "Start",
                      systemImage: running ? "checkmark" : "applewatch")
                    .font(.subheadline.weight(.bold)).frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 44)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.ink)
            .background(MuseStyle.lime, in: .capsule)
            .disabled(running)
            .opacity(running ? 0.6 : 1)
        }
        .museCard()
    }

    private var writeButton: some View {
        Button {
            guard let latest, !coach.isWorking else { return }
            Task { _ = await coach.plan(latest) }
        } label: {
            HStack {
                if coach.isWorking { ProgressView().controlSize(.small).tint(MuseStyle.lime) }
                Text(coach.activePlan == nil ? "Write my plan" : "Write a new plan")
            }
            .font(.subheadline.weight(.bold)).frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 44)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.lime)
        .overlay(Capsule().stroke(MuseStyle.lime.opacity(0.6)))
        .disabled(coach.isWorking || latest == nil)
        .opacity(coach.isWorking || latest == nil ? 0.6 : 1)
    }
}
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "apple/Shared/Views/RacketSceneView.swift", "sha256": "014df2f1bd5f5db697fb8dbd63ca4f30e9902ed14f703c64723f143803a9032a", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````swift
import RacketKit
import SceneKit
import SwiftUI
import simd

/// 3D racket that mirrors the real one. Racket frame: x = toward the tip, y = across the face, z = face normal.
@MainActor
final class RacketScene {
    let scene = SCNScene()
    let racket = SCNNode()
    private let impactDot: SCNNode
    private var paint: [(SCNMaterial, Bool, Any?)] = []

    init() {
        scene.background.contents = nil
        let frameMat = SCNMaterial()
        frameMat.diffuse.contents = PlatformColor(red: 0.05, green: 0.12, blue: 0.08, alpha: 1)
        frameMat.name = "tennis racquet"
        frameMat.metalness.contents = 0.6
        frameMat.roughness.contents = 0.3
        frameMat.lightingModel = .physicallyBased
        let accentMat = SCNMaterial()
        accentMat.diffuse.contents = PlatformColor(red: 0.84, green: 0.95, blue: 0.25, alpha: 1)
        accentMat.name = "dark"
        accentMat.lightingModel = .physicallyBased
        let gripMat = SCNMaterial()
        gripMat.diffuse.contents = PlatformColor(white: 0.22, alpha: 1)
        let stringMat = SCNMaterial()
        stringMat.diffuse.contents = PlatformColor(white: 0.92, alpha: 0.9)

        // Handle (butt at x = 0), grip wrap and butt cap.
        let handle = SCNNode(geometry: SCNBox(width: 0.19, height: 0.03, length: 0.034, chamferRadius: 0.008))
        handle.geometry?.materials = [gripMat]
        handle.position = SCNVector3(0.095, 0, 0)
        let cap = SCNNode(geometry: SCNBox(width: 0.01, height: 0.036, length: 0.04, chamferRadius: 0.004))
        cap.geometry?.materials = [accentMat]
        cap.position = SCNVector3(0.006, 0, 0)

        // Throat: two arms meeting the head.
        func arm(_ side: CGFloat) -> SCNNode {
            let n = SCNNode(geometry: SCNBox(width: 0.17, height: 0.014, length: 0.02, chamferRadius: 0.005))
            n.geometry?.materials = [frameMat]
            n.position = SCNVector3(0.26, Float(side) * 0.035, 0)
            n.eulerAngles = SCNVector3(0, 0, Float(side) * 0.36)
            return n
        }

        // Head: an elliptical hoop lying in the x–y plane.
        let hoop = SCNNode(geometry: SCNTorus(ringRadius: 0.125, pipeRadius: 0.009))
        hoop.geometry?.materials = [frameMat]
        hoop.eulerAngles.x = .pi / 2
        hoop.scale = SCNVector3(1.3, 1, 1)
        hoop.position = SCNVector3(0.52, 0, 0)

        // Strings.
        let strings = SCNNode()
        strings.position = SCNVector3(0.52, 0, 0)
        for i in -7...7 {
            let y = CGFloat(i) * 0.015
            let len = 2 * 0.162 * sqrt(max(0, 1 - pow(y / 0.124, 2)))
            let s = SCNNode(geometry: SCNBox(width: len, height: 0.0015, length: 0.0015, chamferRadius: 0))
            s.geometry?.materials = [stringMat]
            s.position = SCNVector3(0, Float(y), 0)
            strings.addChildNode(s)
        }
        for i in -9...9 {
            let x = CGFloat(i) * 0.016
            let len = 2 * 0.124 * sqrt(max(0, 1 - pow(x / 0.162, 2)))
            let s = SCNNode(geometry: SCNBox(width: 0.0015, height: len, length: 0.0015, chamferRadius: 0))
            s.geometry?.materials = [stringMat]
            s.position = SCNVector3(Float(x), 0, 0)
            strings.addChildNode(s)
        }

        impactDot = SCNNode(geometry: SCNSphere(radius: 0.012))
        impactDot.geometry?.firstMaterial?.diffuse.contents = PlatformColor.systemGreen
        impactDot.geometry?.firstMaterial?.emission.contents = PlatformColor.systemGreen
        impactDot.opacity = 0
        let impactPlane = SCNNode()                    // string-bed center, 512 mm from the butt
        impactPlane.position = SCNVector3(0.512, 0, 0)
        impactPlane.addChildNode(impactDot)

        let model = SCNNode()
        let procedural = SCNNode()
        [handle, cap, arm(1), arm(-1), hoop, strings].forEach(procedural.addChildNode)
        model.addChildNode(procedural)
        model.addChildNode(impactPlane)
        if let detailed = Self.loadDetailedRacket() {
            procedural.isHidden = true
            model.addChildNode(detailed)
        }
        model.position = SCNVector3(-0.3, 0, 0)       // rotate about a point near the grip
        racket.addChildNode(model)
        scene.rootNode.addChildNode(racket)
        var seen = Set<ObjectIdentifier>()
        model.enumerateChildNodes { node, _ in
            for material in node.geometry?.materials ?? [] {
                guard seen.insert(ObjectIdentifier(material)).inserted else { continue }
                if ["tennis racquet", "dark", "grip"].contains(material.name) {
                    paint.append((material, material.name != "tennis racquet", material.diffuse.contents))
                }
            }
        }

        let camera = SCNNode()
        camera.camera = SCNCamera()
        camera.camera?.fieldOfView = 40
        // Default zNear is 1 m; the racket comes within that of the camera and got clipped.
        camera.camera?.zNear = 0.01
        camera.camera?.zFar = 20
        camera.position = SCNVector3(0, 0.12, 0.95)
        camera.look(at: SCNVector3(0, 0, 0))
        scene.rootNode.addChildNode(camera)

        let key = SCNNode()
        key.light = SCNLight()
        key.light?.type = .directional
        key.light?.intensity = 1200
        key.eulerAngles = SCNVector3(-0.8, 0.6, 0)
        scene.rootNode.addChildNode(key)
        let ambient = SCNNode()
        ambient.light = SCNLight()
        ambient.light?.type = .ambient
        ambient.light?.intensity = 500
        scene.rootNode.addChildNode(ambient)
    }

    /// The textured Yonex model (Resources/TennisRacket.glb), mapped into the racket frame: the file has the
    /// head toward −z, the face across x and the face normal along y, 8.87 units long. We scale it to the real
    /// 686 mm length and put the butt at x = 0, tip toward +x. Falls back to the simple model if missing.
    static func loadDetailedRacket() -> SCNNode? {
        guard let url = Bundle.main.url(forResource: "TennisRacket", withExtension: "glb"),
              let node = try? GLBLoader.load(url: url) else { return nil }
        let s: Float = 0.686 / 8.8715
        let container = SCNNode()
        node.simdTransform = simd_float4x4(columns: (SIMD4(0, -s, 0, 0), SIMD4(0, 0, s, 0),
                                                     SIMD4(-s, 0, 0, 0), SIMD4(4.4358 * s, 0, 0, 1)))
        container.addChildNode(node)
        return container
    }

    func applySkin(enabled: Bool, main: String, secondary: String) {
        for (material, isSecondary, original) in paint {
            material.diffuse.contents = enabled ? PlatformColor(RacketSkin.color(isSecondary ? secondary : main)) : original
        }
    }

    /// World (z-up) racket orientation → SceneKit (y-up).
    func update(_ q: simd_quatf) {
        let zUpToYUp = simd_quatf(angle: -.pi / 2, axis: SIMD3(1, 0, 0))
        racket.simdOrientation = zUpToYUp * q
    }

    func showImpact(_ shot: ShotMetrics) {
        // Relative to the string-bed center: x = along the racket (toward tip), y = across.
        impactDot.position = SCNVector3(Float(shot.impactYcm / 100), Float(shot.impactXcm / 100), 0.008)
        let color = shot.isSweetSpot ? PlatformColor.systemGreen : PlatformColor.systemRed
        impactDot.geometry?.firstMaterial?.diffuse.contents = color
        impactDot.geometry?.firstMaterial?.emission.contents = color
        impactDot.removeAllActions()
        impactDot.opacity = 1
        impactDot.runAction(.sequence([.wait(duration: 1.5), .fadeOut(duration: 0.8)]))
    }
}

struct RacketSceneView: View {
    @Environment(AppModel.self) private var model
    @State private var racketScene = RacketScene()
    @AppStorage("skin.enabled") private var skinEnabled = false
    @AppStorage("skin.main") private var mainColor = RacketSkin.defaultMain
    @AppStorage("skin.secondary") private var secondaryColor = RacketSkin.defaultSecondary

    var body: some View {
        SceneView(scene: racketScene.scene, options: [.rendersContinuously])
            .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 20))
            .onChange(of: model.live.orientation) { _, q in racketScene.update(q) }
            .onChange(of: model.shotFlashID) { _, _ in
                if let shot = model.lastShot { racketScene.showImpact(shot) }
            }
            .onAppear { racketScene.update(model.live.orientation); applySkin() }
            .onChange(of: skinEnabled) { _, _ in applySkin() }
            .onChange(of: mainColor) { _, _ in applySkin() }
            .onChange(of: secondaryColor) { _, _ in applySkin() }
    }
    private func applySkin() {
        racketScene.applySkin(enabled: skinEnabled, main: mainColor, secondary: secondaryColor)
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import SwiftUI

/// Opaque sRGB colours stored independently of the scene and restored on every launch.
enum RacketSkin {
    static let defaultMain = "154C3B"
    static let defaultSecondary = "D6F240"

    static func color(_ hex: String) -> Color {
        let value = UInt32(hex, radix: 16) ?? 0x154C3B
        return Color(red: Double((value >> 16) & 255) / 255,
                     green: Double((value >> 8) & 255) / 255, blue: Double(value & 255) / 255)
    }

    static func hex(_ color: Color) -> String {
        #if os(macOS)
        let rgb = NSColor(color).usingColorSpace(.sRGB) ?? .black
        return String(format: "%02X%02X%02X", Int((rgb.redComponent * 255).rounded()),
                      Int((rgb.greenComponent * 255).rounded()), Int((rgb.blueComponent * 255).rounded()))
        #else
        var r: CGFloat = 0, g: CGFloat = 0, b: CGFloat = 0, a: CGFloat = 0
        UIColor(color).getRed(&r, green: &g, blue: &b, alpha: &a)
        return String(format: "%02X%02X%02X", Int((r * 255).rounded()), Int((g * 255).rounded()), Int((b * 255).rounded()))
        #endif
    }
}

struct RacketSkinView: View {
    @AppStorage("skin.enabled") private var enabled = false
    @AppStorage("skin.main") private var main = RacketSkin.defaultMain
    @AppStorage("skin.secondary") private var secondary = RacketSkin.defaultSecondary

    var body: some View {
        Form {
            Section {
                RacketSceneView().frame(height: 280)
                    .accessibilityLabel("Preview of your racket colours")
            }
            Section {
                Toggle("Custom colours", isOn: $enabled)
                ColorPicker("Main colour", selection: colour($main), supportsOpacity: false).disabled(!enabled)
                ColorPicker("Secondary colour", selection: colour($secondary), supportsOpacity: false).disabled(!enabled)
            } footer: {
                Text("Main colours the frame; secondary colours the dark trim. Your colours also appear on the Live screen.")
            }
            Section("Skins") {
                preset("Court green", "154C3B", "D6F240")
                preset("Midnight", "243047", "E8EDF5")
                preset("Clay", "C65B3D", "F4D4A4")
                preset("Electric", "6655E8", "5CF5D4")
                Button("Original racket") { enabled = false }
            }
        }
        .formStyle(.grouped)
        .navigationTitle("Racket skins")
    }

    private func colour(_ value: Binding<String>) -> Binding<Color> {
        Binding(get: { RacketSkin.color(value.wrappedValue) }, set: { value.wrappedValue = RacketSkin.hex($0) })
    }

    private func preset(_ name: String, _ primary: String, _ accent: String) -> some View {
        Button { main = primary; secondary = accent; enabled = true } label: {
            HStack {
                Circle().fill(RacketSkin.color(primary)).frame(width: 20, height: 20)
                Circle().fill(RacketSkin.color(accent)).frame(width: 20, height: 20)
                Text(name)
                Spacer()
                if enabled && main == primary && secondary == accent { Image(systemName: "checkmark") }
            }
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }
}
````````

````````swift
                            Image(systemName: "square.and.arrow.up")
                        }
                    }

            CalibrationView()
                #if os(macOS)
                .frame(minWidth: 560, minHeight: 640)
                #endif
        }
    }

    /// Height shown in cm or inches, stored in meters. Empty until the player enters one.
    private func heightText(for id: UUID) -> Binding<String> {
        let scale = useMetric ? 100.0 : 39.3701
        return Binding(
            get: {
                guard let height = model.players.first(where: { $0.id == id })?.heightM else { return "" }
                return String(format: useMetric ? "%.0f" : "%.1f", Double(height) * scale)
            },
            set: { text in
                guard let index = model.players.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == id }) else { return }
                model.players[index].heightM = Double(text).map { Float($0 / scale) }
            }
        )
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import RacketKit
import SwiftData
import SwiftUI

/// Session reviews waiting for a human's eyes: Muse flags what stood out, you approve or dismiss each one.
struct ReviewQueueView: View {
    @Query(sort: \CoachReview.createdAt, order: .reverse) private var reviews: [CoachReview]
    @Query(sort: \SessionRecord.startDate) private var sessions: [SessionRecord]
    @Environment(CoachModel.self) private var coach
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context

    private var latest: SessionRecord? { sessions.last { $0.hasPlayableShots } }
    private var pendingCount: Int { reviews.filter { $0.status == .pending }.count }

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
                HStack(alignment: .lastTextBaseline) {
                    Text("Review queue").font(MuseStyle.display(30)).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
                    Spacer()
                    if pendingCount > 0 {
                        Text("\(pendingCount) pending").font(.caption.weight(.semibold)).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.lime)
                    }
                }
                Text("Muse flags the moments in a session that need a human look. Approve what you'll work on; dismiss the rest.")
                    .font(.subheadline).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
                reviewButton
                if reviews.isEmpty {
                    Text("No reviews yet.").foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted).museCard()
                }
                ForEach(reviews) { review in card(review) }
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 16)
            .padding(.bottom, 16)
        }
        .navigationTitle("")
        .museScreen()
    }

    private var reviewButton: some View {
        Button {
            guard let latest, !coach.isWorking else { return }
            Task { _ = await coach.review(latest) }
        } label: {
            HStack {
                if coach.isWorking { ProgressView().controlSize(.small).tint(MuseStyle.ink) }
                Text("Review this session")
            }
            .font(.subheadline.weight(.bold)).frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 44)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.ink)
        .background(MuseStyle.lime, in: .capsule)
        .disabled(coach.isWorking || latest == nil)
        .opacity(coach.isWorking || latest == nil ? 0.6 : 1)
    }

    private func sessionLabel(_ id: UUID) -> String {
        guard let s = sessions.first(where: { $0.id == id }) else { return "Session" }
        return "\(s.startDate.formatted(.dateTime.weekday().day().month())) · \(s.playableShotCount) shots"
    }

    private func card(_ review: CoachReview) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
            HStack {
                Text(sessionLabel(review.sessionID).uppercased()).font(MuseStyle.eyebrow).tracking(1.5)
                    .foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
                Spacer()
                statusBadge(review.status)
            }
            if review.isClear {
                Label(review.clearNote.isEmpty ? "Nothing needs a review." : review.clearNote,
                      systemImage: "checkmark.seal")
                    .foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.good)
            } else {
                ForEach(review.flags) { flag in
                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 3) {
                        Label(flag.label, systemImage: "flag.fill").font(.headline).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
                        if !flag.detail.isEmpty { Text(flag.detail).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text) }
                        if !flag.evidence.isEmpty {
                            Text(flag.evidence).font(.caption.monospaced()).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
                        }
                    }
                    .padding(.vertical, 2)
                }
            }
            if review.status == .pending {
                HStack(spacing: 10) {
                    decisionButton("Approve", symbol: "checkmark", filled: true) { decide(review, .approved) }
                    decisionButton("Dismiss", symbol: "xmark", filled: false) { decide(review, .dismissed) }
                }
            } else if let at = review.reviewedAt {
                Text("\(review.status == .approved ? "Approved" : "Dismissed") \(at.formatted(date: .abbreviated, time: .shortened))")
                    .font(.caption).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
            }
            EngineLabel(name: review.engineName.isEmpty ? coach.engineName : review.engineName)
        }
        .museCard()
    }

    private func statusBadge(_ status: CoachReview.Status) -> some View {
        let (text, color): (String, Color) = switch status {
        case .pending: ("Pending", MuseStyle.lime)
        case .approved: ("Approved", MuseStyle.good)
        case .dismissed: ("Dismissed", MuseStyle.ghost)
        }
        return Text(text).font(.caption2.weight(.bold)).foregroundStyle(color)
            .padding(.horizontal, 8).padding(.vertical, 3)
            .overlay(Capsule().stroke(color.opacity(0.6)))
    }

    private func decisionButton(_ title: String, symbol: String, filled: Bool, action: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            Label(title, systemImage: symbol).font(.subheadline.weight(.bold)).frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 44)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .foregroundStyle(filled ? MuseStyle.ink : MuseStyle.text)
        .background(filled ? MuseStyle.lime : MuseStyle.line, in: .capsule)
    }

    private func decide(_ review: CoachReview, _ status: CoachReview.Status) {
        withAnimation { review.decide(status) }
        try? context.save()
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import RacketKit
import SwiftUI

/// Match score keeping. Points come from handle taps (double tap a wide side = won, double tap a narrow
/// side = lost, triple tap = undo), the buttons here, or the Watch.
struct ScoreView: View {
    @Environment(AppModel.self) private var model
    @State private var rules = MatchRules()
    @State private var showTapCalibration = false
    @State private var confirmEnd = false
    @AppStorage(ScoreAnnouncer.enabledKey) private var announce = true

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(spacing: 16) {
                if let match = model.match {
                    if match.score.rules.simpleCount { tapZones(match) } else { scoreboard(match) }
                    pointButtons(match)
                    tapFeedback
                } else {
                    newMatch
                }
                tapGuide
            }
            .padding()
            .frame(maxWidth: 640)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        }
        .navigationTitle("Score")
        .toolbar {
            if model.match != nil {
                ToolbarItem { Button("End match", systemImage: "flag.checkered") { confirmEnd = true } }
            }
        }
        .confirmationDialog("End this match?", isPresented: $confirmEnd) {
            Button("End match", role: .destructive) { model.endMatch() }
        }
        .sheet(isPresented: $showTapCalibration) {
            TapCalibrationView()
                #if os(macOS)
                .frame(minWidth: 480, minHeight: 520)
                #endif
        }
    }

    // MARK: Scoreboard

    private func scoreboard(_ match: ScoreTracker) -> some View {
        let s = match.score
        let simple = s.rules.simpleCount
        return VStack(spacing: 12) {
            Grid(horizontalSpacing: 14, verticalSpacing: 10) {
                GridRow {
                    Text("").gridColumnAlignment(.leading)
                    ForEach(s.sets.indices, id: \.self) { i in Text("Set \(i + 1)") }
                    if s.winner == nil {
                        if !simple { Text(s.isMatchTiebreak ? "" : "Games") }
                        Text(s.isTiebreak ? "Tiebreak" : "Points")
                    }
                }
                .font(.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                ForEach(Player.allCases, id: \.self) { p in
                    GridRow {
                        HStack(spacing: 6) {
                            if s.winner == p { Image(systemName: "trophy.fill").foregroundStyle(.yellow) }
                            Text(p == .me ? "You" : "Opponent").font(.headline)
                        }
                        ForEach(s.sets.indices, id: \.self) { i in
                            let set = s.sets[i]
                            Text("\(set[p])")
                                .font(.title3.monospacedDigit())
                                .fontWeight(set[p] > set[p.other] ? .bold : .regular)
                                .foregroundStyle(set[p] > set[p.other] ? .primary : .secondary)
                        }
                        if s.winner == nil {
                            if !simple {
                                Text(s.isMatchTiebreak ? "" : "\(s.games[p])").font(.title2.monospacedDigit().bold())
                            }
                            Text(s.pointCall(p))
                                .font(.system(size: 34, weight: .bold, design: .rounded).monospacedDigit())
                                .foregroundStyle(Color.accentColor)
                                .contentTransition(.numericText())
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            .animation(.snappy, value: s)
            Text(simple ? "Tap a side to add a point" : s.winner == nil ? s.pointText : (s.winner == .me ? "You won the match" : "Your opponent won the match"))
                .font(.subheadline.weight(.medium))
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
        .padding(18)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        .background(.background.secondary, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 20))
    }

    /// Big tap targets: tap the left half for your point, the right half for your opponent's.
    private func tapZones(_ match: ScoreTracker) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 10) {
            ForEach(Player.allCases, id: \.self) { p in
                Button { model.award(p) } label: {
                    VStack(spacing: 4) {
                        Text(p == .me ? "You" : "Opponent").font(.subheadline.weight(.medium))
                        Text("\(match.score.points[p])")
                            .font(.system(size: 64, weight: .bold, design: .rounded).monospacedDigit())
                            .contentTransition(.numericText())
                        Text("Tap +1").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    }
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 130)
                }
                .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
                .tint(p == .me ? .green : .red)
            }
        }
        .animation(.snappy, value: match.score)
    }

    private func pointButtons(_ match: ScoreTracker) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 10) {
            Button { model.award(.me) } label: {
                Label("I won", systemImage: "checkmark").frame(maxWidth: .infinity).padding(.vertical, 6)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent).tint(.green)
            Button { model.award(.opponent) } label: {
                Label("They won", systemImage: "xmark").frame(maxWidth: .infinity).padding(.vertical, 6)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent).tint(.red)
            Button { model.undoPoint() } label: {
                Label("Undo", systemImage: "arrow.uturn.backward").labelStyle(.iconOnly).padding(.vertical, 6)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.bordered)
            .disabled(!match.canUndo)
        }
        .controlSize(.large)
        .disabled(match.score.winner != nil && !match.canUndo)
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var tapFeedback: some View {
        if let f = model.lastTapFeedback {
            HStack(spacing: 10) {
                Image(systemName: f.recognized ? "hand.tap.fill" : "questionmark.circle")
                    .foregroundStyle(f.recognized ? Color.accentColor : .orange)
                Text(f.text).font(.callout)
                Spacer()
                Text(f.date, style: .relative).font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            .padding(12)
            .background(.fill.quaternary, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 12))
            .id(f.id)
            .transition(.opacity)
        }
    }

    // MARK: New match

    private var newMatch: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 14) {
            Image(systemName: "trophy").font(.system(size: 48)).foregroundStyle(Color.accentColor)
            Text("Keep score with the racket").font(.title2.bold())
            Picker("Scoring", selection: $rules.simpleCount) {
                Text("Tennis scoring").tag(false)
                Text("Just count points").tag(true)
            }
            .pickerStyle(.segmented)
            if !rules.simpleCount {
                Picker("Format", selection: $rules.setsToWin) {
                    Text("Best of 3 sets").tag(2)
                    Text("One set").tag(1)
                }
                .pickerStyle(.segmented)
                Toggle("No-ad scoring", isOn: $rules.noAd)
                if rules.setsToWin > 1 {
                    Toggle("Match tiebreak instead of a third set", isOn: $rules.matchTiebreak)
                }
            }
            Button {
                withAnimation(.snappy) { model.startMatch(rules: rules) }
            } label: {
                Label("Start match", systemImage: "play.fill").font(.headline).frame(maxWidth: .infinity).padding(.vertical, 6)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
            .foregroundStyle(.black)

    // MARK: Tap guide

    private var tapGuide: some View {

        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
            Text("Score by tapping the handle").font(.headline)
            guideRow("2.circle.fill", "Double tap a wide side", "You won the point")
            guideRow("2.circle.fill", "Double tap a narrow side", "Your opponent won it")
            guideRow("3.circle.fill", "Triple tap anywhere", "Undo the last point")
            Text("Taps are ignored for a few seconds after each shot, so a rally can't score by accident.")
                .font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)

            HStack {
                Image(systemName: cal.isCalibrated ? "checkmark.seal.fill" : "exclamationmark.triangle.fill")

                     : "Taps not calibrated yet: the sides are guessed from the racket calibration")
                    .font(.callout)
            }
            Button("Calibrate taps…", systemImage: "hand.tap") { showTapCalibration = true }
            Toggle("Read the score out loud", isOn: $announce)
            if let note = connectionNote {
                Text(note).font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
        }
        .padding(16)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .background(.background.secondary, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 18))
    }

    private func guideRow(_ symbol: String, _ gesture: String, _ meaning: String) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 12) {
            Image(systemName: symbol).font(.title2).foregroundStyle(Color.accentColor)
            VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                Text(gesture).font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
                Text(meaning).font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
        }
    }

    /// Why taps might not arrive: no racket, or firmware from before tap support.
    private var connectionNote: String? {
        guard model.sourceKind == .racket, model.isConnected else {
            return "Taps need the racket connected (Settings tab). The buttons work any time."
        }
        if let fw = model.racketStatus?.firmwareVersion, !RacketFirmware.supportsTaps(fw) {
            return "The racket's firmware (\(fw)) predates tap gestures: update it to 1.2 or later."
        }
        return nil
    }
}

enum RacketFirmware {
    /// Tap gestures arrived in firmware 1.2.
    static func supportsTaps(_ version: String) -> Bool {
        let parts = version.split(separator: ".").compactMap { Int($0) }
        guard parts.count >= 2 else { return false }
        return parts[0] > 1 || (parts[0] == 1 && parts[1] >= 2)
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import RacketKit
import SwiftData
import SwiftUI

extension SessionRecord {
    /// Real (non-calibration) shots, counted from the stored type so no shot JSON is decoded.
    /// `summary` decodes every shot, which stalls the UI on sessions with tens of thousands of hits.
    var playableShotCount: Int {
        (shotRecords ?? []).reduce(0) { $0 + ($1.typeRaw == ShotType.calibration.rawValue ? 0 : 1) }
    }
    var hasPlayableShots: Bool {
        (shotRecords ?? []).contains { $0.typeRaw != ShotType.calibration.rawValue }
    }
}

extension View {
    /// The Muse section's card: padded, dark, rounded.
    func museCard() -> some View {
        padding(16)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            .background(MuseStyle.card, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 22))
    }
}

/// Which engine wrote an answer, shown under every Muse feature.
struct EngineLabel: View {
    var name: String

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 6) {
            Circle().fill(name.hasPrefix("Muse") ? MuseStyle.good : MuseStyle.muted).frame(width: 6, height: 6)
            Text(name).font(.caption2).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
        }
        .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
        .accessibilityLabel("Answered by \(name)")
    }
}

/// A match plan against a friend's shared racket totals, or a self-scout (how an opponent would play you).
struct ScoutView: View {
    /// The session to plan from; nil uses the newest session with shots.
    var session: SessionRecord?
    /// The friend's shared totals; nil runs a self-scout.
    var opponent: SharedPlayerStats?
    var opponentName = ""

    @Query(sort: \SessionRecord.startDate) private var sessions: [SessionRecord]
    @Environment(CoachModel.self) private var coach
    @State private var report = ""
    @State private var engine = ""

    private var source: SessionRecord? { session ?? sessions.last { $0.hasPlayableShots } }
    private var isSelfScout: Bool { opponent == nil }
    private var title: String { isSelfScout ? "Scout yourself" : "Scout \(opponentName)" }

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
                Text(title).font(MuseStyle.display(30)).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
                Text(isSelfScout
                     ? "Muse reads your recent sessions the way an opponent would and predicts where they'd attack."
                     : "Muse sets your session against \(opponentName)'s shared racket totals and predicts how the match plays out.")
                    .font(.subheadline).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
                if let opponent { opponentCard(opponent) }
                reportCard
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 16)
            .padding(.bottom, 16)
        }
        .navigationTitle("")
        .museScreen()
    }

    private func opponentCard(_ stats: SharedPlayerStats) -> some View {
        let units = UnitSystem.current
        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
            Text("\(opponentName.uppercased()) · SHARED TOTALS").font(MuseStyle.eyebrow).tracking(2)
                .foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                StatTile(label: "Shots", value: "\(stats.shots)")
                StatTile(label: "Sweet spot", value: "\(Int(stats.sweetPercent))", unit: "%")
                if let avg = stats.averageBallKmh {
                    StatTile(label: "Avg ball", value: "\(Int(units.speed(avg).rounded()))", unit: units.speedUnit)
                }
            }
            Text("Shared by their racket, not measured by yours.").font(.caption2).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.ghost)
        }
        .museCard()
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var reportCard: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
            Text("MATCH PLAN").font(MuseStyle.eyebrow).tracking(2).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
            if report.isEmpty {
                Text(source == nil ? "Play a session first, then scout." : "Muse writes a short plan: how you match up, what to lean on, what to avoid.")
                    .foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
            } else {
                Text(report).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text).textSelection(.enabled)
            }
            Button(action: run) {
                HStack {
                    if coach.isWorking { ProgressView().controlSize(.small).tint(MuseStyle.ink) }
                    Text(report.isEmpty ? "Write the plan" : "Write it again")
                }
                .font(.subheadline.weight(.bold)).frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 44)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.ink)
            .background(MuseStyle.lime, in: .capsule)
            .disabled(coach.isWorking || source == nil)
            .opacity(coach.isWorking || source == nil ? 0.6 : 1)
            EngineLabel(name: engine.isEmpty ? coach.engineName : engine)
        }
        .museCard()
    }

    private func run() {
        guard let source, !coach.isWorking else { return }
        Task {
            report = await coach.scout(source, opponent: opponent, opponentName: opponentName)
            engine = coach.engineName
        }
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import QuartzCore
import RacketKit
import SceneKit
import SwiftUI
import simd

/// What the animation shows. Changed from SwiftUI; read on SceneKit's render thread.
struct SwingShow: Equatable {
    enum Mode: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable { case auto = "Both", yours = "Yours", change = "Change"; var id: String { rawValue } }
    var before: ShotSimulator.Parameters
    var after: ShotSimulator.Parameters
    var beforeBall: (kmh: Double, rpm: Double)
    var afterBall: (kmh: Double, rpm: Double)
    var stroke: ShotType
    var mode: Mode = .auto

    var hasChange: Bool { before != after }

    static func == (a: SwingShow, b: SwingShow) -> Bool {
        a.before == b.before && a.after == b.after && a.stroke == b.stroke && a.mode == b.mode
    }

    /// Fixed timing (same for every film): 2.6 s per half, contact 1.1 s in, 0.16x slow motion.
    static let half = 2.6, contactAt = 1.1, slowMo = 0.16

    /// Which half is playing and the real time from contact, at `clock` seconds since the start.
    func frame(_ clock: Double) -> (changed: Bool, t: Double) {
        let both = mode == .auto && hasChange
        let u = clock.truncatingRemainder(dividingBy: both ? 2 * Self.half : Self.half)
        let changed = both ? u >= Self.half : (mode == .change && hasChange)
        return (changed, ((both && changed ? u - Self.half : u) - Self.contactAt) * Self.slowMo)
    }
}

/// SceneKit side of the animation: builds the fixed set once, then poses it every frame.
final class SwingStage: NSObject, SCNSceneRendererDelegate, @unchecked Sendable {
    let scene = SCNScene()
    let camera = SCNNode()
    private let racket = SCNNode()
    private let ball = SCNNode()
    private let trail = SCNNode()
    private let ghost = SCNNode()
    private let floor = SwingStage.grid()
    private let lock = NSLock()
    private var show: SwingShow
    private var start = CACurrentMediaTime()
    private var ghostKey: ShotSimulator.Parameters?

    static let accent = PlatformColor(red: 0.867, green: 0.910, blue: 0.357, alpha: 1)   // #DDE85B
    static let background = PlatformColor(red: 0.043, green: 0.047, blue: 0.035, alpha: 1) // #0B0C09

    @MainActor
    init(_ show: SwingShow) {
        self.show = show
        super.init()
        scene.background.contents = Self.background
        scene.lightingEnvironment.intensity = 1

        camera.camera = SCNCamera()
        camera.camera?.zNear = 0.05
        camera.camera?.zFar = 30
        scene.rootNode.addChildNode(camera)

        let key = SCNNode()
        key.light = SCNLight()
        key.light?.type = .directional
        key.light?.intensity = 1100
        key.eulerAngles = SCNVector3(-0.9, -0.5, 0)
        let fill = SCNNode()
        fill.light = SCNLight()
        fill.light?.type = .ambient
        fill.light?.intensity = 260
        let rim = SCNNode()
        rim.light = SCNLight()
        rim.light?.type = .omni
        rim.light?.color = Self.accent
        rim.light?.intensity = 900
        rim.position = SCNVector3(-0.8, 0.6, -1.6)
        [key, fill, rim].forEach(scene.rootNode.addChildNode)

        scene.rootNode.addChildNode(floor)
        racket.addChildNode(RacketScene.loadDetailedRacket() ?? Self.simpleRacket())
        let ballMat = SCNMaterial()
        ballMat.diffuse.contents = PlatformColor(red: 0.85, green: 0.93, blue: 0.25, alpha: 1)
        ballMat.emission.contents = PlatformColor(red: 0.16, green: 0.18, blue: 0.04, alpha: 1)
        let sphere = SCNSphere(radius: CGFloat(SwingTemplate.ballRadius))
        sphere.segmentCount = 40
        sphere.materials = [ballMat]
        let seam = SCNNode(geometry: SCNTorus(ringRadius: CGFloat(SwingTemplate.ballRadius) * 1.002, pipeRadius: 0.0024))
        seam.geometry?.firstMaterial?.diffuse.contents = PlatformColor(white: 0.96, alpha: 1)
        seam.geometry?.firstMaterial?.lightingModel = .constant
        seam.eulerAngles.x = .pi / 2
        ball.geometry = sphere
        ball.addChildNode(seam)
        [ghost, trail, racket, ball].forEach(scene.rootNode.addChildNode)
        frame(show.stroke)
    }

    /// Camera and floor for the stroke's fixed shape (a serve is framed from the side, high).
    private func frame(_ stroke: ShotType) {
        let shape = SwingTemplate.shape(stroke)
        camera.simdPosition = shape.camera
        camera.look(at: SCNVector3(shape.target))
        floor.simdPosition = SIMD3(0, shape.floorY, 0)
    }

    /// Fit the whole swing (about 2.2 m wide, 1.2 m tall) in the card: wide cards fit the height, narrow ones the width.
    @MainActor
    func fit(aspect: CGFloat) {
        guard let cam = camera.camera, aspect.isFinite, aspect > 0 else { return }
        cam.projectionDirection = aspect > 1.8 ? .vertical : .horizontal
        cam.fieldOfView = aspect > 1.8 ? 42 : 70
    }

    func update(_ new: SwingShow) {
        lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }
        if new.before != show.before || new.after != show.after || new.mode != show.mode || new.stroke != show.stroke {
            start = CACurrentMediaTime()
        }
        if new.stroke != show.stroke { ghostKey = nil; frame(new.stroke) }
        show = new
    }

    /// Play the loop again from the start.
    func restart() {
        lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }
        start = CACurrentMediaTime()
    }

    /// Seconds since the current loop started, for the SwiftUI labels.
    func clock() -> (SwingShow, Double) {
        lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }
        return (show, CACurrentMediaTime() - start)
    }

    func renderer(_ renderer: any SCNSceneRenderer, updateAtTime time: TimeInterval) {
        let (show, clock) = clock()
        let (changed, t) = show.frame(clock)
        let params = changed ? show.after : show.before
        let pose = SwingTemplate.pose(params, t: t, stroke: show.stroke)
        racket.simdTransform = pose.racket

        // the string bed's path so far; in the changed half, the player's own swing stays as a ghost
        let points = stride(from: -0.32, through: min(t, 0.32), by: 0.0075).map {
            SwingTemplate.pose(params, t: $0, stroke: show.stroke).bed
        }
        trail.geometry = Self.tube(points, radius: 0.008, color: Self.accent)
        let ghostParams: ShotSimulator.Parameters? = changed ? show.before : nil
        if ghostParams != ghostKey {
            ghostKey = ghostParams
            ghost.geometry = ghostParams.flatMap { p in
                Self.tube(stride(from: -0.32, through: 0.32, by: 0.0075).map { SwingTemplate.pose(p, t: $0, stroke: show.stroke).bed },
                          radius: 0.006, color: PlatformColor(red: 0.49, green: 0.51, blue: 0.42, alpha: 0.7))
            }
        }

        // the ball: in toward the strings, then off the face at the estimated speed, spinning
        let b = changed ? show.afterBall : show.beforeBall
        ball.isHidden = t > SwingTemplate.ballShown
        if t < 0 {
            ball.simdPosition = simd_normalize(SIMD3<Float>(1, 0.04, 0)) * Float(params.incomingSpeedKmh / 3.6 * -t)
            ball.simdOrientation = simd_quatf(angle: 0, axis: SIMD3(0, 1, 0))
        } else {
            ball.simdPosition = pose.normal * Float(b.kmh / 3.6 * t)
            let contact = SwingTemplate.pose(params, t: 0, stroke: show.stroke)
            ball.simdOrientation = simd_quatf(angle: -Float(b.rpm / 60 * 2 * .pi * t), axis: contact.up)
        }
        ball.opacity = t > 0 ? CGFloat(1 - t / SwingTemplate.ballShown) : 1
    }

    // MARK: Geometry

    /// A glowing tube through `points`.
    static func tube(_ points: [SIMD3<Float>], radius: Float, color: PlatformColor) -> SCNGeometry? {
        guard points.count >= 2 else { return nil }
        let sides = 8
        var verts: [SCNVector3] = [], normals: [SCNVector3] = [], index: [Int32] = []
        var prevSide = SIMD3<Float>(0, 1, 0)
        for (i, p) in points.enumerated() {
            let a = points[max(i - 1, 0)], b = points[min(i + 1, points.count - 1)]
            let dir = simd_normalize(b - a + SIMD3(0, 0, 1e-6))
            var side = simd_cross(dir, prevSide)
            if simd_length(side) < 1e-4 { side = simd_cross(dir, SIMD3(1, 0, 0)) }
            side = simd_normalize(side)
            let up = simd_cross(side, dir)
            prevSide = up
            for k in 0..<sides {
                let ang = Float(k) / Float(sides) * 2 * .pi
                let nrm = cos(ang) * side + sin(ang) * up
                verts.append(SCNVector3(p + radius * nrm))
                normals.append(SCNVector3(nrm))
            }
        }
        for i in 0..<(points.count - 1) {
            for k in 0..<sides {
                let a = Int32(i * sides + k), b = Int32(i * sides + (k + 1) % sides)
                let c = a + Int32(sides), d = b + Int32(sides)
                index += [a, c, b, b, c, d]
            }
        }
        let geo = SCNGeometry(sources: [SCNGeometrySource(vertices: verts), SCNGeometrySource(normals: normals)],
                              elements: [SCNGeometryElement(indices: index, primitiveType: .triangles)])
        let mat = SCNMaterial()
        mat.lightingModel = .constant
        mat.diffuse.contents = color
        mat.emission.contents = color
        geo.materials = [mat]
        return geo
    }

    /// Floor lines: a fixed reference for "up".
    private static func grid() -> SCNNode {
        var verts: [SCNVector3] = [], index: [Int32] = []
        let y: Float = 0, half: Float = 3, step: Float = 0.25
        for i in stride(from: -half, through: half, by: step) {
            for (a, b) in [(SIMD3(i, y, -half), SIMD3(i, y, half)), (SIMD3(-half, y, i), SIMD3(half, y, i))] {
                index += [Int32(verts.count), Int32(verts.count + 1)]
                verts += [SCNVector3(a), SCNVector3(b)]
            }
        }
        let geo = SCNGeometry(sources: [SCNGeometrySource(vertices: verts)], elements: [SCNGeometryElement(indices: index, primitiveType: .line)])
        let mat = SCNMaterial()
        mat.lightingModel = .constant
        mat.diffuse.contents = PlatformColor(red: 0.16, green: 0.18, blue: 0.13, alpha: 1)
        geo.materials = [mat]
        return SCNNode(geometry: geo)
    }

    /// If the textured model is missing: hoop, throat and handle in the racket frame (tip toward +x).
    private static func simpleRacket() -> SCNNode {
        let mat = SCNMaterial()
        mat.diffuse.contents = PlatformColor(white: 0.15, alpha: 1)
        let hoop = SCNNode(geometry: SCNTorus(ringRadius: 0.125, pipeRadius: 0.009))
        hoop.geometry?.materials = [mat]
        hoop.eulerAngles.x = .pi / 2
        hoop.scale = SCNVector3(1.3, 1, 1)
        hoop.position = SCNVector3(0.512, 0, 0)
        let shaft = SCNNode(geometry: SCNBox(width: 0.36, height: 0.03, length: 0.03, chamferRadius: 0.008))
        shaft.geometry?.materials = [mat]
        shaft.position = SCNVector3(0.18, 0, 0)
        let node = SCNNode()
        [hoop, shaft].forEach(node.addChildNode)
        return node
    }
}

/// The What-if swing: your average stroke, then the same swing with the change, looping in slow motion.
struct SwingAnimationView: View {
    let show: SwingShow
    var title: String?
    var height: CGFloat = 330
    var cornerRadius: CGFloat = 0
    @Binding var mode: SwingShow.Mode
    @State private var stage: SwingStage

    init(show: SwingShow, title: String? = nil, height: CGFloat = 330, cornerRadius: CGFloat = 0,
         mode: Binding<SwingShow.Mode>) {
        self.show = show
        self.title = title
        self.height = height
        self.cornerRadius = cornerRadius
        _mode = mode
        _stage = State(initialValue: SwingStage(show))
    }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack(alignment: .topLeading) {
            GeometryReader { geo in
                SceneView(scene: stage.scene, pointOfView: stage.camera, options: [.rendersContinuously],
                          antialiasingMode: .multisampling4X, delegate: stage)
                    .onChange(of: geo.size, initial: true) { _, size in stage.fit(aspect: size.width / max(size.height, 1)) }
            }
            .accessibilityElement()
            .accessibilityLabel("Animation of your average swing\(show.hasChange ? " and the changed swing" : "")")
            TimelineView(.periodic(from: .now, by: 0.1)) { _ in
                let (current, clock) = stage.clock()
                let changed = current.frame(clock).changed
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                    Text("\(changed ? "TRY THIS" : "YOUR SWING") · \(SwingShow.slowMo.formatted())× SLOW MOTION")
                        .font(MuseStyle.eyebrow).tracking(2).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.lime)
                    if changed, let title { Text(title).font(MuseStyle.display(22)).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text) }
                }
                .padding(16)
            }
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                if show.hasChange {
                    legend("Yours", color: MuseStyle.ghost, selected: mode == .yours) { mode = mode == .yours ? .auto : .yours }
                    legend("Change", color: MuseStyle.lime, selected: mode == .change) { mode = mode == .change ? .auto : .change }
                } else {
                    Text("RACKET DATA ONLY").font(MuseStyle.eyebrow).tracking(1.5).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
                }
                Spacer()
                Button { stage.restart() } label: {
                    Image(systemName: "arrow.counterclockwise").font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
                        .foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text).frame(width: 44, height: 44).background(MuseStyle.card, in: .circle)
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                .accessibilityLabel("Replay")
            }
            .padding(12)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .bottom)
        }
        .frame(height: height)
        .background(MuseStyle.stage)
        .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: cornerRadius))
        .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
        .onChange(of: show, initial: true) { _, new in stage.update(new) }
    }

    /// A legend entry that also focuses the animation on that swing; tap again for both.
    private func legend(_ label: String, color: Color, selected: Bool, action: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            HStack(spacing: 6) {
                Capsule().fill(color).frame(width: 16, height: 4)
                Text(label).font(.caption.weight(.semibold)).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 12).frame(minHeight: 36)
            .background(selected ? MuseStyle.line : MuseStyle.card.opacity(0.85), in: .capsule)
            .overlay(Capsule().stroke(selected ? color : .clear, lineWidth: 1.5))
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(selected ? .isSelected : [])
        .accessibilityHint("Shows only this swing")
    }
}
````````
