````````swift
import RacketKit
import SwiftUI
import simd

/// Records a few taps on each kind of handle side so tap scoring knows which push direction is which.
/// Afterwards every tap shows the side it was read as, to check before a match.
struct TapCalibrationView: View {
    @Environment(AppModel.self) private var model
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss

    enum Step { case wide, narrow, review, test }
    @State private var step: Step = .wide
    @State private var wide: [SIMD3<Float>] = []
    @State private var narrow: [SIMD3<Float>] = []
    @State private var fitted: TapCalibration?
    @State private var lastReading = ""
    @State private var tapPulse = 0

    private let tapsPerSide = 5

    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            VStack(spacing: 20) {
                switch step {
                case .wide:
                    collect(title: "Wide sides", count: wide.count,
                            text: "Tap one of the two wide sides of the handle, the ones parallel to the strings. One firm tap at a time, about a second apart. Use both wide sides.")
                case .narrow:
                    collect(title: "Narrow sides", count: narrow.count,
                            text: "Now tap the two narrow sides, the edges in line with the frame. Same again: one tap at a time, both sides.")
                case .review: review
                case .test: test
                }
            }
            .padding(24)
            .frame(maxWidth: 520)
            .navigationTitle("Calibrate taps")
            .toolbar {
                ToolbarItem(placement: .cancellationAction) { Button("Close") { dismiss() } }
            }
        }
        .onAppear { model.onCalibrationTap = { tap in record(tap) } }
        .onDisappear { model.onCalibrationTap = nil }
    }

    private func collect(title: String, count: Int, text: String) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: 16) {
            Image(systemName: "hand.tap.fill")
                .font(.system(size: 56))
                .foregroundStyle(Color.accentColor)
                .symbolEffect(.bounce, value: tapPulse)
            Text(title).font(.title2.bold())
            Text(text).multilineTextAlignment(.center).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            HStack(spacing: 10) {
                ForEach(0..<tapsPerSide, id: \.self) { i in
                    Circle().fill(i < count ? Color.accentColor : Color.secondary.opacity(0.25)).frame(width: 18, height: 18)
                }
            }
            if !model.isConnected || model.sourceKind != .racket {
                Text("Connect the racket first (Settings tab).").font(.callout).foregroundStyle(.orange)
            }
            if step == .narrow {
                Button("Start over") { restart() }.font(.callout)
            }
        }
    }

    private var review: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 16) {
            if let cal = fitted {
                let good = cal.separationDegrees >= 45
                Image(systemName: good ? "checkmark.seal.fill" : "exclamationmark.triangle.fill")
                    .font(.system(size: 56))
                    .foregroundStyle(good ? .green : .orange)
                Text(good ? "Sides told apart" : "The sides look alike").font(.title2.bold())
                Text(good
                     ? "The wide and narrow sides push the handle \(Int(cal.separationDegrees))° apart. Save, then try a few taps."
                     : "The two kinds of side are only \(Int(cal.separationDegrees))° apart, so taps would be misread. Try again with firmer taps on the middle of each side.")
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                HStack {
                    Button("Redo") { restart() }
                    Button("Save") {
                        model.tapCalibration = cal
                        step = .test
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent).foregroundStyle(.black)
                }
            } else {
                Text("Couldn't fit the taps").font(.title2.bold())
                Button("Redo") { restart() }.buttonStyle(.borderedProminent).foregroundStyle(.black)
            }
        }
    }

    private var test: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 16) {
            Image(systemName: "hand.tap.fill")
                .font(.system(size: 56))
                .foregroundStyle(Color.accentColor)
                .symbolEffect(.bounce, value: tapPulse)
            Text("Try it").font(.title2.bold())
            Text("Tap any side: the app shows how it read the tap. Score taps are ignored while this screen is open.")
                .multilineTextAlignment(.center).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            Text(lastReading.isEmpty ? "Waiting for a tap…" : lastReading)
                .font(.title3.weight(.semibold))
                .padding(14)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                .background(.fill.quaternary, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 12))
            Button("Done") { dismiss() }.buttonStyle(.borderedProminent).foregroundStyle(.black)
        }
    }

    private func record(_ tap: RacketProtocol.TapGesture) {
        tapPulse += 1
        switch step {
        case .wide:
            wide.append(tap.direction)
            if wide.count >= tapsPerSide { step = .narrow }
        case .narrow:
            narrow.append(tap.direction)
            if narrow.count >= tapsPerSide {
                fitted = TapCalibration.fit(wide: wide, narrow: narrow)
                step = .review
            }
        case .review:
            break
        case .test:
            let side = model.effectiveTapCalibration.classify(tap.direction)
            let what = tap.count == 1 ? "Single tap" : tap.count == 2 ? "Double tap" : "Triple tap"
            let command: String
            switch ScoreCommand.from(count: tap.count, side: side?.side) {
            case .won: command = "point to you"
            case .lost: command = "point to your opponent"
            case .undo: command = "undo"
            case nil: command = "not a score tap"
            }
            lastReading = "\(what), \(side?.side.label.lowercased() ?? "unclear side"): \(command)"
        }
    }

    private func restart() {
        wide = []
        narrow = []
        fitted = nil
        step = .wide
    }
}
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "apple/Shared/Views/WhatIfView.swift", "sha256": "575d336268af896655026c83cdf3c142afdef1a877420cadc4ba3ecc858ed97a", "trailing_newline": true} -->

````````swift
import RacketKit
import SwiftData
import SwiftUI

/// Change one thing about your average stroke and see what the racket model estimates, or have Muse find the best
/// change. Same baseline and physics as Muse's `simulate_change` tool (`WhatIf`, `ShotSimulator`).
struct WhatIfView: View {
    @Query(sort: \SessionRecord.startDate) private var sessions: [SessionRecord]
    @Query(filter: #Predicate<WhatIfTrial> { $0.completedAt == nil }) private var pendingTrials: [WhatIfTrial]
    @Environment(CoachModel.self) private var coach
    @Environment(AppModel.self) private var model
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var context
    @AppStorage(UnitSystem.storageKey) private var useMetric = false
    @State private var stroke = ShotType.forehand
    @State private var deltas = WhatIf.Deltas()
    @State private var lever = Lever.speed
    @State private var asked = ""
    @State private var answer = ""
    @State private var filmError = ""
    @State private var mode = SwingShow.Mode.auto
    private var units: UnitSystem { UnitSystem(metric: useMetric) }

    enum Lever: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable { case speed = "Speed", path = "Path", face = "Face", contact = "Contact"; var id: String { rawValue } }

    /// The latest session with at least one swing the model can start from.
    private var session: SessionRecord? { sessions.last { WhatIf.baseline($0.shots) != nil } }

    private func strokes(_ s: SessionRecord) -> [ShotType] {
        [.forehand, .backhand, .serve, .volley].filter { WhatIf.baseline(s.shots, type: $0) != nil }
    }

    var body: some View {
        Group {
            if let session, let type = currentStroke(session), let base = WhatIf.baseline(session.shots, type: type) {
                content(session, type: type, base: base)
            } else {
                ContentUnavailableView("No swings to test yet", systemImage: "slider.horizontal.3",
                    description: Text("Play a session with the racket's motion sensors on, then try changes here."))
            }
        }
        .navigationTitle("What if")
        .toolbar {
            ToolbarItem(placement: .primaryAction) {
                Button("Reset", systemImage: "arrow.counterclockwise") { withAnimation { deltas = WhatIf.Deltas() } }
                    .disabled(deltas.isZero)
            }
        }
        .museScreen()
        .onAppear(perform: applyLastFilm)
    }

    private func currentStroke(_ s: SessionRecord) -> ShotType? {
        let available = strokes(s)
        return available.contains(stroke) ? stroke : available.first
    }

    /// Open on Muse's last film when there is one and nothing has been changed yet.
    private func applyLastFilm() {
        guard deltas.isZero, let film = coach.lastFilm, let session, strokes(session).contains(film.stroke) else { return }
        stroke = film.stroke
        deltas = film.deltas
    }

    /// Muse's film while its change is still on the levers.
    private func currentFilm(_ type: ShotType) -> SwingFilm? {
        coach.lastFilm.flatMap { $0.deltas == deltas && $0.stroke == type ? $0 : nil }
    }

    private func content(_ session: SessionRecord, type: ShotType, base: WhatIf.Baseline) -> some View {
        let impact = model.impactModel
        let after = WhatIf.apply(deltas, to: base.parameters)
        let b = ShotSimulator.simulate(base.parameters, model: impact), a = ShotSimulator.simulate(after, model: impact)
        let film = currentFilm(type)
        let available = strokes(session)
        return ScrollView {
            VStack(spacing: 0) {
                if available.count > 1 { strokeSwitcher(available, selected: type).padding(.horizontal, 16).padding(.bottom, 10) }
                SwingAnimationView(show: SwingShow(before: base.parameters, after: after, beforeBall: (b.ballSpeedKmh, b.spinRPM),
                                                   afterBall: (a.ballSpeedKmh, a.spinRPM), stroke: type, mode: mode),
                                   title: film?.title, mode: $mode)
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
                    if let film {
                        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                            Text(film.cue).font(.headline).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
                            Text(film.why).font(.subheadline).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
                        }
                    }
                    baselineLine(base, type: type, session: session)
                    leverTiles
                    leverEditor
                    results(before: b, after: a, film: film != nil)
                    tryItButton(session, type: type, before: b, after: a)
                    pendingTrialsSection()
                    askAbout(type, session: session)
                }
                .padding(16)
            }
        }
        .safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom) { bestChangeBar(session, type: type, film: film) }
        .sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: deltas)
        .animation(.snappy, value: deltas)
    }

    // MARK: Stroke and baseline

    private func strokeSwitcher(_ available: [ShotType], selected: ShotType) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 0) {
            ForEach(available) { t in
                Button {
                    stroke = t
                    deltas = WhatIf.Deltas()
                } label: {
                    Text(t.label).font(.footnote.weight(t == selected ? .bold : .semibold))
                        .foregroundStyle(t == selected ? MuseStyle.ink : MuseStyle.text.opacity(0.85))
                        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 38)
                        .background(t == selected ? MuseStyle.text : .clear, in: .capsule)
                        .contentShape(.capsule)
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                .accessibilityAddTraits(t == selected ? .isSelected : [])
            }
        }
        .padding(3)
        .background(MuseStyle.card, in: .capsule)
    }

    private func baselineLine(_ base: WhatIf.Baseline, type: ShotType, session: SessionRecord) -> some View {
        let p = base.parameters
        let face = p.faceAngleDeg >= 0 ? "\(Int(p.faceAngleDeg.rounded()))° open" : "\(Int(-p.faceAngleDeg.rounded()))° closed"
        let path = p.pathAngleDeg >= 0 ? "\(Int(p.pathAngleDeg.rounded()))° up" : "\(Int(-p.pathAngleDeg.rounded()))° down"
        return Text("Your average \(type.label.lowercased()): \(base.sampleCount) swings, \(units.speedText(p.swingSpeedKmh)), path \(path), face \(face), contact \(contactText(x: p.contactXcm, y: p.contactYcm)).")
            .font(.caption).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
    }

    private func contactText(x: Double, y: Double) -> String {
        let d = (x * x + y * y).squareRoot()
        guard d >= 0.5 else { return "centered" }
        let dir = abs(y) >= abs(x) ? (y > 0 ? "toward tip" : "toward throat") : (x > 0 ? "right" : "left")
        return "\(units.lengthText(d)) \(dir)"
    }

    // MARK: Levers

    private func value(_ l: Lever) -> (text: String, changed: Bool) {
        func signed(_ v: Double, _ unit: String) -> String { v == 0 ? "0\(unit)" : "\(v > 0 ? "+" : "−")\(abs(v).formatted(.number.precision(.fractionLength(0...1))))\(unit)" }
        switch l {
        case .speed: return (signed(deltas.swingPercent, "%"), deltas.swingPercent != 0)
        case .path: return (signed(deltas.pathDeg, "°"), deltas.pathDeg != 0)
        case .face: return (signed(deltas.faceDeg, "°"), deltas.faceDeg != 0)
        case .contact:
            let d = (deltas.contactXcm * deltas.contactXcm + deltas.contactYcm * deltas.contactYcm).squareRoot()
            return (d == 0 ? "0 \(units.lengthUnit)" : units.lengthText(d), d != 0)
        }
    }

    private var leverTiles: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 8) {
            ForEach(Lever.allCases) { l in
                let v = value(l)
                Button { lever = l } label: {
                    VStack(spacing: 2) {
                        Text(l.rawValue).font(.caption2).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
                        Text(v.text).font(.system(size: 17, weight: .bold, design: .rounded)).monospacedDigit()
                            .foregroundStyle(v.changed ? MuseStyle.lime : MuseStyle.text)
                    }
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 72)
                    .background(lever == l ? MuseStyle.line : MuseStyle.card, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 18))
                    .overlay(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 18)
                        .stroke(v.changed ? MuseStyle.lime : (lever == l ? MuseStyle.muted : MuseStyle.line), lineWidth: 2))
                    .contentShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 18))
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                .accessibilityLabel("\(l.rawValue), \(v.text)")
                .accessibilityAddTraits(lever == l ? .isSelected : [])
            }
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var leverEditor: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 14) {
            switch lever {
            case .speed:
                slider("Swing speed", value: $deltas.swingPercent, limit: WhatIf.Deltas.swingLimit, step: 1) {
                    $0 == 0 ? "same" : "\($0 > 0 ? "+" : "−")\(Int(abs($0)))%"
                }
            case .path:
                slider("Swing path", value: $deltas.pathDeg, limit: WhatIf.Deltas.angleLimit, step: 1) {
                    $0 == 0 ? "same" : "\(Int(abs($0)))° \($0 > 0 ? "more low-to-high" : "flatter")"
                }
            case .face:
                slider("Racket face", value: $deltas.faceDeg, limit: WhatIf.Deltas.angleLimit, step: 1) {
                    $0 == 0 ? "same" : "\(Int(abs($0)))° \($0 > 0 ? "more open" : "more closed")"
                }
            case .contact:
                slider("Tip ↔ throat", value: $deltas.contactYcm, limit: WhatIf.Deltas.contactLimit, step: 0.5) {
                    $0 == 0 ? "same" : "\(units.lengthText(abs($0))) toward \($0 > 0 ? "tip" : "throat")"
                }
                slider("Left ↔ right", value: $deltas.contactXcm, limit: WhatIf.Deltas.contactLimit, step: 0.5) {
                    $0 == 0 ? "same" : "\(units.lengthText(abs($0))) \($0 > 0 ? "right" : "left")"
                }
            }
        }
        .padding(16)
        .background(MuseStyle.card, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 22))
    }

    private func slider(_ title: String, value: Binding<Double>, limit: Double, step: Double,
                        text: @escaping (Double) -> String) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
            HStack {
                Text(title).font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold)).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
                Spacer()
                Text(text(value.wrappedValue)).font(.subheadline).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted).monospacedDigit()
            }
            Slider(value: value, in: -limit...limit, step: step)
                .tint(MuseStyle.lime)
                .accessibilityLabel(title)
                .accessibilityValue(text(value.wrappedValue))
        }
    }

    // MARK: Results

    private func results(before b: ShotSimulator.Result, after a: ShotSimulator.Result, film: Bool) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 14) {
            bar("Ball speed", before: units.speed(b.ballSpeedKmh), after: units.speed(a.ballSpeedKmh), unit: units.speedUnit)
            bar("Spin", before: b.spinRPM, after: a.spinRPM, unit: "rpm",
                note: a.spin == b.spin ? nil : "\(b.spin.label) → \(a.spin.label)")
            Text(film ? "Estimated by the racket's physics model. Picked and tested by Muse."
                      : "Estimated by the racket's physics model on your average swing. Ball flight isn't modeled.")
                .font(.caption).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
        }
        .padding(16)
        .background(MuseStyle.card, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 22))
    }

    private func bar(_ label: String, before: Double, after: Double, unit: String, note: String? = nil) -> some View {
        let top = max(before, after, 1) * 1.15
        let up = after - before
        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
            HStack(alignment: .firstTextBaseline) {
                Text(label).font(.subheadline).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
                Spacer()
                if abs(up) >= 0.5 { Text("\(Int(before.rounded())) → ").font(.subheadline).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted) }
                Text("\(Int(after.rounded())) \(unit)").font(.subheadline.weight(.bold)).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
                    .monospacedDigit().contentTransition(.numericText())
            }
            GeometryReader { geo in
                ZStack(alignment: .leading) {
                    Capsule().fill(MuseStyle.line)
                    Capsule().fill(MuseStyle.ghost).frame(width: geo.size.width * before / top)
                    if abs(up) >= 0.5 {
                        Capsule().fill(up > 0 ? MuseStyle.lime : Color(red: 1, green: 0.6, blue: 0.55))
                            .frame(width: geo.size.width * after / top).opacity(0.9)
                    }
                }
            }
            .frame(height: 10)
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
            if let note { Text(note).font(.caption.weight(.semibold)).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.good) }
        }
    }

    // MARK: Trials

    /// Save the change on the levers so its estimate can be checked against measured play later.
    private func tryItButton(_ session: SessionRecord, type: ShotType, before: ShotSimulator.Result,
                             after: ShotSimulator.Result) -> some View {
        Button { saveTrial(session, type: type, before: before, after: after) } label: {
            Label("Try it: save this change to check later", systemImage: "flag")
                .font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold)).frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 44)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
        .background(MuseStyle.card, in: .capsule)
        .disabled(deltas.isZero)
    }

    private func saveTrial(_ session: SessionRecord, type: ShotType, before: ShotSimulator.Result,
                           after: ShotSimulator.Result) {
        let measured = ShotSummary(WhatIf.usable(session.shots).filter { $0.type == type })
        let ups = [after.spinRPM > before.spinRPM * 1.05 ? "more spin" : nil,
                   after.ballSpeedKmh > before.ballSpeedKmh * 1.05 ? "more pace" : nil].compactMap { $0 }
        context.insert(WhatIfTrial(sessionID: session.id, stroke: type.rawValue,
            goal: ups.isEmpty ? "test a change" : ups.joined(separator: " + "), deltas: deltas,
            predicted: (before.ballSpeedKmh, after.ballSpeedKmh, before.spinRPM, after.spinRPM),
            measuredBefore: (measured.avgBallKmh, measured.avgSpinRPM)))
    }

    private func pendingTrialsSection() -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
            if !pendingTrials.isEmpty {
                Text("Changes you are trying").font(.headline).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
                ForEach(pendingTrials.sorted { $0.createdAt < $1.createdAt }) { trial in
                    HStack {
                        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                            Text(trial.goal.capitalizedFirst).font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
                                .foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
                            Text(WhatIf.describe(trial.deltas, units: units)).font(.caption)
                                .foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
                        }
                        Spacer()
                        if let session = followUpSession(for: trial) {
                            Button("Log follow-up") { logFollowUp(trial, session: session) }
                                .buttonStyle(.plain).font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
                                .foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.lime)
                        }
                    }
                    .padding(12)
                    .background(MuseStyle.card, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 18))
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// The latest session with swings the trial's stroke can be measured on.
    private func followUpSession(for trial: WhatIfTrial) -> SessionRecord? {
        let stroke = ShotType(rawValue: trial.stroke)
        return sessions.last {
            !WhatIf.usable($0.shots).filter { stroke == nil || $0.type == stroke }.isEmpty
        }
    }

    private func logFollowUp(_ trial: WhatIfTrial, session: SessionRecord) {
        let stroke = ShotType(rawValue: trial.stroke)
        let measured = ShotSummary(WhatIf.usable(session.shots).filter { stroke == nil || $0.type == stroke })
        trial.complete(followUpSessionID: session.id, measuredBall: measured.avgBallKmh,
                       measuredSpin: measured.avgSpinRPM)
    }

    // MARK: Muse

    private func askAbout(_ type: ShotType, session: SessionRecord) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
            Button {
                ask("What if I \(WhatIf.describe(deltas, units: units)) on my \(type.label.lowercased())?", session)
            } label: {
                Label("Ask Muse about this change", systemImage: "questionmark.bubble")
                    .font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold)).frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 44)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text)
            .background(MuseStyle.card, in: .capsule)
            .disabled(deltas.isZero || coach.isWorking)
            if !answer.isEmpty {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
                    Text(asked).font(.subheadline.weight(.bold)).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.lime)
                    Text(answer).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.text).textSelection(.enabled)
                    RememberedNotes()
                    Text(coach.engineName).font(.caption2).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted)
                }
                .padding(16)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                .background(MuseStyle.card, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 22))
            }
        }
    }

    private func bestChangeBar(_ session: SessionRecord, type: ShotType, film: SwingFilm?) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: 6) {
            if !filmError.isEmpty {
                Text(filmError).font(.caption).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted).multilineTextAlignment(.center)
            } else if !coach.museAvailable {
                Text("Sign in under Racket → Account to have Muse find the best change.").font(.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.muted).multilineTextAlignment(.center)
            }
            Button { showBestChange(session, type: type) } label: {
                HStack(spacing: 8) {
                    if coach.isWorking { ProgressView().controlSize(.small).tint(MuseStyle.ink) } else { Image(systemName: "sparkles") }
                    Text(coach.isWorking ? "Muse is testing changes…" : film == nil ? "Show me the best change" : "Find another change")
                }
                .font(.headline).foregroundStyle(MuseStyle.ink)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 54)
                .background(MuseStyle.lime.opacity(coach.museAvailable ? 1 : 0.4), in: .capsule)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .disabled(coach.isWorking || !coach.museAvailable)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 16).padding(.top, 8).padding(.bottom, 8)
        .background(MuseStyle.background)
    }

    private func showBestChange(_ session: SessionRecord, type: ShotType) {
        filmError = ""
        Task {
            switch await coach.swingFilm(session, stroke: type) {
            case .success(let made):
                mode = .auto
                withAnimation { deltas = made.deltas }
            case .failure(let error):
                filmError = error.localizedDescription
            }
        }
    }

    private func ask(_ question: String, _ session: SessionRecord) {
        guard !coach.isWorking else { return }
        asked = question
        answer = ""
        Task { answer = await coach.answer(question, session: session) }
    }
}

/// "Muse remembered: …" under an answer, linking to the notes.
struct RememberedNotes: View {
    @Environment(CoachModel.self) private var coach

    var body: some View {
        if !coach.lastRemembered.isEmpty {
            NavigationLink { MemoryView() } label: {
                Label {
                    Text("Muse remembered: " + coach.lastRemembered.joined(separator: " · ")).font(.caption)
                } icon: { Image(systemName: "brain") }
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
    }
}

extension String {
    var capitalizedFirst: String { prefix(1).uppercased() + dropFirst() }
}
````````

````````swift
import XCTest
import RacketKit

@MainActor
final class CoachPlanTests: XCTestCase {
    func shot(date: Date, speed: Double = 90, type: ShotType = .forehand, x: Double = 1, y: Double = 2) -> ShotMetrics {
        ShotMetrics(date: date, type: type, swingSpeedKmh: speed, ballSpeedKmh: speed * 1.4,
            spinRPM: 1600, spin: .topspin, faceAngleDeg: 0, swingPathDeg: 20,
            impactXcm: x, impactYcm: y, peakG: 100, gyroSaturated: false,
            features: ImpactFeatures(rollRatio: 0, ringNorm: 0, jolt: 0, impulse: 5))
    }

    func session(speeds: [Double] = [100, 100, 100, 100], weakBackhand: Bool = false) -> SessionRecord {
        let s = SessionRecord(startDate: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1000))
        s.endDate = s.startDate.addingTimeInterval(60)
        var recs = speeds.enumerated().map { i, v in
            ShotRecord(metrics: shot(date: s.startDate.addingTimeInterval(Double(i)), speed: v))
        }
        if weakBackhand {
            recs += [ShotRecord(metrics: shot(date: s.startDate, speed: 90, type: .backhand, x: 8, y: 8)),
                     ShotRecord(metrics: shot(date: s.startDate, speed: 90, type: .backhand, x: 8, y: 8))]
        }
        s.shotRecords = recs
        return s
    }

    func opponent() -> ScoutOpponent {
        ScoutOpponent(name: "Rival", shots: 50, sweetPercent: 70, avgBall: 120, topBall: 150, speedUnit: "km/h")
    }

    func testScoutPromptCarriesOpponentBlock() {
        let d = SessionDigest(session: session())
        let p = CoachPrompts.scout(d, opponent: opponent())
        XCTAssertTrue(p.contains("Rival: 50 shots, 70% sweet spot"))
        XCTAssertTrue(p.contains("match plan"))
        XCTAssertTrue(p.contains("shared totals, not your measurements"))
    }

    func testSelfScoutPromptUsesCompareTools() {
        let d = SessionDigest(session: session())
        let p = CoachPrompts.scout(d, opponent: nil)
        XCTAssertTrue(p.contains("compare_sessions"))
        XCTAssertFalse(p.contains("shared totals (given"))
    }

    func testTemplateScoutComparesSweetSpot() async throws {
        let d = SessionDigest(session: session())
        let text = try await TemplateCoach().scout(d, opponent: opponent())
        XCTAssertTrue(text.contains("Rival"))
        XCTAssertTrue(text.contains("shared totals"))
    }

    func testTemplateScoutSelfScoutWithoutOpponent() async throws {
        let d = SessionDigest(session: session(weakBackhand: true))
        let text = try await TemplateCoach().scout(d, opponent: nil)
        XCTAssertTrue(text.contains("backhand"))
    }

    func testPracticePlanParsesThreeSteps() async throws {
        let d = SessionDigest(session: session(weakBackhand: true))
        let text = try await TemplateCoach().plan(d)
        let plan = PracticePlan.parse(text, sessionID: UUID())
        XCTAssertEqual(plan.steps.count, 3)
        XCTAssertEqual(plan.steps.map(\.drill.target), [10, 8, 20])
        XCTAssertEqual(plan.steps[2].drill.criterion, .any)
        XCTAssertFalse(plan.steps[0].note.isEmpty)
    }

    func testPracticePlanToleratesGarbage() {
        let plan = PracticePlan.parse("just some words", sessionID: UUID())
        XCTAssertEqual(plan.steps.count, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(plan.title, "Next practice")
    }

    func testPracticePlanPromptFormat() {
        let d = SessionDigest(session: session())
        let p = CoachPrompts.plan(d)
        XCTAssertTrue(p.contains("STEP 1:") && p.contains("STEP 3:"))
        XCTAssertTrue(p.contains("NOTE:"))
    }

    func testReviewFlagsParse() {
        let (flags, clear) = ReviewFlag.parseAll(
            "FLAG: Late fade\nDETAIL: Speed dropped 150 to 138 km/h.\nEVIDENCE: thirds 150->138 km/h\n" +
            "FLAG: Backhand contact\nDETAIL: Only 30% sweet.\nEVIDENCE: backhand 30% sweet")
        XCTAssertNil(clear)
        XCTAssertEqual(flags.count, 2)
        XCTAssertEqual(flags[0].label, "Late fade")
        XCTAssertTrue(flags[0].evidence.contains("138"))
    }

    func testReviewClearParses() {
        let (flags, clear) = ReviewFlag.parseAll("CLEAR: Steady session.")
        XCTAssertTrue(flags.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertEqual(clear, "Steady session.")
    }

    func testTemplateReviewFlagsFatigue() async throws {
        let d = SessionDigest(session: session(speeds: [120, 120, 100, 100, 60, 60]))
        let text = try await TemplateCoach().review(d)
        XCTAssertTrue(text.contains("FLAG: Late fade"))
        let (flags, _) = ReviewFlag.parseAll(text)
        XCTAssertEqual(flags.count, 1)
    }

    func testTemplateReviewClearWhenSteady() async throws {
        let d = SessionDigest(session: session())
        let text = try await TemplateCoach().review(d)
        XCTAssertTrue(text.hasPrefix("CLEAR:"))
    }

    func testCoachReviewDecide() {
        let r = CoachReview(sessionID: UUID(), flags: [ReviewFlag(label: "X", detail: "Y", evidence: "Z")])
        XCTAssertEqual(r.status, .pending)
        XCTAssertEqual(r.flags.count, 1)
        XCTAssertFalse(r.isClear)
        r.decide(.approved)
        XCTAssertEqual(r.status, .approved)
        XCTAssertNotNil(r.reviewedAt)
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import XCTest
import RacketKit

@MainActor
final class CoachToolsTests: XCTestCase {
    func shot(date: Date, speed: Double = 90, type: ShotType = .forehand) -> ShotMetrics {
        ShotMetrics(date: date, type: type, swingSpeedKmh: speed, ballSpeedKmh: speed * 1.4,
            spinRPM: 1600, spin: .topspin, faceAngleDeg: 0, swingPathDeg: 20,
            impactXcm: 1, impactYcm: 2, peakG: 100, gyroSaturated: false,
            features: ImpactFeatures(rollRatio: 0, ringNorm: 0, jolt: 0, impulse: 5))
    }
    func fixture() -> (SessionRecord, SessionRecord, CoachTools) {
        let a = SessionRecord(startDate: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1000))
        a.endDate = a.startDate.addingTimeInterval(60)
        a.averageHeartRate = 150
        a.shotRecords = [ShotRecord(metrics: shot(date: a.startDate, speed: 80))]
        let b = SessionRecord(startDate: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 2000))
        b.endDate = b.startDate.addingTimeInterval(60)
        b.shotRecords = [ShotRecord(metrics: shot(date: b.startDate, speed: 100)),
                        ShotRecord(metrics: .fromMic(sweet: false, offCenterPercent: 80, date: b.startDate)),
                        ShotRecord(metrics: shot(date: b.startDate, type: .calibration))]
        return (a, b, CoachTools(current: b, app: nil, units: .init(metric: true), sessions: { [a, b] }))
    }
    func object(_ tools: CoachTools, _ name: String, _ args: String = "{}") throws -> [String: Any] {
        try JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: Data(tools.execute(name: name, arguments: args).utf8)) as! [String: Any]
    }
    func testFilteringAndMissingMotion() throws {
        let (_, _, tools) = fixture()
        let query = try object(tools, "query_shots")
        XCTAssertEqual(query["count"] as? Int, 2)
        XCTAssertEqual(query["motion_count"] as? Int, 1)
        let metrics = query["metrics"] as! [String: [String: Any]]
        XCTAssertEqual(metrics["swing_speed"]?["mean"] as? Double, 100)
        let hit = try object(tools, "query_shots", "{\"type\":\"hit\",\"metric\":\"spin\"}")
        let hitMetrics = hit["metrics"] as! [String: [String: Any]]
        XCTAssertTrue(hitMetrics["spin"]?["mean"] is NSNull)
        let empty = try object(tools, "query_shots", "{\"from\":\"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z\"}")
        XCTAssertEqual(empty["count"] as? Int, 0)
        XCTAssertTrue(empty["sweet_spot_percent"] is NSNull)
    }
    func testComparisonCatalogAndHealthExclusion() throws {
        let (_, _, tools) = fixture()
        let result = try object(tools, "compare_sessions", "{\"a\":\"previous\",\"b\":\"current\"}")
        let delta = result["b_minus_a"] as! [String: [String: Any]]
        XCTAssertEqual(delta["swing_speed"]?["value"] as? Double, 20)
        let digest = try object(tools, "get_session_digest")
        XCTAssertEqual((digest["sessions"] as? [[String: Any]])?.count, 2)
        XCTAssertNil((result["a"] as? [String: Any])?["averageHeartRate"])
        let currentDigest = digest["digest"] as! [String: Any]
        let hit = (currentDigest["strokes"] as! [[String: Any]]).first { $0["type"] as? String == "Hit" }!
        XCTAssertTrue(hit["avgBallSpeed"] is NSNull)
        XCTAssertTrue(hit["avgContactTowardTip"] is NSNull)
    }
    func testSystemPromptRequiresEstimatedOnSimulationNumbers() {
        XCTAssertTrue(MuseCoach.systemPrompt.contains("Every sentence stating a simulation number must contain the word estimated."))
        XCTAssertTrue(MuseCoach.systemPrompt.contains("re-simulate your final recommendation last so its numbers are verified."))
        XCTAssertTrue(MuseCoach.systemPrompt.contains("never answer a fix-it question from the digest alone."))
        XCTAssertTrue(MuseCoach.systemPrompt.contains("simulate a larger change before answering"))
        XCTAssertTrue(MuseCoach.systemPrompt.contains("simulate at least two sizes of the change at once"))
        XCTAssertTrue(MuseCoach.systemPrompt.contains("never do arithmetic on them"))
        XCTAssertTrue(MuseCoach.systemPrompt.contains("or why shots feel wrong"))
        XCTAssertTrue(MuseCoach.systemPrompt.contains("whose verdict clears the bar"))
    }
    func testValidationErrorsStayInToolResults() throws {
        let (_, _, tools) = fixture()
        for (name, args) in [("unknown", "{}"), ("query_shots", "[]"), ("query_shots", "{bad"),
            ("query_shots", "{\"type\":\"bogus\"}"), ("query_shots", "{\"from\":\"yesterday\"}"),
            ("compare_sessions", "{}"), ("query_shots", "{\"session\":\"bogus\"}"),
            ("simulate_change", "{\"face_deg\":true}"), ("get_live_state", "{}"),
            ("query_shots", "{\"from\":\"2026-01-02T00:00:00Z\",\"to\":\"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z\"}")] {
            XCTAssertNotNil(try object(tools, name, args)["error"], "\(name) \(args)")
        }
    }
    func testSimulationUsesPlayerBaselineAndClampsDeltas() throws {
        let (_, _, tools) = fixture()
        let result = try object(tools, "simulate_change", "{\"swing_percent\":999,\"face_deg\":100}")
        XCTAssertEqual(result["estimated"] as? Bool, true)
        XCTAssertEqual(result["sample_count"] as? Int, 1)
        let after = result["after"] as! [String: Any]
        let parameters = after["applied_parameters"] as! [String: Any]
        XCTAssertEqual(parameters["swingSpeedKmh"] as? Double, 130)
        XCTAssertEqual(parameters["faceAngleDeg"] as? Double, 15)
        let limits = result["limits"] as! [String: Any]
        XCTAssertEqual(limits["swing_percent"] as? Double, 30)
        XCTAssertEqual(limits["face_deg"] as? Double, 15)
        XCTAssertEqual(limits["path_deg"] as? Double, 15)
        XCTAssertEqual(limits["contact_x_cm"] as? Double, 5)
        XCTAssertEqual(limits["contact_y_cm"] as? Double, 5)
        let before = result["before"] as! [String: Any]
        let delta = result["delta"] as! [String: Any]
        XCTAssertEqual(delta["ball_speed"] as! Double,
                       (after["ball_speed"] as! Double) - (before["ball_speed"] as! Double))
        XCTAssertEqual(delta["spin_rpm"] as! Double,
                       (after["spin_rpm"] as! Double) - (before["spin_rpm"] as! Double))
        let gain = result["gain"] as! [String: Any]
        XCTAssertEqual(gain["spin"] as? String, "small") // +15 deg opens the face, killing brush
        XCTAssertEqual(gain["pace"] as? String, "decisive")
        XCTAssertEqual(gain["contact"] as? String, "off_center") // contact (1, 2) is 2.24 cm out
        XCTAssertNotNil(try object(tools, "simulate_change", "{\"type\":\"hit\"}")["error"])
    }
    func testListShotsFiltersOrdersAndLimits() throws {
        let (_, _, tools) = fixture()

        XCTAssertEqual(newest["matching"] as? Int, 3)
        XCTAssertEqual(newest["returned"] as? Int, 2)
        let shots = newest["shots"] as! [[String: Any]]
        XCTAssertEqual(shots.first?["time"] as? String, "1970-01-01T00:33:20Z")
        let micOnly = shots.first { $0["has_motion"] as? Bool == false }!
        XCTAssertTrue(micOnly["ball_speed"] is NSNull)
        let oldest = try object(tools, "list_shots", "{\"session\":\"all\",\"order\":\"oldest\",\"type\":\"forehand\"}")
        XCTAssertEqual(((oldest["shots"] as! [[String: Any]]).first?["swing_speed"] as? Double), 80)
        let sweet = try object(tools, "list_shots", "{\"contact\":\"sweet_spot\"}")

        XCTAssertNotNil(try object(tools, "list_shots", "{\"order\":\"sideways\"}")["error"])
    }
    func testLiveSensorsAndStatusComeFromTheRacket() throws {
        let (_, b, _) = fixture()
        let now = Date()
        let flat = simd_quatf(angle: 0, axis: SIMD3(0, 0, 1))

        }

        let offline = CoachTools(current: b, app: nil,

        XCTAssertNotNil(try object(offline, "read_live_sensors")["error"])
        XCTAssertTrue(try object(offline, "get_racket_status")["hardware"] is NSNull)
    }
    func testNotesRecallSaveAndLimits() throws {
        let (_, b, _) = fixture()

        let old = CoachNote(playerID: player, text: "Sore right elbow last spring", category: .injury)
        old.updatedAt = Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 0)
        let memory = CoachMemory.inMemory([old, CoachNote(playerID: player, text: "Wants a heavier kick serve", category: .goal)],
                                          playerID: player)
        let tools = CoachTools(current: b, app: nil, memory: memory, sessions: { [b] })

        XCTAssertEqual(injury.first?["text"] as? String, "Sore right elbow last spring")
        XCTAssertEqual(try object(tools, "recall_notes", "{\"query\":\"elbow pain\"}")["matching"] as? Int, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(try object(tools, "remember_note", "{\"text\":\"wants a heavier kick serve\",\"category\":\"goal\"}")["saved"] as? Bool, false)
        XCTAssertNotNil(try object(tools, "remember_note", "{\"text\":\"ok\",\"category\":\"goal\"}")["error"])
        XCTAssertNotNil(try object(tools, "remember_note", "{\"text\":\"Rushes backhand\",\"category\":\"mood\"}")["error"])
        XCTAssertEqual(try object(tools, "remember_note", "{\"text\":\"Rushes the backhand when tired\",\"category\":\"technique\"}")["saved"] as? Bool, true)
        XCTAssertEqual(try object(tools, "remember_note", "{\"text\":\"Prefers morning sessions\",\"category\":\"preference\"}")["saved"] as? Bool, true)
        XCTAssertNotNil(try object(tools, "remember_note", "{\"text\":\"A third note\",\"category\":\"other\"}")["error"])
        XCTAssertEqual(try memory.notes().filter(\.addedByCoach).count, 2)
        let off = CoachTools(current: b, app: nil, sessions: { [b] })
        XCTAssertNotNil(try object(off, "recall_notes")["error"])
        XCTAssertNotNil(try object(off, "remember_note", "{\"text\":\"Anything at all\",\"category\":\"other\"}")["error"])
    }
    func testWhatIfScreenMatchesTheTool() throws {
        let (_, b, tools) = fixture()
        let result = try object(tools, "simulate_change", "{\"swing_percent\":-5,\"face_deg\":3}")
        let after = (result["after"] as! [String: Any])["applied_parameters"] as! [String: Any]

        let p = WhatIf.apply(.init(swingPercent: -5, faceDeg: 3), to: base.parameters)

@MainActor
final class MuseLoopTests: XCTestCase {
    final class Fake: MuseTransport {
        var requests: [([[String: Any]], [[String: Any]])] = []
        var reply: [String: Any] = ["role": "assistant", "content": "A Muse answer."]
        var toolRounds = 0
        var fail = false
        func complete(messages: [[String: Any]], tools: [[String: Any]]) async throws -> [String: Any] {
            requests.append((messages, tools))
            if fail { throw MuseError.http(429) }
            if toolRounds > 0 {
                toolRounds -= 1
                return ["role": "assistant", "content": NSNull(), "reasoning_content": "opaque test context", "tool_calls": [
                    ["id": "query", "type": "function", "function": ["name": "query_shots", "arguments": "{}"]],
                    ["id": "bad", "type": "function", "function": ["name": "unknown", "arguments": "{}"]]]]
            }
            return reply
        }
    }
    func testToolRoundReplaysAssistantAndEveryResult() async throws {
        let fake = Fake(); fake.toolRounds = 1
        let s = SessionRecord()
        let tools = CoachTools(current: s, app: nil, sessions: { [s] })
        let coach = MuseCoach(client: fake, tools: tools)
        let text = try await coach.answer("How was my shot?", digest: SessionDigest(session: s))
        XCTAssertEqual(text, "A Muse answer.")
        XCTAssertEqual(fake.requests.count, 2)
        let history = fake.requests[1].0
        XCTAssertTrue(history.contains { $0["reasoning_content"] as? String == "opaque test context" })
        let results = history.filter { ["query", "bad"].contains($0["tool_call_id"] as? String ?? "") }
        XCTAssertEqual(results.count, 2)
        XCTAssertTrue(results.contains { ($0["content"] as? String)?.contains("error") == true })
        XCTAssertFalse(try CoachTools.json(history).contains("averageHeartRate"))
    }
    func testQuestionsLetTheAgentFetchItsOwnData() async throws {
        let fake = Fake()
        let s = SessionRecord()
        let coach = MuseCoach(client: fake, tools: CoachTools(current: s, app: nil, sessions: { [s] }))
        _ = try await coach.answer("How was my backhand?", digest: SessionDigest(session: s))
        let first = fake.requests[0]
        XCTAssertEqual(first.0.map { $0["role"] as? String }, ["system", "user"])
        XCTAssertTrue((first.0[1]["content"] as? String)?.contains("How was my backhand?") == true)
        let names = first.1.compactMap { ($0["function"] as? [String: Any])?["name"] as? String }
        for tool in ["list_shots", "read_live_sensors", "get_racket_status", "recall_notes", "remember_note"] {
            XCTAssertTrue(names.contains(tool), tool)
        }
        _ = try await coach.summarize(SessionDigest(session: s))
        XCTAssertEqual(fake.requests[1].0.count, 4)   // summaries still start from the digest
    }
    func testRoundLimitStopsEvenIfModelKeepsCallingTools() async {
        let fake = Fake(); fake.toolRounds = 100
        let s = SessionRecord()
        let coach = MuseCoach(client: fake, tools: CoachTools(current: s, app: nil, sessions: { [s] }))
        do { _ = try await coach.drill(SessionDigest(session: s)); XCTFail("Expected limit") }
        catch { XCTAssertTrue(error is MuseError) }
        XCTAssertEqual(fake.requests.count, 5)
        XCTAssertTrue(fake.requests.last!.1.isEmpty)
    }
    func testEmptyAnswerAndTransportFailurePropagate() async {
        let fake = Fake(); fake.reply = ["role": "assistant", "content": " "]
        let s = SessionRecord()
        let coach = MuseCoach(client: fake, tools: CoachTools(current: s, app: nil, sessions: { [s] }))
        do { _ = try await coach.summarize(SessionDigest(session: s)); XCTFail() } catch {}
        fake.fail = true
        do { _ = try await coach.summarize(SessionDigest(session: s)); XCTFail() } catch {}
    }
}

@MainActor
final class CoachFallbackTests: XCTestCase {
    func testMuseFailureFallsBackAndReportsActualEngine() async {

final class MuseURLProtocol: URLProtocol, @unchecked Sendable {
    static var status = 200
    static var payload = Data()
    static var capturedRequest: URLRequest?
    override class func canInit(with request: URLRequest) -> Bool { true }
    override class func canonicalRequest(for request: URLRequest) -> URLRequest { request }
    override func startLoading() {
        Self.capturedRequest = request
        let response = HTTPURLResponse(url: request.url!, statusCode: Self.status, httpVersion: nil, headerFields: nil)!
        client?.urlProtocol(self, didReceive: response, cacheStoragePolicy: .notAllowed)
        client?.urlProtocol(self, didLoad: Self.payload)
        client?.urlProtocolDidFinishLoading(self)
    }
    override func stopLoading() {}
}

@MainActor
final class MuseClientTests: XCTestCase {
    func client(status: Int = 200, payload: String) -> MuseClient {
        MuseURLProtocol.status = status
        MuseURLProtocol.payload = Data(payload.utf8)
        let config = URLSessionConfiguration.ephemeral
        config.protocolClasses = [MuseURLProtocol.self]
        return MuseClient(endpoint: URL(string: "https://example.supabase.co/functions/v1/muse")!, publishableKey: "pub", accessToken: "user-jwt", session: URLSession(configuration: config))
    }
    func testTextAndToolResponseDecoding() async throws {
        let c = client(payload: #"{"choices":[{"finish_reason":"stop","message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Good contact."}}]}"#)
        let reply = try await c.complete(messages: [["role": "user", "content": "Hello"]], tools: CoachTools.schemas)
        XCTAssertEqual(reply["content"] as? String, "Good contact.")
        let request = MuseURLProtocol.capturedRequest!
        XCTAssertEqual(request.url, c.endpoint)
        XCTAssertEqual(request.value(forHTTPHeaderField: "Authorization"), "Bearer user-jwt")
        XCTAssertEqual(request.value(forHTTPHeaderField: "apikey"), "pub")
        let toolClient = client(payload: #"{"choices":[{"finish_reason":"tool_calls","message":{"role":"assistant","content":null,"tool_calls":[{"id":"1","type":"function","function":{"name":"get_live_state","arguments":"{}"}}]}}]}"#)
        let toolReply = try await toolClient.complete(messages: [], tools: CoachTools.schemas)
        XCTAssertEqual((toolReply["tool_calls"] as? [[String: Any]])?.count, 1)
    }
    func testRateLimitAndTruncatedResponsesThrow() async {
        let rate = client(status: 429, payload: "{}")
        do { _ = try await rate.complete(messages: [], tools: []); XCTFail() }
        catch { XCTAssertEqual(error.localizedDescription, "Muse request failed (HTTP 429).") }
        let truncated = client(payload: #"{"choices":[{"finish_reason":"length","message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Partial"}}]}"#)
        do { _ = try await truncated.complete(messages: [], tools: []); XCTFail() } catch {}
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import Foundation

@MainActor
final class ConsumerFeatureTests: XCTestCase {
    func testSharedScoreUsesWearersPerspectiveThroughDeuceAndUndo() {
        let a = UUID(), b = UUID()
        var state = SharedMatchState(id: UUID(), title: "Singles",
            host: SocialProfile(id: a, name: "Alice", friendCode: ""),
            guest: SocialProfile(id: b, name: "Bob", friendCode: ""), inviteCode: "TEST",
            ended: false, revision: 6, points: [], stats: [])
        for winner in [a, b, a, b, a, b] { state.points.append(SharedPoint(id: UUID(), winner: winner)) }
        XCTAssertEqual(state.tracker(for: a).score.pointText, "Deuce")
        XCTAssertEqual(state.tracker(for: b).score.pointText, "Deuce")
        state.points.append(SharedPoint(id: UUID(), winner: a))
        XCTAssertEqual(state.tracker(for: a).score.pointText, "Ad you")
        XCTAssertEqual(state.tracker(for: b).score.pointText, "Ad opponent")
        state.points.append(SharedPoint(id: UUID(), winner: a))
        XCTAssertEqual(state.tracker(for: a).score.games.me, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(state.tracker(for: b).score.games.opponent, 1)
        state.points.removeLast()
        XCTAssertEqual(state.tracker(for: a).score.pointText, "Ad you")
    }

    func testWorkoutOnlySessionSurvivesAndLateCaloriesUseExactRecord() throws {

        let container = try ModelContainer(for: schema,
            configurations: ModelConfiguration(schema: schema, isStoredInMemoryOnly: true, cloudKitDatabase: .none))
        let app = AppModel()
        defer { app.simulator.stop() }
        app.modelContext = container.mainContext
        app.signedInPlayerName = "Alice"
        app.startSession()
        let first = try XCTUnwrap(app.activeSession)
        first.title = " Evening tennis "
        app.stopSession()
        app.startSession()
        let second = try XCTUnwrap(app.activeSession)
        app.recordHealth(averageHeartRate: 0, calories: 210, sessionID: first.id)
        app.recordHealth(averageHeartRate: 0, calories: 200, sessionID: first.id)
        XCTAssertEqual(first.activeCalories, 210) // A delayed earlier snapshot cannot reduce the total.
        XCTAssertEqual(second.activeCalories, 0)
        XCTAssertEqual(first.title, "Evening tennis")
        XCTAssertEqual(first.playerName, "Alice")
        XCTAssertNotNil(first.endDate)
        XCTAssertEqual(try container.mainContext.fetchCount(FetchDescriptor<SessionRecord>()), 2)
        app.recordHealth(averageHeartRate: .nan, calories: .infinity, sessionID: first.id)
        XCTAssertEqual(first.activeCalories, 210)
        XCTAssertEqual(first.averageHeartRate, 0)
    }

    }
````````

````````swift
import RacketKit
import XCTest

final class InsightsModelTests: XCTestCase {
    private let now = Date()
    private func shot(_ type: ShotType, ball: Double, sweet: Bool = true, motion: Bool = true) -> ShotMetrics {
        var s = ShotMetrics(date: now, type: type, swingSpeedKmh: ball * 0.8, ballSpeedKmh: ball, spinRPM: 1000, spin: .flat,
                            faceAngleDeg: 0, swingPathDeg: 0, impactXcm: 0, impactYcm: sweet ? 1 : 9, peakG: 0,
                            gyroSaturated: false, features: ImpactFeatures(rollRatio: 0, ringNorm: 0, jolt: 0, impulse: 0))
        if !motion { s.micOnly = true }
        return s
    }
    private func session(daysAgo: Double, _ shots: [ShotMetrics]) -> InsightSession {
        InsightSession(id: UUID(), date: now.addingTimeInterval(-daysAgo * 86_400), duration: 600, averageHeartRate: 0, shots: shots)
    }
    private func model(_ s: [InsightSession], stroke: ShotType? = nil, metric: InsightMetric = .ballSpeed) -> InsightsModel {
        InsightsModel(sessions: s, period: .week, stroke: stroke, metric: metric, units: UnitSystem(metric: true), now: now)
    }

    func testRangeAndCalibrationAndMicOnlyAreFiltered() {
        let m = model([session(daysAgo: 1, [shot(.forehand, ball: 100), shot(.forehand, ball: 60),
                                           shot(.calibration, ball: 300), shot(.forehand, ball: 0, motion: false)])])
        XCTAssertEqual(m.points.first?.low, 60)
        XCTAssertEqual(m.points.first?.high, 100)
        XCTAssertEqual(m.periodAverage, 80)
    }

    func testDeltaUsesPreviousPeriodAndStrokeFilter() {
        let m = model([session(daysAgo: 10, [shot(.forehand, ball: 70)]),
                       session(daysAgo: 2, [shot(.forehand, ball: 90), shot(.backhand, ball: 10)])], stroke: .forehand)
        XCTAssertEqual(m.delta, 20)
    }

    func testSweetSpotPercentAndStrokeMinimum() {
        let shots = (0..<5).map { _ in shot(.serve, ball: 100) } + [shot(.volley, ball: 50)]
        let m = model([session(daysAgo: 1, shots)], metric: .sweetSpot)
        XCTAssertEqual(m.points.first?.avg, 100)
        XCTAssertEqual(m.byStroke.map(\.type), [.serve])
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import XCTest
import RacketKit
import simd

@MainActor
final class SwingFilmTests: XCTestCase {
    func args(_ overrides: [String: Any] = [:]) -> [String: Any] {
        ["stroke": "forehand", "swing_percent": 10, "face_deg": 0, "path_deg": 5, "contact_x_cm": 0, "contact_y_cm": 0,
         "title": "Brush up faster", "cue": "Swing quicker and brush up the back of the ball", "why": "Pace and spin together"]
            .merging(overrides) { $1 }
    }
    let tested: Set<SwingFilm.Key> = [SwingFilm.Key(WhatIf.Deltas(swingPercent: 10, pathDeg: 5))]

    func testValidScriptBecomesAFilm() throws {
        let film = try SwingFilm.validate(args(), stroke: .forehand, tested: tested).get()
        XCTAssertEqual(film.deltas, WhatIf.Deltas(swingPercent: 10, pathDeg: 5))
        XCTAssertEqual(film.title, "Brush up faster")
    }

    func testLimitsRejectEveryProblem() {
        guard case .failure(let r) = SwingFilm.validate(args(["swing_percent": 25, "face_deg": 1, "path_deg": 5,
                                                              "title": "Hit 3 more over the net"]), stroke: .forehand, tested: tested)
        else { return XCTFail("accepted") }
        let all = r.reasons.joined(separator: " | ")
        XCTAssertTrue(all.contains("swing_percent=25"))
        XCTAssertTrue(all.contains("face_deg=1"))
        XCTAssertTrue(all.contains("one or two levers"))
        XCTAssertTrue(all.contains("not tested"))
        XCTAssertTrue(all.contains("title must not contain digits"))
        XCTAssertTrue(all.contains("title must not use: net"))
    }

    func testUntestedDeltasAndWrongStrokeAreRejected() {
        guard case .failure(let r) = SwingFilm.validate(args(["path_deg": 6]), stroke: .backhand, tested: tested)
        else { return XCTFail("accepted") }
        XCTAssertTrue(r.reasons.contains("stroke must be backhand"))
        XCTAssertTrue(r.reasons.contains { $0.contains("not tested") })
    }

    func testTemplatePutsTheStringsOnTheBallAtContact() {
        let p = ShotSimulator.Parameters(swingSpeedKmh: 100, pathAngleDeg: 10, faceAngleDeg: 3, contactXcm: 1, contactYcm: -2)
        for stroke in SwingFilm.strokes {
            let pose = SwingTemplate.pose(p, t: 0, stroke: stroke)
            let butt = SIMD3<Float>(pose.racket.columns.3.x, pose.racket.columns.3.y, pose.racket.columns.3.z)
            let r = SIMD3<Float>(pose.racket.columns.0.x, pose.racket.columns.0.y, pose.racket.columns.0.z)
            let across = SIMD3<Float>(pose.racket.columns.1.x, pose.racket.columns.1.y, pose.racket.columns.1.z)
            let contact = butt + SwingTemplate.bedFromButt * r + 0.01 * across - 0.02 * r
            XCTAssertLessThan(simd_length(contact), 1e-4)                      // ball at the origin
            XCTAssertEqual(simd_determinant(pose.racket), 1, accuracy: 1e-4)   // a rotation, not a mirror
            XCTAssertGreaterThan(pose.normal.x, 0.9)                           // face toward the target
            var open = p; open.faceAngleDeg += 5
            XCTAssertGreaterThan(SwingTemplate.pose(open, t: 0, stroke: stroke).normal.y, pose.normal.y, "\(stroke)")
        }
        // the serve meets the ball overhead: the shoulder pivot sits below contact
        let serve = SwingTemplate.pose(p, t: -0.05, stroke: .serve)
        XCTAssertLessThan(serve.bed.y, 0)
    }

    /// Muse tests a change, tries an untested one, gets the reasons back, then makes the tested film.
    final class Director: MuseTransport {
        var step = 0
        var requests: [[[String: Any]]] = []
        func call(_ name: String, _ args: String) -> [String: Any] {
            ["role": "assistant", "content": NSNull(), "tool_calls": [
                ["id": "c\(step)", "type": "function", "function": ["name": name, "arguments": args]]]]
        }
        func complete(messages: [[String: Any]], tools: [[String: Any]]) async throws -> [String: Any] {
            requests.append(messages)
            step += 1
            switch step {
            case 1: return call("simulate_change", #"{"type":"forehand","swing_percent":10,"path_deg":5}"#)
            case 2: return call("make_swing_film", #"{"stroke":"forehand","swing_percent":12,"face_deg":0,"path_deg":5,"contact_x_cm":0,"contact_y_cm":0,"title":"Faster","cue":"Swing quicker","why":"More pace"}"#)
            default: return call("make_swing_film", #"{"stroke":"forehand","swing_percent":10,"face_deg":0,"path_deg":5,"contact_x_cm":0,"contact_y_cm":0,"title":"Faster","cue":"Swing quicker","why":"More pace"}"#)
            }
        }
    }

    func testDirectorRetriesUntilTheFilmIsValid() async throws {
        let s = SessionRecord()
        s.shotRecords = [ShotRecord(metrics: CoachToolsTests().shot(date: s.startDate))]
        let fake = Director()
        let film = try await SwingFilmDirector(client: fake, tools: CoachTools(current: s, app: nil, sessions: { [s] })).direct(.forehand)
        XCTAssertEqual(film.deltas, WhatIf.Deltas(swingPercent: 10, pathDeg: 5))
        XCTAssertEqual(fake.step, 3)
        let rejected = fake.requests[2].last { $0["tool_call_id"] as? String == "c2" }?["content"] as? String
        XCTAssertTrue(rejected?.contains("not tested") == true)
        XCTAssertTrue((fake.requests[0][0]["content"] as? String)?.contains("make_swing_film") == true)
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import Foundation
import Observation
import RacketKit
import SwiftUI
import WatchConnectivity
import WatchKit

@main
struct TennisBuddyWatchApp: App {
    @State private var model = WatchModel()

    var body: some Scene {
        WindowGroup {
            WatchRootView().environment(model)
        }
    }
}

/// Watch side of the link. Receives shots from the iPhone, plays a haptic per shot,
/// and sends start/stop and point results back.
@MainActor
@Observable
final class WatchModel: NSObject, WCSessionDelegate {
    var sessionActive = false
    var sessionID: UUID?
    var sharedScore: ScoreTracker?
    /// The match scored on the iPhone itself (not the shared Together match).
    var localScore: ScoreTracker?
    var sharedScoreActive = false
    var sharedMatchID: UUID?
    var sharedRevision = 0
    var commandInFlight = false
    var commandError: String?
    var lastShot: ShotMetrics?
    var summary: ShotSummary?
    var pointsWon = 0
    var pointsLost = 0
    var phoneReachable = false
    var units = UnitSystem(metric: false)
    var drill: Drill?
    /// When the current session began, for the elapsed timer on the session page.
    var sessionStart: Date?
    let workout = WorkoutManager()

    override init() {
        super.init()
        workout.onFinished = { [weak self] id, average, calories in
            self?.sendHealth(id: id, average: average, calories: calories)
        }
        if WCSession.isSupported() {
            WCSession.default.delegate = self
            WCSession.default.activate()
        }
    }

    func toggleSession() {
        let wasActive = sessionActive
        if !wasActive { sessionID = UUID() }
        send(["cmd": wasActive ? "stop" : "start", "sessionID": sessionID?.uuidString ?? ""])
        setSessionActive(!wasActive)
        WKInterfaceDevice.current().play(sessionActive ? .start : .stop)
    }

    /// Keeps the Tennis workout (heart rate, calories, Apple Health) in step with the racket session.
    func setSessionActive(_ active: Bool) {
        guard active != sessionActive else {
            if active { workout.setActive(true, recordID: sessionID) }
            return
        }
        if active && !sessionActive {
            pointsWon = 0; pointsLost = 0; lastShot = nil; summary = nil
            sessionStart = Date()
        }
        if !active { sessionStart = nil }
        if !active && sessionActive && workout.isRunning { sendHealth() }
        sessionActive = active
        workout.setActive(active, recordID: sessionID)
    }

    private func sendHealth(id: UUID? = nil, average: Double? = nil, calories: Double? = nil) {
        guard let recordID = id ?? sessionID else { return }
        let message: [String: Any] = ["cmd": "health", "sessionID": recordID.uuidString,
            "avgHR": average ?? workout.averageHeartRate, "kcal": calories ?? workout.activeCalories]
        // Queued delivery survives a temporarily unreachable iPhone; the record ID prevents misattribution.
        if WCSession.default.activationState == .activated { WCSession.default.transferUserInfo(message) }
    }

    /// New drill or progress from the iPhone: tap per counted shot, a celebration when it's done.
    func updateDrill(_ data: Data) {
        let new = data.isEmpty ? nil : try? JSONDecoder().decode(Drill.self, from: data)
        if let new, let old = drill, new.id == old.id, new.completed > old.completed {
            WKInterfaceDevice.current().play(new.isDone ? .success : .directionUp)
            if new.isDone {
                DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.4) { WKInterfaceDevice.current().play(.success) }
            }
        } else if let new, new.id != drill?.id {
            WKInterfaceDevice.current().play(.notification)
        }
        drill = new
    }

    func cancelDrill() {
        drill = nil
        send(["cmd": "cancelDrill"])
    }

    func logPoint(won: Bool) {
        guard !commandInFlight else { return }
        if sharedScore != nil && !sharedScoreActive { return }
        if !sharedScoreActive {
            if won { pointsWon += 1 } else { pointsLost += 1 }
        }
        send(["cmd": sharedScoreActive ? "sharedPoint" : "point", "won": won,
              "matchID": sharedMatchID?.uuidString ?? "", "revision": sharedRevision])
        WKInterfaceDevice.current().play(.click)
    }

    private func send(_ message: [String: Any]) {
        guard WCSession.default.activationState == .activated, WCSession.default.isReachable else {
            commandError = "Open Tennis Buddee on your iPhone to sync."
            return
        }
        commandInFlight = true; commandError = nil
        WCSession.default.sendMessage(message, replyHandler: { reply in
            let error = reply["error"] as? String
            Task { @MainActor in
                self.commandInFlight = false
                self.commandError = error?.isEmpty == false ? error : nil
            }
            if let active = reply["sessionActive"] as? Bool {
                let id = (reply["sessionID"] as? String).flatMap(UUID.init(uuidString:))
                Task { @MainActor in
                    if let id { self.sessionID = id }
                    self.setSessionActive(active)
                }
            }
        }, errorHandler: { error in
            Task { @MainActor in self.commandInFlight = false; self.commandError = error.localizedDescription }
        })
    }

    private func handle(_ message: [String: Any]) {
        if message["type"] as? String == "shot", let data = message["shot"] as? Data,
           let shot = try? JSONDecoder().decode(ShotMetrics.self, from: data) {
            lastShot = shot
            if let metric = message["metric"] as? Bool { units = UnitSystem(metric: metric) }
            if let s = message["summary"] as? Data { summary = try? JSONDecoder().decode(ShotSummary.self, from: s) }
            // Crisp tap for a sweet-spot hit, a "retry" buzz for a mishit.
            WKInterfaceDevice.current().play(shot.isSweetSpot ? .success : .retry)
        } else if message["type"] as? String == "session", let active = message["active"] as? Bool {
            if let id = (message["sessionID"] as? String).flatMap(UUID.init(uuidString:)) { sessionID = id }
            setSessionActive(active)
        } else if message["type"] as? String == "localScore", let data = message["score"] as? Data {
            localScore = data.isEmpty ? nil : try? JSONDecoder().decode(ScoreTracker.self, from: data)
        } else if message["type"] as? String == "sharedScore", let data = message["score"] as? Data {
            sharedScore = try? JSONDecoder().decode(ScoreTracker.self, from: data)
            sharedScoreActive = message["active"] as? Bool ?? false
            sharedMatchID = (message["matchID"] as? String).flatMap(UUID.init(uuidString:))
            sharedRevision = message["revision"] as? Int ?? 0
        } else if message["type"] as? String == "drill", let data = message["drill"] as? Data {
            updateDrill(data)
        }
    }

    nonisolated func session(_ session: WCSession, didReceiveMessage message: [String: Any]) {
        nonisolated(unsafe) let msg = message
        Task { @MainActor in self.handle(msg) }
    }

    nonisolated func session(_ session: WCSession, didReceiveApplicationContext ctx: [String: Any]) {
        let active = ctx["sessionActive"] as? Bool
        let drill = ctx["drill"] as? Data
        let recordID = (ctx["sessionID"] as? String).flatMap(UUID.init(uuidString:))
        let score = (ctx["sharedScore"] as? Data).flatMap { try? JSONDecoder().decode(ScoreTracker.self, from: $0) }
        let scoreActive = ctx["sharedScoreActive"] as? Bool ?? false
        let local = (ctx["localScore"] as? Data).flatMap { $0.isEmpty ? nil : try? JSONDecoder().decode(ScoreTracker.self, from: $0) }
        let matchID = (ctx["sharedMatchID"] as? String).flatMap(UUID.init(uuidString:))
        let revision = ctx["sharedRevision"] as? Int ?? 0
        Task { @MainActor in
            if let recordID { self.sessionID = recordID }
            self.sharedScore = score; self.sharedScoreActive = scoreActive
            self.localScore = local
            self.sharedMatchID = matchID; self.sharedRevision = revision
            if let active { self.setSessionActive(active) }
            if let drill { self.updateDrill(drill) }
        }
    }

    nonisolated func session(_ session: WCSession, activationDidCompleteWith state: WCSessionActivationState,
                             error: Error?) {
        let reachable = session.isReachable
        Task { @MainActor in self.phoneReachable = reachable }
    }

    nonisolated func sessionReachabilityDidChange(_ session: WCSession) {
        let reachable = session.isReachable
        Task { @MainActor in self.phoneReachable = reachable }
    }
}

enum WatchPalette {
    static let green = Color(red: 0.188, green: 0.820, blue: 0.345) // #30D158
    static let red = Color(red: 1.0, green: 0.271, blue: 0.231) // #FF453B
    static let orange = Color(red: 1.0, green: 0.620, blue: 0.039) // #FF9E0A
    static let secondary = Color(red: 0.600, green: 0.600, blue: 0.631) // #9999A1
    static let ringTrack = Color.white.opacity(0.18)
    static let sweetSpotBackground = Color(red: 0.059, green: 0.251, blue: 0.122) // #0F401F

struct LastShotPage: View {
    @Environment(WatchModel.self) private var model

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 3) {
            if let shot = model.lastShot {
                HStack {
                    HStack(spacing: 5) {
                        Image(systemName: shot.type.symbol).font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
                        Text(shot.type.label).font(.system(size: 15, weight: .semibold))
                    }
                    Spacer()
                    Circle().fill(shot.isSweetSpot ? WatchPalette.green : WatchPalette.red).frame(width: 10, height: 10)
                }
                Text(model.units.speedValue(shot.ballSpeedKmh))
                    .font(.system(size: 52, weight: .bold, design: .rounded)).monospacedDigit()
                Text("\(model.units.speedUnit) · \(Int(shot.spinRPM)) rpm")
                    .font(.system(size: 12)).foregroundStyle(WatchPalette.secondary)
                if let s = model.summary {
                    Text("\(s.count) shots · \(Int(s.sweetSpotPercent))% sweet spot")
                        .font(.system(size: 10.5)).foregroundStyle(WatchPalette.secondary)
                }
                if model.workout.heartRate > 0 {
                    HStack(spacing: 3) {
                        Image(systemName: "heart").font(.system(size: 10))
                        Text("\(Int(model.workout.heartRate)) bpm")
                    }
                    .font(.system(size: 11)).foregroundStyle(WatchPalette.red)
                }
            } else {
                Image(systemName: "figure.tennis").font(.largeTitle).foregroundStyle(Color.accentColor)
                Text(model.sessionActive ? "Waiting for your first shot" : "Start a session to see shots here")
                    .font(.caption).multilineTextAlignment(.center)
            }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 4)
        .containerBackground(background, for: .tabView)
    }

    /// Solid green after a sweet-spot hit, deep red after a mishit.
    private var background: Color {
        guard let shot = model.lastShot else { return .black }
        return shot.isSweetSpot ? WatchPalette.sweetSpotBackground : WatchPalette.mishitBackground
    }
}

/// The drill countdown: a ring that fills as matching shots land.
struct DrillPage: View {
    @Environment(WatchModel.self) private var model

    var body: some View {
        if let drill = model.drill {
            VStack(spacing: 4) {
                Text(drill.title).font(.system(size: 14, weight: .semibold)).lineLimit(1).minimumScaleFactor(0.7)
                ZStack {
                    Circle().stroke(WatchPalette.ringTrack, lineWidth: 8)
                    Circle().trim(from: 0, to: drill.progress)
                        .stroke(Color.accentColor, style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 8, lineCap: .round))
                        .rotationEffect(.degrees(-90))
                        .animation(.snappy, value: drill.completed)
                    VStack(spacing: 0) {
                        if drill.isDone {
                            Image(systemName: "checkmark").font(.title.bold()).foregroundStyle(WatchPalette.green)
                            Text("Done!").font(.system(size: 10.5)).foregroundStyle(WatchPalette.secondary)
                        } else {
                            Text("\(drill.remaining)").font(.system(size: 34, weight: .bold, design: .rounded))
                                .monospacedDigit()
                            Text("to go").font(.system(size: 10.5)).foregroundStyle(WatchPalette.secondary)
                        }
                    }
                }
                .frame(width: 92, height: 92)
                Text(drill.goal).font(.system(size: 10.5)).foregroundStyle(WatchPalette.secondary)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center).lineLimit(2)
                Button(drill.isDone ? "Close" : "Stop drill") { model.cancelDrill() }
                    .buttonStyle(.plain)
                    .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .medium))
                    .foregroundStyle(drill.isDone ? Color.accentColor : WatchPalette.red)
            }
        }
    }
}

struct PointsPage: View {
    @Environment(WatchModel.self) private var model

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 8) {
            Text((model.sharedScore ?? model.localScore)?.score.pointText ?? "\(model.pointsWon) – \(model.pointsLost)")
                .font(.system(size: 38, weight: .bold, design: .rounded)).monospacedDigit()
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                PointButton(title: "Won", symbol: "checkmark", color: WatchPalette.green) { model.logPoint(won: true) }
                PointButton(title: "Lost", symbol: "xmark", color: WatchPalette.red) { model.logPoint(won: false) }
            }
            .disabled(!(model.sessionActive || model.sharedScoreActive || model.localScore != nil) || (model.sharedScoreActive && !model.phoneReachable) || model.commandInFlight || model.sharedScore?.score.winner != nil || (model.sharedScore != nil && !model.sharedScoreActive))
            .opacity(model.sessionActive || model.sharedScoreActive || model.localScore != nil ? 1 : 0.4)
            if let error = model.commandError { Text(error).font(.caption2).foregroundStyle(.red) }
            if let score = model.sharedScore ?? model.localScore { Text(score.setsText).font(.caption.monospacedDigit()) }
            Text(model.sharedScore != nil ? "Shared score · open Together on iPhone" : "Log each point").font(.system(size: 10.5)).foregroundStyle(WatchPalette.secondary)
        }
    }
}
````````
