````````swift
import Foundation
import HealthKit
import Observation

/// A live tennis workout supplies HealthKit's energy/exercise samples used by Activity rings.
@MainActor
@Observable
final class WorkoutManager: NSObject {
    private(set) var heartRate: Double = 0
    private(set) var activeCalories: Double = 0
    private(set) var averageHeartRate: Double = 0
    private(set) var isRunning = false
    private(set) var isTransitioning = false
    private(set) var statusMessage: String?
    var onFinished: ((UUID?, Double, Double) -> Void)?
    private var desiredID: UUID?
    private var activeID: UUID?

    private let store = HKHealthStore()
    private var session: HKWorkoutSession?
    private var builder: HKLiveWorkoutBuilder?
    private var wantsWorkout = false
    @ObservationIgnored private var transition: Task<Void, Never>?

    /// Serialize start/stop, including a stop received while the authorization sheet is open.
    func setActive(_ active: Bool, recordID: UUID? = nil) {
        wantsWorkout = active
        if active { desiredID = recordID }
        guard transition == nil else { return }
        transition = Task {
            isTransitioning = true
            defer { isTransitioning = false; transition = nil }
            while wantsWorkout != isRunning || (wantsWorkout && activeID != desiredID) {
                if isRunning { await stop() }
                else if wantsWorkout {
                    if !(await start()) { break }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func start() async -> Bool {
        heartRate = 0; activeCalories = 0; averageHeartRate = 0; statusMessage = nil
        guard HKHealthStore.isHealthDataAvailable() else {
            statusMessage = "Health is unavailable on this Watch."
            return false
        }
        do {
            let energy = HKQuantityType(.activeEnergyBurned)
            try await store.requestAuthorization(toShare: [HKObjectType.workoutType(), energy],
                                                 read: [HKQuantityType(.heartRate), energy])
            guard store.authorizationStatus(for: HKObjectType.workoutType()) == .sharingAuthorized else {
                statusMessage = "Allow Tennis Buddee to save workouts in Health settings."
                return false
            }
            guard wantsWorkout else { return false }
            activeID = desiredID
            let config = HKWorkoutConfiguration()
            config.activityType = .tennis
            config.locationType = .unknown // Supports indoor and outdoor courts.
            let session = try HKWorkoutSession(healthStore: store, configuration: config)
            let builder = session.associatedWorkoutBuilder()
            builder.dataSource = HKLiveWorkoutDataSource(healthStore: store, workoutConfiguration: config)
            builder.delegate = self
            session.delegate = self
            self.session = session; self.builder = builder
            let start = Date()
            session.startActivity(with: start)
            try await builder.beginCollection(at: start)
            isRunning = true
            return true
        } catch {
            session?.end(); builder?.discardWorkout()
            session = nil; builder = nil; isRunning = false
            statusMessage = "Workout could not start: " + error.localizedDescription
            return false
        }
    }

    private func stop() async {
        guard let session, let builder else { isRunning = false; return }
        session.end()
        do {
            try await builder.endCollection(at: Date())
            if let stats = builder.statistics(for: HKQuantityType(.activeEnergyBurned)) { update(stats) }
            if let stats = builder.statistics(for: HKQuantityType(.heartRate)) { update(stats) }
            guard try await builder.finishWorkout() != nil else {
                throw NSError(domain: "Workout", code: 1, userInfo: [NSLocalizedDescriptionKey: "No workout was saved."])
            }
            statusMessage = "Tennis workout saved to Health."
        } catch { statusMessage = "Workout could not be saved: " + error.localizedDescription }
        onFinished?(activeID, averageHeartRate, activeCalories)
        self.session = nil; self.builder = nil; isRunning = false
    }

    fileprivate func update(_ stats: HKStatistics) {
        switch stats.quantityType {
        case HKQuantityType(.heartRate):
            let bpm = HKUnit.count().unitDivided(by: .minute())
            heartRate = stats.mostRecentQuantity()?.doubleValue(for: bpm) ?? heartRate
            averageHeartRate = stats.averageQuantity()?.doubleValue(for: bpm) ?? averageHeartRate
        case HKQuantityType(.activeEnergyBurned):
            activeCalories = stats.sumQuantity()?.doubleValue(for: .kilocalorie()) ?? activeCalories
        default: break
        }
    }
}

extension WorkoutManager: HKLiveWorkoutBuilderDelegate, HKWorkoutSessionDelegate {
    nonisolated func workoutBuilder(_ workoutBuilder: HKLiveWorkoutBuilder, didCollectDataOf collectedTypes: Set<HKSampleType>) {
        for type in collectedTypes {
            guard let q = type as? HKQuantityType, let stats = workoutBuilder.statistics(for: q) else { continue }
            Task { @MainActor in
                guard self.builder === workoutBuilder else { return }
                self.update(stats)
            }
        }
    }
    nonisolated func workoutBuilderDidCollectEvent(_ workoutBuilder: HKLiveWorkoutBuilder) {}
    nonisolated func workoutSession(_ workoutSession: HKWorkoutSession, didChangeTo toState: HKWorkoutSessionState,
                                   from fromState: HKWorkoutSessionState, date: Date) {
        if toState == .ended {
            Task { @MainActor in
                guard self.session === workoutSession, self.wantsWorkout else { return }
                self.setActive(false)
            }
        }
    }
    nonisolated func workoutSession(_ workoutSession: HKWorkoutSession, didFailWithError error: Error) {
        Task { @MainActor in
            guard self.session === workoutSession else { return }
            self.statusMessage = "Workout interrupted: " + error.localizedDescription
            self.setActive(false)
        }
    }
}
````````

````````markdown
# Insights page redesign (option F, "Metric explorer")

Replaces the body of `Shared/Views/InsightsView.swift`.
Picture: `insights-f.png`. Static HTML of the same screen: `insights-f.html`. All numbers in both are sample data.

## The idea

One page, three controls, one chart.

1. **Time dropdown** (top right): Last 7 days, Last 30 days, Last 90 days, This year, All time.
2. **Shot type chips**: All, Forehand, Backhand, Serve, Volley. Never show Calibration.
3. **Metric tabs** (scroll sideways, underline marks the pick): Ball speed, Swing speed, Spin, Face, Path, Contact, Shots, Heart rate, Sweet spot.

Everything below the tabs follows those three picks. Sweet spot is one tab, not the star.

## Layout, top to bottom

| Block | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Header | "Insights" title, time dropdown pill |
| Shot type chips | Selected chip = accent fill, black text. Others = outline. 44 pt high |
| Metric tabs | Text tabs, 3 pt accent underline on the pick |
| Big number | Average for the period (56 pt bold), unit, delta pill, then "Top · Low · vs previous period" line |
| Range chart | One bar per session: slowest to fastest shot. Dot = session average |
| By stroke | One bar per stroke for the picked metric. Hidden when a stroke chip is picked |
| Sessions | Last 3 sessions: date, shot count, duration, average, top. Tap opens `SessionDetailView` |
| Coach row | One tappable row. Opens the coach screen (see "Moved out of this page") |

## Look

Same dark look as the rest of the app. Accent is the app's `AccentColor` (lime).

| Token | Value |
|---|---|
| Background | `#0B0C09` |
| Card | `#171913`, radius 18–22 |
| Track | `#2A2E20` |
| Text | `#F3F5EC` |
| Muted text | `#A9AE9A` |
| Better | `#5EDC8A`, shown as ▲/▼ plus words, never color alone |
| Neutral | `#2A2E20` pill, `#C9CDBB` text |
| Worse | `#FF9A8D` |

In SwiftUI use system colors where they exist (`.background.secondary`, `.secondary`, `Color.accentColor`) so light mode keeps working. The hex values above are the dark-mode intent.

## Data: where each number comes from

All of it already exists. No new fields.

| Tab | Per shot | Per session range bar | Better is |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ball speed | `ballSpeedKmh` | min, max, mean of motion shots | higher |
| Swing speed | `swingSpeedKmh` | same | higher |
| Spin | `spinRPM` | same | higher (topspin) or neutral |
| Face | `faceAngleDeg` (+ = open) | same | closer to 0 |
| Path | `swingPathDeg` (+ = low to high) | same | no verdict, just show it |
| Contact | `impactDistanceCm` | same | lower |
| Shots | count | no range. Plain bars | higher |
| Heart rate | none | no range. One dot from `SessionRecord.averageHeartRate` (skip if 0) | no verdict |
| Sweet spot | `isSweetSpot` | no range. One dot from `ShotSummary.sweetSpotPercent` | higher |

Rules:
- Use `session.shots` filtered by the stroke chip and `type != .calibration`.
- Speed, spin, face and path only count shots where `hasMotion` is true. Mic-only shots have no motion data.
- Convert at the edge with `UnitSystem` (`speed`, `speedUnit`, `length`, `lengthUnit`). Stored values stay metric.
- Delta = this period's average minus the previous period's average. The previous period is the same length, directly before.
- "Top" and "Low" are the max and min shot in the period. For Shots, Heart rate and Sweet spot, drop that line.
- By stroke: group the same shots by `ShotType`, one average each. Skip a stroke with fewer than 5 shots.
- If a session has no shots for the current picks, leave it out of the chart.

## SwiftUI sketch (not compiled)

```swift
enum InsightMetric: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
    case ballSpeed, swingSpeed, spin, face, path, contact, shots, heartRate, sweetSpot
    var id: String { rawValue }
    var label: String {
        switch self {
        case .ballSpeed: "Ball speed"; case .swingSpeed: "Swing speed"; case .spin: "Spin"
        case .face: "Face"; case .path: "Path"; case .contact: "Contact"
        case .shots: "Shots"; case .heartRate: "Heart rate"; case .sweetSpot: "Sweet spot"
        }
    }
    /// Value for one shot, already in display units. nil = shot has no value for this metric.
    func value(_ s: ShotMetrics, _ u: UnitSystem) -> Double? {
        switch self {
        case .ballSpeed: s.hasMotion ? u.speed(s.ballSpeedKmh) : nil
        case .swingSpeed: s.hasMotion ? u.speed(s.swingSpeedKmh) : nil
        case .spin: s.hasMotion ? s.spinRPM : nil
        case .face: s.hasMotion ? s.faceAngleDeg : nil
        case .path: s.hasMotion ? s.swingPathDeg : nil
        case .contact: u.length(s.impactDistanceCm)
        case .shots, .heartRate, .sweetSpot: nil   // session-level, handled separately
        }
    }
}

enum InsightPeriod: String, CaseIterable { case week, month, quarter, year, all
    var days: Int? { switch self { case .week: 7; case .month: 30; case .quarter: 90; case .year: 365; case .all: nil } }
}

struct SessionPoint: Identifiable {
    var id: UUID; var date: Date
    var low: Double; var high: Double; var avg: Double
    var shotCount: Int; var duration: TimeInterval
}

        .foregroundStyle(Color.accentColor)
}
.chartYAxisLabel(units.speedUnit)   // swap per metric
.frame(height: 210)
```

Put the filtering and averaging in a small `InsightsModel` (plain struct or `@Observable`) so it can be unit tested without views. Add a test next to `Tests/CoachTests.swift`.

## Moved out of this page

The current Insights page also holds things that do not fit here. They need a new home:

| Today in `InsightsView.swift` | Suggested home |
|---|---|
| `coachChat` (ask box, quick questions, drill planner) | New Coach screen, pushed from the Coach row |
| `museSettings` (API key form) | Same Coach screen, under a "Coach engine" section |
| `CoachCard` | Stays in `SessionDetailView`. Not part of this page |

The Coach screen can reuse the current `coachChat` and `museSettings` code as is.

## Empty and edge states

- No sessions at all: keep today's `ContentUnavailableView("No data yet", …)`.
- Period has no shots for the picks: show "No \(stroke) shots in this period" in place of the chart.
- One session only: show the bar and dot, hide the delta pill.
- Heart rate without Watch data: hide the tab.

## Open choices

- Should "Sweet spot" stay as a tab, or become a tile on the Sessions rows?
- Should the Face and Path tabs use a centered axis (0° in the middle) instead of the plain range chart?
- Does the dropdown need a custom date range?
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "apple/iOS/Glasses/GlassesController.swift", "sha256": "4207442d01ee839da778da1c41579578bd28f98711b7b09ba907d812277b38fc", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````swift
import Foundation
import MWDATCore
import MWDATDisplay
import Observation
import RacketKit

/// Meta Ray-Ban Display link: registers the app with the Meta AI app, finds the glasses and mirrors the live session
/// (latest shot, sweet-spot rate, score, drill) to the lens while a session runs.
@MainActor
@Observable
final class GlassesController {
    enum Registration: Equatable { case unavailable, available, registering, registered }
    enum HUDState: Equatable { case off, connecting, live }

    static let hudEnabledKey = "glassesHUDEnabled"
    static let urlActionKey = "metaWearablesAction"

    private(set) var registration: Registration = .unavailable
    private(set) var deviceName: String?
    private(set) var displayDevicePresent = false
    private(set) var deviceReady = false
    private(set) var hud: HUDState = .off
    private(set) var needsGlassesAppUpdate = false
    private(set) var needsFirmwareUpdate = false
    private(set) var errorMessage: String?
    private(set) var configured = false

    var hudEnabled: Bool {
        get { UserDefaults.standard.object(forKey: Self.hudEnabledKey) as? Bool ?? true }
        set { UserDefaults.standard.set(newValue, forKey: Self.hudEnabledKey); sync() }
    }

    @ObservationIgnored private weak var model: AppModel?
    @ObservationIgnored private weak var account: AccountModel?
    @ObservationIgnored private var deviceSession: DeviceSession?
    @ObservationIgnored private var display: Display?
    @ObservationIgnored private var displayReady = false
    @ObservationIgnored private var displayToken: AnyListenerToken?
    @ObservationIgnored private var linkToken: AnyListenerToken?
    @ObservationIgnored private var compatToken: AnyListenerToken?
    @ObservationIgnored private var tasks: [Task<Void, Never>] = []
    @ObservationIgnored private var clockTask: Task<Void, Never>?
    @ObservationIgnored private var confirmTask: Task<Void, Never>?
    @ObservationIgnored private var teardownTask: Task<Void, Never>?
    @ObservationIgnored private var confirmingEnd = false
    @ObservationIgnored private var connecting = false
    @ObservationIgnored private var previewing = false
    @ObservationIgnored private var previewTask: Task<Void, Never>?
    @ObservationIgnored private var observedDevice: DeviceIdentifier?
    @ObservationIgnored private var lastSession: SessionRecord?

    init() {
        do {
            try Wearables.configure()
            configured = true
        } catch {
            errorMessage = "Glasses support is unavailable: \(error.localizedDescription)"
        }
    }

    // MARK: Wiring

    func connect(to model: AppModel, account: AccountModel) {
        guard self.model == nil, configured else { return }
        self.model = model
        self.account = account
        let wearables = Wearables.shared
        tasks.append(Task { [weak self] in
            for await state in wearables.registrationStateStream() {
                self?.apply(registration: state)
            }
        })
        tasks.append(Task { [weak self] in
            for await ids in wearables.devicesStream() {
                self?.apply(devices: ids)
            }
        })
        track()
    }

    /// Routes the Meta AI app's callback (registration and permission grants) into the SDK.
    func handle(url: URL) {
        guard configured,
              URLComponents(url: url, resolvingAgainstBaseURL: false)?
                .queryItems?.contains(where: { $0.name == Self.urlActionKey }) == true else { return }
        Task {
            do { _ = try await Wearables.shared.handleUrl(url) }
            catch { errorMessage = error.localizedDescription }
        }
    }

    // MARK: Actions

    func register() {
        errorMessage = nil
        Task {
            do { try await Wearables.shared.startRegistration() }
            catch { errorMessage = error.localizedDescription }
        }
    }

    func unregister() {
        errorMessage = nil
        Task {
            await tearDown()
            do { try await Wearables.shared.startUnregistration() }
            catch { errorMessage = error.localizedDescription }
        }
    }

    func openFirmwareUpdate() {
        Task { do { try await Wearables.shared.openFirmwareUpdate() } catch { errorMessage = error.localizedDescription } }
    }

    func openGlassesAppUpdate() {
        Task { do { try await Wearables.shared.openDATGlassesAppUpdate() } catch { errorMessage = error.localizedDescription } }
    }

    /// Reconnects the lens and shows a test card, even with no session running (it clears after 20 s).
    func reconnect() {
        errorMessage = nil
        needsGlassesAppUpdate = false
        guard registration == .registered else { errorMessage = "Connect to Meta AI first."; return }
        guard deviceReady else {
            errorMessage = displayDevicePresent
                ? "Your glasses aren't connected. Put them on and open the Meta AI app."
                : "No Meta Ray-Ban Display glasses found. Pair them in the Meta AI app."
            return
        }
        previewing = true
        previewTask?.cancel()
        previewTask = Task { [weak self] in
            await self?.tearDown()
            self?.sync()
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(20))
            guard !Task.isCancelled, let self else { return }
            self.previewing = false
            if self.model?.isSessionActive != true { await self.tearDown() }
        }
    }

    // MARK: Registration and devices

    private func apply(registration state: RegistrationState) {
        switch state {
        case .registered: registration = .registered
        case .registering: registration = .registering
        case .available: registration = .available
        default: registration = .unavailable
        }
        if registration != .registered { Task { await tearDown() } }
        sync()
    }

    private func apply(devices ids: [DeviceIdentifier]) {
        let wearables = Wearables.shared
        let device = ids.lazy.compactMap { wearables.deviceForIdentifier($0) }.first { $0.supportsDisplay() }
        displayDevicePresent = device != nil
        deviceName = device?.nameOrId()
        guard device?.identifier != observedDevice else { return }
        observedDevice = device?.identifier
        linkToken = nil
        compatToken = nil
        guard let device else { deviceReady = false; sync(); return }
        let refresh: @Sendable () -> Void = { [weak self] in
            Task { @MainActor in self?.refreshReadiness(device) }
        }
        linkToken = device.addLinkStateListener { _ in refresh() }
        compatToken = device.addCompatibilityListener { _ in refresh() }
        refreshReadiness(device)
    }

    private func refreshReadiness(_ device: Device) {
        let compatibility = device.compatibility()
        needsFirmwareUpdate = compatibility == .deviceUpdateRequired
        deviceReady = device.linkState == .connected && compatibility == .compatible
        if !deviceReady { Task { await tearDown() } }
        sync()
    }

    // MARK: Session mirroring

    /// Re-runs `sync` whenever any value the HUD shows changes.
    private func track() {
        guard let model else { return }
        withObservationTracking {
            _ = model.isSessionActive
            _ = model.sessionShots.count
            _ = model.lastShot?.id
            _ = model.activeDrill?.completed
            _ = model.activeSession?.pointsWon
            _ = model.activeSession?.pointsLost
            _ = account?.sharedMatch?.revision
        } onChange: { [weak self] in
            Task { @MainActor in self?.sync(); self?.track() }
        }
    }

    private func sync() {
        guard let model else { return }
        let shouldRun = ((hudEnabled && model.isSessionActive) || previewing) && registration == .registered && deviceReady
        if let session = model.activeSession { lastSession = session }
        if shouldRun {
            teardownTask?.cancel()
            if deviceSession == nil && !connecting { Task { await startHUD() } }
            else { render() }
        } else if deviceSession != nil && !model.isSessionActive && hudEnabled && !previewing && teardownTask == nil {
            showSummaryThenStop()
        } else if deviceSession != nil && teardownTask == nil {
            Task { await tearDown() }
        }
    }

    private func startHUD() async {
        connecting = true
        hud = .connecting
        defer { connecting = false }
        do {
            let wearables = Wearables.shared
            // The device is already known and ready, so pick it directly: an auto selector may not have resolved yet.
            guard let id = observedDevice else { throw DeviceSessionError.noEligibleDevice }
            let session = try wearables.createSession(deviceSelector: SpecificDeviceSelector(device: id))
            deviceSession = session
            tasks.append(Task { [weak self] in
                for await error in session.errorStream() { self?.handle(sessionError: error) }
            })
            let started = Task { for await state in session.stateStream() where state == .started { return } }
            do {
                try session.start()
                await started.value
            } catch {
                started.cancel()
                throw error
            }
            let capability = try session.addDisplay()
            display = capability
            displayToken = capability.statePublisher.listen { [weak self] state in
                Task { @MainActor in
                    guard let self else { return }
                    self.displayReady = state == .started
                    if state == .started { self.hud = .live; self.render() }
                    else if state == .stopped { self.hud = .off }
                }
            }
            capability.start()
            clockTask?.cancel()
            clockTask = Task { [weak self] in
                while !Task.isCancelled {
                    try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(30))
                    self?.render()
                }
            }
        } catch {
            handle(sessionError: error)
            await tearDown()
        }
    }

    private func handle(sessionError error: Error) {
        if case DeviceSessionError.datAppOnTheGlassesUpdateRequired = error {
            needsGlassesAppUpdate = true
        } else {
            errorMessage = error.localizedDescription
        }
    }

    private func render() {
        guard displayReady, let display, let model else { return }
        if !model.isSessionActive {
            Task {
                do { try await display.send(GlassesHUD.message("Tennis Buddee", "Glasses connected. Start a session to see your shots here.")) }
                catch { self.errorMessage = (error as? DisplayError)?.description ?? error.localizedDescription }
            }
            return
        }
        let snapshot = snapshot(model)
        let view = GlassesHUD.session(
            snapshot, confirmingEnd: confirmingEnd,
            onEnd: { [weak self] in Task { @MainActor in self?.askToEnd() } },
            onConfirm: { [weak self] in Task { @MainActor in self?.confirmEnd() } },
            onCancel: { [weak self] in Task { @MainActor in self?.cancelEnd() } })
        Task {
            do { try await display.send(view) }
            catch { self.errorMessage = (error as? DisplayError)?.description ?? error.localizedDescription }
        }
    }

    private func askToEnd() {
        confirmingEnd = true
        render()
        confirmTask?.cancel()
        confirmTask = Task { [weak self] in
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(6))
            guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
            self?.cancelEnd()
        }
    }

    private func cancelEnd() {
        confirmTask?.cancel()
        confirmingEnd = false
        render()
    }

    private func confirmEnd() {
        confirmTask?.cancel()
        confirmingEnd = false
        model?.stopSession()
    }

    private func showSummaryThenStop() {
        guard let display, displayReady, let model else { Task { await tearDown() }; return }
        var s = snapshot(model, summarising: lastSession)
        s.summary = true
        let view = GlassesHUD.summary(s)
        teardownTask = Task { [weak self] in
            try? await display.send(view)
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(6))
            guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
            await self?.tearDown()
        }
    }

    private func tearDown() async {
        clockTask?.cancel(); clockTask = nil
        confirmTask?.cancel(); confirmingEnd = false
        teardownTask = nil
        displayReady = false
        display?.stop()
        deviceSession?.stop()
        displayToken = nil
        display = nil
        deviceSession = nil
        hud = .off
    }

    // MARK: Content

    private func snapshot(_ model: AppModel, summarising ended: SessionRecord? = nil) -> GlassesHUDSnapshot {
        let units = UnitSystem.current
        var s = GlassesHUDSnapshot()
        let session = model.activeSession ?? ended
        let summary = ShotSummary(model.sessionShots)
        s.shots = summary.count
        s.sweetSpotPercent = Int(summary.sweetSpotPercent.rounded())
        if let start = session?.startDate {
            let seconds = Int(((session?.endDate ?? Date()).timeIntervalSince(start)))
            s.elapsed = seconds >= 3600
                ? String(format: "%d:%02d:%02d", seconds / 3600, seconds / 60 % 60, seconds % 60)
                : String(format: "%d:%02d", seconds / 60, seconds % 60)
        }
        if let shot = model.lastShot {
            s.lastShotTitle = shot.type.label
            s.lastShotSweet = shot.isSweetSpot
            let where_ = shot.isSweetSpot ? "Sweet spot" : String(format: "%.0f cm off", shot.impactDistanceCm)
            s.lastShotDetail = shot.hasMotion
                ? "\(units.speedValue(shot.ballSpeedKmh)) \(units.speedUnit) · \(where_)"
                : where_
        }
        if let session, session.pointsWon + session.pointsLost > 0 {
            s.points = "Points \(session.pointsWon)–\(session.pointsLost)"
        }
        if let state = account?.sharedMatch, let me = account?.userID, !state.ended, state.guest != nil {
            let t = state.tracker(for: me)
            s.score = t.setsText.isEmpty ? t.score.pointText : "\(t.setsText) · \(t.score.pointText)"
        }
        if let drill = model.activeDrill, !drill.isDone {
            s.drill = "\(drill.title) \(drill.completed)/\(drill.target)"
        }
        return s
    }
}
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "apple/iOS/Glasses/GlassesHUD.swift", "sha256": "f5a2257d6fdf3014916e5998860a44ba797b74a69f65648c2ff823466fd92481", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````swift
import Foundation
import MWDATDisplay

/// Everything the glasses HUD shows, flattened to strings so this file needs no SwiftUI (its `Text`, `Button` and
/// `Image` would clash with the Display DSL).
struct GlassesHUDSnapshot: Equatable {
    var elapsed = ""
    var shots = 0
    var sweetSpotPercent = 0
    /// "Forehand" / "112 km/h · Sweet spot" for the latest hit.
    var lastShotTitle: String?
    var lastShotDetail: String?
    var lastShotSweet = false
    var points: String?
    var score: String?
    var drill: String?
    var summary = false
}

enum GlassesHUD {
    /// The in-session card. Tapping "End" asks for confirmation first, since the glasses are easy to brush.
    static func session(_ s: GlassesHUDSnapshot, confirmingEnd: Bool,
                        onEnd: @escaping @Sendable () -> Void,
                        onConfirm: @escaping @Sendable () -> Void,
                        onCancel: @escaping @Sendable () -> Void) -> FlexBox {
        FlexBox(direction: .column, spacing: 10) {
            FlexBox(direction: .row, spacing: 8, alignment: .start, crossAlignment: .center) {
                Icon(name: .clock)
                Text(s.elapsed, style: .meta, color: .secondary)
            }
            if let title = s.lastShotTitle {
                Text(title, style: .heading)
                if let detail = s.lastShotDetail {
                    Text(detail, style: .body, color: s.lastShotSweet ? .primary : .secondary)
                }
            } else {
                Text("Ready", style: .heading)
                Text("Hit a ball to see your shot", style: .body, color: .secondary)
            }
            Text("\(s.shots) shots · \(s.sweetSpotPercent)% sweet spot", style: .meta, color: .secondary)
            if let score = s.score { Text(score, style: .body) }
            if let points = s.points { Text(points, style: .meta, color: .secondary) }
            if let drill = s.drill { Text(drill, style: .meta, color: .secondary) }
            if confirmingEnd {
                ButtonGroup {
                    Button(label: "End session", style: .primary, iconName: .checkmark, onClick: onConfirm)
                    Button(label: "Keep going", style: .secondary, onClick: onCancel)
                }
            } else {
                ButtonGroup {
                    Button(label: "End", style: .outline, onClick: onEnd)
                }
            }
        }
        .padding(20)
        .background(.card)
    }

    /// Shown for a few seconds when the session ends.
    static func summary(_ s: GlassesHUDSnapshot) -> FlexBox {
        FlexBox(direction: .column, spacing: 10) {
            FlexBox(direction: .row, spacing: 8, alignment: .start, crossAlignment: .center) {
                Icon(name: .checkmarkCircle)
                Text("Session saved", style: .heading)
            }
            Text("\(s.shots) shots · \(s.sweetSpotPercent)% sweet spot", style: .body)
            Text(s.elapsed, style: .meta, color: .secondary)
        }
        .padding(20)
        .background(.card)
    }

    static func message(_ title: String, _ detail: String) -> FlexBox {
        FlexBox(direction: .column, spacing: 8) {
            Text(title, style: .heading)
            Text(detail, style: .body, color: .secondary)
        }
        .padding(20)
        .background(.card)
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import SwiftUI

/// Settings for the Meta Ray-Ban Display link (Settings tab → Glasses).
struct GlassesView: View {
    @Environment(GlassesController.self) private var glasses

    var body: some View {
        @Bindable var glasses = glasses
        Form {
            Section {
                LabeledContent("Meta AI app", value: registrationText)
                if let name = glasses.deviceName {
                    LabeledContent("Glasses", value: deviceText(name))
                }
                switch glasses.registration {
                case .registered:
                    Button("Disconnect from Meta AI", role: .destructive) { glasses.unregister() }
                case .available:
                    Button("Connect to Meta AI", systemImage: "eyeglasses") { glasses.register() }
                case .registering:
                    ProgressView()
                case .unavailable:
                    EmptyView()
                }
            } footer: {
                Text(glasses.configured
                     ? "Needs the Meta AI app with Developer Mode on for your glasses (Settings → Your glasses)."
                     : "The Meta glasses toolkit could not start.")
            }

            Section {
                Toggle("Show session on lens", isOn: $glasses.hudEnabled)
                LabeledContent("Lens", value: hudText)
                Button("Test on lens", systemImage: "eyeglasses") { glasses.reconnect() }
            } header: {
                Text("Live HUD")
            } footer: {
                Text("While a session runs, your lens shows the last shot, sweet-spot rate, score and drill progress. Tap End on the lens to finish the session.")
            }

            if glasses.needsFirmwareUpdate || glasses.needsGlassesAppUpdate {
                Section("Updates") {
                    if glasses.needsFirmwareUpdate {
                        Button("Update glasses software") { glasses.openFirmwareUpdate() }
                    }
                    if glasses.needsGlassesAppUpdate {
                        Button("Update Meta glasses app") { glasses.openGlassesAppUpdate() }
                    }
                }
            }

            if let error = glasses.errorMessage {
                Section { Label(error, systemImage: "exclamationmark.triangle").foregroundStyle(.red) }
            }
        }
        .formStyle(.grouped)
        .navigationTitle("Glasses")
    }

    private var registrationText: String {
        switch glasses.registration {
        case .registered: "Connected"
        case .registering: "Connecting…"
        case .available: "Not connected"
        case .unavailable: "Unavailable"
        }
    }

    private func deviceText(_ name: String) -> String {
        glasses.deviceReady ? "\(name) · Ready" : "\(name) · Not connected"
    }

    private var hudText: String {
        switch glasses.hud {
        case .off: glasses.displayDevicePresent ? "Idle" : "No display glasses"
        case .connecting: "Connecting…"
        case .live: "Showing"
        }
    }
}
````````

````````swift
import Foundation
import RacketKit
import WatchConnectivity

/// iPhone side of the Watch link: pushes shots and session state, receives start/stop and point logging.
/// Message keys are shared with Watch/WatchModel.swift.
@MainActor
final class WatchBridge: NSObject, WCSessionDelegate {
    private weak var model: AppModel?
    private weak var account: AccountModel?

    func connect(to model: AppModel, account: AccountModel) {
        self.model = model
        self.account = account
        account.onSharedMatchChange = { [weak self] state, player in self?.sendSharedScore(state, player: player) }
        guard WCSession.isSupported() else { return }
        WCSession.default.delegate = self
        WCSession.default.activate()
        sendLocalScore(model.match)

        model.onShotForWatch = { [weak self] shot in self?.send(shot: shot) }
        model.onSessionChangeForWatch = { [weak self] active in self?.sendSessionState(active: active) }
        model.onDrillChangeForWatch = { [weak self] drill in self?.send(drill: drill) }
        model.onMatchChangeForWatch = { [weak self] match in self?.sendLocalScore(match) }
    }

    private func send(shot: ShotMetrics) {
        guard WCSession.default.activationState == .activated, WCSession.default.isReachable,
              let data = try? JSONEncoder().encode(shot) else { return }
        let summary = model.map { ShotSummary($0.sessionShots) }
        var msg: [String: Any] = ["type": "shot", "shot": data, "metric": UnitSystem.current.metric]
        if let summary, let s = try? JSONEncoder().encode(summary) { msg["summary"] = s }
        WCSession.default.sendMessage(msg, replyHandler: nil)
    }

    /// Drill updates go both as a live message and in the application context, so the Watch catches up on launch.
    private func send(drill: Drill?) {
        guard WCSession.default.activationState == .activated else { return }
        let data = drill.flatMap { try? JSONEncoder().encode($0) } ?? Data()
        var ctx = WCSession.default.applicationContext
        ctx["drill"] = data
        ctx["updated"] = Date().timeIntervalSince1970
        try? WCSession.default.updateApplicationContext(ctx)
        if WCSession.default.isReachable {
            WCSession.default.sendMessage(["type": "drill", "drill": data], replyHandler: nil)
        }
    }

    /// The match scored on this iPhone (buttons or racket taps), so the Watch shows the same score.
    func sendLocalScore(_ match: ScoreTracker?) {
        guard WCSession.default.activationState == .activated else { return }
        let data = match.flatMap { try? JSONEncoder().encode($0) } ?? Data()
        var ctx = WCSession.default.applicationContext
        ctx["localScore"] = data
        try? WCSession.default.updateApplicationContext(ctx)
        if WCSession.default.isReachable {
            WCSession.default.sendMessage(["type": "localScore", "score": data], replyHandler: nil)
        }
    }

    private func sendSharedScore(_ state: SharedMatchState?, player: UUID?) {
        guard WCSession.default.activationState == .activated else { return }
        let tracker = state.flatMap { state in player.map { state.tracker(for: $0) } }
        let data = tracker.flatMap { try? JSONEncoder().encode($0) } ?? Data()
        var ctx = WCSession.default.applicationContext
        ctx["sharedScore"] = data
        ctx["sharedMatchID"] = state?.id.uuidString ?? ""
        ctx["sharedRevision"] = state?.revision ?? 0
        ctx["sharedScoreActive"] = state.map { !$0.ended && $0.guest != nil } ?? false
        try? WCSession.default.updateApplicationContext(ctx)
        if WCSession.default.isReachable {
            WCSession.default.sendMessage(["type": "sharedScore", "score": data,
                "active": ctx["sharedScoreActive"] as? Bool ?? false,
                "matchID": state?.id.uuidString ?? "", "revision": state?.revision ?? 0], replyHandler: nil)
        }
    }

    private func sendSessionState(active: Bool) {
        guard WCSession.default.activationState == .activated else { return }
        var ctx = WCSession.default.applicationContext
        ctx["sessionActive"] = active
        ctx["sessionID"] = model?.activeSession?.id.uuidString ?? ""
        ctx["updated"] = Date().timeIntervalSince1970
        try? WCSession.default.updateApplicationContext(ctx)
        if WCSession.default.isReachable {
            WCSession.default.sendMessage(["type": "session", "active": active, "sessionID": model?.activeSession?.id.uuidString ?? ""], replyHandler: nil)
        }
    }

    nonisolated func session(_ session: WCSession, didReceiveMessage message: [String: Any],
                             replyHandler: @escaping ([String: Any]) -> Void) {
        handleCommand(message, replyHandler: replyHandler)
    }

    private nonisolated func handleCommand(_ message: [String: Any], replyHandler: @escaping ([String: Any]) -> Void) {
        let cmd = message["cmd"] as? String
        let won = message["won"] as? Bool
        let avgHR = message["avgHR"] as? Double
        let kcal = message["kcal"] as? Double
        let recordID = (message["sessionID"] as? String).flatMap(UUID.init(uuidString:))
        let matchID = (message["matchID"] as? String).flatMap(UUID.init(uuidString:))
        let revision = message["revision"] as? Int
        Task { @MainActor in
            guard let model = self.model else { return replyHandler([:]) }
            var commandError: String?
            switch cmd {
            case "start": model.startSession(id: recordID ?? UUID())
            case "stop": if recordID == nil || recordID == model.activeSession?.id { model.stopSession() }
            case "point":
                if let won { model.logPoint(won: won) }
            case "sharedPoint":
                if let won, let state = self.account?.sharedMatch, state.id == matchID, state.revision == revision {
                    await self.account?.award(won: won)
                    commandError = self.account?.errorMessage
                } else {
                    commandError = "The shared score changed. Check the score and try again."
                    self.sendSharedScore(self.account?.sharedMatch, player: self.account?.userID)
                }
            case "health":
                if let recordID { model.recordHealth(averageHeartRate: avgHR ?? 0, calories: kcal ?? 0, sessionID: recordID) }
            case "cancelDrill": model.cancelDrill()
            default: break
            }
            replyHandler(["sessionActive": model.isSessionActive, "sessionID": model.activeSession?.id.uuidString ?? "",
                          "error": commandError ?? ""])
        }
    }

    nonisolated func session(_ session: WCSession, didReceiveUserInfo userInfo: [String: Any]) {
        handleCommand(userInfo) { _ in }
    }

    nonisolated func session(_ session: WCSession, activationDidCompleteWith state: WCSessionActivationState,
                             error: Error?) {}
    nonisolated func sessionDidBecomeInactive(_ session: WCSession) {}
    nonisolated func sessionDidDeactivate(_ session: WCSession) { WCSession.default.activate() }
}
````````

#### Reference: `backend/supabase/001_social.sql`

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "backend/supabase/001_social.sql", "sha256": "9201a95dd07b72cb9a5987e706e2c18e3082eba68a2baf53416cea274f125cdd", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````sql
-- Run once in a new Supabase project's SQL editor. No service key belongs in the app.
begin;
create table public.player_profiles (
  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  display_name text not null default 'Tennis player' check (length(display_name) between 1 and 60),
  friend_code text not null unique default upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 12))
);
create table public.friendships (
  requester uuid not null references public.player_profiles(id) on delete cascade,
  recipient uuid not null references public.player_profiles(id) on delete cascade,
  accepted boolean not null default false,
  primary key (requester, recipient), check (requester <> recipient)
);
create unique index one_friendship_per_pair on public.friendships
  (least(requester, recipient), greatest(requester, recipient));
create table public.shared_matches (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  host uuid not null references public.player_profiles(id) on delete cascade,
  guest uuid references public.player_profiles(id) on delete cascade,
  title text not null check (length(title) between 1 and 120),
  invite_code text not null unique default upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 12)),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(), ended boolean not null default false,
  revision integer not null default 0,
  check (guest is null or guest <> host)
);
create table public.match_invitations (
  match_id uuid not null references public.shared_matches(id) on delete cascade,
  recipient uuid not null references public.player_profiles(id) on delete cascade,
  primary key (match_id, recipient)
);
create table public.shared_points (
  id uuid primary key, -- client operation UUID makes a retried award idempotent
  match_id uuid not null references public.shared_matches(id) on delete cascade,
  winner uuid not null references public.player_profiles(id) on delete cascade,
  voided boolean not null default false,
  sequence bigint generated always as identity unique
);
create index shared_points_match on public.shared_points(match_id, sequence);
create table public.shared_racket_stats (
  match_id uuid not null references public.shared_matches(id) on delete cascade,
  player_id uuid not null references public.player_profiles(id) on delete cascade,
  shots integer not null check (shots >= 0),
  sweet_percent double precision not null check (sweet_percent between 0 and 100),
  average_ball_kmh double precision check (average_ball_kmh between 0 and 500),
  top_ball_kmh double precision check (top_ball_kmh between 0 and 500),
  primary key (match_id, player_id)
);

-- Tables are not exposed for direct reads/writes. Every RPC below checks the authenticated caller.
alter table public.player_profiles enable row level security;
alter table public.friendships enable row level security;
alter table public.shared_matches enable row level security;
alter table public.match_invitations enable row level security;
alter table public.shared_points enable row level security;
alter table public.shared_racket_stats enable row level security;
revoke all on public.player_profiles, public.friendships, public.shared_matches,
  public.match_invitations, public.shared_points, public.shared_racket_stats from anon, authenticated;

create function public.social_dashboard() returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare me uuid := auth.uid(); result jsonb;
begin
  if me is null then raise exception 'Sign in first'; end if;
  insert into public.player_profiles(id) values (me) on conflict do nothing;
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'profile', jsonb_build_object('id', p.id, 'name', p.display_name, 'friendCode', p.friend_code),
    'friends', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', q.id, 'name', q.display_name, 'friendCode', q.friend_code) order by q.display_name)
      from public.friendships f join public.player_profiles q on q.id = case when f.requester = me then f.recipient else f.requester end
      where f.accepted and me in (f.requester, f.recipient)), '[]'::jsonb),
    'requests', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('player', jsonb_build_object('id', q.id, 'name', q.display_name, 'friendCode', ''), 'incoming', f.recipient = me))
      from public.friendships f join public.player_profiles q on q.id = case when f.requester = me then f.recipient else f.requester end
      where not f.accepted and me in (f.requester, f.recipient)), '[]'::jsonb),
    'invitations', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'title', m.title, 'hostName', h.display_name) order by m.created_at desc)
      from public.match_invitations i join public.shared_matches m on m.id = i.match_id join public.player_profiles h on h.id = m.host
      where i.recipient = me and not m.ended and m.guest is null and m.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'), '[]'::jsonb),
    'matches', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'title', m.title, 'hostName', h.display_name) order by m.created_at desc)
      from (select * from public.shared_matches where me in (host, guest) order by created_at desc limit 30) m
      join public.player_profiles h on h.id = m.host), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) into result from public.player_profiles p where p.id = me;
  return result;
end $$;

create function public.set_player_name(p_name text) returns boolean
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'Sign in first'; end if;
  if length(trim(p_name)) not between 1 and 60 then raise exception 'Enter a name of 1 to 60 characters'; end if;
  insert into public.player_profiles(id, display_name) values (auth.uid(), trim(p_name))
    on conflict(id) do update set display_name = excluded.display_name;
  return true;
end $$;

create function public.request_friend(p_code text) returns boolean
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare me uuid := auth.uid(); other uuid;
begin
  if me is null then raise exception 'Sign in first'; end if;
  insert into public.player_profiles(id) values(me) on conflict do nothing;
  select id into other from public.player_profiles where friend_code = upper(trim(p_code));
  if other is null or other = me then raise exception 'That friend code is not available'; end if;
  if exists(select 1 from public.friendships where requester = other and recipient = me and not accepted)
    then raise exception 'This player has already sent you a request. Accept it below.'; end if;
  insert into public.friendships(requester, recipient) values(me, other) on conflict do nothing;
  return true;
end $$;
create function public.respond_friend(p_player uuid, p_accept boolean) returns boolean
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'Sign in first'; end if;
  if p_accept then
    update public.friendships set accepted = true where requester = p_player and recipient = auth.uid();
  else
    delete from public.friendships where requester = p_player and recipient = auth.uid() and not accepted;
  end if;
  return true;
end $$;
create function public.remove_friend(p_player uuid) returns boolean
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'Sign in first'; end if;
  delete from public.friendships where auth.uid() in (requester, recipient) and p_player in (requester, recipient);
  -- Removing a friend also withdraws any unaccepted invitations between these players.
  delete from public.match_invitations i using public.shared_matches m where i.match_id = m.id
    and ((m.host = auth.uid() and i.recipient = p_player) or (m.host = p_player and i.recipient = auth.uid()));
  return true;
end $$;

create function public.shared_match_state(p_match uuid) returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare m public.shared_matches; result jsonb;
begin
  select * into m from public.shared_matches where id = p_match;
  if auth.uid() is null or m.id is null or (auth.uid() <> m.host and auth.uid() is distinct from m.guest)
    then raise exception 'This match is not available to you'; end if;
  select jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'title', m.title, 'inviteCode', m.invite_code, 'ended', m.ended, 'revision', m.revision,
    'host', (select jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'name', display_name, 'friendCode', '') from public.player_profiles where id = m.host),
    'guest', (select jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'name', display_name, 'friendCode', '') from public.player_profiles where id = m.guest),
    'points', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'winner', winner) order by sequence) from public.shared_points where match_id = m.id and not voided), '[]'::jsonb),
    'stats', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', player_id, 'shots', shots, 'sweetPercent', sweet_percent,
      'averageBallKmh', average_ball_kmh, 'topBallKmh', top_ball_kmh)) from public.shared_racket_stats where match_id = m.id), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) into result;
  return result;
end $$;
create function public.create_shared_match(p_title text, p_friend uuid default null) returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare me uuid := auth.uid(); match_id uuid;
begin
  if me is null then raise exception 'Sign in first'; end if;
  insert into public.player_profiles(id) values(me) on conflict do nothing;
  if p_friend is not null and not exists(select 1 from public.friendships where accepted
    and me in (requester, recipient) and p_friend in (requester, recipient) and p_friend <> me)
    then raise exception 'Only accepted friends can be invited'; end if;
  insert into public.shared_matches(host, title) values(me, left(coalesce(nullif(trim(p_title), ''), 'Tennis with friends'), 120)) returning id into match_id;
  if p_friend is not null then insert into public.match_invitations values(match_id, p_friend); end if;
  return public.shared_match_state(match_id);
end $$;
create function public.join_shared_match(p_code text) returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare m public.shared_matches; me uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  if me is null then raise exception 'Sign in first'; end if;
  select * into m from public.shared_matches where invite_code = upper(trim(p_code)) for update;
  if m.id is null then raise exception 'Session code not found'; end if;
  if me = m.host or me = m.guest then return public.shared_match_state(m.id); end if;
  if m.guest is not null or m.ended or m.created_at < now() - interval '24 hours'
    then raise exception 'This session is full, ended, or the invitation has expired'; end if;
  insert into public.player_profiles(id) values(me) on conflict do nothing;
  update public.shared_matches set guest = me where id = m.id;
  delete from public.match_invitations where match_id = m.id;
  return public.shared_match_state(m.id);
end $$;
create function public.accept_match_invitation(p_match uuid) returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare code text;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or not exists(select 1 from public.match_invitations where match_id = p_match and recipient = auth.uid())
    then raise exception 'No invitation found'; end if;
  select invite_code into code from public.shared_matches where id = p_match;
  return public.join_shared_match(code);
end $$;
create function public.decline_match_invitation(p_match uuid) returns boolean
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'Sign in first'; end if;
  delete from public.match_invitations where match_id = p_match and recipient = auth.uid();
  return true;
end $$;

create function public.add_shared_point(p_match uuid, p_winner uuid, p_operation uuid, p_expected_revision integer) returns boolean
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare m public.shared_matches; previous public.shared_points;
begin
  select * into m from public.shared_matches where id = p_match for update;
  if auth.uid() is null or m.id is null or (auth.uid() <> m.host and auth.uid() is distinct from m.guest)
    then raise exception 'This match is not available to you'; end if;
  select * into previous from public.shared_points where id = p_operation;
  if previous.id is not null then
    if previous.match_id = p_match and previous.winner = p_winner then return true; end if;
    raise exception 'Point operation already used';
  end if;
  if m.ended or m.guest is null then raise exception 'This match is not active'; end if;
  if p_winner is null or p_winner not in (m.host, m.guest) then raise exception 'Invalid player'; end if;
  if p_expected_revision is distinct from m.revision
    then raise exception 'The score changed. Refresh before recording this point.'; end if;
  insert into public.shared_points(id, match_id, winner) values(p_operation, p_match, p_winner);
  update public.shared_matches set revision = revision + 1 where id = p_match;
  return true;
end $$;
create function public.undo_shared_point(p_match uuid, p_point uuid) returns boolean
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare m public.shared_matches; last_id uuid;
begin
  select * into m from public.shared_matches where id = p_match for update;
  if auth.uid() is null or m.id is null or (auth.uid() <> m.host and auth.uid() is distinct from m.guest) or m.ended
    then raise exception 'This match is not active'; end if;
  select id into last_id from public.shared_points where match_id = p_match and not voided order by sequence desc limit 1;
  if last_id is distinct from p_point then raise exception 'The score changed. Refresh before undoing.'; end if;
  update public.shared_points set voided = true where id = p_point;
  update public.shared_matches set revision = revision + 1 where id = p_match;
  return true;
end $$;
create function public.end_shared_match(p_match uuid) returns boolean
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'Sign in first'; end if;
  -- Use the same row lock as point awards and joins.
  perform 1 from public.shared_matches where id = p_match and auth.uid() in (host, guest) for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'This match is not available to you'; end if;
  update public.shared_matches set ended = true where id = p_match;
  delete from public.match_invitations where match_id = p_match;
  return true;
end $$;
create function public.share_racket_stats(p_match uuid, p_shots integer, p_sweet double precision,
  p_average double precision default null, p_top double precision default null) returns boolean
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or not exists(select 1 from public.shared_matches where id = p_match and auth.uid() in (host, guest))
    then raise exception 'This match is not available to you'; end if;
  insert into public.shared_racket_stats values(p_match, auth.uid(), p_shots, p_sweet, p_average, p_top)
    on conflict(match_id, player_id) do update set shots = excluded.shots, sweet_percent = excluded.sweet_percent,
      average_ball_kmh = excluded.average_ball_kmh, top_ball_kmh = excluded.top_ball_kmh;
  return true;
end $$;

-- Definer functions bypass RLS deliberately, so expose only these authenticated entrypoints.
do $$ declare f record; begin
  for f in select p.oid::regprocedure as signature from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace
    where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname in ('social_dashboard', 'set_player_name', 'request_friend',
      'respond_friend', 'remove_friend', 'shared_match_state', 'create_shared_match', 'join_shared_match',
      'accept_match_invitation', 'decline_match_invitation', 'add_shared_point', 'undo_shared_point', 'end_shared_match', 'share_racket_stats')
  loop
    execute format('revoke all on function %s from public, anon', f.signature);
    execute format('grant execute on function %s to authenticated', f.signature);
  end loop;
end $$;
commit;

````````

````````markdown
# Accounts, friends, and shared tennis sessions

The hosted setup was completed on October 28, 2026:

- Supabase project: `birutnqxduzwldvymeun` (West US/Oregon).
- `001_social.sql` was applied successfully; all six app tables exist. **Do not run it again on this project.**
- Google OAuth client is configured in Google Cloud project `robust-cooler-513018-e0` and enabled in Supabase.
  Its secret is stored in Supabase, not in app resources or this repository.
- Google remains in **Testing** mode. The project owner's Google account is the sole test user.
  Add another consenting tester in Google Auth Platform → Audience before testing shared sessions on two accounts.
- Only basic identity scopes are configured: OpenID, email, and profile.
- `tennisbuddee://auth/callback` is in Supabase's allowed redirect URLs.
- The ignored local `apple/Shared/Resources/BackendConfig.plist` contains the project URL and publishable key;
  the configured Mac/iPhone builds pass. It contains no Google client secret or Supabase service key.
- The public auth endpoint confirms both Google and Apple are enabled. Anonymous reads of all six
  app tables return HTTP 401, as intended.
- The configured Mac app opens successfully to Racket → Account. Unsigned Mac development builds now
  check their iCloud entitlements before starting CloudKit and use local storage when those are absent.
- Native Apple sign-in is active for `com.quentinlynch.tennisbuddy` on Apple team `3KJ46YFZM9`.
  The existing Apple Developer App ID is enabled as a primary App ID, and the Supabase Apple provider
  accepts that bundle ID. No web Services ID, Apple private signing key, or OAuth secret is used.
- The signed iPhone/Watch development build succeeds. Both the iPhone code signature and the refreshed
  provisioning profile include `com.apple.developer.applesignin = [Default]`. All 17 app tests pass.
- Signed Mac development testing is blocked because this Mac is not registered with the Apple team.
  The unsigned Mac build passes but cannot validate native Apple authorization. Register the Mac and
  refresh its Mac App Development profile before testing Apple sign-in there.
- A real Apple/Google sign-in and two-player session still need testing on a signed device build.

Without local connection configuration the app works in guest mode.

## Setup reference for a new project

1. For a **new** Supabase project, run `001_social.sql` once in its SQL editor. The current project is already installed.
2. In Supabase Authentication, configure Google OAuth with its project callback URL. For **native Apple**
   sign-in, enable Sign in with Apple on the existing Apple Developer App ID and configure Supabase's
   Apple provider with Client IDs `com.quentinlynch.tennisbuddy`. Leave the OAuth secret empty.
   Services IDs, a `.p8` signing key, and six-month OAuth secret rotation are needed only if adding
   Apple's separate browser OAuth flow; the phone/Mac apps now use native ID-token sign-in.
3. Add `tennisbuddee://auth/callback` to Supabase's allowed redirect URLs. The iPhone/Mac apps already
   register the `tennisbuddee` URL scheme and use the SDK's ASWebAuthenticationSession/PKCE flow.
4. Copy `BackendConfig.plist.example` to `apple/Shared/Resources/BackendConfig.plist`. Fill in the project
   URL and **publishable** client key. Do not use a service-role or secret key. The local file is ignored by Git.
5. Regenerate the Xcode project with `xcodegen generate --spec apple/project.yml`, then build and run.
   Do this after adding the plist so it is copied into app resources. OAuth sessions use the SDK's default
   Apple Keychain storage. The Watch does not hold a Supabase token.
6. Sign in on two test devices. Set names in Racket → Account. In Together, share a friend code once,
   send the request, and accept it from the other account. Each player can then invite the other directly.
   The invited player opens Together and accepts; no session code is needed between friends.

Official setup references: [Google](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/social-sign-in/auth-google),
[Apple](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/social-sign-in/auth-apple),
[Swift OAuth](https://supabase.com/docs/reference/swift/auth-signinwithoauth), and
[database function security](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/functions).

## Behaviour and boundaries

- Friend requests require acceptance. Pending requests expose names, not the other player's friend code.
  Friends can be removed. Removing a friend cancels pending invitations between those two players.
- Each direct invitation creates a shared match. Alternatively, share a random 12-character session code.
  Invitations/codes expire for new participants after 24 hours. Only two participants can join.
- Both players can log points and undo the latest point. The ordered log drives standard best-of-three,
  advantage scoring with normal set tiebreaks. A row lock and monotonic revision reject conflicting writes;
  operation UUIDs make retries idempotent. Undo retains a tombstone so a late retry cannot restore it.
- Together refreshes every two seconds **while the page is foreground**. Invitations are in-app;
  push notifications and background realtime subscriptions are not part of this implementation.
  Keep Together open on the iPhone for live shared Watch score updates. A reachable paired iPhone is
  required to send shared points from the Watch. Shared points are acknowledged before another is sent.
- Match scoring requires no racket. Either player can connect their own racket, then choose Record my
  racket stats. Each player's real racket summaries are uploaded every five seconds in the foreground.
  Simulator/replay data is excluded; microphone-only shots have no invented speed values. Multiple local
  recordings for the same match are aggregated. Pending summary uploads persist for later retries.
- Shared stats include shot count, sweet-spot percentage, average/top ball speed. Heart rate, calories,
  notes, raw recordings, and private session history are excluded. Each user can write only their own summary.
- Profiles/friendships/matches live in Supabase. Private sessions and skins remain in the existing local/iCloud
  storage and are not a Supabase account backup. Account switching does not partition private iCloud history.
- Table access is denied to both anonymous and authenticated roles. Narrow authenticated SQL functions
  validate membership and ownership before accessing data. Service-role access is never used by the app.

## Validation

Run `npm ci --prefix backend/supabase` then `npm test --prefix backend/supabase`.
The test runs the actual migration in embedded PostgreSQL (PGlite), with Supabase auth claims modelled
locally. It checks friend consent, invitations, participant isolation, direct-table denial, point retries,
stale revisions, undo, participant stats ownership, ended matches, and joining by code.

Before release, complete a real two-account OAuth/device test against the configured project, verify provider
branding and callback behaviour, add the required privacy/support/account-deletion flows, and decide whether
in-app invitations need push delivery. Deployment configuration, real provider login, live two-device networking,
Health/Activity ring credit, and hardware firmware transfers cannot be validated by these local tests.

## Native Apple sign-in

The app uses Apple's standard Sign in with Apple button and system sheet on iPhone and Mac.
Each request gets independent random 256-bit nonce/state values. Apple receives SHA-256(nonce),
the returned state is validated, and Supabase receives the signed Apple ID token plus the original nonce.
Challenges are consumed on completion, including cancellation. No Apple developer private key is bundled.
Apple's first-sign-in name is saved in account metadata and used for the player profile only if its name
is still the default. Later sign-ins do not erase an existing custom name.

The Xcode project includes `com.apple.developer.applesignin = [Default]` on iOS and Mac. Use a properly
signed build with updated provisioning profiles for a real sign-in. The unsigned Mac development build
can show the screen but cannot be used to validate native Apple authorization. The Watch uses its paired
phone's account rather than holding its own Supabase credentials.

See [Supabase's Apple guidance](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/social-sign-in/auth-apple) and
[Swift ID-token authentication](https://supabase.com/docs/reference/swift/auth-signinwithidtoken).
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "backend/supabase/functions/muse/index.ts", "sha256": "691d260a5aafb04fbe446a91d4238f8cd21566ef7603d59484d136d18929c94c", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````typescript
// Muse Spark proxy, served by Meta's Model API (OpenAI-compatible). The Meta key lives only in this
// function's secrets (META_API_KEY); the app authenticates with the signed-in user's Supabase session.
// MUSE_MODEL defaults to muse-spark-1.3 (see `GET https://api.meta.ai/v1/models`). MUSE_BASE_URL points
// at another OpenAI-compatible host; MUSE_REASONING_EFFORT (default "low") keeps replies fast.
import { createClient } from "npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2";

const BASE_URL = Deno.env.get("MUSE_BASE_URL") ?? "https://api.meta.ai/v1";
const ENDPOINT = `${BASE_URL}/chat/completions`;
const MODEL = Deno.env.get("MUSE_MODEL") ?? "muse-spark-1.3";
const EFFORT = Deno.env.get("MUSE_REASONING_EFFORT") ?? "low";
const MAX_BODY_BYTES = 256 * 1024;

const json = (body: unknown, status: number) =>
  new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { status, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method !== "POST") return json({ error: "method" }, 405);

  const token = req.headers.get("Authorization")?.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, "");
  if (!token) return json({ error: "unauthorized" }, 401);
  const supabase = createClient(Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!, Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY")!);
  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser(token);
  if (error || !data.user) return json({ error: "unauthorized" }, 401);

  const raw = await req.text();
  if (raw.length > MAX_BODY_BYTES) return json({ error: "too large" }, 413);
  let input: Record<string, unknown>;
  try { input = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { return json({ error: "bad json" }, 400); }
  if (!Array.isArray(input.messages)) return json({ error: "messages required" }, 400);

  const key = Deno.env.get("META_API_KEY");
  if (!key) return json({ error: "model not configured" }, 500);

  // Only forward fields the app needs, with the model and limits pinned server-side.
  const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
    model: MODEL,
    messages: input.messages,
    max_completion_tokens: Math.min(Number(input.max_completion_tokens) || 4096, 4096),
  };
  if (EFFORT) body.reasoning_effort = EFFORT;
  if (Array.isArray(input.tools) && input.tools.length > 0) {
    body.tools = input.tools;
    body.tool_choice = "auto";
  }

  const upstream = await fetch(ENDPOINT, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${key}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(40_000),
  }).catch(() => null);
  if (!upstream) return json({ error: "upstream unreachable" }, 502);
  return new Response(upstream.body, { status: upstream.status, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
});
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "backend/supabase/tests/social.test.mjs", "sha256": "f3a170f86ec29aa40d36b0a5bd5aab4b2ac0d59caee0c1541f02c2d3a6113b0e", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````text
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { PGlite } from '@electric-sql/pglite';

// Real Postgres in WASM; Supabase's auth.uid() is modelled with a per-request claim.
const ids = ['00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003'];
test('friend consent, invitations, participant isolation, score conflicts, undo, and private stats', async () => {
  const db = new PGlite();
  try {
    await db.exec(`create role anon; create role authenticated; create schema auth;
      create table auth.users(id uuid primary key);
      create function auth.uid() returns uuid language sql as $$ select nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), '')::uuid $$;
      grant usage on schema auth to anon, authenticated;`);
    await db.exec(await readFile(new URL('../001_social.sql', import.meta.url), 'utf8'));
    for (const id of ids) await db.query('insert into auth.users values ($1)', [id]);
    const as = async (id, role = 'authenticated') => {
      await db.exec('reset role');
      await db.query("select set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', $1, false)", [id ?? '']);
      await db.exec(`set role ${role}`);
    };
    const call = async (sql, params = []) => (await db.query(`select ${sql} as result`, params)).rows[0].result;
    await as(null, 'anon');
    await assert.rejects(call('public.social_dashboard()'), /permission denied/);
    await as(ids[0]);
    const a = await call('public.social_dashboard()');
    await call("public.set_player_name('Alice')");
    await as(ids[1]);
    const b = await call('public.social_dashboard()');
    await call("public.set_player_name('Bob')");
    await as(ids[2]);
    await call('public.social_dashboard()');
    await as(ids[0]);
    await assert.rejects(call('public.create_shared_match($1, $2)', ['Test', ids[1]]), /accepted friends/);
    await call('public.request_friend($1)', [b.profile.friendCode]);
    await call('public.respond_friend($1, true)', [ids[1]]); // requester cannot accept own request
    assert.equal((await call('public.social_dashboard()')).friends.length, 0);
    await as(ids[1]);
    assert.equal((await call('public.social_dashboard()')).requests[0].incoming, true);
    await call('public.respond_friend($1, true)', [ids[0]]);
    await as(ids[0]);
    assert.equal((await call('public.social_dashboard()')).friends[0].id, ids[1]);
    const match = await call('public.create_shared_match($1, $2)', ['Saturday singles', ids[1]]);
    await as(ids[2]);
    await assert.rejects(call('public.shared_match_state($1)', [match.id]), /not available/);
    await assert.rejects(call('public.accept_match_invitation($1)', [match.id]), /No invitation/);
    await assert.rejects(db.query('select * from public.shared_matches'), /permission denied/);
    await as(ids[1]);
    assert.equal((await call('public.social_dashboard()')).invitations[0].id, match.id);
    const joined = await call('public.accept_match_invitation($1)', [match.id]);
    assert.equal(joined.guest.id, ids[1]);
    const op = '10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
    await call('public.add_shared_point($1, $2, $3, 0)', [match.id, ids[0], op]);
    await call('public.add_shared_point($1, $2, $3, 0)', [match.id, ids[0], op]); // safe retry
    assert.equal((await call('public.shared_match_state($1)', [match.id])).points.length, 1);
    await assert.rejects(call('public.add_shared_point($1, $2, $3, 0)', [match.id, ids[1], '10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002']), /score changed/);
    await assert.rejects(call('public.add_shared_point($1, $2, $3, 1)', [match.id, ids[2], '10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003']), /Invalid player/);
    await call('public.share_racket_stats($1, 25, 80, 90, 125)', [match.id]);
    let state = await call('public.shared_match_state($1)', [match.id]);
    assert.equal(state.stats[0].id, ids[1]);
    assert.equal(state.stats[0].shots, 25);
    assert.equal(state.stats[0].averageBallKmh, 90);
    await assert.rejects(call('public.share_racket_stats($1, -1, 80)', [match.id]), /check constraint/);
    await as(ids[2]);
    await assert.rejects(call('public.share_racket_stats($1, 1, 80)', [match.id]), /not available/);
    await assert.rejects(call('public.add_shared_point($1, $2, $3, 1)', [match.id, ids[0], '10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004']), /not available/);
    await as(ids[0]);
    await assert.rejects(call('public.undo_shared_point($1, $2)', [match.id, '10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005']), /score changed/);
    await call('public.undo_shared_point($1, $2)', [match.id, op]);
    state = await call('public.shared_match_state($1)', [match.id]);
    assert.equal(state.points.length, 0);
    assert.equal(state.revision, 2);
    // A delayed retry of an undone operation must never restore the point.
    await call('public.add_shared_point($1, $2, $3, 0)', [match.id, ids[0], op]);
    assert.equal((await call('public.shared_match_state($1)', [match.id])).points.length, 0);
    await assert.rejects(call('public.add_shared_point($1, $2, $3, 0)', [match.id, ids[0], '10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007']), /score changed/);
    assert.equal(state.stats.length, 1); // undo changes only the point log
    await call('public.end_shared_match($1)', [match.id]);
    await assert.rejects(call('public.add_shared_point($1, $2, $3, 0)', [match.id, ids[0], '10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006']), /not active/);
    const codeMatch = await call("public.create_shared_match('Quick practice')");
    await as(ids[1]);
    await call('public.join_shared_match($1)', [codeMatch.inviteCode]);
    await as(ids[2]);
    await assert.rejects(call('public.join_shared_match($1)', [codeMatch.inviteCode]), /full/);
    await as(ids[0]);
    await call('public.remove_friend($1)', [ids[1]]);
    assert.equal((await call('public.social_dashboard()')).friends.length, 0);
    assert.equal(a.profile.friendCode.length, 12);
  } finally { await db.close(); }
});
````````

````````markdown
# Glimmer on Baseten (dedicated)

`config.yaml` is a complete Truss: vLLM serves `meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B`
(BF16, public, Apache 2.0) on 1xH100 with the `muse_glimmer` tool + reasoning
parsers, exposed as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. No `model/` directory needed.

```bash
# from the repo root, with BASETEN_API_KEY in .env
export K=$(grep -E '^\s*BASETEN_API_KEY\s*=' .env | sed 's/^[^=]*=//;s/^["'\'']//;s/["'\'']$//' | tail -n 1)
HOME=/tmp/truss-home .venv/bin/truss login --api-key "$K" --non-interactive; unset K
HOME=/tmp/truss-home .venv/bin/truss push baseten/glimmer --no-wait
```

Call it like any OpenAI-compatible host (deployment URL + key from the
dashboard). Scale to zero or delete the deployment when idle: an H100 bills
per minute while a replica runs.
````````

#### Reference: `baseten/glimmer/config.yaml`

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "baseten/glimmer/config.yaml", "sha256": "429ec25d2891ef4354cce1123830db3861714ef93d5f12fe0e360420e433b628", "trailing_newline": true} -->

````````text
# Dedicated Muse Glimmer 30B on Baseten (vLLM, OpenAI-compatible).
# Follows https://docs.baseten.co/examples/deploy-a-hugging-face-model with the
# Glimmer-specific image/parsers from Meta's cookbook + the vLLM recipe:
# image vllm/vllm-openai:muse-glimmer, --tool-call-parser + --reasoning-parser
# muse_glimmer together (ATEM framing; reasoning arrives as `reasoning`).
model_name: Muse Glimmer 30B
model_metadata:
  example_model_input:
    model: meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B
    messages:
      - role: user
        content: "Say hi in five words."
    max_tokens: 64
    temperature: 0.7
  tags:
    - openai-compatible

base_image:
  image: vllm/vllm-openai:muse-glimmer

weights:
  - source: "hf://meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B"
    mount_location: "/app/checkpoint/glimmer"

docker_server:
  start_command: >-
    sh -c "GPU_COUNT=$(nvidia-smi --list-gpus | wc -l) && vllm serve /app/checkpoint/glimmer
    --tensor-parallel-size $GPU_COUNT
    --served-model-name meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B
    --max-num-seqs 16
    --max-model-len 16384
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
    --enable-auto-tool-choice
    --tool-call-parser muse_glimmer
    --reasoning-parser muse_glimmer"
  readiness_endpoint: /health
  liveness_endpoint: /health
  predict_endpoint: /v1/chat/completions
  server_port: 8000

environment_variables:
  VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL: INFO

resources:
  accelerator: H100

runtime:
  predict_concurrency: 8
  health_checks:
    startup_threshold_seconds: 600
    restart_threshold_seconds: 300
    stop_traffic_threshold_seconds: 120
````````
