#### Reference: `firmware/include/protocol.h`

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "firmware/include/protocol.h", "sha256": "8117c4c15158d4cc557fe48c9a115e9595a870f521dafa9672c159e0d97e1f04", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````cpp
// BLE protocol shared with the apps (see docs/PLAN.md, "BLE protocol").
// Keep in sync with apple/RacketKit/Sources/RacketKit/Protocol.swift.
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>

#define TB_DEVICE_NAME   "Tennis Buddy"
#define TB_SERVICE_UUID  "7E5B0001-6B1D-4D8E-9C1A-7E5B7E5B0001"
#define TB_IMU_UUID      "7E5B0002-6B1D-4D8E-9C1A-7E5B7E5B0001"
#define TB_STATUS_UUID   "7E5B0003-6B1D-4D8E-9C1A-7E5B7E5B0001"
#define TB_CONTROL_UUID  "7E5B0004-6B1D-4D8E-9C1A-7E5B7E5B0001"
#define TB_SHOT_UUID     "7E5B0005-6B1D-4D8E-9C1A-7E5B7E5B0001"  // on-device ML verdict, notify
#define TB_TAP_UUID      "7E5B0006-6B1D-4D8E-9C1A-7E5B7E5B0001"  // handle tap gesture, notify
// Impact mode (firmware 1.5+): the racket detects hits itself and sends only the samples around each one.
// 0007 stays unused: legacy OTA firmware used it for image data.
#define TB_HIT_UUID      "7E5B0008-6B1D-4D8E-9C1A-7E5B7E5B0001"  // TBHit, notify, sent the moment a hit is seen
#define TB_WINDOW_UUID   "7E5B0009-6B1D-4D8E-9C1A-7E5B7E5B0001"  // TBWindowChunk, notify, the samples around it
#define TB_POSE_UUID     "7E5B000A-6B1D-4D8E-9C1A-7E5B7E5B0001"  // TBPose, notify, ~30 Hz orientation for live views
// Firmware 1.6+: the shot computed on the racket (shot.cpp), sent before its window. Its presence tells the app the
// racket supports TB_STREAM_IMPACTS_ACKED.
#define TB_SUMMARY_UUID  "7E5B000B-6B1D-4D8E-9C1A-7E5B7E5B0001"  // TBShotSummary, notify

#define TB_FW_MAJOR 1
#define TB_FW_MINOR 9

#define TB_SAMPLES_PER_PACKET 8

// Impact window: samples before and after the impact sample, sent in TB_SAMPLES_PER_PACKET chunks.
#define TB_WINDOW_PRE 384
#define TB_WINDOW_POST 64
#define TB_WINDOW_SAMPLES (TB_WINDOW_PRE + TB_WINDOW_POST)
#define TB_WINDOW_CHUNKS (TB_WINDOW_SAMPLES / TB_SAMPLES_PER_PACKET)

// Control commands (first byte written to the control characteristic)
enum : uint8_t {
  TB_CMD_START_STREAM = 0x01,
  TB_CMD_STOP_STREAM  = 0x02,
  TB_CMD_H3LIS_RANGE  = 0x10,  // second byte: 0 = 100 g, 1 = 200 g, 3 = 400 g. Ignored since 1.6 (always 400 g);
                               // TBStatus.h3lis_range reports the range in use.
  TB_CMD_GYRO_RANGE   = 0x11,  // second byte: 0 = ±2000 dps (16.4 LSB/dps), 1 = ±4000 dps (8.2 LSB/dps).
                               // Firmware 1.3+. Since 1.8 the racket is pinned to ±2000 dps and ignores a request
                               // for ±4000 (GYRO_4000_ALLOWED in main.cpp: the sensor did not really leave ±2000 on
                               // 1.5-1.7, so ±4000 packets read 2x high); every packet's TB_FLAG_GYRO_4000 says which.
  TB_CMD_STREAM_MODE  = 0x12,  // second byte: 0 = raw (every sample on the IMU characteristic), 1 = impacts
                               // (hit, window and pose characteristics only). Firmware 1.5+. Back to raw when
                               // the last client disconnects, so an app that never sends this still streams.
  // Firmware 1.6+:
  TB_CMD_SHOT_CONFIG  = 0x13,  // then TB_SHOT_CONFIG_PAYLOAD bytes (shot.h): calibration and racket profile
  TB_CMD_WINDOW_ACK   = 0x14,  // then boot u16, seq u16: the app has that window; the racket frees it
  TB_CMD_WINDOW_RESEND = 0x15, // then boot u16, seq u16, n u8, n chunk indexes (n = 0: the whole window)
  TB_CMD_SET_TIME     = 0x16,  // then unix time in ms, u64: lets backlog shots carry the time they were hit
};

enum : uint8_t {
  TB_STREAM_RAW = 0,
  TB_STREAM_IMPACTS = 1,
  // Firmware 1.6+: impacts, plus a TBShotSummary per hit, windows kept until the app acks them (TB_CMD_WINDOW_ACK)
  // and resent if it doesn't, and windows captured while no phone was connected (RAM, then flash) sent later.
  // Chunks are TBWindowChunkAcked. Once an app has asked for this mode the racket keeps capturing windows
  // even with no phone connected, across reboots.
  TB_STREAM_IMPACTS_ACKED = 2,
};

// What found a hit (TBHit.source)
enum : uint8_t {
  TB_HIT_MOTION = 1,  // high-g jump during a swing
  TB_HIT_MIC = 2,     // the mic heard it and a smaller high-g jump confirmed it (blocks, soft volleys)
};

// Status flags
enum : uint8_t {
  TB_FLAG_MPU_OK   = 1 << 0,
  TB_FLAG_H3LIS_OK = 1 << 1,
  TB_FLAG_STREAMING = 1 << 2,
  TB_FLAG_GYRO_4000 = 1 << 3,  // gyro samples in this packet are 8.2 LSB/dps (±4000 dps), not 16.4
  TB_FLAG_IMPACT_MODE = 1 << 4,  // status only: the racket is in impact mode (TB_CMD_STREAM_MODE)
  TB_FLAG_BACKLOG = 1 << 5,      // window chunk / summary: captured while the link was busy or down, sent late
};

// TBShotSummary.type / .spin (ShotType / SpinType in ShotMetrics.swift)
enum : uint8_t { TB_SHOT_FOREHAND = 0, TB_SHOT_BACKHAND = 1, TB_SHOT_SERVE = 2, TB_SHOT_VOLLEY = 3 };
enum : uint8_t { TB_SPIN_TOPSPIN = 0, TB_SPIN_FLAT = 1, TB_SPIN_SLICE = 2 };
enum : uint8_t {
  TB_SUMMARY_SATURATED = 1 << 0,   // gyro hit its full scale around the swing
  TB_SUMMARY_BACKLOG = 1 << 1,     // sent late (link was busy or down)
};

#pragma pack(push, 1)
// Units are those of the original MPU6050 + H3LIS331DL; the LSM6DSV320X firmware converts into them.
struct TBSample {
  int16_t ax, ay, az;  // low-g accel, 2048 LSB/g (±16 g)
  int16_t gx, gy, gz;  // gyro, 16.4 LSB/(deg/s) (±2000 deg/s), or 8.2 with TB_FLAG_GYRO_4000
  int16_t hx, hy, hz;  // high-g accel as H3LIS331DL counts, 12-bit left-aligned (>> 4), at the h3lis_range scale
};

struct TBPacket {
  uint16_t seq;
  uint32_t t0_us;      // micros() of the first sample; samples are 1 ms apart
  uint8_t count;       // valid samples (normally TB_SAMPLES_PER_PACKET)
  uint8_t flags;       // TB_FLAG_*
  TBSample s[TB_SAMPLES_PER_PACKET];
};

struct TBStatus {
  uint16_t battery_mv;
  uint8_t fw_major, fw_minor;
  uint8_t flags;
  uint8_t h3lis_range;  // 0 = 100 g, 1 = 200 g, 3 = 400 g
  uint16_t dropped;     // packets dropped because the BLE queue was full
};
// One verdict from the on-device sweet-spot model (firmware/src/sweetspot.cpp), sent once per detected impact.
struct TBShot {
  uint16_t seq;         // counts impacts since boot
  uint8_t sweet;        // 1 = sweet spot, 0 = off-center
  uint8_t off_pct;      // 0 if sweet; else 33..100, distance toward the frame (100 = at the frame)
  uint8_t confidence;   // 0 = unavailable (ridge); legacy classifier used 50..100 percent
  uint8_t level;        // impact loudness, 0..255 (255 = full scale; ~255 means the mic clipped)
};
// One handle-tap gesture (firmware/src/tap.cpp), sent once the taps stop: a single, double or triple tap.
// Swings and ball impacts are filtered out on the racket.
struct TBTap {
  uint16_t seq;         // counts gestures since boot
  uint8_t count;        // taps in the gesture: 1 = single, 2 = double, ...
  uint8_t strength;     // strongest tap's jolt, 0..255 (255 = 2 g or more above the resting level)
  uint8_t zone;         // where on the handle: 0 = unknown, 1 butt, 2 grip_60, 3 grip_120, 4 grip_180, 5 throat
  uint8_t confidence;   // 0..100 (%), confidence in the zone; 0 while the zone model is unfitted
  int8_t dir[3];        // strongest tap's push direction in accel (sensor) axes, unit vector x 127. Its sign
                        // depends on which of two opposite sides was hit, so the app compares |cos| to the
                        // calibrated wide-side and narrow-side axes.
};
// Sent the moment a hit is detected, before its window. Quaternions are w, x, y, z x 16384 and rotate sensor
// axes into the world (z up), from the racket's own orientation filter (firmware/src/impact.cpp).
struct TBHit {
  uint16_t seq;         // counts hits since boot; the window with the same seq follows
  uint32_t t_us;        // micros() of the impact sample
  uint8_t source;       // TB_HIT_*
  uint8_t jump_g;       // high-g change over 3 ms at the impact, g (capped at 255)
  uint16_t swing_dps;   // fastest rotation in the 150 ms before the impact
  int16_t q[4];         // orientation at the impact
};
// One slice of a hit's window. Gyro is always at 8.2 LSB/dps (TB_FLAG_GYRO_4000 set), whatever the range.
struct TBWindowChunk {
  uint16_t seq;         // the TBHit this belongs to
  uint8_t index;        // 0 .. total - 1
  uint8_t total;        // TB_WINDOW_CHUNKS
  uint16_t impact;      // index of the impact sample in the whole window
  int16_t q0[4];        // orientation at the window's first sample (same in every chunk)
  uint32_t t0_us;       // micros() of this chunk's first sample; samples are 1 ms apart
  uint8_t count;
  uint8_t flags;        // TB_FLAG_*
  TBSample s[TB_SAMPLES_PER_PACKET];
};
// TB_STREAM_IMPACTS_ACKED: the same chunk with the racket's boot number, so acks and resends name one window even
// across reboots (seq restarts at 0 on every boot).
struct TBWindowChunkAcked {
  uint16_t seq;
  uint8_t index;
  uint8_t total;
  uint16_t impact;
  int16_t q0[4];
  uint32_t t0_us;
  uint8_t count;
  uint8_t flags;        // TB_FLAG_*; TB_FLAG_BACKLOG when sent late
  uint16_t boot;        // increments on every power-up
  TBSample s[TB_SAMPLES_PER_PACKET];
};
// The shot computed on the racket (firmware/src/shot.cpp), one per hit, before its window.
struct TBShotSummary {
  uint16_t seq;         // the TBHit / window it belongs to
  uint16_t boot;
  uint8_t gen;          // TB_CMD_SHOT_CONFIG generation it was computed with
  uint8_t type;         // TB_SHOT_*
  uint8_t spin;         // TB_SPIN_*
  uint8_t flags;        // TB_SUMMARY_*
  uint32_t age_ms;      // ms between the hit and sending this; 0xFFFFFFFF if hit before the last reboot
  uint64_t unix_ms;     // when it was hit, if the app had set the time (TB_CMD_SET_TIME); else 0
  float swing_kmh, ball_kmh, spin_rpm, face_deg, path_deg, impact_x_cm, impact_y_cm, peak_g;
  float roll_ratio, ring_norm, jolt, impulse, spin_axis_y, vertical_spin, swing_deg;   // ImpactFeatures
};
// Live orientation while in impact mode, ~30 Hz.
struct TBPose {
  int16_t q[4];
  uint16_t gyro_dps;    // |gyro|
  uint8_t high_g;       // |high-g accel|, g (capped at 255)
  uint8_t flags;        // TB_FLAG_*
};
#pragma pack(pop)

static_assert(sizeof(TBSample) == 18, "sample size");
static_assert(sizeof(TBPacket) == 152, "packet must fit one 185-byte iOS MTU");
static_assert(sizeof(TBStatus) == 8, "status size");
static_assert(sizeof(TBShot) == 6, "shot size");
static_assert(sizeof(TBTap) == 9, "tap size");
static_assert(sizeof(TBHit) == 18, "hit size");
static_assert(sizeof(TBWindowChunk) == 164, "window chunk must fit one 185-byte iOS MTU");
static_assert(sizeof(TBPose) == 12, "pose size");
static_assert(sizeof(TBWindowChunkAcked) == 166, "acked window chunk must fit one 185-byte iOS MTU");
static_assert(sizeof(TBShotSummary) == 80, "shot summary size");
static_assert(TB_WINDOW_SAMPLES % TB_SAMPLES_PER_PACKET == 0, "window must be whole chunks");
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "firmware/src/backlog.cpp", "sha256": "2bbfa228f1bf23d5e37dc9b0b38a66c81affe241978b55212fd9756253c660d0", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````cpp
#include "backlog.h"

#include <string.h>

#ifdef ARDUINO
#include <Arduino.h>
static portMUX_TYPE mux = portMUX_INITIALIZER_UNLOCKED;
#define BL_LOCK() portENTER_CRITICAL(&mux)
#define BL_UNLOCK() portEXIT_CRITICAL(&mux)
#else
#define BL_LOCK()
#define BL_UNLOCK()
#endif

// Threads: the sampler reserves and captures slots, the shot task analyses them, the loop does everything else
// (sending, acks and resends, which main.cpp queues to it, and all flash access). State changes that cross
// threads happen under BL_LOCK.

static BacklogSlot slots[BL_SLOTS];
static uint16_t bootId;
static uint32_t nextOrder = 1;
static BacklogStats stats;

static const uint64_t ALL_CHUNKS = (TB_WINDOW_CHUNKS >= 64) ? ~0ull : ((1ull << TB_WINDOW_CHUNKS) - 1);
static_assert(TB_WINDOW_CHUNKS <= 64, "chunk bitmap");

// ---- Flash log ----
// Record: RecHeader, TBShotSummary, ImpactWindow, then at the end a commit word (written last) and an ack word.
// Both start erased (0xFFFFFFFF) and are cleared to 0; flash can clear bits without erasing.
static const uint32_t MAGIC = 0x31574254;   // "TBW1"
struct RecHeader {
  uint32_t magic;
  uint32_t serial;     // write order, never reused
  uint16_t boot;
  uint16_t seq;
  uint8_t summaryOk;
  uint8_t pad[3];
  uint32_t hitMs;
  uint64_t unixMs;
  uint32_t crc;        // of the summary and window
  uint32_t pad2;
};
static_assert(sizeof(RecHeader) == 40, "record header");
static const uint32_t OFF_SUMMARY = sizeof(RecHeader);
static const uint32_t OFF_WINDOW = OFF_SUMMARY + sizeof(TBShotSummary);
static const uint32_t DATA_END = OFF_WINDOW + sizeof(ImpactWindow);
static const uint32_t OFF_COMMIT = BL_RECORD_SIZE - 8, OFF_ACK = BL_RECORD_SIZE - 4;
static_assert(DATA_END <= OFF_COMMIT, "record too small for a window");

enum : uint8_t { R_UNKNOWN, R_ERASED, R_PENDING, R_DIRTY };
static const int MAX_RECS = 128;
static const BacklogFlash *fl = nullptr;
static int nrec = 0;
static uint8_t recState[MAX_RECS];
static uint32_t recSerial[MAX_RECS];
static uint16_t recBoot[MAX_RECS], recSeq[MAX_RECS];
static int head = 0;               // next record to write
static uint32_t nextSerial = 1;
// Spill in progress: slot spillSlot is being written to record head, page spillPage next.
static int spillSlot = -1, spillPage = 0;
static RecHeader spillHdr;
// Erase in progress: record eraseRec, sector eraseSector next.
static int eraseRec = -1, eraseSector = 0;

static uint32_t crc32(uint32_t crc, const void *data, size_t len) {
  const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)data;
  crc = ~crc;
  while (len--) {
    crc ^= *p++;
    for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) crc = (crc >> 1) ^ (0xEDB88320u & (0u - (crc & 1)));
  }
  return ~crc;
}

static uint32_t recOff(int r) { return (uint32_t)r * BL_RECORD_SIZE; }

static void freeSlot(BacklogSlot &s) {
  BL_LOCK();
  s.state = BL_FREE;
  BL_UNLOCK();
}

void backlogInit(uint16_t boot, const BacklogFlash *flash) {
  bootId = boot;
  memset(&stats, 0, sizeof(stats));
  for (auto &s : slots) {
    s.state = BL_FREE;
    s.flashRec = -1;
  }
  fl = flash && flash->size >= BL_RECORD_SIZE ? flash : nullptr;
  nrec = fl ? (int)(fl->size / BL_RECORD_SIZE) : 0;
  if (nrec > MAX_RECS) nrec = MAX_RECS;
  spillSlot = eraseRec = -1;
  uint32_t maxSerial = 0;
  int maxRec = -1;
  for (int r = 0; r < nrec; r++) {
    RecHeader h;
    uint32_t words[2];
    recState[r] = R_UNKNOWN;
    recSerial[r] = 0;
    if (!fl->read(recOff(r), &h, sizeof(h)) || !fl->read(recOff(r) + OFF_COMMIT, words, sizeof(words))) continue;
    if (h.magic == MAGIC) {
      recSerial[r] = h.serial;
      recBoot[r] = h.boot;
      recSeq[r] = h.seq;
      recState[r] = (words[0] == 0 && words[1] == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? R_PENDING : R_DIRTY;
      if (h.serial >= maxSerial) { maxSerial = h.serial; maxRec = r; }
    }
  }
  nextSerial = maxSerial + 1;
  head = maxRec < 0 ? 0 : (maxRec + 1) % (nrec ? nrec : 1);
}

BacklogSlot &backlogSlot(int i) { return slots[i]; }

int backlogReserve() {
  int found = -1;
  BL_LOCK();
  for (int i = 0; i < BL_SLOTS; i++)
    if (slots[i].state == BL_FREE) {
      slots[i].state = BL_FILLING;
      found = i;
      break;
    }
  BL_UNLOCK();
  return found;
}

void backlogRelease(int slot) {
  if (slot >= 0) freeSlot(slots[slot]);
}

void backlogCaptured(int slot, uint32_t nowMs, uint64_t unixMs, bool backlog) {
  BacklogSlot &s = slots[slot];
  s.summaryOk = s.summarySent = false;
  s.backlog = backlog;
  s.boot = bootId;
  s.hitMs = nowMs;
  s.unixMs = unixMs;
  s.flashRec = -1;
  s.pending = ALL_CHUNKS;
  s.sentAtMs = 0;
  BL_LOCK();
  s.order = nextOrder++;
  s.state = BL_CAPTURED;
  stats.captured++;
  BL_UNLOCK();
}

void backlogDropped() { stats.dropped++; }

int backlogNextCaptured() {
  int best = -1;
  BL_LOCK();
  for (int i = 0; i < BL_SLOTS; i++)
    if (slots[i].state == BL_CAPTURED && (best < 0 || slots[i].order < slots[best].order)) best = i;
  BL_UNLOCK();
  return best;
}

void backlogAnalyzed(int slot, bool ok) {
  BacklogSlot &s = slots[slot];
  s.summaryOk = ok;
  BL_LOCK();
  if (s.state == BL_CAPTURED) s.state = BL_READY;
  BL_UNLOCK();
}

BacklogMsg backlogNext(bool acked, uint32_t nowMs) {
  BacklogMsg m = {BacklogMsg::NONE, -1, -1};
  // Unacked windows go round again.
  if (acked)
    for (int i = 0; i < BL_SLOTS; i++) {
      BacklogSlot &s = slots[i];
      if (s.state == BL_SENT && i != spillSlot && nowMs - s.sentAtMs > BL_RESEND_MS) {
        s.pending = ALL_CHUNKS;
        s.state = BL_READY;
        stats.resent++;
      }
    }
  // Summaries first, oldest first: they are what the player sees.
  int oldest = -1;
  for (int i = 0; i < BL_SLOTS; i++) {
    BacklogSlot &s = slots[i];
    if (s.state != BL_READY || i == spillSlot) continue;
    if (acked && s.summaryOk && !s.summarySent && (m.slot < 0 || s.order < slots[m.slot].order)) {
      m.kind = BacklogMsg::SUMMARY;
      m.slot = i;
    }
    if (s.pending && (oldest < 0 || s.order < slots[oldest].order)) oldest = i;
  }
  if (m.kind == BacklogMsg::SUMMARY) return m;
  if (oldest < 0) return m;
  BacklogSlot &s = slots[oldest];
  int c = 0;
  while (!(s.pending >> c & 1)) c++;
  m.kind = BacklogMsg::CHUNK;
  m.slot = oldest;
  m.chunk = c;
  return m;
}

void backlogSent(const BacklogMsg &m, bool acked, uint32_t nowMs) {
  if (m.kind == BacklogMsg::NONE) return;
  BacklogSlot &s = slots[m.slot];
  if (m.kind == BacklogMsg::SUMMARY) {
    s.summarySent = true;
    return;
  }
  s.pending &= ~(1ull << m.chunk);
  if (s.pending) return;
  if (acked) {
    s.state = BL_SENT;
    s.sentAtMs = nowMs;
  } else {
    freeSlot(s);   // plain impact mode: fire and forget, as before 1.6
  }
}

static int findSlot(uint16_t boot, uint16_t seq) {
  for (int i = 0; i < BL_SLOTS; i++) {
    const BacklogSlot &s = slots[i];
    if ((s.state == BL_READY || s.state == BL_SENT) && s.boot == boot && s.win.seq == seq) return i;
  }
  return -1;
}

static void flashAck(int r) {
  if (r < 0 || r >= nrec || recState[r] != R_PENDING) return;
  uint32_t zero = 0;
  fl->write(recOff(r) + OFF_ACK, &zero, sizeof(zero));
  recState[r] = R_DIRTY;
}

bool backlogAck(uint16_t boot, uint16_t seq) {
  int i = findSlot(boot, seq);
  bool found = false;
  if (i >= 0) {
    BacklogSlot &s = slots[i];
    if (i == spillSlot) {   // the write in progress is no longer needed: leave the record half-written (dirty)
      recState[head] = R_DIRTY;
      head = (head + 1) % nrec;
      spillSlot = -1;
    }
    flashAck(s.flashRec);
    freeSlot(s);
    found = true;
  }
  for (int r = 0; r < nrec; r++)   // a copy may still sit in flash (spilled, then loaded and acked)
    if (recState[r] == R_PENDING && recBoot[r] == boot && recSeq[r] == seq) {
      flashAck(r);
      found = true;
    }
  if (found) stats.acked++;
  return found;
}

bool backlogResend(uint16_t boot, uint16_t seq, const uint8_t *chunks, int n) {
  int i = findSlot(boot, seq);
  if (i < 0) return false;
  BacklogSlot &s = slots[i];
  if (n == 0) {
    s.pending = ALL_CHUNKS;
  } else {
    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++)
      if (chunks[k] < TB_WINDOW_CHUNKS) s.pending |= 1ull << chunks[k];
  }
  s.state = BL_READY;
  stats.resent++;
  return true;
}

// ---- Flash housekeeping ----

static bool recordErased(int r) {
  static uint8_t buf[BL_PAGE];
  for (uint32_t o = 0; o < BL_RECORD_SIZE; o += sizeof(buf)) {
    if (!fl->read(recOff(r) + o, buf, sizeof(buf))) return false;
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < sizeof(buf); k++)
      if (buf[k] != 0xFF) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

// One page of the record being spilled: header, summary and window laid end to end.
static void recordPage(int page, uint8_t *out) {
  const BacklogSlot &s = slots[spillSlot];
  uint32_t start = (uint32_t)page * BL_PAGE;
  memset(out, 0xFF, BL_PAGE);
  for (uint32_t k = 0; k < BL_PAGE; k++) {
    uint32_t o = start + k;
    if (o < OFF_SUMMARY) out[k] = ((const uint8_t *)&spillHdr)[o];
    else if (o < OFF_WINDOW) out[k] = ((const uint8_t *)&s.summary)[o - OFF_SUMMARY];
    else if (o < DATA_END) out[k] = ((const uint8_t *)&s.win)[o - OFF_WINDOW];
  }
}

static int pendingCount() {
  int n = 0;
  for (int r = 0; r < nrec; r++) n += recState[r] == R_PENDING;
  return n;
}

static int oldestPending() {
  int best = -1;
  for (int r = 0; r < nrec; r++)
    if (recState[r] == R_PENDING && (best < 0 || recSerial[r] < recSerial[best])) best = r;
  return best;
}

static bool anySlot(uint8_t state) {
  for (auto &s : slots)
    if (s.state == state) return true;
  return false;
}

bool backlogStep(bool connected, bool idle, uint32_t nowMs) {
  if (!fl || nrec == 0) {
    // No flash: when RAM is full the newest window is dropped by the sampler (backlogReserve fails).
    return false;
  }
  // 1. A spill in progress: one page per step, then the commit word.
  if (spillSlot >= 0) {
    static uint8_t page[BL_PAGE];
    const int pages = (DATA_END + BL_PAGE - 1) / BL_PAGE;
    if (spillPage < pages) {
      recordPage(spillPage, page);
      fl->write(recOff(head) + (uint32_t)spillPage * BL_PAGE, page, BL_PAGE);
      spillPage++;
      return true;
    }
    uint32_t zero = 0;
    fl->write(recOff(head) + OFF_COMMIT, &zero, sizeof(zero));
    BacklogSlot &s = slots[spillSlot];
    recState[head] = R_PENDING;
    recSerial[head] = spillHdr.serial;
    recBoot[head] = s.boot;
    recSeq[head] = s.win.seq;
    head = (head + 1) % nrec;
    freeSlot(s);
    spillSlot = -1;
    stats.spilled++;
    return true;
  }
  // 2. An erase in progress (only while idle): one sector per step.
  if (eraseRec >= 0) {
    if (!idle) return false;
    fl->erase(recOff(eraseRec) + (uint32_t)eraseSector * BL_SECTOR, BL_SECTOR);
    if (++eraseSector * BL_SECTOR >= BL_RECORD_SIZE) {
      recState[eraseRec] = R_ERASED;
      eraseRec = -1;
    }
    return true;
  }
  // 3. RAM full (or the phone is gone and the racket idle): spill the oldest window that isn't already in flash.
  bool full = !anySlot(BL_FREE);
  if (full || (!connected && idle)) {
    int victim = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < BL_SLOTS; i++) {
      const BacklogSlot &s = slots[i];
      if ((s.state == BL_READY || s.state == BL_SENT) && (victim < 0 || s.order < slots[victim].order)) victim = i;
    }
    if (victim >= 0 && slots[victim].flashRec >= 0) {
      if (full) freeSlot(slots[victim]);   // already safe in flash: just make room
      return false;
    }
    if (victim >= 0) {
      if (recState[head] == R_UNKNOWN) recState[head] = recordErased(head) ? R_ERASED : R_DIRTY;
      if (recState[head] != R_ERASED && idle) {
        // No erased record ready (the log is full of unsent windows, or nothing was erased ahead): make one,
        // overwriting the oldest unsent window if that is what sits there.
        if (recState[head] == R_PENDING) stats.flashLost++;
        eraseRec = head;
        eraseSector = 0;
        return backlogStep(connected, idle, nowMs);
      }
      if (recState[head] == R_ERASED) {
        BacklogSlot &s = slots[victim];
        memset(&spillHdr, 0, sizeof(spillHdr));
        spillHdr.magic = MAGIC;
        spillHdr.serial = nextSerial++;
        spillHdr.boot = s.boot;
        spillHdr.seq = s.win.seq;
        spillHdr.summaryOk = s.summaryOk;
        spillHdr.hitMs = s.hitMs;
        spillHdr.unixMs = s.unixMs;
        spillHdr.crc = crc32(crc32(0, &s.summary, sizeof(s.summary)), &s.win, sizeof(s.win));
        spillSlot = victim;
        spillPage = 0;
        return backlogStep(connected, idle, nowMs);
      }
    }
  }
  // 4. While idle, keep the record at head (and one after it) erased so a spill never has to wait for an erase.
  if (idle) {
    for (int ahead = 0; ahead < 2 && ahead < nrec; ahead++) {
      int r = (head + ahead) % nrec;
      if (recState[r] == R_ERASED) continue;
      if (recState[r] == R_UNKNOWN) {
        recState[r] = recordErased(r) ? R_ERASED : R_DIRTY;
        return true;
      }
      if (recState[r] == R_PENDING) break;   // the log has wrapped onto unsent windows: erase only when needed
      eraseRec = r;
      eraseSector = 0;
      return backlogStep(connected, idle, nowMs);
    }
  }
  // 5. The link is free: bring back the oldest window from flash.
  if (connected && !anySlot(BL_READY) && !anySlot(BL_SENT) && !anySlot(BL_CAPTURED)) {
    int r = oldestPending();
    if (r < 0) return false;
    bool loaded = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < BL_SLOTS && !loaded; i++) {
      BacklogSlot &s = slots[i];
      BL_LOCK();
      bool mine = s.state == BL_FREE;
      if (mine) s.state = BL_FILLING;
      BL_UNLOCK();
      if (!mine) continue;
      RecHeader h;
      bool ok = fl->read(recOff(r), &h, sizeof(h)) && fl->read(recOff(r) + OFF_SUMMARY, &s.summary, sizeof(s.summary)) &&
                fl->read(recOff(r) + OFF_WINDOW, &s.win, sizeof(s.win)) &&
                h.crc == crc32(crc32(0, &s.summary, sizeof(s.summary)), &s.win, sizeof(s.win));
      if (!ok) {
        recState[r] = R_DIRTY;   // corrupt: drop it
        stats.flashLost++;
        freeSlot(s);
        return true;
      }
      s.summaryOk = h.summaryOk;
      s.summarySent = false;
      s.backlog = true;
      s.boot = h.boot;
      s.hitMs = h.hitMs;
      s.unixMs = h.unixMs;
      s.flashRec = r;
      s.pending = ALL_CHUNKS;
      BL_LOCK();
      s.order = nextOrder++;
      s.state = BL_READY;
      BL_UNLOCK();
      stats.loaded++;
      loaded = true;
    }
    return loaded;
  }
  return false;
}

BacklogStats backlogStats() {
  BacklogStats s = stats;
  s.flashPending = pendingCount();
  s.erasedAhead = 0;
  for (int a = 0; a < nrec && recState[(head + a) % nrec] == R_ERASED; a++) s.erasedAhead++;
  return s;
}
````````

````````cpp
// Impact windows waiting to reach the phone (firmware 1.6, TB_STREAM_IMPACTS_ACKED).
//
// RAM: BL_SLOTS windows. The sampler fills one when a hit's window completes, the shot task adds its summary, the
// loop sends the summary and then the chunks, and frees the slot once the app acks it (or, for an app in plain
// impact mode, once the last chunk is out). Unacked windows are sent again after BL_RESEND_MS.
//
// Flash: when every slot is taken (the link is slow or the phone is gone), the oldest is written to a log of
// fixed BL_RECORD_SIZE records in the spare data partition, and read back once the link is free. Erasing stalls
// the CPU for tens of ms, so sectors are only erased while the racket is idle; writes go one page per step.
//
// No Arduino dependencies: the flash is reached through BacklogFlash, so tools/backlog_test/ runs it on a laptop.
#pragma once
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#include "impact.h"
#include "protocol.h"

#define BL_SLOTS 6
#define BL_RESEND_MS 5000
#define BL_SECTOR 4096
#define BL_PAGE 256
#define BL_RECORD_SIZE (3 * BL_SECTOR)

struct BacklogFlash {
  uint32_t size;   // bytes in the partition; 0 = no flash backlog
  bool (*read)(uint32_t off, void *dst, uint32_t len);
  bool (*write)(uint32_t off, const void *src, uint32_t len);   // only clears bits; the range must be erased
  bool (*erase)(uint32_t off, uint32_t len);                     // whole sectors
};

enum : uint8_t { BL_FREE, BL_FILLING, BL_CAPTURED, BL_READY, BL_SENT };

struct BacklogSlot {
  volatile uint8_t state;
  bool summaryOk;      // the shot task produced a summary
  bool summarySent;
  bool backlog;        // sent late: spilled to flash, or captured while no phone was connected
  uint16_t boot;
  uint32_t order;      // capture order, oldest first
  uint32_t hitMs;      // millis() when captured (this boot only)
  uint64_t unixMs;     // wall-clock time of the hit, if known; else 0
  int32_t flashRec;    // flash record holding this window, or -1
  uint64_t pending;    // chunk bits still to send
  uint32_t sentAtMs;
  TBShotSummary summary;
  ImpactWindow win;
};

// Message the loop should send next (see backlogNext).
struct BacklogMsg {
  enum Kind : uint8_t { NONE, SUMMARY, CHUNK } kind;
  int slot;
  int chunk;
};

void backlogInit(uint16_t boot, const BacklogFlash *flash);
BacklogSlot &backlogSlot(int i);

// Sampler: a slot to capture the next window into (-1 if none is free), then hand it over when filled.
int backlogReserve();
void backlogCaptured(int slot, uint32_t nowMs, uint64_t unixMs, bool backlog);
void backlogRelease(int slot);   // a reserved slot that won't be used (e.g. capture turned off)
void backlogDropped();           // a window completed with no slot to put it in

// Shot task: the next captured window, then its result (ok = false: no summary, the app analyses the window).
int backlogNextCaptured();
void backlogAnalyzed(int slot, bool ok);

// Loop: what to send next. acked: the app speaks TB_STREAM_IMPACTS_ACKED. Call backlogSent after sending it.
BacklogMsg backlogNext(bool acked, uint32_t nowMs);
void backlogSent(const BacklogMsg &m, bool acked, uint32_t nowMs);

// The app's TB_CMD_WINDOW_ACK / TB_CMD_WINDOW_RESEND. Return false if no such window is held.
bool backlogAck(uint16_t boot, uint16_t seq);
bool backlogResend(uint16_t boot, uint16_t seq, const uint8_t *chunks, int n);

// Loop housekeeping, one small step per call: spill to flash when RAM is full, erase ahead while idle, load a
// flash record when the link is free. connected: an app in TB_STREAM_IMPACTS_ACKED is connected. Returns true
// if it touched the flash (so the caller can yield to the sampler).
bool backlogStep(bool connected, bool idle, uint32_t nowMs);

// Counters for the status line and tests.
struct BacklogStats {
  uint32_t captured, dropped, acked, resent, spilled, loaded, flashLost, flashPending, erasedAhead;
};
BacklogStats backlogStats();

````````

````````cpp
#include "impact.h"

#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

// ---- Detection tuning (the phone's RacketEngine used the same motion rule on the raw stream) ----
static const float JUMP_G = 10.0f;          // high-g change over 3 ms that counts as a ball impact ...
static const float SWING_RADS = 5.0f;       // ... during a swing this fast (within SWING_LOOKBACK)
static const int SWING_LOOKBACK = 150;
// Mic path, for hits too soft or too still for the motion rule (blocked volleys, drop shots): the mic in the
// handle heard a hit, and the high-g accel confirms the racket was struck within MIC_LOOKBACK ms.
static const float MIC_JUMP_G = 3.0f;
static const float MIC_SWING_RADS = 2.0f;   // some racket movement in the last MIC_SWING_LOOKBACK ms, so a
static const int MIC_SWING_LOOKBACK = 300;  // tap on the handle of a still racket isn't counted
static const int MIC_LOOKBACK = 40;
static const uint32_t MIC_MAX_AGE_US = 50000;
static bool collectMode = false;   // USB data collection: every mic trigger makes a window, still racket or not
static const int REFRACTORY = 400;          // samples between hits
static const int REFINE = 6;                // the impact is placed on the largest jump within ±REFINE

// ---- Orientation (port of MahonyFilter in apple/RacketKit/Sources/RacketKit/Orientation.swift) ----
static const float KP = 2.0f, KI = 0.05f;

static const int RING = 512;   // power of two, > TB_WINDOW_SAMPLES + 2 * REFINE + 4
static_assert(RING >= TB_WINDOW_SAMPLES + 2 * REFINE + 4, "ring too small for a window");

struct Slot {
  TBSample s;
  uint32_t t_us;
  float hg[3];
  float gyroMag;
  float q[4];
};

static Slot ring[RING];
static uint32_t count = 0;   // samples seen; the newest is count - 1
static uint32_t lastT = 0;
static float q[4] = {1, 0, 0, 0}, integral[3] = {0, 0, 0};
static bool qInit = false;
static bool pending = false;
static uint32_t pendingAt = 0, lastImpact = 0;
static uint32_t lastMic = 0;
static uint16_t seq = 0;
static uint32_t hits = 0, windowsDropped = 0;

static inline Slot &at(uint32_t i) { return ring[i & (RING - 1)]; }

void impactReset() {
  count = 0;
  qInit = false;
  q[0] = 1; q[1] = q[2] = q[3] = 0;
  integral[0] = integral[1] = integral[2] = 0;
  pending = false;
  lastImpact = 0;
}

static void normalize(float *v, int n) {
  float s = 0;
  for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) s += v[k] * v[k];
  s = sqrtf(s);
  if (s > 1e-9f)
    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) v[k] /= s;
}

static void mahony(const float *gyro, const float *accel, float dt) {
  float an = sqrtf(accel[0] * accel[0] + accel[1] * accel[1] + accel[2] * accel[2]);
  if (!qInit && an > 0.5f) {
    // Tilt only: the rotation taking the measured "up" to world z.
    float u[3] = {accel[0] / an, accel[1] / an, accel[2] / an};
    if (1 + u[2] < 1e-6f) {
      q[0] = 0; q[1] = 1; q[2] = 0; q[3] = 0;
    } else {
      q[0] = 1 + u[2]; q[1] = u[1]; q[2] = -u[0]; q[3] = 0;
      normalize(q, 4);
    }
    qInit = true;
  }
  float w[3] = {gyro[0], gyro[1], gyro[2]};
  float gn = sqrtf(w[0] * w[0] + w[1] * w[1] + w[2] * w[2]);
  if (an > 0.85f && an < 1.15f && gn < 3) {
    float a[3] = {accel[0] / an, accel[1] / an, accel[2] / an};
    // World up in body axes: the third row of q's rotation matrix.
    float up[3] = {2 * (q[1] * q[3] - q[0] * q[2]), 2 * (q[2] * q[3] + q[0] * q[1]),
                   1 - 2 * (q[1] * q[1] + q[2] * q[2])};
    float e[3] = {a[1] * up[2] - a[2] * up[1], a[2] * up[0] - a[0] * up[2], a[0] * up[1] - a[1] * up[0]};
    for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
      integral[k] += KI * e[k] * dt;
      w[k] += KP * e[k] + integral[k];
    }
  }
  // q += 0.5 q ⊗ (0, w) dt
  float h = 0.5f * dt;
  float dq0 = -q[1] * w[0] - q[2] * w[1] - q[3] * w[2];
  float dq1 = q[0] * w[0] + q[2] * w[2] - q[3] * w[1];
  float dq2 = q[0] * w[1] - q[1] * w[2] + q[3] * w[0];
  float dq3 = q[0] * w[2] + q[1] * w[1] - q[2] * w[0];
  q[0] += h * dq0; q[1] += h * dq1; q[2] += h * dq2; q[3] += h * dq3;
  normalize(q, 4);
}

// High-g change over 3 samples ending at i.
static float jumpAt(uint32_t i) {
  const Slot &a = at(i), &b = at(i - 3);
  float d0 = a.hg[0] - b.hg[0], d1 = a.hg[1] - b.hg[1], d2 = a.hg[2] - b.hg[2];
  return sqrtf(d0 * d0 + d1 * d1 + d2 * d2);
}

// Fastest rotation in the `span` samples before i.
static float swingBefore(uint32_t i, int span) {
  float m = 0;
  for (int k = 1; k <= span; k++) m = fmaxf(m, at(i - k).gyroMag);
  return m;
}

int16_t impactQuatWire(float v) {
  long x = lroundf(v * 16384);
  return (int16_t)(x > 32767 ? 32767 : x < -32768 ? -32768 : x);
}

static void finishWindow(ImpactWindow *win) {
  uint32_t c = pendingAt, best = c;
  float bestJump = 0;
  for (uint32_t k = c - REFINE; k <= c + REFINE; k++) {
    float j = jumpAt(k);
    if (j > bestJump) { bestJump = j; best = k; }
  }
  uint32_t impact = best - 2;   // the first sample of the jump
  uint32_t start = impact - TB_WINDOW_PRE;
  win->seq = seq - 1;
  win->impact = TB_WINDOW_PRE;
  const Slot &first = at(start);
  for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) win->q0[k] = impactQuatWire(first.q[k]);
  for (int j = 0; j < TB_WINDOW_SAMPLES; j++) {
    const Slot &sl = at(start + j);
    win->s[j] = sl.s;
    if (j % TB_SAMPLES_PER_PACKET == 0) win->chunkT0[j / TB_SAMPLES_PER_PACKET] = sl.t_us;
  }
}

int impactStep(const ImpactInput &in, uint32_t micTriggerUs, TBHit *hit, ImpactWindow *win) {
  float dt = 0.001f;
  if (count > 0) {
    dt = (in.t_us - lastT) * 1e-6f;
    dt = dt < 0.0002f ? 0.0002f : dt > 0.02f ? 0.02f : dt;
  }
  lastT = in.t_us;
  mahony(in.gyro, in.accel, dt);

  uint32_t i = count++;
  Slot &sl = at(i);
  sl.s = in.wire;
  sl.t_us = in.t_us;
  memcpy(sl.hg, in.highG, sizeof(sl.hg));
  sl.gyroMag = sqrtf(in.gyro[0] * in.gyro[0] + in.gyro[1] * in.gyro[1] + in.gyro[2] * in.gyro[2]);
  memcpy(sl.q, q, sizeof(sl.q));

  bool micNew = micTriggerUs != 0 && micTriggerUs != lastMic;
  if (micNew) lastMic = micTriggerUs;

  int result = 0;
  if (pending) {
    if (i >= pendingAt + REFINE + TB_WINDOW_POST) {
      pending = false;
      if (win) {
        finishWindow(win);
        result |= IMPACT_WINDOW;
      } else {
        windowsDropped++;
      }
    }
    return result;
  }
  if (i < TB_WINDOW_PRE + MIC_SWING_LOOKBACK || i - lastImpact < REFRACTORY) return result;

  uint32_t cand = 0;
  uint8_t source = 0;
  if (jumpAt(i) > JUMP_G && swingBefore(i, SWING_LOOKBACK) > SWING_RADS) {
    cand = i;
    source = TB_HIT_MOTION;
  } else if (micNew && (int32_t)(in.t_us - micTriggerUs) < (int32_t)MIC_MAX_AGE_US &&
             (collectMode || swingBefore(i, MIC_SWING_LOOKBACK) > MIC_SWING_RADS)) {
    float best = 0;
    for (uint32_t k = i - MIC_LOOKBACK; k <= i; k++) {
      float j = jumpAt(k);
      if (j > best) { best = j; cand = k; }
    }
    if (best > MIC_JUMP_G || collectMode) source = TB_HIT_MIC;
  }
  if (!source) return result;

  pending = true;
  pendingAt = cand;
  lastImpact = cand;
  hits++;
  const Slot &c = at(cand);
  float jump = jumpAt(cand);
  hit->seq = seq++;
  hit->t_us = c.t_us;
  hit->source = source;
  hit->jump_g = (uint8_t)(jump > 255 ? 255 : jump);
  float swingDps = swingBefore(cand, SWING_LOOKBACK) * 57.29578f;
  hit->swing_dps = (uint16_t)(swingDps > 65535 ? 65535 : swingDps);
  for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) hit->q[k] = impactQuatWire(c.q[k]);
  return result | IMPACT_HIT;
}

void impactSetCollect(bool on) { collectMode = on; }
void impactOrientation(float out[4]) { memcpy(out, q, sizeof(q)); }
uint32_t impactHits() { return hits; }
uint32_t impactWindowsDropped() { return windowsDropped; }
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "firmware/src/impact.h", "sha256": "945ca460614e9df648464b0dd83fb5370fa6fde6faf60efd42a29036f13077e2", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````cpp
// Hit detection and orientation on the racket (firmware 1.5, impact mode).
//
// Every 1 kHz sample goes through impactStep(), which keeps the last half second in a ring buffer, tracks the
// racket's orientation with the same Mahony filter the apps use, and watches for hits. A hit is reported at once
// (TBHit); TB_WINDOW_POST ms later the samples around it are copied out as one ImpactWindow for the phone to
// analyse. No Arduino dependencies, so it also builds on a laptop: tools/impact_replay/ replays recorded
// sessions through it.
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>
#include "protocol.h"

struct ImpactInput {
  TBSample wire;    // the sample as the window sends it: gyro at 8.2 LSB/dps
  float accel[3];   // low-g accel, g, sensor axes
  float gyro[3];    // rad/s
  float highG[3];   // high-g accel, g
  uint32_t t_us;    // micros() when it was read
};

struct ImpactWindow {
  uint16_t seq;
  uint16_t impact;                      // index of the impact sample (TB_WINDOW_PRE)
  int16_t q0[4];                        // orientation at s[0]
  uint32_t chunkT0[TB_WINDOW_CHUNKS];   // micros() of each chunk's first sample
  TBSample s[TB_WINDOW_SAMPLES];
};

enum : int {
  IMPACT_HIT = 1,      // *hit was filled in
  IMPACT_WINDOW = 2,   // *win was filled in
};

// Forgets the ring, any pending hit and the orientation (e.g. after the IMU was reconfigured).
void impactReset();

// Feeds one sample. micTriggerUs is micros() of the mic's latest trigger (0 before the first). Pass win = nullptr
// while the previous window is still being sent: a window completed then is dropped (impactWindowsDropped()).
// Returns IMPACT_* flags.
int impactStep(const ImpactInput &in, uint32_t micTriggerUs, TBHit *hit, ImpactWindow *win);

// Data collection (USB serial 'c'): every mic trigger yields a hit and window, even on a still racket and with a
// small high-g jump. Off in normal use.
void impactSetCollect(bool on);

// Latest orientation, sensor axes -> world (z up): w, x, y, z.
void impactOrientation(float q[4]);

// Quaternion component -> wire (x 16384).
int16_t impactQuatWire(float v);

uint32_t impactHits();
uint32_t impactWindowsDropped();

````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "firmware/src/main.cpp", "sha256": "320b1b316b14356f9310cc6aa8372eb2e7cf8de4acca6c8625e6e5fad6874fe3", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````cpp
// Tennis Buddee racket firmware.
//
// Reads the LSM6DSV320X (gyro + low-g accel + high-g accel, on a STEVAL-MKI251A) at 1 kHz. In raw mode every
// sample is streamed over BLE; in impact mode (TB_CMD_STREAM_MODE) the racket detects hits itself (impact.cpp)
// and sends only the samples around each one, which the apps analyse. The sweet-spot model (mic.cpp) and
// handle-tap gestures (tap.cpp) run here in both modes. Wiring and protocol: docs/PLAN.md.
// The BLE format predates this IMU (MPU6050 + H3LIS331DL), so samples are converted to those units.
//
// Serial monitor (115200) prints a status line every second for bench bring-up.

#include <Arduino.h>
#include <Wire.h>
#include <NimBLEDevice.h>
#include "nimble/porting/nimble/include/os/os_mbuf.h"
#include "protocol.h"
#include "mic.h"
#include "tap.h"
#include "impact.h"
#include "shot.h"
#include "backlog.h"
#include <Preferences.h>
#include <esp_partition.h>

// ---- Pins (XIAO ESP32C3) ----
// As built (see docs/WIRING.md): IMU on D4/D5, mic on D1-D3.
static const int PIN_SDA = D4;   // GPIO6
static const int PIN_SCL = D5;   // GPIO7
static const int PIN_VBAT = -1;  // no battery divider fitted (A0/D0 is free)

// ---- LSM6DSV320X (ST driver lsm6dsv320x_reg.h) ----
static const uint8_t LSM_ADDR = 0x6A;   // SDO tied to GND
static const uint8_t LSM_ID = 0x73;
static const uint8_t LSM_WHO_AM_I = 0x0F, LSM_CTRL1 = 0x10, LSM_CTRL2 = 0x11, LSM_CTRL3 = 0x12,
                     LSM_CTRL6 = 0x15, LSM_CTRL8 = 0x17, LSM_OUTX_L_G = 0x22, LSM_OUTX_L_A_HG = 0x34,
                     LSM_CTRL1_XL_HG = 0x4E;
// Native scales at the full scales set in setupIMU().
static const float LSM_G_DPS_PER_LSB = 0.070f;    // ±2000 dps (0.140 at ±4000 dps)
static const float LSM_HG_MG_PER_LSB = 10.417f;   // ±320 g
// Wire units (protocol.h): gyro 16.4 LSB/dps; low-g accel 2048 LSB/g, which the LSM's ±16 g (0.488 mg/LSB)
// already matches; high-g as H3LIS counts << 4 at the app-selected range.
static const float WIRE_G_LSB_PER_DPS = 16.4f;
// At ±4000 dps the native LSB doubles and the wire LSB halves (8.2 LSB/dps, TB_FLAG_GYRO_4000), so
// native -> wire is the same factor in both ranges.
static const float LSM_TO_WIRE_GYRO = LSM_G_DPS_PER_LSB * WIRE_G_LSB_PER_DPS;
static const uint8_t CTRL1_ACCEL = 0x0A;               // accel high-performance, 1.92 kHz
static const uint8_t CTRL2_GYRO = 0x0A;                // gyro high-performance, 1.92 kHz
static const uint8_t CTRL6_GYRO_2000 = 0x04, CTRL6_GYRO_4000 = 0x05;

// ---- Handle taps (tap.cpp detects single jolts; the sampler groups them into gestures) ----
static const int32_t TAP_TRIG_MG = 400;          // jolt above the resting |a| that counts as a tap
static const int TAP_MAX_LEN = 25;               // samples (ms) a tap's jolt may last
static const uint32_t TAP_REFRACTORY_MS = 100;   // short enough for a quick double tap
static const uint32_t TAP_GAP_MS = 450;          // a tap this soon after the previous one joins its gesture
static const int32_t TAP_MAX_JOLT_MG = 12000;    // near the ±16 g rail: a ball impact, not a tap
static const float TAP_MAX_GYRO_DPS = 150.0f;    // rotation this fast means a swing is under way
static const uint32_t TAP_SWING_HOLD_MS = 300;   // ... and taps are ignored until it has been calm this long
static const uint32_t TAP_RALLY_HOLD_MS = 2500;  // no taps this soon after a ball hit: a rally is still going
static const int TAP_MAX_COUNT = 5;

struct TapEvent {
  TBTap tap;
  int32_t jolt_mg;      // strongest tap, for the serial log
  uint32_t detect_us;   // time tapPush() took on the completing sample
};

// ---- State ----
static bool imuOk = false;
static volatile bool streaming = true;   // stream whenever a client subscribes
// High-g goes on the wire as H3LIS 12-bit counts at ±400 g (195 mg/count), so the sensor's whole ±320 g fits.
// Fixed since 1.6: the coarser step is below the sensor's noise (~0.35 g at rest).
static const uint8_t h3Range = 3;        // 0 = 100 g, 1 = 200 g, 3 = 400 g
// ±4000 dps is OFF (1.8). With CTRL6 set to ±4000 the rates still came out 2x too high on 1.5, 1.6 and 1.7: against
// the robot arm's poses, the accelerometer's gravity, the speed in 240 fps video, and an at-rest noise floor (in raw
// counts) identical to the ±2000 setting, which says the sensor stays at ±2000 while the packets claim ±4000. Until a
// bench rotation test shows true ±4000, the range is pinned to ±2000 so the units on the wire are right; the
// ceiling is then the real 2000 dps (34.9 rad/s per axis). TB_CMD_GYRO_RANGE requests for ±4000 are ignored.
static const bool GYRO_4000_ALLOWED = false;
static volatile bool gyro4000Wanted = GYRO_4000_ALLOWED;    // requested by the app (TB_CMD_GYRO_RANGE)
static volatile bool gyro4000 = GYRO_4000_ALLOWED;          // what the IMU is set to; changed by the sampler between packets
static volatile uint32_t imuResets = 0;        // times the watchdog found the IMU had lost its settings
static volatile uint8_t streamMode = TB_STREAM_RAW;

// NimBLE buffers (of the 32 set in platformio.ini) kept free for the stack's own replies. Notifying until
// the pool is empty makes notify() fail silently and leaves nothing to answer the phone's requests.
static const int BLE_BUFFER_RESERVE = 6;
static uint32_t sentPackets = 0;

static volatile uint16_t droppedPackets = 0;
static volatile uint32_t samplesRead = 0, i2cErrors = 0;
static TBSample lastSample = {};

static QueueHandle_t packetQueue;
static NimBLEServer *server;
static NimBLECharacteristic *imuChar, *statusChar, *shotChar, *tapChar;
static QueueHandle_t shotQueue, tapQueue;
static NimBLECharacteristic *hitChar, *windowChar, *poseChar, *summaryChar;

// Impact mode: hits go out at once through hitQueue. The sampler captures each hit's window into a backlog slot
// (backlog.cpp), the shot task computes its summary (shot.cpp), and the loop sends the summary, then the window.
static QueueHandle_t hitQueue;
static QueueHandle_t dumpQueue;   // backlog slots whose IMU window goes out over USB serial (collect mode, no phone)
static volatile uint32_t impactStepMaxUs = 0, shotMaxUs = 0;
static TaskHandle_t shotTaskHandle;
// TB_STREAM_IMPACTS_ACKED: the app's calibration and profile, and its acks and resend requests (queued to the loop,
// which owns the backlog).
static portMUX_TYPE cfgMux = portMUX_INITIALIZER_UNLOCKED;
static ShotConfig shotConfig = {};
struct BacklogCmd {
  uint8_t cmd;
  uint16_t boot, seq;
  uint8_t n;
  uint8_t chunks[24];
};
static QueueHandle_t backlogCmdQueue;
static uint16_t bootId = 0;
// Once an app has used TB_STREAM_IMPACTS_ACKED, windows are captured even with no phone connected (kept in NVS).
static volatile bool backlogEnabled = false, backlogEnablePending = false;
static volatile int64_t unixAtBootMs = 0;      // from TB_CMD_SET_TIME; 0 = unknown
static volatile uint32_t lastActiveMs = 0;     // last swing or hit, for "idle" (flash erases wait for it)
static const uint32_t POSE_INTERVAL_MS = 33;
static volatile uint32_t tapGestures = 0, tapsRejected = 0;
static uint32_t lastHitTapMs = 0;   // last ball hit, on tapStep's clock (micros() / 1000); sampler task only
static bool micOk = false;

// ---- I2C helpers ----
static bool writeReg(uint8_t addr, uint8_t reg, uint8_t val) {
  Wire.beginTransmission(addr);
  Wire.write(reg);
  Wire.write(val);
  return Wire.endTransmission() == 0;
}

static bool readRegs(uint8_t addr, uint8_t reg, uint8_t *buf, size_t len) {
  Wire.beginTransmission(addr);
  Wire.write(reg);
  if (Wire.endTransmission(false) != 0) return false;
  if (Wire.requestFrom(addr, (uint8_t)len) != len) return false;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) buf[i] = Wire.read();
  return true;
}

static uint8_t readReg(uint8_t addr, uint8_t reg) {
  uint8_t v = 0;
  readRegs(addr, reg, &v, 1);
  return v;
}

// ---- Sensor setup ----
static bool setupIMU(bool wideGyro) {
  uint8_t who = readReg(LSM_ADDR, LSM_WHO_AM_I);
  Serial.printf("LSM6DSV320X WHO_AM_I = 0x%02X (expect 0x%02X)\n", who, LSM_ID);
  if (who != LSM_ID) return false;
  bool ok = writeReg(LSM_ADDR, LSM_CTRL3, 0x01);        // software reset
  delay(10);
  ok &= writeReg(LSM_ADDR, LSM_CTRL3, 0x44);            // BDU + register auto-increment
  ok &= writeReg(LSM_ADDR, LSM_CTRL6, wideGyro ? CTRL6_GYRO_4000 : CTRL6_GYRO_2000);
  ok &= writeReg(LSM_ADDR, LSM_CTRL8, 0x03);            // accel ±16 g
  ok &= writeReg(LSM_ADDR, LSM_CTRL1, CTRL1_ACCEL);
  ok &= writeReg(LSM_ADDR, LSM_CTRL2, CTRL2_GYRO);
  ok &= writeReg(LSM_ADDR, LSM_CTRL1_XL_HG, 0xAC);      // high-g: output regs on, 1.92 kHz, ±320 g
  return ok;
}

// Changes the gyro full scale. ST's driver (lsm6dsv320x_gy_full_scale_set) powers the gyro down first: the
// full scale must only be changed in power-down. True once CTRL6 reads back the new range.
static bool setGyroRange(bool wide) {
  const uint8_t want = wide ? CTRL6_GYRO_4000 : CTRL6_GYRO_2000;
  bool ok = writeReg(LSM_ADDR, LSM_CTRL2, 0x00);
  ok &= writeReg(LSM_ADDR, LSM_CTRL6, want);
  ok &= writeReg(LSM_ADDR, LSM_CTRL2, CTRL2_GYRO);
  return ok && readReg(LSM_ADDR, LSM_CTRL6) == want;
}

static int16_t clamp16(float v) { return (int16_t)constrain(lroundf(v), -32768L, 32767L); }

// High-g sample (LSM LSBs) -> H3LIS 12-bit counts, left-aligned, at the range the app selected.
static int16_t toH3Wire(int16_t raw) {
  float mgPerCount = (h3Range == 0) ? 49.0f : (h3Range == 1) ? 98.0f : 195.0f;
  long counts = constrain(lroundf(raw * LSM_HG_MG_PER_LSB / mgPerCount), -2048L, 2047L);
  return (int16_t)(counts * 16);
}

// Runs once per sample on the low-g accel (raw ±16 g LSBs) and the fastest gyro axis. Single taps from
// tap.cpp are accepted only when the racket is calm and no rally is under way, then grouped: the gesture is
// queued once no further tap has arrived for TAP_GAP_MS. A swing or hit while a gesture is open drops it.
static void tapStep(const int16_t *a, float gyroDps, uint32_t t_us) {
  static uint32_t lastFastMs = 0, lastTapMs = 0;
  static uint8_t count = 0;
  static TapEvent ev = {};
  static uint16_t seq = 0;
  const uint32_t now = t_us / 1000;
  if (gyroDps > TAP_MAX_GYRO_DPS) lastFastMs = now;
  const bool busy = now - lastFastMs < TAP_SWING_HOLD_MS || now - lastHitTapMs < TAP_RALLY_HOLD_MS;
  if (busy && count > 0) {
    tapsRejected += count;
    count = 0;
  }

  TapResult r;
  uint32_t t0 = micros();
  // LSM ±16 g: 0.488 mg/LSB = 61/125.
  if (tapPush(a[0] * 61 / 125, a[1] * 61 / 125, a[2] * 61 / 125, t_us, r)) {
    uint32_t dt = micros() - t0;
    if (busy || r.jolt_mg > TAP_MAX_JOLT_MG) {
      tapsRejected++;
    } else {
      if (count == 0 || r.jolt_mg > ev.jolt_mg) {
        ev.tap.strength = r.strength;
        ev.tap.zone = r.zone;
        ev.tap.confidence = r.confidence;
        float n = sqrtf((float)r.dir_mg[0] * r.dir_mg[0] + (float)r.dir_mg[1] * r.dir_mg[1] +
                        (float)r.dir_mg[2] * r.dir_mg[2]);
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) ev.tap.dir[k] = n > 0 ? (int8_t)lroundf(127.0f * r.dir_mg[k] / n) : 0;
        ev.jolt_mg = r.jolt_mg;
        ev.detect_us = dt;
      }
      if (count < TAP_MAX_COUNT) count++;
      lastTapMs = now;
    }
  }
  if (count > 0 && now - lastTapMs > TAP_GAP_MS) {
    ev.tap.seq = seq++;
    ev.tap.count = count;
    xQueueSend(tapQueue, &ev, 0);
    tapGestures++;
    count = 0;
  }
}

// ---- 1 kHz sampling task ----
static void samplerTask(void *) {
  TBPacket pkt = {};
  uint16_t seq = 0;
  uint8_t n = 0;
  uint8_t buf[24];   // 0x22..0x39: gyro, accel, OIS (unused), high-g accel; little-endian
  uint32_t sinceCheck = 0;
  TickType_t last = xTaskGetTickCount();

  for (;;) {
    vTaskDelayUntil(&last, pdMS_TO_TICKS(1));

    // Gyro range changes only between packets, so every packet's samples share one scale.
    if (imuOk && n == 0 && gyro4000Wanted != gyro4000) {
      bool wide = gyro4000Wanted;
      if (setGyroRange(wide)) {
        gyro4000 = wide;
        Serial.printf("Gyro range now ±%d dps\n", wide ? 4000 : 2000);
      } else {
        // Don't retry every packet (each try stops the gyro); the watchdog below restores the old range.
        gyro4000Wanted = gyro4000;
        Serial.printf("Gyro range change to ±%d dps FAILED\n", wide ? 4000 : 2000);
      }
    }
    // Watchdog: a brownout (e.g. a loose supply wire during a fast spin) resets the IMU to power-down,
    // after which it reads all zeros. Check the settings once a second and restore them.
    if (imuOk && ++sinceCheck >= 1000) {
      sinceCheck = 0;
      uint8_t c1 = readReg(LSM_ADDR, LSM_CTRL1), c6 = readReg(LSM_ADDR, LSM_CTRL6);
      if (c1 != CTRL1_ACCEL || c6 != (gyro4000 ? CTRL6_GYRO_4000 : CTRL6_GYRO_2000)) {
        imuResets++;
        Serial.printf("IMU lost its settings (CTRL1 0x%02X CTRL6 0x%02X): reconfiguring\n", c1, c6);
        setupIMU(gyro4000);
      }
    }

    TBSample s = {};
    uint32_t t = micros();
    if (imuOk && readRegs(LSM_ADDR, LSM_OUTX_L_G, buf, sizeof(buf))) {
      auto le = [&](int i) { return (int16_t)(buf[i + 1] << 8 | buf[i]); };
      const float g = LSM_TO_WIRE_GYRO;
      s.gx = clamp16(le(0) * g);
      s.gy = clamp16(le(2) * g);
      s.gz = clamp16(le(4) * g);
      s.ax = le(6);
      s.ay = le(8);
      s.az = le(10);
      const int hg = LSM_OUTX_L_A_HG - LSM_OUTX_L_G;
      s.hx = toH3Wire(le(hg));
      s.hy = toH3Wire(le(hg + 2));
      s.hz = toH3Wire(le(hg + 4));
      const int16_t a[3] = {s.ax, s.ay, s.az};
      int16_t gmax = max(max(abs(le(0)), abs(le(2))), abs(le(4)));
      const float dpsPerLsb = LSM_G_DPS_PER_LSB * (gyro4000 ? 2 : 1);
      tapStep(a, gmax * dpsPerLsb, t);

      // Impact detection runs in both modes (it also feeds the serial log); windows are only claimed when
      // someone in impact mode will receive them. Window gyro is always at 8.2 LSB/dps.
      ImpactInput in;
      in.wire = s;
      in.t_us = t;
      int16_t *wireGyro[3] = {&in.wire.gx, &in.wire.gy, &in.wire.gz};
      for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
        float dps = le(2 * k) * dpsPerLsb;
        *wireGyro[k] = clamp16(dps * WIRE_G_LSB_PER_DPS / 2);
        in.gyro[k] = dps * (float)DEG_TO_RAD;
        in.accel[k] = le(6 + 2 * k) / 2048.0f;
        in.highG[k] = le(hg + 2 * k) * LSM_HG_MG_PER_LSB / 1000.0f;
      }
      const bool connected = server->getConnectedCount() > 0;
      const bool impactMode = streamMode != TB_STREAM_RAW && connected;
      static int fillSlot = -1;
      // Raw mode with a phone connected (calibration, raw recordings) doesn't capture: those aren't play.
      const bool dumpToSerial = micCollecting();   // USB data collection (tools/collect_session.py): windows go to the PC, not the phone
      const bool capture = impactMode || (backlogEnabled && !connected) || dumpToSerial;
      if (capture && fillSlot < 0) fillSlot = backlogReserve();
      if (!capture && fillSlot >= 0) {
        backlogRelease(fillSlot);
        fillSlot = -1;
      }
      TBHit hit;
      uint32_t s0 = micros();
      int r = impactStep(in, micLastTriggerUs(), &hit, fillSlot >= 0 ? &backlogSlot(fillSlot).win : nullptr);
      uint32_t took = micros() - s0;
      if (took > impactStepMaxUs) impactStepMaxUs = took;
      if (r & IMPACT_HIT) {
        xQueueSend(hitQueue, &hit, 0);
        lastActiveMs = millis();
        lastHitTapMs = t / 1000;
      }
      if (r & IMPACT_WINDOW && dumpToSerial) {
        // Collect mode over USB: the loop prints the window and frees the slot; it never enters the BLE backlog.
        if (xQueueSend(dumpQueue, &fillSlot, 0) != pdTRUE) backlogRelease(fillSlot);
        fillSlot = -1;
      } else if (r & IMPACT_WINDOW) {
        int64_t unix0 = unixAtBootMs;
        uint32_t nowMs = millis();
        backlogCaptured(fillSlot, nowMs, unix0 ? (uint64_t)(unix0 + nowMs) : 0,
                        !(streamMode == TB_STREAM_IMPACTS_ACKED && connected));
        fillSlot = -1;
        xTaskNotifyGive(shotTaskHandle);
      }
      if (in.gyro[0] * in.gyro[0] + in.gyro[1] * in.gyro[1] + in.gyro[2] * in.gyro[2] > 1.0f) lastActiveMs = millis();
    } else if (imuOk) {
      i2cErrors++;
    }
    lastSample = s;
    samplesRead++;

    if (!streaming || streamMode != TB_STREAM_RAW || server->getConnectedCount() == 0) {
      n = 0;
      continue;
    }
    if (n == 0) pkt.t0_us = t;
    pkt.s[n++] = s;
    if (n == TB_SAMPLES_PER_PACKET) {
      pkt.seq = seq++;
      pkt.count = n;
      pkt.flags = (imuOk ? TB_FLAG_MPU_OK | TB_FLAG_H3LIS_OK : 0) | TB_FLAG_STREAMING |
                  (gyro4000 ? TB_FLAG_GYRO_4000 : 0);
      if (xQueueSend(packetQueue, &pkt, 0) != pdTRUE) droppedPackets++;
      n = 0;
    }
  }
}

// ---- BLE ----
class ServerCallbacks : public NimBLEServerCallbacks {
  void onConnect(NimBLEServer *s, ble_gap_conn_desc *desc) override {
    Serial.println("BLE: connected");
    // 15-30 ms interval: the fastest iOS accepts; several packets go out per interval.
    s->updateConnParams(desc->conn_handle, 12, 24, 0, 400);
    // A 152-byte packet should travel in one link-layer PDU, at 2 Mbit/s when the phone allows it.
    ble_gap_set_data_len(desc->conn_handle, 251, 2120);
    ble_gap_set_prefered_le_phy(desc->conn_handle, BLE_GAP_LE_PHY_2M_MASK, BLE_GAP_LE_PHY_2M_MASK, 0);
    // Keep advertising so a second device (Mac + iPhone) can join; otherwise whoever reconnects first
    // after a reboot locks everyone else out.
    if (s->getConnectedCount() < 3) NimBLEDevice::startAdvertising();
  }
  void onDisconnect(NimBLEServer *) override {
    Serial.println("BLE: disconnected, advertising again");
    NimBLEDevice::startAdvertising();
    if (NimBLEDevice::getServer()->getConnectedCount() == 0) {
      xQueueReset(packetQueue);
      gyro4000Wanted = GYRO_4000_ALLOWED;    // back to the default, whatever the last app chose
      streamMode = TB_STREAM_RAW;   // the next app may not know about impact mode (captured windows stay queued)
    }
  }
};

class ControlCallbacks : public NimBLECharacteristicCallbacks {
  void onWrite(NimBLECharacteristic *c) override {
    std::string v = c->getValue();
    if (v.empty()) return;
    switch ((uint8_t)v[0]) {
      case TB_CMD_START_STREAM: streaming = true; break;
      case TB_CMD_STOP_STREAM: streaming = false; break;
      case TB_CMD_GYRO_RANGE:
        if (v.size() >= 2 && (v[1] == 0 || v[1] == 1)) gyro4000Wanted = GYRO_4000_ALLOWED && v[1] == 1;
        break;
      case TB_CMD_STREAM_MODE:
        if (v.size() >= 2 && v[1] <= TB_STREAM_IMPACTS_ACKED) {
          streamMode = v[1];
          if (streamMode == TB_STREAM_IMPACTS_ACKED && !backlogEnabled) backlogEnablePending = true;
        }
        break;
      case TB_CMD_SHOT_CONFIG: {
        ShotConfig c;
        if (shotConfigDecode((const uint8_t *)v.data() + 1, v.size() - 1, &c)) {
          portENTER_CRITICAL(&cfgMux);
          shotConfig = c;
          portEXIT_CRITICAL(&cfgMux);
        }
        break;
      }
      case TB_CMD_WINDOW_ACK:
      case TB_CMD_WINDOW_RESEND:
        if (v.size() >= 5) {
          BacklogCmd b = {};
          b.cmd = (uint8_t)v[0];
          b.boot = (uint8_t)v[1] | (uint8_t)v[2] << 8;
          b.seq = (uint8_t)v[3] | (uint8_t)v[4] << 8;
          if (b.cmd == TB_CMD_WINDOW_RESEND && v.size() >= 6) {
            b.n = (uint8_t)v[5];
            if (b.n > sizeof(b.chunks) || v.size() < 6u + b.n) b.n = 0;   // malformed: resend it all
            memcpy(b.chunks, v.data() + 6, b.n);
          }
          xQueueSend(backlogCmdQueue, &b, 0);
        }
        break;
      case TB_CMD_SET_TIME:
        if (v.size() >= 9) {
          uint64_t ms = 0;
          memcpy(&ms, v.data() + 1, 8);
          unixAtBootMs = (int64_t)ms - (int64_t)millis();
        }
        break;
    }
  }
};

static TBStatus makeStatus() {
  TBStatus st;
  st.battery_mv = PIN_VBAT >= 0 ? (uint16_t)(analogReadMilliVolts(PIN_VBAT) * 2) : 0;
  st.fw_major = TB_FW_MAJOR;
  st.fw_minor = TB_FW_MINOR;
  st.flags = (imuOk ? TB_FLAG_MPU_OK | TB_FLAG_H3LIS_OK : 0) | (streaming ? TB_FLAG_STREAMING : 0) |
             (gyro4000 ? TB_FLAG_GYRO_4000 : 0) | (streamMode == TB_STREAM_IMPACTS ? TB_FLAG_IMPACT_MODE : 0);
  st.h3lis_range = h3Range;
  st.dropped = droppedPackets;
  return st;
}

static void setupBLE() {
  // Two rackets in one room must be tellable apart: suffix the name with the last MAC bytes.
  uint8_t mac[6] = {0};
  esp_read_mac(mac, ESP_MAC_BT);
  char bleName[24];
  snprintf(bleName, sizeof(bleName), TB_DEVICE_NAME " %02X%02X", mac[4], mac[5]);
  NimBLEDevice::init(bleName);
  NimBLEDevice::setPower(ESP_PWR_LVL_P9);
  NimBLEDevice::setMTU(185);

  server = NimBLEDevice::createServer();
  server->setCallbacks(new ServerCallbacks());
  NimBLEService *svc = server->createService(TB_SERVICE_UUID);
  imuChar = svc->createCharacteristic(TB_IMU_UUID, NIMBLE_PROPERTY::NOTIFY);
  statusChar = svc->createCharacteristic(TB_STATUS_UUID, NIMBLE_PROPERTY::READ | NIMBLE_PROPERTY::NOTIFY);
  shotChar = svc->createCharacteristic(TB_SHOT_UUID, NIMBLE_PROPERTY::NOTIFY);
  tapChar = svc->createCharacteristic(TB_TAP_UUID, NIMBLE_PROPERTY::NOTIFY);
  hitChar = svc->createCharacteristic(TB_HIT_UUID, NIMBLE_PROPERTY::NOTIFY);
  windowChar = svc->createCharacteristic(TB_WINDOW_UUID, NIMBLE_PROPERTY::NOTIFY);
  summaryChar = svc->createCharacteristic(TB_SUMMARY_UUID, NIMBLE_PROPERTY::NOTIFY);
  poseChar = svc->createCharacteristic(TB_POSE_UUID, NIMBLE_PROPERTY::NOTIFY);
  NimBLECharacteristic *control =
      svc->createCharacteristic(TB_CONTROL_UUID, NIMBLE_PROPERTY::WRITE | NIMBLE_PROPERTY::WRITE_NR);
  control->setCallbacks(new ControlCallbacks());
  svc->start();

  TBStatus st = makeStatus();
  statusChar->setValue((uint8_t *)&st, sizeof(st));

  NimBLEAdvertising *adv = NimBLEDevice::getAdvertising();
  adv->addServiceUUID(TB_SERVICE_UUID);
  adv->setScanResponse(true);
  adv->start();
  Serial.printf("BLE: advertising as \"%s\"\n", bleName);
}

// ---- Backlog: boot number and flags in NVS, windows in the spare data partition ----
static const esp_partition_t *backlogPart = nullptr;
static bool partRead(uint32_t off, void *dst, uint32_t len) { return esp_partition_read(backlogPart, off, dst, len) == ESP_OK; }
static bool partWrite(uint32_t off, const void *src, uint32_t len) {
  return esp_partition_write(backlogPart, off, src, len) == ESP_OK;
}
static bool partErase(uint32_t off, uint32_t len) { return esp_partition_erase_range(backlogPart, off, len) == ESP_OK; }
static BacklogFlash backlogFlash = {0, partRead, partWrite, partErase};

static void setupBacklog() {
  Preferences prefs;
  prefs.begin("tb", false);
  bootId = prefs.getUShort("boot", 0) + 1;
  prefs.putUShort("boot", bootId);
  backlogEnabled = prefs.getBool("backlog", false);
  prefs.end();
  // The default partition table's "spiffs" partition (1.375 MB), which nothing else uses.
  backlogPart = esp_partition_find_first(ESP_PARTITION_TYPE_DATA, ESP_PARTITION_SUBTYPE_DATA_SPIFFS, nullptr);
  backlogFlash.size = backlogPart ? backlogPart->size : 0;
  backlogInit(bootId, &backlogFlash);
  BacklogStats st = backlogStats();
  Serial.printf("Backlog: boot %u, %s, flash %lu KB (%lu windows waiting)\n", bootId,
                backlogEnabled ? "capturing" : "off until an app asks", (unsigned long)(backlogFlash.size / 1024),
                (unsigned long)st.flashPending);
}

// Computes each captured window's shot (shot.cpp) off the 1 kHz sampler.
static void shotTask(void *) {
  for (;;) {
    ulTaskNotifyTake(pdTRUE, pdMS_TO_TICKS(100));
    int s;
    while ((s = backlogNextCaptured()) >= 0) {
      ShotConfig cfg;
      portENTER_CRITICAL(&cfgMux);
      cfg = shotConfig;
      portEXIT_CRITICAL(&cfgMux);
      BacklogSlot &b = backlogSlot(s);
      uint32_t t0 = micros();
      bool ok = shotAnalyze(cfg, b.win, gyro4000, 0.195f, &b.summary);
      uint32_t took = micros() - t0;
      if (took > shotMaxUs) shotMaxUs = took;
      backlogAnalyzed(s, ok);
    }
  }
}

// Sends the backlog's next message; false when there is nothing to send.
static bool sendBacklog(bool acked) {
  uint32_t now = millis();
  BacklogMsg m = backlogNext(acked, now);
  if (m.kind == BacklogMsg::NONE) return false;
  BacklogSlot &b = backlogSlot(m.slot);
  const uint8_t base = (imuOk ? TB_FLAG_MPU_OK | TB_FLAG_H3LIS_OK : 0) | TB_FLAG_GYRO_4000 | (b.backlog ? TB_FLAG_BACKLOG : 0);
  if (m.kind == BacklogMsg::SUMMARY) {
    TBShotSummary s = b.summary;
    s.seq = b.win.seq;
    s.boot = b.boot;
    s.age_ms = b.boot == bootId ? now - b.hitMs : 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    s.unix_ms = b.unixMs;
    if (b.backlog) s.flags |= TB_SUMMARY_BACKLOG;
    summaryChar->setValue((uint8_t *)&s, sizeof(s));
    summaryChar->notify();
  } else if (acked) {
    TBWindowChunkAcked c;
    c.seq = b.win.seq;
    c.index = (uint8_t)m.chunk;
    c.total = TB_WINDOW_CHUNKS;
    c.impact = b.win.impact;
    memcpy(c.q0, b.win.q0, sizeof(c.q0));
    c.t0_us = b.win.chunkT0[m.chunk];
    c.count = TB_SAMPLES_PER_PACKET;
    c.flags = base;
    c.boot = b.boot;
    memcpy(c.s, &b.win.s[m.chunk * TB_SAMPLES_PER_PACKET], sizeof(c.s));
    windowChar->setValue((uint8_t *)&c, sizeof(c));
    windowChar->notify();
  } else {
    TBWindowChunk c;
    c.seq = b.win.seq;
    c.index = (uint8_t)m.chunk;
    c.total = TB_WINDOW_CHUNKS;
    c.impact = b.win.impact;
    memcpy(c.q0, b.win.q0, sizeof(c.q0));
    c.t0_us = b.win.chunkT0[m.chunk];
    c.count = TB_SAMPLES_PER_PACKET;
    c.flags = base & ~TB_FLAG_BACKLOG;
    memcpy(c.s, &b.win.s[m.chunk * TB_SAMPLES_PER_PACKET], sizeof(c.s));
    windowChar->setValue((uint8_t *)&c, sizeof(c));
    windowChar->notify();
  }
  backlogSent(m, acked, now);
  return true;
}

void setup() {
  Serial.begin(115200);
  delay(1500);  // give USB serial time to attach
  Serial.println("\n=== Tennis Buddee firmware " + String(TB_FW_MAJOR) + "." + String(TB_FW_MINOR) + " ===");

  Wire.begin(PIN_SDA, PIN_SCL);
  Wire.setClock(400000);
  // The IMU may not be ready right after power-up: retry a few times.
  for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 10 && !imuOk; attempt++) {
    imuOk = setupIMU(gyro4000);
    if (!imuOk) delay(100);
  }
  Serial.printf("LSM6DSV320X: %s\n", imuOk ? "OK" : "NOT FOUND");
  if (!imuOk) Serial.println("Check wiring: SDA=D4, SCL=D5, VCC=3V3, GND=GND, CS=3V3, SDO=GND (see docs/WIRING.md)");

  analogReadResolution(12);
  packetQueue = xQueueCreate(48, sizeof(TBPacket));
  shotQueue = xQueueCreate(8, sizeof(TBShot));
  micOk = micBegin(shotQueue);
  Serial.printf("INMP441 mic + ridge distance model (156 features): %s\n", micOk ? "OK" : "FAILED to start I2S");
  tapQueue = xQueueCreate(8, sizeof(TapEvent));
  hitQueue = xQueueCreate(8, sizeof(TBHit));
  dumpQueue = xQueueCreate(BL_SLOTS, sizeof(int));
  backlogCmdQueue = xQueueCreate(16, sizeof(BacklogCmd));
  impactReset();
  setupBacklog();
  xTaskCreate(shotTask, "shot", 4096, nullptr, 1, &shotTaskHandle);
  tapInit();
  tapConfigure(TAP_TRIG_MG, TAP_MAX_LEN, TAP_REFRACTORY_MS);
  Serial.printf("Handle taps: trigger %ld mg, gestures up to %d taps %lu ms apart\n", (long)TAP_TRIG_MG,
                TAP_MAX_COUNT, (unsigned long)TAP_GAP_MS);
  Serial.println("Send 'c' over serial to toggle clip dump for training data (tools/collect_clips.py)");
  setupBLE();
  xTaskCreate(samplerTask, "sampler", 4096, nullptr, configMAX_PRIORITIES - 2, nullptr);
}

// Prints one hit's whole IMU window as two lines, for tools/collect_session.py. The header carries everything needed
// to decode and align it, so later analysis never depends on firmware defaults:
//   IMUWIN,seq=..,impact=<index of the impact sample>,n=<samples>,sample_bytes=<bytes per sample>,fs_hz=1000,
//          t0_us=<micros() of sample 0>,t_impact_us=..,mic_trigger_us=..,q0=w:x:y:z (x16384, sensor->world),
//          acc_lsb_per_g=2048,gyro_lsb_per_dps=8.2,hg_range=<H3LIS range code>,fw=1.9,bat_mv=..,chunk_t0_us=a:b:..
//   IMU,<hex of the raw little-endian TBSample array: ax ay az gx gy gz hx hy hz, int16 each, 1 ms apart>
static void dumpWindow(const ImpactWindow &w) {
  xSemaphoreTake(tbSerialLock(), portMAX_DELAY);
  Serial.printf("IMUWIN,seq=%u,impact=%u,n=%u,sample_bytes=%u,fs_hz=1000,t0_us=%lu,t_impact_us=%lu,mic_trigger_us=%lu,"
                "q0=%d:%d:%d:%d,acc_lsb_per_g=2048,gyro_lsb_per_dps=8.2,hg_range=%u,fw=%d.%d,bat_mv=%u,chunk_t0_us=",
                w.seq, w.impact, (unsigned)TB_WINDOW_SAMPLES, (unsigned)sizeof(TBSample), (unsigned long)w.chunkT0[0],
                (unsigned long)(w.chunkT0[0] + 1000UL * w.impact), (unsigned long)micLastTriggerUs(), w.q0[0], w.q0[1],
                w.q0[2], w.q0[3], (unsigned)h3Range, TB_FW_MAJOR, TB_FW_MINOR, makeStatus().battery_mv);
  for (int i = 0; i < TB_WINDOW_CHUNKS; i++) Serial.printf(i ? ":%lu" : "%lu", (unsigned long)w.chunkT0[i]);
  Serial.println();
  Serial.print("IMU,");
  static char line[512];
  const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)w.s;
  const size_t total = sizeof(w.s);
  for (size_t off = 0; off < total; off += 128) {
    size_t n = total - off < 128 ? total - off : 128;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) sprintf(line + 2 * i, "%02x", p[off + i]);
    Serial.write((const uint8_t *)line, 2 * n);
  }
  Serial.println();
  xSemaphoreGive(tbSerialLock());
}

void loop() {
  // Serial 'c' toggles clip dumping for data collection.
  while (Serial.available()) {
    if (Serial.read() == 'c') {
      micSetCollect(!micCollecting());
      impactSetCollect(micCollecting());
      Serial.printf("collect mode %s\n", micCollecting() ? "ON" : "OFF");
    }
  }
  const bool impactMode = streamMode != TB_STREAM_RAW && server->getConnectedCount() > 0;
  const bool acked = streamMode == TB_STREAM_IMPACTS_ACKED && server->getConnectedCount() > 0;
  if (backlogEnablePending) {
    backlogEnablePending = false;
    backlogEnabled = true;
    Preferences prefs;
    prefs.begin("tb", false);
    prefs.putBool("backlog", true);
    prefs.end();
  }
  BacklogCmd cmd;
  while (xQueueReceive(backlogCmdQueue, &cmd, 0) == pdTRUE) {
    if (cmd.cmd == TB_CMD_WINDOW_ACK) backlogAck(cmd.boot, cmd.seq);
    else backlogResend(cmd.boot, cmd.seq, cmd.chunks, cmd.n);
  }
  // Hits go out first: they are what makes the phone react.
  TBHit hit;
  while (xQueueReceive(hitQueue, &hit, 0) == pdTRUE) {
    if (impactMode) {
      hitChar->setValue((uint8_t *)&hit, sizeof(hit));
      hitChar->notify();
    }
    Serial.printf("HIT #%u %s jump %u g swing %u dps\n", hit.seq, hit.source == TB_HIT_MIC ? "mic" : "motion",
                  hit.jump_g, hit.swing_dps);
  }
  // USB collect mode: print each completed IMU window (see dumpWindow).
  int dumpSlot;
  while (xQueueReceive(dumpQueue, &dumpSlot, 0) == pdTRUE) {
    dumpWindow(backlogSlot(dumpSlot).win);
    backlogRelease(dumpSlot);
  }
  // Sweet-spot verdicts from the on-device model.
  TBShot shot;
  while (xQueueReceive(shotQueue, &shot, 0) == pdTRUE) {
    shotChar->setValue((uint8_t *)&shot, sizeof(shot));
    if (server->getConnectedCount() > 0) shotChar->notify();
  }
  // Handle-tap gestures.
  TapEvent tap;
  while (xQueueReceive(tapQueue, &tap, 0) == pdTRUE) {
    tapChar->setValue((uint8_t *)&tap.tap, sizeof(tap.tap));
    if (server->getConnectedCount() > 0) tapChar->notify();
    Serial.printf("TAP x%u strength %u (jolt %ld mg) dir %+.2f %+.2f %+.2f zone %s detect %luus\n",
                  tap.tap.count, tap.tap.strength, (long)tap.jolt_mg, tap.tap.dir[0] / 127.0f,
                  tap.tap.dir[1] / 127.0f, tap.tap.dir[2] / 127.0f, TAP_ZONE_NAMES[tap.tap.zone],
                  (unsigned long)tap.detect_us);
  }

  // Impact mode: live orientation, then the current hit's window while NimBLE has buffers to spare.
  static uint32_t lastPose = 0;
  if (impactMode && millis() - lastPose >= POSE_INTERVAL_MS) {
    lastPose = millis();
    float q[4];
    impactOrientation(q);
    TBSample ls = lastSample;
    float gs = gyro4000 ? WIRE_G_LSB_PER_DPS / 2 : WIRE_G_LSB_PER_DPS;
    float h3Scale = (h3Range == 0) ? 0.049f : (h3Range == 1) ? 0.098f : 0.195f;
    float gyroDps = sqrtf((float)ls.gx * ls.gx + (float)ls.gy * ls.gy + (float)ls.gz * ls.gz) / gs;
    float hx = (ls.hx >> 4) * h3Scale, hy = (ls.hy >> 4) * h3Scale, hz = (ls.hz >> 4) * h3Scale;
    float highG = sqrtf(hx * hx + hy * hy + hz * hz);
    TBPose pose;
    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) pose.q[k] = impactQuatWire(q[k]);
    pose.gyro_dps = (uint16_t)min(gyroDps, 65535.0f);
    pose.high_g = (uint8_t)min(highG, 255.0f);
    pose.flags = makeStatus().flags;
    poseChar->setValue((uint8_t *)&pose, sizeof(pose));
    poseChar->notify();
  }
  // Summaries, then windows, while NimBLE has buffers to spare.
  while (impactMode && os_msys_num_free() > BLE_BUFFER_RESERVE && sendBacklog(acked)) {
  }
  // Flash housekeeping, one small step; it stalls the CPU, so let the sampler catch up after it.
  const bool idle = millis() - lastActiveMs > 3000;
  if (backlogStep(acked, idle, millis())) vTaskDelay(1);

  // Send queued packets as notifications.
  // Send queued packets while NimBLE has buffers to spare. When the link can't keep up, packets wait in
  // the queue and the sampler counts any that overflow it as dropped.
  TBPacket pkt;
  if (os_msys_num_free() <= BLE_BUFFER_RESERVE) {
    vTaskDelay(1);
  } else {
    while (os_msys_num_free() > BLE_BUFFER_RESERVE && xQueueReceive(packetQueue, &pkt, pdMS_TO_TICKS(2)) == pdTRUE) {
      imuChar->setValue((uint8_t *)&pkt, sizeof(pkt));
      imuChar->notify();
      sentPackets++;
    }
  }

  static uint32_t lastStatus = 0, lastSamples = 0, lastSent = 0, lastRetry = 0;
  uint32_t now = millis();
  if (!imuOk && now - lastRetry > 2000) {
    lastRetry = now;
    imuOk = setupIMU(gyro4000);
  }
  if (now - lastStatus >= 1000) {
    TBStatus st = makeStatus();
    statusChar->setValue((uint8_t *)&st, sizeof(st));
    if (server->getConnectedCount() > 0) statusChar->notify();

    uint32_t rate = samplesRead - lastSamples;
    lastSamples = samplesRead;
    uint32_t sentRate = sentPackets - lastSent;
    lastSent = sentPackets;
    lastStatus = now;
    TBSample s = lastSample;
    float gs = gyro4000 ? WIRE_G_LSB_PER_DPS / 2 : WIRE_G_LSB_PER_DPS;
    float h3Scale = (h3Range == 0) ? 0.049f : (h3Range == 1) ? 0.098f : 0.195f;
    MicLevel mic = micLevel();
    BacklogStats bs = backlogStats();
    Serial.printf(
        "rate %4lu Hz | a[g] %6.2f %6.2f %6.2f  g[dps] %7.1f %7.1f %7.1f | high-g a[g] %6.1f %6.1f %6.1f | "
        "mic floor %4d peak %5d trig %5d hits %lu | taps %lu (rejected %lu) jolt %4ld/%ld mg | BLE %s, "
        "sent %lu pkt/s, dropped %u, bufs free %d, itvl %.1f ms, i2c err %lu, gyro ±%d dps, imu resets %lu | "
        "%s mode, hits %lu, windows dropped %lu, detect max %lu us, shot max %lu us | backlog acked %lu resent %lu "
        "flash %lu waiting, %lu spilled, %lu lost | heap %lu | bat %u mV\n",
        (unsigned long)rate, s.ax / 2048.0f, s.ay / 2048.0f, s.az / 2048.0f, s.gx / gs, s.gy / gs,
        s.gz / gs, (s.hx >> 4) * h3Scale, (s.hy >> 4) * h3Scale, (s.hz >> 4) * h3Scale, mic.floor, mic.peak,
        mic.trigger, (unsigned long)micImpactCount(), (unsigned long)tapGestures, (unsigned long)tapsRejected,
        (long)tapPeakDeviation(), (long)TAP_TRIG_MG,
        server->getConnectedCount() ? (server->getConnectedCount() > 1 ? "connected x2+" : "connected") : "advertising", (unsigned long)sentRate, droppedPackets, os_msys_num_free(), server->getConnectedCount() ? server->getPeerInfo(0).getConnInterval() * 1.25f : 0.0f, (unsigned long)i2cErrors, gyro4000 ? 4000 : 2000, (unsigned long)imuResets,
        streamMode == TB_STREAM_IMPACTS_ACKED ? "acked impact" : streamMode == TB_STREAM_IMPACTS ? "impact" : "raw",
        (unsigned long)impactHits(), (unsigned long)impactWindowsDropped(), (unsigned long)impactStepMaxUs,
        (unsigned long)shotMaxUs, (unsigned long)bs.acked, (unsigned long)bs.resent, (unsigned long)bs.flashPending,
        (unsigned long)bs.spilled, (unsigned long)bs.flashLost, (unsigned long)ESP.getFreeHeap(), st.battery_mv);
    impactStepMaxUs = 0;
    shotMaxUs = 0;
  }
}
````````
