````````tsx
import { TransitionSeries, linearTiming } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { fade } from '@remotion/transitions/fade';
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, Audio, Sequence, interpolate, staticFile, useVideoConfig } from 'remotion';
import { video } from '../config/brand';
import { cues, effects, sound, type Cue } from '../config/sound';
import type { Cut, Entry } from '../config/timeline';
import { voSeconds } from '../config/voiceover';
import { scenes, type SceneId } from '../scenes';
import { FootageSlot } from './FootageSlot';
import { OverlayLayer } from './Overlays';
import { VoiceoverTrack, voFile } from './Voiceover';

const fps = video.fps;

/**
 * Frame length of each entry. Rounded from cumulative time, not per entry, so a
 * long run of beat-length scenes never drifts off the music.
 */
const lengths = (cut: Cut) => {
  let t = 0;
  return cut.entries.map((e, i) => {
    const start = Math.round(t * fps);
    t += e.seconds - (i < cut.entries.length - 1 ? cut.transition : 0);
    const end = Math.round(t * fps) + (i < cut.entries.length - 1 ? Math.round(cut.transition * fps) : 0);
    return end - start;
  });
};
const overlap = (cut: Cut) => Math.round(cut.transition * fps);

/** Total length after crossfades overlap. Root.tsx uses it for durationInFrames. */
export const cutFrames = (cut: Cut) => lengths(cut).reduce((n, l) => n + l, 0) - overlap(cut) * (cut.entries.length - 1);

/** The name a line of voiceover uses for an entry: its scene or footage id. */
const entryId = (e: Entry) => ('scene' in e ? e.scene : e.footage);

/** First frame of each entry in the finished cut. */
const startFrames = (cut: Cut) => {
  const len = lengths(cut);
  const starts = new Map<string, number>();
  cut.entries.reduce((at, e, i) => {
    starts.set(entryId(e), at);
    return at + len[i] - overlap(cut);
  }, 0);
  return starts;
};

/** One sound effect, placed so its hit point lands on `frame`. */
export const Effect: React.FC<{ cue: Cue; frame: number }> = ({ cue, frame }) => {
  const fx = effects[cue.sfx];
  const [from, to] = 'trim' in fx ? fx.trim : [0, undefined];
  const start = frame - Math.round((fx.hit - from) * fps);
  return (
    <Sequence from={start} layout="none">
      <Audio
        src={staticFile(fx.src)}
        trimBefore={Math.max(0, Math.round(from * fps) - Math.min(0, start))}
        trimAfter={to === undefined ? undefined : Math.round(to * fps)}
        volume={cue.volume ?? 1}
      />
    </Sequence>
  );
};

/** A CGI scene plus its sound cues from config/sound.ts, optionally started `skip` frames in. */
export const SceneWithSound: React.FC<{ id: SceneId; skip?: number; children?: React.ReactNode }> = ({ id, skip = 0, children }) => {
  const Scene = scenes[id];
  const { durationInFrames } = useVideoConfig();
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <Sequence from={-skip}>
        <Scene />
      </Sequence>
      {cues[id].map((c, i) => <Effect key={i} cue={c} frame={c.fromEnd ? durationInFrames - c.at : c.at - skip} />)}
      {children}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

/** Music bed: ducks under talking footage, fades out at the end. */
const Music: React.FC<{ cut: Cut }> = ({ cut }) => {
  const { durationInFrames } = useVideoConfig();
  const len = lengths(cut);
  const talk: [number, number][] = [];
  const silent: [number, number][] = [];
  cut.entries.reduce((at, e, i) => {
    if ('footage' in e && e.muted === false) talk.push([at, at + len[i]]);
    if ('scene' in e && e.ownMusic) silent.push([at, at + len[i]]);
    return at + len[i] - overlap(cut);
  }, 0);
  // Only recorded lines duck the music: a caption alone makes no sound to clear.
  const starts = startFrames(cut);
  const spoken = (cut.voiceover ?? []).filter((l) => voFile(l.id) && starts.has(l.at)).map((l) => {
    const from = starts.get(l.at)! + Math.round((l.lead ?? 0.3) * fps);
    return [from, from + Math.round(voSeconds(l) * fps)];
  });
  const base = cut.music.volume ?? 0.5;
  const volumeAt = (f: number) => {
    const ducked = talk.some(([a, b]) => f >= a - 10 && f <= b + 10);
    const underVo = spoken.some(([a, b]) => f >= a - 10 && f <= b + 10);
    const fade = interpolate(f, [durationInFrames - sound.musicFadeOut * fps, durationInFrames], [1, 0], { extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp' });
    const out = silent.reduce((m, [a, b]) => Math.min(m, interpolate(f, [a - 8, a, b - 8, b], [1, 0, 0, 1], { extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp' })), 1);
    return (ducked ? sound.musicUnderTalk : underVo ? sound.musicUnderVoiceover : base) * fade * out;
  };
  const from = Math.round((cut.music.from ?? 0) * fps);
  const src = staticFile(cut.music.src);
  const { jump } = cut.music;
  if (!jump) return <Audio src={src} trimBefore={from} loop volume={volumeAt} />; // loops if the cut outlasts the song
  const first = Math.round(jump.at * fps) - from;
  return (
    <>
      <Sequence durationInFrames={first} layout="none"><Audio src={src} trimBefore={from} volume={volumeAt} /></Sequence>
      <Sequence from={first} layout="none"><Audio src={src} trimBefore={Math.round(jump.to * fps)} volume={(f) => volumeAt(f + first)} /></Sequence>
    </>
  );
};

/** Plays a cut: CGI scenes and footage slots, crossfades (or hard cuts), music and effects. */
export const Timeline: React.FC<{ cut: Cut }> = ({ cut }) => {
  const len = lengths(cut);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <TransitionSeries>
        {cut.entries.flatMap((e: Entry, i) => {
          const items = [
            <TransitionSeries.Sequence key={`s${i}`} durationInFrames={len[i]}>
              {'scene' in e ? (
                <SceneWithSound id={e.scene} skip={e.skip}>{e.overlays && <OverlayLayer overlays={e.overlays} />}</SceneWithSound>
              ) : (
                <FootageSlot entry={e} />
              )}
            </TransitionSeries.Sequence>,
          ];
          if (i < cut.entries.length - 1 && overlap(cut) > 0)
            items.push(<TransitionSeries.Transition key={`t${i}`} presentation={fade()} timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: overlap(cut) })} />);
          return items;
        })}
      </TransitionSeries>
      <Music cut={cut} />
      {cut.voiceover && <VoiceoverTrack lines={cut.voiceover} starts={startFrames(cut)} fps={fps} />}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "video/src/components/Voiceover.tsx", "sha256": "147f1e18b703e3b7e6d98e42e93d4d9f84fb5527bf38468e57ca4f8c62d584c2", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````tsx
// The Demo's spoken lines (config/voiceover.ts): each plays once its recording exists in public/audio/vo/, and its
// caption is always burned in, one short phrase at a time, so the video reads muted.
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, Audio, Sequence, getStaticFiles, staticFile, useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';
import { colors, fonts } from '../config/brand';
import { voSeconds, type VoLine } from '../config/voiceover';

/** The recording of a line, if it has been saved. */
export const voFile = (id: string) => getStaticFiles().find((f) => new RegExp(`^audio/vo/${id}\\.(wav|mp3|m4a)$`).test(f.name))?.name;

/** Breaks a line at punctuation, then at about eight words. */
const phrases = (text: string) =>
  text.split(/(?<=[.,:?!])\s+/).flatMap((part) => {
    const words = part.split(/\s+/);
    if (words.length <= 9) return [part];
    const mid = Math.ceil(words.length / 2);
    return [words.slice(0, mid).join(' '), words.slice(mid).join(' ')];
  });

const LineCaption: React.FC<{ text: string; frames: number }> = ({ text, frames }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const parts = phrases(text);
  const total = text.split(/\s+/).length;
  // Each phrase stays up in proportion to its words.
  let spent = 0;
  const current = parts.find((p) => {
    spent += p.split(/\s+/).length / total;
    return frame < spent * frames;
  }) ?? parts[parts.length - 1];
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ justifyContent: 'flex-end', alignItems: 'center', paddingBottom: 58 }}>
      <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.sans, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 40, color: colors.text, background: 'rgba(11,12,9,0.78)', padding: '12px 28px', borderRadius: 14, maxWidth: 1560, textAlign: 'center', lineHeight: 1.25 }}>
        {current}
      </div>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

/** All spoken lines of a cut. `starts` maps an entry id to its first frame. */
export const VoiceoverTrack: React.FC<{ lines: VoLine[]; starts: Map<string, number>; fps: number }> = ({ lines, starts, fps }) => (
  <>
    {lines.map((l) => {
      const start = starts.get(l.at);
      if (start === undefined) return null; // its entry was cut from the timeline
      const from = start + Math.round((l.lead ?? 0.3) * fps);
      const frames = Math.round(voSeconds(l) * fps);
      const file = voFile(l.id);
      return (
        <React.Fragment key={l.id}>
          {file && <Sequence from={from} layout="none"><Audio src={staticFile(file)} /></Sequence>}
          <Sequence from={from} durationInFrames={frames} layout="none"><LineCaption text={l.text} frames={frames} /></Sequence>
        </React.Fragment>
      );
    })}
  </>
);

````````

````````typescript
// BuildLog (~26 s X clip): how the racket was built, as a numbered how-to. Real footage from the
// bench (Oct 26-28), the robot session (Oct 29), the indoor session (Oct 28) and the court
// (Oct 17), with CGI where the CAD takes over. Clips are files in public/footage/, made by scripts/cut-footage.mjs (bt-*, rh-*).
// Suggested post: "We built an AI tennis racket from scratch. Here's the build log."
import type { Cue } from './sound.ts';

export const buildLog = {
  // "Comin Wit It" (Anno Domini Beats), 130.67 BPM, flat-out from bar one. scripts/prep-songs.mjs
  // cuts bars from 18.52 s and muffles the first two, so the full mix drops on beat 8.
  song: { src: 'audio/comin-wit-it.wav', bpm: 130.67, volume: 0.8 },
  beats: 56, // 14 bars ≈ 25.7 s

  // 1. Muffled intro: the title over the bench.

    { at: [12, 18], title: 'BUILD THE HANDLE.', pcb: 'bt-pcb', pod: 'bt-pod', push: 14, cut: 15.5, podOrigin: '76% 52%', tags: ['MOTION SENSOR', 'MICROPHONE', 'PROCESSOR'] },
    { at: [18, 22], title: 'WRITE THE CODE.', shots: [{ clip: 'bt-code', beats: 2 }, { clip: 'bt-code2', beats: 2 }] },
    // push into the CAD of the rig on the monitor, into the CGI arm, whip to the real one
    { at: [22, 28], title: 'PUT IT ON A ROBOT.', cad: 'bt-cad', monitor: '72% 44%', cut: 24.5, whip: 26, real: 'rh-arm' },
    { at: [28, 36], title: 'SWING. RECORD. REPEAT.', words: ['SWING.', 'RECORD.', 'REPEAT.'], shots: ['bt-wired', 'rh-over', 'bt-room', 'rh-swingin', 'bt-wired2', 'rh-pan', 'bt-room2', 'rh-face'] },
    // four indoor hits, one per beat, then the hero shot at the gate
    { at: [36, 44], title: 'TAKE IT TO COURT.', hits: ['bt-in1', 'bt-in2', 'bt-in3', 'bt-in4'], gate: 'bt-gate' },
  ],

  // 3. The gate shot carries on: push in on the racket he's holding up, cut to the CGI racket
  //    (head up, like his), then the name.
  finale: { at: [44, 56], clip: 'bt-gate2', racket: '47% 32%', cut: 47, name: 'TENNIS BUDDEE', line: 'Built from scratch.', cta: 'Coming soon' },
} as const;
````````

````````typescript
// Every word that appears on screen in the CGI scenes lives here. Spoken words: voiceover.ts.
// Numbers from git and hackathon.json are not here: they come from generated/facts.json (npm run assets).
//
// Rules we keep:
// - Never call the product a "coach" or "analyzer" (hackathon anti-project list).
// - UI labels copy the real app strings (quoted in comments with their source).
// - Example shots run through the real simulator (lib/sim.ts). To show your own, change the inputs below.
//   `npm run check` lists anything still marked as a sample.
import { applyDeltas, simulate, toMph, type SimDeltas, type SimInput } from '../lib/sim.ts';

// ---- Example shots: change these and every card, HUD and what-if follows. ----
const forehand: SimInput = { swingKmh: 75, pathDeg: 12, faceDeg: 2, contactXcm: -0.4, contactYcm: -2.1, incomingKmh: 43.2 };
const serve: SimInput = { swingKmh: 100, pathDeg: 10, faceDeg: 2, contactXcm: 0.5, contactYcm: -1.5, incomingKmh: 0 };
const whatIfChange: SimDeltas = { swingPercent: 5, contactYcm: 2 };

/** The Live card's fields for a simulated shot (ShotCard in the app). */
const card = (stroke: string, p: SimInput, sample: boolean) => {
  const r = simulate(p);
  return {
    stroke,
    badge: r.sweetSpot ? 'Sweet spot' : `${Math.round(Math.hypot(p.contactXcm, p.contactYcm))} cm off`,
    speed: Math.round(toMph(r.ballKmh)),
    unit: 'mph',
    sub: `${Math.round(r.spinRpm)} rpm ${r.spinType} · ${Math.round(toMph(p.swingKmh))} mph swing`,
    sample,
  };
};
const forehandCard = card('Forehand', forehand, false);
const before = simulate(forehand), after = simulate(applyDeltas(forehand, whatIfChange));
````````

````````typescript
// EverySwing (~29 s X clip): the racket on court. Real play, mostly from the indoor session
// (Oct 28) with a few Oct 17 outdoor shots, under a viewfinder HUD; a CGI swing that shows the
// contact point; the app on the phone; then the name. Tagline: "Be better." Clips are files in
// public/footage/ (ev-*), made by scripts/cut-footage.mjs.
// Suggested post: "Every swing, measured. Be better."
import type { Cue } from './sound.ts';

export const everySwing = {
  // "Not My First Rodeo" (Dyalla), 92 BPM. The section from 9.14 s: two quiet beats, the drums
  // come in on beat 3 and the full groove lands on beat 4 (11.75 s in the song).
  song: { src: 'audio/not-my-first-rodeo.wav', bpm: 92, volume: 0.8 },
  beats: 44, // ≈ 28.7 s

  // 1. Serve in silhouette: toss, trophy, contact on the drop.
  hook: { at: [0, 6], shots: [{ clip: 'ev-toss', at: [0, 2], word: 'WHAT IF YOUR RACKET' }, { clip: 'ev-toss2', at: [2, 4], word: 'COULD SEE' }, { clip: 'ev-serve', at: [4, 6], word: 'EVERYTHING.', accent: true }] },

  // 2. One real shot per beat under the HUD, each tagged with what the racket measures; the last
  //    is the whole indoor hall playing.
  montage: {
    at: [6, 14],
    shots: [
      { clip: 'ev-1', tag: 'FACE ANGLE' },
      { clip: 'ev-2', tag: 'SWING PATH' },
      { clip: 'ev-3', tag: 'SWING SPEED' },
      { clip: 'ev-4', tag: 'CONTACT POINT' },
      { clip: 'ev-5', tag: 'SPIN' },
      { clip: 'ev-6', tag: 'SHOT TYPE' },
      { clip: 'ev-7', tag: 'IMPACT' },
      { clip: 'ev-8', tag: 'EVERY SHOT.' },
    ],
  },

  // 3. CGI: the racket swings through two balls over the court; the contact point lights up.
  feel: { at: [14, 20], plate: 'ev-plate-court', contacts: [16, 18], lines: ['IT FEELS', 'EVERY HIT.'], label: 'CONTACT POINT' },

  // 4. The app: the session on the phone, racket in the other hand.
  phone: { at: [20, 26], shots: [{ clip: 'ev-phone', at: [20, 24] }, { clip: 'ev-check', at: [24, 26] }], lines: ['EVERY SESSION.', 'IN YOUR POCKET.'] },

  // 5. Serve against the sky, then four quick indoor hits.
  train: { at: [26, 34], sky: 'ev-sky2', line: 'KNOW YOUR GAME.', hits: ['ev-9', 'ev-10', 'ev-11', 'ev-12'], words: ['TRAIN.', 'TRACK.', 'IMPROVE.'] },

  // 6. The racket at the net, cut to CGI, the name and the tagline.
  finale: { at: [34, 44], clip: 'ev-net', cut: 36, name: 'TENNIS BUDDEE', tagline: 'BE BETTER.', cta: 'Coming soon' },
} as const;

/** Sound effects on beats. */
export const everySwingCues: (Omit<Cue, 'at'> & { beat: number })[] = [
  { sfx: 'riser', beat: 4, volume: 0.45 },
  { sfx: 'impact', beat: 4, volume: 1 },
  { sfx: 'boom', beat: 4, volume: 0.35 },
  ...[7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12].map((beat) => ({ sfx: 'tap' as const, beat, volume: 0.6 })),
  { sfx: 'impact', beat: 13, volume: 0.7 },
  { sfx: 'whoosh', beat: 14, volume: 0.3 },
  { sfx: 'impact', beat: 16, volume: 0.8 },
  { sfx: 'impact', beat: 18, volume: 0.8 },
  { sfx: 'swipe', beat: 20, volume: 0.5 },
  { sfx: 'blip', beat: 22, volume: 0.35 },
  { sfx: 'whoosh', beat: 26, volume: 0.3 },
  ...[30, 31, 32, 33].map((beat) => ({ sfx: 'impact' as const, beat, volume: 0.5 })),
  { sfx: 'whoosh', beat: 36, volume: 0.3 },
  { sfx: 'boom', beat: 36, volume: 0.45 },
];
````````

````````typescript
// Music and sound effects. Files live in public/audio/ (credits: public/audio/CREDITS.md).
import type { SceneId } from '../scenes';

export type Music = {
  src: string;
  /** seconds into the file where the video starts */
  from?: number;
  volume?: number;
  /** At `at` seconds into the file, jump back to `to`, so a long cut never reaches the song's fade-out. Use bar lines. */
  jump?: { at: number; to: number };
};

/** Default music bed for the Reveal and Demo cuts (the song cut sets its own). */
export const music: Music = { src: 'audio/keep-it-movin.mp3', from: 0.386, volume: 0.55 };

export const sound = {
  /** Music level while a footage slot with `muted: false` plays (people talking). */
  musicUnderTalk: 0.12,
  /** Music level under a recorded voiceover line (public/audio/vo/). */
  musicUnderVoiceover: 0.16,
  /** Fade the music out over the last N seconds. */
  musicFadeOut: 3,
};

/**
 * Each effect: file, `hit` = seconds into the file where its key moment is (the
 * transient, the peak of a riser), optional `trim` [start, end] seconds to use.
 * Cues place the hit exactly on their frame.
 */
export const effects = {
  impact: { src: 'audio/sfx/impact.mp3', hit: 0.05, trim: [0, 0.9] },
  whoosh: { src: 'audio/sfx/whoosh.mp3', hit: 0.36 },
  riser: { src: 'audio/sfx/riser.mp3', hit: 3.42, trim: [0.6, 3.6] },
  boom: { src: 'audio/sfx/boom.mp3', hit: 0.45, trim: [0, 4] },
  tap: { src: 'audio/sfx/tap.mp3', hit: 0.92, trim: [0.9, 1.15] },
  blip: { src: 'audio/sfx/blip.mp3', hit: 0.06, trim: [0, 0.6] },
  ping: { src: 'audio/sfx/ping.mp3', hit: 0.08 },
  servo: { src: 'audio/sfx/servo.mp3', hit: 0.42, trim: [0.4, 2.1] },
  chime: { src: 'audio/sfx/chime.mp3', hit: 0.03 },
  swipe: { src: 'audio/sfx/swipe.mp3', hit: 0.05 },
} satisfies Record<string, { src: string; hit: number; trim?: number[] }>;

export type Effect = keyof typeof effects;
/** `at` = frame within the scene where the effect's hit lands (or before the scene's end, with fromEnd). */
export type Cue = { sfx: Effect; at: number; volume?: number; fromEnd?: boolean };
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "video/src/config/timeline.ts", "sha256": "2c1410a00e8b77d674a43517f1f01d1e303e0b48cb2af45d693410eeccd3ac26", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````typescript
// The order and length of every beat. Edit these lists to re-cut the videos.
//
// An entry is either:
//   { scene: '<id>', seconds }                  CGI scene from src/scenes
//   { footage: '<id>', seconds, ... }           real footage slot
//
// Footage: save the clip as public/footage/<id>.mp4 and it is used automatically. Until then the slot plays, in
// order: `clips` (short cuts already in public/footage), `fallback` (a CGI scene), or a placeholder with the shot notes.
// `from` trims the start of the clip (seconds). `caption` is burned in at the bottom.
// Scenes take `skip` (frames) to start a scene part-way in, e.g. so its key moment lands on a beat.
// Any entry takes `overlays`: text and cards over the picture, drawn by src/components/Overlays.tsx.

import type { SceneId } from '../scenes';
import { music, type Music } from './sound.ts'; // .ts so scripts can import it with plain node
import { voiceover, type VoLine } from './voiceover.ts';

/** `at` and `seconds` are relative to the entry. `text` is a key of copy.overlays. */
export type Overlay =
  | { type: 'headline'; text: 'hook'; at: number; seconds: number }
  | { type: 'shotCard'; at: number; seconds: number }
  | { type: 'badge'; text: 'deviceBadge' | 'filmBadge'; at: number; seconds: number; x?: number; y?: number }
  | { type: 'callouts'; text: 'museCallouts'; at: number; every: number }
  | { type: 'lowerThird'; text: 'testimonial1' | 'testimonial2'; at: number; seconds: number };

export type SceneEntry = {
  scene: SceneId;
  seconds: number;
  skip?: number;
  overlays?: Overlay[];
  /** The scene plays its own song: the cut's music goes silent under it. */
  ownMusic?: boolean;
};
export type FootageEntry = {
  footage: string;
  seconds: number;
  file?: string; // only to use a name other than <footage>.mp4
  from?: number;
  muted?: boolean;
  caption?: string;
  shot: string; // what to film, shown on the placeholder
  /** Plays until the real clip exists: [clip name, seconds, optional playback rate]. */
  clips?: [string, number, number?][];
  /** The clips above are a stand-in, not the final shot: tags the frame and `npm run check` lists it. */
  standIn?: boolean;
  /** CGI scene to show until the real clip exists. */
  fallback?: SceneId;
  /** 'phone': a portrait screen recording in an iPhone frame, ungraded. Default: full frame, graded. */
  layout?: 'full' | 'phone';
  playbackRate?: number;
  overlays?: Overlay[];
};
export type Entry = SceneEntry | FootageEntry;

// Crossfade between beats, in seconds. Set to 0 for hard cuts.
export const transitionSeconds = 0.4;

// Optional: turn on once ShotSimulator returns launch angle/flight.
export const features = { showBallFlight: false };

// ~60 s CGI-only reveal: the X/LinkedIn post and the opening of the demo.
export const reveal: Entry[] = [
  { scene: 'hook', seconds: 3.5 },
  { scene: 'racketReveal', seconds: 6 },
  { scene: 'insideHandle', seconds: 9 },
  { scene: 'impact', seconds: 6.5 },
  { scene: 'robotLab', seconds: 8 },
  { scene: 'devices', seconds: 7 },
  { scene: 'score', seconds: 5.5 },
  { scene: 'whatIf', seconds: 11 },
  { scene: 'together', seconds: 5.5 },
  { scene: 'endcard', seconds: 5 },
];

// The 3:00 hackathon submission (script: video/DEMO_SCRIPT.md). Spoken lines live in voiceover.ts and follow their
// entry, so you can reorder this list freely. `npm run timeline` prints the cut; `npm run check` tells you what's left.
export const demoTransition = 0.25;
// The song fades out at about 2:05. Jump back from bar 49 to bar 9, where it's just as full, on a bar line.
const songBar = (n: number) => 0.386 + ((n - 1) * 4 * 60) / 95;
const demoMusic: Music = { ...music, jump: { at: songBar(49), to: songBar(9) } };
export const demo: Entry[] = [
  { footage: 'cold-open', seconds: 8, standIn: true, clips: [['ev-toss', 3.2, 0.5], ['ev-serve', 4.8, 0.3]],
    overlays: [{ type: 'headline', text: 'hook', at: 0.4, seconds: 3.6 }, { type: 'shotCard', at: 4.6, seconds: 3.4 }],
    shot: 'Your serve at the court: toss, then contact. Film 240 fps slow-mo from the side. Phone on the Live tab so the card numbers are real.' },
  { scene: 'racketReveal', seconds: 6 },
  { footage: 'talk-intro', seconds: 9, muted: false,
    caption: 'I built a smart racket that combines Meta AI with real data from your own swings, so you can see what a change will do before you make it.',
    shot: 'Bedroom, landscape, racket in hand. One line on the problem, one on what you built. Say what the caption says, in your own words, and change the caption to match.' },
  { scene: 'insideHandle', seconds: 8 },
  { footage: 'build-montage', seconds: 6, clips: [['bt-smoke', 1.2], ['bt-solder', 1], ['bt-pcb', 1], ['bt-pod', 0.7], ['bt-code', 1.1], ['bt-wired', 0.6], ['bt-cad', 0.4]],
    shot: 'Already cut from the build footage. Replace only if you have something better.' },
  // The first 24 beats of the X clip, on its own song. It stops before the claims the Demo doesn't make.
  { scene: 'robotShort', seconds: 11.25, ownMusic: true },
  { scene: 'twoModels', seconds: 8.75 },
  { scene: 'evidence', seconds: 9 },
  { scene: 'devices', seconds: 6, overlays: [{ type: 'badge', text: 'deviceBadge', at: 1.6, seconds: 4.2, x: 1560, y: 300 }] },
  { footage: 'glasses-pov', seconds: 7, fallback: 'glassesPov',
    shot: 'Optional: through the lens of the real Ray-Ban Display. Until then, the simulated-view CGI plays, and says so.' },
  { scene: 'museAgent', seconds: 12 },
  { scene: 'whatIf', seconds: 10 },
  { footage: 'muse-screen-recording', seconds: 22, layout: 'phone',
    overlays: [{ type: 'callouts', text: 'museCallouts', at: 1, every: 5 }],
    shot: 'iPhone screen recording, about a minute, slowly: Muse tab, What if, ask it, wait for the numbers. Then Next drill, then Start on Watch. Set playbackRate to speed it up and move the callouts to match.' },
  { footage: 'drill-on-watch', seconds: 7.5,
    shot: 'Close on the Watch: the to-go count drops as you hit. Finish on the phone Live tab saying Drill complete!' },
  { scene: 'samTrack', seconds: 6.75 },
  { scene: 'swingFilm', seconds: 7, overlays: [{ type: 'badge', text: 'filmBadge', at: 0.3, seconds: 6.5, x: 960, y: 40 }] },
  // Made by scripts/testimonials.py, which cleans the audio. The files are full length: pick each line with `from` and `seconds`.
  { footage: 'testimonial-1', seconds: 12, from: 15, muted: false, overlays: [{ type: 'lowerThird', text: 'testimonial1', at: 0.4, seconds: 4 }],
    shot: 'npm run testimonials' },
  { footage: 'testimonial-2', seconds: 12, from: 1.5, muted: false, overlays: [{ type: 'lowerThird', text: 'testimonial2', at: 0.4, seconds: 4 }],
    shot: 'npm run testimonials' },
  { footage: 'simulator', seconds: 10,
    shot: 'Screen record tennisbuddy.net/emulator in landscape: pick a match, Start Session on Live, let a few hits land, then open Muse and What if.' },
  { scene: 'endcard', seconds: 6 },
];

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Cut to "Keep It Movin'" (Jahdean): 95 BPM, first downbeat 0.386 s, bar = 2.526 s.
// Found with scripts/analyze-song.mjs. Every scene is a whole number of bars and
// cuts hard on the downbeat; the song fills out at bar 9, where the ball impact lands.
export const song: Music & { bpm: number } = { src: 'audio/keep-it-movin.mp3', from: 0.386, bpm: 95, volume: 0.7 };
const bars = (n: number) => (n * 4 * 60) / song.bpm;

export const revealSong: Entry[] = [
  { scene: 'hook', seconds: bars(2) }, // bars 1-2, riser peaks on the cut
  { scene: 'racketReveal', seconds: bars(3), skip: 24 }, // title + boom on bar 4's downbeat
  { scene: 'insideHandle', seconds: bars(3) },
  { scene: 'impact', seconds: bars(3), skip: 3 }, // starts on the lift (bar 9); ball hits on beat 4
  { scene: 'robotLab', seconds: bars(3) }, // racket meets the ball on beats
  { scene: 'devices', seconds: bars(3) },
  { scene: 'score', seconds: bars(2) },
  { scene: 'whatIf', seconds: bars(4) },
  { scene: 'together', seconds: bars(2) },
  { scene: 'endcard', seconds: bars(2), skip: 4 }, // logo pop + boom on the downbeat
];

/** Every cut: its entries, crossfade length and music. Root.tsx makes one composition each. */
export type Cut = { entries: Entry[]; transition: number; music: Music; voiceover?: VoLine[] };
export const cuts: Record<'Reveal' | 'RevealSong' | 'Demo', Cut> = {
  Reveal: { entries: reveal, transition: transitionSeconds, music },
  RevealSong: { entries: revealSong, transition: 0, music: song },
  Demo: { entries: demo, transition: demoTransition, music: demoMusic, voiceover },
};
````````

````````typescript
// Every spoken line in the Demo, and its burned-in caption. Rewrite a line here and the caption follows.
//
// - `at`: the entry in timeline.ts it starts on (a scene id or footage id), so a line moves with its shot.
// - `lead`: seconds after that entry starts. Default 0.3.
// - Record a line: save it as public/audio/vo/<id>.wav (or .mp3, .m4a). It plays on its own and the music ducks.
// - `seconds`: how long the line runs, for captions and ducking. Default: from the word count.
//   `npm run check` warns when a line would run into the next one.
//
// Say "smart racket" and "predicts". The hackathon's anti-project list bans the other words (see ../../README.md).

export type VoLine = { id: string; at: string; lead?: number; seconds?: number; text: string };

/** Comfortable reading pace, words per second. */
export const WORDS_PER_SECOND = 2.6;
export const voSeconds = (l: VoLine) => l.seconds ?? l.text.split(/\s+/).length / WORDS_PER_SECOND;

export const voiceover: VoLine[] = [
  { id: 'open', at: 'cold-open', lead: 0.6, text: 'Hundreds of hits per match, but which ones are good, and where can you improve?' },
  { id: 'reveal', at: 'racketReveal', lead: 1.2, text: 'This is Tennis Buddee: a smart racket that feels every shot.' },
  // talk-intro is you on camera, and robotShort plays on its own song: no line on either.
  { id: 'hardware', at: 'insideHandle', text: 'A sensor insert replaces the foam in the handle: a thousand samples a second, up to 320 g, and a microphone that hears where the ball met the strings. It computes every shot itself.' },
  // The on-racket model is ridge regression (firmware/src/sweetspot.cpp). Don't call it a neural net until one ships.
  { id: 'models', at: 'twoModels', text: 'On the racket, our own ML model runs on the ESP32. In the app, Meta\'s open Muse Spark, served by Baseten.' },
  { id: 'evidence', at: 'evidence', text: 'The firmware matches Python on every clip, distance error stays under two centimeters, and Muse passes a strict test 88 percent of the time.' },
  { id: 'everywhere', at: 'devices', lead: 0.8, text: 'Every shot lands on your phone, your Apple Watch, and Meta Ray-Ban Display, through the Meta Wearables toolkit, in a UI you can read at a glance.' },
  { id: 'agent', at: 'museAgent', text: 'Muse Spark isn\'t a chat box here. It\'s an agent with ten tools, over your shots and the live racket. Every number it reports has to come from a tool.' },
  { id: 'whatif', at: 'whatIf', text: 'Ask what if, and it runs a physics simulation on your own average stroke, and predicts what the change does to speed and spin.' },
  { id: 'drill', at: 'muse-screen-recording', lead: 15.5, text: 'Then it plans a drill, and then your wearable tracks it.' },
  { id: 'sam', at: 'samTrack', text: 'SAM 3.1 tracks the racket through real video, frame by frame, and pre-fills the contact labels.' },
  { id: 'film', at: 'swingFilm', text: 'And Muse directs this swing film from the simulator\'s numbers, so it can\'t invent a swing.' },
  { id: 'end', at: 'endcard', lead: 0.8, text: 'Try our online simulator, and feel like a tennis pro.' },
];
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "video/src/hype/BuildLog.tsx", "sha256": "8f47e40ee3b59f233a7bc35268bf670808c4184819e814e0cf3dd1087a1e4d3e", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````tsx
// BuildLog (~26 s X clip): "how to build an AI tennis racket" as six numbered steps, on
// "Comin Wit It". Timed in beats; copy, clips and beats come from src/config/buildLog.ts.
// Real -> CGI hand-offs as in RobotHype: one grade, grain and vignette over both, CGI over the
// real place (blurred), and each cut on matching framing: the pod's end, the CAD on the monitor,
// the racket held up at the gate.
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, Audio, Easing, Sequence, interpolate, staticFile, useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';
import { Effect } from '../components/Timeline';
import { Stage3D } from '../components/Stage3D';
import { colors, fonts } from '../config/brand';
import { buildLog as B, buildLogCues } from '../config/buildLog';
import { RobotArm } from '../scenes/RobotLab';
import { Big, Center, Grain, useSlam } from './Hype';
import { Clip, Flash, GRADE, Plate, SHADOW, Shade, Vignette, beatClock, clamp, inOut, makeDuck, mix, type V3, whipIn, whipOut } from './kit';
import { HandleCGI, PushToBlack, RacketFinale, Tags } from './pieces';

const { BEAT, f, pulse, Shot } = beatClock(B.song.bpm); // ~13.78 frames per beat
export const buildLogFrames = f(B.beats);
const [SOLDER, HANDLE, CODE, ROBOT, REPEAT, OUTSIDE] = B.steps;

// ---------- 1. Intro: the title over the bench, music muffled ----------
const Intro: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const i = B.intro;
  const top = useSlam(f(0.5));
  const bottom = useSlam(f(4));
  const typed = B.intro.kicker.slice(0, Math.floor(frame / 3));
  // a lamp-like flicker while the music is still behind the wall
  const flicker = 0.85 + 0.15 * Math.sin(frame * 1.7) * Math.sin(frame * 0.37);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ filter: `brightness(${flicker})` }}>
      {i.shots.map((s) => (
        <Sequence key={s.clip} from={f(s.at[0])} durationInFrames={f(s.at[1]) - f(s.at[0])}>
          <Clip name={s.clip} len={f(4)} zoom={[1.18, 1.04]} />
        </Sequence>
      ))}
      <Shade amount={0.5} />
      <Center style={{ flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 30, letterSpacing: 8, color: colors.accent, marginBottom: 14, minHeight: 40 }}>● {typed}{frame % 16 < 8 ? '_' : ' '}</div>
        <Big size={150} style={{ ...top, textShadow: SHADOW }}>{i.title[0]}</Big>
        {frame >= f(4) && <Big size={150} color={colors.accent} style={{ ...bottom, textShadow: SHADOW }}>{i.title[1]}</Big>}
      </Center>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---------- 2. Steps: counter top left, title bottom left, over whatever the step shows ----------
const StepFrame: React.FC<{ n: number; title: string; children: React.ReactNode; titleAt?: number }> = ({ n, title, children, titleAt = 0 }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const slam = useSlam(titleAt);
  const total = B.steps.length;
  const fill = interpolate(frame, [0, 10], [(n - 1) / total, n / total], { ...clamp, easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic) });
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      {children}
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.6), transparent 42%)', pointerEvents: 'none' }} />
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 110, top: 96 }}>
        <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 28, letterSpacing: 4, color: colors.text, textShadow: SHADOW }}>
          STEP <span style={{ color: colors.accent }}>{String(n).padStart(2, '0')}</span> / {String(total).padStart(2, '0')}
        </div>
        <div style={{ width: 300, height: 5, marginTop: 14, background: 'rgba(243,245,236,0.25)' }}>
          <div style={{ width: `${fill * 100}%`, height: '100%', background: colors.accent }} />
        </div>
      </div>
      {frame >= titleAt && (
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 110, bottom: 100, right: 110 }}>
          <Big size={title.length > 18 ? 116 : 140} style={{ ...slam, transformOrigin: 'left center', textShadow: SHADOW }}>{title}</Big>
        </div>
      )}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

/** Shots of `beats` beats each, back to back from local frame 0. */
const Cuts: React.FC<{ shots: readonly { clip: string; beats: number }[]; zoom?: [number, number] }> = ({ shots, zoom = [1.14, 1.02] }) => {
  let at = 0;
  return (
    <>
      {shots.map((s, i) => {
        const el = (
          <Sequence key={i} from={f(at)} durationInFrames={f(at + s.beats) - f(at)}>
            <Clip name={s.clip} len={f(s.beats)} zoom={zoom} ease={Easing.out(Easing.cubic)} />
          </Sequence>
        );
        at += s.beats;
        return el;
      })}
    </>
  );
};

const Handle: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const h = HANDLE;
  const b = (beat: number) => f(beat - h.at[0]);
  const push = b(h.push), cut = b(h.cut), end = b(h.at[1]);
  const k = frame - cut;
  const explode = interpolate(k, [0, f(1.4)], [0.25, 1], { ...clamp, easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic) });
  const move = interpolate(k, [0, end - cut], [0, 1], { ...clamp, easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic) });
  const up = interpolate(k, [0, 7], [1, 0], clamp);
  return (
    <StepFrame n={2} title={h.title}>
      {frame < push && <Clip name={h.pcb} len={push} zoom={[1.1, 1.22]} />}
      {frame >= push && frame < cut && (
        <Sequence from={push} layout="none">
          <PushToBlack clip={h.pod} len={cut - push} origin={h.podOrigin} zoom={3.6} />
        </Sequence>
      )}
      {frame >= cut && (
        <AbsoluteFill>
          <Plate name="bt-plate-bench" blur={26} dim={0.62} zoom={1.5} />
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ filter: GRADE }}>
            <HandleCGI explode={explode} move={move} imu={k > f(1) ? 0.5 + 0.5 * pulse(frame) : 0} />
          </AbsoluteFill>
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 110, top: 100 }}>
            <Tags tags={h.tags} at={cut + f(0.5)} every={f(0.5)} />
          </div>
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: '#050504', opacity: up }} />
        </AbsoluteFill>
      )}
    </StepFrame>
  );
};

// The CAD on the monitor shows the arm from its side, upright, light grey on dark grey.
const VIEWPORT_CAM = { from: [-0.4, 1.8, 7.2] as V3, to: [-0.9, 1.5, 5.6] as V3, target: [-0.6, 1.2, 0] as V3 };
const Robot: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const r = ROBOT;
  const b = (beat: number) => f(beat - r.at[0]);
  const cut = b(r.cut), whip = b(r.whip), end = b(r.at[1]);
  const glow = interpolate(frame, [cut - 6, cut], [0, 1], clamp); // the monitor's light fills the frame
  const t = interpolate(frame, [cut, whip], [0, 1], clamp);
  const angle = interpolate(frame, [cut, whip - 4], [-0.2, 0.55], { ...clamp, easing: inOut });
  return (
    <StepFrame n={4} title={r.title}>
      {frame < cut && (
        <AbsoluteFill>
          <Clip name={r.cad} len={cut} zoom={[1, 4.2]} origin={r.monitor} ease={Easing.in(Easing.cubic)} />
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: '#2a2d31', opacity: glow * 0.9 }} />
        </AbsoluteFill>
      )}
      {frame >= cut && frame < whip && (
        <AbsoluteFill style={whipOut(frame, whip)}>
          {/* CAD viewport: flat dark grey with a faint grid, like the monitor */}
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: 'radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%, #34383d, #1f2226 75%)' }} />
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ filter: GRADE }}>
            <Stage3D camera={mix(VIEWPORT_CAM.from, VIEWPORT_CAM.to, t)} target={VIEWPORT_CAM.target} fov={36} rim="#ffffff" envIntensity={0.8}>
              <RobotArm angle={angle} racket="blue" />
            </Stage3D>
          </AbsoluteFill>
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 110, top: 100, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 26, letterSpacing: 3, color: colors.accent }}>◆ CAD · TEST RIG</div>
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: '#2a2d31', opacity: interpolate(frame, [cut, cut + 5], [0.9, 0], clamp) }} />
        </AbsoluteFill>
      )}
      {frame >= whip && (
        <AbsoluteFill style={whipIn(frame, whip)}>
          <Clip name={r.real} len={end - whip} zoom={[1.15, 1]} />
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 110, top: 100, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 26, letterSpacing: 3, color: colors.text }}>● REAL · EPSON C8</div>
        </AbsoluteFill>
      )}
    </StepFrame>
  );
};

const Repeat: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const r = REPEAT;
  const word = Math.min(2, Math.floor(frame / f(2)));
  const slam = useSlam(f(word * 2));
  const last = word === 2;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <StepFrame n={5} title="" titleAt={1e9}>
        {r.shots.map((clip, i) => (
          <Sequence key={i} from={f(i)} durationInFrames={f(i + 1) - f(i)}>
            <Clip name={clip} len={f(1)} zoom={[1.2, 1.05]} />
          </Sequence>
        ))}
        <Flash at={f(Math.floor(frame / BEAT))} len={4} peak={0.18} />
      </StepFrame>
      <Center>
        <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
          {/* REPEAT. echoes once per beat behind itself */}
          {last && [3, 2, 1].map((e) => {
            const on = frame >= f(4 + e);
            return on && <Big key={e} size={230} color="transparent" style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, WebkitTextStroke: `2px ${colors.accent}`, opacity: 0.5 / e, transform: `scale(${1 + e * 0.12})` }}>{r.words[2]}</Big>;
          })}
          <Big key={word} size={230} color={last ? colors.accent : colors.text} style={{ ...slam, textShadow: SHADOW }}>{r.words[word]}</Big>
        </div>
      </Center>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

const Outside: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const o = OUTSIDE;
  return (
    <StepFrame n={6} title={o.title}>
      {o.hits.map((clip, i) => (
        <Sequence key={clip} from={f(i)} durationInFrames={f(1 + i) - f(i)}>
          <Clip name={clip} len={f(1)} zoom={[1.2, 1.04]} />
          <Flash at={0} len={5} peak={0.35} />
        </Sequence>
      ))}
      <Sequence from={f(4)} durationInFrames={f(8) - f(4)}>
        <Clip name={o.gate} len={f(4)} zoom={[1, 1.08]} origin="47% 32%" />
      </Sequence>
      {frame < f(4) && <div style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 110, top: 100, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 26, letterSpacing: 3, color: colors.accent }}>● ON COURT</div>}
    </StepFrame>
  );
};

// ---------- 3. Finale: the racket at the net, cut to CGI, the name ----------
const Finale: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const fin = B.finale;
  const cut = f(fin.cut - fin.at[0]);
  const blurIn = interpolate(frame, [cut - 5, cut], [0, 8], clamp);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      {frame < cut ? (
        <AbsoluteFill style={{ filter: blurIn ? `blur(${blurIn}px)` : undefined }}>
          <Clip name={fin.clip} len={cut} zoom={[1.08, 2.6]} origin={fin.racket} ease={Easing.in(Easing.quad)} />
        </AbsoluteFill>
      ) : (
        <Sequence from={cut} layout="none">
          <RacketFinale beat={BEAT} finish="red" name={fin.name} line={fin.line} cta={fin.cta} room={fin.clip} headDown={false} glow={(k) => 0.4 + 0.6 * pulse(k + cut)} />
        </Sequence>
      )}
      <Flash at={cut - 1} len={6} peak={0.5} />
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

const duck = makeDuck(buildLogCues, f);

export const BuildLog: React.FC = () => {
  const s = B.song;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: colors.bg, color: colors.text, fontFamily: fonts.sans, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      <Shot at={B.intro.at}><Intro /></Shot>
      <Shot at={SOLDER.at}><StepFrame n={1} title={SOLDER.title}><Cuts shots={SOLDER.shots} /></StepFrame></Shot>
      <Shot at={HANDLE.at}><Handle /></Shot>
      <Shot at={CODE.at}><StepFrame n={3} title={CODE.title}><Cuts shots={CODE.shots} /></StepFrame></Shot>
      <Shot at={ROBOT.at}><Robot /></Shot>
      <Shot at={REPEAT.at}><Repeat /></Shot>
      <Shot at={OUTSIDE.at}><Outside /></Shot>
      <Shot at={B.finale.at}><Finale /></Shot>
      <Vignette />
      <Grain />
      <Audio src={staticFile(s.src)} volume={(fr) => s.volume * duck(fr) * interpolate(fr, [buildLogFrames - 24, buildLogFrames], [1, 0], clamp)} />
      {buildLogCues.map((c, i) => <Effect key={i} cue={{ ...c, at: 0 }} frame={f(c.beat)} />)}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};
````````

#### Reference: `video/src/hype/EverySwing.tsx`

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "video/src/hype/EverySwing.tsx", "sha256": "30d6f6e5d2ad2cac1b670efc7a5acff71fa80585f6fbff460b6cd0009c0ca313", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````tsx
// EverySwing (~29 s X clip): on court with the racket, on "Not My First Rodeo". Timed in beats;
// copy, clips and beats come from src/config/everySwing.ts. Same treatment as RobotHype: one
// grade, grain and vignette over real and CGI, CGI over a blurred plate of the same court.
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, Audio, Easing, Sequence, interpolate, staticFile, useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';
import { Effect } from '../components/Timeline';
import { Racket } from '../components/Racket';
import { Stage3D } from '../components/Stage3D';
import { colors, fonts } from '../config/brand';
import { everySwing as E, everySwingCues } from '../config/everySwing';
import { gyroTrace } from '../config/gyro-trace';
import { Big, Center, Grain, useSlam } from './Hype';
import { Brackets, Clip, Flash, GRADE, Plate, SHADOW, Shade, Vignette, beatClock, clamp, makeDuck, type V3, whipIn, whipOut } from './kit';
import { RacketFinale, WordShot } from './pieces';

const { BEAT, f, pulse, Shot } = beatClock(E.song.bpm); // ~19.57 frames per beat
export const everySwingFrames = f(E.beats);

// ---------- 1. Hook: the serve, contact on the drop ----------
const Hook: React.FC = () => (
  <>
    {E.hook.shots.map((s) => (
      <Sequence key={s.clip} from={f(s.at[0])} durationInFrames={f(s.at[1]) - f(s.at[0])}>
        <WordShot clip={s.clip} len={f(2)} word={s.word} accent={'accent' in s} size={'accent' in s ? 230 : 150} zoom={'accent' in s ? [1.25, 1.05] : [1.12, 1.02]} />
      </Sequence>
    ))}
    <Flash at={f(4)} len={8} peak={0.55} />
  </>
);

// ---------- 2. Montage: one shot per beat under a viewfinder HUD ----------
/** The racket's own gyro trace, scrolling: a live readout in the corner. */
const Sparkline: React.FC<{ offset: number; width?: number; height?: number }> = ({ offset, width = 420, height = 90 }) => {
  const n = 120, max = Math.max(...gyroTrace);
  const pts = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => gyroTrace[(offset + i) % gyroTrace.length]);
  const d = pts.map((v, i) => `${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${((i / (n - 1)) * width).toFixed(1)},${(height - (v / max) * (height - 6)).toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');
  return (
    <svg width={width} height={height} style={{ overflow: 'visible' }}>
      <line x1={0} x2={width} y1={height} y2={height} stroke="rgba(243,245,236,0.3)" strokeWidth={2} />
      <path d={d} stroke={colors.accent} strokeWidth={3} fill="none" strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
};
const MontageShot: React.FC<{ i: number }> = ({ i }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const shot = E.montage.shots[i];
  const slam = useSlam(0);
  const last = i === E.montage.shots.length - 1;
  const t = (f(E.montage.at[0] + i) + frame) / 30;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={i === 0 ? whipIn(frame, 0) : undefined}>
      <Clip name={shot.clip} len={f(1)} zoom={[1.22, 1.06]} ease={Easing.out(Easing.cubic)} />
      {last ? (
        <>
          <Shade amount={0.45} />
          <Center><Big size={230} color={colors.accent} style={{ ...slam, textShadow: SHADOW }}>{shot.tag}</Big></Center>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.55), transparent 45%)' }} />
          <Brackets />
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 110, top: 100, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 26, color: colors.text, display: 'flex', gap: 16, alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <div style={{ width: 16, height: 16, borderRadius: 8, background: colors.accent, opacity: frame % 12 < 8 ? 1 : 0.25 }} />
            LIVE  00:{t.toFixed(2).padStart(5, '0')}
          </div>
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 110, top: 100, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 26, color: colors.accent }}>SHOT {String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</div>
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 110, bottom: 110 }}>
            <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 26, letterSpacing: 4, color: colors.accent, marginBottom: 10 }}>MEASURING ▸</div>
            <Big size={140} style={{ ...slam, transformOrigin: 'left center', textShadow: SHADOW }}>{shot.tag}</Big>
          </div>
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 110, bottom: 120 }}>
            <Sparkline offset={(i * 70 + frame * 3) % gyroTrace.length} />
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---------- 3. Feel: the CGI racket swings through two balls; the contact point lights up ----------
// Camera looks straight at the string bed. The racket turns about a "wrist" below the frame,
// so its head sweeps across the frame: forehand left -> right, then back.
const FEEL_CAM = { pos: [0, 0.3, 6.5] as V3, target: [0, 0.3, 0] as V3, fov: 34 };
const PIVOT: V3 = [0.9, -1.3, 0];
const REACH = 1.75; // pivot -> racket centre
const HEAD = REACH + 0.76; // pivot -> head centre
const PX = 1080 / (2 * FEEL_CAM.pos[2] * Math.tan((FEEL_CAM.fov / 2) * (Math.PI / 180))); // px per unit at z = 0
const toScreen = (x: number, y: number) => [960 + x * PX, 540 - (y - FEEL_CAM.target[1]) * PX];
const SWING = 0.9;
const Feel: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const fe = E.feel;
  const b = (beat: number) => f(beat - fe.at[0]);
  const [c1, c2] = fe.contacts.map(b);
  const s = (c: number, fr: number) => 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.tanh((fr - c) / 2.4);
  const angleAt = (fr: number) => SWING - 2 * SWING * s(c1, fr) + 2 * SWING * s(c2, fr);
  const angle = angleAt(frame);
  const head = (a: number) => toScreen(PIVOT[0] - HEAD * Math.sin(a), PIVOT[1] + HEAD * Math.cos(a));
  // ball: in from the side the racket is moving toward, back out the way it came, faster
  const c = frame < (c1 + c2) / 2 ? c1 : c2;
  const side = c === c1 ? 1 : -1;
  const hit: V3 = [PIVOT[0], PIVOT[1] + HEAD, 0.15];
  const inT = interpolate(frame, [c - 14, c], [0, 1], clamp);
  const outT = interpolate(frame, [c, c + 12], [0, 1], clamp);
  const ball: V3 = frame < c
    ? [hit[0] + side * 4.5 * (1 - inT), hit[1] + 0.3 * (1 - inT), hit[2] - 1.5 * (1 - inT)]
    : [hit[0] + side * 5 * outT, hit[1] + 0.7 * outT, hit[2] - 7 * outT];
  const showBall = frame > c - 15 && frame < c + 12;
  // motion trail of the head over the last frames
  const trail = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, k) => head(angleAt(frame - k * 0.8)));
  const speed = Math.abs(angleAt(frame) - angleAt(frame - 1));
  const glow = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.min(Math.abs(frame - c1), Math.abs(frame - c2)) / 7);
  const ring = frame >= c1 ? (frame - (frame >= c2 ? c2 : c1)) : -1;
  const [hx, hy] = head(0);
  const l1 = useSlam(0);
  const l2 = useSlam(b(fe.contacts[0]));
  const shake = frame >= c1 && frame < c1 + 6 ? Math.sin(frame * 7.1) * 10 * (1 - (frame - c1) / 6) : frame >= c2 && frame < c2 + 6 ? Math.sin(frame * 7.1) * 10 * (1 - (frame - c2) / 6) : 0;
  const end = b(fe.at[1]);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ ...whipIn(frame, 0), ...whipOut(frame, end), translate: `${shake}px ${-shake / 2}px` }}>
      <Plate name={fe.plate} blur={24} dim={0.55} zoom={1.2} />
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ filter: GRADE }}>
        <Stage3D camera={FEEL_CAM.pos} target={FEEL_CAM.target} fov={FEEL_CAM.fov} rim="#ffe9c9" envIntensity={0.8}>
          <group position={PIVOT} rotation={[0, 0, angle]}>
            <Racket finish="red" position={[0, REACH, 0]} rotation={[0, -0.35 * angle, 0]} glow={glow} />
          </group>
          {showBall && (
            <mesh position={ball}>
              <sphereGeometry args={[0.147, 32, 32]} />
              <meshStandardMaterial color="#D9EE3F" roughness={0.9} emissive="#D9EE3F" emissiveIntensity={0.15} />
            </mesh>
          )}
        </Stage3D>
      </AbsoluteFill>
      <svg width={1920} height={1080} style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, mixBlendMode: 'screen', filter: 'blur(6px)', opacity: Math.min(1, speed * 6) }}>
        {trail.slice(1).map(([x, y], k) => (
          <line key={k} x1={trail[k][0]} y1={trail[k][1]} x2={x} y2={y} stroke={colors.accent} strokeWidth={60 - k * 7} strokeLinecap="round" opacity={0.5 - k * 0.07} />
        ))}
      </svg>
      {ring >= 0 && (
        <svg width={1920} height={1080} style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0 }}>
          <circle cx={hx} cy={hy} r={18 + ring * 6} fill="none" stroke={colors.accent} strokeWidth={4} opacity={Math.max(0, 1 - ring / 14)} />
          <circle cx={hx} cy={hy} r={11} fill={colors.accent} opacity={Math.abs(angle) < 0.35 ? 1 : 0} style={{ filter: `drop-shadow(0 0 12px ${colors.accent})` }} />
        </svg>
      )}
      {ring >= 0 && Math.abs(angle) < 0.35 && (
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: hx + 34, top: hy - 18, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 26, letterSpacing: 3, color: colors.accent, background: 'rgba(11,12,9,0.6)', padding: '4px 12px', borderRadius: 6 }}>{fe.label}</div>
      )}
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 110, bottom: 110 }}>
        <Big size={130} style={{ ...l1, transformOrigin: 'left center', textShadow: SHADOW }}>{fe.lines[0]}</Big>
        {frame >= b(fe.contacts[0]) && <Big size={150} color={colors.accent} style={{ ...l2, transformOrigin: 'left center', textShadow: SHADOW }}>{fe.lines[1]}</Big>}
      </div>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 110, top: 100, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 26, letterSpacing: 3, color: colors.accent }}>◆ CGI</div>
      <Flash at={c1} len={6} peak={0.4} />
      <Flash at={c2} len={6} peak={0.4} />
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---------- 4. The app on the phone ----------
const Phone: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const p = E.phone;
  const b = (beat: number) => f(beat - p.at[0]);
  const l1 = useSlam(0);
  const l2 = useSlam(b(22));
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      {p.shots.map((s) => (
        <Sequence key={s.clip} from={b(s.at[0])} durationInFrames={b(s.at[1]) - b(s.at[0])}>
          <Clip name={s.clip} len={b(s.at[1]) - b(s.at[0])} zoom={[1.0, 1.12]} origin="65% 50%" />
        </Sequence>
      ))}
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.6), transparent 55%)' }} />
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 110, top: 100, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 14, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 26, letterSpacing: 3, color: colors.accent }}>
        <div style={{ width: 14, height: 14, borderRadius: 7, background: colors.accent, boxShadow: `0 0 ${10 + 10 * pulse(frame)}px ${colors.accent}` }} />
        SYNCED TO THE APP
      </div>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 110, bottom: 110 }}>
        <Big size={120} style={{ ...l1, transformOrigin: 'left center', textShadow: SHADOW }}>{p.lines[0]}</Big>
        {frame >= b(22) && <Big size={120} color={colors.accent} style={{ ...l2, transformOrigin: 'left center', textShadow: SHADOW }}>{p.lines[1]}</Big>}
      </div>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---------- 5. Serve against the sky, then four hits, one word each ----------
const Train: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const t = E.train;
  const b = (beat: number) => f(beat - t.at[0]);
  const hit = Math.floor((frame - b(30)) / BEAT);
  const word = Math.min(2, hit);
  const slam = useSlam(b(30 + word));
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <Sequence durationInFrames={b(30)}>
        <WordShot clip={t.sky} len={b(30)} word={t.line} size={170} zoom={[1.0, 1.1]} at={4} />
      </Sequence>
      {t.hits.map((clip, i) => (
        <Sequence key={clip} from={b(30 + i)} durationInFrames={b(31 + i) - b(30 + i)}>
          <Clip name={clip} len={b(31 + i) - b(30 + i)} zoom={[1.28, 1.06]} />
          <Flash at={0} len={5} peak={0.3} />
        </Sequence>
      ))}
      {frame >= b(30) && (
        <>
          <Shade amount={0.4} />
          <Center><Big key={word} size={240} color={word === 2 ? colors.accent : colors.text} style={{ ...slam, textShadow: SHADOW }}>{t.words[word]}</Big></Center>
        </>
      )}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---------- 6. Finale ----------
const Finale: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const fin = E.finale;
  const cut = f(fin.cut - fin.at[0]);
  const blurIn = interpolate(frame, [cut - 5, cut], [0, 8], clamp);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      {frame < cut ? (
        <AbsoluteFill style={{ filter: blurIn ? `blur(${blurIn}px)` : undefined }}>
          <Clip name={fin.clip} len={cut} zoom={[1, 1.25]} origin="45% 60%" ease={Easing.in(Easing.quad)} />
        </AbsoluteFill>
      ) : (
        <Sequence from={cut} layout="none">
          <RacketFinale beat={BEAT} finish="red" name={fin.name} tagline={fin.tagline} cta={fin.cta} room={fin.clip} glow={(k) => 0.4 + 0.6 * pulse(k + cut)} />
        </Sequence>
      )}
      <Flash at={cut - 1} len={6} peak={0.5} />
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

const duck = makeDuck(everySwingCues, f);

export const EverySwing: React.FC = () => {
  const s = E.song;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: colors.bg, color: colors.text, fontFamily: fonts.sans, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      <Shot at={E.hook.at}><Hook /></Shot>
      {E.montage.shots.map((_, i) => (
        <Shot key={i} at={[E.montage.at[0] + i, E.montage.at[0] + i + 1]}><MontageShot i={i} /></Shot>
      ))}
      <Shot at={E.feel.at}><Feel /></Shot>
      <Shot at={E.phone.at}><Phone /></Shot>
      <Shot at={E.train.at}><Train /></Shot>
      <Shot at={E.finale.at}><Finale /></Shot>
      <Vignette />
      <Grain />
      <Audio src={staticFile(s.src)} volume={(fr) => s.volume * duck(fr) * interpolate(fr, [everySwingFrames - 24, everySwingFrames], [1, 0], clamp)} />
      {everySwingCues.map((c, i) => <Effect key={i} cue={{ ...c, at: 0 }} frame={f(c.beat)} />)}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "video/src/hype/Hype.tsx", "sha256": "7b5da2f99edafeb23c2f770bb58dbcb31366c591b73f93e290efd29e4335df6f", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````tsx
// 30-second X hype clip cut to "Keep It Movin'". Everything is timed in beats;
// copy, numbers and beat positions come from src/config/hype.ts.
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, Audio, Sequence, interpolate, spring, staticFile, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig } from 'remotion';
import { Effect } from '../components/Timeline';
import { Racket } from '../components/Racket';
import { Stage3D } from '../components/Stage3D';
import { colors, fonts } from '../config/brand';
import { hype, hypeCues } from '../config/hype';
import { Glasses, Watch } from '../scenes/Devices';

const FPS = 30;
export const BEAT = (FPS * 60) / hype.song.bpm; // frames per beat (~18.95)
export const f = (beat: number) => Math.round(beat * BEAT);
export const hypeFrames = f(hype.beats);

type V3 = [number, number, number];

/** A shot spanning [from, to) beats; children see a local frame starting at 0. */
const Shot: React.FC<{ at: number[] | readonly number[]; children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ at, children }) => (
  <Sequence from={f(at[0])} durationInFrames={f(at[1]) - f(at[0])}>{children}</Sequence>
);

/** 1 on each beat, decaying fast: drives pulses and flashes. */
export const pulse = (frame: number, every = 1) => Math.exp(-((frame % (BEAT * every)) / BEAT) * 6);

/** Slam-in: overshooting scale + quick fade, starting at local frame `start`. */
export const useSlam = (start: number) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const s = spring({ frame: frame - start, fps: FPS, config: { damping: 11, stiffness: 220 } });
  const shake = frame >= start && frame < start + 5 ? Math.sin(frame * 9.1) * 6 : 0;
  return { opacity: frame < start ? 0 : Math.min(1, (frame - start) / 3), transform: `translate(${shake}px, ${-shake / 2}px) scale(${1.5 - 0.5 * s})` };
};

export const Big: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode; size?: number; color?: string; style?: React.CSSProperties }> = ({ children, size = 170, color = colors.text, style }) => (
  <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: size, lineHeight: 0.95, letterSpacing: -3, color, textTransform: 'uppercase', ...style }}>{children}</div>
);
export const Small: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode; style?: React.CSSProperties }> = ({ children, style }) => (
  <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.sans, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 40, color: colors.muted, letterSpacing: 1, ...style }}>{children}</div>
);
export const Center: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode; style?: React.CSSProperties }> = ({ children, style }) => (
  <AbsoluteFill style={{ justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center', ...style }}>{children}</AbsoluteFill>
);

// ---------- 1. Ball bouncing on the beat, words slam in ----------
export const Ball: React.FC<{ spin: number }> = ({ spin }) => (
  <svg width={110} height={110} viewBox="-55 -55 110 110" style={{ transform: `rotate(${spin}deg)` }}>
    <circle r={52} fill="#D9EE3F" />
    <path d="M -38 -36 C -10 -12, -10 12, -38 36" stroke="#F4F7E6" strokeWidth={6} fill="none" />
    <path d="M 38 -36 C 10 -12, 10 12, 38 36" stroke="#F4F7E6" strokeWidth={6} fill="none" />
  </svg>
);
const Intro: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const phase = (frame % BEAT) / BEAT;
  const h = Math.sin(Math.PI * phase); // 0 on every beat = ball hits the ground
  const beat = Math.floor(frame / BEAT);
  const word = beat >= 2 ? hype.intro.words[Math.min(hype.intro.words.length - 1, Math.floor(beat / 2) - 1)] : null;
  const wordStart = f(Math.floor(beat / 2) * 2);
  const slam = useSlam(wordStart);
  const x = interpolate(frame, [0, f(8)], [-600, 600]);
  const squash = 1 - 0.25 * pulse(frame);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 960 + x - 55, top: 860 - 230 * h - 110, transform: `scale(${1 / squash}, ${squash})`, transformOrigin: 'bottom' }}>
        <Ball spin={frame * 6} />
      </div>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 960 + x - 60 * (1 - h * 0.6), top: 862, width: 120 * (1 - h * 0.6), height: 16, borderRadius: '50%', background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)', boxShadow: `0 0 ${30 * pulse(frame)}px ${colors.accent}` }} />
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 0, right: 0, top: 862, height: 2, background: colors.track }} />
      {word && <Center style={{ paddingBottom: 420 }}><Big key={word} size={190} style={slam}>{word}</Big></Center>}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---------- 2. Racket: four angles, hard cut every 2 beats ----------
const ANGLES: { cam: V3; target: V3; fov: number; rot: V3; drift: V3 }[] = [
  { cam: [0.75, 1.55, 1.15], target: [0.15, 1.25, 0], fov: 22, rot: [0.1, 1.3, -0.16], drift: [0, -0.2, 0] }, // macro along the hoop
  { cam: [0.45, -1.05, 0.55], target: [0, -1.4, -0.36], fov: 30, rot: [0.25, 0.6, 0], drift: [-0.25, 0, 0] }, // lime ring on the butt cap
  { cam: [0.5, -0.2, 2.2], target: [0, -0.2, 0], fov: 30, rot: [0.1, 0.5, 0], drift: [0, 0.15, 0] }, // throat
  { cam: [0, 0.1, 6.1], target: [0, 0.05, 0], fov: 32, rot: [0.1, 0.35, -0.12], drift: [0, 0, -0.4] }, // hero
];
const RacketCuts: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const i = Math.min(ANGLES.length - 1, Math.floor(frame / f(2)));
  const a = ANGLES[i];
  const t = (frame - f(i * 2)) / f(2);
  const cam: V3 = [a.cam[0] + a.drift[0] * t, a.cam[1] + a.drift[1] * t, a.cam[2] + a.drift[2] * t];
  const slam = useSlam(f(6));
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <Stage3D camera={cam} target={a.target} fov={a.fov} env="studio" envIntensity={1.4} hero>
        <pointLight position={[0.4, 2.2, -1.8]} intensity={40} distance={8} color="#ffffff" />
        <Racket rotation={[a.rot[0], a.rot[1] + (i === 3 ? t * 0.5 : t * 0.12), a.rot[2]]} glow={0.6 + 0.4 * pulse(frame)} />
      </Stage3D>
      <Center style={{ justifyContent: 'flex-end', paddingBottom: 90 }}>
        <Big size={120} style={slam}>{hype.racket.line}</Big>
      </Center>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---------- 3. Stats: one slam per 2 beats ----------
const Stat: React.FC<{ item: (typeof hype.stats.items)[number] }> = ({ item }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const slam = useSlam(0);
  const count = 'value' in item ? Math.round((item.value ?? 0) * Math.min(1, frame / (BEAT * 0.6))) : 0;
  const spike = Array.from({ length: 120 }, (_, k) => {
    const x = k / 119, after = x - 0.5;
    const y = after >= 0 ? Math.exp(-after * 18) * Math.cos(after * 140) : 0;
    return `${k ? 'L' : 'M'}${x * 1920},${540 - y * 260 * pulse(frame, 2)}`;
  }).join(' ');
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <svg width={1920} height={1080} style={{ position: 'absolute', opacity: 0.35 }}>
        <path d={spike} stroke={colors.accent} strokeWidth={4} fill="none" />
      </svg>
      <Center>
        <div style={slam}>
          {'value' in item ? (
            <Big size={330} color={colors.accent}>{count}<span style={{ fontSize: 110, color: colors.text, marginLeft: 20 }}>{item.unit}</span></Big>
          ) : (
            <Big size={210} color={colors.accent}>{item.text}</Big>
          )}
          <Small style={{ fontSize: 52, marginTop: 14 }}>{item.label}</Small>
        </div>
      </Center>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---------- 4. Features: 2 beats each ----------
const MiniScore: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const pts = frame < f(1) ? '30' : '40';
  return (
    <div style={{ width: 560, borderRadius: 18, overflow: 'hidden', background: `${colors.score}cc`, fontFamily: fonts.sans, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 48 }}>
      {[['YOU', 3, pts], ['OPP', 2, '15']].map(([n, g, p]) => (
        <div key={n} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', height: 96, borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25)' }}>
          <div style={{ flex: 1, paddingLeft: 30 }}>{n}</div>
          <div style={{ width: 90, color: colors.accent, textAlign: 'center' }}>{g}</div>
          <div style={{ width: 130, height: '100%', background: '#f3f5ec', color: '#7a3d2c', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>{p}</div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};
const Friends: React.FC = () => (
  <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 24 }}>
    {[['YOU', 74, true], ['SAM', 70, false]].map(([n, v, win]) => (
      <div key={String(n)} style={{ width: 250, padding: 26, borderRadius: 22, background: colors.card, border: `2px solid ${win ? colors.accent : colors.track}`, fontFamily: fonts.sans }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 30, color: colors.muted }}>{n}</div>
        <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 96, fontWeight: 800, color: win ? colors.accent : colors.text }}>{v}</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 24, color: colors.muted }}>top mph</div>
      </div>
    ))}
  </div>
);
const Feature: React.FC<{ item: (typeof hype.features.items)[number] }> = ({ item }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const slam = useSlam(0);
  const rise = spring({ frame: frame - 3, fps: FPS, config: { damping: 14 } });
  const visual = { score: <MiniScore />, watch: <Watch />, glasses: <Glasses />, friends: <Friends /> }[item.visual];
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', padding: '0 120px', gap: 60 }}>
      <div style={{ flex: 1, ...slam, transformOrigin: 'left center' }}>
        <Big size={150}>{item.title}</Big>
        <Small style={{ marginTop: 18 }}>{item.sub}</Small>
      </div>
      <div style={{ opacity: rise, transform: `translateY(${(1 - rise) * 80}px) scale(${item.visual === 'glasses' ? 1.32 : 1.25})` }}>{visual}</div>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---------- 5. Muse Spark what-if ----------
const WhatIf: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const w = hype.whatIf;
  const answer = useSlam(f(4));
  const by = interpolate(frame, [f(5), f(5) + 8], [0, 1], { extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp' });
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      {frame < f(4) ? (
        <Center style={{ flexDirection: 'column' }}>
          {w.question.map((q, i) => (frame >= f(i) ? <Big key={q} size={160} color={i === 2 ? colors.accent : colors.text}>{q}</Big> : null))}
        </Center>
      ) : (
        <Center style={{ flexDirection: 'column', gap: 30 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', gap: 50, ...answer }}>
            <Big size={200} color={colors.muted} style={{ textDecoration: 'line-through', textDecorationThickness: 12 }}>{w.before}</Big>
            <Big size={140} color={colors.muted}>→</Big>
            <Big size={330} color={colors.accent}>{w.after}</Big>
            <Big size={110}>{w.unit}</Big>
          </div>
          <Small style={{ opacity: by, fontSize: 46 }}><span style={{ color: colors.accent }}>✦ </span>{w.by}</Small>
        </Center>
      )}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---------- 6. Finale ----------
const Finale: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const fin = hype.finale;
  const name = useSlam(0);
  const appear = (b: number) => ({ opacity: interpolate(frame, [f(b), f(b) + 6], [0, 1], { extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp' }) });
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <Stage3D camera={[0, 0.1, 6.1]} target={[0, 0.05, 0]} fov={32} env="studio" envIntensity={1.4} hero>
        <pointLight position={[-0.6, 2.2, -1.8]} intensity={40} distance={8} color="#ffffff" />
        <Racket position={[-1.25, 0, 0]} rotation={[0.1, 0.3 + frame * 0.006, -0.16]} glow={0.5 + 0.5 * pulse(frame)} />
      </Stage3D>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ justifyContent: 'center', paddingLeft: 900, gap: 18 }}>
        <Big size={150} style={{ ...name, transformOrigin: 'left center' }}>{fin.name}</Big>
        <div style={{ ...appear(2), fontFamily: fonts.sans, fontSize: 52, color: colors.text }}>{fin.line}</div>
        <Small style={{ ...appear(4), color: colors.muted }}><span style={{ color: colors.accent }}>✦ </span>{fin.by}</Small>
        <div style={{ ...appear(6), alignSelf: 'flex-start', marginTop: 20, padding: '14px 30px', borderRadius: 40, background: colors.accent, color: '#11130c', fontFamily: fonts.sans, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 38 }}>{fin.cta}</div>
      </AbsoluteFill>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---------- finish: grain, downbeat flash, music ----------
export const Grain: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  return (
    <svg width={1920} height={1080} style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, opacity: 0.09, mixBlendMode: 'overlay', pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
      <filter id="grain"><feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency={0.9} numOctaves={2} seed={frame % 12} /></filter>
      <rect width="100%" height="100%" filter="url(#grain)" />
    </svg>
  );
};
const SECTION_STARTS = [hype.racket.at[0], hype.stats.at[0], hype.features.at[0], hype.whatIf.at[0], hype.finale.at[0]];
const Flash: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const strong = SECTION_STARTS.some((b) => frame >= f(b) && frame < f(b) + 8) ? 0.3 : 0;
  const o = Math.max(strong * pulse(frame, 4), 0.06 * pulse(frame, 4));
  return <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: colors.accent, opacity: o, mixBlendMode: 'screen', pointerEvents: 'none' }} />;
};

export const Hype: React.FC = () => {
  const { durationInFrames } = useVideoConfig();
  const s = hype.song;
  const songStart = s.firstDownbeat + ((s.startBar - 1) * 4 * 60) / s.bpm;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: colors.bg, color: colors.text, fontFamily: fonts.sans, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: `radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 60% at 50% 50%, rgba(221,232,91,0.10), rgba(11,12,9,0) 65%)` }} />
      <Shot at={hype.intro.at}><Intro /></Shot>
      <Shot at={hype.racket.at}><RacketCuts /></Shot>
      {hype.stats.items.map((item, i) => (
        <Shot key={i} at={[hype.stats.at[0] + i * 2, hype.stats.at[0] + i * 2 + 2]}><Stat item={item} /></Shot>
      ))}
      {hype.features.items.map((item, i) => (
        <Shot key={i} at={[hype.features.at[0] + i * 2, hype.features.at[0] + i * 2 + 2]}><Feature item={item} /></Shot>
      ))}
      <Shot at={hype.whatIf.at}><WhatIf /></Shot>
      <Shot at={hype.finale.at}><Finale /></Shot>
      <Flash />
      <Grain />
      <Audio
        src={staticFile(s.src)}
        trimBefore={Math.round(songStart * FPS)}
        volume={(fr) => s.volume * interpolate(fr, [durationInFrames - 45, durationInFrames], [1, 0], { extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp' })}
      />
      {hypeCues.map((c, i) => <Effect key={i} cue={{ ...c, at: 0 }} frame={f(c.beat)} />)}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};
````````
