````````tsx
// Possessed (~27 s X clip, Halloween): "this racket is possessed... by an AI", on "Whoop".
// Timed in beats; copy, clips and beats come from src/config/possessed.ts. Everything gets a
// colder, darker grade than the other cuts; the brand lime does the haunting (glow, reticles,
// the X-ray). Glitch cuts slice the frame into displaced bands for a few frames.
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, Audio, Easing, Sequence, interpolate, random, staticFile, useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';
import { Effect } from '../components/Timeline';
import { colors, fonts } from '../config/brand';
import { possessed as P, possessedCues } from '../config/possessed';
import { Big, Center, Grain, useSlam } from './Hype';
import { Clip, Flash, Plate, SHADOW, Shade, Vignette, beatClock, clamp, makeDuck } from './kit';
import { HandleCGI, PushToBlack, RacketFinale, Tags } from './pieces';

const { BEAT, f, pulse, Shot } = beatClock(P.song.bpm); // ~17.09 frames per beat
export const possessedFrames = f(P.beats);

// Cold and dark: crushed, desaturated, pushed toward teal.
const HAUNT = 'contrast(1.3) saturate(0.4) brightness(0.72) hue-rotate(-14deg)';

/** Glitch: for `len` frames from `at`, the frame splits into bands that jump sideways. */
const Glitch: React.FC<{ at: number; len?: number; children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ at, len = 6, children }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const on = frame >= at && frame < at + len;
  if (!on) return <>{children}</>;
  const k = 1 - (frame - at) / len;
  const bands = Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, i) => {
    const y = random(`y${frame}-${i}`) * 1000;
    const h = 20 + random(`h${frame}-${i}`) * 120;
    const dx = (random(`x${frame}-${i}`) - 0.5) * 240 * k;
    return { y, h, dx };
  });
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ transform: `translateX(${(random(`s${frame}`) - 0.5) * 30 * k}px)` }}>{children}</AbsoluteFill>
      {bands.map((b, i) => (
        <AbsoluteFill key={i} style={{ clipPath: `inset(${b.y}px 0 ${Math.max(0, 1080 - b.y - b.h)}px 0)`, transform: `translateX(${b.dx}px)`, filter: i % 2 ? 'hue-rotate(90deg) saturate(2)' : undefined }}>{children}</AbsoluteFill>
      ))}
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: colors.accent, opacity: 0.12 * k, mixBlendMode: 'screen' }} />
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

/** Found-footage overlay: REC, a running clock, scanlines, a green night-vision cast. */
const FoundFootage: React.FC<{ label: string; offset?: number }> = ({ label, offset = 0 }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame() + offset;
  const s = 57 + Math.floor(frame / 30);
  const clock = `23:59:${String(Math.min(59, s)).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: '#5f8f4a', mixBlendMode: 'color', opacity: 0.45 }} />
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: 'repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.18) 0 2px, transparent 2px 4px)' }} />
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 110, top: 96, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 16, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 30, color: colors.text }}>
        <div style={{ width: 18, height: 18, borderRadius: 9, background: '#ff3b30', opacity: frame % 20 < 12 ? 1 : 0.15 }} />
        REC
      </div>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 110, top: 96, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 30, color: colors.text }}>{label}</div>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 110, bottom: 96, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 30, color: colors.text }}>{clock}</div>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

/** A line slammed in at local frame `at`, a little shaky, glowing lime when `accent`. */
const Line: React.FC<{ at: number; text: string; accent?: boolean; size?: number }> = ({ at, text, accent, size = 180 }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const slam = useSlam(at);
  if (frame < at) return null;
  const jitter = Math.sin(frame * 3.1) * 1.5;
  return <Big size={size} color={accent ? colors.accent : colors.text} style={{ ...slam, translate: `${jitter}px 0`, textShadow: accent ? `0 0 40px ${colors.accent}, ${SHADOW}` : SHADOW }}>{text}</Big>;
};

// ---------- 1. Intro ----------
const Intro: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const i = P.intro;
  // a failing light: mostly steady, the odd dip
  const flicker = random(`fl${Math.floor(frame / 2)}`) < 0.12 ? 0.45 : 0.9 + 0.1 * Math.sin(frame * 0.9);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ filter: `brightness(${flicker})` }}>
        {i.shots.map((s) => (
          <Sequence key={s.clip} from={f(s.at[0])} durationInFrames={f(s.at[1]) - f(s.at[0])}>
            <Clip name={s.clip} len={f(4)} zoom={[1.1, 1.22]} grade={HAUNT} />
          </Sequence>
        ))}
      </AbsoluteFill>
      <FoundFootage label={i.rec} />
      <Shade amount={0.45} />
      <Center style={{ flexDirection: 'column' }}>
        {i.lines.map((l, k) => <Line key={k} at={f(l.at)} text={l.text} accent={k === 1} size={150} />)}
      </Center>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---------- 2. Drop ----------
const Drop: React.FC = () => (
  <AbsoluteFill>
    <Glitch at={0} len={8}>
      <Clip name={P.drop.clip} len={f(2)} zoom={[1.3, 1.1]} grade={HAUNT} />
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: `radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 60% at 75% 55%, rgba(221,232,91,0.25), transparent 70%)`, mixBlendMode: 'screen' }} />
    </Glitch>
    <Shade amount={0.4} />
    <Center><Line at={0} text={P.drop.text} accent size={240} /></Center>
    <Flash at={0} len={8} peak={0.6} />
  </AbsoluteFill>
);

// ---------- 3. Watch: a lock-on reticle per swing ----------
const Reticle: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const lock = interpolate(frame, [0, 8], [1.8, 1], { ...clamp, easing: Easing.out(Easing.back(2)) });
  return (
    <svg width={1920} height={1080} style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0 }}>
      <g transform={`translate(960 540) scale(${lock}) rotate(${frame * 2})`} stroke={colors.accent} strokeWidth={3} fill="none" style={{ filter: `drop-shadow(0 0 8px ${colors.accent})` }}>
        <circle r={150} strokeDasharray="40 22" />
        <circle r={6} fill={colors.accent} />
        {[0, 90, 180, 270].map((a) => <line key={a} x1={170} x2={230} transform={`rotate(${a})`} />)}
      </g>
      <text x={960 + 190} y={540 - 160} fill={colors.accent} style={{ font: `26px ${fonts.mono}`, letterSpacing: 3 }}>{frame % 10 < 6 ? 'TRACKING' : ''}</text>
    </svg>
  );
};
const Watch: React.FC = () => (
  <>
    {P.watch.shots.map((s, i) => (
      <Sequence key={s.clip} from={f(i * 2)} durationInFrames={f(i * 2 + 2) - f(i * 2)}>
        <Glitch at={0} len={4}>
          <Clip name={s.clip} len={f(2)} zoom={[1.2, 1.04]} grade={HAUNT} />
        </Glitch>
        <Shade amount={0.35} />
        <Reticle />
        <Center style={{ alignItems: 'flex-end', justifyContent: 'flex-end', padding: '0 110px 100px' }}>
          <Line at={0} text={s.word} accent={i === 2} size={170} />
        </Center>
      </Sequence>
    ))}
  </>
);

// ---------- 4. Inside: push into the grip, X-ray into the CAD handle ----------
const Inside: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const n = P.inside;
  const b = (beat: number) => f(beat - n.at[0]);
  const cut = b(n.cut), end = b(n.at[1]);
  const k = frame - cut;
  const explode = interpolate(k, [0, f(2)], [0.1, 1], { ...clamp, easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic) });
  const move = interpolate(k, [0, end - cut], [0, 1], { ...clamp, easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic) });
  const heart = pulse(frame, 2) * 0.8 + 0.2; // a slow heartbeat, every other beat
  const up = interpolate(k, [0, 7], [1, 0], clamp);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      {frame < cut ? (
        <PushToBlack clip={n.clip} len={cut} origin={n.origin} zoom={3.2} grade={HAUNT} />
      ) : (
        <AbsoluteFill>
          <Plate name={n.plate} blur={28} dim={0.7} zoom={1.5} grade={HAUNT} />
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: 'repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(221,232,91,0.05) 0 2px, transparent 2px 6px)' }} />
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ filter: 'contrast(1.1) saturate(0.7)' }}>
            <HandleCGI explode={explode} move={move} glow={heart} rim={colors.accent} xray />
          </AbsoluteFill>
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 110, top: 100, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 26, letterSpacing: 3, color: colors.accent }}>◆ X-RAY · CAD</div>
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 110, bottom: 100 }}>
            <Line at={cut} text={n.lines[0]} size={130} />
            <Line at={cut + f(2)} text={n.lines[1]} accent size={130} />
          </div>
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 110, bottom: 110 }}>
            <Tags tags={n.tags} at={cut + f(2.5)} every={f(0.5)} />
          </div>
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: '#050504', opacity: up }} />
        </AbsoluteFill>
      )}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---------- 5. Trained by a robot ----------
const Trained: React.FC = () => {
  const t = P.trained;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      {t.clips.map((clip, i) => (
        <Sequence key={clip} from={f(i * 2)} durationInFrames={f(i * 2 + 2) - f(i * 2)}>
          <Glitch at={0} len={4}>
            <Clip name={clip} len={f(2)} zoom={[1.18, 1.04]} grade={HAUNT} />
          </Glitch>
        </Sequence>
      ))}
      <Shade amount={0.45} />
      <Center style={{ flexDirection: 'column' }}>
        {t.lines.map((l, k) => <Line key={k} at={f(l.at - t.at[0])} text={l.text} accent={k === 1} size={170} />)}
      </Center>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---------- 6. Wants your game ----------
const Wants: React.FC = () => {
  const w = P.wants;
  return (
    <>
      {w.shots.map((s, i) => (
        <Sequence key={s.clip} from={f(s.at[0] - w.at[0])} durationInFrames={f(s.at[1]) - f(s.at[0])}>
          <Glitch at={0} len={i ? 5 : 0}>
            <Clip name={s.clip} len={f(4)} zoom={[1.0, 1.14]} grade={HAUNT} />
          </Glitch>
          <Shade amount={0.35} />
          <Center><Line at={2} text={s.word} accent={i === 1} size={200} /></Center>
        </Sequence>
      ))}
    </>
  );
};

// ---------- 7. Finale ----------
const Finale: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const fin = P.finale;
  const cut = f(fin.cut - fin.at[0]);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      {frame < cut ? (
        <AbsoluteFill>
          <Clip name={fin.clip} len={cut} zoom={[1.05, 1.2]} grade={HAUNT} />
          <FoundFootage label="CAM 02  ·  COURT 4" offset={f(40)} />
        </AbsoluteFill>
      ) : (
        <Sequence from={cut} layout="none">

const duck = makeDuck(possessedCues, f);

export const Possessed: React.FC = () => {

      <Shot at={P.drop.at}><Drop /></Shot>
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "video/src/hype/RobotHype.tsx", "sha256": "21f9623c90949d69db44a0594d0a53c6e3d4e0492d60cc8d16ae75f87f4929cf", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````tsx
// ~27 s X clip: the 2026-10-29 robot-arm session (real footage) cut against CGI from the
// CAD, on "Ten". Timed in beats; copy, clips and beats come from src/config/robotHype.ts.
//
// Real -> CGI hand-offs are built to read as one shot:
//   - every clip gets the same grade, and grain + vignette sit over real and CGI alike
//   - CGI is drawn over the real room (the clip itself, or a still of it, blurred) rather than black
//   - each cut happens on matching framing and motion: the handle push, the arm, the racket throat
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, Audio, Easing, Sequence, interpolate, spring, staticFile, useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';
import { Effect } from '../components/Timeline';
import { Racket } from '../components/Racket';
import { Stage3D } from '../components/Stage3D';
import { colors, fonts } from '../config/brand';
import { gyroTrace } from '../config/gyro-trace';
import { robotHype as R, robotHypeCues } from '../config/robotHype';
import { useCad } from '../lib/models';
import { Part } from '../scenes/InsideHandle';
import { RobotArm } from '../scenes/RobotLab';
import { Big, Center, Grain, Small, useSlam } from './Hype';
import { Brackets, Clip, FPS, Flash, GRADE, Plate, SHADOW, Shade, Vignette, beatClock, clamp, inOut, makeDuck, mix, type V3, whipIn, whipOut } from './kit';

const { f, pulse, Shot } = beatClock(R.song.bpm); // ~14.28 frames per beat
export const robotHypeFrames = f(R.beats);

// Swing range of the CGI arm about J1 (radians), as in RobotLab.
const BACK = -0.6, THROUGH = 0.6;

// ---------- 1. Hook: real cuts, one phrase per two beats ----------
const HookShot: React.FC<{ shot: (typeof R.hook.shots)[number] }> = ({ shot }) => {
  const slam = useSlam(0);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <Clip name={shot.clip} len={f(2)} zoom={[1.14, 1]} />
      <Shade />
      <Center>
        <Big size={shot.word.length > 10 ? 175 : 210} color={'accent' in shot ? colors.accent : colors.text} style={{ ...slam, textShadow: SHADOW }}>{shot.word}</Big>
      </Center>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---------- 2. Twin: real arm, whip-pan cut to its CGI twin, which swings on the drop ----------
// The racket CAD lies along scene Z (handle -1.5 .. tip +1.5) at x ~ -2.4. From the -X side
// the handle is screen-left and the head screen-right with the arm behind, as in the real shot.
const TWIN_CAM = { from: [-5.6, 1.9, 0.4] as V3, to: [-4.9, 1.6, -0.2] as V3, target: [-2.0, 1.25, -0.2] as V3, fov: 40 };
const Twin: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const t = R.twin;
  const b = (beat: number) => f(beat - t.at[0]);
  const cut = b(t.whip), contact = b(t.contact), end = b(t.at[1]);
  const scan = interpolate(frame, [b(t.scan[0]), b(t.scan[1])], [0, 1], { ...clamp, easing: inOut });
  // Wind back after the cut, then whip through contact on the drop.
  const angle = frame < contact - 6
    ? interpolate(frame, [cut, contact - 6], [0, BACK], { ...clamp, easing: inOut })
    : BACK + (THROUGH - BACK) * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.tanh((frame - contact + 1) / 2.2) / Math.tanh(3));
  const push = interpolate(frame, [contact - 2, contact + 10], [0, 1], { ...clamp, easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic) });
  const cam = mix(mix(TWIN_CAM.from, TWIN_CAM.to, interpolate(frame, [cut, end], [0, 1], clamp)), TWIN_CAM.target, push * 0.18);
  const shake = frame >= contact && frame < contact + 8 ? Math.sin(frame * 7.3) * 14 * (1 - (frame - contact) / 8) : 0;
  const name = useSlam(b(t.scan[1]) - 3);
  const tagIn = (i: number) => interpolate(frame, [b(t.scan[1]) + i * 4, b(t.scan[1]) + 6 + i * 4], [0, 1], clamp);
  const corner: React.CSSProperties = { position: 'absolute', left: 110, top: 100, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 26, letterSpacing: 3, color: colors.accent };
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ transform: `translate(${shake}px, ${-shake / 2}px)` }}>
      {frame < cut ? (
        <AbsoluteFill style={whipOut(frame, cut)}>
          <Clip name={t.clip} len={cut} zoom={[1, 1.1]} origin="60% 45%" />
          <div style={{ ...corner, color: colors.text }}>{t.real}</div>
        </AbsoluteFill>
      ) : (
        <AbsoluteFill style={{ ...whipIn(frame, cut), ...whipOut(frame, end) }}>
          {/* the real room keeps moving behind the CGI: the same clip, blurred */}
          <Clip name={t.clip} len={end} zoom={[1, 1.2]} origin="60% 45%" blur={20} />
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: 'rgba(11,12,9,0.5)' }} />
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ filter: `${GRADE} blur(0.5px)` }}>
            <Stage3D camera={cam} target={TWIN_CAM.target} fov={TWIN_CAM.fov} rim="#ffe9c9" envIntensity={0.75}>
              <RobotArm angle={angle} grid={false} racket="blue" racketGlow={Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(frame - contact) / 6)} />
            </Stage3D>
          </AbsoluteFill>
          {/* scan pass: lines left behind it, a lime edge on it */}
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ clipPath: `inset(0 ${(1 - scan) * 100}% 0 0)`, background: 'repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(221,232,91,0.07) 0 2px, transparent 2px 5px)', mixBlendMode: 'screen' }} />
          {scan > 0 && scan < 1 && (
            <>
              <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, bottom: 0, left: scan * 1920 - 240, width: 240, background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(221,232,91,0.2))' }} />
              <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, bottom: 0, left: scan * 1920 - 2, width: 4, background: colors.accent, boxShadow: `0 0 30px 8px ${colors.accent}` }} />
            </>
          )}
          <div style={corner}>{t.cgiLabel}</div>
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ justifyContent: 'flex-end', alignItems: 'flex-end', padding: '0 110px 90px 0', gap: 18 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 14 }}>
              {t.tags.map((tag, i) => (
                <div key={tag} style={{ opacity: tagIn(i), transform: `translateY(${(1 - tagIn(i)) * 20}px)`, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 26, letterSpacing: 2, color: colors.accent, border: `1.5px solid ${colors.accent}`, borderRadius: 30, padding: '8px 18px', background: 'rgba(11,12,9,0.5)' }}>{tag}</div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {frame >= b(t.scan[1]) - 3 && <Big size={130} color={colors.accent} style={{ ...name, transformOrigin: 'right center', textShadow: SHADOW }}>{t.cgi}</Big>}
          </AbsoluteFill>
        </AbsoluteFill>
      )}
      <Flash at={contact} len={8} peak={0.55} />
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---------- 3. What the racket measures: one real cut per beat, viewfinder HUD ----------
const Measure: React.FC<{ shot: (typeof R.measures.shots)[number]; i: number; len: number }> = ({ shot, i, len }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const slam = useSlam(0);
  const last = i === R.measures.shots.length - 1;
  const n = R.measures.shots.length - 1;
  const t = (f(R.measures.at[0]) + f(i) + frame) / FPS;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={i === 0 ? whipIn(frame, 0) : undefined}>
      <Clip name={shot.clip} len={len} zoom={last ? [1.2, 1] : [1.16, 1.02]} ease={Easing.out(Easing.cubic)} />
      {last ? (
        <>
          <Shade amount={0.45} />
          <Center><Big size={250} color={colors.accent} style={{ ...slam, textShadow: SHADOW }}>{shot.tag}</Big></Center>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.55), transparent 45%)' }} />
          <Brackets />
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 110, top: 100, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 26, color: colors.text, display: 'flex', gap: 16, alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <div style={{ width: 16, height: 16, borderRadius: 8, background: '#ff4a3d', opacity: frame % 16 < 10 ? 1 : 0.2 }} />
            REC  00:00:{t.toFixed(2).padStart(5, '0')}
          </div>
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 110, top: 100, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 26, color: colors.accent }}>{String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')} / {String(n).padStart(2, '0')}</div>
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 110, bottom: 110 }}>
            <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 26, letterSpacing: 4, color: colors.accent, marginBottom: 10 }}>MEASURING ▸</div>
            <Big size={140} style={{ ...slam, transformOrigin: 'left center', textShadow: SHADOW }}>{shot.tag}</Big>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};
const Measures: React.FC = () => {
  let at = R.measures.at[0];
  return (
    <>
      {R.measures.shots.map((shot, i) => {
        const beats = ('beats' in shot ? shot.beats : undefined) ?? 1;
        const s = <Shot key={i} at={[at, at + beats]}><Measure shot={shot} i={i} len={f(beats)} /></Shot>;
        at += beats;
        return s;
      })}
    </>
  );
};

// ---------- 4. Into the handle: push into the real pod until it goes black, open up inside the CAD ----------
// The black box on the racket is the external mount (not in the CAD; the CAD insert is two thin
// shells inside the handle), so this cut matches on darkness instead of shape: the real push ends
// with the matte pod filling the frame, and the CGI comes up out of black already inside.
const POD = { origin: '40% 56%', zoom: 4.6 }; // pod centre in the clip, and how far to push to fill the frame with it
const HANDLE_CAM = { from: [1.1, 0.75, 2.6] as V3, fromTarget: [0.9, 0, 0] as V3, to: [1.3, 1.5, 4.4] as V3, toTarget: [1.3, 0.05, 0] as V3, fov: 30 };
const Handle: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const h = R.handle;
  const cut = f(h.cut - h.at[0]);
  const len = f(h.at[1] - h.at[0]);
  const cad = useCad('handle');
  const k = frame - cut;
  const explode = interpolate(k, [0, f(1.6)], [0.25, 1], { ...clamp, easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic) });
  const move = interpolate(k, [0, len - cut], [0, 1], { ...clamp, easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic) });
  const lift = 22 * explode;
  const imu = k > f(1.5) ? 0.5 + 0.5 * pulse(frame) : 0;
  const big = useSlam(cut + 3);
  const line = useSlam(cut + f(1));
  const sub = interpolate(k, [f(2), f(2) + 8], [0, 1], clamp);
  // to black as the push fills the frame with the pod, then up from black inside the handle
  const dark = k < 0 ? interpolate(frame, [cut - 7, cut], [0, 1], clamp) : interpolate(k, [0, 8], [1, 0], clamp);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      {frame < cut ? (
        <Clip name={h.clip} len={cut} zoom={[1, POD.zoom]} origin={POD.origin} ease={Easing.in(Easing.cubic)} />
      ) : (
        <AbsoluteFill>
          <Plate name="rh-plate-handle" blur={26} dim={0.62} zoom={1.6} />
          <Stage3D camera={mix(HANDLE_CAM.from, HANDLE_CAM.to, move)} target={mix(HANDLE_CAM.fromTarget, HANDLE_CAM.toTarget, move)} fov={HANDLE_CAM.fov} rim="#ffe9c9" envIntensity={0.6}>
            {cad && (
              <group position={[0, 0, 0]} rotation={[0.1 + 0.08 * move, -0.3 - 0.25 * move, 0]}>
                <group scale={0.036} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0]}>
                  <group position={cad.center.clone().negate().toArray()}>
                    <Part group={cad.groups.shell1} offset={[0, lift, 0]} ghost={explode > 0.05} />
                    <Part group={cad.groups.shell2} offset={[0, -lift, 0]} ghost={explode > 0.05} />
                    <Part group={cad.groups.screws} offset={[0, -lift, 0]} />
                    <Part group={cad.groups.button} offset={[0, lift, 0]} />
                    <Part group={cad.groups.board} />
                    <Part group={cad.groups.imu} offset={[0, 6 * explode, 0]} glow={imu} />
                    <Part group={cad.groups.mic} offset={[0, 4 * explode, 0]} />
                    <Part group={cad.groups.mcu} offset={[0, 4 * explode, 0]} />
                  </group>
                </group>
              </group>
            )}
          </Stage3D>
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'flex-end', padding: '0 120px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
            <Big size={300} color={colors.accent} style={{ ...big, transformOrigin: 'right center', textShadow: SHADOW }}>{h.big}</Big>
            <Big size={88} style={{ ...line, transformOrigin: 'right center', marginTop: 10, textShadow: SHADOW }}>{h.line}</Big>
            <Small style={{ opacity: sub, marginTop: 18 }}>{h.sub}</Small>
          </AbsoluteFill>
        </AbsoluteFill>
      )}
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: '#050504', opacity: dark, pointerEvents: 'none' }} />
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---------- 5. Ground truth: real arm | CGI twin, swinging on the racket's own gyro peaks ----------
const PANEL_W = 608; // 1080 x 1920 portrait shown full height
const TRACE_PEAKS = gyroTrace
  .map((v, i) => ({ v, i }))
  .filter(({ v, i }) => v > 12 && gyroTrace.slice(Math.max(0, i - 40), i + 40).every((u) => u <= v))
  .map(({ i }) => i);
const Trace: React.FC<{ progress: number; width: number; height: number }> = ({ progress, width, height }) => {
  const n = gyroTrace.length, max = Math.max(...gyroTrace);
  const shown = Math.max(2, Math.floor(progress * n));
  const pts = gyroTrace.slice(0, shown).map((v, i) => `${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${((i / (n - 1)) * width).toFixed(1)},${(height - (v / max) * (height - 12)).toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');
  const head = gyroTrace[shown - 1];
  return (
    <svg width={width} height={height} style={{ overflow: 'visible' }}>
      <line x1={0} x2={width} y1={height} y2={height} stroke={colors.track} strokeWidth={2} />
      <path d={pts} stroke={colors.accent} strokeWidth={3.5} fill="none" strokeLinejoin="round" />
      <circle cx={((shown - 1) / (n - 1)) * width} cy={height - (head / max) * (height - 12)} r={9} fill={colors.accent} style={{ filter: `drop-shadow(0 0 10px ${colors.accent})` }} />
    </svg>
  );
};
const Truth: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const t = R.truth;
  const len = f(t.at[1] - t.at[0]);
  const progress = frame / len;
  const toFrame = (i: number) => (i / (gyroTrace.length - 1)) * len;
  // CGI twin: alternate forehand/backhand through each gyro peak.
  let angle = BACK;
  TRACE_PEAKS.forEach((pk, k) => {
    const s = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.tanh((frame - toFrame(pk)) / 2.5);
    angle += (k % 2 ? BACK - THROUGH : THROUGH - BACK) * s;
  });
  const hit = Math.max(0, ...TRACE_PEAKS.map((pk) => 1 - Math.abs(frame - toFrame(pk)) / 6));
  const line = Math.min(t.lines.length - 1, Math.floor(frame / f(2)));
  const slam = useSlam(f(line * 2));
  const label: React.CSSProperties = { fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 24, letterSpacing: 3, color: colors.accent, background: 'rgba(11,12,9,0.6)', padding: '6px 14px', borderRadius: 6 };
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <Plate name="rh-plate-lab" blur={24} dim={0.6} />
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 420, top: 60, width: 1920, height: 1080 }}>
        <Stage3D camera={[-1.2 + Math.sin(-0.95 + progress * 0.3) * 6.4, 1.4, 0.3 + Math.cos(-0.95 + progress * 0.3) * 6.4]} target={[-1.2, 0.25, 0.3]} fov={38} rim="#ffe9c9" envIntensity={0.75}>
          <RobotArm angle={angle} grid={false} racket="blue" racketGlow={hit} />
        </Stage3D>
      </div>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 0, top: 0, width: PANEL_W, height: 1080, overflow: 'hidden', boxShadow: '20px 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)' }}>
        <Clip name={t.clip} len={len} zoom={[1, 1.06]} />
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 30, top: 30, ...label }}>REAL</div>
      </div>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: PANEL_W + 40, top: 30, ...label }}>CGI TWIN</div>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: PANEL_W + 90, right: 90, top: 90, textAlign: 'right' }}>
        <Big key={line} size={96} style={{ ...slam, transformOrigin: 'right center', textShadow: SHADOW }}>{t.lines[line]}</Big>
      </div>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: PANEL_W + 90, right: 90, bottom: 70 }}>
        <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 22, letterSpacing: 3, color: colors.muted, marginBottom: 12 }}>{t.trace}</div>
        <Trace progress={progress} width={1920 - PANEL_W - 180} height={170} />
      </div>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---------- 6. Test matrix: wall of real clips, then the line ----------
const Matrix: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const m = R.matrix;
  const b = (beat: number) => f(beat - m.at[0]);
  const step = 0.4375; // nine tiles across four beats
  const dim = interpolate(frame, [b(m.lineAt) - 2, b(m.lineAt) + 4], [0, 0.66], clamp);
  const line = useSlam(b(m.lineAt));
  const len = f(m.at[1] - m.at[0]);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ transform: `scale(${interpolate(frame, [0, len], [1, 1.08])})` }}>
        {m.tiles.map((tile, i) => {
          const start = f(i * step);
          const pop = spring({ frame: frame - start, fps: FPS, config: { damping: 13, stiffness: 200 } });
          const edge = frame >= start ? Math.exp(-(frame - start) / 5) : 0;
          return (
            <div key={tile} style={{ position: 'absolute', left: (i % 3) * 640, top: Math.floor(i / 3) * 360, width: 640, height: 360, opacity: frame < start ? 0 : 1, transform: `scale(${0.7 + 0.3 * pop})`, outline: `3px solid rgba(221,232,91,${edge})`, outlineOffset: -3, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
              <Sequence from={start} layout="none">
                <Clip name={tile} len={len} zoom={[1.1, 1]} />
              </Sequence>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </AbsoluteFill>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: `rgba(11,12,9,${dim})` }} />
      {frame >= b(m.lineAt) && (
        <Center style={{ flexDirection: 'column' }}>
          <div style={line}>
            <Big size={190} style={{ textShadow: SHADOW }}>{m.line[0]}</Big>
            <Big size={250} color={colors.accent} style={{ textShadow: SHADOW }}>{m.line[1]}</Big>
          </div>
        </Center>
      )}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

// ---------- 7. Finale: down the real throat, match cut to the CGI racket, then the name ----------
// CGI camera starts below the throat looking up the shaft (like the POV clip), then pulls back.
const FIN_CAM = { from: [0.02, -1.05, 0.42] as V3, fromTarget: [0, 0.35, -0.05] as V3, to: [0, 0.1, 6.1] as V3, toTarget: [0, 0.05, 0] as V3 };
const Finale: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const fin = R.finale;
  const b = (beat: number) => f(beat - fin.at[0]);
  const cut = b(fin.cut);
  const k = frame - cut;
  const pull = interpolate(k, [0, f(2.5)], [0, 1], { ...clamp, easing: inOut });
  const slide = interpolate(k, [f(1.5), f(3)], [0, 1], { ...clamp, easing: inOut });
  const panelW = interpolate(k, [0, 9], [PANEL_W, 1920], { ...clamp, easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic) });
  const left = useSlam(0);
  const right = useSlam(f(1));
  const name = useSlam(cut + f(2));
  const appear = (beat: number) => ({ opacity: interpolate(k, [f(beat), f(beat) + 6], [0, 1], clamp) });
  const blurIn = interpolate(frame, [cut - 5, cut], [0, 8], clamp);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      {frame < cut ? (
        <AbsoluteFill style={{ filter: blurIn ? `blur(${blurIn}px)` : undefined }}>
          <Clip name={fin.clip} len={cut} zoom={[1.3, 1.5]} blur={30} />
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: 'rgba(11,12,9,0.5)' }} />
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: (1920 - PANEL_W) / 2, top: 0, width: PANEL_W, height: 1080, overflow: 'hidden', boxShadow: '0 0 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.7)' }}>
            <Clip name={fin.clip} len={cut} zoom={[1, 1.22]} origin="50% 62%" ease={Easing.in(Easing.quad)} />
          </div>
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <div style={{ width: (1920 - PANEL_W) / 2, paddingRight: 40, textAlign: 'right' }}>
              <Big size={104} style={{ ...left, transformOrigin: 'right center', textShadow: SHADOW, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{fin.pov[0]}</Big>
            </div>
            <div style={{ width: PANEL_W }} />
            <div style={{ width: (1920 - PANEL_W) / 2, paddingLeft: 40 }}>
              <Big size={104} color={colors.accent} style={{ ...right, transformOrigin: 'left center', textShadow: SHADOW, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{fin.pov[1]}</Big>
            </div>
          </AbsoluteFill>
        </AbsoluteFill>
      ) : (
        <AbsoluteFill>
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: colors.bg }} />
          {/* the real room behind the CGI at the cut, fading out as the camera pulls back */}
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ opacity: 1 - pull }}>
            <Clip name={fin.clip} len={b(fin.at[1])} zoom={[1.5, 1.7]} blur={30} />
            <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: 'rgba(11,12,9,0.5)' }} />
          </AbsoluteFill>
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: `radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 60% at 30% 50%, rgba(221,232,91,${0.1 * slide}), rgba(11,12,9,0) 65%)` }} />
          <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, bottom: 0, left: (1920 - panelW) / 2, width: panelW, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, left: -(1920 - panelW) / 2, width: 1920, height: 1080 }}>
              <Stage3D camera={mix(FIN_CAM.from, FIN_CAM.to, pull)} target={mix(FIN_CAM.fromTarget, FIN_CAM.toTarget, pull)} fov={interpolate(pull, [0, 1], [62, 32])} env="studio" envIntensity={1.4} hero>
                <pointLight position={[-0.6, 2.2, -1.8]} intensity={40} distance={8} color="#ffffff" />
                <Racket finish="blue" position={[-1.25 * slide, 0, 0]} rotation={[0.1 * pull, 0.3 * pull + k * 0.005, -0.16 * slide]} glow={0.4 + 0.6 * pulse(frame)} />
              </Stage3D>
            </div>
          </div>
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ justifyContent: 'center', paddingLeft: 860, gap: 18 }}>
            {k >= f(2) && <Big size={118} style={{ ...name, transformOrigin: 'left center', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{fin.name}</Big>}
            <div style={{ ...appear(3), fontFamily: fonts.sans, fontSize: 52, color: colors.text }}>{fin.line}</div>
            <div style={{ ...appear(4), alignSelf: 'flex-start', marginTop: 20, padding: '14px 30px', borderRadius: 40, background: colors.accent, color: '#11130c', fontFamily: fonts.sans, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 38 }}>{fin.cta}</div>
          </AbsoluteFill>
        </AbsoluteFill>
      )}
      <Flash at={cut - 1} len={6} peak={0.5} />
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

const duck = makeDuck(robotHypeCues, f);

/** Hook, digital twin and what it measures, on the song, for the Demo. Stops before "the AI learns" and "zero guesswork". */
const INTRO_BEATS = 24;
export const RobotHypeIntro: React.FC = () => {
  const s = R.song;
  const end = f(INTRO_BEATS);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: colors.bg, color: colors.text, fontFamily: fonts.sans, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      {R.hook.shots.map((shot, i) => (
        <Shot key={i} at={[R.hook.at[0] + i * 2, R.hook.at[0] + i * 2 + 2]}><HookShot shot={shot} /></Shot>
      ))}
      <Shot at={R.twin.at}><Twin /></Shot>
      <Measures />
      <Vignette />
      <Grain />
      <Audio
        src={staticFile(s.src)}
        trimBefore={Math.round(s.start * FPS)}
        volume={(fr) => s.volume * duck(fr) * interpolate(fr, [end - 14, end - 4], [1, 0], clamp)}
      />
      {robotHypeCues.filter((c) => c.beat < INTRO_BEATS - 1).map((c, i) => <Effect key={i} cue={{ ...c, at: 0 }} frame={f(c.beat)} />)}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

export const RobotHype: React.FC = () => {
  const s = R.song;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: colors.bg, color: colors.text, fontFamily: fonts.sans, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      {R.hook.shots.map((shot, i) => (
        <Shot key={i} at={[R.hook.at[0] + i * 2, R.hook.at[0] + i * 2 + 2]}><HookShot shot={shot} /></Shot>
      ))}
      <Shot at={R.twin.at}><Twin /></Shot>
      <Measures />
      <Shot at={R.handle.at}><Handle /></Shot>
      <Shot at={R.truth.at}><Truth /></Shot>
      <Shot at={R.matrix.at}><Matrix /></Shot>
      <Shot at={R.finale.at}><Finale /></Shot>
      <Vignette />
      <Grain />
      <Audio
        src={staticFile(s.src)}
        trimBefore={Math.round(s.start * FPS)}
        volume={(fr) => s.volume * duck(fr) * interpolate(fr, [robotHypeFrames - 24, robotHypeFrames], [1, 0], clamp)}
      />
      {robotHypeCues.map((c, i) => <Effect key={i} cue={{ ...c, at: 0 }} frame={f(c.beat)} />)}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "video/src/hype/kit.tsx", "sha256": "66b149d3b658e6e8a721357a49d262d9e818c9a1a89954c288fa29d32aa75275", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````tsx
// Shared pieces of the footage + CGI X cuts (RobotHype, BuildLog, EverySwing, Possessed):
// beat timing, the one grade every clip and CGI layer gets, whip-pan cuts, HUD bits and the
// music ducking under loud effects.
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, Easing, Img, OffthreadVideo, Sequence, interpolate, staticFile, useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';
import { colors } from '../config/brand';
import type { Cue } from '../config/sound';

export const FPS = 30;
export type V3 = [number, number, number];
export const clamp = { extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp' } as const;
export const inOut = Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic);
export const mix = (a: V3, b: V3, t: number): V3 => [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t];

// One look for all footage: a little more contrast, a little less colour, slightly warm.
export const GRADE = 'contrast(1.12) saturate(0.84) brightness(0.9) sepia(0.06)';
export const SHADOW = '0 8px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';

/** Beat clock for a song: frames per beat, beat -> frame, an on-beat pulse and a Shot spanning beats. */
export const beatClock = (bpm: number) => {
  const BEAT = (FPS * 60) / bpm;
  const f = (beat: number) => Math.round(beat * BEAT);
  /** 1 on each beat, decaying fast. */
  const pulse = (frame: number, every = 1) => Math.exp(-((frame % (BEAT * every)) / BEAT) * 6);
  const Shot: React.FC<{ at: readonly number[]; children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ at, children }) => (
    <Sequence from={f(at[0])} durationInFrames={f(at[1]) - f(at[0])}>{children}</Sequence>
  );
  return { BEAT, f, pulse, Shot };
};

/** A clip from public/footage, graded, with a zoom across `len` frames. */
export const Clip: React.FC<{ name: string; len: number; zoom?: [number, number]; origin?: string; blur?: number; grade?: string; ease?: (t: number) => number; style?: React.CSSProperties }> = ({ name, len, zoom = [1.06, 1], origin = '50% 50%', blur = 0, grade = GRADE, ease, style }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const z = interpolate(frame, [0, len], zoom, { ...clamp, easing: ease });
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ overflow: 'hidden', ...style }}>
      <OffthreadVideo
        src={staticFile(`footage/${name}.mp4`)}
        muted
        style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover', transform: `scale(${z})`, transformOrigin: origin, filter: blur ? `${grade} blur(${blur}px)` : grade }}
      />
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

/** A still of the real location, blurred and darkened: the room behind the CGI. */
export const Plate: React.FC<{ name: string; blur?: number; dim?: number; zoom?: number; grade?: string }> = ({ name, blur = 22, dim = 0.55, zoom = 1.15, grade = GRADE }) => (
  <AbsoluteFill style={{ overflow: 'hidden' }}>
    <Img src={staticFile(`footage/${name}.jpg`)} style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover', filter: `${grade} blur(${blur}px)`, transform: `scale(${zoom})` }} />
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: `rgba(11,12,9,${dim})` }} />
  </AbsoluteFill>
);

/** Darkens the frame centre a touch so white type reads over bright footage. */
export const Shade: React.FC<{ amount?: number }> = ({ amount = 0.35 }) => (
  <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: `radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 50% at 50% 50%, rgba(0,0,0,${amount}), rgba(0,0,0,${amount * 0.4}) 70%)` }} />
);

/** Lime flash that decays over `len` frames from local frame `at`. */
export const Flash: React.FC<{ at: number; len?: number; peak?: number; color?: string }> = ({ at, len = 6, peak = 0.7, color = colors.accent }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const o = frame < at ? 0 : peak * Math.exp(-(frame - at) / (len / 3));
  return <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: `radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #ffffff, ${color})`, opacity: o, mixBlendMode: 'screen', pointerEvents: 'none' }} />;
};

/** Whip-pan cut: the outgoing shot smears off to the left over its last frames... */
export const whipOut = (frame: number, end: number, len = 5): React.CSSProperties => {
  const t = interpolate(frame, [end - len, end], [0, 1], { ...clamp, easing: Easing.in(Easing.cubic) });
  return t ? { transform: `translateX(${-t * 340}px) scaleX(${1 + t * 0.15})`, filter: `blur(${t * 24}px)` } : {};
};
/** ...and the incoming one smears in from the right, so the move reads as one camera. */
export const whipIn = (frame: number, start: number, len = 6): React.CSSProperties => {
  const t = interpolate(frame, [start, start + len], [1, 0], { ...clamp, easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic) });
  return t ? { transform: `translateX(${t * 340}px) scaleX(${1 + t * 0.15})`, filter: `blur(${t * 24}px)` } : {};
};

/** Camera viewfinder corners. */
export const Brackets: React.FC<{ color?: string }> = ({ color = colors.text }) => {
  const L = 70, W = 4, I = 70;
  const corner = (s: React.CSSProperties) => <div style={{ position: 'absolute', width: L, height: L, borderColor: color, borderStyle: 'solid', borderWidth: 0, opacity: 0.85, ...s }} />;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      {corner({ left: I, top: I, borderLeftWidth: W, borderTopWidth: W })}
      {corner({ right: I, top: I, borderRightWidth: W, borderTopWidth: W })}
      {corner({ left: I, bottom: I, borderLeftWidth: W, borderBottomWidth: W })}
      {corner({ right: I, bottom: I, borderRightWidth: W, borderBottomWidth: W })}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

/** One vignette over real and CGI alike. */
export const Vignette: React.FC<{ strength?: number }> = ({ strength = 0.55 }) => (
  <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: `radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%, transparent 55%, rgba(0,0,0,${strength}))`, pointerEvents: 'none' }} />
);

// The songs are mastered to 0 dBFS and the whoosh/riser/boom files peak near it too, so the music
// ducks under each of those hits (in fast, out over a few frames) instead of clipping.
const LOUD = new Set(['whoosh', 'riser', 'boom', 'impact']);
export const makeDuck = (cues: (Omit<Cue, 'at'> & { beat: number })[], f: (beat: number) => number) => {
  const hits = cues.filter((c) => LOUD.has(c.sfx)).map((c) => ({ at: f(c.beat), depth: 0.5 * Math.min(1, (c.volume ?? 1) / 0.6) }));
  return (fr: number) => {
    let d = 0;
    for (const { at, depth } of hits) {
      const dt = fr - at;
      const env = dt < -12 ? 0 : dt < -4 ? (dt + 12) / 8 : dt < 6 ? 1 : Math.exp(-(dt - 6) / 6);
      d = Math.max(d, depth * env);
    }
    return 1 - d;
  };
};
````````

````````tsx
// Larger building blocks shared by the footage + CGI X cuts: a real shot with a word slammed
// over it, the CAD handle opening up, and the CGI racket finale with the name.
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, Easing, interpolate, useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';
import { Racket } from '../components/Racket';
import { Stage3D } from '../components/Stage3D';
import { colors, fonts } from '../config/brand';
import { useCad } from '../lib/models';
import { Part } from '../scenes/InsideHandle';
import { Big, Center, useSlam } from './Hype';
import { Clip, GRADE, SHADOW, Shade, clamp, inOut, mix, type V3 } from './kit';

/** A real shot with one phrase slammed over it on its first frame. */
export const WordShot: React.FC<{ clip: string; len: number; word?: string; accent?: boolean; size?: number; zoom?: [number, number]; origin?: string; grade?: string; at?: number; kicker?: string }> = ({ clip, len, word, accent, size, zoom = [1.14, 1], origin, grade = GRADE, at = 0, kicker }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const slam = useSlam(at);
  const auto = !word ? 0 : word.length > 14 ? 150 : word.length > 9 ? 180 : 210;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <Clip name={clip} len={len} zoom={zoom} origin={origin} grade={grade} />
      {word && <Shade />}
      {word && frame >= at && (
        <Center style={{ flexDirection: 'column', padding: '0 80px' }}>
          {kicker && <div style={{ ...slam, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 30, letterSpacing: 6, color: colors.accent, marginBottom: 18 }}>{kicker}</div>}
          <Big size={size ?? auto} color={accent ? colors.accent : colors.text} style={{ ...slam, textShadow: SHADOW }}>{word}</Big>
        </Center>
      )}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

/**
 * The CAD handle (shells, screws, button, board, IMU, mic, MCU) opening up. `explode` and `move`
 * run 0..1; `imu` lights the motion sensor. `xray` draws the shells as ghosts from the start.
 */
const HANDLE_CAM = { from: [1.1, 0.75, 2.6] as V3, fromTarget: [0.9, 0, 0] as V3, to: [1.3, 1.5, 4.4] as V3, toTarget: [1.3, 0.05, 0] as V3, fov: 30 };
export const HandleCGI: React.FC<{ explode: number; move: number; imu?: number; glow?: number; rim?: string; xray?: boolean }> = ({ explode, move, imu = 0, glow = 0, rim = '#ffe9c9', xray }) => {
  const cad = useCad('handle');
  const lift = 22 * explode;
  return (
    <Stage3D camera={mix(HANDLE_CAM.from, HANDLE_CAM.to, move)} target={mix(HANDLE_CAM.fromTarget, HANDLE_CAM.toTarget, move)} fov={HANDLE_CAM.fov} rim={rim} envIntensity={0.6}>
      {cad && (
        <group rotation={[0.1 + 0.08 * move, -0.3 - 0.25 * move, 0]}>
          <group scale={0.036} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0]}>
            <group position={cad.center.clone().negate().toArray()}>
              <Part group={cad.groups.shell1} offset={[0, lift, 0]} ghost={xray || explode > 0.05} />
              <Part group={cad.groups.shell2} offset={[0, -lift, 0]} ghost={xray || explode > 0.05} />
              <Part group={cad.groups.screws} offset={[0, -lift, 0]} />
              <Part group={cad.groups.button} offset={[0, lift, 0]} />
              <Part group={cad.groups.board} glow={glow * 0.4} />
              <Part group={cad.groups.imu} offset={[0, 6 * explode, 0]} glow={Math.max(imu, glow)} />
              <Part group={cad.groups.mic} offset={[0, 4 * explode, 0]} glow={glow} />
              <Part group={cad.groups.mcu} offset={[0, 4 * explode, 0]} glow={glow} />
            </group>
          </group>
        </group>
      )}
    </Stage3D>
  );
};

/** Tags that pop in one after another, bottom right. */
export const Tags: React.FC<{ tags: readonly string[]; at: number; every?: number; color?: string }> = ({ tags, at, every = 4, color = colors.accent }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const tagIn = (i: number) => interpolate(frame, [at + i * every, at + 6 + i * every], [0, 1], clamp);
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 14 }}>
      {tags.map((tag, i) => (
        <div key={tag} style={{ opacity: tagIn(i), transform: `translateY(${(1 - tagIn(i)) * 20}px)`, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 26, letterSpacing: 2, color, border: `1.5px solid ${color}`, borderRadius: 30, padding: '8px 18px', background: 'rgba(11,12,9,0.5)' }}>{tag}</div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * Finale, local frame 0 = the cut from the last real shot. The real shot ends close on the racket
 * standing head-down against the net, so the CGI racket starts head-down and close, then turns
 * upright as the camera pulls back and slides left for the name. `room` is the real clip, blurred,
 * that stays behind the CGI for the first moments.
 */
const FIN_CAM = { from: [0, -0.15, 1.5] as V3, fromTarget: [0, -0.1, 0] as V3, to: [0, 0.1, 6.1] as V3, toTarget: [0, 0.05, 0] as V3 };
export const RacketFinale: React.FC<{
  beat: number; // frames per beat
  finish: 'carbon' | 'blue' | 'red';
  name: string;
  /** a sentence under the name, or a `tagline` slammed in lime instead */
  line?: string;
  tagline?: string;
  cta: string;
  room?: string;
  roomLen?: number;
  headDown?: boolean;
  glow?: (frame: number) => number;
  grade?: string;
  aura?: string;
}> = ({ beat, finish, name, line, tagline, cta, room, roomLen = 120, headDown = true, glow = () => 0.4, grade, aura = colors.accent }) => {
  const k = useCurrentFrame();
  const B = (n: number) => Math.round(n * beat);
  const pull = interpolate(k, [0, B(2.5)], [0, 1], { ...clamp, easing: inOut });
  const slide = interpolate(k, [B(1.5), B(3)], [0, 1], { ...clamp, easing: inOut });
  const turn = headDown ? interpolate(k, [0, B(2.2)], [Math.PI, 0], { ...clamp, easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic) }) : 0;
  const nameSlam = useSlam(B(2));
  const tagSlam = useSlam(B(3));
  const appear = (n: number) => ({ opacity: interpolate(k, [B(n), B(n) + 6], [0, 1], clamp) });
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: colors.bg }} />
      {room && (
        <AbsoluteFill style={{ opacity: 1 - pull }}>
          <Clip name={room} len={roomLen} zoom={[1.5, 1.7]} blur={30} grade={grade} />
          <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: 'rgba(11,12,9,0.5)' }} />
        </AbsoluteFill>
      )}
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: `radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 60% at 30% 50%, ${aura}${Math.round(26 * slide).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}, rgba(11,12,9,0) 65%)` }} />
      <Stage3D camera={mix(FIN_CAM.from, FIN_CAM.to, pull)} target={mix(FIN_CAM.fromTarget, FIN_CAM.toTarget, pull)} fov={interpolate(pull, [0, 1], [50, 32])} env="studio" envIntensity={1.4} hero>
        <pointLight position={[-0.6, 2.2, -1.8]} intensity={40} distance={8} color="#ffffff" />
        <Racket finish={finish} position={[-1.25 * slide, 0, 0]} rotation={[0.1 * pull, 0.3 * pull + k * 0.005, turn - 0.16 * slide]} glow={glow(k)} />
      </Stage3D>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ justifyContent: 'center', paddingLeft: 860, gap: 18 }}>
        {k >= B(2) && <Big size={118} style={{ ...nameSlam, transformOrigin: 'left center', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{name}</Big>}
        {line && <div style={{ ...appear(3), fontFamily: fonts.sans, fontSize: 52, color: colors.text }}>{line}</div>}
        {tagline && k >= B(3) && <Big size={96} color={colors.accent} style={{ ...tagSlam, transformOrigin: 'left center', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{tagline}</Big>}
        <div style={{ ...appear(4), alignSelf: 'flex-start', marginTop: 20, padding: '14px 30px', borderRadius: 40, background: colors.accent, color: '#11130c', fontFamily: fonts.sans, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 38 }}>{cta}</div>
      </AbsoluteFill>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

/** Push into a point of a real shot until it goes black (local frames 0..len). */
export const PushToBlack: React.FC<{ clip: string; len: number; origin: string; zoom: number; grade?: string }> = ({ clip, len, origin, zoom, grade }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const dark = interpolate(frame, [len - 7, len], [0, 1], clamp);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill>
      <Clip name={clip} len={len} zoom={[1, zoom]} origin={origin} ease={Easing.in(Easing.cubic)} grade={grade} />
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: '#050504', opacity: dark }} />
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};
````````

````````typescript
import { Easing, interpolate, spring } from 'remotion';

const clamp = { extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp' } as const;

/** 0→1 between two frames, eased. */
export const ramp = (frame: number, start: number, end: number, ease = Easing.out(Easing.cubic)) =>
  interpolate(frame, [start, end], [0, 1], { ...clamp, easing: ease });

/** Fade + rise for text entering at `start`. */
export const enter = (frame: number, start: number, dur = 14, rise = 24) => {
  const t = ramp(frame, start, start + dur);
  return { opacity: t, transform: `translateY(${(1 - t) * rise}px)` };
};

export const pop = (frame: number, start: number, fps: number) =>
  spring({ frame: frame - start, fps, config: { damping: 12, stiffness: 140 } });

export const lerp = (a: number, b: number, t: number) => a + (b - a) * t;

/** Deterministic pseudo-random in [0,1) — Remotion renders frames in parallel, so no Math.random. */
export const rand = (seed: number) => {
  const x = Math.sin(seed * 127.1 + 311.7) * 43758.5453;
  return x - Math.floor(x);
};
````````

````````typescript
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { cancelRender, continueRender, delayRender, staticFile } from 'remotion';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';

// Loads are cached per tab so scenes that share a model don't fetch it twice.
const cache = new Map<string, Promise<unknown>>();
const once = <T,>(key: string, load: () => Promise<T>) => {
  if (!cache.has(key)) cache.set(key, load());
  return cache.get(key) as Promise<T>;
};

/** Holds the frame until the asset is ready, so renders never show a blank model. */
function useAsset<T>(key: string, load: () => Promise<T>): T | null {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<T | null>(null);
  const [handle] = useState(() => delayRender(`load ${key}`, { timeoutInMilliseconds: 120_000 }));
  useEffect(() => {
    // Release the frame only after React has committed and the canvas has redrawn
    // (see useRedraw in Stage3D), otherwise the render captures an empty scene.
    once(key, load)
      .then((v) => { setValue(v); requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => continueRender(handle))); })
      .catch(cancelRender);
  }, [key, handle]);
  return value;
}

/** A glTF binary from public/models, with its materials and embedded textures. */
export const useGlb = (name: string) =>
  useAsset(`glb:${name}`, () => new GLTFLoader().loadAsync(staticFile(`models/${name}.glb`)).then((g) => g.scene));

type CadPart = { color: [number, number, number]; position: number[]; index: number[] };
type CadFile = { bounds: { min: number[]; max: number[] }; groups: Record<string, CadPart[]> };

export type CadGroup = { name: string; meshes: { geometry: THREE.BufferGeometry; color: THREE.Color }[]; center: THREE.Vector3 };

/** A STEP assembly converted by scripts/step-to-json.mjs (handle | robot). */
export const useCad = (name: 'handle' | 'robot') => {
  const file = useAsset(`cad:${name}`, () => fetch(staticFile(`models/${name}.json`)).then((r) => r.json() as Promise<CadFile>));
  return useMemo(() => {
    if (!file) return null;
    const groups: Record<string, CadGroup> = {};
    for (const [g, parts] of Object.entries(file.groups)) {
      const box = new THREE.Box3();
      const meshes = parts.map((p) => {
        const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
        geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(p.position, 3));
        geometry.setIndex(p.index);
        geometry.computeVertexNormals();
        geometry.computeBoundingBox();
        box.union(geometry.boundingBox!);
        return { geometry, color: new THREE.Color(...p.color) };
      });
      groups[g] = { name: g, meshes, center: box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3()) };
    }
    const b = file.bounds;
    const center = new THREE.Vector3(...b.min).add(new THREE.Vector3(...b.max)).multiplyScalar(0.5);
    return { groups, center, size: new THREE.Vector3(...b.max).sub(new THREE.Vector3(...b.min)) };
  }, [file]);
};
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "video/src/lib/racketMesh.ts", "sha256": "0bd55c50ca40a1b578b3f92856fcb3e80652ba5103a2a79d820291f20f65a1ba", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````typescript
// Geometry for the CGI racket, built from real dimensions (metres, measured from the butt, head
// toward +Y, strings facing +Z). Generic and unbranded: 27" long, ~100 sq in head, 16x19.
//
// The frame is one surface, not tubes stuck together: the shaft, the two throat arms and the hoop
// (whose bottom is the bridge) are each a signed distance field of a rounded-box beam swept along
// a centreline, joined with a smooth minimum so the throat gets real fillets where the arms split
// from the shaft and where they flow into the hoop. The field is meshed with surface nets.
// Strings, grommets, the bumper strip and the handle parts are built directly.
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { mergeGeometries } from 'three/examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js';

export const D = {
  length: 0.685,
  // hoop centreline: superellipse, a little wider at the top than at the bridge (egg)
  headA: 0.1245, // half-width to beam centre
  headB: 0.164, // half-length to beam centre
  headY: 0.516,
  n: 2.3,
  egg: 0.045,
  // throat
  shaft: [0.18, 0.262] as const, // shaft centreline y range (bottom hidden in the collar)
  armFrom: 0.222, // arms leave from inside the shaft
  armJoin: -0.98, // hoop angle (right side) the arm runs into, tangentially
  // strings
  mains: 16,
  crosses: 19,
  mainGap: 0.0128,
  crossGap: 0.0158,
  string: 0.00065, // radius (1.3 mm gauge)
  // handle
  grip: [0.013, 0.198] as const,
  gripApothem: 0.0169, // grip 4 3/8"
};

const sp = (v: number, p: number) => Math.sign(v) * Math.abs(v) ** p;
const smoothstep = (a: number, b: number, x: number) => {
  const t = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (x - a) / (b - a)));
  return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
};
const smin = (a: number, b: number, k: number) => {
  const h = Math.max(k - Math.abs(a - b), 0) / k;
  return Math.min(a, b) - h * h * k * 0.25;
};
/** Signed distance to a 2D rounded box (half sizes hx, hy, corner radius r). */
const roundBox = (x: number, y: number, hx: number, hy: number, r: number) => {
  const qx = Math.abs(x) - (hx - r), qy = Math.abs(y) - (hy - r);
  return Math.hypot(Math.max(qx, 0), Math.max(qy, 0)) + Math.min(Math.max(qx, qy), 0) - r;
};

/** 1 at the bridge (bottom of the hoop), falling off either side. */
const bridgeWeight = (t: number) => {
  const a = ((((t + Math.PI / 2) % (2 * Math.PI)) + 3 * Math.PI) % (2 * Math.PI)) - Math.PI; // angle from the bottom
  return Math.exp(-((a / 0.42) ** 2));
};
/** Hoop centreline: squarer over the top (an isometric-style head), flatter along the bridge. */
export const hoopPoint = (t: number): [number, number] => {
  const n = D.n + 0.25 * Math.max(0, Math.sin(t)) + 0.45 * bridgeWeight(t);
  return [D.headA * sp(Math.cos(t), 2 / n) * (1 + D.egg * Math.sin(t)), D.headY + D.headB * sp(Math.sin(t), 2 / n)];
};

// ---------- frame centrelines with their beam sizes ----------
type Piece = { x: Float64Array; y: Float64Array; hw: Float64Array; hd: Float64Array; t: Float64Array; closed: boolean };
const piece = (pts: [number, number][], hw: (i: number, p: [number, number]) => number, hd: (i: number, p: [number, number]) => number, closed: boolean, t?: number[]): Piece => ({
  x: Float64Array.from(pts, (p) => p[0]),
  y: Float64Array.from(pts, (p) => p[1]),
  hw: Float64Array.from(pts, (p, i) => hw(i, p)),
  hd: Float64Array.from(pts, (p, i) => hd(i, p)),
  t: Float64Array.from(t ?? pts.map((_, i) => i)),
  closed,
});

const HOOP_N = 1200;
const hoopT = Array.from({ length: HOOP_N }, (_, i) => -Math.PI / 2 + (2 * Math.PI * i) / HOOP_N);
/** Face half-width along the hoop: 13 mm at the top, a little more down the sides, slim bridge. */
const hoopHW = (t: number) => {
  const s = Math.sin(t);
  const bridge = bridgeWeight(t);
  return (0.0066 + 0.0007 * (1 - s) / 2) * (1 - 0.2 * bridge);
};
/** Beam half-depth: 23 mm at the top, 25 mm through the sides and throat, a thinner bridge. */
const hoopHD = (t: number) => {
  const s = Math.sin(t);
  const bridge = bridgeWeight(t);
  return (0.0115 + 0.001 * (1 - s) / 2) * (1 - 0.3 * bridge);
};

function framePieces(): Piece[] {
  const hoopPts = hoopT.map(hoopPoint);
  const hoop = piece(hoopPts, (i) => hoopHW(hoopT[i]), (i) => hoopHD(hoopT[i]), true, hoopT);

  // Arms: a cubic from straight up out of the shaft into the hoop's tangent, then a stretch
  // along the hoop so the two surfaces run together.
  const arm = (side: 1 | -1) => {
    const tj = side > 0 ? D.armJoin : Math.PI - D.armJoin;
    const dir = side > 0 ? 1 : -1; // direction of increasing height along the hoop
    const P3 = hoopPoint(tj);
    const e = 1e-4, Pn = hoopPoint(tj + dir * e);
    const T = [(Pn[0] - P3[0]) / e, (Pn[1] - P3[1]) / e];
    const l = Math.hypot(T[0], T[1]);
    T[0] /= l; T[1] /= l;
    const P0: [number, number] = [0, D.armFrom];
    const P1: [number, number] = [0, D.armFrom + 0.05];
    const P2: [number, number] = [P3[0] - T[0] * 0.055, P3[1] - T[1] * 0.055];
    const pts: [number, number][] = [];
    const M = 220;
    for (let i = 0; i <= M; i++) {
      const s = i / M, u = 1 - s;
      pts.push([
        u * u * u * P0[0] + 3 * u * u * s * P1[0] + 3 * u * s * s * P2[0] + s * s * s * P3[0],
        u * u * u * P0[1] + 3 * u * u * s * P1[1] + 3 * u * s * s * P2[1] + s * s * s * P3[1],
      ]);
    }
    // past the join the arm runs on along the hoop, tapering until it is inside it
    for (let i = 1; i <= 60; i++) pts.push(hoopPoint(tj + dir * 0.3 * (i / 60)));
    const n = pts.length - 1;
    const tAt = (i: number) => Math.min(1, i / M);
    const tail = (i: number) => Math.max(0, (i - M) / 60);
    return piece(
      pts,
      (i) => (0.0088 + (hoopHW(tj) - 0.0088) * smoothstep(0, 1, tAt(i))) * (1 - 0.6 * smoothstep(0, 1, tail(i))),
      (i) => 0.0124 + (hoopHD(tj) - 0.0124) * smoothstep(0.6, 1, tAt(i)),
      false,
      pts.map((_, i) => i / n),
    );
  };

  const S = 40;
  const shaftPts = Array.from({ length: S + 1 }, (_, i): [number, number] => [0, D.shaft[0] + ((D.shaft[1] - D.shaft[0]) * i) / S]);
  const shaft = piece(shaftPts, (_, p) => 0.0112 - 0.02 * (p[1] - D.shaft[0]), () => 0.0125, false);
  return [hoop, arm(1), arm(-1), shaft];
}

// ---------- the field on a grid ----------
const H = 0.0006; // grid step (0.6 mm)
const BOUNDS = { x: [-0.146, 0.146], y: [0.172, 0.694], z: [-0.0152, 0.0152] };

/**
 * Per column (x, y) and per piece: distance to the centreline in the XY plane, which side of it,
 * and where along it (to look up the beam size). Rasterised segment by segment within a band.
 */
function nearest(pieces: Piece[], nx: number, ny: number) {
  const cols = nx * ny;
  return pieces.map((p) => {
    const dist = new Float32Array(cols).fill(1);
    const side = new Int8Array(cols);
    const at = new Float32Array(cols); // segment index + fraction
    const m = p.x.length, segs = p.closed ? m : m - 1;
    for (let s = 0; s < segs; s++) {
      const a = s, b = (s + 1) % m;
      const ax = p.x[a], ay = p.y[a], bx = p.x[b], by = p.y[b];
      const band = Math.max(p.hw[a], p.hw[b]) + 0.005;
      const i0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Math.min(ax, bx) - band - BOUNDS.x[0]) / H)), i1 = Math.min(nx - 1, Math.ceil((Math.max(ax, bx) + band - BOUNDS.x[0]) / H));
      const j0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Math.min(ay, by) - band - BOUNDS.y[0]) / H)), j1 = Math.min(ny - 1, Math.ceil((Math.max(ay, by) + band - BOUNDS.y[0]) / H));
      const dx = bx - ax, dy = by - ay, len2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
      for (let j = j0; j <= j1; j++) {
        const y = BOUNDS.y[0] + j * H;
        for (let i = i0; i <= i1; i++) {
          const x = BOUNDS.x[0] + i * H;
          // past an open end the distance is to the end point, which rounds the beam off
          const fc = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, ((x - ax) * dx + (y - ay) * dy) / len2));
          const px = ax + dx * fc, py = ay + dy * fc;
          const d = Math.hypot(x - px, y - py);
          const c = j * nx + i;
          if (d < dist[c]) {
            dist[c] = d;
            at[c] = s + fc;
            side[c] = (x - px) * dy - (y - py) * dx >= 0 ? 1 : -1; // right of travel
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return { dist, side, at };
  });
}

const lookup = (arr: Float64Array, at: number, closed: boolean) => {
  const m = arr.length, i = Math.floor(at), f = at - i;
  const a = arr[closed ? i % m : Math.min(i, m - 1)], b = arr[closed ? (i + 1) % m : Math.min(i + 1, m - 1)];
  return a + (b - a) * f;
};

/** Surface-nets mesh of the frame, with vertex normals from the field and a paint-zone weight. */
export function buildFrame() {
  const pieces = framePieces();
  const nx = Math.round((BOUNDS.x[1] - BOUNDS.x[0]) / H) + 1;
  const ny = Math.round((BOUNDS.y[1] - BOUNDS.y[0]) / H) + 1;
  const nz = Math.round((BOUNDS.z[1] - BOUNDS.z[0]) / H) + 1;
  const near = nearest(pieces, nx, ny);
  const [hoopN] = near;
  const hoop = pieces[0];

  // The pieces are joined in the face-on outline only (smooth union of the 2D distances), so the
  // throat gets fillets without the beam swelling where pieces overlap; the outline is then given
  // depth with rounded edges, which keeps the faces flat like a moulded frame.
  const cols = nx * ny;
  const plan = new Float32Array(cols).fill(1), depth = new Float32Array(cols), round = new Float32Array(cols);
  const grooveAt = new Float32Array(cols), grooveU = new Float32Array(cols), grooveW = new Float32Array(cols);
  const K = [0, 0.005, 0.005, 0.007]; // fillet size joining each piece onto the ones before it
  for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
    let d = 1, wsum = 0, hd = 0, r = 0, any = false;
    const ds: number[] = [];
    pieces.forEach((p, pi) => {
      const n = near[pi];
      if (n.dist[c] > 0.03) { ds.push(1); return; }
      any = true;
      const hw = lookup(p.hw, n.at[c], p.closed);
      const di = n.dist[c] - hw;
      ds.push(di);
      d = pi === 0 || d === 1 ? Math.min(d, di) : smin(d, di, K[pi]);
    });
    if (!any) continue;
    pieces.forEach((p, pi) => {
      if (ds[pi] === 1) return;
      const w = Math.exp(-(ds[pi] - d) / 0.003);
      const hw = lookup(p.hw, near[pi].at[c], p.closed);
      hd += w * lookup(p.hd, near[pi].at[c], p.closed);
      r += w * Math.min(0.0042, hw * 0.62);
      wsum += w;
    });
    plan[c] = d; depth[c] = hd / wsum; round[c] = r / wsum;

    if (ds[0] !== 1 && hoopN.side[c] > 0 && ds[0] - d < 0.0005) {
      const t = lookup(hoop.t, hoopN.at[c], true);
      grooveAt[c] = smoothstep(-0.86, -0.62, Math.sin(t)); // 0..1 strength

  const OUT = 0.004;

  const layer = (j: number, out: Float32Array) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < nx; i++) {
      const c = j * nx + i;

      const d2 = plan[c], hd = depth[c], r = round[c], gd = grooveAt[c];

        if (gd > 0) d = Math.max(d, -roundBox(grooveU[c] - grooveW[c], z, 0.0021 * gd, 0.0023 * Math.sqrt(gd), 0.0007 * gd));

          sz += ((a >> 1) & 1) + (((b >> 1) & 1) - ((a >> 1) & 1)) * f;

        const lerp = (a: number, b: number, t: number) => a + (b - a) * t;
        const gx = lerp(lerp(g(1) - g(0), g(3) - g(2), fz), lerp(g(5) - g(4), g(7) - g(6), fz), fy);
        const gz = lerp(lerp(g(2) - g(0), g(3) - g(1), fx), lerp(g(6) - g(4), g(7) - g(5), fx), fy);
        const gy = lerp(lerp(g(4) - g(0), g(5) - g(1), fx), lerp(g(6) - g(2), g(7) - g(3), fx), fz);
        const gl = Math.hypot(gx, gy, gz) || 1;
        const X = BOUNDS.x[0] + (i + fx) * H, Y = BOUNDS.y[0] + (j + fy) * H, Z = BOUNDS.z[0] + (k + fz) * H;
        V0[i * nz + k] = pos.length / 3; // this cell's vertex (layer j lives in V0)
        pos.push(X, Y, Z);
        nor.push(gx / gl, gy / gl, gz / gl);
        // paint zone: the +x throat arm from the split to about halfway up (the real racket's
        // light blue panel), with crisp edges
        zone.push(smoothstep(0.0005, 0.0025, X) * smoothstep(0.262, 0.266, Y) * (1 - smoothstep(0.334, 0.338, Y)));

        const s0 = corner[0] < 0;
        const vid = (ii: number, kk: number, prev: boolean) => (prev ? Vp : V0)[ii * nz + kk];
        // edge along y (corner 0 -> 4): cells (i-1..i, j, k-1..k)
        if (i > 0 && k > 0 && s0 !== corner[4] < 0) quad(vid(i - 1, k - 1, false), vid(i, k - 1, false), vid(i, k, false), vid(i - 1, k, false), s0);
        // edge along x (corner 0 -> 1): cells (i, j-1..j, k-1..k)
        if (j > 0 && k > 0 && s0 !== corner[1] < 0) quad(vid(i, k - 1, true), vid(i, k, true), vid(i, k, false), vid(i, k - 1, false), s0);
        // edge along z (corner 0 -> 2): cells (i-1..i, j-1..j, k)
        if (i > 0 && j > 0 && s0 !== corner[2] < 0) quad(vid(i - 1, k, true), vid(i - 1, k, false), vid(i, k, false), vid(i, k, true), s0);
      }
    }
    // the cells of row j are done: they become the previous row
    const tv = Vp; Vp = V0; V0 = tv; V0.fill(-1);
    const tl = L0; L0 = L1; L1 = tl;
  }
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
  g.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(nor, 3));
  g.setAttribute('zone', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(zone, 1));
  g.setIndex(idx);
  return g;
}

// ---------- strings and grommets ----------
/** Hoop inner face as a closed polyline (centreline moved inward by the face half-width). */
const innerFace = () => {
  const N = 1600;
  return Array.from({ length: N }, (_, i) => {
    const t = -Math.PI / 2 + (2 * Math.PI * i) / N, e = 1e-4;
    const [x, y] = hoopPoint(t), [x2, y2] = hoopPoint(t + e);
    const tx = x2 - x, ty = y2 - y, l = Math.hypot(tx, ty);
    const w = hoopHW(t);
    return [x - (ty / l) * w, y + (tx / l) * w] as [number, number];

};
/** Where a line x = c (axis 0) or y = c (axis 1) crosses a closed polyline: [low, high]. */
const span = (poly: [number, number][], axis: 0 | 1, c: number) => {
  const hits: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < poly.length; i++) {
    const a = poly[i], b = poly[(i + 1) % poly.length];
    if ((a[axis] - c) * (b[axis] - c) <= 0 && a[axis] !== b[axis]) {
      const f = (c - a[axis]) / (b[axis] - a[axis]);
      hits.push(a[1 - axis] + (b[1 - axis] - a[1 - axis]) * f);
    }
  }
  return hits.length >= 2 ? [Math.min(...hits), Math.max(...hits)] : null;
};

export function buildStrings() {
  const inner = innerFace();
  const amp = D.string * 0.9;
  const x0 = -((D.mains - 1) / 2) * D.mainGap;
  const y0 = D.headY - ((D.crosses - 1) / 2) * D.crossGap;
  const tubes: THREE.BufferGeometry[] = [];
  const ends: { p: THREE.Vector3; dir: THREE.Vector3 }[] = [];
  const IN = 0.0015; // strings run this far into the beam
  for (let i = 0; i < D.mains; i++) {
    const x = x0 + i * D.mainGap, sg = i % 2 ? -1 : 1, sp2 = span(inner, 0, x);
    if (!sp2) continue;
    const [lo, hi] = [sp2[0] - IN, sp2[1] + IN];
    const pts: THREE.Vector3[] = [];
    for (let k = 0; k <= 60; k++) {
      const y = lo + ((hi - lo) * k) / 60;
      pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(x, y, sg * amp * Math.cos((Math.PI * (y - y0)) / D.crossGap)));
    }
    tubes.push(new THREE.TubeGeometry(new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts), 180, D.string, 6));
    ends.push({ p: new THREE.Vector3(x, sp2[0], 0), dir: new THREE.Vector3(0, -1, 0) }, { p: new THREE.Vector3(x, sp2[1], 0), dir: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0) });
  }
  for (let j = 0; j < D.crosses; j++) {
    const y = y0 + j * D.crossGap, sg = j % 2 ? -1 : 1, sp2 = span(inner, 1, y);
    if (!sp2) continue;
    const [lo, hi] = [sp2[0] - IN, sp2[1] + IN];
    const pts: THREE.Vector3[] = [];
    for (let k = 0; k <= 48; k++) {
      const x = lo + ((hi - lo) * k) / 48;
      pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(x, y, -sg * amp * Math.cos((Math.PI * (x - x0)) / D.mainGap)));
    }
    tubes.push(new THREE.TubeGeometry(new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts), 144, D.string, 6));
    ends.push({ p: new THREE.Vector3(sp2[0], y, 0), dir: new THREE.Vector3(-1, 0, 0) }, { p: new THREE.Vector3(sp2[1], y, 0), dir: new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0) });
  }
  // a grommet where each string goes into the frame: a short sleeve standing off the inner face
  const up = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
  const grommets = ends.map(({ p, dir }) => {
    const g = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.0013, 0.0016, 0.0022, 12, 1);
    g.applyQuaternion(new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(up, dir));
    g.translate(p.x - dir.x * 0.0004, p.y - dir.y * 0.0004, 0);

/** The grommet strip in the outside groove, thick over the top of the head (the bumper). */
export function buildBumper() {
  const t0 = -0.72, t1 = Math.PI + 0.72, N = 500, R = 24;
  const pos: number[] = [], idx: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
    const t = t0 + ((t1 - t0) * i) / N, e = 1e-4;
    const [x, y] = hoopPoint(t), [x2, y2] = hoopPoint(t + e);
    const tx = x2 - x, ty = y2 - y, l = Math.hypot(tx, ty);
    const nx = ty / l, ny = -tx / l; // outward
    const top = smoothstep(0.55, 0.8, Math.sin(t)); // the bumper proper over the top
    const ends = smoothstep(0, 0.06, Math.min(t - t0, t1 - t));
    const proud = (0.0006 + 0.0016 * top) * ends; // how far it stands out of the groove
    const half = 0.0021 + 0.0012 * top; // half height (along z)
    const base = hoopHW(t) - 0.0021; // groove floor
    for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) {
      const a = (2 * Math.PI * r) / R;
      // rounded rectangle in (out, z)
      const cx = Math.cos(a), cz = Math.sin(a);
      const o = base + (0.0021 + proud) / 2 + ((0.0021 + proud) / 2) * sp(cx, 0.35);
      const z = half * sp(cz, 0.35);
      pos.push(x + nx * o, y + ny * o, z);

    for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) {
      const a = i * R + r, b = i * R + ((r + 1) % R), c = (i + 1) * R + r, d = (i + 1) * R + ((r + 1) % R);
      idx.push(a, c, b, b, c, d);
    }
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
  g.setIndex(idx);

}

// ---------- handle ----------
/** Rounded octagon (apothem a) in polar form, a bevel facing +Z like a real handle. */
const octagon = (th: number, a: number) => {
  const seg = Math.PI / 4;
  const phi = ((((th + seg / 2) % seg) + seg) % seg) - seg / 2;
  const r = a / Math.cos(phi);
  const cap = a * 1.045; // round the corners off
  return r > cap ? cap + (r - cap) * 0.25 : r;
};
/** Polar rounded box (the shaft's cross-section) with half sizes hx (x) and hz (z). */
const box = (th: number, hx: number, hz: number) => 1 / ((Math.abs(Math.cos(th)) / hx) ** 3 + (Math.abs(Math.sin(th)) / hz) ** 3) ** (1 / 3);

/** A surface of revolution-like mesh around Y: radius(theta, y) over rows of y. */
function lathe(ys: number[], radius: (th: number, y: number) => number, R = 128, capBottom = false) {
  const pos: number[] = [], idx: number[] = [];
  ys.forEach((y) => {
    for (let r = 0; r <= R; r++) {
      const th = (2 * Math.PI * r) / R, rr = radius(th, y);
      pos.push(rr * Math.cos(th), y, rr * Math.sin(th));
    }
  });
  for (let i = 0; i < ys.length - 1; i++)
    for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) {
      const a = i * (R + 1) + r, b = a + 1, c = a + R + 1, d = c + 1;
      idx.push(a, c, b, b, c, d);
    }
  if (capBottom) {
    const centre = pos.length / 3;
    pos.push(0, ys[0], 0);
    for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) idx.push(centre, r, r + 1);
  }
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
  g.setIndex(idx);
  g.computeVertexNormals();
  return g;
}
const rows = (a: number, b: number, n: number) => Array.from({ length: n + 1 }, (_, i) => a + ((b - a) * i) / n);

export function buildHandle() {
  const [g0, g1] = D.grip, A = D.gripApothem;
  const PITCH = 0.027; // one turn of overgrip
  // overgrip: octagon with the spiral overlap ridge, a slight flare at the butt
  const grip = lathe(rows(g0, g1 - 0.010, 520), (th, y) => {
    const s = (((y - g0) / PITCH - th / (2 * Math.PI)) % 1 + 1) % 1;
    const ridge = 0.00055 * smoothstep(0, 0.06, s) * (1 - 0.7 * s);
    const flare = 0.0012 * Math.exp(-(y - g0) / 0.012);
    const taper = smoothstep(g1 - 0.02, g1 - 0.01, y) * -0.0003;
    return octagon(th, A + flare + taper) + ridge;
  }, 192);
  // finishing tape at the top of the grip
  const tape = lathe(rows(g1 - 0.011, g1, 6), (th, y) => octagon(th, A + 0.0004) * (1 - 0.04 * smoothstep(g1 - 0.003, g1, y)), 128);
  // collar: octagon to the shaft's section
  const collar = lathe(rows(g1 - 0.001, g1 + 0.016, 24), (th, y) => {
    const t = smoothstep(g1, g1 + 0.016, y);
    return (1 - t) * octagon(th, A + 0.0006) + t * (box(th, 0.0101, 0.0124) + 0.0004);
  }, 128);
  // butt cap with a chamfered edge, closed underneath
  const cap = lathe([0, 0.0012, 0.003, 0.0105, g0 + 0.0005], (th, y) => octagon(th, A + 0.0019) * (y < 0.003 ? 0.9 + 0.1 * (y / 0.003) : 1), 128, true);
  return { grip, tape, collar, cap };
}
````````

````````typescript
// The app's what-if physics, so every example number on screen is what the simulator would really return.
// Mirrors ShotSimulator.simulate (apple/RacketKit) and ml/coach_sim.py.
const bounded = (v: number, lo: number, hi: number) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, v));

export type SimInput = { swingKmh: number; pathDeg: number; faceDeg: number; contactXcm: number; contactYcm: number; incomingKmh: number };
export type SimDeltas = { swingPercent?: number; pathDeg?: number; faceDeg?: number; contactXcm?: number; contactYcm?: number };

export const simulate = (p: SimInput) => {
  const swing = bounded(p.swingKmh, 0, 200);
  const distance = Math.hypot(bounded(p.contactXcm, -12, 12), bounded(p.contactYcm, -14, 14));
  const e = 0.42 * Math.max(0.55, 1 - 0.035 * distance);
  const brush = (swing / 3.6) * Math.sin(((bounded(p.pathDeg, -80, 80) - bounded(p.faceDeg, -60, 60)) * Math.PI) / 180);
  const spinRpm = ((0.7 * Math.abs(brush)) / 0.0335) * (60 / (2 * Math.PI));
  return {
    ballKmh: e * bounded(p.incomingKmh, 0, 200) + (1 + e) * swing,
    spinRpm,
    spinType: spinRpm < 600 ? 'flat' : brush > 0 ? 'topspin' : 'slice',
    sweetSpot: distance <= 4,
  };
};

export const applyDeltas = (p: SimInput, d: SimDeltas): SimInput => ({
  ...p,
  swingKmh: p.swingKmh * (1 + (d.swingPercent ?? 0) / 100),
  pathDeg: p.pathDeg + (d.pathDeg ?? 0),
  faceDeg: p.faceDeg + (d.faceDeg ?? 0),
  contactXcm: p.contactXcm + (d.contactXcm ?? 0),
  contactYcm: p.contactYcm + (d.contactYcm ?? 0),
});

export const toMph = (kmh: number) => kmh * 0.621371;
````````

````````typescript
// Small procedural textures (canvas-drawn, so no image assets and fully deterministic).
import * as THREE from 'three';

const canvasTexture = (w: number, h: number, draw: (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D) => void) => {
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = w;
  c.height = h;
  draw(c.getContext('2d')!);
  const t = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  t.wrapS = t.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  t.anisotropy = 8;
  return t;
};

/** 2x2 twill carbon weave, used as a bump map on the frame. */
export const carbonWeave = () =>
  canvasTexture(64, 64, (ctx) => {
    for (let y = 0; y < 8; y++)
      for (let x = 0; x < 8; x++) {
        const over = ((x + y) >> 1) % 2 === 0;
        const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x * 8, y * 8, x * 8 + (over ? 8 : 0), y * 8 + (over ? 0 : 8));
        g.addColorStop(0, '#6a6a6a');
        g.addColorStop(0.5, over ? '#d0d0d0' : '#b0b0b0');
        g.addColorStop(1, '#6a6a6a');
        ctx.fillStyle = g;
        ctx.fillRect(x * 8, y * 8, 8, 8);
      }
  });

/** Overgrip wrap: one slanted overlap groove per tile; repeat along the handle for the spiral. */
export const gripWrap = () =>
  canvasTexture(256, 64, (ctx) => {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#d8d8d8';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 64);
    // fine perforation texture
    for (let i = 0; i < 900; i++) {
      const x = (i * 97) % 256, y = (i * 53) % 64;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#c4c4c4';
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, 1.5, 1.5);
    }
    // the overlap edge, slanting one full turn across the tile
    for (const dx of [-256, 0, 256]) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#5a5a5a';
      ctx.lineWidth = 5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(dx, 64);
      ctx.lineTo(dx + 256, 0);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#f2f2f2';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(dx + 4, 64);
      ctx.lineTo(dx + 260, 0);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  });

````````

````````tsx
import React from 'react';

import { Backdrop, Card, Kicker, Title } from '../components/ui';
import { colors, fonts } from '../config/brand';
import { copy } from '../config/copy';
````````
