````````tsx
const c = copy.builtProof;
const { git, tests, parityClips } = facts;
const LINE = 42; // px per commit subject
const day = (d: string) => new Date(`${d}T00:00:00Z`).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' });

// The repo's real history, read from git before each render (scripts/sync-facts.mjs).
export const BuiltProof: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const most = Math.max(...git.days.map((d) => d.commits));
  const scroll = ramp(frame, 10, 230, (x) => x) * Math.max(0, git.subjects.length * LINE - 620);
  const stats = [tests.swift, tests.python, parityClips];
  return (
    <Backdrop glow={0.08}>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ padding: '70px 0 150px 100px', width: 1020, gap: 20 }}>
        <Kicker style={enter(frame, 4)}>{c.kicker}</Kicker>
        <Title size={76} style={enter(frame, 10)}>{c.title}</Title>
        <div style={{ ...enter(frame, 22), display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', gap: 22 }}>
          <span style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 116, fontWeight: 800, color: colors.accent, lineHeight: 1 }}>{Math.round(git.commits * ramp(frame, 26, 70))}</span>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 36, color: colors.muted }}>commits · {day(git.first)} to {day(git.last)}</span>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: 12, height: 150 }}>
          {git.days.map((d, i) => (
            <div key={d.date} style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'flex-end', height: '100%', gap: 6 }}>
              <div style={{ width: '100%', height: (d.commits / most) * 110 * ramp(frame, 30 + i * 3, 56 + i * 3), minHeight: 3, background: d.commits ? colors.accent : colors.track, borderRadius: 5 }} />
              <div style={{ fontSize: 19, color: colors.muted, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{day(d.date).split(' ')[1]}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 20, marginTop: 6 }}>
          {stats.map((v, i) => (
            <Card key={c.testsLabel[i]} style={{ ...enter(frame, 90 + i * 12), flex: 1, padding: '16px 22px' }}>
              <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 56, fontWeight: 800, lineHeight: 1 }}>{v}</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 24, color: colors.muted, marginTop: 4 }}>{c.testsLabel[i]}</div>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div style={{ ...enter(frame, 130), fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 26, color: colors.better }}>{c.verify}  <span style={{ color: colors.muted }}>· {c.license}</span></div>
      </AbsoluteFill>

      {/* git log, scrolling */}
      <div style={{ ...enter(frame, 6), position: 'absolute', left: 1130, top: 70, width: 720, height: 800, overflow: 'hidden', background: colors.card, border: `1px solid ${colors.track}`, borderRadius: 18, padding: '20px 26px', WebkitMaskImage: 'linear-gradient(180deg, #000 86%, transparent)' }}>
        <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 24, color: colors.accent, marginBottom: 14 }}>$ git log --reverse --oneline</div>
        <div style={{ height: 720, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
          <div style={{ transform: `translateY(${-scroll}px)` }}>
            {git.subjects.map((s) => (
              <div key={s} style={{ fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 21, color: colors.text, height: LINE, whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', lineHeight: `${LINE}px` }}>{s}</div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Backdrop>
  );
};
````````

````````tsx
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';
import { Backdrop, Card, Kicker, Title } from '../components/ui';
import { colors, fonts } from '../config/brand';
import { copy } from '../config/copy';
import facts from '../config/generated/facts.json';
import { enter, ramp, rand } from '../lib/anim';

const c = copy.clubFinding;
// Beat timings (frames)
const T = { stream: 16, stat: 40, pivot: 150, steps: 172, stepEvery: 14 };
const COLS = 40, ROWS = 22, CELL = 21;

// The Oct 28 club session: most of the raw stream never arrived, so the shot moved onto the racket.
export const ClubFinding: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const sweep = ramp(frame, T.stream, T.pivot - 20, (x) => x);
  const after = ramp(frame, T.pivot, T.pivot + 16);
  const percent = Math.round(c.arrivedPercent * ramp(frame, T.stat, T.pivot - 40));
  return (
    <Backdrop glow={0.08}>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ padding: '0 0 60px 110px', width: 810, gap: 18, justifyContent: 'center' }}>
        <Kicker style={enter(frame, 4)}>{c.kicker} · {facts.clubMinutes} minutes</Kicker>
        <div style={{ position: 'relative', height: 250 }}>
          <Title size={76} style={{ position: 'absolute', opacity: (1 - after) * ramp(frame, 10, 24) }}>{c.title}</Title>
          <Title size={76} style={{ position: 'absolute', opacity: after, color: colors.accent }}>{c.pivot}</Title>
        </div>
        <div style={{ ...enter(frame, T.stat), fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 170, fontWeight: 800, lineHeight: 1, color: colors.accent }}>{percent}%</div>
        <div style={{ ...enter(frame, T.stat + 8), fontSize: 36, color: colors.muted }}>{c.arrivedLabel}</div>
      </AbsoluteFill>

      {/* One cell per slice of the stream, in time order: lit only if it arrived. */}
      <svg width={COLS * CELL} height={ROWS * CELL} style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 980, top: 290, opacity: 1 - after }}>
        {Array.from({ length: COLS * ROWS }, (_, i) => {
          const x = i % COLS, y = Math.floor(i / COLS);
          const seen = x / COLS < sweep;
          const arrived = rand(i * 3 + 11) < c.arrivedPercent / 100;
          return <rect key={i} x={x * CELL} y={y * CELL} width={CELL - 4} height={CELL - 4} rx={3} fill={!seen ? colors.card : arrived ? colors.accent : colors.track} />;
        })}
      </svg>

      <AbsoluteFill style={{ left: 980, width: 840, justifyContent: 'center', gap: 24, paddingBottom: 60 }}>
        {c.steps.map((s, i) => {
          const at = T.steps + i * T.stepEvery;
          return (
            <Card key={s.big} style={{ ...enter(frame, at), display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 30, padding: '24px 32px' }}>
              <span style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 68, fontWeight: 800, color: colors.accent, minWidth: 320, lineHeight: 1 }}>{s.big}</span>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 32, color: colors.text, lineHeight: 1.2 }}>{s.small}</span>
            </Card>
          );
        })}
      </AbsoluteFill>
    </Backdrop>
  );
};
````````

````````tsx
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, Img, staticFile, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig } from 'remotion';
import { Backdrop, Kicker } from '../components/ui';
import { colors, fonts } from '../config/brand';
import { copy } from '../config/copy';
import { enter, pop, rand } from '../lib/anim';

const shot = copy.impact;
const SOURCE = { x: 210, y: 600 };
const TARGETS = [
  { x: 640, y: 560, at: 18 }, // phone
  { x: 1090, y: 600, at: 30 }, // watch
  { x: 1560, y: 560, at: 42 }, // glasses
];

/** Bluetooth packets: dots travelling from the handle to each device. */
const Stream: React.FC<{ frame: number }> = ({ frame }) => (
  <svg width={1920} height={1080} style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0 }}>
    {TARGETS.map((t, k) =>
      Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => {
        const p = ((frame - t.at + i * 9 + rand(i + k * 10) * 6) % 90) / 90;
        if (frame < t.at || p < 0) return null;
        const cx = SOURCE.x + (t.x - SOURCE.x) * p;
        const cy = SOURCE.y + (t.y - SOURCE.y) * p - Math.sin(p * Math.PI) * 140;
        return <circle key={`${k}-${i}`} cx={cx} cy={cy} r={5} fill={colors.accent} opacity={Math.sin(p * Math.PI)} />;
      }),
    )}
  </svg>
);

const Label: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => (
  <div style={{ fontSize: 28, color: colors.muted, marginTop: 22, textAlign: 'center' }}>{children}</div>
);

export const Phone: React.FC = () => (
  <div style={{ width: 340, height: 700, borderRadius: 54, background: '#000', border: '10px solid #2b2d27', padding: '60px 26px 26px', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}>

    </div>
    <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 130, fontWeight: 800, lineHeight: 1 }}>{shot.speed}</div>
    <div style={{ fontSize: 22, color: colors.muted }}>{shot.unit} ball speed</div>
    <div style={{ height: 1, background: colors.track, margin: '18px 0' }} />
    <div style={{ fontSize: 22, color: colors.muted }}>{shot.sub}</div>
    <div style={{ flex: 1 }} />
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 16, color: colors.muted }}>
      {copy.devices.tabs.map((t) => <span key={t} style={{ color: t === 'Live' ? colors.accent : undefined }}>{t}</span>)}
    </div>
  </div>
);

export const Watch: React.FC = () => (
  <div style={{ width: 250, height: 300, borderRadius: 70, background: '#000', border: '12px solid #2b2d27', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
    <div style={{ fontSize: 22, color: colors.better }}>{shot.badge}</div>
    <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 104, fontWeight: 800, lineHeight: 1 }}>{shot.speed}</div>
    <div style={{ fontSize: 24, color: colors.muted }}>{shot.unit}</div>
  </div>
);

export const Glasses: React.FC = () => (
  <div style={{ width: 520, height: 330, borderRadius: 24, overflow: 'hidden', position: 'relative', border: `2px solid ${colors.track}` }}>
    <Img src={staticFile('img/court.jpg')} style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover', filter: 'blur(1.5px) brightness(0.85)' }} />
    <div style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 26, top: 50, width: 270, padding: '14px 18px', borderRadius: 18, border: '2px solid rgba(94,220,138,0.8)', background: 'rgba(20,24,18,0.45)', backdropFilter: 'blur(6px)' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 700, alignItems: 'center' }}>
        {shot.stroke}<span style={{ fontSize: 14, color: colors.better }}>{shot.badge}</span>
      </div>

// One shot fans out over Bluetooth to phone, watch and glasses.
export const Devices: React.FC = () => {

  const devices = [

  return (
````````

````````tsx
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';
import { Backdrop, Card, Kicker, Title } from '../components/ui';
import { colors, fonts } from '../config/brand';
import { copy } from '../config/copy';
import facts from '../config/generated/facts.json';
import { enter, ramp } from '../lib/anim';

const c = copy.evidence;
// Beat timings (frames)
const T = { parity: 20, distance: 60, whatIf: 100, source: 170 };

const CARD: React.CSSProperties = { flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: 36 };
const LABEL: React.CSSProperties = { fontSize: 38, fontWeight: 700, lineHeight: 1.15 };
const DETAIL: React.CSSProperties = { fontSize: 31, color: colors.muted, lineHeight: 1.3 };

const Big: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode; color?: string }> = ({ children, color = colors.text }) => (
  <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 112, fontWeight: 800, lineHeight: 1, color, letterSpacing: -3 }}>{children}</div>
);

const Bar: React.FC<{ value: number; max: number; color: string; t: number; label: string }> = ({ value, max, color, t, label }) => (
  <div style={{ marginTop: 20 }}>
    <div style={{ fontSize: 28, color: colors.muted, lineHeight: 1.2 }}>{label}</div>
    <div style={{ height: 20, background: colors.track, borderRadius: 10, marginTop: 8 }}>
      <div style={{ height: '100%', width: `${((value * t) / max) * 100}%`, background: color, borderRadius: 10 }} />
    </div>
  </div>
);

// Measured results only, each with its comparison or its caveat on screen.
export const Evidence: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const { parityClips: clips, sweetSpot } = facts;
  const grow = ramp(frame, T.distance + 10, T.distance + 40);
  return (
    <Backdrop glow={0.08}>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ padding: '70px 100px 150px', gap: 30 }}>
        <div>
          <Kicker style={enter(frame, 4)}>{c.kicker}</Kicker>
          <Title size={76} style={{ ...enter(frame, 10), marginTop: 10 }}>{c.title}</Title>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 28, flex: 1 }}>
          <Card style={{ ...enter(frame, T.parity), ...CARD }}>
            <div style={LABEL}>{c.parity.label}</div>
            <Big color={colors.better}>{Math.round(clips * ramp(frame, T.parity + 8, T.parity + 34))}/{clips}</Big>
            <div style={DETAIL}>{c.parity.detail}</div>
          </Card>
          <Card style={{ ...enter(frame, T.distance), ...CARD }}>
            <div style={LABEL}>{c.distance.label}</div>
            <Big color={colors.better}>{sweetSpot.errorCm} cm</Big>
            <div>
              <Bar value={sweetSpot.errorCm} max={3} color={colors.better} t={grow} label={`${c.distance.detail}: ${sweetSpot.errorCm} cm`} />
              <Bar value={c.distance.medianCm} max={3} color="#5c6040" t={grow} label={`${c.distance.medianLabel}: ${c.distance.medianCm} cm`} />
            </div>
          </Card>
          <Card style={{ ...enter(frame, T.whatIf), ...CARD }}>
            <div style={LABEL}>{c.whatIf.label}</div>
            <Big color={colors.better}>{(c.whatIf.percent * ramp(frame, T.whatIf + 8, T.whatIf + 34)).toFixed(1)}%</Big>
            <div style={DETAIL}>{c.whatIf.detail}</div>
          </Card>
        </div>
        <div style={{ ...enter(frame, T.source), fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 24, color: colors.muted }}>{c.source}</div>
      </AbsoluteFill>
    </Backdrop>
  );
};
````````

````````tsx
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, Img, staticFile, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig } from 'remotion';
import { colors, fonts } from '../config/brand';
import { copy } from '../config/copy';
import { Vignette } from '../hype/kit';
import { enter, pop, ramp } from '../lib/anim';

const c = copy.glassesPov;
// Frames a shot lands on the HUD
const HITS = [45, 135];

// Looking through Meta Ray-Ban Display: the fields of GlassesHUD.swift in the right lens, over the court.
export const GlassesPov: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const { fps } = useVideoConfig();
  const hits = HITS.filter((h) => frame >= h).length;
  const last = hits ? HITS[hits - 1] : -1;
  const s = hits ? pop(frame, last, fps) : 1;
  const glow = hits ? Math.exp(-(frame - last) / 14) : 0;
  const drift = 1.08 - 0.05 * ramp(frame, 0, 210, (x) => x);
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: '#000', fontFamily: fonts.sans }}>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        <Img src={staticFile('footage/ev-plate-court.jpg')} style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover', transform: `scale(${drift})`, filter: 'blur(1.4px) brightness(0.8) saturate(0.95)' }} />
      </AbsoluteFill>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: 'radial-gradient(ellipse 88% 96% at 54% 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 54%, rgba(0,0,0,0.3) 84%, rgba(0,0,0,0.62) 100%)' }} />
      <Vignette strength={0.3} />

      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 1080, top: 190, width: 620, color: '#fff', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10, padding: '30px 36px', borderRadius: 30, background: 'rgba(12,14,12,0.72)', backdropFilter: 'blur(10px)', border: `2px solid rgba(94,220,138,${0.25 + glow * 0.75})`, boxShadow: `0 0 ${20 + glow * 60}px rgba(94,220,138,${0.15 + glow * 0.5})` }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 28, color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.65)' }}>{c.elapsed}</div>
        {hits === 0 ? (
          <>
            <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 76, fontWeight: 800 }}>{c.idleTitle}</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 34, color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)' }}>{c.idleDetail}</div>
          </>
        ) : (
          <div style={{ transform: `scale(${0.94 + 0.06 * s})`, transformOrigin: 'left center' }}>
            <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 76, fontWeight: 800 }}>{c.stroke}</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 38, fontWeight: 600, color: colors.better }}>{c.detailSweet}</div>
          </div>
        )}
        <div style={{ fontSize: 28, color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)', marginTop: 10 }}>{c.shots + hits} shots · {c.sweetPercent}% sweet spot</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 34, fontWeight: 600 }}>{c.score}</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 28, color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)' }}>{c.points}</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 28, color: colors.accent, fontWeight: 600 }}>{c.drillName} {c.drillStart + hits}/{c.drillTarget}</div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ ...enter(frame, 8), position: 'absolute', left: 70, top: 60, fontSize: 26, fontWeight: 600, color: colors.text, background: 'rgba(11,12,9,0.72)', padding: '10px 20px', borderRadius: 12 }}>{c.badge}</div>
      <div style={{ ...enter(frame, 14), position: 'absolute', left: 70, top: 118, fontSize: 22, color: colors.muted, background: 'rgba(11,12,9,0.72)', padding: '7px 16px', borderRadius: 10 }}>{c.tag}</div>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};
````````

````````tsx
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, interpolate, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig } from 'remotion';
import { Racket } from '../components/Racket';
import { Stage3D } from '../components/Stage3D';
import { Backdrop, Card, Kicker } from '../components/ui';
import { colors, fonts } from '../config/brand';
import { copy } from '../config/copy';
import { enter, lerp, pop, ramp, rand } from '../lib/anim';

const HIT = 60; // frame the ball meets the strings
const RACKET_X = -1.9;
const SWEET: [number, number, number] = [RACKET_X, 0.78, 0.05];

// Synthetic sensor traces shaped like the real ones: swing bell (gyro),
// impact spike + ringing (high-g), broadband burst (mic). Illustrative, not data.
const N = 220;
const HIT_AT = 0.55;
const signal = (kind: number, i: number) => {
  const x = i / N;
  const after = x - HIT_AT;
  if (kind === 0) return Math.exp(-((x - 0.5) ** 2) / 0.02) * 0.8 - (after > 0 ? 0.25 * Math.exp(-after * 20) : 0) + (rand(i) - 0.5) * 0.04;
  if (kind === 1) return (after >= 0 ? Math.exp(-after * 30) * Math.cos(after * 260) * 0.95 : 0) + (rand(i + 99) - 0.5) * 0.06;
  return (after >= 0 ? Math.exp(-after * 14) * (rand(i + 7) - 0.5) * 1.8 : (rand(i + 7) - 0.5) * 0.05);
};

const Trace: React.FC<{ kind: number; label: string; progress: number }> = ({ kind, label, progress }) => {
  const w = 760, h = 120;
  const count = Math.max(2, Math.floor(N * progress));
  const d = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => `${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${(i / N) * w},${h / 2 - signal(kind, i) * (h / 2 - 6)}`).join(' ');
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 24 }}>
      <div style={{ width: 200, fontSize: 28, color: colors.muted, textAlign: 'right' }}>{label}</div>
      <svg width={w} height={h} style={{ background: colors.card, borderRadius: 14 }}>
        <line x1={HIT_AT * w} x2={HIT_AT * w} y1={0} y2={h} stroke={colors.track} strokeWidth={2} />
        <path d={d} fill="none" stroke={kind === 1 ? colors.accent : colors.text} strokeWidth={3} strokeLinejoin="round" />
      </svg>
    </div>
  );
};

export const Impact: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const { fps } = useVideoConfig();
  const t = frame - HIT;

  // Ball: in from right-front, out to the left after contact.
  const inT = ramp(frame, 18, HIT, (x) => x);
  const outT = ramp(frame, HIT, HIT + 40, (x) => x);
  const ball: [number, number, number] = frame < HIT
    ? [lerp(2.6, SWEET[0], inT), lerp(1.5, SWEET[1], inT), lerp(3.2, SWEET[2] + 0.15, inT)]
    : [lerp(SWEET[0], SWEET[0] - 2.4, outT), lerp(SWEET[1], 1.9, outT), lerp(SWEET[2] + 0.15, 3.6, outT)];
  const wobble = t > 0 ? Math.exp(-t / 9) * Math.sin(t * 1.9) * 0.05 : 0;
  const ring = t > 0 ? ramp(frame, HIT, HIT + 24) : 0;

  // Traces sweep in sync with the ball: the impact spike draws exactly on HIT.
  const progress = interpolate(frame, [HIT - HIT_AT * 70, HIT + (1 - HIT_AT) * 70], [0, 1], { extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp' });
  const readout = pop(frame, HIT + 30, fps);
  const speed = Math.round(copy.impact.speed * ramp(frame, HIT + 30, HIT + 60));

  return (
    <Backdrop glow={0.08 + (t > 0 ? 0.2 * Math.exp(-t / 10) : 0)}>
      <Stage3D camera={[0, 0.6, 7.2]} target={[0, 0.3, 0]} fov={34} env="studio" envIntensity={1.4} hero>
        <pointLight position={[-2.4, 2.2, -1.8]} intensity={40} distance={8} color="#ffffff" />
        <Racket position={[RACKET_X, 0, 0]} rotation={[wobble, 0.35, wobble * 0.5]} />
        <mesh position={ball}>
          <sphereGeometry args={[0.15, 48, 48]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#D9EE3F" roughness={0.9} />
        </mesh>
        {ring > 0 && ring < 1 && (
          <mesh position={SWEET} rotation={[0, 0.35, 0]} scale={0.2 + ring * 2.2}>
            <torusGeometry args={[0.5, 0.012, 8, 96]} />
            <meshBasicMaterial color={colors.accent} transparent opacity={1 - ring} />
          </mesh>
        )}
      </Stage3D>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ padding: '100px 110px', alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: 22 }}>
        <Kicker style={{ ...enter(frame, 4), alignSelf: 'flex-end', marginRight: 0 }}>{copy.impact.kicker}</Kicker>
        {copy.impact.traces.map((label, k) => <Trace key={label} kind={k} label={label} progress={progress} />)}
        <Card style={{ marginTop: 18, width: 760, opacity: readout, transform: `scale(${0.92 + 0.08 * readout})`, transformOrigin: 'right top', border: `2px solid ${colors.better}` }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 18, fontSize: 38, fontWeight: 700 }}>
            {copy.impact.stroke}
            <span style={{ fontSize: 26, color: colors.better, background: 'rgba(94,220,138,0.15)', padding: '4px 14px', borderRadius: 20 }}>{copy.impact.badge}</span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', gap: 14 }}>
            <span style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 140, fontWeight: 800, lineHeight: 1 }}>{speed}</span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 44, color: colors.muted }}>{copy.impact.unit}</span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 32, color: colors.muted, marginTop: 6 }}>{copy.impact.sub}</div>
        </Card>
      </AbsoluteFill>
    </Backdrop>
  );
};

````````

````````tsx
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, interpolate, useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';
import { Stage3D } from '../components/Stage3D';
import { Backdrop, Kicker, Title } from '../components/ui';
import { colors } from '../config/brand';
import { copy } from '../config/copy';
import { enter, ramp } from '../lib/anim';
import { useCad, type CadGroup } from '../lib/models';

// Timing (frames at 30 fps)
const EXPLODE = [40, 100] as const;
const LABEL_START = 105;
const LABEL_EVERY = 36;

export const Part: React.FC<{ group?: CadGroup; offset?: [number, number, number]; glow?: number; ghost?: boolean }> = ({ group, offset = [0, 0, 0], glow = 0, ghost }) => {
  if (!group) return null;
  return (
    <group position={offset}>
      {group.meshes.map((m, i) => (
        <mesh key={i} geometry={m.geometry}>
          <meshStandardMaterial
            color={ghost ? '#2a2d24' : m.color}
            metalness={ghost ? 0.1 : 0.35}
            roughness={ghost ? 0.35 : 0.5}
            transparent={ghost}
            opacity={ghost ? 0.55 : 1}
            emissive={colors.accent}
            emissiveIntensity={glow * 0.9}
          />
        </mesh>
      ))}
    </group>
  );
};

// Exploded view of the real handle insert (Onshape STEP → public/models/handle.json).
export const InsideHandle: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const cad = useCad('handle');
  const parts = copy.insideHandle.parts;
  const explode = ramp(frame, ...EXPLODE);
  const active = Math.floor((frame - LABEL_START) / LABEL_EVERY);
  const glowFor = (name: string) => {
    const i = parts.findIndex((p) => p.part === name);
    if (i < 0 || i !== Math.min(active, parts.length - 1) || frame < LABEL_START) return 0;
    const local = frame - LABEL_START - i * LABEL_EVERY;
    return i === parts.length - 1 && local > LABEL_EVERY ? 0.35 : 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(local / 4);
  };
  const turn = interpolate(frame, [0, 270], [-0.5, 0.35]);
  const lift = 22 * explode; // mm

  return (
    <Backdrop glow={0.1}>
      <Stage3D camera={[0, 3.2, 5.4]} target={[0, -0.1, 0]} fov={34}>
        {cad && (
          <group position={[-1.5, 0.05, 0]} rotation={[0, turn, 0]}>
            {/* mm → scene units; CAD length (Z) laid along screen X */}
            <group scale={0.036} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0]}>
              <group position={cad.center.clone().negate().toArray()}>
                <Part group={cad.groups.shell1} offset={[0, lift, 0]} ghost />
                <Part group={cad.groups.shell2} offset={[0, -lift, 0]} ghost />
                <Part group={cad.groups.screws} offset={[0, -lift, 0]} />
                <Part group={cad.groups.button} offset={[0, lift, 0]} />
                <Part group={cad.groups.board} glow={glowFor('board')} />
                <Part group={cad.groups.imu} offset={[0, 4 * explode, 0]} glow={glowFor('imu')} />
                <Part group={cad.groups.mic} offset={[0, 4 * explode, 0]} glow={glowFor('mic')} />
                <Part group={cad.groups.mcu} offset={[0, 4 * explode, 0]} glow={glowFor('mcu')} />
              </group>
            </group>
          </group>
        )}
      </Stage3D>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ padding: '110px 120px', alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
        <div style={{ width: 640, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
          <Kicker style={enter(frame, 6)}>{copy.insideHandle.kicker}</Kicker>
          <Title size={64} style={enter(frame, 14)}>{copy.insideHandle.title}</Title>
          <div style={{ height: 30 }} />
          {parts.map((p, i) => {
            const on = frame >= LABEL_START + i * LABEL_EVERY;
            const current = i === Math.min(active, parts.length - 1);
            return (
              <div key={p.part} style={{ ...enter(frame, LABEL_START + i * LABEL_EVERY, 12), display: 'flex', gap: 20, alignItems: 'flex-start', padding: '16px 0', borderTop: `1px solid ${colors.track}`, opacity: on ? (current ? 1 : 0.55) : 0 }}>
                <div style={{ width: 14, height: 14, borderRadius: 7, marginTop: 14, background: current ? colors.accent : colors.track }} />
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 40, fontWeight: 700 }}>{p.name}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 28, color: colors.muted, marginTop: 4 }}>{p.detail}</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </AbsoluteFill>
    </Backdrop>
  );
};
````````

````````tsx
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';
import { Backdrop, Kicker } from '../components/ui';
import { colors, fonts } from '../config/brand';
import { copy } from '../config/copy';
import facts from '../config/generated/facts.json';
import { enter, ramp } from '../lib/anim';

const c = copy.museAgent;
// Beat timings (frames): each call starts, its result lands, then the answer.
const T = { ask: 12, calls: [{ at: 66, result: 112 }, { at: 150, result: 205 }], answer: 250, rule: 300 };
const HUB = { x: 1340, y: 450 };
// Tool groups around Muse, in the order of copy.museAgent.groups.
const GROUP_AT = [{ x: 1085, y: 175 }, { x: 1600, y: 175 }, { x: 1085, y: 725 }, { x: 1600, y: 725 }];

const Line: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode; dir: string; style?: React.CSSProperties }> = ({ children, dir, style }) => (
  <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 26, lineHeight: 1.35, display: 'flex', gap: 14, ...style }}>
    <span style={{ color: colors.accent, flexShrink: 0 }}>{dir}</span><span>{children}</span>
  </div>
);

// Muse Spark as a tool-calling agent: the tools around it light up as it uses them on a real trace.
export const MuseAgent: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const current = T.calls.findIndex((t) => frame >= t.at && frame < t.result);
  const activeTool = current >= 0 ? c.calls[current].tool : null;
  const used = c.calls.filter((_, i) => frame >= T.calls[i].at).map((x) => x.tool);
  return (
    <Backdrop glow={0.06}>
      {/* Transcript */}
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ left: 70, width: 790, padding: '60px 0 150px', gap: 18 }}>
        <Kicker style={enter(frame, 4)}>{c.kicker}</Kicker>
        <div style={{ ...enter(frame, T.ask), alignSelf: 'flex-end', maxWidth: 640, background: colors.accent, color: '#11130c', fontSize: 31, fontWeight: 600, padding: '16px 24px', borderRadius: '24px 24px 6px 24px', lineHeight: 1.25, marginTop: 6 }}>{c.question}</div>
        {c.calls.map((call, i) => (
          <div key={call.tool} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
            <Line dir="→" style={{ ...enter(frame, T.calls[i].at), color: colors.text }}><b>{call.tool}</b>({call.args})</Line>
            <Line dir="←" style={{ ...enter(frame, T.calls[i].result), color: colors.muted }}>{call.result}</Line>
          </div>
        ))}
        <div style={{ ...enter(frame, T.answer), fontSize: 32, lineHeight: 1.3, background: colors.card, border: `1px solid ${colors.track}`, padding: '16px 24px', borderRadius: '24px 24px 24px 6px' }}>{c.answer}</div>
        <div style={{ ...enter(frame, T.answer + 12), fontSize: 22, color: colors.muted }}>{c.traceNote}</div>
      </AbsoluteFill>

      {/* Wires from Muse to each tool group */}
      <svg width={1920} height={1080} style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0 }}>
        {c.groups.map((g, i) => {
          const hot = activeTool !== null && g.tools.includes(activeTool);
          const p = GROUP_AT[i];
          const pulse = hot ? ((frame * 2) % 30) / 30 : 0;
          return (
            <g key={g.name}>
              <line x1={HUB.x} y1={HUB.y} x2={p.x} y2={p.y} stroke={hot ? colors.accent : colors.track} strokeWidth={hot ? 4 : 2} />
              {hot && <circle cx={HUB.x + (p.x - HUB.x) * pulse} cy={HUB.y + (p.y - HUB.y) * pulse} r={9} fill={colors.accent} />}
            </g>
          );
        })}
      </svg>

      {/* Muse */}
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: HUB.x - 145, top: HUB.y - 95, width: 290, height: 190, borderRadius: 28, background: colors.card, border: `3px solid ${colors.accent}`, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', opacity: ramp(frame, 0, 12), boxShadow: `0 0 ${activeTool ? 70 : 30}px rgba(221,232,91,${activeTool ? 0.45 : 0.18})` }}>
        <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 46, fontWeight: 800 }}>Muse Spark</div>
        <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 24, color: colors.muted }}>{facts.model}</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 26, color: colors.accent, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 6 }}>{facts.agentTools.length} tools</div>
      </div>

      {/* Tool groups */}
      {c.groups.map((g, i) => (
        <div key={g.name} style={{ ...enter(frame, 14 + i * 5), position: 'absolute', left: GROUP_AT[i].x - 190, top: GROUP_AT[i].y - 125, width: 380, background: colors.bg, border: `1px solid ${colors.track}`, borderRadius: 18, padding: '14px 18px' }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 8, color: colors.muted }}>{g.name}</div>
          {g.tools.map((t) => (
            <div key={t} style={{ fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 24, padding: '3px 8px', borderRadius: 8, color: t === activeTool ? '#11130c' : used.includes(t) ? colors.accent : colors.text, background: t === activeTool ? colors.accent : 'transparent', fontWeight: t === activeTool ? 700 : 400 }}>{t}</div>
          ))}
        </div>
      ))}

      {/* The rule and the limits, below the graph */}
      <div style={{ ...enter(frame, T.rule), position: 'absolute', left: 900, right: 40, top: 880, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4, alignItems: 'center', fontSize: 30 }}>
        <span style={{ color: colors.accent, fontWeight: 700 }}>{c.rule}</span>
        <span style={{ color: colors.muted, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 23 }}>{facts.agentLimits.max_requests_per_round} requests · {facts.agentLimits.max_tool_calls_per_round} tool calls · {facts.agentLimits.timeout_s} s per round</span>
      </div>
    </Backdrop>
  );
};
````````

````````tsx
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, Easing, interpolate, useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';
import { RealRacket } from '../components/RealRacket';
import { Stage3D } from '../components/Stage3D';
import { Backdrop, Title } from '../components/ui';
import { colors } from '../config/brand';
import { copy } from '../config/copy';
import { enter, ramp } from '../lib/anim';

type V3 = [number, number, number];
const ease = Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic);

/** Camera keyframes: [frame, position, target, fov]. Edit these to re-frame the shot. */
const SHOT: [number, V3, V3, number][] = [
  [0, [-0.35, 1.55, 1.15], [-0.95, 1.25, 0], 22], // macro on the top of the hoop
  [55, [0.05, 0.55, 1.9], [-0.85, 0.55, 0], 24], // tracking down the beam
  [125, [0, 0.15, 6.1], [0, 0.05, 0], 32], // hero framing, racket left, title right
];

const along = (frame: number, pick: (k: (typeof SHOT)[number]) => number) =>
  interpolate(frame, SHOT.map((k) => k[0]), SHOT.map(pick), { easing: ease, extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp' });

// Opening hero shot: macro along the frame, light sweeping the clearcoat, pull back to reveal.
export const RacketReveal: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const cam: V3 = [0, 1, 2].map((i) => along(frame, (k) => k[1][i])) as V3;
  const target: V3 = [0, 1, 2].map((i) => along(frame, (k) => k[2][i])) as V3;
  const fov = along(frame, (k) => k[3]);

  // Edge-on to three-quarter, then a slow drift so the hero frame never sits dead still.
  const turn = interpolate(frame, [0, 125, 200], [1.35, 0.42, 0.32], { easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp' });
  const sweepX = interpolate(frame, [0, 90], [-4, 4], { easing: ease, extrapolateRight: 'clamp' });
  const fadeIn = ramp(frame, 0, 18);

  return (
    <Backdrop glow={0.1 * ramp(frame, 60, 125)}>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ opacity: fadeIn }}>
        <Stage3D camera={cam} target={target} fov={fov} env="studio" envIntensity={1.4} hero>
          {/* back rim light: separates the dark frame from the dark background */}
          <pointLight position={[-0.6, 2.2, -1.8]} intensity={40} distance={8} color="#ffffff" />
          <pointLight position={[-2.2, -1.2, -1.2]} intensity={18} distance={6} color={colors.accent} />
          {/* moving glint across the clearcoat during the macro */}
          <pointLight position={[sweepX, 1.6, 2.2]} intensity={25 * (1 - ramp(frame, 80, 110))} distance={8} color="#ffffff" />
          <RealRacket position={[-1.1, 0, 0]} rotation={[0.1, turn, -0.16]} />
        </Stage3D>
      </AbsoluteFill>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ justifyContent: 'center', paddingLeft: 1000, gap: 16 }}>
        <Title size={124} style={enter(frame, 100, 18)}>{copy.reveal.name}</Title>
        <div style={{ ...enter(frame, 114, 18), fontSize: 46, color: colors.muted }}>{copy.reveal.tagline}</div>
        <div style={{ ...enter(frame, 126, 18), width: 120, height: 6, borderRadius: 3, background: colors.accent, marginTop: 12 }} />
      </AbsoluteFill>
    </Backdrop>
  );
};

````````

````````tsx
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, interpolate, useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';
import { Stage3D, useRedraw } from '../components/Stage3D';
import { Backdrop, Kicker, Title } from '../components/ui';
import { colors } from '../config/brand';
import { copy } from '../config/copy';
import { enter, lerp, ramp } from '../lib/anim';
import { useCad, type CadGroup } from '../lib/models';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { Racket, RACKET_LENGTH } from '../components/Racket';

// CAD is in mm, Z up (Onshape). J1 (base yaw) = centre of the turret on top of the base.
const J1: [number, number] = [56, 22];
const TURRET_TOP = 244;
// J2 (shoulder pitch): centre of the round boss at the bottom of arm_2, axis along Y.
const J2: [number, number, number] = [-44, 22, 438];
const SCALE = 0.0036;
const CONTACTS = [76, 171]; // frames where the strings meet the ball (beats 4 and 9 at 95 BPM)
const HEAD: [number, number, number] = [-545, -430, 871]; // string-bed centre at swing angle 0
const BACK = -0.6, THROUGH = 0.6;

const smooth = (x: number) => x * x * (3 - 2 * x);
/** Slow wind-up, fast swing through contact, slow recovery. */
const swingAngle = (f: number) => {
  for (let k = 0; k < CONTACTS.length; k++) {
    const c = CONTACTS[k];
    const prevEnd = k === 0 ? 0 : CONTACTS[k - 1] + 20;
    if (f < c - 20) return k === 0 ? lerp(0, BACK, smooth(Math.min(1, f / (c - 20)))) : lerp(THROUGH, BACK, smooth((f - prevEnd) / (c - 20 - prevEnd)));
    if (f <= c + 20) return BACK + (THROUGH - BACK) * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.tanh((f - c) / 5) / Math.tanh(4));
  }
  return THROUGH;
};

const Group: React.FC<{ group?: CadGroup; glow?: number }> = ({ group, glow = 0 }) => (
  <>
    {group?.meshes.map((m, i) => (
      <mesh key={i} geometry={m.geometry}>
        <meshStandardMaterial color={m.color} metalness={0.25} roughness={0.45} emissive={colors.accent} emissiveIntensity={glow} />
      </mesh>
    ))}
  </>
);

/**
 * STAND-IN for link 1 (J1 → J2), which is missing from the STEP export: a column on
 * the J1 turret plus the J2 hub that arm_2 pivots on. Used only while the export has
 * no `_arm_1` mesh; re-export with it and this disappears automatically.
 */
const Shoulder: React.FC<{ color?: THREE.Color }> = ({ color }) => {
  const mat = <meshStandardMaterial color={color ?? '#e8e8e4'} metalness={0.25} roughness={0.45} />;
  const columnH = J2[2] - TURRET_TOP;
  return (
    <>
      {/* column rising from the turret (cylinder axis Y → CAD Z) */}
      <mesh position={[J1[0], J1[1], TURRET_TOP + columnH / 2]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
        <cylinderGeometry args={[82, 88, columnH, 64]} />
        {mat}
      </mesh>
      {/* dome cap (hemisphere's +Y turned to CAD +Z) */}
      <mesh position={[J1[0], J1[1], J2[2]]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[82, 40, 82]}>
        <sphereGeometry args={[1, 48, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2]} />
        {mat}
      </mesh>
      {/* J2 hub joining the column to the bottom of arm_2 (axis along CAD Y) */}
      <mesh position={J2}>
        <cylinderGeometry args={[70, 70, 150, 64]} />
        {mat}
      </mesh>
      <mesh position={[(J1[0] + J2[0]) / 2, J2[1], J2[2] - 20]}>
        <boxGeometry args={[J1[0] - J2[0], 150, 100]} />
        {mat}
      </mesh>
    </>
  );
};

/**
 * The Epson C8 rig from the Onshape assembly, scaled to scene units and stood on a grid.
 * `angle` turns everything above the base about J1; children are placed in CAD space (mm).
 */
// The CAD racket (`Body1`) is a bare hoop. `racket="blue"` draws the strung procedural racket
// in its place: same 833 mm length, centred on the CAD one, head toward CAD -Y, face along X.
const CAD_RACKET = { center: [-545, -212.5, 871] as [number, number, number], length: 833 };
const RACKET_TO_CAD = new THREE.Euler().setFromRotationMatrix(
  new THREE.Matrix4().makeBasis(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1), new THREE.Vector3(0, -1, 0), new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0)),
);

export const RobotArm: React.FC<{ angle: number; glow?: number; racketGlow?: number; grid?: boolean; racket?: 'cad' | 'blue'; children?: React.ReactNode }> = ({ angle, glow = 0, racketGlow = 0, grid = true, racket = 'cad', children }) => {
  const cad = useCad('robot');
  useRedraw([cad]); // loaded inside the canvas, so ask it to draw once the CAD arrives
  if (!cad) return null;
  return (
    <group position={[-0.9, 0, 0]}>
      {grid && <gridHelper args={[14, 28, colors.track, '#1a1d14']} position={[0, (-28 - cad.center.z) * SCALE, 0]} />}
      <group scale={SCALE} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
        <group position={cad.center.clone().negate().toArray()}>
          <Group group={cad.groups.base} glow={glow} />
          <Group group={cad.groups.uno} glow={glow} />
          <Group group={cad.groups.rig} glow={glow} />
          <group position={[J1[0], J1[1], 0]} rotation={[0, 0, angle]}>
            <group position={[-J1[0], -J1[1], 0]}>
              {cad.groups.shoulder ? <Group group={cad.groups.shoulder} glow={glow} /> : <Shoulder color={cad.groups.base?.meshes[0].color} />}
              <Group group={cad.groups.swing} glow={glow} />
              {racket === 'cad' ? (
                <Group group={cad.groups.racket} glow={Math.max(glow, racketGlow)} />
              ) : (
                <group position={CAD_RACKET.center} rotation={RACKET_TO_CAD} scale={CAD_RACKET.length / RACKET_LENGTH}>
                  <Racket finish="blue" glow={Math.max(glow, racketGlow)} />
                </group>
              )}
            </group>
          </group>
          {children}
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  );
};

// The Epson C8 test rig from the Onshape assembly, swinging the racket into balls.
export const RobotLab: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const angle = swingAngle(frame);
  const orbit = interpolate(frame, [0, 240], [-0.9, -0.35]);
  const cam: [number, number, number] = [Math.sin(orbit) * 7.4, 1.6, Math.cos(orbit) * 7.4];

  // Ball in CAD space: in from the string side (-X), back out after contact.
  const c = CONTACTS.find((x) => frame < x + 30) ?? CONTACTS[CONTACTS.length - 1];
  const inT = ramp(frame, c - 22, c, (x) => x);
  const outT = ramp(frame, c, c + 26, (x) => x);
  const ball: [number, number, number] = frame < c
    ? [lerp(-1900, HEAD[0] - 40, inT), lerp(HEAD[1] - 300, HEAD[1], inT), lerp(HEAD[2] + 160, HEAD[2], inT)]
    : [lerp(HEAD[0] - 40, -2200, outT), lerp(HEAD[1], HEAD[1] - 900, outT), lerp(HEAD[2], HEAD[2] + 500, outT)];
  const flash = copy.robotLab.showBalls ? Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(frame - c) / 8) : 0;

  return (
    <Backdrop glow={0.08}>
      <Stage3D camera={cam} target={[0.9, 0.4, 0]} fov={36}>
        <RobotArm angle={angle} racketGlow={flash * 0.8} racket="blue">
          {copy.robotLab.showBalls && frame > c - 24 && (
            <mesh position={ball}>
              <sphereGeometry args={[34, 32, 32]} />
              <meshStandardMaterial color="#D9EE3F" roughness={0.9} emissive="#D9EE3F" emissiveIntensity={0.15} />
            </mesh>
          )}
        </RobotArm>
      </Stage3D>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ padding: '110px 120px', alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
        <div style={{ width: 620, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
          <Kicker style={enter(frame, 6)}>{copy.robotLab.kicker}</Kicker>
          <Title size={62} style={enter(frame, 14)}>{copy.robotLab.title}</Title>
          <div style={{ height: 24 }} />
          {copy.robotLab.bullets.map((b, i) => (
            <div key={b} style={{ ...enter(frame, 40 + i * 22), fontSize: 34, display: 'flex', gap: 16, alignItems: 'center', padding: '10px 0' }}>
              <div style={{ width: 10, height: 10, borderRadius: 5, background: colors.accent }} />
              {b}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </AbsoluteFill>
    </Backdrop>
  );
};
````````

````````tsx
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, OffthreadVideo, staticFile, useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';
import { Kicker, Title } from '../components/ui';
import { colors, fonts } from '../config/brand';
import { copy } from '../config/copy';
import track from '../config/generated/samTrack.json';
import { Vignette } from '../hype/kit';
import { enter, ramp } from '../lib/anim';

const c = copy.samTrack;
const K = 1920 / track.width;
const TRAIL = 40; // frames of racket path behind the current one
type Box = number[] | null;

const Boxed: React.FC<{ box: Box; color: string; label: string }> = ({ box, color, label }) => {
  if (!box) return null;
  const [x1, y1, x2, y2] = box.map((v) => v * K);
  return (
    <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: x1, top: y1, width: x2 - x1, height: y2 - y1, border: `4px solid ${color}`, borderRadius: 6 }}>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: -4, top: y1 > 44 ? -40 : undefined, bottom: y1 > 44 ? undefined : -40, background: color, color: '#11130c', fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 700, padding: '3px 10px', borderRadius: 6, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
        {label} {box[4].toFixed(2)}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// A real 240 fps forehand, one source frame per video frame, under the real cached SAM 3.1 boxes.
export const SamTrack: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const i = Math.min(frame, track.racket.length - 1);
  const racket = track.racket as Box[], ball = track.ball as Box[];
  const centre = (b: number[]) => `${((b[0] + b[2]) / 2) * K},${((b[1] + b[3]) / 2) * K}`;
  const trail = racket.slice(Math.max(0, i - TRAIL), i + 1).filter((b): b is number[] => !!b).map(centre).join(' ');
  const contact = track.contactIndex ?? -1;
  const flash = contact >= 0 && frame >= contact ? Math.exp(-(frame - contact) / 10) : 0;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: colors.bg, fontFamily: fonts.sans }}>
      <OffthreadVideo src={staticFile('footage/sam-clip.mp4')} muted style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover', filter: 'contrast(1.05) saturate(0.9) brightness(0.82)' }} />
      <Vignette strength={0.5} />
      <svg width={1920} height={1080} style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0 }}>
        <polyline points={trail} fill="none" stroke={colors.accent} strokeWidth={5} strokeLinejoin="round" opacity={0.8} />
      </svg>
      <Boxed box={racket[i]} color={colors.accent} label={c.prompts.racket} />
      <Boxed box={ball[i] ?? null} color={colors.better} label={c.prompts.ball} />
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: colors.accent, opacity: flash * 0.22, mixBlendMode: 'screen' }} />

      <AbsoluteFill style={{ padding: '60px 70px', alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
        <div style={{ width: 760, background: 'rgba(11,12,9,0.78)', borderRadius: 20, padding: '24px 30px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
          <Kicker style={enter(frame, 4)}>{c.kicker}</Kicker>
          <Title size={56} style={{ ...enter(frame, 10), marginTop: 6 }}>{c.title}</Title>
          <div style={{ ...enter(frame, 24), fontSize: 28, color: colors.muted, marginTop: 10, lineHeight: 1.25 }}>{c.stat}</div>
          <div style={{ ...enter(frame, 36), fontSize: 30, color: colors.accent, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 8 }}>{c.purpose}</div>
          <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 24, color: colors.muted, marginTop: 10, opacity: ramp(frame, 40, 50) }}>frame {track.startFrame + i}</div>
        </div>
      </AbsoluteFill>
      {contact >= 0 && frame >= contact && (
        <div style={{ ...enter(frame, contact, 6, 12), position: 'absolute', left: 70, top: 60, fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 64, fontWeight: 800, color: colors.accent }}>{c.contact}</div>
      )}
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};
````````

````````tsx
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';
import { Backdrop, Title } from '../components/ui';
import { colors, fonts } from '../config/brand';
import { copy } from '../config/copy';
import { enter, ramp } from '../lib/anim';

// Each double-tap on the handle awards a point. Frames of each tap pair:
const TAPS = [36, 100];
const POINTS = ['0', '15', '30', '40'];
// [you, opponent] point index, games, sets before/after each tap pair
const STATES = [
  { pts: [2, 1], games: [3, 2] },
  { pts: [3, 1], games: [3, 2] },
  { pts: [0, 0], games: [4, 2] },
];

const Row: React.FC<{ name: string; sets: number; games: number; pts: string; serving?: boolean; flash: number }> = ({ name, sets, games, pts, serving, flash }) => (
  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', height: 110, fontFamily: fonts.sans, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 52 }}>
    <div style={{ width: 60, color: colors.accent, fontSize: 30 }}>{serving ? '●' : ''}</div>
    <div style={{ flex: 1, letterSpacing: 2 }}>{name}</div>
    <div style={{ width: 90, textAlign: 'center' }}>{sets}</div>
    <div style={{ width: 90, textAlign: 'center', color: colors.accent }}>{games}</div>
    <div style={{ width: 150, textAlign: 'center', background: `rgba(243,245,236,${0.92})`, color: '#7a3d2c', height: '100%', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', transform: `scale(${1 + flash * 0.12})` }}>{pts}</div>
  </div>
);

export const Score: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const step = TAPS.filter((t) => frame >= t + 8).length;
  const s = STATES[step];
  const flash = TAPS.reduce((m, t) => Math.max(m, 1 - Math.abs(frame - t - 10) / 8), 0);
  const tapRing = (t: number, d: number) => {
    const p = ramp(frame, t + d, t + d + 14);
    return p > 0 && p < 1 ? p : 0;
  };

  return (
    <Backdrop glow={0.08}>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ alignItems: 'center', paddingTop: 110, gap: 18 }}>
        <Title size={84} style={enter(frame, 4)}>{copy.score.title}</Title>
        <div style={{ ...enter(frame, 14), fontSize: 36, color: colors.muted }}>{copy.score.sub}</div>
      </AbsoluteFill>
      {/* Handle, seen end-on, with tap ripples */}
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 300, top: 520, width: 140, height: 330, borderRadius: 30, background: 'linear-gradient(90deg,#1b1d17,#3b3e33,#1b1d17)', border: `2px solid ${colors.track}` }} />
      {TAPS.flatMap((t) => [0, 8].map((d) => {
        const p = tapRing(t, d);
        return p ? <div key={`${t}${d}`} style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 370 - 40 - p * 80, top: 640 - 40 - p * 80, width: 80 + p * 160, height: 80 + p * 160, borderRadius: '50%', border: `4px solid ${colors.accent}`, opacity: 1 - p }} /> : null;
      }))}
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 300, top: 880, width: 140, textAlign: 'center', fontSize: 28, color: colors.accent, opacity: flash > 0 ? 1 : 0.35 }}>tap · tap</div>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 680, top: 560, width: 900, borderRadius: 18, overflow: 'hidden', background: `linear-gradient(90deg, ${colors.score}cc, ${colors.score}88)`, border: '2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4)', ...enter(frame, 10) }}>
        <Row name={copy.score.you} sets={1} games={s.games[0]} pts={POINTS[s.pts[0]]} serving flash={flash} />
        <div style={{ height: 1, background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)' }} />
        <Row name={copy.score.opponent} sets={0} games={s.games[1]} pts={POINTS[s.pts[1]]} flash={0} />
      </div>
    </Backdrop>
  );
};
````````

````````tsx
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig } from 'remotion';
import { Backdrop, Card, Kicker, Title } from '../components/ui';
import { colors, fonts } from '../config/brand';
import { copy } from '../config/copy';
import { enter, pop, ramp } from '../lib/anim';

const c = copy.together;

// Two players' sessions side by side, Strava-style.
export const Together: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const { fps } = useVideoConfig();
  const grow = ramp(frame, 40, 80);
  const [a, b] = c.players;
  const stats = [
    { label: 'Shots', key: 'shots' as const, unit: '' },
    { label: 'Top ball speed', key: 'top' as const, unit: ` ${c.unit}` },
    { label: 'Sweet spot', key: 'sweet' as const, unit: '%' },
  ];
  return (
    <Backdrop glow={0.1}>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ alignItems: 'center', paddingTop: 110, gap: 14 }}>
        <Kicker style={enter(frame, 4)}>Shared stats</Kicker>
        <Title size={96} style={enter(frame, 10)}>{c.title}</Title>
        <div style={{ ...enter(frame, 20), fontSize: 36, color: colors.muted }}>{c.sub}</div>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 40, marginTop: 50 }}>
          {[a, b].map((p, i) => {
            const s = pop(frame, 26 + i * 8, fps);
            return (
              <Card key={p.name} style={{ width: 620, opacity: s, transform: `translateY(${(1 - s) * 40}px)` }}>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 18, marginBottom: 24 }}>
                  <div style={{ width: 64, height: 64, borderRadius: 32, background: i ? colors.track : colors.accent, color: i ? colors.text : '#11130c', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontSize: 30, fontWeight: 800 }}>{p.name[0]}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 40, fontWeight: 700 }}>{p.name}</div>
                </div>
                {stats.map((st) => {
                  const v = p[st.key], other = (i ? a : b)[st.key];
                  return (
                    <div key={st.key} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'baseline', padding: '12px 0', borderTop: `1px solid ${colors.track}` }}>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 30, color: colors.muted }}>{st.label}</span>
                      <span style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 48, fontWeight: 800, color: v >= other ? colors.accent : colors.text }}>{Math.round(v * grow)}{st.unit}</span>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </Card>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </AbsoluteFill>
    </Backdrop>
  );
};
````````

````````tsx
import React from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig } from 'remotion';
import { Backdrop, Card, Kicker, Title } from '../components/ui';
import { colors, fonts } from '../config/brand';
import { copy } from '../config/copy';
import { features } from '../config/timeline';
import { enter, pop, ramp } from '../lib/anim';

const c = copy.whatIf;
// Beat timings (frames)
const T = { ask: 20, tool: 55, result: 90, note: 140, press: 200, drill: 214 };

const Bar: React.FC<{ label: string; before: number; after: number; unit: string; t: number }> = ({ label, before, after, unit, t }) => {
  const max = after * 1.15;
  const now = Math.round(before + (after - before) * t);
  return (
    <div style={{ marginBottom: 22 }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 30 }}>
        <span>{label}</span>
        <span><span style={{ color: colors.muted }}>{before} → </span><b>{now}</b> <span style={{ color: colors.muted }}>{unit}</span> <span style={{ color: colors.better, fontSize: 26 }}>▲ {Math.round(((after - before) / before) * 100)}%</span></span>
      </div>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', height: 16, background: colors.track, borderRadius: 8, marginTop: 10 }}>
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', height: '100%', width: `${(before / max) * 100}%`, background: '#5c6040', borderRadius: 8 }} />
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', height: '100%', width: `${((before + (after - before) * t) / max) * 100}%`, background: colors.accent, borderRadius: 8, opacity: t > 0 ? 1 : 0 }} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

/** Only drawn when features.showBallFlight is on (needs a flight model in ShotSimulator). */
const Flight: React.FC<{ t: number }> = ({ t }) => {
  const arc = (h: number, len: number) => `M20,150 Q${20 + len / 2},${150 - h} ${20 + len},150`;
  return (
    <svg width={760} height={170} style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
      <line x1={0} x2={760} y1={150} y2={150} stroke={colors.track} strokeWidth={3} />
      <path d={arc(160, 520)} fill="none" stroke="#5c6040" strokeWidth={4} strokeDasharray="10 8" />
      <path d={arc(170, 520 + 120 * t)} fill="none" stroke={colors.accent} strokeWidth={5} />
    </svg>
  );
};

// Muse Spark calls simulate_change on the player's own average shot, then plans a drill.
export const WhatIf: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const { fps } = useVideoConfig();
  const grow = ramp(frame, T.result + 10, T.result + 50);
  const thinking = frame >= T.tool && frame < T.result;
  const dots = '•••'.slice(0, 1 + (Math.floor(frame / 6) % 3));
  const press = frame >= T.press && frame < T.press + 8 ? 0.95 : 1;
  const drill = pop(frame, T.drill, fps);
  const remaining = Math.max(c.drillTarget - Math.floor(Math.max(0, frame - T.drill - 30) / 9), c.drillTarget - 3);

  return (
    <Backdrop glow={0.1}>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ padding: '0 110px', width: 780, gap: 18, justifyContent: 'center' }}>
        <Kicker style={enter(frame, 4)}>{c.kicker}</Kicker>
        <Title size={70} style={enter(frame, 10)}>{c.title}</Title>
      </AbsoluteFill>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ left: 900, width: 920, gap: 24, justifyContent: 'center' }}>
        <div style={{ ...enter(frame, 6), display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, fontSize: 26, color: colors.muted }}>
          <span style={{ color: colors.accent, fontSize: 30 }}>✦</span>{c.status}
        </div>
        <div style={{ ...enter(frame, T.ask), alignSelf: 'flex-end', maxWidth: 680, background: colors.accent, color: '#11130c', fontSize: 32, fontWeight: 600, padding: '18px 26px', borderRadius: '26px 26px 6px 26px', lineHeight: 1.3 }}>{c.question}</div>
        <div style={{ ...enter(frame, T.tool), fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 24, color: colors.muted, background: colors.card, border: `1px solid ${colors.track}`, borderRadius: 12, padding: '10px 18px', alignSelf: 'flex-start' }}>
          <span style={{ color: colors.accent }}>{c.tool}</span>({c.toolArgs}){thinking ? `  ${dots}` : '  ✓'}
        </div>
        <Card style={{ ...enter(frame, T.result) }}>
          {features.showBallFlight && <Flight t={grow} />}
          {c.results.map((r) => <Bar key={r.label} {...r} t={grow} />)}
          <div style={{ fontSize: 22, color: colors.muted }}>{c.note}</div>
        </Card>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 22, alignItems: 'stretch' }}>
          <div style={{ ...enter(frame, T.note + 20), transform: `scale(${press})`, background: colors.card, border: `2px solid ${colors.accent}`, color: colors.accent, fontSize: 30, fontWeight: 700, borderRadius: 18, padding: '20px 28px', alignSelf: 'flex-start' }}>
            ✦ {c.drillButton}
          </div>
          <Card style={{ flex: 1, opacity: drill, transform: `translateY(${(1 - drill) * 30}px)`, padding: '18px 26px', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 24 }}>
            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
              <div style={{ fontFamily: fonts.display, fontSize: 76, fontWeight: 800, color: colors.accent, lineHeight: 1 }}>{remaining}</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 20, color: colors.muted }}>{c.drillRemaining}</div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 30, fontWeight: 700 }}>{c.drillName}</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 22, color: colors.muted }}>{c.drillStart}</div>
            </div>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </AbsoluteFill>
    </Backdrop>
  );
};
````````

````````tsx
import React from 'react';
import { useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';
import { Racket } from '../../components/Racket';
import { Stage3D } from '../../components/Stage3D';
import { Backdrop } from '../../components/ui';

type V3 = [number, number, number];
// One view per frame, for checking the racket's shape: npx remotion still racket-sheet --frame=N
export const VIEWS: { cam: V3; target: V3; fov: number; rot: V3; finish?: 'carbon' | 'blue' | 'red' }[] = [
  { cam: [0, 0, 14], target: [0, 0, 0], fov: 14, rot: [0, 0, 0] }, // face-on
  { cam: [0, 0, 14], target: [0, 0, 0], fov: 14, rot: [0, Math.PI / 2, 0] }, // side
  { cam: [0, 0.3, 6.4], target: [0, 0.05, 0], fov: 32, rot: [0.1, 0.42, -0.16] }, // hero 3/4
  { cam: [0.5, -0.2, 2.2], target: [0, -0.2, 0], fov: 30, rot: [0.1, 0.5, 0] }, // throat close-up
  { cam: [0, -0.1, 2.6], target: [0, -0.12, 0], fov: 30, rot: [0, 0, 0], finish: 'red' }, // throat face-on
  { cam: [1.1, 0.1, 1.6], target: [0, -0.15, 0], fov: 30, rot: [0, 0, 0], finish: 'red' }, // throat 3/4 from above
  { cam: [2.2, -0.1, 0.2], target: [0, -0.15, 0], fov: 30, rot: [0, 0, 0], finish: 'red' }, // throat from the side
  { cam: [0.6, 1.9, 1.4], target: [0, 1.3, 0], fov: 30, rot: [0, 0, 0], finish: 'red' }, // top of the head, bumper
  { cam: [0.8, -0.9, 1.6], target: [0, -1.0, 0], fov: 30, rot: [0, 0, 0], finish: 'red' }, // handle
  { cam: [0, 0.3, 6.4], target: [0, 0.05, 0], fov: 32, rot: [0.1, 0.42, -0.16], finish: 'red' }, // hero 3/4, red
  { cam: [0, 0.3, 6.4], target: [0, 0.05, 0], fov: 32, rot: [0.1, 0.42, -0.16], finish: 'blue' }, // hero 3/4, blue
];

export const RacketSheet: React.FC = () => {
  const v = VIEWS[Math.min(useCurrentFrame(), VIEWS.length - 1)];
  return (
    <Backdrop glow={0.08}>
      <Stage3D camera={v.cam} target={v.target} fov={v.fov} env="studio" envIntensity={1.4} hero>
        <pointLight position={[-0.6, 2.2, -1.8]} intensity={40} distance={8} color="#ffffff" />
        <Racket rotation={v.rot} glow={1} finish={v.finish} />
      </Stage3D>
    </Backdrop>
  );
};
````````

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "video/src/swingfilm/SwingFilm.tsx", "sha256": "c4d259f79e4ae34a5ea8c9ab843d234706d00f08c2dfafb9eaddb07ff3d9b40b", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````tsx
// Swing film: the player's average forehand, then Muse's recommended change, then the estimated effect.
// Everything visual is fixed here and in look.ts; the script (config/swingFilm.json) comes from
// tools/swing_film.py, which asks Muse Spark and validates the answer against docs/SWING_FILM.md.
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { AbsoluteFill, useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { Racket } from '../components/Racket';
import { Stage3D } from '../components/Stage3D';
import { Backdrop, Card, Kicker, Title } from '../components/ui';
import { colors, fonts } from '../config/brand';
import { enter, ramp } from '../lib/anim';
import { CAMERA, CM, FILM, M, SWING } from './look';

export type Side = {
  swingKmh: number; pathDeg: number; faceDeg: number; contactXcm: number; contactYcm: number;
  ballKmh: number; spinRpm: number; spinType: string;
};
export type FilmScript = {
  model: string; stroke: string; sampleCount: number; estimated: boolean; source: string;
  deltas: Record<string, number>; title: string; cue: string; why: string; before: Side; after: Side;
};

const deg = Math.PI / 180;
const v3 = (x: number, y: number, z: number) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z);

/** Racket pose at real time `t` seconds from contact (negative before). */
function pose(s: Side, t: number) {
  const p = s.pathDeg * deg, f = s.faceDeg * deg;
  const e1 = v3(0, 0, 1); // pivot -> head at contact: out to the player's side
  const e2 = v3(Math.cos(p), Math.sin(p), 0); // head travel at contact: toward the target, tilted by the path
  const n = e1.clone().cross(e2).normalize(); // up, out of the swing plane
  const R = SWING.pivotToHeadM * M;
  const omega = s.swingKmh / 3.6 / SWING.pivotToHeadM; // rad/s at contact
  const phi = SWING.maxTurn * Math.tanh((omega * t) / SWING.maxTurn);
  const r = e1.clone().multiplyScalar(Math.cos(phi)).addScaledVector(e2, Math.sin(phi)); // radial: racket long axis
  const tan = e1.clone().multiplyScalar(-Math.sin(phi)).addScaledVector(e2, Math.cos(phi));
  const normal = tan.clone().multiplyScalar(Math.cos(f)).addScaledVector(n, Math.sin(f)); // + opens the face
  const x = r.clone().cross(normal).normalize(); // across the strings (x, r, normal is right-handed)
  const q = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromRotationMatrix(new THREE.Matrix4().makeBasis(x, r, normal));
  const pivot = e1.clone().multiplyScalar(-R);
  const head = pivot.clone().addScaledVector(r, R);
  // place the racket so the ball (fixed at the origin) meets the strings at the measured contact point
  const origin = head.clone().addScaledVector(r, -SWING.headOffset)
    .addScaledVector(x, -s.contactXcm * CM).addScaledVector(r, -s.contactYcm * CM);
  const bed = head.clone().addScaledVector(x, -s.contactXcm * CM).addScaledVector(r, -s.contactYcm * CM);
  return { q, origin, bed, normal, tan, n };
}

const realTime = (frame: number, start: number) => ((frame - start - FILM.contactAt) / FILM.fps) * FILM.slowMo;

/** The string-bed centre's path through the swing, as a tube. */
const Trail: React.FC<{ side: Side; until: number; color: string; opacity: number }> = ({ side, until, color, opacity }) => {
  const geo = useMemo(() => {
    const pts: THREE.Vector3[] = [];
    const t0 = -0.32;
    const end = Math.min(until, 0.32);
    if (end <= t0 + 0.01) return null;
    for (let k = 0; k <= 60; k++) pts.push(pose(side, t0 + ((end - t0) * k) / 60).bed);
    return new THREE.TubeGeometry(new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts), 120, 0.035, 10, false);
  }, [side, until]);
  if (!geo) return null;
  return (
    <mesh geometry={geo}>
      <meshStandardMaterial color={color} emissive={color} emissiveIntensity={0.6} transparent opacity={opacity} toneMapped={false} />
    </mesh>
  );
};

const Ball: React.FC<{ side: Side; t: number }> = ({ side, t }) => {
  if (t > SWING.ballShowS) return null;
  const { normal, n } = pose(side, 0);
  const pos = t < 0
    ? v3(1, 0.04, 0).multiplyScalar((SWING.incomingKmh / 3.6) * -t * M)
    : normal.clone().multiplyScalar((side.ballKmh / 3.6) * t * M);
  const spin = t > 0 ? (side.spinRpm / 60) * 2 * Math.PI * t : 0;
  const q = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(n, -spin);
  const fade = t > 0 ? 1 - t / SWING.ballShowS : 1;
  return (
    <group position={pos} quaternion={q}>
      <mesh>
        <sphereGeometry args={[SWING.ballR, 40, 40]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#D9EE3F" roughness={0.85} emissive="#D9EE3F" emissiveIntensity={0.18} transparent opacity={fade} />
      </mesh>
      {/* seam, so spin is visible */}
      <mesh rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0]}>
        <torusGeometry args={[SWING.ballR * 1.002, SWING.ballR * 0.07, 8, 64]} />
        <meshBasicMaterial color="#f4f7e6" transparent opacity={fade} />
      </mesh>
    </group>
  );
};

const SwingScene: React.FC<{ side: Side; ghost?: Side; t: number; glow: number }> = ({ side, ghost, t, glow }) => {
  const p = pose(side, t);
  return (
    <Stage3D camera={CAMERA.pos} target={CAMERA.target} fov={CAMERA.fov} env="studio" envIntensity={0.7}>
      {/* floor grid: a fixed reference for "up" */}
      <gridHelper args={[30, 30, '#2A2E20', '#1b1e15']} position={[0, -3.4, 0]} />
      {ghost && <Trail side={ghost} until={0.32} color="#7c826a" opacity={0.55} />}
      <Trail side={side} until={t} color={colors.accent} opacity={0.95} />
      <group position={p.origin} quaternion={p.q}>
        <Racket finish="carbon" glow={glow} />
      </group>
      <Ball side={side} t={t} />
    </Stage3D>
  );
};

// ---------- HUD (fixed slots) ----------

const fmt = (v: number, d = 0) => (Math.abs(v) < 0.05 && d > 0 ? '0' : v.toFixed(d));
const sign = (v: number, d = 0) => `${v > 0 ? '+' : v < 0 ? '−' : '±'}${fmt(Math.abs(v), d)}`;

const Stat: React.FC<{ label: string; value: string; delta?: string; lit: boolean }> = ({ label, value, delta, lit }) => (
  <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'baseline', padding: '12px 0', borderBottom: `1px solid ${colors.track}` }}>
    <span style={{ fontSize: 22, color: colors.muted, letterSpacing: 1, marginRight: 24 }}>{label}</span>
    <span style={{ fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 30, color: lit ? colors.accent : colors.text }}>
      {value}{delta && <span style={{ fontSize: 22, marginLeft: 12, color: colors.accent }}>{delta}</span>}
    </span>
  </div>
);

/** String bed seen face-on with the contact point; before in grey, after in lime. */
const StringBed: React.FC<{ before: Side; after?: Side }> = ({ before, after }) => {
  const s = 7; // px per cm
  const dot = (x: number, y: number, c: string) => <circle cx={110 + x * s} cy={140 - y * s} r={9} fill={c} style={{ filter: `drop-shadow(0 0 8px ${c})` }} />;
  return (
    <svg width={220} height={280}>
      <ellipse cx={110} cy={140} rx={12.45 * s} ry={16.4 * s} fill="none" stroke={colors.muted} strokeWidth={4} />
      {Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, k) => <line key={`m${k}`} x1={110 + (k - 4) * 20} x2={110 + (k - 4) * 20} y1={40} y2={240} stroke={colors.track} strokeWidth={2} />)}
      {Array.from({ length: 11 }, (_, k) => <line key={`c${k}`} y1={140 + (k - 5) * 20} y2={140 + (k - 5) * 20} x1={30} x2={190} stroke={colors.track} strokeWidth={2} />)}
      <circle cx={110} cy={140} r={4 * s} fill="none" stroke={colors.better} strokeWidth={2} strokeDasharray="6 5" />
      {dot(before.contactXcm, before.contactYcm, after ? '#7c826a' : colors.accent)}
      {after && dot(after.contactXcm, after.contactYcm, colors.accent)}
    </svg>
  );
};

const Hud: React.FC<{ script: FilmScript; showing: Side; changed: boolean; frame: number; start: number }> = ({ script, showing, changed, frame, start }) => {
  const d = script.deltas;
  const lit = (k: string) => changed && d[k] !== 0;
  return (
    <>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ padding: '80px 110px', justifyContent: 'flex-start', gap: 14, width: 900 }}>
        <Kicker style={enter(frame, start + 2)}>{changed ? 'Try this' : 'Your swing · forehand average'}</Kicker>
        <Title size={70} style={enter(frame, start + 6)}>{changed ? script.title : `${script.sampleCount} forehands`}</Title>
        {changed && <div style={{ ...enter(frame, start + 14), fontSize: 34, color: colors.text, maxWidth: 760, lineHeight: 1.3 }}>{script.cue}</div>}
      </AbsoluteFill>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 80, top: 120, width: 520, padding: '18px 30px 24px', background: 'rgba(23,25,19,0.94)', border: `1px solid ${colors.track}`, borderRadius: 22, ...enter(frame, start + 8) }}>
        <Stat label="SWING SPEED" value={`${fmt(showing.swingKmh)} km/h`} delta={lit('swing_percent') ? `${sign(d.swing_percent)}%` : undefined} lit={lit('swing_percent')} />
        <Stat label="SWING PATH" value={`${fmt(showing.pathDeg)}° up`} delta={lit('path_deg') ? `${sign(d.path_deg)}°` : undefined} lit={lit('path_deg')} />
        <Stat label="FACE" value={`${fmt(Math.abs(showing.faceDeg))}° ${showing.faceDeg >= 0 ? 'open' : 'closed'}`} delta={lit('face_deg') ? `${sign(d.face_deg)}°` : undefined} lit={lit('face_deg')} />
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 24, marginTop: 18 }}>
          <StringBed before={script.before} after={changed ? script.after : undefined} />
          <div style={{ fontSize: 22, color: colors.muted, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>CONTACT<br /><span style={{ color: colors.better }}>- - -</span> sweet spot</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 110, bottom: 70, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontSize: 22, color: colors.muted, letterSpacing: 2 }}>
        SUPER SLOW-MO · RACKET DATA ONLY
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

const Bar: React.FC<{ label: string; before: number; after: number; unit: string; t: number; extra?: string }> = ({ label, before, after, unit, t, extra }) => {
  const max = Math.max(before, after) * 1.15;
  const now = before + (after - before) * t;
  return (
    <div style={{ marginBottom: 30 }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', fontSize: 32 }}>
        <span>{label}</span>
        <span><span style={{ color: colors.muted }}>{Math.round(before)} → </span><b>{Math.round(now)}</b> <span style={{ color: colors.muted }}>{unit}</span>{extra && <span style={{ color: colors.better, fontSize: 26, marginLeft: 12 }}>{extra}</span>}</span>
      </div>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', height: 16, background: colors.track, borderRadius: 8, marginTop: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', height: '100%', width: `${(before / max) * 100}%`, background: '#5c6040', borderRadius: 8 }} />
        <div style={{ position: 'absolute', height: '100%', width: `${(now / max) * 100}%`, background: colors.accent, borderRadius: 8, opacity: t > 0 ? 1 : 0 }} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

const ResultCard: React.FC<{ script: FilmScript; frame: number }> = ({ script, frame }) => {
  const s = FILM.card[0];
  const t = ramp(frame, s + 12, s + 40);
  const { before: b, after: a } = script;
  const pct = (x: number, y: number) => `${y >= x ? '▲' : '▼'} ${Math.abs(Math.round(((y - x) / x) * 100))}%`;
  return (
    <Backdrop glow={0.1}>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ padding: '0 110px', width: 820, justifyContent: 'center', gap: 20 }}>
        <Kicker style={enter(frame, s + 2)}>Estimated effect</Kicker>
        <Title size={76} style={enter(frame, s + 6)}>{script.title}</Title>
        <div style={{ ...enter(frame, s + 14), fontSize: 32, color: colors.muted, lineHeight: 1.35 }}>{script.why}</div>
      </AbsoluteFill>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ left: 940, width: 870, justifyContent: 'center' }}>
        <Card style={enter(frame, s + 8)}>
          <Bar label="Ball speed" before={b.ballKmh} after={a.ballKmh} unit="km/h" t={t} extra={pct(b.ballKmh, a.ballKmh)} />
          <Bar label="Spin" before={b.spinRpm} after={a.spinRpm} unit="rpm" t={t} extra={b.spinType !== a.spinType ? `${b.spinType} → ${a.spinType}` : pct(b.spinRpm, a.spinRpm)} />
          <div style={{ fontSize: 22, color: colors.muted, marginTop: 6 }}>
            Estimated on your average forehand ({script.sampleCount} shots). Picked and tested by Muse Spark (Meta).
          </div>
        </Card>
      </AbsoluteFill>
    </Backdrop>
  );
};

export const SwingFilm: React.FC<{ script: FilmScript }> = ({ script }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  if (frame >= FILM.card[0]) return <ResultCard script={script} frame={frame} />;
  const changed = frame >= FILM.tryThis[0];
  const start = changed ? FILM.tryThis[0] : FILM.yours[0];
  const side = changed ? script.after : script.before;
  const t = realTime(frame, start);
  const glow = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(frame - start - FILM.contactAt) / 6);
  return (
    <Backdrop glow={0.12}>
      <AbsoluteFill style={{ opacity: ramp(frame, start, start + 8) }}>
        <SwingScene side={side} ghost={changed ? script.before : undefined} t={t} glow={glow} />
      </AbsoluteFill>
      <Hud script={script} showing={side} changed={changed} frame={frame} start={start} />
    </Backdrop>
  );
};
````````

#### Reference: `video/src/swingfilm/look.ts`

<!-- TB_REFERENCE {"path": "video/src/swingfilm/look.ts", "sha256": "b08498f11c08d7ed9ba29e69919917032622f5219ca914139ad282938720ca21", "trailing_newline": true} -->
````````typescript
// The swing film's fixed look (docs/SWING_FILM.md). Muse never sets anything in this file: the script
// (config/swingFilm.json) only carries the change, three short texts and the simulator's numbers.
import type { V3 } from '../hype/kit';

export const FILM = {
  fps: 30,
  frames: 240, // 8 s
  yours: [0, 90] as const, // "Your swing"
  tryThis: [90, 180] as const, // "Try this", with your swing as a ghost
  card: [180, 240] as const, // before/after numbers
  contactAt: 48, // frame of contact inside each swing half
  slowMo: 0.16, // real seconds per film second, the same in both halves
} as const;

export const CAMERA = { pos: [-5.2, 4.6, 9.4] as V3, target: [0.9, -0.3, -1.2] as V3, fov: 36 };

// Scene units: the Racket component is 3 units for 0.685 m.
export const M = 3 / 0.685;
export const CM = M / 100;

/** The swing template: a fixed pivot (the arm) and a racket that turns about it. Only the five racket numbers
 *  (speed, path, face, contact across/along) change between films. */
export const SWING = {
  pivotToHeadM: 1.1, // shoulder to string-bed centre at contact
  headOffset: 0.76, // racket origin to string-bed centre, scene units
  maxTurn: 2.0, // radians either side of contact (backswing / follow-through)
  incomingKmh: 43.2, // ShotSimulator's groundstroke assumption
  ballR: 0.0335 * M,
  ballShowS: 0.11, // real seconds the ball stays on screen after contact (no flight is modelled)
} as const;
````````

````````markdown
# Website hosting

The site is hosted on Cloudflare Pages in the `tennisbuddy` project.

- Custom domain: https://tennisbuddy.net
- Cloudflare URL: https://tennisbuddy.pages.dev
- Dashboard: https://dash.cloudflare.com/f4d685670c2bba7116a40663ea1d80f8/pages/view/tennisbuddy

To publish updates, run `npm run deploy:website` from the repository root.
The build copies `website/index.html`, `website/emulator.html`, `website/emulator_session.json`,
`website/emulator_sessions.json`, `website/emulator/` (three.js, the loader and the 0.65 MB racket model), and `website/img/` into `.website-dist/`.
Alternate design pages and this document are excluded from publication.

Wrangler uses the existing Cloudflare login. If it expires, run `npx wrangler login`.
````````
