.bl{font-size:12px;color:var(--m-muted);margin:10px 0}
.lt{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
.lt button{min-height:72px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--m-card);border:2px solid var(--m-line);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;color:var(--m-text)}
.lt button.sel{background:var(--m-line);border-color:var(--m-muted)}.lt button.chg{border-color:var(--m-lime)}
.lt .l{font-size:11px;color:var(--m-muted)}.lt .v{font:700 17px var(--rounded)}.lt .chg .v{color:var(--m-lime)}
.sl{margin-bottom:12px}.sl:last-child{margin:0}
.sl .tp{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:15px}.sl .tp b{font-weight:600}.sl .tp span{color:var(--m-muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.sl input{width:100%;accent-color:var(--m-lime);margin:6px 0 0}
.res .rw{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:6px;color:var(--m-text)}
.res .rw .n{font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.res .rw .n i{font-style:normal;color:var(--m-muted);font-weight:400}
.pbar{height:10px;border-radius:5px;background:var(--m-line);position:relative;margin-bottom:12px;overflow:hidden}
.pbar i{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;border-radius:5px}
.res .nt{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--m-good);margin:-6px 0 10px}
.bbar{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:10px 16px 12px;background:var(--m-bg);display:flex;gap:10px;z-index:5}
.bbar button{flex:1;min-height:48px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700}
.bbar .p{background:var(--m-lime);color:var(--m-ink)}.bbar .g{background:var(--m-card);color:var(--m-text);flex:0 0 100px}
/* ---------- grouped forms ---------- */
.sect{margin-bottom:22px}
.sect .hd{font-size:13px;color:var(--sec);text-transform:uppercase;padding:0 16px 6px;letter-spacing:.2px}
.sect .ft{font-size:13px;color:var(--sec);padding:6px 16px 0}
.grp{background:#fff;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden}
.grp>*{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;min-height:46px;padding:11px 16px;width:100%;text-align:left;border-top:.5px solid var(--sep);font-size:17px}
.grp>*:first-child{border-top:0}
.grp .v{color:var(--sec)} .grp .lk{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center}.grp .lk svg{color:var(--accent);filter:saturate(1.2) brightness(.8);font-size:20px}
.grp .ch{color:var(--ter);font-size:13px}
.grp .link{color:var(--blue)}
.sw3{width:51px;height:31px;border-radius:999px;background:#E5E5EA;position:relative;flex:none}
.sw3 i{position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:27px;height:27px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.25);transition:left .2s}
.sw3.on{background:var(--green)}.sw3.on i{left:22px}
.seg3{display:flex;background:rgba(118,118,128,.12);border-radius:9px;padding:2px;width:100%}
.seg3 button{flex:1;padding:6px 0;border-radius:7px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500}.seg3 button.on{background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.15);font-weight:600}
.btnp{width:100%;height:50px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--accent);color:#000;font-weight:600;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px}
.btn2{height:50px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;flex:1}
/* score */
.sb{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}.sb th{font-size:12px;font-weight:400;color:var(--sec);text-align:center;padding:0 6px 10px}.sb th:first-child,.sb td:first-child{text-align:left}
.sb td{text-align:center;padding:5px 6px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.sb .pt{font:700 34px var(--rounded);color:var(--accent);filter:saturate(1.1) brightness(.85)}
.zones{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.zone{border-radius:14px;min-height:130px;color:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px}
.zone b{font:700 64px var(--rounded)}
.foot{width:100%;max-width:820px;font-size:12.5px;color:#55555a;padding:0 16px}
.toast{position:absolute;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:100px;background:rgba(28,28,30,.92);color:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:14px;z-index:30}
@media(max-width:480px){
 .wrap{flex-direction:column;flex-wrap:nowrap;align-items:stretch;gap:14px;padding:0 0 30px}
 .mobnote{display:block;order:0;background:#1C1C1E;color:#F2F2F7;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;padding:8px 14px}
 .phone{order:1;width:100%;height:calc(100dvh - 44px);max-height:none;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none}
 .side{order:2;width:100%;padding:0 14px}.foot{order:3}
 .island,.sbar{display:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">
 <div class="mobnote"><b style="color:#B0DA1C">Pro-match replay.</b> Strokes and timing come from labelled data and video; speeds, spin and contacts are model estimates. Details below the phone.</div>
 <div class="side">
  <div class="brandrow"><a href="index.html">Tennis Buddee</a><a href="https://github.com/QuentinL-eng/Tennis-Buddy-Smart-Racket/blob/main/docs/EMULATOR_DATA.md">How this data was made</a></div>
  <div class="panel prov" id="prov">Loading…</div>
  <div class="panel"><h2>Whose match</h2><div class="pl" id="players"></div></div>
  <div class="panel" id="vidpanel"><h2>Source video</h2>
    <div id="vidbox"><button class="btn" id="vidload" style="border:1.5px solid #D8D8DE;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 12px;font-weight:600;background:#fff;font-size:13px">Load the source video</button>
    <div class="vnote">Watch the real match next to the data. It plays from YouTube, and nothing is requested from YouTube until you press this.</div></div>
    <div id="vidwrap" hidden><div class="vid"><div id="ytp"></div></div>
     <div class="vidrow"><label><input type="checkbox" id="vidfollow" checked> Follow the replay</label><a id="vidyt" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="margin-left:auto;color:#0A66C2">Open on YouTube</a></div>
     <div class="vnote" id="vidnote"></div></div>
    <div class="hits" id="hitlist"></div>
    <div class="vnote" id="vidcredit"></div></div>
  <div class="panel"><h2>Emulator controls</h2>
    <div class="row2"><div class="seg2" id="speed"><button data-v="1" class="on">1×</button><button data-v="2">2×</button><button data-v="4">4×</button></div>
    <button class="btn" id="skip">Skip to end of match</button></div>
    <div class="row2" style="margin-top:8px"><span class="note" style="margin:0">Racket swing</span><div class="seg2" id="pace"><button data-k="1">Real time</button><button data-k="0.6" class="on">Slower</button></div></div>
    <div class="note" style="margin-top:8px">These controls aren't in the app; everything inside the phone is. “Slower” stretches each swing around contact; the hit itself stays on the video's hit.</div></div>
  <div class="panel"><h2>Try it</h2><ol>
    <li>Tap <b>Start Session</b> on Live and watch the racket swing and every hit land.</li>
    <li>Open the <b>Muse</b> tab for the best change, questions, a practice plan and more.</li>
    <li>From Muse, open <b>What if</b> and move the levers, or check <b>Insights</b> for the session summary.</li></ol></div>
 </div>
 <div class="phone" id="phone">
  <div class="island"></div>
  <div class="sbar"><span>9:41</span><span class="r" id="sbr"></span></div>
  <div class="nav" id="nav"></div>
  <div class="body" id="body">
   <div class="scroll on" id="v-live"></div>
   <div class="scroll" id="v-other"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="tabs" id="tabs"></div>
  <div class="toast" id="toast" hidden></div>
 </div>
 <p class="foot">This is a browser emulator of the iPhone app, not a recording of a real match. In the labelled Ostrava match, stroke types and outcomes are the F3Tennis dataset's labels and the swing timing follows the SAM-tracked racket (a 2D box, so a rough guide). In the other eight matches the stroke types, hitters and hit times are predictions of the F3Tennis model (97% on held-out Ostrava hits, not measured on these broadcasts), and the swing timing follows the SAM-tracked racket. Speeds, spin, face and path angles, contact points, the 3D swing and the gyro/g readouts are estimates from the app's own physics model and swing template, ported to JavaScript.
 The source video is the real broadcast, played from YouTube on request. Method and limits: <a href="https://github.com/QuentinL-eng/Tennis-Buddy-Smart-Racket/blob/main/docs/EMULATOR_DATA.md">docs/EMULATOR_DATA.md</a>.</p>
</div>

<script type="module">
import * as THREE from "three";
import {GLTFLoader} from "./emulator/GLTFLoader.js";

/* =====================================================================
   Model ports: RacketKit ShotSimulator + ImpactModel defaults, WhatIf, SwingTemplate
   ===================================================================== */
const ACOR=0.42, SPIN_GAIN=0.7, SWEET=4.0, BED=0.512, BALL_R=0.0335;
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.min(b,Math.max(a,isFinite(v)?v:0));
const mean=a=>a.length?a.reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0)/a.length:0;
function simulate(p){
  p={swing:clamp(p.swing,0,200),path:clamp(p.path,-80,80),face:clamp(p.face,-60,60),cx:clamp(p.cx,-12,12),cy:clamp(p.cy,-14,14),inc:clamp(p.inc??43.2,0,200)};
  const dist=Math.hypot(p.cx,p.cy), e=ACOR*Math.max(.55,1-.035*dist), v=p.swing/3.6, brush=v*Math.sin((p.path-p.face)*Math.PI/180);
  const rpm=SPIN_GAIN*Math.abs(brush)/.0335*60/(2*Math.PI);
  return {p,ball:e*p.inc+(1+e)*p.swing,rpm,spin:rpm<600?"flat":brush>0?"topspin":"slice",dist};
}
const LIM={swing:30,angle:15,contact:5};
const apply=(b,d)=>({swing:b.swing*(1+clamp(d.swing,-30,30)/100),face:b.face+clamp(d.face,-15,15),path:b.path+clamp(d.path,-15,15),cx:b.cx+clamp(d.cx,-5,5),cy:b.cy+clamp(d.cy,-5,5),inc:b.inc});
const Z=()=>({swing:0,face:0,path:0,cx:0,cy:0});
const isZero=d=>!d.swing&&!d.face&&!d.path&&!d.cx&&!d.cy;

const V3=(x,y,z)=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);
const SHAPES={
  forehand:{reach:1.1,maxTurn:2.0,side:V3(0,0,1),serve:false,camera:V3(-.75,.7,1.45),target:V3(.05,-.08,-.45),floorY:-.75,dist:1.05},
  backhand:{reach:1.1,maxTurn:2.0,side:V3(0,0,-1),serve:false,camera:V3(-.75,.7,-1.45),target:V3(.05,-.08,.45),floorY:-.75,dist:1.05},
  serve:{reach:1.15,maxTurn:2.6,side:V3(0,1,0),serve:true,camera:V3(-.55,-.45,2.9),target:V3(.05,-.6,0),floorY:-2.45,dist:1.35},
  volley:{reach:.85,maxTurn:.7,side:V3(0,0,1),serve:false,camera:V3(-.6,.5,1.25),target:V3(.05,-.05,-.3),floorY:-.9,dist:1.05}};
SHAPES.hit=SHAPES.forehand;
const shapeOf=t=>SHAPES[t]||SHAPES.forehand;
function swingFrame(p,phi,shape){
  shape=shape||SHAPES.forehand;
  const path=p.path*Math.PI/180, face=p.face*Math.PI/180, R=shape.reach;
  const e2=new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(path),Math.sin(path),0);
  const e1=shape.side.clone().addScaledVector(e2,-shape.side.dot(e2)).normalize();
  let n=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(e1,e2).normalize(); if(n.y<0)n.negate();
  let r=e1.clone().multiplyScalar(Math.cos(phi)).addScaledVector(e2,Math.sin(phi));
  const tan=e1.clone().multiplyScalar(-Math.sin(phi)).addScaledVector(e2,Math.cos(phi));
  let normal;
  if(shape.serve){
    // a vertical swing plane: opening the face leans the racket back about the swing axis
    const q=new THREE.Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(e2,e1).normalize(),face);
    r=r.applyQuaternion(q);normal=tan.clone().applyQuaternion(q);
  }else normal=tan.clone().multiplyScalar(Math.cos(face)).addScaledVector(n,Math.sin(face));
  const across=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(normal,r);
  const head=e1.clone().multiplyScalar(-R).addScaledVector(e1,R*Math.cos(phi)).addScaledVector(e2,R*Math.sin(phi));
  const bed=head.clone().addScaledVector(across,-p.cx/100).addScaledVector(r,-p.cy/100);
  const butt=bed.clone().addScaledVector(r,-BED);
  return {m:new THREE.Matrix4().makeBasis(r,across,normal).setPosition(butt),bed,normal,up:n};
}
const omegaOf=(p,sh)=>(p.swing/3.6)/sh.reach;
const phiAt=(p,t,sh)=>sh.maxTurn*Math.tanh(omegaOf(p,sh)*t/sh.maxTurn);
const poseAt=(p,t,sh)=>swingFrame(p,phiAt(p,t,sh),sh);

/* =====================================================================
   Data: video-derived shots -> estimated swing parameters -> ShotSimulator
   ===================================================================== */
function mulberry32(a){return function(){a|=0;a=a+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(a^a>>>15,1|a);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296;};}
function params(s){
  const r=mulberry32(s.index*2654435761+7), i=s.intensity, slice=s.technique==="slice"||(s.technique==null&&i<.25&&s.index%3===0);
  const path=slice?-Math.round(8+10*r()):s.path_deg!=null?Math.round(s.path_deg):Math.round(10+20*i);
  // Contact point is NOT observable in video. Assumption: a pro's contact is bell-shaped around the sweet spot,
  // sigma ~2.2 cm (a bit looser for harder swings), which puts roughly 85% of hits inside the 4 cm sweet spot.
  const gauss=()=>Math.sqrt(-2*Math.log(1-r()))*Math.cos(2*Math.PI*r());
  const sg=2.0+.5*i, type=s.stroke||"hit";
  return {swing:60+90*i,face:Math.round(i*8*(s.index%2?1:-1)),path,
          cx:clamp(gauss()*sg*.9,-11,11),cy:clamp(gauss()*sg*1.1,-14,14),
          inc:type==="serve"?0:type==="volley"?54:43.2};   // incoming ball speed as WhatIf.baseline uses
}
const LABEL={forehand:"Forehand",backhand:"Backhand",serve:"Serve",volley:"Volley",hit:"Hit"};
const enrich=s=>{const p=params(s),r=simulate(p),type=s.stroke||"hit";
  return {s,p,r,type,name:LABEL[type],t:s.t_s,i:s.intensity,sweet:r.dist<=SWEET,id:s.index,outcome:s.outcome||null,prog:s.prog||null,predicted:!!s.predicted,conf:s.conf==null?null:s.conf};};
const baselineOf=rows=>rows.length?{swing:mean(rows.map(x=>x.p.swing)),face:mean(rows.map(x=>x.p.face)),path:mean(rows.map(x=>x.p.path)),cx:mean(rows.map(x=>x.p.cx)),cy:mean(rows.map(x=>x.p.cy)),inc:mean(rows.map(x=>x.p.inc))}:null;
const STROKES=["forehand","backhand","serve","volley","hit"];
const strokesIn=rs=>STROKES.filter(t=>rs.some(x=>x.type===t));

/* units: the app defaults to mph / inches */
const U={metric:false,
  speed:k=>U.metric?k:k*.621371, su:()=>U.metric?"km/h":"mph", sv:k=>Math.round(U.speed(k)),
  len:c=>U.metric?c:c/2.54, lu:()=>U.metric?"cm":"in", lt:c=>`${U.len(c).toFixed(1)} ${U.lu()}`};

/* =====================================================================
   Icons (SF Symbols approximations)
   ===================================================================== */
const IC={
 figure:'<circle cx="14" cy="4.5" r="2"/><path d="M13 8.5l-3 4 3.5 2.5-1 5.5M10 12.5L6 10M13.5 15l4 3"/><ellipse cx="18.5" cy="8" rx="2.4" ry="3.4" transform="rotate(30 18.5 8)"/><path d="M16.2 10.8L14.5 13"/>',
 trophy:'<path d="M7 4h10v5a5 5 0 0 1-10 0z"/><path d="M7 5.5H4v1.8a3 3 0 0 0 3 3M17 5.5h3v1.8a3 3 0 0 1-3 3M12 14v4M8 20h8"/>',
 trophyf:'<path class="f" d="M7 4h10v5a5 5 0 0 1-10 0z"/><path d="M12 14v4M8 20h8"/>',
 people:'<circle cx="9" cy="8" r="3.2"/><path d="M3.5 19.5c.6-3 2.8-4.7 5.5-4.7s4.9 1.700 5.500 4.700"/><circle cx="17" cy="9" r="2.4"/><path d="M16 14.600c2.300.2 3.900 1.600 4.400 4"/>',
 sparkles:'<path d="M11 3l1.9 5.600L18.500 10.500l-5.600 1.900L11 18l-1.900-5.600L3.500 10.500l5.600-1.900z"/><path d="M19 15l.8 2.200L22 18l-2.200.8L19 21l-.8-2.200L16 18l2.200-.8z"/>',
 tag:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2"/><path d="M8.600 15.400a4.800 4.800 0 0 1 0-6.800M15.400 8.600a4.800 4.800 0 0 1 0 6.800M5.800 18.200a8.800 8.800 0 0 1 0-12.400M18.200 5.800a8.800 8.800 0 0 1 0 12.400"/>',
 scope:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="6.500"/><path d="M12 2.500v5M12 16.500v5M2.500 12h5M16.500 12h5"/>',
 gyro:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><ellipse cx="12" cy="12" rx="9" ry="3.500"/><path d="M12 3v18"/>',
 ecg:'<path d="M2 12h4l2-5 3.500 11 2.500-8 1.500 2H22"/>',
 radio:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1.600"/><path d="M8.500 15.500a5 5 0 0 1 0-7M15.500 8.500a5 5 0 0 1 0 7M5.500 18.500a9 9 0 0 1 0-13M18.500 5.500a9 9 0 0 1 0 13"/>',
 play:'<path class="f" d="M7 4.500v15l13-7.500z"/>', stop:'<rect class="f" x="6" y="6" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/>',
 chev:'<path d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"/>', chevl:'<path d="M15 5l-7 7 7 7"/>', chevd:'<path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"/>',
 up:'<path d="M12 19V5M5 12l7-7 7 7"/>', sliders:'<path d="M4 7h10M18 7h2M4 17h2M10 17h10"/><circle cx="16" cy="7" r="2"/><circle cx="8" cy="17" r="2"/>',
 brain:'<path d="M9 4a3 3 0 0 0-3 3 3 3 0 0 0-2 2.800A3 3 0 0 0 5 14a3 3 0 0 0 4 4.500V4zM15 4a3 3 0 0 1 3 3 3 3 0 0 1 2 2.800A3 3 0 0 1 19 14a3 3 0 0 1-4 4.500V4z"/>',
 gear:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="6.500"/><path d="M12 2.500v3M12 18.500v3M2.500 12h3M18.500 12h3M5.300 5.300l2.100 2.100M16.600 16.600l2.100 2.100M18.700 5.300l-2.100 2.100M7.400 16.600l-2.100 2.100"/>', chartup:'<path d="M3 17l5-6 4 3 8-9"/><path d="M15 5h5v5"/>', listn:'<path d="M10 6h10M10 12h10M10 18h10M4 5.500h2v3M4 11h2l-2 2.500h2M4 17h2v1.500H4M4 19.500h2"/>', bino:'<circle cx="7" cy="16" r="3.500"/><circle cx="17" cy="16" r="3.500"/><path d="M7 12.500V6h3v5M17 12.500V6h-3v5M10 8.500h4"/>', target:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1"/>', flagf:'<path class="f" d="M6 3h12l-2.500 4.500L18 12H6z"/><path d="M6 3v18"/>',
 turnl:'<path d="M9 4L4 9l5 5"/><path d="M4 9h9a6 6 0 0 1 6 6v5"/>', turnr:'<path d="M15 4l5 5-5 5"/><path d="M20 9h-9a6 6 0 0 0-6 6v5"/>', upc:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 17V8M8 12l4-4 4 4"/>', hand:'<path d="M8 12V6a1.500 1.500 0 0 1 3 0v5M11 11V4.500a1.500 1.500 0 0 1 3 0V11M14 11V6a1.500 1.500 0 0 1 3 0v8a6 6 0 0 1-6 6h-1a5 5 0 0 1-4-2l-3-4a1.500 1.500 0 0 1 2.400-1.800L8 15"/>',
 ball:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M4.500 6.500c4 2 4 9 0 11M19.500 6.500c-4 2-4 9 0 11"/>',
 check:'<path d="M5 12.500l4.500 4.500L19 7.500"/>', x:'<path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/>', undo:'<path d="M9 8L4 12.500 9 17M4.500 12.500H15a5 5 0 0 1 0 10"/>',
 flag:'<path d="M6 21V4M6 5h12l-2.500 4L18 13H6"/>', racket:'<ellipse cx="10" cy="9" rx="6" ry="7" transform="rotate(-25 10 9)"/><path d="M14.500 14.500L20 21"/>',
 palette:'<path d="M12 3a9 9 0 1 0 0 18c1.500 0 2-1 1.500-2.200-.5-1.300.2-2.300 1.500-2.300H17a4 4 0 0 0 4-4c0-5-4-9.500-9-9.500z"/>',
 glasses:'<circle cx="6.500" cy="14" r="3.500"/><circle cx="17.500" cy="14" r="3.500"/><path d="M10 14h4M3 14L5 7M21 14l-2-7"/>',
 account:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/><path d="M6.500 18c1-2.500 3-3.500 5.500-3.500s4.500 1 5.500 3.500"/>',
 tap:'<path d="M9 11V5a1.500 1.500 0 0 1 3 0v5.500l5 1a2 2 0 0 1 1.500 2l-.5 4.500a3 3 0 0 1-3 2.500h-3a3 3 0 0 1-2.400-1.200L6 14"/>'
};
const SYM={forehand:"turnl",backhand:"turnr",serve:"upc",volley:"hand",hit:"ball"};
const ic=(n,c="")=>`<svg class="i ${c}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">${IC[n]}</svg>`;
document.getElementById("sbr").innerHTML='<svg class="i" viewBox="0 0 24 24" style="font-size:17px"><path class="f" d="M3 17h2.500v3H3zM8 14h2.500v6H8zM13 11h2.500v9H13zM18 8h2.500v12H18z"/></svg><svg class="i" viewBox="0 0 24 24" style="font-size:17px"><path d="M2 9a14 14 0 0 1 20 0M5 12.500a9.500 9.500 0 0 1 14 0M8.500 16a5 5 0 0 1 7 0"/></svg><svg viewBox="0 0 30 14" width="28" height="14"><rect x=".5" y=".5" width="25" height="13" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#000" opacity=".4"/><rect x="2" y="2" width="22" height="10" rx="2.500"/><rect x="27" y="4.500" width="2" height="5" rx="1" opacity=".4"/></svg>';

/* =====================================================================
   3D: the app's textured Yonex racket (TennisRacket.glb), SwingTemplate poses
   ===================================================================== */
function proceduralRacket(){
  const g=new THREE.Group(), frame=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x0d1f14,metalness:.6,roughness:.3}), grip=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x383838}), accent=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xd6f240});
  const h=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.19,.03,.034),grip);h.position.x=.095;g.add(h);
  const cap=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.01,.036,.04),accent);cap.position.x=.006;g.add(cap);
  [1,-1].forEach(s=>{const a=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.17,.014,.02),frame);a.position.set(.26,s*.035,0);a.rotation.z=s*.36;g.add(a);});
  const hoop=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.125,.009,12,64),frame);hoop.scale.set(1.3,1,1);hoop.position.x=.52;g.add(hoop);
  const sm=new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:0xeeeeee});
  for(let i=-7;i<=7;i++){const y=i*.015,l=.162*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-(y/.124)**2));g.add(Object.assign(new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([new THREE.Vector3(.52-l,y,0),new THREE.Vector3(.52+l,y,0)]),sm)));}
  for(let i=-9;i<=9;i++){const x=i*.016,l=.124*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-(x/.162)**2));g.add(new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([new THREE.Vector3(.52+x,-l,0),new THREE.Vector3(.52+x,l,0)]),sm));}
  return g;
}
const racketReady=new Promise(res=>{
  new GLTFLoader().load("emulator/TennisRacket.glb",gl=>{
    const s=.686/8.8715, c=new THREE.Group(), node=gl.scene;
    node.matrixAutoUpdate=false;
    node.matrix.makeBasis(new THREE.Vector3(0,-s,0),new THREE.Vector3(0,0,s),new THREE.Vector3(-s,0,0)).setPosition(4.4358*s,0,0);
    c.add(node);res(c);
  },undefined,()=>res(proceduralRacket()));
});
let glOK=true; try{const t=document.createElement("canvas");glOK=!!(t.getContext("webgl2")||t.getContext("webgl"));}catch(e){glOK=false;}

class Stage{
  constructor(el,o){
    this.el=el;this.o=o;this.scene=new THREE.Scene();
    this.cam=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(50,1,.05,30);this.cam.position.copy(o.pos);this.cam.lookAt(o.target);
    this.r=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true,alpha:!o.bg});this.r.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2));
    this.r.outputColorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;if(o.bg)this.scene.background=new THREE.Color(o.bg);
    el.appendChild(this.r.domElement);
    const key=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,o.key??2.4);key.position.set(.9,1.6,.9).multiplyScalar(3);this.scene.add(key);
    this.scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff,0x667766,o.amb??1.6));
    if(o.rim){const rim=new THREE.PointLight(0xdde85b,6,6);rim.position.set(-.8,.6,-1.6);this.scene.add(rim);}
    this.racket=new THREE.Group();this.racket.matrixAutoUpdate=false;this.scene.add(this.racket);
    racketReady.then(r=>{this.racket.add(r.clone(true));});
    this.dot=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(.012,16,12),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x34c759,transparent:true}));
    this.dot.material.opacity=0;this.dot.position.set(BED,0,.008);this.racket.add(this.dot);this.dotAt=-9;
    this.ro=new ResizeObserver(()=>this.size());this.ro.observe(el);this.size();
  }
  size(){
    const w=this.el.clientWidth,h=this.el.clientHeight;if(!w||!h)return;this.r.setSize(w,h,false);
    const a=w/h;this.cam.aspect=a;this.cam.fov=this.o.fov?this.o.fov:this.o.wide&&a>1.8?42:2*Math.atan(Math.tan(35*Math.PI/180)/a)*180/Math.PI;this.cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
  }
  setPose(m){this.racket.matrix.copy(m);this.racket.matrixWorldNeedsUpdate=true;}
  showImpact(row,now){this.dot.position.set(BED+row.p.cy/100,row.p.cx/100,.008);this.dot.material.color.set(row.sweet?0x34c759:0xff3b30);this.dotAt=now;}
  render(now){
    const a=(now-this.dotAt)/1000;this.dot.material.opacity=a<0?0:a<1.5?1:Math.max(0,1-(a-1.5)/.8);
    if(this.el.clientWidth)this.r.render(this.scene,this.cam);
  }
  dispose(){this.ro.disconnect();this.r.dispose();this.r.domElement.remove();}
}

/* =====================================================================
   String bed (StringBedView port), as SVG
   ===================================================================== */
function bedSVG(rows,hi,px=90,heat=false){
  const sc=10,W=278,H=430,cx=W/2,cy=H/2,hw=12.4,hl=16.2,k=px/W;
  let s=`<svg class="bed" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" width="${px}" role="img" aria-label="String bed with ${rows.length} impacts"><defs><clipPath id="hc${px}"><ellipse cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" rx="${hw*sc}" ry="${hl*sc}"/></clipPath></defs>`;
  s+=`<ellipse cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" rx="${hw*sc}" ry="${hl*sc}" fill="rgba(0,0,0,.04)"/><g clip-path="url(#hc${px})" stroke="rgba(0,0,0,.12)" stroke-width="${.6/k*.3}">`;
  for(let i=-7;i<=8;i++){const x=cx+(i-.5)*1.5*sc;s+=`<line x1="${x}" y1="${cy-hl*sc}" x2="${x}" y2="${cy+hl*sc}"/>`;}
  for(let i=-9;i<=9;i++){const y=cy+i*1.6*sc;s+=`<line x1="${cx-hw*sc}" y1="${y}" x2="${cx+hw*sc}" y2="${y}"/>`;}
  s+=`</g><ellipse cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" rx="${hw*sc}" ry="${hl*sc}" fill="none" stroke="rgba(0,0,0,.7)" stroke-width="${Math.max(3/k,sc*.9)}"/>`;
  s+=`<circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="${SWEET*sc}" fill="rgba(52,199,89,.1)" stroke="rgba(52,199,89,.6)" stroke-width="${1.2/k}" stroke-dasharray="${4/k} ${3/k}"/>`;
  rows.forEach((x,i)=>{const h=i===hi,r=Math.max(3/k,.75*sc),col=x.sweet?"52,199,89":"255,59,48";
    s+=`<circle cx="${cx+x.p.cx*sc}" cy="${cy-x.p.cy*sc}" r="${r}" fill="rgba(${col},${h?1:.55})"${h?` stroke="#000" stroke-width="${2/k}"`:""}/>`;});
  return s+"</svg>";
}

/* =====================================================================
   App state
   ===================================================================== */
let PLAYERS=[],rows=[];
const S={tab:"live",stack:{live:[],score:[],muse:[],insights:[],settings:[]},pi:0,active:false,shown:0,clock:-1.4,speed:1,last:0,
  title:"Tennis session",lastRow:null,flashKey:0,
  stroke:null,metric:"ballSpeed",period:"Month",
  d:Z(),lever:"Speed",film:null,trials:[],chat:[],drill:null,drillRun:false,question:"",museSeen:false,
  plan:null,planRun:-1,scout:"",reviews:[],match:null,rules:{simple:false,setsToWin:2,noAd:false,matchTB:false},recenter:0,skin:false};
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const shownRows=()=>rows.slice(0,S.shown);
const clockStr=s=>{s=Math.floor(s);return s>=3600?`${Math.floor(s/3600)}:${String(Math.floor(s/60)%60).padStart(2,"0")}:${String(s%60).padStart(2,"0")}`:`${Math.floor(s/60)}:${String(s%60).padStart(2,"0")}`;};
const endT=()=>rows.length?rows[rows.length-1].t+2:0;
let toastT;function toast(t){const e=$("toast");e.textContent=t;e.hidden=false;clearTimeout(toastT);toastT=setTimeout(()=>e.hidden=true,2600);}

/* ---------- racket motion for the Live scene ---------- */
let SWING_K=.6;   // 1 = real time (matches the video exactly); <1 stretches the swing around contact so it is easier to follow
const LEAD=1.4, SLOW=1, HALF=12, FPS=25, REST={swing:80,face:0,path:10,cx:0,cy:0,inc:43.2}, READYF=-.4;
// racket progress in -1..1 (fraction of the stroke's turn) at `tau` seconds from contact for one hit.
// Hits with a SAM track use that track's real timing (sampled at 25 fps); the rest use the template's tanh profile.
function rowFrac(r,tau){
  const sh=shapeOf(r.type);tau*=SWING_K;
  if(r.prog){
    const x=clamp(tau*FPS+HALF,0,2*HALF),i=Math.min(2*HALF-1,Math.floor(x)),w=x-i;
    return r.prog[i]*(1-w)+r.prog[i+1]*w;
  }
  return Math.tanh(omegaOf(r.p,sh)*tau*SLOW/sh.maxTurn);
}
function motion(clock){
  let sum=0,dom=null,dw=0,fr=0;const w=[];
  for(let i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
    const tau=clock-rows[i].t;if(tau<-1.1||tau>1.6)continue;
    const up=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(tau+1.1)/.5)),dn=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(1.6-tau)/.6)),wi=up*up*(3-2*up)*(dn*dn*(3-2*dn));
    if(wi<=0)continue;w.push([i,tau,wi]);sum+=wi;if(wi>dw){dw=wi;dom=i;}
  }
  const wn=Math.max(1,sum);
  for(const [i,tau,wi] of w)fr+=wi/wn*(rowFrac(rows[i],tau)-READYF);
  const row=dom!=null?rows[dom]:null,sh=row?shapeOf(row.type):SHAPES.forehand;
  const phi=(READYF+fr)*sh.maxTurn+.04*Math.sin(clock*1.3);
  return {phi,p:row?row.p:REST,shape:sh,dom,slow:SWING_K*(row&&row.prog?1:SLOW),w:Math.min(1,sum)};
}
let gyroSm=0;
function liveSensors(clock){
  const e=.02,A=motion(clock-e),a=A.phi,b=motion(clock+e).phi;
  // template-timed swings run slowed (SLOW); tracked swings run in real time
  const real=Math.abs(b-a)/(2*e)/A.slow*180/Math.PI;
  gyroSm+=(real-gyroSm)*.35;
  let g=1;for(const r of rows){const tau=clock-r.t;if(Math.abs(tau)<.6)g+=(8+60*r.i)*Math.exp(-((tau/.09)**2));}
  return {gyro:gyroSm,g};
}

/* =====================================================================
   Live screen
   ===================================================================== */
function buildLive(){
  $("v-live").innerHTML=`
   <div class="rk" id="rk"><div class="gl" id="rkgl"></div><div class="lab"><span id="lGyro">${ic("gyro")}0 °/s</span><span id="lG">${ic("ecg")}0.0 g</span><span id="lHz">${ic("radio")}1000 Hz</span></div></div>
   <div id="sess"></div><div id="shotPanel"></div><div id="recent"></div>`;
  paintSess();paintShot();paintRecent();
  if(!glOK)$("rkgl").innerHTML='<div class="msg">The 3D racket needs WebGL, which this browser has turned off.</div>';
  else liveStage=new Stage($("rkgl"),{pos:SHAPES.forehand.camera.clone().normalize().multiplyScalar(1.05),target:new THREE.Vector3(0,0,0),fov:40,key:2.2,amb:1.5});
}
let liveStage=null;
function paintSess(){
  const a=S.active,rs=shownRows(),n=rs.length,sw=rs.filter(x=>x.sweet).length,bs=rs.map(x=>x.r.ball);
  let h=`<button class="pbtn ${a?"stop":""}" data-act="session"${a?' style="color:#fff"':""}>${ic(a?"stop":"play")} ${a?"End Session":"Start Session"}</button>`;
  if(a){
    h+=`<div style="margin-top:12px"><input class="field" id="sname" aria-label="Session name" value="${S.title.replace(/"/g,"&quot;")}"></div>
    <div class="tiles" style="margin-top:12px">
     <div class="tile"><div class="l">Shots</div><div class="v">${n}</div></div>
     <div class="tile"><div class="l">Sweet spot</div><div class="v">${n?Math.round(100*sw/n):0}<small>%</small></div></div>
     <div class="tile"><div class="l">Avg ball</div><div class="v">${n?U.sv(mean(bs)):"0"}<small>${U.su()}</small></div></div>
     <div class="tile"><div class="l">Best</div><div class="v">${n?U.sv(Math.max(...bs)):"0"}<small>${U.su()}</small></div></div></div>
    <div class="cap" id="sclock" style="margin-top:12px">Session time ${clockStr(Math.max(0,S.clock))}</div>`;
  }
  $("sess").innerHTML=h;const f=$("sname");if(f)f.addEventListener("input",()=>S.title=f.value.slice(0,120));
}
function shotCardHTML(r,anim=true){
  const p=r.p,m=r.r,ang=(d,pos,neg)=>{d=Math.round(d);return d===0?"0°":`${Math.abs(d)}° ${d>0?pos:neg}`;};
  return `<div class="shotcard ${r.sweet?"sweet":"off"}" ${anim?"":'style="animation:none"'}>
   <div class="sc-head"><span class="t">${ic(SYM[r.type])} ${r.name}</span><span class="badge">${r.sweet?"Sweet spot":"Off center"}</span></div>
   <div class="sc-body"><div><div class="big">${U.sv(m.ball)}</div><div class="cap">${U.su()} ball speed (est.)</div>
    <div class="grid2"><div class="mt"><div class="l">Swing</div><div class="v">${U.sv(p.swing)} ${U.su()}</div></div>
     <div class="mt"><div class="l">Spin</div><div class="v">${Math.round(m.rpm)} rpm ${m.spin}</div></div>
     <div class="mt"><div class="l">Face</div><div class="v">${ang(p.face,"open","closed")}</div></div>
     <div class="mt"><div class="l">Path</div><div class="v">${ang(p.path,"up","down")}</div></div></div></div>
    ${bedSVG([r],0,90)}</div>${r.predicted?`<div class="cap" style="margin-top:10px">Stroke type predicted by the F3Tennis model${r.conf!=null?` · ${Math.round(100*r.conf)}% sure`:""}</div>`:""}</div>`;
}
function paintShot(){
  const r=S.lastRow;
  $("shotPanel").innerHTML=r?shotCardHTML(r):`<div class="cu">${ic("racket")}<div class="t">Swing away</div><div class="d">${S.active?"Every hit shows up here.":"Start a session to save shots. Hits still show up here."}</div></div>`;
}
function paintRecent(){
  const rs=shownRows();
  if(!(S.active&&rs.length>1)){$("recent").innerHTML="";return;}
  $("recent").innerHTML=`<div class="card2"><div class="h">This session</div>${bedSVG(rs,rs.length-1,168)}
   ${rs.slice(-6).reverse().map(x=>`<div class="rrow">${ic(SYM[x.type])}<span>${x.name}</span><span class="sp">${U.sv(x.r.ball)} ${U.su()}</span><span class="dot" style="background:${x.sweet?"var(--green)":"var(--red)"}"></span></div>`).join("")}</div>`;
}
function setActive(a){
  S.active=a;S.last=performance.now();VID.seg=null;if(!a)pauseVideoNow();
  if(a&&S.shown>=rows.length&&rows.length){S.shown=0;S.clock=-LEAD;S.lastRow=null;}
  if(!a&&S.shown===0)S.lastRow=null;
  paintSess();paintShot();paintRecent();renderNav();
}
function skipToEnd(){S.active=false;pauseVideoNow();VID.seg=null;S.shown=rows.length;S.clock=endT();S.lastRow=rows[rows.length-1]||null;paintSess();paintShot();paintRecent();refreshOther();paintVidList();}
function frameLive(now){
  const dt=Math.min(.1,(now-S.last)/1000);S.last=now;
  if(S.active){
    if(!videoMaster(now))S.clock+=dt*S.speed;
    let added=false;
    while(S.shown<rows.length&&rows[S.shown].t<=S.clock){S.lastRow=rows[S.shown];S.shown++;added=true;
      if(liveStage)liveStage.showImpact(S.lastRow,now);}
    if(added){paintShot();paintRecent();paintSess();paintVidList();if(S.tab==="insights")refreshOther();}
    const sc=$("sclock");if(sc)sc.textContent="Session time "+clockStr(Math.max(0,S.clock));
    if(S.clock>=endT()){setActive(false);toast("Replay finished — see Insights for the session.");}
  }
  if(S.tab==="live"&&liveStage){
    const m=motion(S.clock),pose=swingFrame(m.p,m.phi,m.shape),sens=liveSensors(S.clock);
    // the camera eases to each stroke's own viewpoint (serves overhead, backhands from the other side)
    const want=m.shape.camera.clone().normalize().multiplyScalar(m.shape.dist),k=1-Math.exp(-dt*5);
    liveStage.cam.position.lerp(want,k);liveStage.cam.lookAt(0,0,0);
    // like the app, the IMU only gives orientation: turn the racket about a point near the grip (0.3 m from the butt)
    const rr=new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixColumn(pose.m,0),gm=pose.m.clone().setPosition(rr.multiplyScalar(-.3));
    liveStage.setPose(gm);liveStage.render(now);
    $("lGyro").lastChild.textContent=Math.round(sens.gyro)+" °/s";$("lG").lastChild.textContent=sens.g.toFixed(1)+" g";
  }
  if(S.tab==="muse"&&S.stack.muse.at(-1)==="whatif"&&wiStage)frameWhatIf(now);
}

/* =====================================================================
   Nav + tabs
   ===================================================================== */
const TABS=[["live","Live","figure"],["score","Score","trophy"],["muse","Muse","sparkles"],["insights","Insights","chartup"],["settings","Settings","gear"]];
$("tabs").innerHTML=TABS.map(t=>`<button class="tab" data-tab="${t[0]}">${ic(t[2])}<span>${t[1]}</span></button>`).join("");
const TITLES={live:"Live",score:"Score",together:"Play together",insights:"Insights",settings:"Settings",muse:"",whatif:"What if",memory:"Memory",plan:"",scout:"",review:"",detail:"Session",account:"Account"};
const DARK=new Set(["muse","whatif","memory","plan","scout","review"]);
function top(){return S.stack[S.tab].at(-1)||S.tab;}
function renderNav(){
  const v=top(),ph=$("phone"),dark=DARK.has(v);
  ph.classList.toggle("dark",dark);ph.classList.toggle("grouped",!dark&&["settings","together","account"].includes(v));
  document.querySelectorAll(".tab").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("on",b.dataset.tab===S.tab));
  if(v!=="muse")document.getElementById("askbar")?.remove();
  if(v!=="whatif")document.getElementById("bbar")?.remove();
  const back=S.stack[S.tab].length?`<button class="back" data-act="back">${ic("chevl")}${S.stack[S.tab].length>1?TITLES[S.stack[S.tab].at(-2)]||"Back":TITLES[S.tab].replace("Play together","Together")||"Back"}</button>`:"";
  let right="";
  if(v==="live")right=`<span class="tbtn"><span class="dot" style="background:var(--green)"></span><span>Pro replay</span></span><button class="tbtn" data-act="recenter">${ic("scope")} Recenter</button>`;
  if(v==="insights")right=`<span class="tbtn" data-act="period">${S.period} ${ic("chevd")}</span>`;
  if(v==="whatif")right=`<button class="tbtn" data-act="wireset" style="${isZero(S.d)?"opacity:.4":""}">${ic("undo")} Reset</button>`;
  if(v==="score"&&S.match)right=`<button class="tbtn" data-act="endmatch">${ic("flag")} End match</button>`;
  const title=DARK.has(v)&&v!=="whatif"?"":TITLES[v];
  const inline=DARK.has(v);
  $("nav").innerHTML=`<div class="bar"><div class="l">${back}</div>${inline&&v==="whatif"?`<b style="font-size:17px">What if</b>`:""}<div class="r">${right}</div></div>${inline?"":`<div class="large">${title}</div>`}`;
  ["live","other"].forEach(x=>$("v-"+x).classList.toggle("on",(x==="live")===(v==="live")));
  $("body").classList.toggle("dk",dark);
}
function go(v){S.stack[S.tab].push(v);navChanged();}
function back(){S.stack[S.tab].pop();navChanged();}
function setTab(t){if(S.tab===t){S.stack[t]=[];}S.tab=t;navChanged();}
function navChanged(){disposeWI();renderNav();refreshOther();if(top()==="live")$("v-live").scrollTop=0;}

/* =====================================================================
   Screens (rendered into v-other)
   ===================================================================== */
function refreshOther(){
  const v=top();if(v==="live")return;
  const el=$("v-other"),keep=el.scrollTop;
  if(v==="whatif")disposeWI();
  el.innerHTML="";
  ({score:scoreHTML,together:togetherHTML,insights:insightsHTML,settings:racketHTML,muse:museHTML,whatif:whatifHTML,memory:memoryHTML,plan:planHTML,scout:scoutHTML,review:reviewHTML,detail:detailHTML,account:accountHTML})[v](el);
  el.scrollTop=keep;
  if(v==="whatif")mountWI();
}
const empty=(t,d,i="racket")=>`<div class="cu" style="background:transparent">${ic(i)}<div class="t">${t}</div><div class="d">${d}</div></div>`;

/* ---------- Insights ---------- */
const METRICS=[["ballSpeed","Ball speed"],["swingSpeed","Swing speed"],["spin","Spin"],["face","Face"],["path","Path"],["contact","Contact"],["shots","Shots"],["sweetSpot","Sweet spot"]];
const mval={ballSpeed:r=>U.speed(r.r.ball),swingSpeed:r=>U.speed(r.p.swing),spin:r=>r.r.rpm,face:r=>r.p.face,path:r=>r.p.path,contact:r=>U.len(r.r.dist)};
const munit=m=>({ballSpeed:U.su(),swingSpeed:U.su(),spin:"rpm",face:"°",path:"°",contact:U.lu(),shots:"shots",sweetSpot:"%"}[m]);
function insightsHTML(el){
  const rs=shownRows(),all=!S.stroke;
  const f=n=>["face","path","contact"].includes(S.metric)?n.toFixed(1):n.toFixed(0);
  let h="";
  if(!rs.length)return el.innerHTML=h+empty("No data yet","Play a session and your trends show up here.","ecg"),bind(el);
  h+=`<div class="chips">${[null,"Forehand","Backhand","Serve","Volley"].map(s=>`<button class="${(S.stroke||null)===s?"on":""}" data-act="stroke" data-v="${s||""}">${s||"All"}</button>`).join("")}</div>`;
  h+=`<div class="mtabs">${METRICS.map(m=>`<button class="${S.metric===m[0]?"on":""}" data-act="metric" data-v="${m[0]}">${m[1]}<span></span></button>`).join("")}</div>`;
  const use=all?rs:rs.filter(x=>x.type===S.stroke.toLowerCase());
  if(!use.length){h+=`<div class="card22" style="min-height:140px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--sec);text-align:center">No ${(S.stroke||"").toLowerCase()} shots in this period</div>`;return el.innerHTML=h,bind(el);}
  let avg,tp,lo,vals;
  if(S.metric==="shots"){avg=use.length;}else if(S.metric==="sweetSpot"){avg=100*use.filter(x=>x.sweet).length/use.length;}
  else{vals=use.map(mval[S.metric]);avg=mean(vals);tp=Math.max(...vals);lo=Math.min(...vals);}
  h+=`<div><div class="bignum">${f(avg)}<small>${munit(S.metric)}</small></div>${vals?`<div class="sub15" style="margin-top:6px">Top ${f(tp)} · Low ${f(lo)} · vs previous period</div>`:""}</div>`;
  // chart: one session = one point with its min-max range bar
  const W=330,H=210,pad=34;let ymin,ymax;
  if(vals){ymin=lo;ymax=tp;}else{ymin=0;ymax=Math.max(avg*1.5,1);}
  const span=Math.max(ymax-ymin,1e-6),pyv=v=>H-24-(v-ymin)/span*(H-54);
  let ch=`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" width="100%">`;
  for(let i=0;i<=3;i++){const v=ymin+span*i/3,y=pyv(v);ch+=`<line x1="${pad}" x2="${W}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="rgba(60,60,67,.18)"/><text x="${pad-6}" y="${y+4}" font-size="11" text-anchor="end" fill="rgba(60,60,67,.6)">${f(v)}</text>`;}
  const x=pad+(W-pad)/2;
  if(S.metric==="shots"||S.metric==="sweetSpot")ch+=`<rect x="${x-18}" y="${pyv(avg)}" width="36" height="${H-24-pyv(avg)}" rx="3" fill="#B0DA1C"/>`;
  else ch+=`<line x1="${x}" x2="${x}" y1="${pyv(tp)}" y2="${pyv(lo)}" stroke="rgba(176,218,28,.28)" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="${x}" cy="${pyv(avg)}" r="6.500" fill="#B0DA1C"/>`;
  ch+=`<text x="${x}" y="${H-4}" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="rgba(60,60,67,.6)">${sessionDate()}</text></svg>`;
  h+=`<div class="card22">${S.metric!=="shots"&&S.metric!=="sweetSpot"?`<div class="cap" style="margin-bottom:4px">${munit(S.metric)}</div>`:""}${ch}</div>`;
  // by stroke, one bar per stroke the session has
  const grp=strokesIn(rs);
  if(all&&grp.length>1){
    const val=g=>{const q=rs.filter(x=>x.type===g);return S.metric==="shots"?q.length:S.metric==="sweetSpot"?100*q.filter(x=>x.sweet).length/q.length:mean(q.map(mval[S.metric]));};
    const vs=grp.map(val),mx=Math.max(...vs.map(Math.abs),1e-6);
    h+=`<div class="card22"><div class="h">By stroke</div>${grp.map((g,k)=>`<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:8px 0"><span style="width:62px;font-size:12px;color:var(--sec)">${LABEL[g]}</span><div style="flex:1"><div style="height:22px;width:${Math.max(2,100*Math.abs(vs[k])/mx)}%;background:#B0DA1C;border-radius:4px"></div></div><span class="cap" style="width:42px;text-align:right">${f(vs[k])}</span></div>`).join("")}</div>`;
  }
  h+=`<div class="card22"><div class="h">Shot by shot</div>${shotsChart(use)}<div class="cap" style="margin-top:4px">Ball speed per hit. Green = sweet spot, red = off center.</div></div>`;
  h+=`<div><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:10px"><span class="h" style="margin:0">Sessions</span><span style="color:var(--blue);font-size:15px">All sessions</span></div>
   <button class="srow" data-act="detail"><span><div class="a">${sessionDate(true)}</div><div class="b">${rs.length} shots · ${Math.max(1,Math.round((rs[rs.length-1].t-rs[0].t)/60))}m</div></span>
   <span class="rt"><div class="a">Avg ${U.sv(mean(rs.map(x=>x.r.ball)))} ${U.su()}</div><div class="b">Top ${U.sv(Math.max(...rs.map(x=>x.r.ball)))} ${U.su()}</div></span><span style="color:var(--ter)">${ic("chev")}</span></button></div>`;
  el.innerHTML=h;bind(el);
}
function sessionDate(long){const d=new Date();return d.toLocaleDateString("en-US",long?{weekday:"short",day:"numeric",month:"short"}:{month:"short",day:"numeric"});}
function shotsChart(rs){
  const W=330,H=90,bw=W/rs.length,mx=Math.max(...rs.map(x=>x.r.ball));
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" width="100%" role="img" aria-label="Ball speed per hit">${rs.map((x,i)=>{const h=Math.max(3,(H-4)*x.r.ball/mx);return `<rect x="${(i*bw+.5).toFixed(1)}" y="${(H-h).toFixed(1)}" width="${Math.max(1,bw-1).toFixed(1)}" height="${h.toFixed(1)}" rx="1.500" fill="${x.sweet?"#34C759":"#FF3B30"}" opacity=".85"/>`;}).join("")}</svg>`;
}
function detailHTML(el){
  const rs=shownRows(),sw=rs.filter(x=>x.sweet).length;
  el.innerHTML=`<div class="tiles">
   <div class="tile"><div class="l">Shots</div><div class="v">${rs.length}</div></div><div class="tile"><div class="l">Sweet spot</div><div class="v">${rs.length?Math.round(100*sw/rs.length):0}<small>%</small></div></div>
   <div class="tile"><div class="l">Avg ball</div><div class="v">${U.sv(mean(rs.map(x=>x.r.ball)))}<small>${U.su()}</small></div></div><div class="tile"><div class="l">Best</div><div class="v">${rs.length?U.sv(Math.max(...rs.map(x=>x.r.ball))):0}<small>${U.su()}</small></div></div></div>
   <div class="card2"><div class="h">Impacts</div>${bedSVG(rs,-1,300)}</div>
   <div class="card2"><div class="h">Shots</div>${rs.slice().reverse().map(x=>`<div class="rrow">${ic(SYM[x.type])}<span>${x.name}</span><span class="sp">${U.sv(x.r.ball)} ${U.su()}</span><span class="dot" style="background:${x.sweet?"var(--green)":"var(--red)"}"></span></div>`).join("")}</div>`;
}

/* ---------- Muse (offline demo engine over real local tool ports) ---------- */
const CANDS=[
 {k:"swing",d:{...Z(),swing:8},title:"Swing a little faster",cue:"Let the racket head run through the ball",why:"More head speed adds ball speed on your average swing."},
 {k:"path",d:{...Z(),path:6},title:"Brush up the back",cue:"Swing low to high through the ball",why:"A steeper brush adds spin without needing more speed."},
 {k:"face",d:{...Z(),face:-4},title:"Close the face a touch",cue:"Feel the strings point slightly down at contact",why:"A slightly closed face turns more of your swing into spin."},
 {k:"contact",d:null,title:"Meet it in the middle",cue:"Aim for the center of the strings",why:"Centered contact keeps the speed you already make."}];
/* The worth-it bar, same numbers as WhatIf.Deltas in the app and the simulate_change gain verdict. */
const GAIN={spinRatio:1.3,spinRPM:400,spinFloor:1200,paceRatio:1.05,centered:2};
const gainOf=(A,B)=>({spin:B.rpm>=Math.max(A.rpm*GAIN.spinRatio,A.rpm+GAIN.spinRPM,GAIN.spinFloor)?"decisive":"small",
  pace:B.ball>=A.ball*GAIN.paceRatio?"decisive":"small",contact:Math.hypot(B.p.cx,B.p.cy)<=GAIN.centered?"centered":"off_center"});
const isDecisive=(A,B)=>{const g=gainOf(A,B);return g.spin==="decisive"||g.pace==="decisive"||(g.contact==="centered"&&Math.hypot(A.p.cx,A.p.cy)>GAIN.centered);};
const scaled=(d,k)=>({swing:clamp(d.swing*k,-30,30),face:clamp(d.face*k,-15,15),path:clamp(d.path*k,-15,15),cx:d.cx,cy:d.cy});
function evalCands(b){
  const A=simulate(b);
  return CANDS.map(c=>{const d0=c.d||{...Z(),cx:clamp(-b.cx,-3,3),cy:clamp(-b.cy,-3,3)};
    // Test two sizes and keep the smallest with a decisive gain, as Muse does in the app.
    const d=c.d&&!isDecisive(A,simulate(apply(b,d0)))&&isDecisive(A,simulate(apply(b,scaled(d0,2))))?scaled(d0,2):d0,B=simulate(apply(b,d));
    return {...c,d,decisive:isDecisive(A,B),verdict:gainOf(A,B),gain:B.ball/A.ball-1,rpm:B.rpm,rpm0:A.rpm,ball:B.ball,score:(B.ball/A.ball-1)+.5*(B.rpm/Math.max(A.rpm,1)-1)};})
    .sort((a,z)=>(z.decisive-a.decisive)||(z.score-a.score));
}
function museHTML(el){
  const rs=shownRows(),f=S.film,st=f?f.stroke:curStroke(rs),b=baselineOf(strokeRows(rs,st));
  let h=`<div class="mh"><span class="t">Muse</span><span class="s"><span class="dot" style="background:var(--m-muted)"></span>Demo engine · offline</span></div>`;
  h+=`<div class="hero" ${f?'data-act="openwi" style="cursor:pointer"':""}><div class="top"><div class="eyebrow" style="opacity:.7">BEST CHANGE · ${st.toUpperCase()}</div><div class="ti">${f?f.title:"Find your best change"}</div>
   <div class="cu2">${f?f.cue:`Muse tests changes on your average ${LABEL[st].toLowerCase()} and shows you the one that helps most.`}</div></div>
   <svg class="sk" viewBox="0 0 300 110" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="M18 42C75 130 190 118 246 28" fill="none" stroke="rgba(17,19,12,.35)" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="6 7"/><path d="M18 52C75 140 190 118 246 20" fill="none" stroke="#11130C" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="214" cy="62" r="10" fill="#FBFBF4" stroke="#11130C" stroke-width="3"/></svg>
   <div class="ft">${f?(()=>{const A=simulate(b),B=simulate(apply(b,f.d));return `<div><div class="v">${(B.ball/A.ball-1>=0?"+":"")+Math.round((B.ball/A.ball-1)*100)}%</div><div class="l">ball speed</div></div><div><div class="v">${Math.round(B.rpm)}</div><div class="l">rpm, was ${Math.round(A.rpm)}</div></div><span class="go">Watch ›</span>`;})():
   `<span class="e">${rs.length?"Runs on this page, not Muse Spark":"Play or skip to the end of the match first"}</span><button class="go" data-act="findfilm" ${rs.length?"":"disabled"} style="min-height:44px">Find it ›</button>`}</div></div>`;
  h+=`<div class="mtiles"><button class="mtile" data-act="drill" ${rs.length?"":"disabled"}>${ic("scope")}<span class="a">${S.drillRun?"Drill running":"Next drill"}</span><span class="b">${S.drillRun?S.drill.goal:rs.length?"Muse plans one for you":"Play a session first"}</span></button>
   <button class="mtile" data-act="memory">${ic("brain")}<span class="a">Memory</span><span class="b">0 notes Muse keeps</span></button></div>`;
  if(S.drill)h+=`<div class="mcard"><div class="eyebrow" style="color:var(--m-muted)">NEXT DRILL</div><div style="font:800 22px var(--rounded);margin:6px 0">${S.drill.title}</div><div>${S.drill.goal}</div><div class="mfoot" style="margin-top:6px">${S.drill.why}</div>
   <button data-act="rundrill" style="margin-top:12px;width:100%;min-height:44px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--m-lime);color:var(--m-ink);font-weight:700" ${S.drillRun?"disabled":""}>${S.drillRun?"Drill running":"Start on Watch"}</button></div>`;
  h+=`<button class="mrow" data-act="openwi">${ic("sliders")}<span><div class="a">What if</div><div class="b">Try a change on your swing in 3D</div></span><span class="ch">${ic("chev")}</span></button>`;
  const pend=S.reviews.filter(x=>x.status==="pending").length;
  h+=`<button class="mrow" data-act="plan">${ic("listn")}<span><div class="a">Practice plan</div><div class="b">${S.plan?`${S.plan.title} · ${S.plan.steps.length} steps`:"Three steps from your last session"}</div></span><span class="ch">${ic("chev")}</span></button>`;
  h+=`<button class="mrow" data-act="scout">${ic("bino")}<span><div class="a">Scout yourself</div><div class="b">Where an opponent would attack you</div></span><span class="ch">${ic("chev")}</span></button>`;
  h+=`<button class="mrow" data-act="review">${ic("flag")}<span><div class="a">Review queue</div><div class="b">${pend?`${pend} waiting for you`:"Flag a session for a human look"}</div></span><span class="ch">${ic("chev")}</span></button>`;
  h+=`<div><div class="eyebrow" style="color:var(--m-muted);margin:4px 0 8px">ASK</div><div class="asklist">${SUGG.map(q=>`<button data-act="ask" data-v="${q}"><span>${q}</span>${ic("chev")}</button>`).join("")}</div></div>`;
  S.chat.forEach((c,i)=>{h+=`<div class="mcard"><div class="mq">${c.q}</div><div class="mans">${c.a}</div>${i===S.chat.length-1?`<div class="mfoot">Tools: ${c.tools.join(", ")} · demo engine, template reply over real tool results</div>`:""}</div>`;});
  h+=`<div class="mcard" style="font-size:12px;color:var(--m-muted)">In the app, Muse Spark makes these tool calls on your sessions and writes the reply. This page can't reach Muse, so a template writes the reply from the same tool outputs, computed here on the replayed match.</div>`;
  el.innerHTML=h;
  const bar=document.createElement("div");bar.className="askbar";bar.id="askbar";
  bar.innerHTML=`<div class="in"><input id="q" placeholder="Ask Muse anything about your game" value="${S.question.replace(/"/g,"&quot;")}"><button data-act="send" aria-label="Send">${ic("up")}</button></div>`;
  $("body").querySelector("#askbar")?.remove();$("body").appendChild(bar);
  const q=$("q");q.addEventListener("input",()=>S.question=q.value);q.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Enter")askMuse(q.value);});
  bind(el);
}
const SUGG=["What's my weakest stroke?","Am I getting tired?","Show my last 5 off-center hits","Is the racket working right?"];
const f1=v=>Math.round(v*10)/10;
const strokeRows=(rs,t)=>rs.filter(x=>x.type===t);
function curStroke(rs){const st=strokesIn(rs);return st.includes(S.wiStroke)?S.wiStroke:(st[0]||"hit");}
function wiBase(){const rs=shownRows(),st=curStroke(rs),q=strokeRows(rs,st);return {rs,st,q,b:baselineOf(q)};}

function answer(q){
  const rs=shownRows(),n=rs.length,low=q.toLowerCase();
  if(!n)return {a:"Play or skip to the end of the match first, then ask again.",tools:[]};
  if(/tired|fade|late|fatigue/.test(low)){
    const t=Math.max(1,Math.floor(n/3)),a=mean(rs.slice(0,t).map(x=>x.p.swing)),z=mean(rs.slice(-t).map(x=>x.p.swing));
    return {tools:["query_shots","query_shots"],a:Math.abs(z-a)<1?`No. Your swing speed held steady: ${U.sv(a)} ${U.su()} in the first third, ${U.sv(z)} ${U.su()} in the last.`:
      `Swing speed went from ${U.sv(a)} ${U.su()} in the first third of the session to ${U.sv(z)} ${U.su()} in the last third (${z<a?"down":"up"} ${Math.round(100*Math.abs(z-a)/a)}%).${z<a?" That's a sign of tiring.":" It rose rather than faded."}`};}
  if(/off.?center|last 5|miss|sweet/.test(low)){
    const off=rs.filter(x=>!x.sweet).slice(-5).reverse();
    if(!off.length)return {tools:["list_shots"],a:"Every hit so far was in the sweet spot."};
    return {tools:["list_shots"],a:`Your last ${off.length} off-center hits:\n`+off.map(x=>`• ${clockStr(x.t)} — ${U.lt(x.r.dist)} from center, ${U.sv(x.r.ball)} ${U.su()}`).join("\n")+`\nOverall ${rs.filter(x=>!x.sweet).length} of ${n} hits missed the sweet spot.`};}
  if(/weak|stroke|worst|best/.test(low)){
    const sw=rs.filter(x=>x.sweet).length,grp=strokesIn(rs),lab=rs.some(x=>x.outcome);
    if(grp.length>1&&!lab){
      const st=grp.map(g=>{const q=strokeRows(rs,g);return `• ${LABEL[g]}: ${q.length} hits, average ball ${U.sv(mean(q.map(x=>x.r.ball)))} ${U.su()}`;});
      return {tools:grp.map(()=>"query_shots"),a:`I can't say which stroke loses you points: this replay has no outcome labels (winner or error), and the sweet-spot rates are an assumption. What it does show, with stroke types predicted by the F3Tennis model:\n`+st.join("\n")};}
    if(grp.length<2||!lab)return {tools:["get_session_digest"],a:`Every hit in this replay is logged as a plain "Hit", because this match's clips carry no stroke labels, so there is no stroke to compare. What the data does show: ${Math.round(100*sw/n)}% of ${n} hits found the sweet spot, and the average ball was ${U.sv(mean(rs.map(x=>x.r.ball)))} ${U.su()}.`};
    // the dataset labels each hit's outcome, so this one is real data, not the contact prior
    const st=grp.map(g=>{const q=strokeRows(rs,g),e=q.filter(x=>/err/.test(x.outcome||"")).length;return {g,n:q.length,e,rate:e/q.length,ball:mean(q.map(x=>x.r.ball))};}).filter(x=>x.n>=3).sort((a,z)=>z.rate-a.rate);
    const w=st[0];
    return {tools:grp.map(()=>"query_shots"),a:`By the dataset's own labels, your ${LABEL[w.g].toLowerCase()} lost the most points: ${w.e} errors in ${w.n} hits (${Math.round(100*w.rate)}%).\n`+st.map(x=>`• ${LABEL[x.g]}: ${x.e} errors in ${x.n} hits, average ball ${U.sv(x.ball)} ${U.su()}`).join("\n")+`\nSmall numbers, so read it as a hint. Errors are the dataset's labels (forced and unforced); sweet-spot rates here are an assumption and not used for this.`};}
  if(/racket|working|battery|sensor|firmware/.test(low))
    return {tools:["get_racket_status"],a:"This is a video replay, so no racket hardware is connected and there is no battery or firmware to report. With a real racket, Muse reads those straight from its status packet."};
  return {tools:[],a:"In this demo I can answer the four suggested questions. Tap one above."};
}
function askMuse(q){q=(q||"").trim();if(!q)return;const r=answer(q);S.chat.push({q,a:r.a,tools:r.tools});S.question="";refreshOther();const sc=$("v-other");sc.scrollTop=sc.scrollHeight;}
function memoryHTML(el){el.innerHTML=`<div class="mh"><span class="t">Memory</span></div>${`<div class="mcard" style="text-align:center;padding:40px 20px"><div style="font-size:44px;color:var(--m-lime)">${ic("brain")}</div><div style="font:800 20px var(--rounded);margin:8px 0">No notes yet</div><div style="color:var(--m-muted)">Muse keeps short notes about your habits between sessions. This replay starts with none.</div></div>`}`;}

/* ---------- Muse feature screens (demo engine over the replay's own numbers) ---------- */
const museHead=(t,sub,right="")=>`<div class="mh"><span class="t" style="font-size:30px">${t}</span>${right}</div><div class="msub">${sub}</div>`;
const engLabel=()=>`<div class="eng"><i></i>Demo engine · offline</div>`;
function strokeStats(rs){return strokesIn(rs).map(g=>{const q=strokeRows(rs,g);return {g,n:q.length,sw:q.filter(x=>x.sweet).length/q.length,ball:mean(q.map(x=>x.r.ball)),off:q.filter(x=>!x.sweet)};}).filter(x=>x.n>=3);}
function makePlan(rs){
  const st=strokeStats(rs).sort((a,z)=>a.sw-z.sw),w=st[0]||{g:"hit",sw:rs.filter(x=>x.sweet).length/Math.max(1,rs.length)};
  const name=LABEL[w.g].toLowerCase(),n=Math.round(clamp(5+10*(1-w.sw),5,15)),when=new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-US",{weekday:"short",day:"numeric",month:"short"});
  return {title:`Center the ${name}`,when,steps:[
    {title:`Center ${name}s`,goal:`Land ${n} sweet-spot ${name}s.`,why:`Your ${name} found the sweet spot ${Math.round(100*w.sw)}% of the time here, the lowest of your strokes (an estimate).`,note:"Slow it down: aim for the middle of the strings, not the fastest ball."},
    {title:"Add pace, keep the middle",goal:`Hit ${n+3} balls at your normal pace with centered contact.`,why:"Pace only helps if the contact stays centered.",note:"If you start missing the middle, ease off."},
    {title:"Rally count",goal:"Keep one rally going for 12 shots.",why:"Puts the first two steps under match pressure.",note:""}]};
}
function planHTML(el){
  const rs=shownRows(),P=S.plan;let h=museHead("Practice plan","Three steps from your last session: the weakest link first, a progression, then a rally count.");
  if(P){
    h+=`<div style="background:var(--m-lime);color:var(--m-ink);border-radius:22px;padding:16px"><div class="eyebrow" style="opacity:.7">PLAN · ${P.when.toUpperCase()}</div><div style="font:800 24px var(--rounded);margin:6px 0">${P.title}</div><div style="font-size:11px;opacity:.7">Demo engine · offline</div></div>`;
    P.steps.forEach((x,i)=>{const run=S.planRun===i;
      h+=`<div class="mcard"><div class="eyebrow" style="color:var(--m-muted)">STEP ${i+1}</div><div style="font:800 20px var(--rounded);margin:6px 0">${x.title}</div><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px">${ic("target")}<span>${x.goal}</span></div><div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--m-muted)">${x.why}</div>${x.note?`<div style="font-style:italic;opacity:.85;margin-top:6px">${x.note}</div>`:""}
       <button class="mbtn" style="margin-top:12px;${run?"opacity:.6":""}" data-act="planstep" data-v="${i}" ${run?"disabled":""}>${ic(run?"check":"play")} ${run?"Running on Watch":"Start"}</button></div>`;});
  }else h+=`<div class="mcard">${rs.length?"No plan yet. Muse writes one from your last session.":"Play a session first, then Muse writes a plan from it."}</div>`;
  h+=`<button class="mbtn ghost" data-act="writeplan" ${rs.length?"":"disabled"}>${P?"Write a new plan":"Write my plan"}</button>`;
  el.innerHTML=h;
}
function makeScout(rs){
  const st=strokeStats(rs);if(!st.length)return "Not enough hits yet to scout.";
  const by=st.slice().sort((a,z)=>a.sw-z.sw),w=by[0],b=by[by.length-1];
  const off=w.off,mx=mean(off.map(x=>x.p.cx)),my=mean(off.map(x=>x.p.cy));
  const dir=Math.abs(my)>=Math.abs(mx)?(my>0?"toward the tip":"toward the throat"):(mx>0?"to the right":"to the left");
  return `Over ${rs.length} hits, an opponent would see your ${LABEL[w.g].toLowerCase()} as the softer wing: ${Math.round(100*w.sw)}% sweet-spot against ${Math.round(100*b.sw)}% on your ${LABEL[b.g].toLowerCase()}.\n\nAttack: go at the ${LABEL[w.g].toLowerCase()}. When it misses the middle it drifts ${dir} (about ${U.lt(mean(off.map(x=>x.r.dist)))} off center), which tends to cost you pace: ${U.sv(w.ball)} ${U.su()} on average against ${U.sv(b.ball)} ${U.su()} on the ${LABEL[b.g].toLowerCase()}.\n\nLean on: the ${LABEL[b.g].toLowerCase()}. Avoid: long exchanges on the ${LABEL[w.g].toLowerCase()} side.\n\nThese are estimates: contact points here are an assumption, not measured.`;
}
function scoutHTML(el){
  const rs=shownRows();let h=museHead("Scout yourself","Muse reads your recent sessions the way an opponent would and predicts where they'd attack.");
  h+=`<div class="mcard"><div class="eyebrow" style="color:var(--m-muted)">MATCH PLAN</div><div style="margin:10px 0;white-space:pre-wrap">${S.scout||(rs.length?"Muse writes a short plan: how you match up, what to lean on, what to avoid.":"Play a session first, then scout.")}</div>
   <button class="mbtn" data-act="writescout" ${rs.length?"":"disabled"}>${S.scout?"Write it again":"Write the plan"}</button>${engLabel()}</div>`;
  el.innerHTML=h;
}
function makeReview(rs){
  const flags=[],t=Math.max(1,Math.floor(rs.length/3)),a=mean(rs.slice(0,t).map(x=>x.p.swing)),z=mean(rs.slice(-t).map(x=>x.p.swing)),sw=rs.filter(x=>x.sweet).length/rs.length;
  if(z<a*.92)flags.push({label:"Swing speed faded late",detail:"Your swing got slower toward the end of the session.",evidence:`first third ${U.sv(a)} → last third ${U.sv(z)} ${U.su()}`});
  if(sw<.7)flags.push({label:"Many off-center hits",detail:"Fewer than 7 in 10 hits found the sweet spot.",evidence:`${Math.round(100*sw)}% sweet spot over ${rs.length} hits (estimate)`});
  const when=new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-US",{weekday:"short",day:"numeric",month:"short"});
  return {label:`${when} · ${rs.length} shots`,flags,clear:!flags.length,status:"pending",at:null};
}
function reviewHTML(el){
  const rs=shownRows(),pend=S.reviews.filter(x=>x.status==="pending").length;
  let h=museHead("Review queue","Muse flags the moments in a session that need a human look. Approve what you'll work on; dismiss the rest.",pend?`<span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--m-lime)">${pend} pending</span>`:"");
  h+=`<button class="mbtn" data-act="reviewnow" ${rs.length?"":"disabled"}>Review this session</button>`;
  if(!S.reviews.length)h+=`<div class="mcard" style="color:var(--m-muted)">No reviews yet.</div>`;
  S.reviews.forEach((r,i)=>{
    const col=r.status==="pending"?"var(--m-lime)":r.status==="approved"?"var(--m-good)":"var(--m-ghost)";
    h+=`<div class="mcard"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center"><span class="eyebrow" style="color:var(--m-muted)">${r.label.toUpperCase()}</span><span class="stat" style="color:${col};border-color:${col}">${r.status[0].toUpperCase()+r.status.slice(1)}</span></div>`;
    if(r.clear)h+=`<div style="color:var(--m-good);margin:10px 0">${ic("check")} Nothing needs a review.</div>`;
    else r.flags.forEach(f=>{h+=`<div class="flagrow"><b>${ic("flagf")} ${f.label}</b><div>${f.detail}</div><div class="ev">${f.evidence}</div></div>`;});
    if(r.status==="pending")h+=`<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:10px"><button class="mbtn" data-act="decide" data-v="${i}:approved">${ic("check")} Approve</button><button class="mbtn dim" data-act="decide" data-v="${i}:dismissed">${ic("x")} Dismiss</button></div>`;
    else h+=`<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--m-muted);margin-top:8px">${r.status==="approved"?"Approved":"Dismissed"} ${r.at}</div>`;
    h+=engLabel()+`</div>`;});
  el.innerHTML=h;
}

/* ---------- What if ---------- */
let wiStage=null,wiStart=0,wiKey="";
const WI_TIMING={half:2.6,contactAt:1.1,slow:.16};
const CAP={
  swing:v=>v?`${v>0?"+":"−"}${Math.abs(v)}%`:"same",
  path:v=>v?`${Math.abs(v)}° ${v>0?"more low-to-high":"flatter"}`:"same",
  face:v=>v?`${Math.abs(v)}° ${v>0?"more open":"more closed"}`:"same",
  cy:v=>v?`${U.lt(Math.abs(v))} toward ${v>0?"tip":"throat"}`:"same",
  cx:v=>v?`${U.lt(Math.abs(v))} ${v>0?"right":"left"}`:"same"};
const cap1=s=>s[0].toUpperCase()+s.slice(1);
const curFilm=()=>S.film&&S.film.stroke===wiBase().st&&JSON.stringify(S.film.d)===JSON.stringify(S.d)?S.film:null;
function wiTiles(){
  const d=S.d,stat={Speed:d.swing?`${d.swing>0?"+":"−"}${Math.abs(d.swing)}%`:"0%",Path:d.path?`${d.path>0?"+":"−"}${Math.abs(d.path)}°`:"0°",Face:d.face?`${d.face>0?"+":"−"}${Math.abs(d.face)}°`:"0°",
    Contact:Math.hypot(d.cx,d.cy)?U.lt(Math.hypot(d.cx,d.cy)):"0 "+U.lu()};
  const chg={Speed:!!d.swing,Path:!!d.path,Face:!!d.face,Contact:!!(d.cx||d.cy)};
  return ["Speed","Path","Face","Contact"].map(l=>`<button class="${S.lever===l?"sel":""} ${chg[l]?"chg":""}" data-act="lever" data-v="${l}"><span class="l">${l}</span><span class="v">${stat[l]}</span></button>`).join("");
}
function wiCue(){const f=curFilm();return f?`<div class="cue">${f.cue}</div><div class="why">${f.why}</div>`:"";}
function wiResults(b){
  const A=simulate(b),B=simulate(apply(b,S.d)),f=curFilm();
  const bar=(lab,b0,a0,unit,note,t)=>{const up=a0-b0;return `<div class="res"><div class="rw"><span>${lab}</span><span class="n">${Math.abs(up)>=.5?`<i>${Math.round(b0)} → </i>`:""}${Math.round(a0)} ${unit}</span></div>
    <div class="pbar"><i style="width:${100*b0/t}%;background:var(--m-ghost)"></i>${Math.abs(up)>=.5?`<i style="width:${100*a0/t}%;background:${up>0?"var(--m-lime)":"#FF998C"};opacity:.9"></i>`:""}</div>${note?`<div class="nt">${note}</div>`:""}</div>`;};
  return bar("Ball speed",U.speed(A.ball),U.speed(B.ball),U.su(),"",Math.max(U.speed(A.ball),U.speed(B.ball),1)*1.15)+
    bar("Spin",A.rpm,B.rpm,"rpm",A.spin===B.spin?"":`${cap1(A.spin)} → ${cap1(B.spin)}`,Math.max(A.rpm,B.rpm,1)*1.15)+
    wiVerdict(A,B)+`<div class="mfoot" style="margin:0">${f?"Estimated by the racket's physics model. Picked and tested by Muse (demo engine).":"Estimated by the racket's physics model on your average swing. Ball flight isn't modeled."} Ball flight, landing and net clearance are not modeled.</div>`;
}
function wiEditor(){
  const sl=(t,key,lim,step)=>`<div class="sl"><div class="tp"><b>${t}</b><span data-cap="${key}">${CAP[key](S.d[key])}</span></div><input type="range" data-d="${key}" min="${-lim}" max="${lim}" step="${step}" value="${S.d[key]}" aria-label="${t}"></div>`;
  return {Speed:()=>sl("Swing speed","swing",30,1),Path:()=>sl("Swing path","path",15,1),Face:()=>sl("Racket face","face",15,1),
    Contact:()=>sl("Tip ↔ throat","cy",5,.5)+sl("Left ↔ right","cx",5,.5)}[S.lever]();
}
function bindSlider(i){
  i.addEventListener("input",()=>{S.d[i.dataset.d]=+i.value;const cp=document.querySelector(`[data-cap="${i.dataset.d}"]`);
    if(cp)cp.textContent=CAP[i.dataset.d](S.d[i.dataset.d]);wiUpdate();});
}
function wiVerdict(A,B){
  if(isZero(S.d))return "";const g=gainOf(A,B);
  return `<div class="mfoot" style="margin:0 0 6px" id="wi-gain">Estimated gain: spin ${g.spin}, pace ${g.pace}, contact ${g.contact==="centered"?"centered":"off center"}.</div>`;
}
const describeD=d=>Object.keys(CAP).filter(k=>d[k]).map(k=>`${({swing:"swing",path:"path",face:"face",cy:"contact",cx:"contact"})[k]} ${CAP[k](d[k])}`).join(", ");
function wiTrials(){
  const w=wiBase();if(!w.b)return "";
  const pend=S.trials.filter(t=>!t.completed);
  return `<button class="mrow" data-act="tryit" id="wi-tryit" ${isZero(S.d)?'disabled style="opacity:.5;margin-bottom:12px"':'style="margin-bottom:12px"'}>${ic("flag")}<span><div class="a">Try it</div><div class="b">Save this change to check later</div></span></button>`+
   (pend.length?`<div style="font-weight:700;color:var(--m-text);margin-bottom:8px">Changes you are trying</div>`+pend.map(t=>`<div class="mcard" style="margin-bottom:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px"><div style="flex:1"><div style="font-weight:600">${cap1(t.goal)}</div><div class="mfoot" style="margin:2px 0 0">${t.text}</div></div>${strokeRows(w.rs,t.stroke).length?`<button data-act="followup" data-v="${t.id}" style="color:var(--m-lime);font-weight:600;min-height:44px">Log follow-up</button>`:""}</div>`).join(""):"");
}
function whatifHTML(el){
  const {rs:all,st,q:rs,b}=wiBase();
  if(!b)return el.innerHTML=`<div class="mcard" style="text-align:center;padding:40px 20px;color:var(--m-text)"><div style="font-size:44px;color:var(--m-lime)">${ic("sliders")}</div><div style="font:800 20px var(--rounded);margin:8px 0">No swings to test yet</div><div style="color:var(--m-muted)">Play a session with the racket's motion sensors on, then try changes here.</div></div>`;
  let h=`<div class="sw">${strokesIn(all).map(t=>`<button class="${t===st?"on":""}" data-act="wistroke" data-v="${t}">${LABEL[t]}</button>`).join("")}</div>
   <div class="stage3d"><div class="gl" id="wigl"></div><div class="tg" id="witag"></div>
    <div class="modes" id="wimodes">${["Both","Yours","Change"].map(m=>`<button class="${(S.wiMode||"Both")===m?"on":""}" data-act="wimode" data-v="${m}">${m}</button>`).join("")}</div></div>
   <div id="wi-cue" style="margin-bottom:12px">${wiCue()}</div>
   <div class="bl">Your average ${LABEL[st].toLowerCase()}: ${rs.length} swings, ${U.sv(b.swing)} ${U.su()}, path ${Math.abs(Math.round(b.path))}° ${b.path>=0?"up":"down"}, face ${Math.abs(Math.round(b.face))}° ${b.face>=0?"open":"closed"}, contact ${Math.hypot(b.cx,b.cy)<.5?"centered":U.lt(Math.hypot(b.cx,b.cy))}.</div>
   <div class="lt" id="wi-tiles">${wiTiles()}</div>
   <div class="mcard" style="margin-bottom:12px" id="wi-ed">${wiEditor()}</div>
   <div class="mcard res" id="wi-res">${wiResults(b)}</div>
   <div id="wi-try" style="margin-top:12px">${wiTrials()}</div>`;
  el.innerHTML=h;
  const bb=document.createElement("div");bb.className="bbar";bb.id="bbar";
  bb.innerHTML=`<button class="p" data-act="bestchange">${ic("sparkles")} ${S.film?"Find another change":"Find the best change"}</button><button class="g" data-act="wireset">Reset</button>`;
  $("body").querySelector("#bbar")?.remove();$("body").appendChild(bb);
  el.querySelectorAll("input[data-d]").forEach(bindSlider);
}
function wiUpdate(){
  const b=wiBase().b;if(!b||!$("wi-res"))return;
  $("wi-tiles").innerHTML=wiTiles();$("wi-res").innerHTML=wiResults(b);$("wi-try").innerHTML=wiTrials();$("wi-cue").innerHTML=wiCue();
  const rb=document.querySelector('.nav [data-act="wireset"]');if(rb)rb.style.opacity=isZero(S.d)?".4":"1";
}
function mountWI(){
  if(wiStage||!glOK)return;
  const el=$("wigl");if(!el)return;
  const sh=shapeOf(wiBase().st);
  wiStage=new Stage(el,{bg:0x0b0c09,pos:sh.camera.clone(),target:sh.target,key:2.4,amb:1.2,rim:true,wide:true});
  const grid=new THREE.GridHelper(4,20,0x3a3d2c,0x1d2016);grid.position.y=sh.floorY;wiStage.scene.add(grid);
  const bm=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xd9ed40,emissive:0x2a2e0a,roughness:.7});
  wiStage.ball=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(BALL_R,32,24),bm);
  const seam=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(BALL_R*1.002,.0024,8,48),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xf5f5f5}));seam.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;wiStage.ball.add(seam);wiStage.scene.add(wiStage.ball);
  wiStage.trail=new THREE.Mesh();wiStage.ghost=new THREE.Mesh();wiStage.scene.add(wiStage.trail,wiStage.ghost);wiStart=performance.now();wiKey="";
}
function disposeWI(){if(wiStage){wiStage.dispose();wiStage=null;}}
function tube(pts,rad,color,op=1){
  const g=new THREE.TubeGeometry(new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts),pts.length*2,rad,8,false);
  return {g,m:new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color,transparent:op<1,opacity:op})};
}
function frameWhatIf(now){
  const {st:stk,b}=wiBase();if(!b||!wiStage)return;const sh=shapeOf(stk),st=wiStage;
  const a=simulate(b),A=simulate(apply(b,S.d)),hasChange=!isZero(S.d),mode=S.wiMode||"Both";
  const clock=(now-wiStart)/1000,both=mode==="Both"&&hasChange,H=WI_TIMING.half;
  const u=clock%(both?2*H:H),changed=both?u>=H:(mode==="Change"&&hasChange),t=(((both&&changed)?u-H:u)-WI_TIMING.contactAt)*WI_TIMING.slow;
  const p=changed?apply(b,S.d):b,res=changed?A:a;
  const pose=poseAt(p,t,sh);st.setPose(pose.m);
  const key=JSON.stringify([p,changed,hasChange,stk]);
  const pts=[];for(let x=-.32;x<=Math.min(t,.32);x+=.0075)pts.push(poseAt(p,x,sh).bed);
  if(pts.length>=2){const T=tube(pts,.008,0xdde85b);st.trail.geometry.dispose();st.trail.geometry=T.g;st.trail.material=T.m;st.trail.visible=true;}else st.trail.visible=false;
  if(key!==wiKey){wiKey=key;
    if(changed){const gp=[];for(let x=-.32;x<=.32;x+=.0075)gp.push(poseAt(b,x,sh).bed);const T=tube(gp,.006,0x7d856a,.7);st.ghost.geometry.dispose();st.ghost.geometry=T.g;st.ghost.material=T.m;st.ghost.visible=true;}else st.ghost.visible=false;}
  const ballOut=t>.11;st.ball.visible=!ballOut;
  if(t<0)st.ball.position.set(1,.04,0).normalize().multiplyScalar(p.inc/3.6*-t);
  else{st.ball.position.copy(pose.normal).multiplyScalar(res.ball/3.6*t);const c=poseAt(p,0,sh);st.ball.quaternion.setFromAxisAngle(c.up,-res.rpm/60*2*Math.PI*t);}
  const tag=$("witag");if(tag){const html=hasChange?`<span class="${changed?"hot":""}">${changed?"With change":"Yours"}</span>`:`<span>Yours</span>`;if(tag.dataset.k!==html){tag.innerHTML=html;tag.dataset.k=html;}}
  st.render(now);
}

/* ---------- Score ---------- */
const PC=["0","15","30","40"];
function newMatchState(r){return {r:{...r},pts:[0,0],games:[0,0],sets:[],tb:false,mtb:false,winner:null,hist:[]};}
function snap(m){return JSON.stringify({pts:m.pts,games:m.games,sets:m.sets,tb:m.tb,mtb:m.mtb,winner:m.winner});}
function awardPoint(p){
  const m=S.match;if(!m||(m.winner!=null&&!m.hist.length))return;
  m.hist.push(snap(m));const o=1-p,r=m.r;
  if(r.simple){m.pts[p]++;return;}
  if(m.winner!=null)return;
  m.pts[p]++;
  const gameWon=()=>{if(m.tb||m.mtb){const tgt=m.mtb?10:7;return m.pts[p]>=tgt&&m.pts[p]-m.pts[o]>=2;}
    if(r.noAd)return m.pts[p]>=4;return m.pts[p]>=4&&m.pts[p]-m.pts[o]>=2;};
  if(!gameWon())return;
  const wasMTB=m.mtb;m.pts=[0,0];
  if(wasMTB){m.sets.push([m.sets.length?0:0,0]);m.sets.pop();m.sets.push(p===0?[1,0]:[0,1]);finishSet(p,true);return;}
  m.games[p]++;const g=m.games;
  if(m.tb){m.tb=false;finishSet(p);return;}
  if(g[p]>=6&&g[p]-g[o]>=2||g[p]===7){finishSet(p);return;}
  if(g[0]===6&&g[1]===6)m.tb=true;
}
function finishSet(p,mtb){
  const m=S.match,o=1-p;if(!mtb)m.sets.push(m.games.slice());m.games=[0,0];
  const won=[0,0];m.sets.forEach(s=>{if(s[0]>s[1])won[0]++;else won[1]++;});
  if(won[p]>=m.r.setsToWin)m.winner=p;
  else if(m.r.matchTB&&m.r.setsToWin>1&&won[0]===1&&won[1]===1)m.mtb=true;
}
function pointCall(p){const m=S.match,o=1-p;if(m.winner!=null)return"";if(m.tb||m.mtb)return""+m.pts[p];
  const a=m.pts[p],b=m.pts[o];if(m.r.noAd)return PC[Math.min(a,3)];
  if(a>=3&&b>=3){return a===b?"40":a>b?"Ad":"40";}return PC[Math.min(a,3)];}
function pointText(){const m=S.match;if(m.winner!=null)return m.winner===0?"You won the match":"Your opponent won the match";
  if(m.tb||m.mtb)return"Tiebreak";const[a,b]=m.pts;if(!m.r.noAd&&a>=3&&b>=3)return a===b?"Deuce":a>b?"Advantage you":"Advantage opponent";return"Game in progress";}
function scoreHTML(el){
  const m=S.match;let h="";
  if(!m){
    const r=S.rules;
    h=`<div class="card2" style="border-radius:20px;padding:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;align-items:stretch"><div style="text-align:center;color:var(--accent);font-size:48px;filter:saturate(1.2)">${ic("trophy")}</div><div style="font-size:22px;font-weight:700;text-align:center">Keep score with the racket</div>
     <div class="seg3" data-g="simple"><button class="${!r.simple?"on":""}" data-act="rule" data-k="simple" data-v="0">Tennis scoring</button><button class="${r.simple?"on":""}" data-act="rule" data-k="simple" data-v="1">Just count points</button></div>
     ${!r.simple?`<div class="seg3"><button class="${r.setsToWin===2?"on":""}" data-act="rule" data-k="sets" data-v="2">Best of 3 sets</button><button class="${r.setsToWin===1?"on":""}" data-act="rule" data-k="sets" data-v="1">One set</button></div>
     <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center"><span>No-ad scoring</span><button class="sw3 ${r.noAd?"on":""}" data-act="rule" data-k="noad"><i></i></button></div>
     ${r.setsToWin>1?`<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px"><span>Match tiebreak instead of a third set</span><button class="sw3 ${r.matchTB?"on":""}" data-act="rule" data-k="mtb"><i></i></button></div>`:""}`:""}
     <button class="btnp" data-act="startmatch">${ic("play")} Start match</button></div>`;
  }else{
    const simple=m.r.simple;
    if(simple){h+=`<div class="zones">${[0,1].map(p=>`<button class="zone" style="background:${p?"var(--red)":"var(--green)"}" data-act="pt" data-v="${p}"><span style="font-size:15px">${p?"Opponent":"You"}</span><b>${m.pts[p]}</b><span style="font-size:12px;opacity:.85">Tap +1</span></button>`).join("")}</div>`;}
    else{h+=`<div class="card2" style="border-radius:20px;padding:18px"><table class="sb"><tr><th></th>${m.sets.map((s,i)=>`<th>Set ${i+1}</th>`).join("")}${m.winner==null?`<th>${m.mtb?"":"Games"}</th><th>${m.tb||m.mtb?"Tiebreak":"Points"}</th>`:""}</tr>
     ${[0,1].map(p=>`<tr><td style="font-weight:600">${m.winner===p?`<span style="color:#FFCC00">${ic("trophyf")}</span> `:""}${p?"Opponent":"You"}</td>${m.sets.map(s=>`<td style="font-size:20px;font-weight:${s[p]>s[1-p]?700:400};color:${s[p]>s[1-p]?"#000":"var(--sec)"}">${s[p]}</td>`).join("")}${m.winner==null?`<td style="font-size:22px;font-weight:700">${m.mtb?"":m.games[p]}</td><td class="pt">${pointCall(p)}</td>`:""}</tr>`).join("")}</table>
     <div style="text-align:center;color:var(--sec);font-weight:500;font-size:15px;margin-top:12px">${pointText()}</div></div>`;}
    if(!simple)h+=`<div style="display:flex;gap:10px"><button class="btn2" style="background:var(--green)" data-act="pt" data-v="0">${ic("check")} I won</button><button class="btn2" style="background:var(--red)" data-act="pt" data-v="1">${ic("x")} They won</button><button class="btn2" style="background:var(--fill2);color:#000;flex:0 0 56px" data-act="undo" ${m.hist.length?"":"disabled"}>${ic("undo")}</button></div>`;
    else h+=`<div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end"><button class="btn2" style="background:var(--fill2);color:#000;flex:0 0 56px" data-act="undo" ${m.hist.length?"":"disabled"}>${ic("undo")}</button></div>`;
  }
  h+=`<div class="card2" style="background:transparent;padding:0"><div class="h">Score by tapping the handle</div>
   ${[["2","Double tap a wide side","You won the point"],["2","Double tap a narrow side","Your opponent won it"],["3","Triple tap anywhere","Undo the last point"]].map(r=>`<div style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin:10px 0"><span style="width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);color:#000;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:15px">${r[0]}</span><span><div style="font-size:15px">${r[1]}</div><div class="cap">${r[2]}</div></span></div>`).join("")}
   <div class="cap" style="margin-top:6px">Taps are ignored for a few seconds after each shot, so a rally can't score by accident. The emulator has no handle to tap, so use the buttons above.</div></div>`;
  el.innerHTML=h;bind(el);
}

/* ---------- Together / Racket / Account ---------- */
function togetherHTML(el){
  el.innerHTML=`<div class="sect"><div class="grp"><div style="display:block">Sign in to invite friends and share a session.</div><button class="link" data-act="account">Sign in</button></div></div>
   <div class="cap" style="padding:0 16px">Shared matches need an account. The emulator has no sign-in, so this screen shows the signed-out state.</div>`;bind(el);
}
function accountHTML(el){
  el.innerHTML=`<div class="sect"><div class="grp"><div style="display:block;color:var(--sec)">Sign in with Apple is part of the iPhone app. The emulator doesn't sign in or send anything anywhere.</div></div></div>`;
}
const swc=(on,act,k)=>`<button class="sw3 ${on?"on":""}" data-act="${act}" data-k="${k||""}" role="switch" aria-checked="${on}"><i></i></button>`;
function racketHTML(el){
  const P=PLAYERS[S.pi]||{name:"—"};
  el.innerHTML=`<div class="sect"><div class="grp"><button data-act="together"><span class="lk">${ic("people")}Play together</span><span class="ch">${ic("chev")}</span></button></div><div class="ft">Invite friends, keep score together and share racket stats.</div></div>
   <div class="sect"><div class="hd">Your racket</div><div class="grp">

     S.trials.push({id:Date.now(),stroke:w.st,goal:ups.length?ups.join(" + "):"test a change",text:describeD(S.d),d:{...S.d},predicted:{ball0:A.ball,ball1:B.ball,rpm0:A.rpm,rpm1:B.rpm},before:{ball:mean(w.q.map(x=>x.r.ball)),rpm:mean(w.q.map(x=>x.r.rpm))},completed:false});wiUpdate();break;}
   case"followup":{const t=S.trials.find(x=>String(x.id)===v);if(t){const q=strokeRows(wiBase().rs,t.stroke);t.after={ball:mean(q.map(x=>x.r.ball)),rpm:mean(q.map(x=>x.r.rpm))};t.completed=true;}wiUpdate();break;}
   case"bestchange":{const w=wiBase(),c=evalCands(w.b),i=S.film&&S.film.stroke===w.st?(c.findIndex(x=>x.title===S.film.title)+1)%c.length:0;S.film={...c[i],stroke:w.st};S.d={...c[i].d};refreshOther();break;}

   case"units":U.metric=!U.metric;paintSess();paintShot();paintRecent();refreshOther();break;
   case"player":setPlayer(+v);break;
