$("skip").addEventListener("click",skipToEnd);
$("pace").addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("button");if(!b)return;SWING_K=+b.dataset.k;[...$("pace").children].forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle("on",x===b));});
$("speed").addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("button");if(!b)return;S.speed=+b.dataset.v;vidNote();[...$("speed").children].forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle("on",x===b));});

/* ---------- source video (YouTube IFrame API, loaded only on click) ---------- */
const VID={bias:0,lead:.5,armed:false,seekAt:0,cur:0,wall:0,waiting:false,tries:0,rateAt:0,warned:false,asked:false,ready:false,player:null,follow:true,seg:null,last:0,state:-1,pending:null,loadedId:null,err:false};
let SEGS=[];
function buildSegments(){
  VID.bias=((PLAYERS[S.pi]||{}).session||{}).video_bias||0;
  SEGS=[];let cur=null;
  rows.forEach(r=>{const c=r.s.clip;if(!cur||cur.clip!==c){cur={clip:c,t0:r.t,t1:r.t,off:r.s.video_t-r.t};SEGS.push(cur);}cur.t1=r.t;});
  SEGS.forEach(g=>{g.c0=g.t0-1;g.c1=g.t1+1;g.off+=VID.bias;});
}
const segAt=clock=>SEGS.find(g=>clock>=g.c0&&clock<=g.c1)||null;
const vtime=sec=>{sec=Math.max(0,Math.floor(sec));const h=Math.floor(sec/3600),m=Math.floor(sec/60)%60,x=sec%60;return (h?h+":"+String(m).padStart(2,"0"):m)+":"+String(x).padStart(2,"0");};
const curVideoId=()=>(PLAYERS[S.pi]||{}).video_id||null;
function ytLink(sec){const id=curVideoId();return id?`https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${id}&t=${Math.max(0,Math.floor(sec))}s`:"#";}
function loadVideo(then){
  if(VID.asked){if(then)seekVideo(then.t);return;}
  VID.asked=true;VID.pending=then||null;
  $("vidbox").hidden=true;$("vidwrap").hidden=false;
  const tag=document.createElement("script");tag.src="https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api";document.head.appendChild(tag);
  window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady=()=>{
    const id=curVideoId(),first=SEGS[0]?SEGS[0].t0+SEGS[0].off:0;
    VID.player=new YT.Player("ytp",{host:"https://www.youtube-nocookie.com",videoId:id,width:"100%",height:"100%",
      playerVars:{rel:0,playsinline:1,modestbranding:1,start:Math.max(0,Math.floor(first-1)),origin:location.origin},
      events:{onReady:()=>{VID.ready=true;VID.loadedId=id;if(VID.pending){seekVideo(VID.pending.t);VID.pending=null;}vidNote();},
              onStateChange:e=>{VID.state=e.data;if(e.data===1&&!S.active&&VID.follow&&!VID.err&&S.speed<=2)startFromVideo();},
              onError:()=>{VID.err=true;vidNote("This video can't be played here. Use “Open on YouTube”.");}}});
  };
}
function seekVideo(sec){
  if(!VID.ready){VID.pending={t:sec};return;}
  VID.seg=null;VID.player.seekTo(Math.max(0,sec),true);VID.player.playVideo();
}
function vidNote(msg){
  const n=$("vidnote");if(!n)return;
  n.textContent=msg||(S.speed>2?"Following the replay works at 1× and 2×. Pick a hit below to jump to it.":"The video and the replay move together: Start Session plays both, End Session pauses both, and pausing or scrubbing the video moves the replay. Between tracked windows it skips the dead air.");
}
function onVidPlayerChange(){
  buildSegments();VID.seg=null;
  const id=curVideoId(),P=PLAYERS[S.pi]||{};
  $("vidpanel").hidden=!id;
  $("vidcredit").textContent=id?`${(P.session&&P.session.provenance&&P.session.provenance.source)||""} — video courtesy of its YouTube uploader.`:"";
  if(VID.ready&&id&&VID.loadedId!==id){VID.player.cueVideoById({videoId:id,startSeconds:SEGS[0]?Math.max(0,SEGS[0].t0+SEGS[0].off-1):0});VID.loadedId=id;}
  paintVidList();
}
function paintVidList(){
  const rs=shownRows(),last=rs.slice(-6).reverse(),box=$("hitlist");if(!box)return;
  if(!curVideoId()){box.innerHTML="";return;}
  const latest=rs[rs.length-1];
  $("vidyt").href=ytLink(latest?latest.s.video_t+VID.bias-1.5:(SEGS[0]?SEGS[0].t0+SEGS[0].off:0));
  box.innerHTML=last.length?`<div class="vnote" style="margin:0">Latest hits — tap one to watch it in the video</div>`+last.map(x=>`<button data-vt="${x.s.video_t}"><span class="d" style="background:${x.sweet?"#34C759":"#FF3B30"}"></span>${x.name}<span class="tm">${vtime(x.s.video_t)}</span></button>`).join(""):`<div class="vnote">Hits appear here as the replay plays. Tap one to see it in the video.</div>`;
}
const videoMasterOn=()=>VID.ready&&VID.follow&&!VID.err&&S.speed<=2;
const videoSegAt=cur=>SEGS.find(g=>cur>=g.c0+g.off-.7&&cur<=g.c1+g.off+.02)||null;      // window by VIDEO time (a seek can land a little early)
const liveState=()=>{if(VID.ready){try{VID.state=VID.player.getPlayerState();}catch(e){}}return VID.state;};   // read the player, not a cached event (events can be missed)
function pauseVideoNow(){if(VID.ready&&(liveState()===1||VID.state===3))VID.player.pauseVideo();}
function rewindShown(){   // the clock moved backwards (the viewer scrubbed): drop hits that haven't happened yet
  let changed=false;while(S.shown>0&&rows[S.shown-1].t>S.clock+.05){S.shown--;changed=true;}
  if(changed){S.lastRow=S.shown?rows[S.shown-1]:null;paintShot();paintRecent();paintSess();paintVidList();}
}
function videoTimeNow(now){   // smooth estimate of the player's position between its coarse updates
  const v=VID.player.getCurrentTime();
  if(v!==VID.cur){VID.cur=v;VID.wall=now;}
  return VID.cur+Math.min(.4,(now-VID.wall)/1000*S.speed);
}
/* While following, the VIDEO is the clock: the replay position is read from the player, so the two cannot drift.
   Buffering or a pause in the player freezes the replay; a scrub moves it. Returns true when the video owns the clock. */
function videoMaster(now){
  liveState();
  if(!videoMasterOn()){
    VID.seg=null;VID.waiting=false;
    if(VID.ready&&S.speed>2)pauseVideoNow();          // YouTube can't play faster than 2x
    return false;
  }
  if(VID.seg===null){                                   // enter a window: seek, then wait for the picture
    let g=segAt(S.clock);
    if(!g){g=SEGS.find(x=>x.c0>S.clock)||null;if(!g){S.clock=endT();return true;}S.clock=g.c0;rewindShown();}   // skip the dead air between windows
    VID.seg=g;VID.waiting=true;VID.armed=true;VID.seekAt=now;VID.tries=0;VID.warned=false;
    VID.player.seekTo(S.clock+g.off+VID.lead,true);VID.player.setPlaybackRate(S.speed);VID.player.playVideo();
    return true;
  }
  const g=VID.seg;
  if(VID.state!==1){                                    // buffering, paused by the viewer, or not started: the replay waits
    if(now-VID.seekAt>5000&&!VID.warned&&VID.state!==3&&VID.state!==2){VID.warned=true;vidNote("The video hasn't started. Press play in the player.");}
    return true;
  }
  const cur=videoTimeNow(now);
  if(VID.waiting){                                      // first picture after a seek: check where it landed
    if(now-VID.seekAt<300)return true;
    const target=S.clock+g.off,miss=cur-target;
    if(Math.abs(miss)>.25&&VID.tries<2){VID.tries++;VID.lead=clamp(VID.lead-miss*.8,-1,2);VID.seekAt=now;VID.player.seekTo(target+VID.lead,true);return true;}
    VID.waiting=false;
  }
  const gv=videoSegAt(cur);
  if(!gv){                                              // past this window, or the viewer scrubbed out of the data
    if(cur>g.c1+g.off)S.clock=g.c1+.01;
    VID.seg=null;return true;
  }
  if(gv!==g)VID.seg=gv;                                 // the viewer scrubbed into another window: follow it
  S.clock=cur-VID.seg.off;rewindShown();
  if(now-VID.rateAt>500){VID.rateAt=now;if(VID.player.getPlaybackRate()!==S.speed)VID.player.setPlaybackRate(S.speed);}
  return true;
}
function startFromVideo(){                              // the viewer pressed play in the player while the session was stopped
  const cur=VID.player.getCurrentTime(),g=videoSegAt(cur);
  if(!g){VID.player.pauseVideo();vidNote("No tracked hits at this point in the video. Press Start Session, or tap a hit below.");return;}
  S.clock=cur-g.off;S.shown=0;while(S.shown<rows.length&&rows[S.shown].t<=S.clock)S.shown++;
  S.lastRow=S.shown?rows[S.shown-1]:null;VID.seg=g;VID.waiting=false;VID.armed=false;
  S.active=true;S.last=performance.now();paintSess();paintShot();paintRecent();renderNav();paintVidList();
}
$("vidload").addEventListener("click",()=>loadVideo());
$("vidfollow").addEventListener("change",e=>{VID.follow=e.target.checked;VID.seg=null;if(!VID.follow)pauseVideoNow();});
$("hitlist").addEventListener("click",e=>{
  const b=e.target.closest("button[data-vt]");if(!b)return;
  VID.follow=false;$("vidfollow").checked=false;
  loadVideo({t:+b.dataset.vt+VID.bias-1.5});
});

function setPlayer(i){
  S.pi=i;S.active=false;S.shown=0;S.clock=-LEAD;S.lastRow=null;S.d=Z();S.film=null;S.trials=[];S.chat=[];S.drill=null;S.drillRun=false;S.plan=null;S.planRun=-1;S.scout="";S.reviews=[];
  const P=PLAYERS[i],ses=P.session;rows=(ses.shots||[]).map(enrich);
  const lab=ses.provenance.labels,pred=ses.provenance.predicted;
  $("prov").innerHTML=pred?`<b>Predicted by a model:</b> each hit's stroke type, which player hit it and when — the F3Tennis tsm_e2espot model (97% stroke-type accuracy on held-out Ostrava hits; not measured on this broadcast). <b>From video:</b> how the hitter's racket moved, tracked with SAM 3.1 (box centre, 25 fps, windows spread through the match). <b>Estimated:</b> speeds, spin, angles, contact points, and the 3D swing built from that motion.<br><a href="${P.video_url}">Source video</a>`:lab?`<b>From the dataset (real):</b> each hit's stroke, forehand/backhand, technique and outcome — ${ses.provenance.labels}. <b>From video:</b> when each hit happened and how the hitter's racket moved, tracked with SAM 3.1 (box centre, 25 fps). <b>Estimated:</b> speeds, spin, angles, contact points, and the 3D swing built from that motion.<br><a href="${P.video_url}">F3Tennis dataset</a>`:
   `<b>From video:</b> ${ses.provenance.source} — shot times and swing intensity, tracked with SAM 3.1 in short windows around contacts (not the full match). Stroke types aren't labelled for this match, so every hit shows as "Hit" with a generic swing. <b>Estimated:</b> speeds, spin, angles, contact points, and the racket's 3D motion.${P.video_url?`<br><a href="${P.video_url}">Source video</a>`:""}`;
  [...$("players").children].forEach((b,k)=>b.classList.toggle("on",k===i));
  paintSess();paintShot();paintRecent();renderNav();refreshOther();onVidPlayerChange();
}
function boot(players){
  PLAYERS=players;
  $("players").innerHTML=players.map((p,i)=>`<button data-i="${i}">${p.name}</button>`).join("");
  $("players").addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("button");if(b)setPlayer(+b.dataset.i);});
  buildLive();setPlayer(0);
  S.last=performance.now();
  (function loop(now){frameLive(now);requestAnimationFrame(loop);})(performance.now());
  window.__emu={S,get rows(){return rows;},simulate,swingFrame,motion,setActive,skipToEnd,go,setTab,THREE,VID,segAt};
}
fetch("emulator_sessions.json").then(r=>r.json()).then(d=>boot(d.players))
 .catch(()=>fetch("emulator_session.json").then(r=>r.json()).then(s=>boot([{name:"Demo",video_url:null,session:s}])))
 .catch(e=>{$("prov").textContent="Could not load emulator_sessions.json — serve this folder over HTTP or deploy the files together. "+e;});

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Tennis Buddee</title>
<meta name="claude:viewport-fit-sides" content="cover">
<meta name="description" content="Tennis Buddee lives inside your racket handle. It hears every hit, measures every swing and shows you what to change between points.">
<meta property="og:title" content="Tennis Buddee">
<meta property="og:description" content="Find the sweet spot.">
<meta property="og:image" content="img/reveal_serve.jpg">
<link rel="icon" href="img/icon.png">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,500..800&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600&display=swap">
<style>
/* Tennis-ball felt yellow and ink on paper. A felt hero with the ball's seam as the signature curve,
   then calm editorial sections; "what it does" is drawn as a court seen from above. Single light look. */
:root {
  --felt: #DDE85B;
  --felt-deep: #C9D640;
  --ink: #1D2614;
  --ink-soft: #3F4A32;
  --muted: #5B6450;
  --paper: #FBFAF3;
  --rule: #E2E0D2;
  --seam: #FBFBF4;
  --display: "Bricolage Grotesque", "Arial Black", Arial, sans-serif;
  --sans: "DM Sans", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  color-scheme: light;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
body { margin: 0; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 400 18px/1.55 var(--sans); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
a { color: inherit; }
a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; }
.wrap { max-width: 1160px; margin: 0 auto; padding-left: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px)); padding-right: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px)); }
h1, h2, h3 { font-family: var(--display); margin: 0; text-wrap: balance; }
h3 { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
p { margin: 0; }
.label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-soft); }
.btn { display: inline-block; padding: 13px 22px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--felt); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; }
.btn.alt { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border: 2px solid var(--ink); }
mark { background: var(--felt); color: var(--ink); padding: 0 0.12em; border-radius: 0.12em; }

/* ---- Hero ---- */
.hero { background: var(--felt); position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.hero svg.seam { position: absolute; right: -180px; top: -120px; width: 820px; height: 820px; z-index: 0; }
.hero .wrap { position: relative; z-index: 1; padding-block: 24px 88px; display: grid; gap: 56px; }
.top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
.brand { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; font: 800 20px/1 var(--display); text-decoration: none; }
.brand img { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 9px; }
.hero-body { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 48px; align-items: center; }
.hero h1 { font-size: clamp(60px, 9vw, 128px); font-weight: 800; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.035em; }
.hero p { font-size: 20px; color: var(--ink-soft); max-width: 32ch; margin-top: 22px; }
.hero .cta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; margin-top: 30px; }
.hero img { border-radius: 36px; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; object-fit: cover; object-position: 22% 50%; width: 100%; border: 6px solid var(--seam); }
@media (max-width: 820px) { .hero-body { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .hero img { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; } .hero svg.seam { right: -320px; } }

/* ---- What it does: a court from above ---- */
.court-sec { padding-block: 88px; }
.court-sec .label { display: block; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.court { background: var(--ink); border: 4px solid var(--ink); outline: 3px solid var(--seam); outline-offset: -10px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; color: var(--seam); border-radius: 6px; }
.court > div { padding: 44px 36px; display: grid; gap: 12px; align-content: start; min-width: 0; }
.court > div + div { border-left: 3px solid var(--seam); }
.court .n { font: 800 64px/1 var(--display); letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: var(--felt); }
.court p { color: #C9D0BE; }
@media (max-width: 820px) { .court { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .court > div + div { border-left: 0; border-top: 3px solid var(--seam); } }

/* ---- Strip ---- */
.strip { padding-block: 24px 96px; }
.strip .wrap { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr); gap: 56px; align-items: center; }
.strip h2 { font-size: clamp(42px, 5.2vw, 68px); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1; }
.strip p { color: var(--muted); margin-top: 20px; max-width: 42ch; }
.strip img { border-radius: 28px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; object-fit: cover; width: 100%; }
@media (max-width: 820px) { .strip .wrap { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 32px; } }

/* ---- Roadmap ---- */
.road { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); padding-block: 80px; }
.road .grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 32px; margin-top: 28px; }
.road .grid div { display: grid; gap: 10px; align-content: start; min-width: 0; }
.road .when { font: 800 40px/1 var(--display); letter-spacing: -0.03em; justify-self: start; }
.road .grid div:first-child .when { background: var(--felt); padding: 4px 14px; border-radius: 12px; }
.road .grid p { color: var(--muted); }
@media (max-width: 820px) { .road .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 28px; } }

/* ---- Contact ---- */
.contact { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); padding-block: 96px; }
.contact .wrap { display: grid; gap: 22px; justify-items: start; }
.contact h2 { font-size: clamp(56px, 8vw, 112px); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 0.9; }
.contact h2 em { font-style: normal; color: var(--felt); }
.contact .mail { font: 600 clamp(22px, 2.8vw, 30px)/1.2 var(--sans); user-select: all; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
footer { background: var(--ink); color: #A9B19E; font-size: 14px; padding-block: 0 calc(32px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header class="hero">
  <svg class="seam" viewBox="0 0 800 800" aria-hidden="true">
    <circle cx="400" cy="400" r="380" fill="#C9D640"/>
    <path d="M140 120 C 330 260, 330 540, 140 680" fill="none" stroke="#FBFBF4" stroke-width="22" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M660 120 C 470 260, 470 540, 660 680" fill="none" stroke="#FBFBF4" stroke-width="22" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </svg>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="top">
      <a class="brand" href="#"><img src="img/icon.png" alt="">Tennis Buddee</a>
      <a class="btn alt" href="#contact">Contact</a>
    </div>
    <div class="hero-body">
      <div>
        <h1>Find the sweet spot.</h1>
        <p>A smart module inside your racket handle that hears every hit, measures every swing and shows you what to change between points.</p>      </div>
      <img src="img/reveal_serve.jpg" alt="A player at full stretch on a serve under a cloudy sky">
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<section class="court-sec"><div class="wrap">
  <span class="label">What it does</span>
  <div class="court">
    <div><span class="n">7</span><h3>Stats on every shot</h3><p>Swing speed, ball speed, spin, face angle, swing path and shot type.</p></div>
    <div><span class="n">1</span><h3>Sweet spot, by ear</h3><p>AI on the racket hears each hit and tells you how far off center it was.</p></div>
    <div><span class="n">AI</span><h3>Meta Muse Spark</h3><p>Muse Spark reads your shots, predicts what a swing change will do, and plans a drill for your Watch and Ray-Ban Display.</p></div>
  </div>
</div></section>

<section class="strip"><div class="wrap">
  <div>
    <h2>Same racket. <mark>New game.</mark></h2>
    <p>The sensors sit inside the handle, so the racket looks and plays like yours. Your phone and Apple Watch show each shot as you play.</p>
  </div>
  <img src="img/reveal_app.jpg" alt="A player hitting a forehand beside the Tennis Buddee app showing the live shot">
</div></section>

<section class="road"><div class="wrap">
  <p class="label">Where we’re headed</p>
  <div class="grid">
    <div><span class="when">Now</span><p>Working prototype. iPhone and Mac apps live; Apple Watch and sweet-spot AI in beta. <a href="emulator.html">Try the pro-match emulator</a>.</p></div>
    <div><span class="when">Next</span><p>Train on real court data, validate against high-speed video, sealed custom module.</p></div>
    <div><span class="when">Later</span><p>A retail module under $100, club dashboards, pickleball and padel.</p></div>
  </div>
</div></section>

<section class="contact" id="contact"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>Let’s <em>rally.</em></h2>
  <p style="color:#C8CFBE">Investors, clubs, academies and hardware partners.</p>
  <p class="mail">quentin.lynch@wsu.edu</p>
</div></section>
<footer><div class="wrap">© 2026 Tennis Buddee · Pullman, Washington</div></footer>
</body>
</html>
